title: Awomo-SimDataEngine: Agentic Simulation-ReadyWorld Generation
summary: Generating useful robot-training data requires more than visually plausiblescenes: objects must support interaction, placements must remain physicallyvalid, and tasks must admit repeatable execution. We present\textbf{Awomo-SimDataEngine}, an agentic system that connects asset and scenegeneration to robot demonstration synthesis. Shared asset services providerigid and articulated objects, including structure-grounded part and jointgeneration with ISArt. Scene generation supports two complementary routes:Unravel reconstructs editable scenes from images, while SimForge buildssingle-room and multi-room environments from text. A graph-native harnesscoordinates construction, validation, andbounded repair, routing failures to the responsible module while retainingunaffected scene state. PolicyForge binds validated worlds to tasks and robotembodiments to produce replayable demonstrations. Evaluations cover assetgeometry, scene quality, and downstream policy learning. On MuJoCo-basedLIBERO-Plus, co-training with Isaac Sim demonstrations improves the overallsuccess rate of a World-Action Model (WAM) from $77.17\%$ to $89.43\%$. Goal and spatialsuccess improve by $31.66$ and $6.25$ percentage points, respectively.These results support the utility of the generated data for cross-simulatorpolicy training, with more limited gains on long-horizon tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出Awomo-SimDataEngine智能体系统，将资产生成、场景生成与机器人示教合成打通，通过图原生协调框架实现构建-验证-修复闭环，并验证生成数据可提升跨模拟器策略训练效果。
AI.motivation: 有用的机器人训练数据不仅需要视觉上合理的场景，还要求物体可交互、布局物理有效、任务可重复执行。现有数据生成方法难以同时满足这些条件，缺乏从资产、场景到机器人示教的端到端生成与验证机制。
AI.method: 构建Awomo-SimDataEngine智能体系统，包含共享资产服务（借助ISArt生成结构基础的部件与关节，支持刚体和铰接物体）；场景生成两条路径：Unravel从图像重建可编辑场景，SimForge从文本构建单房间与多房间环境；采用图原生（graph-native）协调框架统一构建、验证与有界修复，将失败路由至对应模块并保留未受影响的场景状态；PolicyForge将验证过的世界绑定到任务与机器人本体，生成可回放示教数据。评估覆盖资产几何、场景质量与下游策略学习。
AI.result: 在基于MuJoCo的LIBERO-Plus上，与Isaac Sim示教数据协同训练使World-Action Model（WAM）总体成功率从77.17%提升至89.43%；目标成功率与空间成功率分别提升31.66和6.25个百分点。长时程任务上提升较为有限。
AI.conclusion: 生成数据对跨模拟器策略训练具有实用价值；系统实现了资产生成到示教合成的有效衔接，但在长时程任务上仍有改进空间。

title: World-Calibrated Proposal-to-Action Flow for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Flow-based Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies generate action chunks by transporting samples from a task-agnostic isotropic Gaussian source. As this source is conditioned on neither recent execution nor predicted future evolution, (i) it discards the local continuity established by recently executed motion. (ii) Even when predictive world representations are introduced, they often only condition the transport dynamics rather than determine where generation starts, how far it may deviate, or along which action directions it may expand. Building on this observation, we introduce ProAct, a world-calibrated proposal-to-action framework that makes the generative source itself predictable. (i) To preserve motion continuity, a lightweight Proposal Expert converts recent actions into a scene-aware hypothesis via one motion-anchored endpoint flow-matching step, initializing generation near the demonstrated action manifold. (ii) To jointly capture intended scene evolution and proposal-future compatibility, a prospective World Expert treats the hypothesis as a soft motion prior while predicting the task-consistent latent future. (iii) From this compatibility, the model calibrates a proposal-centered anisotropic source, where a bounded per-step extent controls the allowed deviation and a trace-normalized low-rank geometry under a condition-number budget allocates refinement over coupled translation, rotation, and gripper directions. Compared with $π_{0.5}$, ProAct improves performance across simulation and real-world tasks while reducing denoising steps by 50%, inference latency by up to 25.8%, and increasing throughput by up to 34.8%.

AI.tldr: ProAct 提出世界模型校准的 proposal-to-action 框架，使流式 VLA 策略的生成源本身可预测：用近期动作生成场景感知假设作为起点，再由世界专家预测潜在未来并校准各向异性源分布，在仿真与真实任务上超越 π0.5，同时降步数、降延迟、提吞吐。
AI.motivation: 现有基于流的 VLA 策略从任务无关的各向同性高斯源采样动作块，该源既不依赖近期执行也不依赖未来演化预测，因而丢弃了近期运动建立的局部连续性；即便引入预测性世界表示，也往往只条件化传输动力学，而不决定生成的起点、允许的偏离范围与可扩展的动作方向。
AI.method: ProAct 由三部分组成：(i) 轻量 Proposal Expert 通过一次动作锚定的端点流匹配步骤，将近期动作转换为场景感知假设，使生成初始化在示范动作流形附近；(ii) 前瞻性 World Expert 将该假设作为软运动先验，同时预测任务一致的潜在未来，联合捕捉意图场景演化与 proposal-future 兼容性；(iii) 基于该兼容性校准以 proposal 为中心的各向异性源：用有界每步 extent 控制允许偏离，并在条件数预算下用迹归一化低秩几何在耦合的平移、旋转和夹爪方向上分配细化。
AI.result: 与 π0.5 相比，ProAct 在仿真和真实世界任务上均提升性能，同时将去噪步数减少 50%，推理延迟最多降低 25.8%，吞吐量最多提升 34.8%。
AI.conclusion: 让生成源本身可预测（而非仅条件化传输动力学）是提升流式 VLA 策略效率与性能的有效途径；ProAct 通过 proposal 初始化与世界校准的各向异性源，实现了性能与推理效率的同步改进。

title: SoTa: Soft Tactile Skins for Dexterous Manipulation
comment: The first three authors contributed equally. Project website: https://sota-skin.github.io
summary: A growing body of work suggests that tactile sensing gives robot policies contact information that complements vision in dexterous manipulation. However, visuo-tactile robot data remains scarce: dexterous demonstrations require teleoperating robots, which limits dataset scale. Human demonstrations are far cheaper to collect and offer a path to scale this data, but only if human and robot hands carry tactile sensors with corresponding signals. This requires sensors that conform to different hand geometries, cover the full hand, and share a common layout across embodiments. We present SoTa, a low-cost capacitive tactile skin that provides full-hand coverage on humans and robots while preserving a shared layout of 202 taxels across corresponding finger and palm regions. Our multilayer design with fabric electrodes enables in-house fabrication of thin, soft skins with customizable geometry for under $10 in materials per skin. The sensor retains over 97% of its initial response span after 10,000 loading-unloading cycles with traces retaining continuity through 1,280 tight-fist folding cycles. The shared taxel layout supports human-robot co-training with a common tactile encoder and no learned cross-sensor mapping. Across three contact-rich manipulation tasks, tactile observations improve in-distribution success over vision-only policies. With a fixed robot demonstration budget, adding human demonstrations more than doubles mean success across eight evaluation conditions, from 22.8% to 45.9%, improving success in all five out-of-distribution conditions. We plan to open-source the resources needed to fabricate and operate these skins.

AI.tldr: 提出SoTa低成本电容式触觉皮肤，实现人手与机器人手全掌覆盖且共享202个taxel布局，支持人机协同训练，显著提升接触丰富操作任务成功率。
AI.motivation: 视触觉机器人数据稀缺，灵巧示教依赖遥操作限制数据规模；人类示教成本低但需人手与机器手配备信号对应的触觉传感器，要求传感器能贴合不同手部几何、覆盖全手、并在不同本体间共享布局。
AI.method: 设计多层结构、织物电极的电容式触觉皮肤，材料成本低于10美元，可定制几何；保持人手与机器人手指及手掌对应区域202个taxel的共享布局，从而使用统一触觉编码器、无需学习跨传感器映射，实现人机协同训练。
AI.result: 10,000次加载-卸载循环后保留超过97%初始响应幅度，1,280次紧握拳折叠循环后迹线保持连续；三个接触丰富操作任务中触觉观测提升分布内成功率；固定机器人示教预算下加入人类示教使八个评估条件平均成功率从22.8%提升至45.9%，五个分布外条件全部提升。
AI.conclusion: SoTa以低成本、可自制、耐用的共享布局触觉皮肤，为规模化人机协同视触觉数据采集与策略学习提供可行路径，并计划开源制造与操作资源。

title: NEEDLEWORK: Offline Rewriting of Robot Data with Verified Local Stitches
comment: Submitted to ICLR 2027. Project page: https://needle-work.github.io
summary: Robot demonstrations may contain useful behavior even when individual episodes are inefficient or unsuccessful. Trajectory stitching offers a way to compose these behaviors into improved training data, but identifying useful connections and verifying their feasibility is difficult in high-dimensional robot data, where many prior methods rely on low-dimensional state representations. We introduce NEEDLE, an offline dataset-augmentation algorithm that addresses these challenges by adding short, verified action bridges between recorded observations in high-dimensional robot demonstrations. First, NEEDLE identifies and creates connections that bypass suboptimal detours, broaden action coverage, and augment the original dataset with failed trajectories, using only RGB images, proprioception, and episode-level outcomes, without new environment interaction or privileged object state. Next, we present a sampling technique that incorporates accepted bridges into policy training without synthesizing intermediate images or discarding the original demonstrations, allowing policies to learn alternative actions while retaining the original dataset's coverage. On real-robot tasks, NEEDLE improves success rate over the strongest baseline on each task by an average of 21 percentage points. Videos and supplementary materials are on https://needle-work.github.io/.

AI.tldr: NEEDLE是一种离线数据集增强算法，通过在高维机器人演示的观测之间添加短小且经过验证的动作桥接，实现轨迹缝合以改善策略训练。
AI.motivation: 机器人演示中即使单条轨迹低效或失败，也可能包含有用行为。轨迹缝合可将这些行为组合为更优训练数据，但在高维机器人数据中识别有用连接并验证其可行性很困难，先前方法多依赖低维状态表示。
AI.method: NEEDLE仅使用RGB图像、本体感知和轨迹级结果，无需新环境交互或特权物体状态，识别并创建可绕过次优弯路、扩大动作覆盖、并利用失败轨迹增强数据集的连接；随后提出采样技术，将接受的桥接纳入策略训练，而不合成中间图像、也不丢弃原始演示。
AI.result: 在真实机器人任务上，NEEDLE相较每个任务最强基线平均提升成功率21个百分点。
AI.conclusion: NEEDLE通过高维观测下的验证式动作桥接与训练采样，实现了有效的离线数据集增强，在保留原始演示覆盖的同时让策略学习替代动作，显著提升真实机器人任务成功率。

title: EditHero: A Benchmark for Long-Horizon Part-Level 3D Editing and Vibe Modeling
summary: 3D editing methods are usually tested on a single edit, yet an asset is built through a long sequence of revisions, each of which must implement the requested change while leaving everything else unchanged. We introduce EditHero, to our knowledge the first benchmark for long-horizon, part-level 3D editing, with natural-language instructions and target images for both geometry and texture. A deterministic assembly engine produces the exact target after every edit, and every sequence is reviewed by hand. We use EditHero to compare 2 opposite approaches to 3D editing. Non-agentic methods operate top down, regenerating the object from a learned 3D representation and inferring what to keep. In contrast, LLM/VLM agents operate bottom up, editing through code that inspects the mesh and rewrites only the parts required by instructions. The non-agentic methods often miss the requested change and disturb regions that should stay fixed. Most LLMs follow instructions more closely, and all of them preserve the unedited parts better, but each of their edits takes minutes. We will release the engine and the edit sequences to support research on reliable iterative 3D editing.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 EditHero——首个面向长程、部件级 3D 编辑的基准，采用自然语言指令与几何/纹理目标图像，通过确定性装配引擎与人工审核构建编辑序列，并对比非智能体式（自顶向下）与 LLM/VLM 智能体式（自底向上）两类方法。
AI.motivation: 现有 3D 编辑方法通常仅针对单次编辑进行测试，但真实资产是通过一长串修订逐步构建的，每次编辑都必须实现所要求的改动同时保持其余部分不变。缺乏能够评估这种长程、部件级迭代编辑能力的基准，是本文的核心动因。
AI.method: 构建 EditHero 基准：包含带自然语言指令与几何、纹理目标图像的长程部件级 3D 编辑序列；使用确定性装配引擎保证每次编辑后都能得到精确目标状态，且每条序列均经人工审核。利用该基准对比两类相反方法——非智能体式（自顶向下，从学习到的 3D 表示重新生成对象并推断需保留内容）与 LLM/VLM 智能体式（自底向上，通过代码检查网格并仅重写指令所需部件）。
AI.result: 非智能体式方法往往无法实现所要求的改动，并扰动本应保持不变的区域；多数 LLM 更严格遵循指令，且所有 LLM 智能体方法在保持未编辑部分方面表现更好，但每次编辑耗时数分钟。
AI.conclusion: EditHero 揭示了现有两类 3D 编辑范式在长程迭代场景下的权衡：指令遵循与局部保持能力 vs 编辑效率。作者将公开装配引擎与编辑序列，以支持可靠的迭代式 3D 编辑研究。

title: MintFlow: Minimal Trajectory Intervention for Constrained Flow Matching
summary: Flow matching models excel at generative modeling, and many downstream applications require their samples to satisfy prescribed constraints, such as observed measurements and physical laws. However, existing constrained samplers often face a trade-off: \textit{enforcing constraints can substantially displace samples from the pretrained data distribution}. To address this trade-off, we introduce \textbf{MintFlow}, a training-free constrained sampling framework that formulates constraint enforcement as a minimal intervention on the pretrained flow trajectory. MintFlow seeks the minimal perturbation of an intermediate flow state such that its subsequent evolution under the pretrained flow field satisfies the target constraint. By minimally perturbing the flow state while keeping the pretrained flow field unchanged, MintFlow enforces the constraint while minimizing unnecessary deviation from the pretrained distribution. An adjoint formulation yields a closed-form expression for this perturbation, eliminating expensive iterative optimization. Furthermore, MintFlow adaptively selects the intervention time to balance the required perturbation magnitude with its amplification by the remaining flow. Across a range of tasks in generative vision and physical system modeling, MintFlow achieves competitive constraint satisfaction while preserving the pretrained generative distribution substantially better than state-of-the-art constrained methods.

AI.tldr: MintFlow是一个免训练的约束采样框架，将约束满足表述为对预训练流轨迹的最小干预，通过伴随公式获得闭式扰动解，在满足约束的同时更好地保持预训练分布。
AI.motivation: 流匹配模型在生成建模中表现优异，但许多下游应用要求其样本满足预设约束（如观测测量和物理规律）。然而现有约束采样器面临一种权衡：强制满足约束往往会使样本大幅偏离预训练数据分布。因此需要一种方法在满足约束的同时最小化对预训练分布的偏离。
AI.method: 提出MintFlow，一种免训练的约束采样框架，将约束满足表述为对预训练流轨迹的最小干预。它在中间流状态上寻求最小扰动，使得其在预训练流场下的后续演化满足目标约束；通过最小扰动流状态并保持预训练流场不变，在满足约束的同时最小化不必要的分布偏离。采用伴随公式给出该扰动的闭式表达，避免昂贵的迭代优化；并自适应选择干预时刻，以平衡所需扰动幅度与其被剩余流放大的程度。
AI.result: 在生成式视觉和物理系统建模的一系列任务中，MintFlow在实现有竞争力的约束满足的同时，比当前最先进的约束方法更好地保持了预训练生成分布。
AI.conclusion: MintFlow通过在预训练流轨迹上施加最小干预并结合伴随闭式解与自适应干预时刻选择，有效缓解了约束满足与分布保真之间的权衡，在多种任务上优于现有约束采样方法。

title: Hybrid Machine Learning-Assisted Raman Spectroscopy with Generative Feature Augmentation for Pharmaceutical Identification
summary: Rapid and reliable identification of pharmaceutical residues is important for safeguarding public health, ensuring food safety, and enabling practical Raman-based screening. In this study, we propose HyMLRaman, a hybrid Raman spectroscopy framework that combines deep spectral feature extraction, generative models, and classical machine-learning classifiers to identify six pharmaceutical compounds, including amoxicillin, chloramphenicol, ciprofloxacin, tetracycline, ibuprofen, and paracetamol. Raman spectra are converted into spectral images and encoded with several deep neural-network backbones, among which EfficientNet-B3 yields the most effective representation. The resulting 1536-dimensional embeddings are then used to train downstream classifiers, including SVM, KNN, logistic regression, random forest, XGBoost, and ANN, using stratified 10-fold cross-validation. The hybrid EfficientNet-B3--SVM configuration achieves the strongest baseline performance, reaching 96.31% accuracy and a macro-F1 score of 96.36%, outperforming the standalone CNN baseline. To address limited-data conditions, a generative model, a DDPM-based feature augmentation, is introduced in a PCA-reduced EfficientNet-B3 latent space. The low-data ablation results show that DDPM augmentation provides selective benefits, particularly for KNN with reduced training fractions, and that its effect remains classifier-dependent. Finally, an application-level Raman Pharmaceutical Analyzer demonstrates the feasibility of embedding the trained model into an interactive Raman analysis workflow. These results suggest that HyMLRaman provides a practical and interpretable route for rapid Raman-based pharmaceutical screening.

AI.tldr: 提出HyMLRaman混合框架，将深度光谱特征提取、生成模型与经典机器学习分类器结合，实现六种药物残留的快速拉曼识别，EfficientNet-B3--SVM达96.31%准确率，DDPM增强在低数据下对KNN有选择性收益。
AI.motivation: 药物残留的快速可靠识别对保障公共健康、食品安全及实用拉曼筛查至关重要，但现有方法在特征表达与有限数据条件下仍面临挑战。
AI.method: 将拉曼光谱转为光谱图像，用多种深度骨干网络编码，EfficientNet-B3表现最佳，输出1536维嵌入；以此训练SVM、KNN、逻辑回归、随机森林、XGBoost和ANN，采用分层10折交叉验证；并在PCA降维的EfficientNet-B3潜空间中引入DDPM进行特征增强以应对低数据场景。
AI.result: EfficientNet-B3--SVM组合基线最优，准确率96.31%、宏F1 96.36%，优于独立CNN基线；低数据消融显示DDPM增强收益具有选择性，对训练比例较低的KNN较明显，且效果依赖分类器。
AI.conclusion: HyMLRaman为快速拉曼药物筛查提供了实用且可解释的路径，并可通过交互式Raman Pharmaceutical Analyzer嵌入实际分析流程。

title: Filter-Aware Fine-Tuning for Safe Humanoid Whole-Body Tracking
summary: Safe whole-body motion is essential for deploying humanoid robots in unstructured environments. Modern humanoid control commonly separates reference specification from execution, with a planner, teleoperator, or motion generator providing a reference that a reinforcement-learning policy tracks through dynamically feasible whole-body control. Runtime safety filters, such as control barrier functions (CBFs), offer a promising approach for enforcing newly introduced constraints via interventions on the tracker's outputs. We show, however, that treating the tracking policy and safety filter independently induces fundamental mismatches, as filtering alters both the executed actions and the induced state distribution. We study this policy-filter interface through case studies that isolate dynamics, objective, and information mismatches, highlight their root causes, and use these insights to develop CoFiT (Constrained Filter-aware Tuning), a filter-aware fine-tuning method for pretrained trackers. Across diverse constraint scenes, CoFiT reduces violation time relative to filter-only training by 91% on TWIST2 and 21% on SONIC, while requiring smaller safety filter corrections. On Unitree G1 hardware, CoFiT reduces violation time by 83% for TWIST2 and completes every trial without operator intervention, whereas 50% of baseline trials require an operator stop. Together, these results provide actionable insights into policy-filter interactions and establish design principles for integrating learned trackers with runtime safety filters.

AI.tldr: 本文研究人形机器人全身运动中"跟踪策略"与"运行时安全滤波器"之间的耦合失配问题，提出滤波器感知微调方法CoFiT，通过让预训练跟踪器在微调阶段感知滤波器干预，显著降低约束违反时间与滤波器修正量，并在真实硬件上验证有效性。
AI.motivation: 人形机器人在非结构化环境中部署需保证全身运动安全。现有方法将参考生成（规划器/遥操作/运动生成器）与执行（强化学习跟踪策略）解耦，并借助控制障碍函数（CBF）等运行时安全滤波器在跟踪器输出上施加新约束。然而作者指出，将跟踪策略与安全滤波器独立看待会引发根本性失配：滤波不仅改变执行动作，也改变了诱导的状态分布，导致策略与滤波器接口存在动力学、目标与信息层面的错配，威胁安全性与任务完成度。
AI.method: 作者通过案例研究系统剖析策略-滤波器接口，分别隔离并分析动力学失配、目标失配与信息失配的根因。基于这些洞察提出CoFiT（Constrained Filter-aware Tuning），一种面向预训练跟踪器的滤波器感知微调方法，使跟踪策略在训练中考虑滤波干预带来的动作与状态分布变化。
AI.result: 在多种约束场景中，CoFiT相比仅使用滤波器训练（filter-only training）将违反约束时间在TWIST2上降低91%、在SONIC上降低21%，同时所需的安全滤波器修正更小。在Unitree G1硬件上，CoFiT在TWIST2中减少83%的违反时间，且每次试验均无需操作员干预完成；而基线方法有50%的试验需要操作员急停。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了跟踪策略与运行时安全滤波器交互的可操作机理，并确立了将学习型跟踪器与安全滤波器集成的设计原则，表明滤波器感知微调可同时提升安全性与执行可靠性。

title: DeskForge: Dense Supervision from Desktop Environments for Computer-Use Agents
comment: 37 pages, 15 figures, 12 tables. Project page: https://saidgurbuz.github.io/deskforge/
summary: Computer-use agents need to reliably ground action targets in complex desktop scenes, where multiple applications, overlapping windows, and visually similar controls compete for attention. Existing training data rarely pair such scenes with dense annotations or vary them in a controlled way. We introduce DeskForge, a controllable desktop environment that composes and explores real applications to generate large-scale supervision for computer-use agents. It varies application states, content, window layout, appearance, and resolution, and fuses screenshots, accessibility trees, and window geometry into dense element annotations while recording the outcome of each executed action. Using this environment, we construct DeskForge-1M, a corpus of 1.2M annotated desktop observations containing 159.7M element instances. We fine-tune four vision-language models on 200K grounding examples drawn from DeskForge-1M. All four improve across held-out desktop conditions and on all five external GUI grounding benchmarks; for Qwen3.5-4B, accuracy increases by 11.51 percentage points on ScreenSpot-Pro and 10.11 points on OSWorld-G. The gains also translate to long-horizon task completion: under a fixed planner, the fine-tuned action models solve more WebArena-Infinity and OpenApps tasks, with Qwen3.5-4B increasing from 31 to 50 of 119 tasks and from 3 to 15 of 100 tasks, respectively. These results show that controllable composition of real desktop environments provides a scalable source of supervision for improving both GUI grounding and long-horizon computer use. The framework code, the dataset, and the fine-tuned model are available from the project page: https://saidgurbuz.github.io/deskforge/

AI.tldr: 本文提出可控桌面环境 DeskForge，通过组合真实应用生成大规模标注数据，构建 120 万条观测、1.597 亿元素实例的 DeskForge-1M 语料，微调四个视觉语言模型后在 GUI 定位与长程任务完成上均取得显著提升。
AI.motivation: 计算机使用智能体需在复杂桌面场景中可靠定位操作目标，但多个应用、重叠窗口与视觉相似控件相互干扰；已有训练数据很少将此类场景与密集标注配对，也缺乏可控的变化方式，导致监督信号稀缺且多样性不足。
AI.method: 构建可控桌面环境 DeskForge，组合并探索真实应用，系统变化应用状态、内容、窗口布局、外观与分辨率；融合截图、可访问性树与窗口几何信息生成密集元素标注，并记录每次执行动作的结果。基于该环境构建 DeskForge-1M 语料（120 万条标注观测、1.597 亿元素实例），从中抽取 20 万条定位样本微调四个视觉语言模型。
AI.result: 四个模型在留出桌面条件及五个外部 GUI 定位基准上全面提升；Qwen3.5-4B 在 ScreenSpot-Pro 上提升 11.51 个百分点，在 OSWorld-G 上提升 10.11 个百分点。在固定规划器下，微调后的动作模型完成更多长程任务：WebArena-Infinity 由 119 个任务中完成 31 个提升至 50 个，OpenApps 由 100 个中完成 3 个提升至 15 个。
AI.conclusion: 可控地组合真实桌面环境可为计算机使用智能体提供可扩展的监督来源，同时提升 GUI 定位能力与长程任务完成能力；框架代码、数据集与微调模型已公开。

title: Fast Models, Slow Evidence: A Paired and Self-Audited Evaluation of System-1 Decision Models for LLM Agent Harnesses
summary: Agent harnesses make many small, typed decisions per task: which model to call, which tool to use, whether retrieved text is relevant, whether an input carries an injection. System-1 decision models answer such questions in a single forward pass with class probabilities, promising large cost and latency savings over LLM calls. We present a paired evaluation of an open-weight (Laya) and a hosted (Jev) System-1 model on 11 agent decision points built from 18 public sources: 7,283 base cases plus 6,640 robustness variants, with byte-identical inputs, paired tests, and cross-hardware and cross-day reproducibility checks. Jev is significantly more accurate on 9 of 11 decision points (+10.8 to +46.0 pp). Neither model beats chance on zero-shot model routing, and they tie on RAG relevance gating. Laya changes 30% of its answers when the option order is reversed and degrades sharply with many or similar candidates (31% at 50 nearest-neighbour tools, vs. 98% for Jev on items with a unique correct tool). We also audit our own pipeline. Three analysis errors and one design confound distorted headline deployment claims: an omitted pre-screen cost (reported 23.9% saving, actual 4.3%), gate accuracy reported as end-to-end quality (58% vs. 98%), in-sample thresholds (5% target, up to 17% held-out misses), and a "channel effect" on injection false positives that vanishes with channel-native content. Two other suspected confounds did not change the conclusions. All cases, raw outputs and analysis code are available at https://github.com/David-DL-Space/sys1-eval.

AI.tldr: 对开源(Laya)与托管(Jev)两个System-1决策模型在11个智能体决策点进行配对评测(7,283基础案例+6,640鲁棒性变体)，Jev在9个决策点上显著最优，两者在零样本模型路由上均不优于随机；同时作者对自身流水线进行审计，发现三处分析错误与一处设计混淆曾夸大部署收益。
AI.motivation: 智能体框架每步需做大量小型类型化决策(选模型、选工具、判断检索相关性、检测注入)，用System-1决策模型单次前向传播即可给出类别概率，有望比调用LLM大幅节省成本与延迟。但此类模型的实际可靠性缺乏严格、可复现的配对评测，且现有部署收益宣称可能受分析缺陷影响，因此需要系统评测并自我审计。
AI.method: 构建11个决策点、来自18个公开数据源的大规模基准：7,283个基础案例加6,640个鲁棒性变体，所有输入逐字节一致；采用配对检验，并做跨硬件与跨日期可复现性验证。对比开源模型Laya与托管模型Jev。鲁棒性探测包括选项顺序反转、候选数量与相似度干扰等。此外对自身分析流水线进行审计，识别并修正错误与设计混淆。
AI.result: Jev在11个决策点中的9个上显著更准(+10.8至+46.0个百分点)。两模型在零样本模型路由上均未超过随机水平，在RAG相关性门控上打平。Laya在选项顺序反转时改变30%答案；候选多且相似时性能急剧下降(50个最近邻工具时仅31%，而Jev在有唯一正确工具的条目上达98%)。流水线审计发现：遗漏预筛成本(宣称节省23.9%，实际仅4.3%)、将门控准确率当作端到端质量(58% vs. 98%)、样本内阈值(目标5%但留出集误报最高17%)，以及随通道原生内容消失的注入假阳性“通道效应”；另两个可疑混淆未改变结论。
AI.conclusion: System-1决策模型在部分决策点上具有成本与延迟优势，但性能高度依赖决策点类型与实现质量；开源与托管模型差距显著，且鲁棒性问题(顺序敏感、候选干扰)突出。研究还表明部署收益的宣称极易被分析错误与设计混淆夸大，需严格审计；所有案例、原始输出与分析代码已公开以保证可复现。

title: The Price of Greenwashing: Algorithmic Verification and Market Discipline using Conformal Machine Learning
summary: While corporate sustainability mandates are expanding, the systemic reliance on self-reported emissions data exposes financial markets to pervasive greenwashing. Current literature relies heavily on subjective ESG ratings or textual sentiment analysis, leaving a critical econometric gap in objectively quantifying physical climate realities. To resolve this information asymmetry, we fuse U.S. SEC financial fundamentals with facility-level EPA greenhouse gas registries to establish a mathematically guaranteed baseline of physical corporate emissions. Leveraging a gradient boosting architecture and Mondrian Conformal Prediction, we quantify the shortfall between self-reported data and this algorithmic baseline into a novel Conformal-Weighted Continuous Divergence (CWCD) metric. Evaluating this divergence via a cross-sectional lead-lag econometric design, we uncover a robust mechanism of market discipline: algorithmic emissions divergence exhibits a severe, statistically significant negative relationship with subsequent market valuation (Tobin's Q) and operational profitability (ROA). Providing definitive evidence against the market blindness hypothesis, this study proves that institutional capital actively prices environmental deception not merely as an ethical lapse, but as a leading indicator of fundamental corporate mismanagement. Ultimately, these findings provide the quantitative justification necessary for asset managers and regulators to deploy algorithmic auditing infrastructure at scale.

AI.tldr: 本研究融合美国SEC财务基本面与EPA设施级温室气体登记数据，构建物理排放基线，并利用梯度提升与Mondrian保形预测提出CWCD分歧指标；实证发现算法识别的排放分歧对未来Tobin's Q与ROA具有显著负向预测力，证明市场能对"漂绿"进行定价。
AI.motivation: 企业可持续性披露要求不断扩大，但金融体系高度依赖企业自报排放数据，导致"漂绿"风险普遍存在。现有文献多依赖主观ESG评级或文本情感分析，缺乏客观量化物理气候现实的经济计量手段，存在关键研究空白。作者试图通过构建算法化排放基线，解决这一信息不对称问题。
AI.method: 将美国SEC财务基本面数据与EPA设施级温室气体登记数据相融合，建立具有数学保证的企业物理排放基线；采用梯度提升架构结合Mondrian保形预测，量化自报数据与算法基线之间的缺口，构造"保形加权连续分歧"（CWCD）指标；再以截面领先-滞后经济计量设计评估该分歧指标的市场效应。
AI.result: 算法识别的排放分歧与随后的市场估值（Tobin's Q）及经营盈利能力（ROA）之间存在严重的、统计显著的负相关关系，形成稳健的市场约束机制。
AI.conclusion: 研究否定了"市场盲视"假说，证明机构资本会主动对环保欺骗行为进行定价，将其视为企业根本性管理不善的先行指标而非单纯的道德瑕疵。研究为资产管理者和监管者大规模部署算法审计基础设施提供了定量依据。

title: SocialVLA: A Social Perception Gateway for Human-Reaction-Based Failure Detection and Recovery in VLA Manipulation
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies enable diverse robotic manipulation but can fail during execution without recognizing their own errors. Human observers provide complementary signals, as unexpected robot behavior can trigger rapid vocal, facial, or verbal reactions before failure is completed. We introduce SocialVLA, a local, policy-agnostic social perception gateway that converts spontaneous human reactions into runtime intervention signals for VLA manipulation. SocialVLA combines causal paralinguistic audio detection, visual reaction recognition, explicit stop phrases, and robot-relevance estimation. An asynchronous first-event fusion mechanism triggers a VLA hold from the earliest sufficiently confident signal, while a separate speech channel captures verbal corrections for participant-directed continuation, restart, or instruction revision. We evaluate SocialVLA on physical Unitree G1 manipulation using 15 participants, with 238 annotated intervention-worthy episodes and 1.038 h of non-intervention behavior. Frozen offline replay achieves 54.6% recall and 69.5% precision, while unfiltered audio-video fusion reaches 64.3% recall. Relevance estimation reduces false-stop episodes from 100 to 57 and increases precision from 60.5% to 69.8%. In prospective deployment on an unseen 16th participant, the frozen system achieves 59.5% recall and 91.7% precision. Median detector-to-fusion latency is 47.9 ms, VLA-gate-to-physical-hold latency is 336 ms, and reaction-onset-to-hold latency is 1.021 s. These results demonstrate a complete local pathway from spontaneous social reaction to physical VLA interruption and participant-directed recovery.

AI.tldr: 提出 SocialVLA：一个本地、策略无关的社会感知网关，将人类自发反应（副语言音频、视觉反应、停止短语）转化为 VLA 操作策略的运行时中断信号，并支持口头纠正后的恢复。
AI.motivation: VLA 策略虽能完成多样机器人操作，但执行中无法识别自身错误。人类旁观者的自发反应（声音、表情、语言）往往先于失败完成而出现，可作为互补的中断信号。
AI.method: 结合因果副语言音频检测、视觉反应识别、显式停止短语与机器人相关性估计；采用异步首事件融合机制，由最早达到置信阈值的信号触发 VLA 暂停；独立语音通道捕获口头纠正，用于参与者导向的继续、重启或指令修改。
AI.result: 在 Unitree G1 真机操作上由 15 名参与者评测，含 238 个标注干预片段与 1.038 小时非干预行为。冻结离线回放召回 54.6%、精确率 69.5%；未过滤音视频融合召回 64.3%；相关性估计将误停片段从 100 降至 57，精确率由 60.5% 提升至 69.8%。对未见过的第 16 名参与者前瞻部署中，冻结系统召回 59.5%、精确率 91.7%。中位检测到融合延迟 47.9 ms，VLA 门控到物理暂停延迟 336 ms，反应起始到暂停延迟 1.021 s。
AI.conclusion: 验证了一条完整的本地通径：从自发的社会反应到物理层面的 VLA 中断，再到参与者导向的恢复。

title: SCION: Scene Composition with Instanced Neural Primitives
summary: Real-world scenes are compositional: bricks, blades of grass, pebbles, and tree leaves recur across human-built and natural environments. Existing neural scene representations model these elements independently. Most 3D Gaussian Splatting and follow-up abstraction and compression methods treat each element as unique, fitting millions of independent Gaussians per scene. Prior methods like Splat and Replace fit template objects, but they require mostly manual selection of repeated elements. As a result, these representations store redundant parameters and provide weak manipulation handles for downstream tasks. We introduce SCION, a hier- archical compositional scene representation that replaces independent Gaussians with a compact vocabulary of reusable primitives and lightweight world-space instances that place transformed copies throughout the scene. We fit this represen- tation to multi-view captures via a joint optimization over discrete and continuous scene parameters, combining two-level densification over splats and instances with an adversarial loss that preserves detail across shared primitives. The recovered structure yields a compact, controllable representation while maintaining high quality even at 1.2 MB. SCION achieves rate-distortion favorable to existing Gaussian compression methods, and it enables instance-level scene editing and animation without retraining. Our results show that neural scene representations need not memorize scenes as independent primitives; they can discover reusable parts. Project webpage: https://light.princeton.edu/SCION

AI.tldr: SCION提出一种层次化组合式场景表示，用可复用基元词汇表和轻量世界空间实例替代独立高斯，通过离散-连续联合优化拟合多视角捕获，在1.2 MB下保持高质量，并支持实例级编辑与动画。
AI.motivation: 现实场景具有组合性：砖块、草叶、卵石、树叶等元素在人工与自然环境中反复出现。但现有神经场景表示（如3D Gaussian Splatting及其抽象与压缩方法）将每个元素视为独立个体，为每个场景拟合数百万个独立高斯，导致参数冗余、表示臃肿，且缺乏可用于下游任务的操控接口。Splat and Replace 等方法虽拟合模板物体，却依赖大量人工选择重复元素，难以规模化。
AI.method: 1) 构建层次化组合表示：用紧凑的可复用基元（primitive）词汇表加轻量世界空间实例（instance）替换独立高斯，实例通过变换将基元副本放置到场景各处；2) 通过离散与连续场景参数的联合优化，将表示拟合到多视角捕获数据；3) 引入两层致密化（two-level densification），分别在splat层与instance层进行；4) 使用对抗损失以在共享基元条件下保持细节保真度。
AI.result: 恢复出的结构在1.2 MB存储下仍保持高质量；在率失真性能上优于现有高斯压缩方法；支持无需重训练的实例级场景编辑与动画。
AI.conclusion: 神经场景表示无需将场景记忆为独立基元，而能够发现可复用的部件，从而获得紧凑且可控的表示，同时保持渲染质量。

title: The AI Risk Observatory: What Can We Learn from AI Disclosures in Annual Reports About Societal Resilience?
comment: 22 pages (9 main text + appendices), 12 figures, 7 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/84rt/AI-Risk-Observatory (release dataset-v1.1)
summary: Societal resilience research relies on access to useful and actionable data, which motivates our main research question: Can annual reports, processed at scale with LLMs, provide a useful signal about how companies disclose their response to AI? We test this by applying a reproducible two-stage classification pipeline to 9,821 annual reports from 1,362 UK listed companies (2020-2025, with partial 2026 data). We first validate the method against 474 human-annotated passages, finding high recall and moderate label-level agreement. We then report three empirical patterns: (i) between 2020 and 2025, the share of reports mentioning AI risk rose from 2.8% to 41.2%, while AI adoption disclosure also rose, from 13.8% to 45.2%, and named vendor mentions cluster around a small set of major providers led by Microsoft; (ii) disclosure varies substantially by Critical National Infrastructure sector and market segment: AIM reports disclose AI risk at far lower rates than Main Market reports, and sectors such as Energy and Data Infrastructure lag behind the rest in AI risk disclosure; and (iii) harm disclosures are near-absent (seven reports across the entire corpus). We develop a substantiveness classification to assess the quality of the disclosure and find that most AI risk disclosure is not substantive: in 2025, 41.2% of all reports mention AI as a risk, but only 4.3% contain AI risk disclosure we classify as substantive.

AI.tldr: 该研究用LLM两阶段分类流程分析9821份英国上市公司年报，考察企业对AI风险、采用与危害的披露信号，发现AI风险披露比例六年内从2.8%升至41.2%，但实质性披露仅4.3%，且存在行业与市场板块差异。
AI.motivation: 社会韧性研究依赖有用且可操作的数据，而企业如何披露其对AI的响应缺乏规模化、可复现的信号来源。作者由此提出核心问题：以LLM大规模处理的年报能否提供关于企业AI披露的有用信号。
AI.method: 构建可复现的两阶段分类流程，应用于1362家英国上市公司2020—2025年（含部分2026年数据）共9821份年报；先以474条人工标注段落进行方法验证，再提炼实证模式，并开发"实质性"分类以评估披露质量。
AI.result: 方法验证显示高召回率与中等的标签级一致性。三项实证发现：(i) 2020—2025年提及AI风险的报告比例由2.8%升至41.2%，AI采用披露由13.8%升至45.2%，具名供应商集中于以微软为首的少数主要提供商；(ii) 披露情况在关键国家基础设施行业与市场板块间差异显著，AIM市场AI风险披露率远低于主板市场，能源与数据基础设施等行业落后；(iii) 危害披露几乎缺失，全语料库仅7份报告。2025年41.2%报告提及AI风险，但仅4.3%的披露被归为实质性。
AI.conclusion: LLM规模化处理年报可提供可用的企业AI披露信号，但多数AI风险披露流于形式而非实质；披露水平受行业与市场板块结构性影响，危害类信息近乎空白。

title: State-Space Unlearning for Non-Stationary Bias in Land Surface Forecasting
summary: Operational land surface forecasting systems built on Mamba-family Structured State Space Models absorb non-stationary confounding events (unrecorded irrigation booms, dam-operation shifts, sensor recalibrations) into their state-transition matrices, silently biasing NDVI, LST, and crop phenology predictions long after the physical cause ends. This paper introduces SSU-LSF (State-Space Unlearning for Land Surface Forecasting), the first machine-unlearning framework purpose-built for geoscientific Mamba-based SSMs. We develop EKFac influence functions specialized to the Mamba state matrices via a closed-form matrix-exponential gradient, use spectral-radius-weighted elbow thresholding to localize a temporal confounding footprint $Φ$, and apply Hessian-free projected gradient ascent within a KL-divergence trust region augmented by spatial total-variation (TV) regularization. Proposition 1 establishes that residual confounding is bounded by $\mathcal{O}\big((1-ρ(\bar{A})^{T_c})/((1-ρ(\bar{A}))μ)\big)$, which grows with the window length $T_c$. Across three heterogeneous benchmarks and eleven baselines, SSU-LSF achieves confounding reduction rates of $0.773$ (CropHarvest), $0.821$ (NDVI-LST), and $0.859$ (ERA5), with worst-case clean-domain RMSE degradation of $4.2\%$ on ERA5, converging in 3--5 epochs at $8.4\times$ lower GPU-cost per unlearning request than full retraining. Code: https://github.com/Anidipta/SSU-LSF

AI.tldr: 提出首个面向地学Mamba状态空间模型（SSM）的机器遗忘框架SSU-LSF，通过EKFac影响函数定位时间混淆足迹并施加Hessian-free投影梯度上升，在三个基准上实现0.773–0.859的混淆削减率，精度退化最坏仅4.2%，且比全量重训高效8.4倍。
AI.motivation: 基于Mamba族结构化状态空间模型的业务化地表预测系统会将非平稳的混淆事件（未记录的灌溉激增、水库调度变化、传感器重校准）吸收进状态转移矩阵中，即使物理成因结束后仍长期隐性偏置NDVI、LST与作物物候预测。现有机器遗忘方法面向通用深度网络，缺乏针对地学Mamba SSM状态矩阵的专用解决方案。
AI.method: 提出SSU-LSF框架：1）通过闭式矩阵指数梯度推导专用于Mamba状态矩阵的EKFac影响函数；2）用谱半径加权肘部阈值法定位时间混淆足迹Φ；3）在KL散度信赖域内施加Hessian-free投影梯度上升，并加入空间全变分（TV）正则；4）给出命题1，证明残余混淆上界为O((1-ρ(Ā)^{T_c})/((1-ρ(Ā))μ))，随窗口长度T_c增长。
AI.result: 在三个异质基准与十一个基线上，SSU-LSF取得混淆削减率0.773（CropHarvest）、0.821（NDVI-LST）、0.859（ERA5）；最坏情况下干净域RMSE退化仅4.2%（ERA5）；3–5个epoch收敛；单次遗忘请求的GPU成本比全量重训低8.4倍。
AI.conclusion: SSU-LSF是首个面向地学Mamba SSM的业务化遗忘方案，兼顾混淆削减效果与干净域性能保持，并以显著更低的计算成本实现快速收敛，为地表预测系统的可靠维护提供了可行路径。代码已开源。

title: Rethinking World-Action Model for Compositional and In-Context Robotic Manipulation
summary: Long-horizon compositional manipulation has become increasingly important for real-world robot deployment, where a single task involves multiple coordinated subtasks. Existing world-action models (WAMs) jointly predict short-horizon visual futures and actions, but typically lack explicit subtask-level reasoning. We propose Visual Goal-conditioned Action Reasoning (ViGAR), a hierarchical framework that factorizes manipulation into a visual subgoal planner and a subgoal executor. Given the current observation and global instruction, the subgoal planner predicts a visual subgoal for the next subtask. The subgoal executor then jointly generates future visual trajectories and actions conditioned on the predicted subgoal. Both components share a pretrained world-model representation, enabling task-level planning and action generation to benefit from common physical knowledge. Moreover, our framework naturally supports in-context learning: using a global goal image as context can induce different subtask decompositions and behaviors without parameter updates. On the RoboTwin Clean2Random benchmark, ViGAR achieves 82.00% and 67.02% success rates under the Clean and Random settings, respectively, surpassing the strongest baseline by 12.86 percentage points in average success rate. Real-world robot experiments on five compositional and two in-context learning tasks further confirm the effectiveness of ViGAR.

AI.tldr: ViGAR：分层世界-动作模型，用视觉子目标规划器+子目标执行器分解长时序操作任务，共享预训练世界模型表征，支持上下文学习，在RoboTwin与真机任务上显著超越基线。
AI.motivation: 长时序组合操作任务需要多个子任务协同，现有world-action models (WAMs)仅联合预测短时程视觉未来与动作，缺乏显式的子任务级推理，难以支撑任务级规划。
AI.method: 提出Visual Goal-conditioned Action Reasoning (ViGAR) 分层框架，将操作分解为视觉子目标规划器与子目标执行器：规划器依据当前观测与全局指令预测下一子任务的视觉子目标；执行器以该子目标为条件联合生成未来视觉轨迹与动作；两模块共享预训练世界模型表征；并利用全局目标图像作为上下文实现无需参数更新的in-context learning。
AI.result: 在RoboTwin Clean2Random基准上，ViGAR在Clean与Random设置下分别取得82.00%与67.02%成功率，平均成功率超过最强基线12.86个百分点；在五个组合任务与两个上下文学习任务的真实机器人实验中进一步验证有效性。
AI.conclusion: 显式子任务级规划与共享世界模型表征可有效提升长时序组合操作的性能，并赋予框架免训练的上下文适应能力，为真实机器人部署提供可行方案。

title: SCOPE-4D: Endoscopic 4D Geometry Foundation Models
summary: Geometric understanding supports endoscopic navigation and robotic assistance, but learning reliable endoscopic geometry faces two challenges: scarce geometric annotations and ambiguity between camera motion and tissue deformation. We present SCOPE-4D, an endoscopic 4D geometry foundation model that jointly predicts camera parameters, dense geometry, and 3D tissue trajectories from monocular RGB video in a single forward pass. Our curation and annotation pipeline constructs SCOPE-5K, a collection of approximately 5,000 clips spanning real and synthetic gastrointestinal endoscopy and laparoscopy. The collection provides rich geometric supervision and includes newly collected phantom and real-colonoscopy evaluation sets. Geometric supervised fine-tuning on SCOPE-5K learns endoscopic priors that improve camera and depth estimation. Common--Residual Motion (CRM) further constrains local deformation relative to common tissue movement. Together with geometric supervision, CRM and trajectory supervision further improve camera and depth estimation over geometric fine-tuning alone while enabling dense 3D tissue tracking. Evaluations on public and newly collected benchmarks demonstrate strong in-domain and out-of-domain geometry, superior 3D tracking, and more stable long-sequence colon reconstruction. A blinded user study further supports the perceived reconstruction quality on real clinical video. Together, these results demonstrate the value of large-scale endoscopic supervision and motion constraints for joint geometry estimation and tissue tracking.

AI.tldr: 提出内窥镜4D几何基础模型SCOPE-4D，单次前向从单目RGB视频联合预测相机参数、稠密几何与3D组织轨迹；配套构建约5000片段数据集SCOPE-5K，并引入Common-Residual Motion（CRM）约束局部形变，在域内/域外基准、3D跟踪与长序列结肠重建上取得更优表现。
AI.motivation: 内窥镜导航与机器人辅助依赖几何理解，但可靠的内窥镜几何学习面临两大挑战：几何标注稀缺，以及相机运动与组织形变之间存在歧义。
AI.method: SCOPE-4D为统一前向模型，同时输出相机参数、稠密几何和3D组织轨迹；构建数据整理与标注流程得到SCOPE-5K（约5000个片段，覆盖真实与合成的胃肠内窥镜及腹腔镜），提供丰富几何监督，并新增体模与真实结肠镜评测集；采用几何监督微调学习内窥镜先验，并以Common-Residual Motion（CRM）在共同组织运动基础上约束局部形变，结合轨迹监督进行联合训练。
AI.result: 在公开及新采集基准上，域内与域外几何估计表现强，3D跟踪更优，长序列结肠重建更稳定；几何监督、CRM与轨迹监督相较仅几何微调进一步提升了相机与深度估计，并实现稠密3D组织跟踪；盲法用户研究支持真实临床视频上的重建质量感知。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，大规模内窥镜监督与运动约束对联合几何估计与组织跟踪具有重要价值。

title: Keep It CALM: Analyzing the Limits of Global Unsafety in Text-to-Image Generation
summary: Training-free safeguards for text-to-image generation often rely on a reusable safety signal, such as an unsafe direction or global toxic subspace, applied broadly across prompts. We provide a controlled geometric analysis of this global-unsafety assumption and reveal a consistent coverage-selectivity trade-off: compact unsafe subspaces fail to cover heterogeneous unsafe semantics, whereas broader aggregation increasingly distorts safety-adjacent benign prompts. Motivated by this finding, we propose CALM (Counterfactual Adaptive Local Modulation), a training-free safeguard that replaces uniform global removal with prompt-local counterfactual correction. Using matched unsafe-benign anchors, CALM routes each prompt to active unsafe categories, minimally edits only violating token representations toward the safe side, and suppresses positively aligned unsafe residual components. Across broad evaluation, CALM significantly improves unsafe content suppression while preserving benign utility, demonstrating that local counterfactual correction provides a more selective alternative to global unsafe signal removal.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出CALM框架，通过提示级局部反事实修正替代全局不安全信号移除，缓解覆盖度-选择性权衡，在不牺牲良性效用的前提下提升不安全内容抑制能力。
AI.motivation: 现有免训练文生图安全防护依赖可复用的全局安全信号（如不安全方向或全局有害子空间），并跨提示统一应用。作者通过受控几何分析发现该假设存在一致的覆盖度-选择性权衡：紧凑的不安全子空间无法覆盖多样化的不安全语义，而更广的聚合会逐渐扭曲与安全相邻的良性提示。
AI.method: 提出CALM（反事实自适应局部调制，Counterfactual Adaptive Local Modulation），一种免训练防护方法。它用提示级局部反事实修正替代统一的全局移除：利用配对的不安全-良性锚点，将每个提示路由到活跃的不安全类别，仅将违规令牌表示朝安全侧做最小编辑，并抑制正向对齐的不安全残差分量。
AI.result: 在广泛评测中，CALM显著提升了不安全内容的抑制效果，同时较好地保持了良性提示的效用，优于全局不安全信号移除方案。
AI.conclusion: 局部反事实修正为全局不安全信号移除提供了一种更具选择性的替代方案，验证了从全局统一处理转向提示自适应、最小化编辑的安全防护思路的有效性。

title: Nearest-neighbour baselines for fingerprint prediction from MS/MS spectra under different assumptions
summary: It has recently been shown that nearest-neighbour retrieval provides a strong baseline for molecular fingerprint prediction from MS/MS spectra, with several variants matching or outperforming current deep learning models (Khoo and Barzilay, 2026; Liu et al., 2026; Gupta et al., 2026). Importantly, "nearest neighbour" encompasses a family of retrieval methods that differ in the information assumed to be available at inference. In this report, we systematically compare several nearest-neighbour variants and show how these differing assumptions affect performance. Our goal is to establish stricter baselines that enable more rigorous benchmarking and better measure progress in this area.

AI.tldr: 该报告系统比较多种最近邻检索变体，揭示不同推理假设对分子指纹预测性能的影响，旨在建立更严格的基线。
AI.motivation: 近期研究显示最近邻检索可作为MS/MS谱分子指纹预测的强基线，甚至匹敌或超越深度学习模型；但"最近邻"实际涵盖推理时所假设可用信息各异的多种检索方法，需要厘清这些差异对性能的影响。
AI.method: 系统性地比较若干最近邻检索变体，分析其各自在推理时假设可用的信息差异，并评估这些假设对预测性能的影响。
AI.result: 不同最近邻变体因推理假设差异而表现不同，具体差异影响性能表现（摘要未给出具体数值）。
AI.conclusion: 建立更严格的基线，以实现更严谨的基准测试并更准确地衡量该领域的进展。

title: Keep the Effect, Drop the Actor: Programmable Effect-to-Execution World-Action Models
summary: A robot demonstration records two things in the same frames: what happened to the objects, and how one particular arm made it happen. We condition on the first. A demonstration is compiled into an effect program: the 3D keypoint trajectories of the objects that moved, two points marking where each was held, and the configuration the scene ends in, with the demonstrator removed. PEWAM, a 71.5M-parameter world-action model, generates effect, robot execution, action and terminal state as four streams with independent flow-matching times, so clamping a program and sampling the execution turns inference into programming, re-solved closed loop from the live scene. On held-out LIBERO-Goal tasks, one demonstration's program completes 40 of 90 episodes, where the same backbone given a goal image or language, and published demonstration-conditioned methods, complete at most 19; on three of Meta-World's held-out classes it exceeds the best published results, though not on the five-class mean. Because a program is a set of coordinates, a person can edit it: the placement follows a shifted terminal state and the grasp turns with rotated contact points. The same program runs on four robot arms without retraining, and after a push, re-solving completes 23 of 60 episodes where replaying the demonstration completes 6. On a Franka arm, fine-tuned on real demonstrations of other tasks, programs compiled from single human videos complete 36 of 40 trials, against 22 for the same backbone conditioned on the video's last frame as a goal image.

AI.tldr: 提出将演示编译为"效果程序"（物体3D关键点轨迹、抓取标记点与终止状态），用71.5M参数的PEWAM世界-动作模型以四个流独立生成，从而把推理转化为可编辑、可跨本体复用的闭环"编程"。
AI.motivation: 机器人演示同时编码了"物体发生了什么"与"某条机械臂如何做到"，二者耦合导致策略难以迁移到新机器人、难以在场景变化后重解、也难以由人编辑修改。作者希望只以"发生了什么"为条件，剥离具体执行本体。
AI.method: 把演示编译为效果程序：运动物体的3D关键点轨迹、每个被抓取物体的两个抓取接触点、去除演示者后的场景终止构型。PEWAM（71.5M参数）生成效果、机器人执行、动作、终止状态四路流，各流拥有独立的flow-matching时间步；夹紧程序并采样执行流即把推理变为编程，并基于实时场景闭环重解。
AI.result: 在LIBERO-Goal留出任务上，单条演示程序完成90个回合中的40个，而同一骨干以目标图像/语言为条件及已发表的演示条件方法最多完成19个；在Meta-World三个留出类别上超过最好已发表结果，但五类均值未超过。同一程序无需重训练即可在四种机械臂上运行；被推动后重解完成60回合中的23个，而直接回放演示仅完成6个。在Frank机械臂上微调后，由单个人类视频编译的程序在40次试验中完成36次，同一骨干以视频末帧作目标图像仅完成22次。
AI.conclusion: 以"效果程序"为中间表示、以流匹配多流生成实现闭环重解，能提升单演示样本效率、对场景扰动与本体差异的鲁棒性，并使策略具备可解释、可人为编辑的编程式接口；局限在于多类均值上未必优于现有方法。

title: Confidence-Controlled XAI Auditing for Pedestrian Detection under Domain Shift
comment: Accepted at the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Vehicular Electronics and Safety (ICVES 2026). 6 pages, 4 figures
summary: Explainability is increasingly required for perception models in intelligent vehicles, yet whether explanations remain faithful under driving domain shift is still poorly understood. This work audits post-hoc explanations of a fixed YOLOv8s pedestrian detector across PIE and JAAD using ROI-based D-Deletion, frozen confidence terciles, rank-based tests, bootstrap intervals, and Holm correction. The audit shows that deletion-based faithfulness is strongly coupled to detection strength at explanation time, with Spearman correlations between 0.70 and 0.82 for D-RISE, making naive confidence-stratified comparisons unreliable. After controlling for detection strength within fixed f0 bins, D-RISE faithfulness remains domain-dependent in the central f0 range, with PIE showing higher D-Deletion than JAAD and Holm-adjusted significance. A non-perturbative EigenCAM baseline is less faithful than D-RISE but also exhibits score coupling, suggesting that the effect is not specific to D-RISE and is related to the deletion-based evaluation setup. These results motivate confidence-controlled XAI audits for safety-critical perception under domain shift.

AI.tldr: 该研究审计了驾驶域偏移下行人检测器后置解释的忠实性，发现基于删除的忠实度与解释时的检测置信度强耦合，需在控制置信度后再比较域间差异。
AI.motivation: 智能车辆感知模型的可解释性日益被要求，但解释在驾驶域偏移下是否仍保持忠实尚不清楚。
AI.method: 对固定YOLOv8s行人检测器在PIE与JAAD数据集上的后置解释进行审计，采用基于ROI的D-Deletion、冻结置信度三分位、秩检验、自助法置信区间及Holm校正；并在固定f0分箱内控制检测强度，另设非扰动EigenCAM基线作对照。
AI.result: D-RISE的删除忠实度与解释时检测强度强相关（Spearman 0.70–0.82），使朴素的置信度分层比较不可靠；控制f0后，D-RISE忠实度在中心f0区间仍具域依赖性，PIE的D-Deletion高于JAAD且经Holm校正显著；EigenCAM忠实度低于D-RISE，但同样存在分数耦合，表明效应源于基于删除的评测设置而非D-RISE特有。
AI.conclusion: 域偏移下的忠实性评估必须控制检测置信度，本文因此倡导面向安全关键感知的置信度受控XAI审计。

title: Choosing Before Acting: Comparative Value Estimation for Long-Horizon Tool-Use Agents
summary: Large language models (LLMs) rely on long-horizon tool invocation sequences for complex tasks, where each invocation can alter the task state and condition subsequent decisions. In long-horizon tool use, final-outcome rewards provide weak credit assignment over long interaction traces. Step-level rewards can offer more targeted feedback, but obtaining reliable step supervision often requires human or LLM judgment, or additional rollouts to estimate the downstream effect of an intermediate decision. In this paper, we argue that effective tool-use agents should estimate the long-horizon value of a possible next tool invocation before executing it. This objective requires comparative supervision over alternative invocations under the same context, while logged trajectories only contain the invocation that was actually taken. Therefore, we propose Comparative Inference for Tool-use Agents (CITA). CITA trains a Comparative Inference Model (CIM) from paired signals that combine observed tool behavior, scalable supervision from a Bayesian tool-graph simulator, and semantic judgments from LLM-based comparison. The resulting CIM learns to estimate how likely a possible next tool invocation is to support final task success under the current context. Across three tool-use benchmarks and multiple backbone LLMs, CITA consistently improves Tool F1 and task success. Additional analysis shows that CIM learns accurate step-level value estimates for comparative tool choices.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CITA，通过训练比较推理模型（CIM）估计长程工具调用中下一步的价值，在多个基准和主干 LLM 上提升 Tool F1 与任务成功率。
AI.motivation: LLM 在复杂任务中依赖长程工具调用序列，最终结果奖励在长交互轨迹上信用分配能力弱，而步骤级奖励依赖人工/LLM 判断或额外 rollout，代价高。作者认为工具使用智能体应在执行前估计可能的下一次工具调用的长程价值，但该目标需要同一上下文下不同调用的比较监督，而已记录轨迹只包含实际执行的调用。
AI.method: 提出 Comparative Inference for Tool-use Agents（CITA），训练一个 Comparative Inference Model（CIM）。CIM 使用配对信号训练：观察到的工具行为、来自贝叶斯工具图模拟器的可扩展监督，以及基于 LLM 的语义比较判断。CIM 学习估计当前上下文下某个可能的下一次工具调用支持最终任务成功的可能性。
AI.result: 在三个工具使用基准和多个主干 LLM 上，CITA 一致提升 Tool F1 和任务成功率。额外分析表明 CIM 能为比较性工具选择学到准确的步骤级价值估计。
AI.conclusion: CITA 通过比较式推理监督解决长程工具使用中的信用分配问题，验证了在执行前估计下一步工具调用长程价值的有效性。

title: Rank-Aware Speculative Sampling for Diffusion Draft Trees
summary: Speculative sampling accelerates diffusion generation by verifying inexpensive draft states in parallel while preserving the target law. Recent tree-based methods allocate the parallel compute budget more effectively than single-chain drafts, as demonstrated by Diffusion Greedy Rejection Sampling (D-GRS). D-GRS generates $K$ conditionally independent candidates per node, and sequentially tests them in their generation order. Yet the sampled candidates admit an informative ranking without additional target-model evaluations. To exploit this, we introduce Rank-Aware Speculative Sampling (RASS), a verification rule for speculative draft trees based on rank-aware list coupling. RASS orders draft candidates along the proposal-target mean displacement and samples a rank with weights optimized to minimize total variation between the selected-proposal and target laws. Finally, the selected candidate is maximally coupled with the target, with residual correction ensuring exact sampling for any choice of rank weights. We evaluate RASS on a Gaussian-mixture target, unconditional pixel-space generation on FFHQ, conditional generation on CIFAR-10, and latent diffusion with Stable Diffusion 3.5 using COCO2014 prompts. Measured by the ratio of standard to speculative sampling's target-model evaluation counts, RASS improves on D-GRS across the evaluated settings, with gains reaching approximately 20% on CIFAR-10 at matched compute budgets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Rank-Aware Speculative Sampling (RASS)，一种基于rank-aware list coupling的扩散模型推测采样验证规则，利用候选样本的排序信息选择验证顺序，在多个生成任务上优于D-GRS，CIFAR-10上目标模型评估次数减少约20%。
AI.motivation: 树式推测采样（如D-GRS）虽能更有效分配并行计算预算，但D-GRS按生成顺序依次验证K个条件独立候选，未利用候选样本间蕴含的有信息量排序，存在进一步降低目标模型评估次数的空间。
AI.method: 提出RASS验证规则：基于rank-aware list coupling，将候选沿proposal-target mean displacement排序，采样一个以最小化所选proposal与目标分布间总变差为目标的优化权重所确定的rank；随后将选中候选与目标分布做最大耦合，并通过残差校正保证任意rank权重下采样精确（保持目标law）。
AI.result: 在Gaussian-mixture target、FFHQ无条件像素空间生成、CIFAR-10条件生成及使用COCO2014提示的Stable Diffusion 3.5潜扩散上评估。以标准采样与推测采样的目标模型评估次数之比衡量，RASS在各设定下均优于D-GRS，匹配计算预算下CIFAR-10增益约达20%。
AI.conclusion: 利用推测draft树中候选样本的排序信息进行rank-aware验证，可在保持精确目标分布的同时提升推测采样效率，为扩散生成加速提供新思路。

title: Autonomous mobile robot operations logistics: a dataset of jobs, dispatch events and robot states
summary: Autonomous mobile robots (AMRs) increasingly perform material transport in production logistics, where their operation is governed by job generation, dispatching and robot control. We present MoRoOp, a dataset of AMR operations recorded in a laboratory kit preparation and supply scenario over nine eight-hour shifts. During each shift, an AMR executed stochastically generated kit supply, empty-box refill and charging jobs. The dataset links job specifications, the operations constituting each job, dispatch events documenting operation state transitions and outcomes, and robot-state observations comprising position, orientation, velocity, per-wheel state of charge and diagnostics. It contains 1,382 jobs, 4,815 operations, 19,352 dispatch events and 140,386 robot-state observations together with the kit specifications used during job generation. The dataset was recorded in an operating laboratory environment, and technically valid observations of delays, obstructed navigation and unsuccessful operations were retained. Both raw and cleaned robot-state tables are provided. Documented reuse directions include the evaluation of AI agents on operational decision records, disturbance detection, operation prediction, data-driven simulation and event-log analysis.

AI.tldr: MoRoOp是一个记录自主移动机器人（AMR）在实验室套件准备与供应场景中运行九班（每班8小时）作业的数据集，包含作业规格、操作、调度事件与机器人状态观测，并提供原始与清洗后的机器人状态表。
AI.motivation: AMR在生产物流中承担物料运输，其运行受作业生成、调度与机器人控制支配，但缺乏真实运行场景下细粒度、可复用的运行数据来支撑算法评估与研究。
AI.method: 在实验室套件准备与供应场景中，令AMR按随机生成的套件供应、空箱补充与充电作业运行，连续记录九个8小时班次；采集并关联作业规格、构成作业的操作、记录操作状态转移与结果的调度事件、以及包含位置、朝向、速度、各轮荷电状态与诊断信息的机器人状态观测；保留技术上有效的延迟、导航受阻与失败操作观测，并同时提供原始与清洗后的机器人状态表。
AI.result: 数据集包含1,382个作业、4,815个操作、19,352个调度事件、140,386条机器人状态观测，以及作业生成所用的套件规格。
AI.conclusion: MoRoOp提供了真实运行环境下多层级关联的AMR运行数据，可用于AI智能体在运行决策记录上的评估、扰动检测、操作预测、数据驱动仿真与事件日志分析等方向。

title: EviDent-CBCT: Evidence-Bottlenecked Report Generation from Dental CBCT under Non-Exhaustive Report Supervision
summary: Dento-maxillofacial cone-beam CT (CBCT) reports may contain dozens of tooth-specific, anatomical, and spatial findings from a single 3D scan. Learning to generate such reports from limited clinical data is challenging because routine reports may not exhaustively document image findings, and a non-mention may reflect either absence or non-reporting. We present EviDent-CBCT, an evidence-bottlenecked framework designed for this incomplete supervision. An anatomy-aware network maps each CBCT scan to a discrete record of tooth-level, global, and tooth-IAC evidence. A dental-logic consistency projection reconciles incompatible evidence before a deterministic renderer and an image-blind local language model generate the report using only this record. For tooth-level evidence, reliability-aware training uses eligible non-mentions as reduced-weight negatives, while unreported global and tooth-IAC labels remain unknown. A metal-sensitive input channel preserves intensity cues from dental materials. Across three validation runs, EviDent-CBCT achieves $0.666\pm0.006$ merged evidence set-F1 and $0.402\pm0.003$ RadFact-Lite-Dental logical-F1, versus $0.371\pm0.018$ for the strongest controlled direct baseline. In the ODIN 2026 challenge, it ranked second in automated evaluation and third in blinded clinical Arena comparison on the hidden test set. These results support the discrete evidence record as an effective and auditable interface for CBCT report generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EviDent-CBCT框架，通过证据瓶颈设计解决CBCT报告生成中的不完整监督问题，将每例扫描映射为离散的证据记录后再渲染报告。
AI.motivation: 牙颌面锥形束CT（CBCT）报告可能包含来自单次三维扫描的数十条牙特异性、解剖及空间发现。但常规报告往往不会穷尽记录影像发现，"未提及"既可能代表不存在，也可能代表未记录，加之临床数据有限，使得从有限数据中学习生成此类报告极具挑战性。
AI.method: 提出EviDent-CBCT，一种面向不完整监督的证据瓶颈框架：解剖感知网络将每例CBCT扫描映射为牙级、全局和牙-IAC证据的离散记录；牙科逻辑一致性投影在生成前调和不相容证据；随后由确定性渲染器和图像盲的本地语言模型仅依据该记录生成报告。针对牙级证据，采用可靠性感知训练，将合格的非提及作为降权负样本，而未报告的全局与牙-IAC标签保持未知。此外引入金属敏感输入通道以保留牙科材料的强度线索。
AI.result: 在三次验证运行中，EviDent-CBCT取得0.666±0.006的合并证据集set-F1和0.402±0.003的RadFact-Lite-Dental逻辑F1，而最强受控直接基线为0.371±0.018。在ODIN 2026挑战赛中，于隐藏测试集上自动评估排名第二、盲法临床Arena比较排名第三。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，离散证据记录是一种有效且可审计的CBCT报告生成接口。

title: World Editing: Intervening on Executable Worlds at Increasing Depth
summary: Interactive world models are increasingly capable of generating environments and acting within them, yet deliberately editing an existing executable world remains underexplored. We formulate world editing as intervening on an existing world while preserving properties that should remain unchanged, and introduce intervention depth as an axis describing how strongly an edit couples world entities, dynamics, and systems. We instantiate this capability through industry-grade game modding and introduce IGMWorld, together with IGMBench, a benchmark of 110 tasks and over 1.1K executable state and behavioral criteria across Minecraft and Terraria. The tasks span property, entity, dynamics, and system interventions and are evaluated through deterministic executability, behavioral, preservation, and visual checks. Frontier coding agents already exhibit substantial world-editing capability: the strongest configuration solves 78.2% of tasks under a strict task-level criterion, while criterion-level performance reaches 94.8%. Reliability generally decreases with intervention depth, and this pattern persists even among tasks with similar numbers of evaluation criteria. Most failed edits still build and load successfully, suggesting that the main difficulty is making the edited world behave as requested. Visual consistency remains a separate weakness, with all evaluated configurations below 50% joint visual pass rate. These results show that world editing is a distinct capability from world generation and interaction, and that executable games provide a practical testbed for studying it.

AI.tldr: 本文将“世界编辑”形式化为在保留既有属性的前提下对可执行世界进行干预，并提出干预深度这一维度。通过游戏模组化构建 IGMWorld 与 IGMBench（覆盖 Minecraft 与 Terraria 的 110 个任务、逾 1.1K 条可执行状态与行为判据），评测发现前沿编码智能体已具备显著编辑能力（任务级 78.2%、判据级 94.8%），但可靠性随干预深度下降，且视觉一致性普遍不足（联合通过率均低于 50%）。
AI.motivation: 交互式世界模型已能生成环境并在其中行动，但对“已有可执行世界进行刻意编辑”这一能力研究不足。世界编辑与生成、交互是不同能力，缺乏统一的形式化定义与可执行评测基准。
AI.method: 将世界编辑定义为对既有世界的干预，同时保持应不变的属性，并提出“干预深度”这一轴，刻画编辑对世界实体、动力学与系统耦合的强度。以工业级游戏模组化为实例，构建 IGMWorld 与 IGMBench：覆盖 Minecraft 与 Terraria 的 110 个任务、超过 1.1K 条可执行状态与行为判据，任务涵盖属性、实体、动力学、系统四类干预，并通过确定性可执行性、行为、保持性与视觉检查进行评测。
AI.result: 最强配置在严格任务级判据下解决 78.2% 任务，判据级达 94.8%；可靠性随干预深度增加而下降，且在判据数量相近的任务中依然存在该趋势；多数失败编辑仍能成功构建与加载，说明主要难点在于使编辑后的世界按预期运行；视觉一致性是独立短板，所有配置的联合视觉通过率均低于 50%。
AI.conclusion: 世界编辑是与世界生成、世界交互相区别的独立能力，可执行游戏为其研究提供了实用测试平台。

title: Counterfactual Predictions in Scientific Emulators Without Controlled Experiments
summary: Many scientific questions require reasoning about what was never observed: What if the conditions, interventions, or history had been different? Models can predict accurately on observed data yet fail on such what-if queries when correlated inputs are varied independently. A common remedy is to add controlled simulation data in which these factors are explicitly disentangled, but this requires access to a simulator, can be computationally expensive, and inherits the simulator's modeling assumptions. We introduce ReRoute, a framework for targeted scientific what-if prediction that combines factual data with partial mechanistic knowledge, without requiring controlled intervention data for adaptation. ReRoute fixes the queried input of a pretrained backbone to a reference value, reintroduces its variation through a known mechanistic pathway, and fine-tunes on the original factual data, while leaving downstream effects to the learned dynamics. We provide a causal identification result for this construction under explicit structural assumptions, with the core argument machine-checked in Lean. After showing that ReRoute achieves highly accurate counterfactual predictions in a controlled advection-diffusion system where exact responses are available, we turn to state-of-the-art climate emulation. On held-out coupled-climate interventions, ReRoute reduces aggregate climate error by 18.2-31.8% under severe CO$_2$ distribution shifts while preserving skill under standard conditions, at a small fraction of the cost of retraining on additional controlled simulations, without even accounting for the substantial expense of generating such data. Finally, on an emulator trained from historical ERA5 reanalysis, where no counterfactual reference exists, ReRoute preserves substantially more of the surface warming implied by the observed boundary conditions under a fixed-CO$_2$ counterfactual.

AI.tldr: ReRoute：将预训练模型查询输入固定为参考值、通过已知机制通路重新引入其变化，并在原始事实数据上微调，无需受控干预数据即可实现科学反事实/假设预测，Lem中机器验证了因果可识别性，在气候仿真上显著降低误差。
AI.motivation: 科学问题常涉及对未观测情形的推理（若条件、干预或历史不同会怎样）。模型在观测数据上预测准确，但当相关输入被独立变动时，在what-if查询上失效。常用补救是加入受控仿真数据以显式解耦因素，但需要模拟器、计算昂贵且继承模拟器建模假设。
AI.method: ReRoute框架：结合事实数据与部分机制知识，不需受控干预数据做适配。做法是将预训练骨干网络被查询的输入固定为参考值，通过已知机制通路重新引入其变化，并在原始事实数据上微调，同时把下游效应留给学习到的动力学。在明确结构假设下给出因果可识别性结果，核心论证在Lean中机器验证。
AI.result: 在可获精确响应的一维受控平流-扩散系统中，ReRoute实现高精度反事实预测；在先进气候仿真中，在严重CO2分布偏移下，对留出的耦合气候干预将总体气候误差降低18.2-31.8%，同时保持标准条件下的技能，且成本仅为额外受控仿真重训练的一小部分（尚未计入生成此类数据的巨大开销）。在基于历史ERA5再分析训练的仿真器上（不存在反事实参考），ReRoute在固定CO2反事实下保留了更多由观测边界条件暗示的地表增暖。
AI.conclusion: ReRoute为无需受控干预数据的定向科学what-if预测提供了可行途径，通过机制通路重引入变化并在事实数据上微调，兼具因果识别保证与实证精度，在气候仿真中显著提升分布偏移下鲁棒性，并适用于无真值反事实的场景。

title: OpenRUA: Robot-Use Agents Are Zero-Shot Visuomotor Policies
summary: Coding agents are extending their reach into the physical world by writing and executing robot control programs. One might expect the agents to use the existing mature software stack that engineers have developed over decades to access sensors and control motion. Yet prior work primarily engineers complex custom harnesses to orchestrate agents for robot use, particularly by prescribing specialized workflows and providing bespoke interfaces. This raises the question: "Is such additional harness engineering necessary?" We introduce OpenRUA, a zero-abstraction harness that bypasses bespoke abstraction layers by providing off-the-shelf coding agents with only terminal access to the robot's native software interface ROS 2. OpenRUA employs a minimalist workspace-as-harness design, only offering ROS 2 documentation and basic tools while leaving the coding agent to organize its own work without orchestrating any agentic workflow. Within this workspace, OpenRUA recasts perception as file I/O and manipulation as coding. With Claude Code powered by Claude Opus 5, OpenRUA achieves success rates of 99.0% on CaP-Bench and 87.0% on LIBERO-PRO, demonstrating that an off-the-shelf coding agent can serve as a zero-shot visuomotor policy through the robot's native interface, without bespoke primitives or task-specific training. Under this minimalist design, further analysis reveals striking emergent behaviors of coding agents: (1) For perception, the agent spontaneously writes programs that process raw sensory inputs and derive metric measurements in 96.80% of episodes. (2) For manipulation, the agent spontaneously builds motion-control clients (e.g., gripper control) in 95.87% of episodes and closed-loop control programs (e.g., adjusting motion based on sensor feedback) in 50.13% of episodes. Our code is available at https://github.com/terminalworld/OpenRUA.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 OpenRUA，一种"零抽象"harness：仅给现成编程智能体开放终端访问机器人原生软件接口 ROS 2，将感知重构为文件 I/O、操作重构为编程，无需专门工作流与定制接口即可实现零样本视觉运动策略。
AI.motivation: 已有机器人智能体研究普遍依赖工程师手工搭建的复杂定制 harness（规定专用工作流、提供定制接口）来编排智能体，而机器人领域本身已有数十年积累的成熟软件栈（ROS 2 等）。作者据此质疑：这种额外 harness 工程是否真的必要？
AI.method: 提出 OpenRUA，采用极简的"工作区即 harness"（workspace-as-harness）设计：不设任何抽象层，只给现成编程智能体提供对 ROS 2 的终端访问、ROS 2 文档与基础工具，不编排任何智能体工作流，由智能体自行组织工作；在该工作区内将感知转化为文件 I/O，将操作转化为编写代码。实验用 Claude Code（Claude Opus 驱动）进行评测。
AI.result: 在 CaP-Bench 上成功率达 99.0%，在 LIBERO-PRO 上达 87.0%，表明现成编程智能体可经由机器人原生接口作为零样本视觉运动策略，无需定制原语或任务特定训练。分析还揭示涌现行为：96.80% 的回合中智能体自发编写程序处理原始传感输入并推导度量测量（感知）；95.87% 的回合中自发构建运动控制客户端（如夹爪控制），50.13% 的回合中构建闭环控制程序（根据传感器反馈调整运动）。
AI.conclusion: 额外的 harness 工程并非必要：极简、零抽象地暴露机器人原生软件接口，配合现成编程智能体即可完成机器人感知与控制任务，并自发涌现出测量、控制客户端与闭环控制等类工程化行为。

title: FactorSplat: Appearance-Controllable Gaussian Proxies for Medical Volume Rendering
summary: Transfer functions (TFs) control color and visibility in medical volume rendering, but image-trained Gaussian proxies typically bake one transfer function into their appearance. We present FactorSplat, a per-scene N-dimensional Gaussian splatting (N-DGS) proxy that accepts region-specific intensity-to-RGBA curves at inference. A local lookup applies the authored color and opacity change, while a shared functional encoder and low-rank per-Gaussian factors learn the residual appearance response. Geometry and directional appearance remain shared across presets, with visibility control and TF-aware pruning preserving the ability to hide and reveal structures. On seven CT and MR scans, FactorSplat improves mean PSNR and changed-region error over region-aware VEG across validation, interpolation, unseen composition, and out-of-distribution (OOD) edits. Across these four splits, seven-scan mean PSNR gains over VEG range from 1.10 to 1.52 dB. One checkpoint per scan supports unseen edits without retraining. At $1600^2$, the cached fast renderer averages 524 FPS with 1.17 ms TF switches. Project page: https://gaozhongpai.github.io/FactorSplat/.

AI.tldr: 提出FactorSplat，一种每场景的N维高斯泼溅代理，可在推理时接受区域特定的强度到RGBA曲线，实现传递函数可控的医学体渲染，无需重训练即可支持未见编辑。
AI.motivation: 医学体渲染中传递函数（TF）控制颜色与可见性，但基于图像训练的高斯代理通常将单一传递函数烘焙进外观，导致改变TF需重新训练、无法灵活编辑。
AI.method: 构建每场景的N维高斯泼溅（N-DGS）代理：局部查找表施加作者定义的颜色与不透明度变化，共享功能编码器与低秩逐高斯因子学习残差外观响应；几何与方向外观在预设间共享，并结合可见性控制与TF感知剪枝以保持隐藏/显露结构能力。
AI.result: 在七例CT与MR扫描上，于验证、插值、未见组合及OOD编辑四种划分中，平均PSNR与变化区域误差均优于区域感知的VEG，PSNR增益1.10–1.52 dB；每扫描单检查点即可支持未见编辑而无需重训练；1600²分辨率下缓存快速渲染器平均524 FPS，TF切换1.17 ms。
AI.conclusion: FactorSplat以单场景检查点实现推理时传递函数编辑的高质量、实时医学体渲染，兼顾外观保真与结构可见性控制。

title: A Multi Method Importance and Performance Efficiency Analysis of Topological Metrics for Natural Visibility Graph Based Cyber Attack Detection
summary: Natural Visibility Graph (NVG) based analysis characterizes network traffic through topological descriptors reflecting different structural properties. However, not all descriptors contribute equally to cyber-attack classification, and extracting a large metric set can increase computational cost. This study evaluates 21 NVG derived topological metrics and investigates whether a compact subset can preserve classification capability while improving computational efficiency. Four importance analysis methods SHAP, grouped Permutation Importance, Boruta, and Recursive Feature Elimination (RFE) are integrated through a Consensus Ranking strategy. Based on this ranking, Full21, Top15, Top10, Top7, Top5, and Top3 configurations are evaluated using the CICIDS2018 dataset, a CNN classifier, and stratified 5 fold cross validation. The three highest ranked metrics are avg_clustering_coeff_median, avg_clustering_coeff_std, and avg_clustering_coeff_mean. Top3 achieved the highest observed mean performance, with 97.148% accuracy, 97.055% weighted F1 score, and an MCC of 0.9675, compared with 95.999%, 95.521%, and 0.9549 for Full21, respectively. It also reduced total runtime from 14,961.39 s to 589.22 s (96.06%). These results indicate that importance guided metric reduction can provide a compact NVG representation with higher observed mean predictive performance and substantially lower computational cost under the evaluated setting.

AI.tldr: 本研究评估21个NVG拓扑指标，通过SHAP、分组排列重要性、Boruta与RFE的共识排序筛选紧凑子集，在CICIDS2018上用CNN与5折交叉验证比较。Top3配置取得97.148%准确率与0.9675 MCC，优于Full21的95.999%与0.9549，并把运行时间从14961.39s降至589.22s（减少96.06%）。
AI.motivation: NVG分析能刻画网络流量的拓扑结构，但各拓扑指标对攻击分类的贡献不均，使用全部指标会增加计算开销。因此需要验证能否用紧凑指标子集在保持甚至提升分类性能的同时显著降低计算成本。
AI.method: 评估21个NVG派生的拓扑指标，采用SHAP、分组排列重要性、Boruta和递归特征消除（RFE）四种重要性分析方法，并通过共识排序（Consensus Ranking）整合结果。基于该排序构建Full21、Top15、Top10、Top7、Top5、Top3六种配置，在CICIDS2018数据集上使用CNN分类器和分层5折交叉验证进行评估。
AI.result: 排名最高的三个指标为avg_clustering_coeff_median、avg_clustering_coeff_std和avg_clustering_coeff_mean。Top3取得最高平均性能：准确率97.148%、加权F1 97.055%、MCC 0.9675；Full21分别为95.999%、95.521%、0.9549。运行时间从14961.39s降至589.22s，减少96.06%。
AI.conclusion: 在该评估设定下，基于重要性引导的指标约简可构建紧凑的NVG表示，不仅提升观测到的平均预测性能，还大幅降低计算成本，表明减少拓扑指标数量是可行且有效的优化方向。

title: Approximation Property of Dropout Neural Networks: Sobolev Rates and Confidence Bounds
summary: The universal approximation property of dropout neural networks does not by itself describe the network size required for an accurate random realization. In this work, we study approximation of the unit ball of $W^{n,\infty}([0,1]^d)$ by ReLU networks whose edges are retained independently with probability $p$. The approximation error is measured uniformly over the input domain, and the guarantee holds with probability at least $1-δ$ for a single sampled network. We construct networks of constant depth and size $\widetilde O_{n,d}(p^{-9}\varepsilon^{-\max\{d/n,2\}} \log(1/δ))$. The construction combines bounded local subnetworks, localization on a successful approximation event, and a multiscale Taylor decomposition. Conversely, Sobolev capacity imposes a lower bound on the number of surviving edges, while approximation of a fixed affine function requires an output-layer cost of order $((1-p)/p)\varepsilon^{-2}\log(1/δ)$ at sufficiently high confidence. For fixed $p\in(0,1)$ and $δ<\min\{1/2,1-p\}$, the upper and lower bounds match in the accuracy exponent under a fixed or logarithmic depth budget. When $d\leq2n$, they also match in confidence up to logarithms of accuracy. We extend the lower bounds to $W^{n,r}$ targets with $L^s$ error, and distinguish this extension from the upper bound for $W^{n,\infty}$. The optimal retention dependence and logarithmic factors remain open.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了dropout-ReLU网络对Sobolev空间单位球的随机逼近问题，给出了单次采样网络以概率1-δ达到一致逼近误差ε所需的网络规模上界与下界，并证明在固定或对数深度下，精度指数上界与下界匹配。
AI.motivation: dropout网络的通用逼近性本身无法刻画一次随机实现达到给定精度所需的网络规模，因此需要研究在边以概率p保留的随机网络中，单次采样网络高概率逼近目标函数所需的规模与误差关系。
AI.method: 针对W^{n,∞}([0,1]^d)单位球，构造常深度ReLU网络，规模为Õ_{n,d}(p^{-9}ε^{-max{d/n,2}} log(1/δ))；构造结合局部有界子网络、成功逼近事件上的局部化以及多尺度Taylor分解。下界方面，利用Sobolev容量给出存活边数的下界，并分析固定仿射函数逼近在输出层产生的((1-p)/p)ε^{-2}log(1/δ)代价。
AI.result: 上界：常深度、规模Õ_{n,d}(p^{-9}ε^{-max{d/n,2}} log(1/δ))，单样本以概率≥1-δ在输入域上一致逼近。下界：Sobolev容量限制存活边数；逼近固定仿射函数需输出层代价((1-p)/p)ε^{-2}log(1/δ)。固定p∈(0,1)且δ<min{1/2,1-p}时，固定或对数深度预算下上下界的精度指数匹配；当d≤2n时，置信度项在对数精度范围内也匹配。下界可推广至W^{n,r}目标与L^s误差，并区别于W^{n,∞}的上界。
AI.conclusion: 在固定或对数深度预算下，dropout-ReLU网络逼近W^{n,∞}的规模上界与下界在精度指数上匹配，d≤2n时置信度也匹配；但最优的保留概率依赖关系与对数因子仍未解决。

title: RUL-Aware RRT*: Degradation-Balanced Motion Planning for Robotic Manipulators
summary: Robotic manipulators operating over long durations often experience uneven joint degradation, which causes the weakest actuator to fail prematurely, leads to unplanned downtime, and results in significant operational losses. Traditional motion-planning algorithms do not account for joint health conditions and therefore tend to exacerbate this imbalance during extended operation. To address this challenge, this study introduces the RUL-aware RRT*, a motion-planning method that incorporates joint remaining useful life information into the planning process and adaptively adjusts joint usage in response to evolving health conditions. The method is evaluated across three representative scenarios, namely the Full Health Scenario (FHS), the Heterogeneous Degradation Scenario (HDS), and the Local Degradation Scenario (LDS). The results show that the RUL-aware RRT* effectively suppresses degradation imbalance, delays the emergence of bottleneck failures, and improves the long-term reliability of the robotic system during extended operation. These findings demonstrate that integrating health feedback into motion planning provides a practical and robust pathway for enhancing the durability and operational resilience of manipulators subject to continuous wear.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RUL-aware RRT*运动规划方法，将关节剩余寿命信息融入规划过程，自适应调节关节使用以抑制长期运行中的关节退化不均衡，在三种场景下验证其可延缓瓶颈失效并提升系统长期可靠性。
AI.motivation: 机械臂长时间运行常出现关节退化不均衡，最弱执行器提前失效，导致非计划停机和显著运营损失；传统运动规划算法不考虑关节健康状态，在长期运行中反而加剧这种失衡。
AI.method: 提出RUL-aware RRT*，将关节剩余使用寿命（RUL）信息纳入规划过程，并根据不断变化的健康状态自适应调整各关节的使用程度；在三种代表性场景（完全健康场景FHS、异质退化场景HDS、局部退化场景LDS）中进行评估。
AI.result: RUL-aware RRT*能有效抑制退化不均衡，延缓瓶颈失效的出现，并提升机器人在长期运行中的可靠性。
AI.conclusion: 将健康反馈融入运动规划，为提升持续磨损下机械臂的耐久性与运行韧性提供了一条实用且稳健的路径。

title: Octrees as an Explicit 3D Language
summary: Existing 3D large language models (LLMs) compromise on two fronts: they compress shapes into latent codebook indices or coordinate text, which removes spatial structure from what the model observes, and they acquire the 3D modality by fine-tuning the backbone, which overwrites its general language ability. We present OctLLM, which addresses both limitations. Geometry enters as an explicit 3D sequence of octree occupancy tokens. However, full octree sequences grow rapidly with depth; OctLLM therefore randomly empties penultimate-level nodes and omits descendants while preserving shape, yielding a shorter coordinate- and depth-anchored Sparse Octree (S-Octree) for position-aware mask-modeling generation and 3D understanding. On the other front, existing methods introduce a new modality with full fine-tuning or LoRA, but full fine-tuning is costly, LoRA limits 3D capacity, and both modify the language pathway. OctLLM instead adds 3D capacity in parameters separate from the pretrained ones: mesh tokens are routed through independent trainable branches in a subset of blocks while text and image tokens retain the frozen vision-language pathway, and the two streams interact through shared self-attention. It trains far fewer parameters than full fine-tuning, yet sets a new state of the art among unified multimodal LLMs, lowering image-to-3D FID by $17.4\%$ and raising render-grounded captioning by $28.7$ points over ShapeLLM-Omni, while matching the backbone on general language benchmarks.

AI.tldr: OctLLM 用显式稀疏八叉树占用 token 表示三维几何，并在冻结的视觉-语言主干上附加独立可训练分支注入三维能力，训练参数远少于全量微调，却刷新统一多模态 LLM 的 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有 3D LLM 存在两处妥协：(1) 将形状压缩为隐式码本索引或坐标文本，破坏了模型所观测数据的空间结构；(2) 通过微调主干获得三维模态，覆盖了原有通用语言能力。作者希望同时解决这两点。
AI.method: 几何以八叉树占用 token 的显式三维序列输入；由于完整八叉树序列随深度迅速膨胀，随机清空倒数第二层节点并省略其子孙，在保持形状的前提下得到更短的、锚定坐标与深度的稀疏八叉树（S-Octree），用于位置感知的掩码建模生成与三维理解。参数层面，不改动语言通路：网格 token 经过部分模块中独立的可训练分支，文本与图像 token 保留冻结的视觉-语言通路，两条流通过共享自注意力交互。
AI.result: 相比全量微调训练参数大幅减少，同时在统一多模态 LLM 中达到新的 SOTA：相比 ShapeLLM-Omni，image-to-3D FID 降低 17.4%，渲染接地的图像描述（render-grounded captioning）提升 28.7 分，并在通用语言基准上与主干持平。
AI.conclusion: 以显式稀疏八叉树序列保留空间结构，并以与预训练参数分离的独立分支注入三维容量，可同时避免结构信息丢失与语言能力被覆盖，实现高效且不牺牲通用语言性能的三维多模态统一建模。

title: DeReAct: Decomposed Reasoning and Acting for Reliable AI Agents
summary:
ReAct-based agents typically rely on a single LLM policy to propose actions, interact with the environment, and decide when a task is complete. This coupling makes action authorization and completion control difficult to enforce independently, allowing errors to propagate and unsupported completion claims to terminate execution. We introduce DeReAct, a modular agent architecture that externalizes two gating policies: a Critic that validates proposed actions before execution, and a Context Manager that reconstructs an environment-supported \textsc{State} and certifies task completion.
  Across GAIA and SWE-bench Verified, DeReAct improves Pass@1 most for weaker Brain models, with gains of 6.5--7.0 points for Qwen3-Coder-480B and 4.2--5.2 points for Claude Sonnet~4.5; gains diminish as Brain capability increases. Trajectory and ablation analyses show that external gating is effective when targeted failures are sufficiently prevalent and the gating policy is itself sufficient. With Claude Opus~4.5, Pass@1 remains comparable to ReAct, while DeReAct produces more evidence-complete and constraint-satisfying trajectories, indicating that completion control can trade earlier termination for stronger grounding. Overall, DeReAct improves weaker agents while retaining grounding benefits as models strengthen.

AI.tldr: DeReAct 通过外置 Critic 与 Context Manager 两个门控策略，将动作授权与完成判定从单一 LLM 策略中解耦，在 GAIA 与 SWE-bench Verified 上显著提升较弱模型的 Pass@1，并增强轨迹的证据完备性与约束满足度。
AI.motivation: ReAct 类智能体依赖单一 LLM 策略同时负责提出动作、与环境交互以及判断任务是否完成。这种耦合导致动作授权与完成控制难以独立执行：错误会沿轨迹传播，且模型可在环境未支持的情况下宣称任务完成并终止执行。
AI.method: 提出模块化架构 DeReAct，将两个门控策略外置：Critic 在执行前验证被提议的动作；Context Manager 重建由环境支持的 State 并认证任务完成状态。
AI.result: 在 GAIA 与 SWE-bench Verified 上，DeReAct 对较弱 Brain 模型提升最明显：Qwen3-Coder-480B 提升 6.5–7.0 分，Claude Sonnet 4.5 提升 4.2–5.2 分；随 Brain 能力增强，增益递减。轨迹与消融分析表明，当目标失败足够普遍且门控策略本身充分时，外置门控更有效。使用 Claude Opus 4.5 时 Pass@1 与 ReAct 相当，但轨迹更具证据完备性与约束满足性。
AI.conclusion: 外置门控可提升较弱智能体表现；随着模型增强，DeReAct 以可能的更早终止换取更强的 grounding，仍保留 grounding 收益，整体上兼容不同能力水平的模型。

title: Overcoming Challenges of Interpretive Structural Modeling with Large Language Models
comment: This preprint has not undergone peer review or any post-submission improvements or corrections
summary: Interpretive Structural Modeling (ISM) is a well-known process for multi-criteria decision making. The success of ISM over other methodologies is its ability to model causal relationships, the binary scale of factors, and resulting hierarchical representation. Traditionally, the modeling process is performed by repeated interactions with subject matter experts until consensus is reached. This process is tedious, labor-intense, and most importantly limits the ability of ISM to scale to studies with hundreds of variables. Drawing on existing work of causal graph discovery with large language models (LLM) as imperfect experts, this work explores an integrated LLM-ISM approach for ISM. Pairwise, k-wise, rowwise, and full graph discovery methodologies are compared and evaluated. It is shown that causal graph discovery methods for ISM perform best using rowwise (SHD=160, F1-score=0.77) and full graph methods (SHD=135, F1-score=0.73).

AI.tldr: 本文提出将大语言模型(LLM)与解释结构模型(ISM)相结合的LLM-ISM方法，以自动化传统依赖专家反复交互的建模过程，并对比了pairwise、k-wise、rowwise和full graph四种因果图发现策略。
AI.motivation: 传统ISM依赖与领域专家反复交互直至达成共识，过程繁琐、耗费人力，且难以扩展到包含数百个变量的研究，因此需要借助LLM作为“不完美专家”来自动化因果图发现，提升ISM的可扩展性。
AI.method: 借鉴基于LLM的因果图发现研究成果，构建集成的LLM-ISM框架，用LLM替代专家进行因果关系的成对比较。系统比较并评估了四种因果图发现方法：pairwise（成对）、k-wise（k元）、rowwise（逐行）以及full graph（全图）发现。
AI.result: 实验表明，rowwise方法与full graph方法表现最佳：rowwise的SHD=160、F1-score=0.77；full graph的SHD=135、F1-score=0.73。
AI.conclusion: LLM-ISM集成方法可实现ISM因果结构的自动化构建，其中逐行与全图发现策略在因果图发现上效果最优，为ISM向大规模变量研究扩展提供了可行路径。

title: CriticHack: Evaluating Visual Rewards Under Robot Policy Optimization
summary: Learned visual reward models are increasingly used to optimize robot policies, yet a reward model can score an execution that acts on the wrong object as highly as one that completes the task. We show that optimizing such a reward can amplify these wrong-object failures while reward and task success both rise, so the signals a practitioner would normally monitor look healthy. We fine-tune every denoiser parameter of a diffusion policy against Robometer on a drawer task. Starting from a supervised policy with no prior reward exposure, five training runs raise task success by 10.2 percentage points and wrong-object failures by 10.9 points on 512 evaluation seeds, whereas five runs trained on the simulator's task-completion signal raise success without amplifying wrong-object failures (difference 9.2 points, 95% CI 5.6 to 13.0). The amplification recurs from a policy previously optimized against learned rewards, under the policy's native diffusion sampler, at matched distance from the initial policy, and across constrained-policy experiments with two critics and two optimizers. A tilt model explains when it occurs: under KL-regularized optimization, an outcome becomes more frequent whenever its expected reward under the initial policy exceeds the population average. Robometer separates successes from failures well overall (AUROC .81) but scores wrong-object failures slightly above successes (AUROC .37), so optimization raises both. The same model predicts the outcome shifts across 26 constrained settings (Spearman .89), including those in which task success falls, and Robometer's own published success-termination recipe inherits the error. A frozen outcome verifier redirects the same optimization toward the requested task.

AI.tldr: 学习型视觉奖励模型在优化机器人策略时会放大“作用对象错误”的失败模式，且在任务成功率同步上升时监控指标看似健康；该放大可由KL正则优化下的“倾斜模型”预测，冻结的结果验证器可纠正优化方向。
AI.motivation: 学习型视觉奖励模型被广泛用于优化机器人策略，但奖励模型可能无法区分“作用于错误对象”的执行与“正确完成任务”的执行，给出相近分数。作者希望揭示：针对此类奖励优化会放大错误对象失败，而常用监控指标（奖励与任务成功率）却同时上升，从而使实践者难以察觉问题。
AI.method: 在抽屉任务上，对扩散策略的所有去噪器参数基于Robometer（学习型奖励模型）进行微调，起点为未接触过奖励的监督策略；对比使用模拟器任务完成信号训练的对照组。通过512个评估种子统计任务成功率与错误对象失败率，并检验放大现象的稳健性（来自曾被学习奖励优化过的策略、策略原生扩散采样器下、与初始策略距离匹配条件下、以及两个critic与两个优化器的约束策略实验）。提出“倾斜模型”解释：在KL正则优化下，某结果的期望奖励高于初始策略下的群体均值时，该结果会更频繁出现。
AI.result: 五次Robometer训练使任务成功率提升10.2个百分点，同时错误对象失败率提升10.9个百分点；而五次任务完成信号训练提升成功率但未放大错误对象失败（差异9.2个百分点，95% CI 5.6–13.0）。Robometer整体区分成功与失败较好（AUROC .81），但对错误对象失败的评分略高于成功（AUROC .37），故优化同时抬升两者。倾斜模型在26个约束设置中预测结果偏移（Spearman .89），包括任务成功率下降的情形；Robometer自身公开的成功终止配方也继承了该错误。冻结的结果验证器可将同一优化重定向至所请求任务。
AI.conclusion: 学习型视觉奖励模型可能在指标看似健康的情况下放大错误对象失败，其机制可由KL正则优化下的倾斜模型刻画，并可跨多种设置复现。Robometer的高整体AUROC掩盖了对错误对象失败的偏差评分，且该偏差会传导至其终止配方。引入冻结的结果验证器可有效将优化导向正确任务，提示需在奖励优化中加入结果级校验。

title: An AI-Based Multi-Stage Approach for Androgenetic Alopecia Assessment from Low-Magnification Scalp Images
