summary: Androgenetic alopecia (AGA) is characterized by patterned follicular miniaturization, increased single-hair follicular units, and altered hair-shaft diameter. We present an automated quantitative scalp-analysis and clinical decision-support framework combining FU localization, ordinal visible-shaft counting, calibrated shaft-width estimation, regional aggregation, and an interpretable rule layer. The clinical cohort comprised 243 patients (127 AGA, 116 non-AGA), while the computer-vision experiments used 160 expert-annotated patients, 2,400 trichoscopic images, and approximately 158,000 FU annotations. Under patientdisjoint evaluation, YOLOv8m achieved test mAP@0.5=0.920 and recall=0.860; EfficientNet-B5 with a support-map channel achieved 87.0% expert-box count accuracy (macro F1=0.85). A separate 500-image set was processed end-to-end with detector-generated boxes, yielding MAE of 6.56 for follicle detection and 16.59 for follicle classification relative to human-expert annotations. The system is intended to assist, rather than replace, dermatologist interpretation.

AI.tldr: 提出一套自动化头皮定量分析与临床决策支持框架，用于雄激素性脱发（AGA）的毛囊定位、毛发计数、毛干直径估计与区域聚合，并叠加可解释规则层。在患者不相交评估下，检测与计数性能良好，系统定位为辅助而非替代皮肤科医生判读。
AI.motivation: AGA表现为模式化毛囊微小化、单根毛发毛囊单位增多及毛干直径改变，临床判读依赖毛发镜图像的人工评估，主观性强且耗时；因此需要自动化、可量化且可解释的分析工具来支持诊断与随访。
AI.method: 构建融合毛囊单位（FU）定位、有序可见毛干计数、经校准的毛干宽度估计、区域聚合与可解释规则层的框架。临床队列243例（127例AGA、116例非AGA）；计算机视觉实验使用160例专家标注患者、2400张毛发镜图像及约158,000个FU标注。检测采用YOLOv8m，计数/分类采用带支持图通道的EfficientNet-B5。
AI.result: 患者不相交评估下，YOLOv8m取得测试mAP@0.5=0.920、召回率=0.860；带支持图通道的EfficientNet-B5实现87.0%的专家框计数准确率（宏F1=0.85）。另用500张图像以检测器生成框进行端到端处理，相对人类专家标注，毛囊检测MAE为6.56，毛囊分类MAE为16.59。
AI.conclusion: 该框架可实现AGA相关头皮毛发特征的自动化定量分析与可解释决策支持，性能达到较高水平，但设计用途是辅助而非替代皮肤科医生的临床判读。

title: Traversing the Satisfaction-Diversity Frontier in Text-to-Image Diffusion
summary: Text-to-image generation enables users to explore several images generated from the same prompt. For these generated images to be useful, each one must reflect the user's preferences, measured by a learned reward, and differ visually from the others to maintain diversity. Existing methods are limited: they either address reward and diversity separately or combine them in one aggregate score, enabling high diversity to offset low rewards. In this paper, we address these limitations by formulating generation as satisficing: every image (candidate) must satisfy a reward floor and the batch of images must satisfy a diversity cutoff. The reward floor controls the balance between worst-candidate reward and batch diversity; we show that varying this floor defines a Pareto frontier. To traverse this frontier, we introduce SatisDive, a training-free inference-time method. SatisDive uses a batch-relative reward cutoff to distinguish lower- from higher-reward candidates, emphasizing reward improvement for candidates below the cutoff and diversity among candidates above it. On Pick-a-Pic, at matched DreamSim, SatisDive improves worst-candidate reward over FK steering by up to 0.43 with FLUX.1-dev as the base model and HPSv3 as the reward, and by up to 0.70 with SANA-1.6B as the base model and ImageReward as the reward. More broadly, across their overlapping DreamSim ranges, SatisDive's satisfaction-diversity curve Pareto-dominates FK steering's curve in each setting.

AI.tldr: 提出将文本到图像生成建模为"满意化"问题，并设计免训练推理期方法 SatisDive，在保证奖励下限与多样性下界的前提下实现奖励-多样性帕累托前沿的遍历。
AI.motivation: 同一提示词生成多张图像时，每张图既要符合用户偏好（由学习到的奖励衡量），又要在视觉上彼此不同以保持多样性。现有方法存在缺陷：或分别独立处理奖励与多样性，或将其合并为单一总分，导致高多样性可能掩盖低奖励（即以多样性换取奖励下降）。
AI.method: 将生成问题形式化为满意化（satisficing）：每张候选图须满足一个奖励下限（reward floor），同时整批图像须满足多样性下界（diversity cutoff）。奖励下限控制最差候选奖励与批次多样性之间的权衡，改变下限即刻画出一条帕累托前沿。为遍历该前沿，提出 SatisDive——一种免训练、推理期方法：使用批量相对的奖励截断值区分低奖励与高奖励候选，对低于截断值的候选强调奖励提升，对高于截断值的候选强调多样性。
AI.result: 在 Pick-a-Pic 数据集上，在 DreamSim 相同的条件下，以 FLUX.1-dev 为基座模型、HPSv3 为奖励时，SatisDive 相比 FK steering 将最差候选奖励最多提升 0.43；以 SANA-1.6B 为基座模型、ImageReward 为奖励时最多提升 0.70。在两者重叠的 DreamSim 区间内，SatisDive 的满意-多样性曲线在各设定下均帕累托优于 FK steering 的曲线。
AI.conclusion: 将奖励与多样性通过满意化框架解耦并分别施加下限约束，可避免单一总分带来的权衡失真；SatisDive 作为免训练推理期方法，能在不牺牲多样性的前提下显著改善最差候选奖励，并在多个基座模型与奖励模型组合下稳定帕累托支配已有方法。

title: MACTS-EM: Multi-Agent Collaborative Time Series Forecasting with Emergent Memory
summary: Time series forecasting remains a critical challenge across numerous domains. Despite significant advancements, existing approaches struggle with complex phenomena such as regime shifts, cross-domain knowledge transfer, and multimodal data integration. This paper introduces Multi-Agent Collaborative Time Series Forecasting with Emergent Memory (MACTS-EM), a novel framework where specialised agents collaborate to achieve superior forecasting performance. The MACTS-EM architecture integrates: (1) domain-specialised forecasting agents for pattern recognition, anomaly detection, causal inference, and uncertainty quantification; (2) a meta-cognitive layer for dynamic agent allocation; (3) an emergent memory mechanism enabling cross-domain pattern transfer; (4) multimodal contextual integration; and (5) adversarial robustness components. Evaluation across financial markets, climate patterns, energy consumption, and pandemic propagation demonstrates that MACTS-EM outperforms existing approaches in most scenarios, with 8-12% improvement in forecasting accuracy, 22-27% better zero-shot transfer capability, 16-21% enhanced resilience during regime shifts, and 15-18% faster recovery after distribution shifts. Our findings suggest that collaborative, agentic approaches to time series forecasting represent a promising direction beyond traditional architectures, particularly for complex real-world scenarios requiring multi-resolution temporal understanding and contextual adaptation.

AI.tldr: 提出多智能体协同时间序列预测框架MACTS-EM，集成专用预测智能体、元认知调度、涌现记忆、多模态融合与对抗鲁棒性，在多数场景下优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 时间序列预测在诸多领域仍是关键挑战。现有方法难以应对机制转换（regime shifts）、跨域知识迁移与多模态数据融合等复杂现象，需要超越传统架构的新范式。
AI.method: MACTS-EM由五部分组成：(1) 领域专用预测智能体，分别负责模式识别、异常检测、因果推断与不确定性量化；(2) 元认知层实现智能体动态分配；(3) 涌现记忆机制支持跨域模式迁移；(4) 多模态上下文融合；(5) 对抗鲁棒性组件。
AI.result: 在金融市场、气候模式、能源消费与疫情传播四类场景评估：预测精度提升8-12%，零样本迁移能力提升22-27%，机制转换期韧性增强16-21%，分布漂移后恢复速度加快15-18%。
AI.conclusion: 协同式智能体方法代表超越传统架构的有前景方向，尤其适用于需要多分辨率时间理解与上下文自适应的复杂现实场景。

title: Real-time Event-camera Stereo Visual Odometry via Keytime Gaussian Process Regression
comment: Submitted to IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation (ICRA) 2027, 8 pages, 1 figures, 3 tables. The corresponding video can be found at https://youtu.be/MmpH8QYR76g
summary:
Event cameras have microsecond-level temporal resolution and high dynamic range which make them more resilient to motion blur and poor illumination than standard frame-based cameras. Event-camera visual odometry (VO) pipelines maximize these benefits when they process the asynchronous event stream at the native temporal resolution. Continuous-time Gaussian process (GP) regression and a white-noise-on-acceleration (WNOA) prior can handle asynchronous measurements but result in a prohibitively large estimation state when applied naively.
  This paper presents a continuous-time event-camera stereo VO pipeline that maintains the native measurement times of asynchronous events while also running in real time. It reduces the estimation states to keytimes while maintaining full temporal resolution by interpolating measurements to their exact timestamps with a physically founded WNOA prior. This decouples the state size from the dense number of measurements without discarding their asynchronous nature.
  The real-time continuous-time VO pipeline is evaluated on the MVSEC and DSEC datasets. It provides estimates in real time that are more accurate than ES-PTAM, a state-of-the-art discrete estimator, in all but one of the tested sequences. The pipeline respectively provides estimates at 22 Hz and 6 Hz on MVSEC and DSEC and RMS relative errors of 0.46 cm and 0.038 degrees across all valid sequences, which were 11 and 15 times better than ES-PTAM, respectively.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种连续时间事件相机双目视觉里程计（VO）流水线，利用白噪声加速度先验在关键时间点插值异步事件，实现实时且保持原生时间分辨率的估计。
AI.motivation: 事件相机具备微秒级时间分辨率和高动态范围，抗运动模糊与弱光能力优于标准帧相机。但只有以原生时间分辨率处理异步事件流时才能最大化这些优势。连续时间高斯过程回归与白噪声加速度先验虽可处理异步测量，但直接应用会导致估计状态规模过大，难以实时运行。
AI.method: 采用连续时间事件相机双目VO流水线：将估计状态缩减至关键时间点（keytimes），同时借助物理上合理的白噪声加速度（WNOA）先验把测量插值到其精确时间戳，从而保持完整时间分辨率。该方法将状态规模与稠密测量数量解耦，又不丢弃测量的异步特性。
AI.result: 在MVSEC和DSEC数据集上评测。所有测试序列中除一个外，精度均优于当前最先进的离散估计器ES-PTAM。流水线在MVSEC和DSEC上分别达到22 Hz和6 Hz的实时估计频率；在所有有效序列上的RMS相对误差分别为0.46 cm和0.038度，分别比ES-PTAM好11倍和15倍。
AI.conclusion: 该方法通过关键时间点状态与WNOA先验插值，成功解耦状态规模与测量密度，实现实时连续时间事件相机双目VO，在保持原生时间分辨率的同时取得优于离散基线ES-PTAM的精度与实时性能。

title: A Simulation-Grounded Agentic VLM Framework for Wildfire Monitoring and Reporting
summary: Effective wildfire monitoring requires relating visual evidence to physical fire dynamics, yet real videos with synchronized physical annotations are scarce and high-fidelity 3D simulation is costly. We present a simulation-grounded vision-language model (VLM) framework that automatically converts 2D wildfire simulations into labeled video episodes. A fixed Blender mapping produces low-detail 3D proxies aligned with simulator terrain, fuel layout, fire activity, and wind cues; controllable video generation supplies richer appearance. The proxies are intermediate representations rather than finely rendered final scenes. Generated videos and simulator labels form reusable multimodal memory for a training-free multi-agent VLM system that retrieves reference episodes, reconciles visual and memory-based predictions, and produces structured wildfire reports. On held-out generated episodes, video memory achieves 51.5% exact four-tag accuracy, compared with 22.6% for direct VLM querying and 16-17% for text-only memory; the complete system achieves 77.3% accuracy on six simulator-derived report fields. Component ablations, cross-generator tests, and three real-UAV evaluations assess retrieval, reporting, generator changes, and observable monitoring tasks. The framework connects automatic simulation-to-proxy conversion with memory-based VLM reasoning under scarce real-world physical annotations.

AI.tldr: 提出一个基于模拟的视觉-语言模型（VLM）框架，将2D野火模拟自动转化为带标注的视频片段，构建可复用的多模态记忆，驱动免训练的多智能体VLM系统进行野火监测与结构化报告生成。
AI.motivation: 野火监测需要将视觉证据与物理火行为关联，但同步物理标注的真实视频稀缺，高保真3D模拟成本高昂。因此需要一种低成本、可扩展的途径，在缺乏真实物理标注的条件下实现视觉-物理关联推理。
AI.method: 用固定Blender映射将2D野火模拟转为低细节3D代理（对齐地形、燃料布局、火势与风场线索），作为中间表示而非精渲染场景；再由可控视频生成提供更丰富外观。生成视频与模拟器标签构成可复用多模态记忆，支撑免训练多智能体VLM系统：检索参考片段、融合视觉与记忆预测，输出结构化野火报告。
AI.result: 在留出生成片段上，视频记忆实现51.5%的四标签完全正确率，直接VLM查询为22.6%，纯文本记忆为16–17%；完整系统在六个模拟器衍生报告字段上达77.3%准确率。通过组件消融、跨生成器测试及三次真实无人机评估，验证了检索、报告、生成器更换与可观测监测任务。
AI.conclusion: 该框架将自动模拟到代理的转换与基于记忆的VLM推理相结合，在真实物理标注稀缺条件下实现有效的野火视觉-物理监测与结构化报告。

title: THPL: A Vision-to-Language Decision Support Framework for Rainbow Trout Feeding Management in RAS
comment: Meng Liang and Guanbo Feng contributed equally. Corresponding authors: Zhihong Ma and Ying Liu. 50 pages, 10 figures, 3 tables. Supplementary video: https://youtu.be/Tg2Qk7m46-A
summary: In Recirculating Aquaculture Systems (RAS), precision feeding is critical for minimizing costs and improving fish welfare. However, existing methods lack cognitive alignment between fish behaviors and management knowledge, impeding translation into executable, interpretable feeding decisions. To address this, we propose THPL, a generative feeding decision framework tailored for rainbow trout (Oncorhynchus mykiss) in RAS. First, Fishsort extracts trajectories to establish an Activity Coefficient (AC) quantifying feeding intensity. Second, a Hierarchical Behavior Encoder (HBE) models individual temporal progression and collective dynamics using Temporal and Set Transformers, transforming trajectory tensors into dual-evidence representations of explicit physical and implicit soft tokens. Finally, these tokens are integrated with environmental parameters, metadata, and expert rules to fine-tune an LLM via LoRA, followed by counterfactual multimodal Direct Preference Optimization (mDPO) to reinforce causal reasoning. Results show that AC exhibits a statistically significant monotonic positive correlation with expert-annotated feeding intensity (Spearman $ρ= 0.925$, $p < 0.001$). Ablations indicate that decision accuracy improves from 33.33% (text-only baseline) to 93.33% with dual-evidence tokens, confirming that continuous spatiotemporal tokens provide necessary physical grounding for LLMs. Compared with standard LoRA, counterfactual mDPO elevates decision accuracy from 93.33% to 96.67%, advances METEOR from 58.10% to 85.30%, reduces Self-BLEU-2 from 58.79% to 52.88%, and increases Distinct-3 from 6.68% to 7.81%, suppressing templating and actuation biases while reinforcing causal consistency and operational safety. Overall, by integrating continuous kinematics with LLM reasoning, this study provides a novel decision support paradigm for precision aquaculture.

AI.tldr: 提出THPL生成式投喂决策框架，通过连续时空行为证据与LLM推理的认知对齐，实现循环水养殖虹鳟的精准投喂决策。
AI.motivation: 循环水养殖系统（RAS）中精准投喂对降低成本、提升鱼类福利至关重要，但现有方法缺乏鱼类行为与管理知识之间的认知对齐，导致难以转化为可执行、可解释的投喂决策。
AI.method: THPL框架包含三部分：（1）Fishsort提取轨迹并构建活动系数（AC）量化摄食强度；（2）分层行为编码器（HBE）利用Temporal Transformer与Set Transformer建模个体时序进程与群体动态，将轨迹张量转化为显式物理与隐式软令牌的双证据表示；（3）将令牌与环境参数、元数据及专家规则融合，通过LoRA微调LLM，并采用反事实多模态直接偏好优化（mDPO）强化因果推理。
AI.result: AC与专家标注摄食强度呈显著单调正相关（Spearman ρ=0.925，p<0.001）。消融显示，决策准确率由纯文本基线的33.33%提升至引入双证据令牌后的93.33%，证明连续时空令牌为LLM提供必要物理接地。相比标准LoRA，反事实mDPO将准确率由93.33%提升至96.67%，METEOR由58.10%升至85.30%，Self-BLEU-2由58.79%降至52.88%，Distinct-3由6.68%升至7.81%，抑制模板化与执行偏差。
AI.conclusion: 该研究通过将连续运动学与LLM推理相结合，为精准水产养殖提供了新的决策支持范式，在提升决策准确性与可解释性的同时增强因果一致性与操作安全性。

title: TRACE: A Reproducible Benchmark for Electricity Price Forecasting with Official Operational Text
comment: Accepted to the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Foundation Models for Time Series (FMTS)
summary: Electricity price forecasting (EPF) supports scheduling, bidding, and risk management in electricity markets, yet existing benchmarks focus mainly on numerical inputs, leaving the forecasting value of forecast-time textual context insufficiently evaluated. We introduce TRACE, a reproducible benchmark of 7,300 zone--day instances pairing prices from five zones in a major U.S. market with official operational text available at the forecast cutoff. TRACE reconstructs official operational text at each cutoff, preventing post-cutoff information leakage. We evaluate TRACE for semantic alignment and forecasting value. Semantic assessments align with central movement and both tail risks in ground-truth prices, most consistently for upper-tail price risk. Forecasting value is reflected in a median 7.4\% reduction in upper-tail pinball loss across time-series foundation models. A controlled cross-day text-mismatch ablation reverses the gains, falling below the no-text baseline.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TRACE基准，将美国某主要电力市场5个区域的价格与预测截止时刻可得的官方运营文本配对，构建7,300个区域-日实例，以评估文本上下文对电价预测的价值，发现文本在尾部风险预测上有稳定增益。
AI.motivation: 现有电价预测（EPF）基准主要关注数值输入，未能充分评估预测时刻可获得的文本上下文在预测中的价值；同时若纳入运营文本，容易引入截止时刻之后的信息，造成信息泄漏，因此需要一个可复现、无泄漏的基准来系统评估文本的语义对齐与预测价值。
AI.method: 构建TRACE基准：包含7,300个区域-日实例，覆盖美国某主要电力市场5个区域的价格；在每个预测截止时刻重建官方运营文本，以避免截止后信息泄漏。随后从两方面评估：一是文本与真实价格的语义对齐（中心走势与双侧尾部风险），二是文本对预测的价值；并使用跨日文本错配的受控消融实验进行检验。
AI.result: 语义评估显示，文本与真实价格的中心走势及双侧尾部风险均存在对齐，其中与上尾价格风险的对齐最为稳定；在预测价值方面，时间序列基础模型的上尾pinball损失中位数降低7.4%。跨日文本错配消融使增益逆转，表现降至无文本基线以下。
AI.conclusion: TRACE提供了一个无信息泄漏、可复现的评估框架，表明预测时刻可得的官方运营文本对电价预测（尤其是上尾风险）具有实际价值；且该增益依赖文本与目标日的正确对应关系，错配会消除甚至反转收益。

title: A Passive AI System for Verifying Physical State on Automated Liquid Handlers
summary: Automated liquid handlers execute digital protocols, but operators must assemble the deck and confirm that the physical setup matches the intended experiment. We present the Labware Setup Checker, a passive vision system that verifies deck preparation on an Opentrons Flex without modifying its hardware or firmware. A consumer webcam mounted outside the robot supplies images to a browser application. The checker segments the deck into slots, corrects slot assignments using the known deck geometry, classifies the labware, and compares the observed setup with a reference protocol library to report missing, misplaced, or unexpected labware. It operates independently of the robot controller and does not interrupt or gate a run. During SwabSeq Respiratory Viral Panel (RVP) pre-PCR deck preparation, the checker tracked a slot from empty to a base and then to the completed plate-and-base assembly, identifying the completed assembly in all 29 frames before robot motion. Across these frames, 95.1% of the 348 labware classifications for slots requiring exact matches agreed with the protocol reference. In 480 frames with partially occluded reservoirs, all 6,720 slot assignments were correct. Across three camera positions and two lighting conditions, slot assignment was 100% correct, and 97.73% of labware classifications matched the protocol reference. Median verification time was 2.10 s on a laptop using only its CPU and 4.24 s from frame capture to receipt of results during AWS deployment in the laboratory. These results show that an external camera and independent software can provide verification of deck setup against protocol requirements within seconds, allowing operators to review the physical setup before starting a run.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出Labware Setup Checker，一种不修改Opentrons Flex硬件或固件的被动视觉系统，用外部普通摄像头与独立浏览器软件验证工作站台面装配是否与协议一致，可在数秒内报告缺失、错位或多余耗材且不干扰运行。
AI.motivation: 自动化液体处理器执行数字协议时，仍需操作员手动装配台面并确认物理设置与预期实验一致，这一人工核对环节缺乏自动化验证手段。
AI.method: 系统在机器人外部安装消费级网络摄像头，将图像传入浏览器应用；对台面进行槽位分割，利用已知台面几何校正槽位分配，分类耗材类型，并与参考协议库比对，从而报告缺失、错位或非预期耗材；系统独立于机器人控制器，不中断也不阻断运行。
AI.result: 在SwabSeq呼吸道病毒面板预PCR台面准备中，系统跟踪某槽位由空到底座再到完整板-底座组件，在机器人运动前全部29帧中识别出完整组件；这些帧中348次需精确匹配的耗材分类有95.1%与协议参考一致；480帧部分遮挡储液槽图像中6,720次槽位分配全部正确；三种相机位置和两种光照条件下槽位分配100%正确，耗材分类与参考一致率97.73%；笔记本电脑纯CPU中位验证时间2.10 s，实验室AWS部署下从采集到接收结果4.24 s。
AI.conclusion: 外部摄像头加独立软件可在数秒内依据协议要求验证台面设置，使操作员能在启动运行前复核物理设置，为自动化实验流程提供低成本、非侵入式的预运行检查方案。

title: DeepStratNet: A Context-Aware Coordinate Regression Framework for Seismic Horizon Tracking under Sparse Labels
summary: Automatic horizon tracking is a foundational task in 3D seismic interpretation. Most existing deep learning approaches formulate it as dense semantic segmentation, typically using U-Net-based architectures. The model produces a probability map over all pixels that must be post-processed to extract precise horizon coordinates, while horizon picks in time/depth must be converted into dense masks for training. Unpicked seismic traces are consequently treated as background, which can hinder convergence, and both pre- and post-processing can introduce errors into the final interpretation. Moreover, 2D segmentation models do not inherently capture inter-slice context, while 3D models are often computationally prohibitive. We instead formulate horizon tracking as a bounded coordinate regression problem, where the model directly predicts the time/depth coordinate of the target horizon at each lateral position. We propose a lightweight regression head compatible with any pretrained vision backbone, coupled with an LSTM module to model inter-slice context and produce a continuous horizon surface across the volume. A combination of L1 and L2 losses supervises predictions at valid horizon picks, while a geology-informed regularization enforces lateral continuity between successive traces. Under controlled experimental conditions, we evaluate four pretrained vision backbones under both segmentation and regression configurations on a seismic volume from New Zealand. The proposed approach consistently outperforms its segmentation counterparts quantitatively, using metrics including RMSE and PCC, and qualitatively, while also demonstrating greater robustness to increasing sparsity of training picks. Finally, we show that prediction variation across successive traces captures local variations in geological complexity, providing an automated quality control measure for downstream seismic interpretation.

AI.tldr: 本文将三维地震层位追踪重新定义为有界坐标回归问题，提出可与任意预训练视觉骨干兼容的轻量回归头，并结合LSTM建模切片间上下文，直接预测层位坐标，在性能、鲁棒性和质量监控方面均优于分割方法。
AI.motivation: 现有深度学习层位追踪多采用U-Net式稠密语义分割，存在多个问题：需要前后处理提取精确坐标且易引入误差；未拾取道被当作背景影响收敛；二维模型缺乏切片间上下文，三维模型计算代价高。因此作者希望规避分割范式，直接回归层位坐标。
AI.method: 提出有界坐标回归公式，模型在每个横向位置直接预测目标层位的时间/深度坐标。设计轻量回归头，兼容任意预训练视觉骨干；引入LSTM模块建模切片间上下文，生成跨数据体的连续层面。采用L1与L2联合损失在有效层位拾取处监督预测，并用地质信息驱动的正则项约束相邻道间的横向连续性。
AI.result: 在新西兰地震数据体上，于受控实验条件下对比四种预训练视觉骨干在分割与回归两种配置下的表现。所提方法在RMSE、PCC等定量指标及定性效果上一致优于分割对照方法，并对训练拾取稀疏度增加表现出更强鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 将层位追踪建模为有界坐标回归是可行且有效的，能规避分割范式的前后处理误差与稀疏拾取问题。此外，相邻道间预测变化可反映局部地质复杂度，为下游地震解释提供自动化质量控制手段。

title: FlashSinkhorn 2: Block-Sparse Entropic Optimal Transport
summary: Streaming GPU solvers for entropic optimal transport (EOT), such as FlashSinkhorn, avoid storing the dense kernel but still evaluate all $n\times m$ point pairs in every Sinkhorn iteration. We present \textbf{FlashSinkhorn~2} (FS2), a solver for squared-Euclidean cost on low-dimensional point clouds that solves large discrete EOT problems to a prescribed marginal residual on a single GPU by coupling two stages. A coarse stage solves on cell centroids, lifts the potentials to every point and, when a sampled marginal check rejects the lift, continues on the centroids, replacing most point-level updates. A block-sparse fine stage then removes the centroid error that coarse updates cannot. Its Morton-ordered blocks support screening and fused tensor-core execution, and a threshold set by the block masses bounds each omitted tile's contribution to every row and column. On synthetic benchmarks, FS2 reaches the target residual on all 32 problems and GeomLoss multiscale on 10. On one A100, FS2 solves discrete EOT between two $1.34\times10^8$-particle measures from a cosmological $N$-body simulation, at an entropic blur equal to the mean interparticle distance, to an all-particle marginal residual below 0.01 in under 2.5 hours. To our knowledge, it is the largest discrete EOT problem solved to this accuracy within hours. For reproducibility, we release an open-source implementation at https://github.com/ot-triton-lab/flash-sinkhorn

AI.tldr: FlashSinkhorn 2 (FS2) 是一种面向低维点云上平方欧氏代价的流式 GPU 熵正则最优传输求解器，通过"粗粒度质心阶段 + 块稀疏精细阶段"耦合，在单卡上求解十亿级粒子的离散 EOT 问题。
AI.motivation: 现有流式 GPU 求解器（如 FlashSinkhorn）虽避免存储稠密核矩阵，但每次 Sinkhorn 迭代仍需计算全部 n×m 点对，规模受限于算力与显存。需要一种能在单 GPU 上将大规模离散 EOT 求解到指定边际残差的方法。
AI.method: FS2 采用两阶段耦合：(1) 粗粒度阶段在单元质心上求解，将势函数提升至所有点，当采样边际检验拒绝该提升时继续在质心上迭代，从而替代大部分点级更新；(2) 块稀疏精细阶段消除粗更新无法修正的质心误差。精细阶段采用 Morton 排序分块，支持筛选与融合张量核执行，并由块质量设定阈值，约束每个被省略 tile 对每行每列贡献的上界。
AI.result: 在合成基准上，FS2 在全部 32 个问题上达到目标残差，GeomLoss 多尺度在 10 个问题上达标。单张 A100 上，FS2 求解宇宙学 N-body 模拟中两个 1.34×10^8 粒子测度间的离散 EOT（熵模糊等于平均粒子间距），使全粒子边际残差低于 0.01，耗时不到 2.5 小时。据作者所知，这是数小时内以该精度求解的最大离散 EOT 问题。
AI.conclusion: FS2 通过粗-精两阶段与 Morton 块稀疏张量核执行的结合，在单 GPU 上实现了超大规模离散 EOT 的高精度求解，显著扩展了可处理问题的规模，并开源了实现以保证可复现性。

title: Parameter-Free Interval-Dynamic Regret under Heavy-Tailed Noise
summary:
We study online convex optimization with one unbiased stochastic subgradient per round and an unknown finite conditional $p$th noise moment, $1<p\le2$. For every fixed interval $I$ of length $n$ and comparator path with $Λ_I=1+P_I/D$, one learner achieves
  \[ E[Regret_I(u)]\le\min(GDn, C[GD\sqrt{n(Λ_I+\log^2(2T))} +σDn^{1/p}(Λ_I+\log^2(2T))^{(p-1)/p}]). \]
  The learner uses none of $G,σ,p,I,P_I$, and the constant is universal. Interval adaptation adds to comparator complexity, preserving the distinct mean-gradient and noise exponents. The analysis controls calibration in expectation and limits the cost of observation-scale changes. Its general theorem compares to distributions over predictably available experts with relative-entropy dependence on a nonuniform prior. A common prior favors long windows and long restart lengths. With the statistics supplied, the interval cost becomes $1+\log(T/n)$, including the optimal full-horizon static rate. A change-of-measure lower bound identifies the noise power of this logarithm for learners retaining a full-horizon optimal guarantee, under explicit conditions. Static comparisons and deterministic partitions follow from the same decisions.

AI.tldr: 研究每轮仅一个无偏随机次梯度的在线凸优化,条件 p 阶噪声矩未知(1<p≤2)。学习器无需知道 G、σ、p、区间 I 等量,在任意长度 n 的区间上实现自适应遗憾界,同时保持均值梯度项与噪声项的不同指数。
AI.motivation: 经典在线凸优化遗憾界通常需要事先知晓梯度上界 G、噪声矩 σ、p 等参数,且在自适应区间与自适应比较器路径的联合设定下,去中心化梯度自适应的噪声与均值梯度指数往往被混淆。本文希望在参数全部未知的情况下,给出同时具备区间自适应与比较器路径自适应的最优遗憾保证。
AI.method: 采用去中心化梯度(centered gradient)分析,在期望意义下控制标定(calibration);限制观测尺度变化带来的代价。得到的一般定理与"可预测可用专家上的分布"比较,依赖非均匀先验的相对熵;采用偏好长窗口与长重启长度的先验。结合所提供统计量,区间代价化为 1+log(T/n)。并以变测度(change-of-measure)下界刻画保留全时域最优保证的学习器所对应噪声项中的对数幂次。
AI.result: 对任意区间 I 与比较器路径 Λ_I=1+P_I/D,学习器取得 E[Regret_I(u)] ≤ min(GDn, C[GD√(n(Λ_I+log²(2T))) + σD n^{1/p}(Λ_I+log²(2T))^{(p-1)/p}]),常数通用且学习器不使用 G、σ、p、I、P_I。区间自适应仅增加比较器复杂度而保持均值梯度与噪声的不同指数;静态比较与确定性划分由同一决策推出。
AI.conclusion: 该工作给出了参数未知下带条件的区间与路径双重自适应在线凸优化最优速率,揭示了保留全时域最优保证时对数噪声幂次的不可避免性,并统一了静态与划分场景。

title: DeltaWorld: Physically Consistent Interactive World Simulators via Action-Conditioned Latent Increment Learning
summary: Interactive world simulators can provide scalable environments for robot planning, policy training, and evaluation by predicting action consequences while reducing reliance on repeated physical rollouts. To serve these applications, they must generate future image sequences that respond faithfully to robot actions and preserve the dynamics of robot-object interactions over long horizons. However, existing world models typically predict the entire next latent state and often fail to capture subtle changes induced by robot actions. Such omissions can produce physically implausible outcomes, including object interpenetration and excessive deformation. To address this limitation, we propose DeltaWorld, a physically consistent interactive world simulator for robotic manipulation. Our method introduces the Delta Latent Transition Model (Delta-LTM), which predicts action-induced latent feature changes and adds them to the current latent state to obtain the next state, rather than predicting the next latent state directly. To mitigate object interpenetration and excessive deformation in predicted future frames, Interaction-aware Latent Alignment is introduced to construct counterfactual interaction regions and supervise interaction-related latent changes. DeltaWorld is evaluated on the IWS manipulation benchmark and a self-collected cross-robot dataset covering multiple robot embodiments and manipulation tasks. On the cross-robot dataset, DeltaWorld reduces FVD by 46.6% and LPIPS by 31.1% relative to the IWS baseline. These results highlight the potential of DeltaWorld for long-horizon action-conditioned video prediction in robotic manipulation.

AI.tldr: 提出DeltaWorld交互式世界模拟器，通过预测动作引起的潜特征变化（Delta-LTM）替代直接预测下一潜状态，并引入交互感知潜对齐，缓解物体穿透与过度变形。
AI.motivation: 交互式世界模拟器可减少对物理滚动的依赖，但现有世界模型通常整体预测下一潜状态，难以捕捉机器人动作引发的细微变化，导致物体穿透、过度变形等物理不合理结果。
AI.method: 核心为Delta潜状态转移模型（Delta-LTM）：预测动作诱导的潜特征增量并叠加到当前潜状态得到下一状态；同时引入交互感知潜对齐（Interaction-aware Latent Alignment），构建反事实交互区域以监督与交互相关的潜变化。
AI.result: 在IWS操作基准与自采集跨机器人数据集（涵盖多种机器人本体与操作任务）上评估；跨机器人数据集上相较IWS基线，FVD降低46.6%，LPIPS降低31.1%。
AI.conclusion: DeltaWorld在长时程、动作条件化的机器人操作视频预测中展现出潜力，提升了物理一致性与生成质量。

title: MeshQuery: Agentic Seam Planning for UV Parametrization
summary: We present MeshQuery, a training-free agentic approach to automatic UV unwrapping of production-grade quad meshes. A Vision-Language Model (VLM) plans artist-aligned seams using a set of edge-selection tools, conditioned on domain-specific UV-unwrapping knowledge expressed in natural language and refined with a feedback loop. We design a queryable mesh representation together with a domain-specific language (DSL) that enables the agent to retrieve mesh information on demand, express a seam plan as a compact program of edge-selection operators over topological, geometric, and semantic mesh attributes, and iteratively refine it from UV quality feedback. On Adobe Substance 3D and Toys4K meshes, MeshQuery produces 2.9x/4.29x fewer charts and 1.63x/1.7x shorter seams than the strongest baseline, and professional artists prefer its results in 80.9% of comparisons. Ultimately, decoupling high-level intent planning from low-level edge selection and compact mesh representation lets MeshQuery run on different backend VLMs and scale to meshes an order of magnitude larger than autoregressive seam prediction

AI.tldr: 本文提出 MeshQuery，一种免训练的智能体式自动 UV 展开方法，通过 VLM 规划接缝、DSL 表达选择算子并结合 UV 质量反馈迭代精化，在专业数据集上显著优于基线并获艺术家偏好。
AI.motivation: 生产级四边形网格的自动 UV 展开需生成符合艺术家习惯的接缝，传统方法在接缝规划的高层意图与底层边选择之间缺乏有效解耦，且难以扩展到大网格。
AI.method: 使用视觉语言模型（VLM）结合领域自然语言知识进行接缝规划；设计可查询网格表示与领域特定语言（DSL），使智能体按需检索网格信息，并以拓扑、几何、语义属性的边选择算子程序紧凑表达接缝方案；基于 UV 质量反馈构建闭环迭代精化。
AI.result: 在 Adobe Substance 3D 与 Toys4K 网格上，相比最强基线，图表数减少 2.9x/4.29x，接缝长度缩短 1.63x/1.7x；专业艺术家在 80.9% 的对比中更偏好其结果。
AI.conclusion: 将高层意图规划与低层边选择及紧凑网格表示解耦，使 MeshQuery 可运行于不同后端 VLM，并能扩展到比自回归接缝预测大一个数量级的网格。

title: When Terminal-Agent Training Stalls: Demystifying Data Generation and Verification Challenge
summary: Using a frontier model like Claude Opus as a meta-agent to generate terminal tasks and verifiers for RL training is increasingly common. Yet a runnable Docker image and executable test suite do not guarantee a faithful end-to-end pipeline for terminal agent training. We present a meta-agent pipeline motivated by this gap, diagnosing three classes of failure: benchmark invalidity, harness brittleness, and reward misalignment. Prompt redesign and context extension raise baseline solvability 5.6 times, but a 9B model saturates at 81.3% mean pass@2 within 20 steps on Claude Opus-generated tasks. Adding hard tasks reduces mean pass@2 to 20.6% without changing the training configuration, a strong evidence that the solvability band is model-specific. These findings demonstrate that meta-agent reliability requires solvability-band calibration, verifier audits, and infrastructure error accounting as first-class evaluation criteria, not post-hoc diagnost.

AI.tldr: 元智能体生成的终端任务即使可运行，也未必构成忠实的训练流水线；需将可解性带校准、验证器审计与基础设施错误核算列为一等评估标准。
AI.motivation: 以Claude Opus等前沿模型作为元智能体生成终端任务与验证器用于RL训练日益普遍，但可运行的Docker镜像与可执行测试套件并不能保证端到端的忠实性，存在评估盲区。
AI.method: 提出元智能体流水线，诊断三类失败：基准无效性、框架脆弱性、奖励错位；通过提示重设计与上下文扩展提升基线可解性，并在同一训练配置下引入困难任务进行对照。
AI.result: 提示重设计与上下文扩展使基线可解性提升5.6倍；9B模型在Opus生成任务上20步内平均pass@2饱和于81.3%；引入困难任务后平均pass@2降至20.6%。
AI.conclusion: 可解性带具有模型特异性，元智能体可靠性要求将可解性带校准、验证器审计与基础设施错误核算作为一等评估标准，而非事后诊断手段。

title: From Mathematical to Executable Certificates for Machine Unlearning
summary: Machine unlearning is needed when data must be removed because of deletion requests, outdated records, or data-quality concerns, while retraining from scratch can be costly. Certified machine unlearning methods provide mathematical guarantees, while deployed systems release concrete finite-precision artifacts produced by software. To bridge the gap between mathematical guarantees and practical deployment, we introduce Executable Release Certification (ExecCert), a release-time layer that certifies the candidate artifact considered for release. ExecCert either closes a method's native certificate for the executed candidate or applies Retraining-Reference Release Verification (RRV) to certify fidelity to current retain-set retraining. Sequential deletion makes the latter nontrivial because the exact retain-set reference and the stored numerical state evolve separately. For frozen representations with a mutable ridge head, we develop an incremental realization of RRV that maintains certified evidence across deletion requests rather than reconstructing it at each release. On four published unlearning implementations, ExecCert preserves valid certificates, changes release decisions, tightens conservative bounds, and identifies the retraining-reference fidelity supported by concrete outputs. In sequential-service experiments, RRV eliminates false releases caused by stored-equation verification while closely tracking realized error, and incremental certification remains cheaper than both fresh and maintained verified-factor alternatives once release checks become sufficiently frequent.

AI.tldr: 提出ExecCert发布时认证层，弥合机器遗忘数学保证与实际部署产物间的差距，通过RRV认证候选产物的重训练保真度，并在冻结尾+可变岭回归头场景下实现增量认证。
AI.motivation: 机器遗忘中从零重训练代价高昂，已认证方法虽提供数学保证，但实际部署发布的是有限精度软件产物，数学保证与部署产物之间存在鸿沟；尤其顺序删除时，精确保留集参考与存储数值状态分别演化，使重训练参考验证变得困难。
AI.method: 提出ExecCert发布时认证层，对候选产物闭合方法原生证书或应用重训练参考发布验证（RRV）认证其对当前保留集重训练的保真度；针对冻结表示+可变岭回归头，开发RRV的增量实现，跨删除请求维护认证证据而非每次发布重构。
AI.result: 在四个已发表的遗忘实现上，ExecCert保持有效证书、改变发布决策、收紧保守界，并识别出由具体输出支持的重训练参考保真度；顺序服务实验中，RRV消除由存储方程验证导致的错误发布，同时紧密跟踪实际误差；发布检查足够频繁后，增量认证比全新构建和维护验证因子两种替代方案都更便宜。
AI.conclusion: ExecCert以发布时认证层连接数学保证与部署产物，RRV能够基于具体有限精度输出认证重训练保真度，增量实现可提升顺序删除服务场景下的效率。

title: Who Went Where When on the Lunar Surface: Forensic Trajectory Analysis to Identify Byzantine Rovers
summary: Future planetary surface missions are likely to involve multiple independently operated rovers sharing the same deployment region, raising the need to verify compliance with operational constraints such as Lunar Safety Zones. Because continuous in-situ observability is rarely available, such verification requires post-hoc reconstruction of rover trajectories from sparse telemetry, including odometry, pose priors, and relative inter-rover detections. We introduce the problem of forensic trajectory analysis for non-cooperative planetary rovers in the presence of Byzantine agents: rovers that provide miscalibrated or deliberately falsified measurements to support an incorrect trajectory. We show that standard outlier-robust pose graph optimisation methods are vulnerable in this setting, because Byzantine rovers can generate measurements that are internally consistent and numerous enough to make truthful incriminating measurements appear as outliers. To address this, we propose an attribution-aware trajectory estimation method that reasons over rover credibility rather than individual measurement validity. The method evaluates candidate credible rover subsets by comparing the statistical consistency of their internal and boundary relative detections against provided priors, and then estimates trajectories using only measurements attributed to credible agents. Across synthetic simulations and real planetary-analogue trajectory data, the proposed method identifies Byzantine rovers and produces significantly more accurate trajectory estimates than existing robust pose graph optimisation baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"非合作行星巡视器取证轨迹分析"问题：在多巡视器共享部署区且无持续观测条件下，需从稀疏遥测中事后重建轨迹以核查安全区合规性；针对拜占庭巡视器伪造/失校测量问题，提出基于"巡视器可信度"而非"单测量有效性"的归因感知轨迹估计方法，在合成与真实行星类比数据上均优于鲁棒位姿图优化基线。
AI.motivation: 未来行星表面任务可能由多个独立运行的巡视器共享同一部署区域，需要核查其是否遵守月面安全区等运行约束；但持续在轨观测通常不可得，只能依靠里程计、位姿先验和巡视器间相对观测等稀疏遥测进行事后轨迹重建。更棘手的是存在拜占庭巡视器——提供失校或蓄意伪造的测量以支持错误轨迹，而标准外点鲁棒位姿图优化在此场景下失效，因为拜占庭测量可内部自洽且数量占优，使真实的"不利"测量反被当作外点。
AI.method: 提出归因感知（attribution-aware）轨迹估计方法：不判断单个测量是否有效，而是推理各巡视器的可信度。具体地，通过比较候选可信巡视器子集内部及边界相对观测与给定先验之间的统计一致性，评估各候选子集，再用仅归属于可信智能体的测量进行轨迹估计。
AI.result: 在合成仿真与真实行星类比轨迹数据上，所提方法能够识别拜占庭巡视器，并且轨迹估计精度显著优于现有鲁棒位姿图优化基线。
AI.conclusion: 将取证轨迹分析建模为智能体级别的可信度归因问题，可有效应对内部自洽的拜占庭测量攻击，为多巡视器行星任务的安全区合规核查提供更可靠的轨迹重建手段。

title: From Fragments to Global Maps: Learning Vectorized Map Aggregation with Large Language Models
summary: Large-scale vectorized HD maps provide structured road information that is essential for perception, localization, and planning in autonomous driving. Constructing such maps requires aggregating noisy, fragmented, and overlapping local predictions collected along a vehicle trajectory into a coherent global map. Existing aggregation methods typically rely on hand-crafted rules for fragment association and refinement. However, a fixed set of thresholds cannot effectively handle variations in road structures and prediction errors, often requiring detector-specific tuning or manual adjustment. To address this limitation, we propose MapMergeLLM, a data-driven framework that formulates vectorized map aggregation as conditional sequence generation with a large language model. Given serialized local vectorized maps, our model directly predicts the aggregated global map polylines. To reduce dependence on any particular upstream detector, we train the model on synthetic local maps generated from clean vector maps using corruptions that simulate representative prediction errors. We further introduce a coordinate tokenizer with geometry-aware pretraining to precisely represent map coordinates. In addition, we propose a line-level association loss that explicitly supervises correspondences between local observations of the same map element. Experiments on Argoverse2 and nuScenes using multiple recent upstream detectors demonstrate that MapMergeLLM substantially outperforms heuristic and optimization-based aggregation baselines without detector-specific retraining.

AI.tldr: 提出MapMergeLLM，将矢量高精地图聚合建模为基于大语言模型的条件序列生成任务，通过学习数据驱动方式替代手工规则，在多数据集和多检测器上取得更优聚合效果。
AI.motivation: 矢量高精地图对自动驾驶的感知、定位与规划至关重要，其构建需将车辆轨迹沿途收集的含噪、碎片化、重叠的局部预测聚合为一致的全局地图。现有聚合方法多依赖手工规则进行片段关联与精炼，固定阈值难以应对道路结构变化和预测误差的多样性，且往往需要针对特定检测器调参或人工调整。
AI.method: 将矢量地图聚合形式化为条件序列生成问题，利用大语言模型直接由序列化的局部矢量地图预测全局地图折线。为减少对上游检测器的依赖，使用由干净矢量地图经模拟代表性预测误差的腐蚀生成的合成局部地图进行训练；引入几何感知预训练的坐标分词器以精确表示地图坐标；并提出线级关联损失，显式监督同一地图元素在不同局部观测间的对应关系。
AI.result: 在Argoverse2与nuScenes数据集上，使用多个近期上游检测器进行实验，MapMergeLLM显著优于启发式和基于优化的聚合基线，且无需针对检测器进行重新训练。
AI.conclusion: MapMergeLLM验证了以大语言模型进行条件序列生成作为矢量高精地图聚合范式的有效性，具备跨检测器的泛化能力，可作为免检测器特定调参的通用聚合框架。

title: Reinforcement Learning Techniques for the Optimization of Target Polarization in Nuclear Physics Scattering Experiments
summary: The operation of dynamically polarized targets in nuclear physics experiments relies on continuous tuning of the microwave frequency to compensate for radiation damage and evolving material properties, a task that is traditionally performed through manual trial-and-error by expert operators. This work presents a data-driven control framework that combines surrogate modeling with reinforcement learning to optimize the target polarization. Using operational data from the APOLLO cryogenic target system, we train and evaluate multilayer perceptron and Gaussian process regression models to predict polarization as a function of microwave frequency, beam current, and accumulated radiation dose. We show that Gaussian process-based models provide calibrated uncertainty estimates and reliably identify regions outside the training distribution, while MLPs exhibit limited sensitivity to distributional shift. To enable learning and control across multiple target samples, we introduce a Gaussian process approximation and embed the surrogate model within a standardized simulation environment. A reinforcement learning agent is trained using a lower-confidence-bound reward formulation that balances performance maximization against uncertainty. We are able to show an almost 2x improvement on the operators actions utilizing our RL agent.

AI.tldr: 提出代理模型+强化学习的数据驱动控制框架用于动态极化靶的微波频率调优，基于APOLLO靶系统数据实现约2倍于人工操作的性能提升。
AI.motivation: 动态极化靶运行中需持续调节微波频率以补偿辐射损伤与材料性质演变，传统上依赖专家人工试错，效率低且难以扩展到多样本场景，因此需要数据驱动的自动化优化方法。
AI.method: 利用APOLLO低温靶系统运行数据，训练并评估多层感知机（MLP）与高斯过程回归（GPR）模型，以微波频率、束流和累积辐射剂量为输入预测极化度；引入高斯过程近似以支持跨靶样本学习，并将代理模型嵌入标准化仿真环境，采用下置信界（LCB）奖励形式的强化学习智能体进行训练，以平衡性能最大化与不确定性。
AI.result: 高斯过程模型提供经校准的不确定性估计并能可靠识别训练分布外区域，而MLP对分布偏移敏感性有限；所训练的RL智能体相较人工操作策略实现约2倍的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 代理建模与强化学习相结合可为极化靶频率调优提供自动化、可泛化的控制方案，高斯过程在不确定性量化和分布外检测上具有优势，整体性能显著优于人工试错操作。

title: CLEAN: Psychometrically Consistent Incremental Cognitive Diagnosis under Concept-Space Expansion via Architectural Isolation
summary: Cognitive diagnosis (CD) is a fundamental task in intelligent education that profiles learner proficiency over knowledge concepts. In real-world learning platforms, newly added items continually introduce previously unseen concepts, necessitating dynamic expansion of the underlying concept space. Yet existing incremental CD models assume a fixed concept space, allowing gradients from new items to overwrite historical pathways and induce catastrophic forgetting. More critically, these methods rely solely on soft constraints to preserve historical diagnoses. Such constraints may fail to satisfy the requirement of diagnostic invariance after incremental updates, a requirement known as psychometric consistency in cognitive diagnosis. Therefore, we propose CLEAN (Continual Learning with Expandable and Architecturally Isolated Networks), a novel incremental CD framework supporting concept-space expansion while providing structural guarantees for pointwise invariance of historical diagnoses. Specifically, CLEAN first introduces a strict topological bipartition protocol, freezes historical diagnostic functions and applies deterministic orthogonal column masking to sever gradient interference. Second, to accommodate concept expansion, expandable full-rank branches with micro-variance initialization are deployed to learn novel concepts. Finally, to verify that this architectural design achieves invariance by construction, we formalize Representation Drift (RD) to quantify the perturbation of historical traits. Extensive experiments on three large-scale educational datasets demonstrate that CLEAN achieves zero RD, preserving old-item metrics identically to static anchors through architectural isolation while remaining competitive with or superior to strong continual-learning baselines on new items.

AI.tldr: CLEAN：支持概念空间扩展的增量认知诊断框架，通过拓扑二分与正交列掩码实现结构隔离，保证历史诊断的不变性（零表征漂移）。
AI.motivation: 现有增量认知诊断模型假设概念空间固定，新题引入新概念时梯度会覆盖历史通路，导致灾难性遗忘；且仅靠软约束难以满足心理测量一致性所要求的诊断不变性。
AI.method: CLEAN 包含三部分：（1）严格拓扑二分协议，冻结历史诊断函数并用确定性正交列掩码切断梯度干扰；（2）可扩展满秩分支配合微小方差初始化，学习新概念；（3）形式化表征漂移（RD）以量化历史特质的扰动，验证该架构天然满足不变性。
AI.result: 在三个大规模教育数据集上，CLEAN 实现零表征漂移，旧题指标与静态锚模型完全一致，同时在新题上达到或优于强持续学习基线。
AI.conclusion: 通过架构隔离而非软约束，CLEAN 将诊断不变性由“约束求解”转变为“结构保证”，兼顾概念空间扩展与历史诊断的心理测量一致性。

title: GeoScaffold: Learning Compact Geometric Latents via Reconstruction for Efficient Vision-Language Navigation
summary: Recent vision-and-language navigation (VLN) systems increasingly adopt streaming Video-LLM policies that map egocentric RGB observations and instructions directly to low-level actions. Yet these policies inherit weak 3D geometric priors from 2D pretraining. Existing geometry-aware extensions charge a persistent inference-time price: depth sensors, 3D encoders, or per-step perception tool calls. We propose GeoScaffold, a geometric supervision framework that pays this price once, at training time, by internalizing geometry into the policy itself. It first learns a compact depth tokenizer on depth maps from the training trajectories and freezes it. It then fine-tunes the policy with a handful of learnable geometry query tokens, training their hidden states to reconstruct navigation-critical geometry such as depth, connectivity, and traversability. This supervision turns the query states into compact geometric latents for action decoding, and through the shared weights also internalizes geometry into the backbone's own representations. Like a scaffold, the tokenizer, target generators, and reconstruction heads are discarded after training, leaving the backbone and action interface unchanged. Extensive experiments show that GeoScaffold consistently outperforms leading vision-only navigators on continuous VLN benchmarks, offering a practical paradigm for lightweight edge deployment of spatially aware embodied navigation models.

AI.tldr: GeoScaffold 提出一种训练期几何监督框架，将深度、连通性、可通行性等几何信息内化进流式 Video-LLM 导航策略，训练后丢弃脚手架模块，推理时保持纯视觉、零额外开销，在连续 VLN 基准上超越领先纯视觉导航器。
AI.motivation: 现有流式 Video-LLM 导航策略直接从自我中心 RGB 观测与指令映射到低级动作，继承自 2D 预训练的 3D 几何先验薄弱；已有几何增强方案需在推理期持续付出代价（深度传感器、3D 编码器或逐步感知工具调用），不利于轻量边缘部署。
AI.method: 先基于训练轨迹的深度图学习一个紧凑的深度分词器（tokenizer）并冻结；随后用少量可学习的几何查询 token 微调策略，训练其隐状态重建导航关键几何（深度、连通性、可通行性）；该监督使查询状态成为用于动作解码的紧凑几何隐变量，并通过共享权重将几何内化到骨干表示中。训练后分词器、目标生成器与重建头全部丢弃，骨干与动作接口保持不变。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，GeoScaffold 在连续 VLN 基准上持续优于领先的纯视觉导航器，为空间感知具身导航模型的轻量边缘部署提供了实用范式。
AI.conclusion: 几何监督可在训练期一次性"付费"，把几何内化进策略本身，从而在推理期不增加任何传感器或计算开销，兼顾空间感知能力与部署轻量性。

title: Spatial Memory Intelligence: Endowing World Models with Understanding-Driven Long-Term Memory
summary: Long-video generation and world models have shown strong potential for interactive entertainment and embodied simulation by predicting future observations conditioned on user actions and historical memory. However, as memory sequences grow longer and their structures become increasingly complex, managing long-range spatial context becomes increasingly challenging, calling for a more intelligent and systematic memory-management strategy. Building on the advancing spatial reasoning capabilities of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) and the broader vision of unified models, we propose Spatial Memory Intelligence (SMI), the first framework to systematically employ an understanding model for spatial-memory management in long-video world models. SMI introduces four coordinated atomic operations: spatial clustering, within-cluster sparsification, action-aware retrieval, and reliability-aware filtering. Extensive experiments across multiple baselines, benchmarks, and world-model backbones demonstrate the effectiveness and generalizability of SMI, achieving comprehensive improvements in memory sparsity, generation stability, and spatial consistency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Spatial Memory Intelligence (SMI) 框架，首次系统性地利用多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的理解能力，对长视频世界模型中的空间记忆进行智能管理，以提升长程空间上下文的一致性与生成稳定性。
AI.motivation: 长视频生成与世界模型需依据用户动作和历史记忆预测未来观测，但随记忆序列增长、结构愈加复杂，长程空间上下文的管理变得愈发困难，亟需更智能、更系统的记忆管理策略。同时，MLLM 空间推理能力的进步与统一模型的愿景为此提供了契机。
AI.method: 基于 MLLM 的空间推理能力，提出 SMI 框架，系统性地将理解模型用于长视频世界模型的空间记忆管理，并设计了四种协同的原子操作：空间聚类（spatial clustering）、簇内稀疏化（within-cluster sparsification）、动作感知检索（action-aware retrieval）与可靠性感知过滤（reliability-aware filtering）。
AI.result: 在多种基线、基准与世界模型主干网络上进行的大量实验验证了 SMI 的有效性与泛化性，在记忆稀疏度、生成稳定性和空间一致性方面均取得全面提升。
AI.conclusion: SMI 表明利用理解模型进行空间记忆管理是一种可行且有效的范式，能够系统性改善长视频世界模型的记忆效率与长程空间一致性，并具备良好的跨模型泛化能力。

title: Tropical Reinforcement Learning
summary: Reinforcement learning for large language models typically maximizes expected return, adding up the probabilities of all successful trajectories. However, the classical sum formulation can only report how often the model policy succeeds, not which solution actually worked, and because probabilities sum to one, reinforcing one solution can make the model forget another that was never shown to be wrong. This makes expected return a poor fit for compositional reasoning, where a solution must be assembled from reasoning steps that the model produces in separate, often failed, attempts but rarely produces together. To address this, we propose Tropical Reinforcement Learning, which rests on a simple change of algebra: instead of adding the probabilities of alternative solutions, we take their maximum, which yields the tropical semiring. The value of a state then becomes the log-probability of its most likely verified solution, together with an explicit path that can be replayed and reused. This enables true composition, since the best prefix and the best suffix meeting at a shared state can be joined even when they come from different rollouts. To put this into practice, we introduce TROPIC, a training algorithm for deterministic, resettable environments with verifiable outcomes. On four agentic tasks (Sokoban, Countdown, FrozenLake, WebShop), TROPIC outperforms the strongest on-policy baselines by up to 16 percentage points. Changing the algebra of reinforcement learning, not just its estimators, can thus substantially improve compositional reasoning in language models

AI.tldr: 本文提出热带强化学习（Tropical RL），将强化学习中的期望回报求和运算替换为热带半环下的取最大运算，从而得到"最可能被验证的解"的对数概率及可复用路径，并据此提出训练算法 TROPIC，在四个智能体任务上比最强同策略基线高出最多16个百分点。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型的强化学习通常最大化期望回报，即累加所有成功轨迹的概率。但求和式表述只能报告策略成功的频率，无法指出究竟哪个解法有效；且由于概率归一化，强化一个解会使模型遗忘另一个未被证明错误的解。因此期望回报不适合组合式推理——这类任务要求把模型在不同（且多为失败）尝试中分别产生、却极少同时出现的推理步骤组合起来。
AI.method: 提出热带强化学习：改变代数结构，不再对备选解的概率求和，而是取最大值，由此得到热带半环。此时状态价值定义为"其最可能被验证解"的对数概率，并附带一条可重放、可复用的显式路径。这带来真正的组合能力：在共享状态处相遇的最优前缀与最优后缀可以直接拼接，即使它们来自不同的 rollout。为此提出 TROPIC 训练算法，面向结果可验证的确定性、可重置环境。
AI.result: 在四个智能体任务（Sokoban、Countdown、FrozenLake、WebShop）上，TROPIC 相比最强的同策略（on-policy）基线提升最多达16个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 改变强化学习的代数结构（而不仅是其估计器），可以显著提升语言模型的组合式推理能力。

title: MuLoRA: Spectrally Balanced Low-Rank Adaptation for Continual Learning
summary: Low-rank adaptation (LoRA) provides a parameter-efficient approach to continual learning, but its nominal rank can conceal a loss of effective adaptation capacity. We identify \emph{spectral plasticity collapse}: during sequential adaptation, update energy becomes concentrated in a small subset of singular modes, leaving much of the available low-rank space underutilized. This exposes a limitation of interference avoidance alone: protecting historical representations does not ensure that the remaining adaptation capacity is responsive to new tasks or effectively utilized. To address this problem, we propose \texttt{MuLoRA}, which jointly controls capacity allocation and utilization. First, historical whitening identifies input directions with strong current-task response relative to accumulated historical response, yielding a task-adaptive basis that remains fixed during training. Second, approximate polar orthogonalization of momentum updates reduces spectral concentration within theselected space. An orthonormal basis connects these mechanisms by transferring the factor-update spectrum exactly tothe induced weight update. We establish a max--min characterization of exact subspace selection and derive cumulative spectral bounds under controlled cross-step anisotropy. Across five class-incremental benchmarks and eight incremental settings, \texttt{MuLoRA} achieves the highest mean accuracy in 15 of 16 reported metrics.

AI.tldr: LoRA在持续学习中存在"谱可塑性崩塌"问题，即更新能量集中于少数奇异模式，导致低秩空间利用不足。作者提出MuLoRA，通过历史白化选择任务自适应基、对动量更新做近似极坐标正交化，并建立子空间选择与累积谱界理论，在5个类增量基准、8种设置下16项指标中15项取得最高平均精度。
AI.motivation: LoRA虽提供参数高效的持续学习方案，但其标称秩会掩盖有效适应能力的损失。作者发现"谱可塑性崩塌"现象：序贯适应过程中更新能量集中于少数奇异模式，大量低秩空间未被利用。这揭示了仅靠"避免干扰"的局限——保护历史表征并不能保证剩余适应能力对新任务具有响应性且被有效利用。
AI.method: MuLoRA联合控制容量分配与利用：其一，历史白化识别相对累积历史响应具有强当前任务响应的输入方向，得到训练期间固定的任务自适应基；其二，对动量更新做近似极坐标正交化，降低所选空间内的谱集中。正交基将因子更新的谱精确传递到诱导的权重更新，从而连接两个机制。理论方面，给出精确子空间选择的max–min刻画，并在受控跨步各向异性下推导累积谱界。
AI.result: 在五个类增量基准、八种增量设置下，MuLoRA在16项报告指标中有15项取得最高平均精度。
AI.conclusion: MuLoRA表明，持续学习中LoRA的有效适应能力需从"容量分配"与"容量利用"两方面联合治理；通过历史白化与动量更新正交化，可缓解谱可塑性崩塌，并具备可分析的理论保证，实验上在多基准多设置中表现领先。

title: AdaTempo: Learning Shared Relative Tempo from Demonstrations for Faster Robot Manipulation
summary: Visuomotor policies trained via imitation learning often inherit the unnecessarily slow timing of teleoperated demonstrations. Yet uniform speedup is unreliable because different phases of a manipulation task tolerate acceleration differently. In this work, we introduce AdaTempo, a self-supervised method that accelerates visuomotor policies by exploiting shared relative-tempo structure in demonstrations. AdaTempo establishes phase correspondence, aggregates the aligned relative tempo into a consensus, and maps it to a continuous speedup profile used to resample demonstrations into accelerated training trajectories. Training standard policies such as ACT or Diffusion Policy on these resampled trajectories directly embeds the desired tempo in the learned behavior, without runtime tempo selection or online retiming. Extensive evaluations show that AdaTempo achieves up to a $3.57\times$ speedup and yields a stronger success--speed trade-off than the original policies and representative acceleration baselines.

AI.tldr: AdaTempo：一种自监督方法，通过挖掘演示中的共享相对节奏结构，将示范重采样为加速轨迹，使策略无需运行时调速即可实现最高3.57倍加速。
AI.motivation: 模仿学习训练的视觉运动策略常继承遥操作演示中不必要的慢速时序；而统一加速并不可靠，因为操作任务的不同阶段对加速的容忍度不同。
AI.method: 建立阶段对应关系，将对齐后的相对节奏聚合成共识，并映射为连续加速曲线，据此把演示重采样为加速训练轨迹；在重采样轨迹上训练ACT、Diffusion Policy等标准策略。
AI.result: 大量评估显示，AdaTempo实现最高3.57倍加速，并在成功率-速度权衡上优于原始策略和代表性加速基线。
AI.conclusion: 通过将所需节奏直接嵌入学习到的行为中，AdaTempo免去了运行时节奏选择与在线重定时，为视觉运动策略加速提供了有效方案。

title: Oracle headroom without signal: null-calibrated evaluation of candidate selection for thermal heart rate estimation
summary: Camera-based physiological monitoring can produce multiple estimates from several facial regions, extraction methods, and processing settings. Signal quality indices aim to select reliable estimates without a physiological reference, and their potential is often assessed with an oracle that selects the estimate closest to the reference in each window. This retrospective selection can reward chance agreement. We model the effect with order statistics. For K independent candidates unrelated to the reference, the expected oracle error decreases approximately as 1/K. We analyze thermal heart rate estimation on 96 iBVP recordings with 168 candidates per 10 s window. The oracle achieves a mean absolute error of 0.91 bpm, compared with 10.74 bpm for the best fixed configuration, 18.03 bpm for the best quality index, and 8.61 bpm for a constant predictor. With K = 24, a forehead signal from another recording matches the correct one, with 4.62 against 4.61 bpm. Oracle evaluations should report candidate count, valid coverage, and matched null controls.

AI.tldr: 基于摄像头的生理监测可从多个面部区域、多种提取方法和参数设置中产生大量估计值。信号质量指标用于在没有生理参考的情况下选择可靠估计，其潜力通常用"预测窗口内最接近参考值的估计"这一oracle来评估。本文用顺序统计量建模并证明这种回顾性选择会奖励偶然一致性，随后以热成像心率估计为例进行实证。
AI.motivation: 信号质量指标常在无生理参考条件下选择可靠估计，学界多以oracle（每窗口选取最接近参考的候选）评估其潜力。但这种回顾性选择可能把偶然与参考接近的候选也算作成功，从而高估信号质量指标（及多候选策略）的真实价值，因此需要量化该偏差并给出更严格的评估规范。
AI.method: 用顺序统计量建模oracle效应：当K个候选与参考无关时，期望oracle误差近似按1/K下降。在96段iBVP记录上做热成像心率估计，每10秒窗口含168个候选，比较oracle、最佳固定配置、最佳质量指标与常数预测器的MAE，并构造K=24的匹配零对照（用另一段记录的前额信号替代正确信号）。
AI.result: oracle平均绝对误差0.91 bpm；最佳固定配置10.74 bpm；最佳质量指标18.03 bpm；常数预测器8.61 bpm。K=24的零对照中，来自另一段记录的前额信号为4.62 bpm，与正确信号的4.61 bpm几乎相同，说明oracle优势主要源自候选数量而非信号质量。
AI.conclusion: oracle评估会因候选数量增加而系统性偏低，并可被与参考无关的匹配零对照复现。因此oracle评估应同时报告候选数量、有效覆盖率以及匹配零对照，以避免把偶然一致性误判为方法有效性。

title: MEA: A Reward-Driven Multi-Agent System for Faithful Model Explanations
summary: Recent years have seen the employment of a plethora of machine learning (ML) models in high-stakes domains, but they remain largely opaque to the practitioners who act on their predictions. While post-hoc explanation methods offer a lens into this model behavior, wielding them effectively demands expertise most domain experts lack: navigating high-dimensional outputs, selecting the best explanations, and synthesizing evidence across disparate tools. To this end, we present MEA, a multi-agent framework that removes the explanation knowledge barrier entirely: a Proposer agent selects and configures explanation tools based on the question and modality, while an Actor agent is optimized end-to-end against faithfulness, transforming the outputs into natural language explanations grounded in model behavior across tabular, text, and vision modalities. Further, we introduce diverse question types spanning feature attribution, counterfactual reasoning, and spurious feature detection, each paired with a perturbation-based faithfulness metric. We find that frontier LLMs systematically produce unfaithful explanations. By optimizing against faithfulness rewards augmented with a modality-adaptive penalty, MEA consistently outperforms post hoc explainers, agentic, and closed-source baselines across six datasets, with reward-driven optimization yielding faithfulness gains of +28% (tabular), +21% (text), and +34% (vision) over the untrained backbone. More broadly, our findings suggest that AI agents themselves can serve as a scalable, adaptable interface to ML explainability, opening a path toward natural-language explainability that generalizes beyond the fixed, single-purpose tools that have long defined the field.

AI.tldr: MEA：多智能体框架，用Proposer选配解释工具、Actor端到端优化忠实性，将解释转为自然语言，在表格/文本/视觉上超越后验解释器与智能体基线。
AI.motivation: 高风险的机器学习模型对从业者仍不透明，后验解释方法虽能揭示模型行为，但使用门槛高：需处理高维输出、挑选最佳解释、跨工具整合证据，多数领域专家缺乏相应专业知识。
AI.method: 提出MEA多智能体框架：Proposer智能体根据问题与模态选择并配置解释工具；Actor智能体以忠实性为目标进行端到端优化，把输出转化为基于模型行为的自然语言解释，覆盖表格、文本、视觉三种模态。并构建了涵盖特征归因、反事实推理、伪特征检测的多种问题类型，每种配有基于扰动的忠实性指标；训练时以忠实性奖励叠加模态自适应惩罚。
AI.result: 前沿大模型会系统性产生不忠实解释；经奖励驱动优化后，MEA在六个数据集上稳定优于后验解释器、智能体及闭源基线，忠实性相对未训练主干提升：表格+28%、文本+21%、视觉+34%。
AI.conclusion: AI智能体本身可作为可扩展、可适配的ML可解释性接口，推动超越固定单一用途工具的自然语言可解释性范式。

title: Effects of interpulse-interval variation on deep-learning classification of bat vocalizations
summary: Temporal context may aid automated bat-species classification, but the contribution of specific features remains unclear. We investigated whether variation in the interpulse interval (IPI)-the time between consecutive call onsets-provides species-discriminative information and whether transformer-based models are more sensitive to this information than convolutional neural networks. We created two matched datasets from European bat recordings: a natural-IPI condition retaining the original call timing and a normalized-IPI condition in which call onsets were spaced at 50-ms intervals. EfficientNet-B0 and PaSST were fine-tuned and evaluated within each condition. In an additional experiment, each architecture was trained separately on natural-IPI and normalized-IPI recordings, and evaluated on the same natural-IPI test set. Finally, the pretrained classifiers BatDetect2 and BAT were evaluated on both conditions. Within-condition IPI normalization had model-dependent effects. PaSST accuracy differed little between the natural-IPI ($71 \pm 2.3\%$) and normalized-IPI ($70 \pm 6.3\%$) conditions, whereas EfficientNet accuracy increased from $47 \pm 4.7\%$ to $57 \pm 3.9\%$. PaSST exceeded EfficientNet under both conditions. In the cross-condition evaluation, models trained on natural-IPI recordings outperformed those trained on normalized-IPI recordings on the natural-IPI test set: accuracy decreased from 54% to 50% for EfficientNet and from 65% to 57% for PaSST. BatDetect2 and BAT differed little between IPI conditions. Overall, we found limited support for the hypotheses that natural IPI variation contributes substantially to bat-species classification and that it is used more effectively by transformer-based than CNN-based models. Nevertheless, the cross-condition performance decrease shows that results obtained under normalized conditions may not transfer fully to natural recordings.

AI.tldr: 研究蝙蝠脉冲间期（IPI）对物种分类的贡献，发现自然IPI变异判别信息有限，Transformer相对CNN的优势证据不足。
AI.motivation: 时间上下文可能有助于蝙蝠物种自动分类，但具体特征（如脉冲间期IPI）的贡献尚不明确，且不同架构（Transformer vs CNN）对该信息的敏感度存在疑问。
AI.method: 基于欧洲蝙蝠录音构建两个匹配数据集：自然IPI条件（保留原始呼叫时序）与归一化IPI条件（呼叫起始间隔固定为50 ms）。微调并评估EfficientNet-B0与PaSST；另进行交叉条件实验（分别在自然/归一化IPI上训练，统一在自然IPI测试集评估）；同时评估预训练分类器BatDetect2与BAT。
AI.result: 条件内IPI归一化效应依模型而定：PaSST在自然IPI（71±2.3%）与归一化IPI（70±6.3%）间差异很小，EfficientNet则从47±4.7%升至57±3.9%；两条件下PaSST均优于EfficientNet。交叉条件评估中，自然IPI训练的模型在自然IPI测试集上表现更好（EfficientNet 54%→50%，PaSST 65%→57%）。BatDetect2与BAT在两条件下差异不大。
AI.conclusion: 对"自然IPI变异对蝙蝠物种分类贡献显著"及"Transformer比CNN更有效利用该信息"两假设的支持有限；但交叉条件性能下降表明归一化条件下的结果未必能完全迁移到自然录音。

title: RoboChemGym: A Protocol-Driven Generative Simulation Framework for Long-Horizon Chemical Manipulation
summary: Wet-lab experimentation serves as the gold standard for hypothesis verification in scientific discovery; yet it is inherently labor-intensive, costly, and safety-critical. Embodied agents hold the promise of automating these tedious workflows, but their development is hindered by the scarcity of real-world training data. While simulation offers a scalable alternative for producing demonstrations, current methods primarily target relatively short-horizon tasks with loosely structured interactions, failing to meet the strict procedural constraints and fine-grained manipulation demands of chemical experiments. To bridge this gap, we introduce \textbf{RoboChemGym}, a framework that autonomously generates high-fidelity manipulation demonstrations aligned with real-world experiment protocols, featuring a \textit{self-improving task synthesis} mechanism to iteratively refine task execution and scene configurations, enabling the reliable generation of expert trajectories for complex, multi-object protocols exceeding 10 interaction steps. Furthermore, we introduce a hierarchical benchmark that systematically assesses performance across varying granularities, spanning from atomic operations to full-cycle experimental workflows. RoboChemGym sets a scalable paradigm for the automated data synthesis and capability evaluation of embodied agents in intricate chemical tasks, serving as a critical stepping stone toward fully intelligent laboratories.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 RoboChemGym 框架，通过自改进任务合成机制自主生成符合真实实验规程的高保真操作演示，并构建分层基准，用于化学实验中具身智能体的数据合成与能力评估。
AI.motivation: 湿实验是科学假设验证的金标准，但劳动密集、成本高且具安全性风险。具身智能体有望自动化此类流程，但受限于真实世界训练数据稀缺。现有仿真方法多针对短时程、结构松散的任务，无法满足化学实验严格的程序约束与精细操作需求。
AI.method: 提出 RoboChemGym 框架：自主生成与真实实验规程一致的高保真操作演示；引入自改进任务合成机制，迭代优化任务执行与场景配置；并设计分层基准，从原子操作到全周期实验流程系统评估不同粒度下的性能。
AI.result: 可可靠生成超过10个交互步骤的复杂多物体实验协议的专家轨迹；分层基准支持从原子操作到全周期实验流程的细粒度性能评估。
AI.conclusion: RoboChemGym 为复杂化学任务中具身智能体的自动化数据合成与能力评估提供了可扩展范式，是迈向全智能实验室的重要基石。

title: DAGS: Disentangled Appearance-and-Geometry Steering of a Frozen Image DiT for Temporally Stabilized Generative Rendering
comment: 5 pages, 3 figures, 2 tables. Accepted to SIGGRAPH Asia 2026 Technical Communications
summary: Diffusion transformers (DiTs) generate high-fidelity images from text and image conditions, but their outputs carry large variance and their faithfulness to a desired target depends heavily on how the condition is supplied. We present DAGS, a lightweight, attention-free, disentangled appearance and geometry conditioning scheme that steers a frozen image DiT to produce high-fidelity, highly faithful, and independently controllable renders. Two small convolutional encoders compute conditioning features once per frame and inject them as a learned, per-layer, element-wise residual into the image tokens, avoiding the quadratic cost of stacking conditions through attention. Because control and temporal handling live outside the frozen backbone, we retain its vast pretrained prior and eliminate backbone-overfitting risk. We further add a small recurrent lighting stabilizer and a training-free temporal guidance term that, coupled with our conditioning, elevate a per-frame image model into a streaming renderer. DAGS produces controllable, high-quality renders at a fraction of the compute of path tracing; it is not real-time, trading compute for controllability and quality. On a matched 1-spp + G-buffer input, per-frame DAGS reconstructs +8.6 dB / +10.1 dB PSNR over the real-time denoiser Intel OIDN and the diffusion renderer RGB<->X while being 2.5-8x more temporally stable perceptually (temporal-LPIPS flicker).

AI.tldr: DAGS 是一种轻量、无注意力机制的解耦外观与几何条件注入方案，通过将小卷积编码器生成的特征以逐层逐元素残差注入冻结的图像 DiT，实现高保真、可控的流式渲染。
AI.motivation: 扩散 Transformer（DiT）能从文本和图像条件生成高保真图像，但其输出方差大，且对目标的忠实度高度依赖条件注入方式。作者希望在不破坏预训练先验的前提下，实现外观与几何的独立可控、高忠实度渲染。
AI.method: 提出 DAGS：两个小型卷积编码器每帧只计算一次条件特征，以学习到的逐层、逐元素残差注入图像 token，避免通过注意力堆叠条件带来的二次计算开销；控制与时间处理置于冻结骨干之外，规避骨干过拟合；并引入小型循环光照稳定器和免训练的时间引导项，将逐帧图像模型提升为流式渲染器。
AI.result: 在匹配的 1-spp + G-buffer 输入上，逐帧 DAGS 相比实时降噪器 Intel OIDN 和扩散渲染器 RGB<->X 分别提升 +8.6 dB / +10.1 dB PSNR，同时在感知时间稳定性（temporal-LPIPS 闪烁）上高出 2.5-8 倍。
AI.conclusion: DAGS 以远低于路径追踪的计算量产生可控、高质量渲染；它并非实时，而是以计算换取可控性与质量。

title: What Does a Token Cost? A Mixture-of-Agents Measurement of Sufficient Per-Token Compute
summary: Large language models spend the same amount of computation on every token they generate, regardless of how difficult each token is to produce. Methods such as speculative decoding and model routing are built on the premise that much of this computation is unnecessary, yet the computation an individual token actually requires has not been measured. We measure it through a Mixture-of-Agents (MoA) lens: a panel of fifteen language models of increasing capacity, drawn from three families, in which every agent attempts to reproduce a reference sequence token by token, conditioned on the correct preceding tokens. We define the inference cost of the smallest agent that succeeds as the token's sufficient compute, which upper-bounds what the token requires. On three core benchmarks, a 0.5B agent reproduces 92--95\% of reference tokens. Across Qwen, OLMo, and R1-distilled panels, the most expensive 10\% account for 64--80\% of estimated FLOPs. On all 500 MATH-500 problems, the MoA-derived map helps model routing reduce projected latency from 7.59 to 5.12 seconds while slightly improving accuracy, relative to the best confidence-routing baseline. The MoA-map helps drafting use 32.6\% fewer draft tokens and approximately 20\% lower projected latency than fixed-window drafting at similar accuracy. These comparisons reveal remaining allocation headroom, motivating controllers that exploit sufficient-compute structure.

AI.tldr: 本文通过Mixture-of-Agents框架首次测量单个token所需的"充分计算量"，发现计算需求高度不均匀，并据此提出可优化推理分配的控制方法。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型对每个生成的token投入相同计算量，忽视了不同token的难度差异。推测解码与模型路由等方法都基于"大部分计算是多余的"这一假设，但单个token实际所需计算量从未被测量。
AI.method: 采用Mixture-of-Agents（MoA）视角：选取来自三个系列的15个容量递增的语言模型组成模型组，每个智能体在给定正确前序token的条件下，逐token复现参考序列。将成功复现的最小智能体的推理成本定义为该token的"充分计算量"（sufficient compute），作为其实际需求的上界。
AI.result: 在三个核心基准上，0.5B模型可复现92%–95%的参考token。在Qwen、OLMo与R1蒸馏模型组中，最昂贵的10% token贡献了64%–80%的估计FLOPs。在全部500道MATH-500题目上，基于MoA的计算量地图使模型路由的预计延迟从7.59秒降至5.12秒，同时精度略有提升；用于起草时，相比固定窗口起草减少32.6%的草稿token，预计延迟降低约20%，精度相当。
AI.conclusion: 这些对比揭示了仍存在的计算分配空间，说明利用"充分计算量"结构设计控制器具有可行性。

title: Diffusion-Based Synthetic Data Pretraining for Enhancing Activity Recognition
summary: Human activity recognition (HAR) is increasingly important for healthcare, well-being, and daily monitoring ap- plications, for which detecting alimentary activities such as eating and drinking can provide actionable insight into dietary habits and chronic disease management. HAR systems, however, often underperform on subtle and underrepresented classes, limiting their utility in real-world dietary monitoring. This work builds upon CABiGRU, a convolutional architecture with Bidirectional GRU layers, multi-head attention, and residual connections, designed to capture discriminative temporal patterns from smart- watch accelerometer, gyroscope, and magnetometer data. To improve CaBiGRU's generalization and reduce underfitting in the minority class, we leverage synthetic sensor data windows using a diffusion model and adopt a two-stage training strategy: pre-training CABiGRU on synthetic data, followed by fine-tuning on the real-world data. On the DEO (drinking/eating/other) dataset, the proposed pipeline achieves a balanced accuracy of 90.6%, improving over a strong supervised baseline and showing the benefits of diffusion-based synthetic pre-training for recognizing alimentary activities and representing a step forward dealing with unbalanced classes. These results suggest that combining diffusion-generated data with targeted fine-tuning enhances robust recognition of dietary behaviors, supporting more reliable deployment in healthcare and nutrition-monitoring settings.

AI.tldr: 本文在CABiGRU模型（卷积+双向GRU+多头注意力+残差连接）基础上，利用扩散模型生成合成传感器数据窗口，并采用"合成数据预训练+真实数据微调"的两阶段训练策略，在DEO数据集上取得90.6%的平衡准确率，改善了饮食活动识别中少数类欠拟合与类别不平衡问题。
AI.motivation: 人体活动识别（HAR）在医疗健康、日常监测中日益重要，其中进食、饮水等饮食活动的检测可为饮食习惯分析与慢性病管理提供可操作依据。然而HAR系统在细微且样本不足的类别上表现不佳，限制了其在真实饮食监测场景中的实用性，尤其是少数类存在欠拟合与泛化能力弱的问题。
AI.method: 以CABiGRU为骨干模型，该架构结合卷积结构、双向GRU层、多头注意力与残差连接，用于从智能手表加速度计、陀螺仪和磁力计数据中提取判别性时序模式。为提升泛化能力并缓解少数类欠拟合，采用扩散模型生成合成传感器数据窗口，并设计两阶段训练策略：先在合成数据上预训练CABiGRU，再在真实数据上微调。
AI.result: 在DEO（饮水/进食/其他）数据集上，所提流程达到90.6%的平衡准确率，优于强监督基线，验证了基于扩散的合成预训练在饮食活动识别中的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 将扩散模型生成的合成数据与针对性微调相结合，能够增强饮食行为的鲁棒识别能力，是处理类别不平衡问题的一项进展，有助于HAR系统在医疗健康与营养监测场景中的更可靠部署。

title: RoboBridge: A Self-Evolving Embodied Agent Framework for Sim-to-Real Transfer
summary: A key challenge in bringing embodied intelligence into the real world is transferring capabilities from simulation to reality and enabling agents to continually adapt after deployment. End-to-end vision-language-action policies provide strong manipulation capabilities, but their transfer to physical environments typically relies on calibrating simulated visual and dynamical conditions, collecting additional target-domain demonstrations, and optimizing the policy through further training. Tool-using embodied agents offer flexible task orchestration, yet existing systems primarily emphasize task execution and experience reuse within a given environment, with limited support for transferring procedural knowledge and continuously adapting it across simulation and reality. We propose RoboBridge, a framework that treats sim-to-real transfer as the continued adaptation of executable task skills. The agent represents task knowledge as procedures connecting task intent, observations, tool operations, and outcome verification. Interaction feedback is used to generate candidate skill revisions, which are evaluated before being persisted or rejected. A pretrained vision-language-action policy is exposed as a reusable action tool and enhanced with inference-time guidance, enabling fine-grained execution without retraining the underlying policy. RoboBridge grounds transferable skills in task semantics and interaction interfaces shared across simulation and reality. This representation preserves reusable task structure while allowing environment-dependent operations to be selectively revised through real-world execution feedback. We evaluate the framework on LIBERO-PRO and corresponding physical tasks, studying both skill evolution and post-transfer adaptation. Our framework provides a route from one-shot policy deployment to continual procedural learning across environments.

AI.tldr: RoboBridge将仿真到现实的迁移视为可执行任务技能的持续适应：用过程表示任务知识，通过交互反馈生成并验证技能修订，将预训练VLA策略作为可复用动作工具，实现无需重训练策略的跨环境持续程序化学习。
AI.motivation: 具身智能落地面临仿真到现实迁移与部署后持续适应的挑战。端到端VLA策略虽操作能力强，但迁移通常依赖视觉与动力学标定、额外目标域演示和再训练；现有工具型具身智能体侧重任务执行与单一环境内经验复用，缺乏对过程性知识的跨仿真—现实迁移与持续适应支持。
AI.method: 提出RoboBridge框架，将sim-to-real迁移视为可执行任务技能的持续适应。智能体以过程表示任务知识，连接任务意图、观测、工具操作与结果验证；利用交互反馈生成候选技能修订，经评估后决定持久化或拒绝；将预训练VLA策略封装为可复用动作工具并加入推理时引导，在底层策略不重训练的前提下实现细粒度执行。技能以仿真与现实共享的任务语义和交互接口为基底，保留可复用任务结构，同时允许环境相关操作依据真实执行反馈被选择性修订。
AI.result: 在LIBERO-PRO及对应物理任务上评估框架，研究了技能演化与迁移后适应两方面表现。
AI.conclusion: 该框架提供了一条从一次性策略部署走向跨环境持续程序化学习的路径。

title: Physical AI Smart Spaces: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Multi-Camera 3D Perception in Smart Spaces
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026, Evaluations & Datasets Track (poster)
summary: Physical AI Smart Spaces is, to the best of our knowledge, the first benchmark to simultaneously provide large-scale, multi-class, and multi-camera 3D perception data for indoor smart spaces. It contains over 280 hours of synchronized 1080p footage captured by nearly 1,800 cameras in warehouses, hospitals, retail venues, and similar settings, together with automatic annotations for multi-camera identities, 2D bounding boxes, 3D bounding boxes, camera calibration, and depth where available. The benchmark spans Isaac Sim synthetic generation, Cosmos Transfer appearance augmentation, and real-world Sim2Real evaluation. For the real-world target, we include two warehouse deployments with time-synchronized streams, automatic VGGT-based calibration, and a 3D labeling interface that projects world-frame 3D boxes into each view for cross-camera verification. We describe the dataset scope, annotation and calibration schema, generation workflow, benchmark protocols, and official evaluation system, which standardizes submission format, and leaderboard reporting. A central contribution is a 3D instantiation of Higher Order Tracking Accuracy (HOTA), extending the usual 2D box-based tracking evaluation to 3D locations and 3D boxes. We further report empirical baselines from the AI City Challenge leaderboards, showing how methods evolve from person-only 3D location tracking to multi-class 3D box tracking under realistic smart-space constraints. The release is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/nvidia/PhysicalAI-SmartSpaces.

AI.tldr: Physical AI Smart Spaces 是首个面向室内智能空间、同时提供大规模、多类别、多相机 3D 感知数据的基准，包含 280+ 小时同步 1080p 视频、近 1800 个相机的多类标注，并引入 3D HOTA 评测指标。
AI.motivation: 现有智能空间感知基准难以同时满足大规模、多类别与多相机 3D 感知的需求，缺乏覆盖合成生成、外观增强与真实世界 Sim2Real 评估的统一平台，也缺少面向 3D 位置与 3D 框的跟踪评测标准。
AI.method: 构建包含 280+ 小时、近 1800 相机同步 1080p 视频的数据集，覆盖仓库、医院、零售等场景；提供多相机身份、2D/3D 边界框、相机标定与深度等自动标注；采用 Isaac Sim 合成生成与 Cosmos Transfer 外观增强，并进行真实世界 Sim2Real 评估；在真实仓库部署中实现时间同步流、基于 VGGT 的自动标定及 3D 标注界面。核心方法贡献为将 HOTA 扩展至 3D 位置与 3D 框。
AI.result: 给出 AI City Challenge 排行榜上的经验基线，展示方法从仅人物 3D 位置跟踪演进到真实智能空间约束下的多类 3D 框跟踪；建立统一提交格式、排行榜与官方评测系统。
AI.conclusion: 该基准为室内智能空间多相机 3D 感知与跟踪提供了统一的数据、标注、标定与评测框架，推动从 2D 框跟踪向 3D 多类跟踪发展，数据集已公开。

title: Right Order, Wrong Scale: Auditing LLM Judges for Occupational AI Measurement
summary: LLM judges are increasingly used to assess whether AI outputs meet workplace requirements, but agreement on response rankings does not establish agreement on acceptance rates or occupational aggregates. We introduce O*NET-BENCH, an audit suite derived from an existing survey of 45,796 worker ratings, and evaluate 33 pre-existing judge configurations across six model families on 4,501 test ratings. Twenty-five configurations achieve tie-aware pair accuracy of at least 0.60, although a train-fitted response-only TF-IDF baseline nearly matches the strongest judge. Despite this ordering agreement, judges estimate that 3.0%-97.9% of responses are acceptable, compared with 61.1% for occupation-matched workers. In one fine-tuned lineage, changing from pointwise scoring to a bundled few-shot/listwise protocol improves response ordering while reducing agreement with worker means at the task and occupation levels; this reversal replicates on a task- and worker-disjoint validation split under prespecified criteria. Cross-validated calibration largely removes mean bias, but calibrated scores explain at most 8.5% of individual worker-rating variance. Prediction-assisted estimation yields at most small precision gains at the studied label budgets. These results show that ranking agreement alone is insufficient for occupational measurement. Judges should be validated against the acceptance rates and aggregates their scores will be used to estimate.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 O*NET-BENCH 审计套件，用 45,796 条工人评分数据评估 33 种 LLM 评审配置，发现排序一致性无法保证通过率与职业层面聚合估计的有效性。
AI.motivation: LLM 评审被广泛用于判断 AI 输出是否满足职场要求，但现有评估通常只验证排序一致性，忽略评审分数是否真能反映工人对"可接受性"的实际判断与职业层面聚合指标。
AI.method: 构建 O*NET-BENCH 审计套件，基于已有 45,796 条工人评分调查，在 4,501 条测试评分上评估 6 个模型家族共 33 种既有评审配置，并以响应级 TF-IDF 基线、任务与工人不相交的验证集、交叉验证校准与预测辅助估计进行对照分析。
AI.result: 25 种配置达到至少 0.60 的 tie-aware 配对准确率，但纯响应的 TF-IDF 基线几乎追平最强评审；评审估计的通过率跨度达 3.0%–97.9%，而职业匹配工人的通过率为 61.1%。某微调谱系中，从逐点评分改为捆绑的 few-shot/listwise 协议可提升排序，却降低与工人在任务级和职业级均值的一致性，该反转在预设标准下于验证集复现。交叉验证校准基本消除均值偏差，但校准分数最多解释 8.5% 的个体评分方差；预测辅助估计在所研究标注预算下仅带来少量精度提升。
AI.conclusion: 排序一致性不足以支撑职业测量，评审须在其分数将要估计的通过率与聚合指标上进行验证。

title: $Ψ$-Resilience: Model-Free Feature Importance from 1D Topological Signals
summary: We introduce $Ψ$-Resilience, a model-free feature importance method that derives explanations directly from the data itself via 1D topological signals. Our method constructs a class-disagreement landscape by estimating class-conditional densities and taking their pointwise absolute difference along the feature axis. Then, the 0-dimensional persistence of this 1D signal defines a resilience functional that aggregates only those topological features that survive perturbations up to a robustness scale which is set by the user. This gives us a context-robust importance score that is inherently auditable via the underlying 1D landscapes and their persistence. We evaluate our method on both synthetic and real datasets. On synthetic generators with specified ground-truth importance, $Ψ$-Resilience recovers the ranking of features with high fidelity, achieving Spearman rank correlations up to 0.8 and performing competitively with multiple feature importance methods, including SHAP and mutual information. On real datasets with no known ground truth, our technique agrees with these methods, with correlations up to 0.9. These results show that $Ψ$-Resilience is a stable explanation method that enables rigorous, distribution-level auditing of feature importance without relying on a predictive model.

AI.tldr: 提出无模型特征重要性方法 Ψ-Resilience，基于一维拓扑信号与0维持续同调构造弹性泛函，用户设定扰动尺度以获得上下文稳健的重要性评分。合成数据上斯皮尔曼秩相关达0.8，真实数据上与SHAP、互信息等方法相关性达0.9。
AI.motivation: 现有特征重要性方法多依赖预测模型，导致解释受模型选择与训练过程影响，缺乏对数据分布层面的可审计性。作者希望直接从数据本身出发，获得不依赖预测模型、且可严格审计的稳健特征重要性度量。
AI.method: 方法通过估计类条件密度并沿特征轴取逐点绝对差，构造类别不一致性景观（一维拓扑信号）；对该一维信号计算0维持续同调，定义弹性泛函，仅聚合在用户指定鲁棒尺度内仍存活的拓扑特征，从而得到上下文稳健的重要性分数。
AI.result: 在具有指定真值重要性的合成生成器上，方法高保真恢复特征排序，斯皮尔曼秩相关最高约0.8，与SHAP、互信息等方法竞争力相当；在无真值的真实数据集上，与这些方法结果一致，相关性最高约0.9。
AI.conclusion: Ψ-Resilience 是一种稳定的解释方法，无需依赖预测模型即可实现严格的、分布层面的特征重要性审计。

title: Around the World: Unified Learned Locomotion on a 270 g Continuous-Rotation Quadruped
summary: Closed-loop learned locomotion is established on commercial quadrupeds but remains uncommon at the sub-kilogram scale. Continuous-rotation legs give MiNI-Q, a 270 g quadruped, access to supporting configurations on either side of the body. We exploit this range with a single posture-conditioned reinforcement-learning policy that runs entirely onboard. A continuous joint-space reference on the torus $T^8$ and its gravity-conditioned transformation connect upright walking, inverted walking, and landing recovery without state machines or phase switching. Coordinated posture and release curricula train this behavior family; identified actuation, cross-engine validation, and embedded execution support hardware transfer. The same sub-100k-parameter network tracks forward velocity with RMSE of 0.037 m/s upright and 0.050 m/s inverted, resumes walking in 24 of 30 release trials, and operates with four interchangeable foot geometries across four indoor surfaces. Hardware experiments and simulation ablations connect these capabilities to the representation, conditioning, and training choices that exploit the platform's motion range. Demonstration videos and supplementary material are available on the project website: https://submissionreview.github.io/around-the-world/.

AI.tldr: 提出MiNI-Q（270 g四足机器人），利用腿部连续旋转能力构建T^8环面关节空间参考与重力条件化变换，用单个姿态条件化强化学习策略在机载实现直立行走、倒立行走与落地恢复，无需状态机切换。
AI.motivation: 闭环学习式运动控制在商用大型四足上已成熟，但在亚千克（sub-kilogram）尺度仍罕见；同时希望不依赖状态机或相位切换，用单一策略覆盖机身两侧的支撑构型。
AI.method: 1) 平台：270 g四足MiNI-Q，腿部可连续旋转，可在机身两侧形成支撑配置；2) 表示：在环面T^8上设定连续关节空间参考，并用重力条件化变换统一直立、倒立与落地恢复；3) 训练：姿态与释放（release）协同课程学习；4) 部署：执行器辨识、跨引擎验证与嵌入式执行保障硬件迁移；网络参数量<100k。
AI.result: 同一网络直立跟踪前进速度RMSE 0.037 m/s、倒立0.050 m/s；30次释放试验中24次恢复行走；在四种室内表面上兼容四种可互换足部几何。硬件实验与仿真消融将能力归因于表示、条件化与训练设计。
AI.conclusion: 单一姿态条件化策略可充分开发小型连续旋转腿平台的运动范围，实现跨姿态（直立/倒立/恢复）的统一闭环运动控制并完成硬件迁移；相关视频与补充材料见项目网站。

title: GRAFT: Growing Agglomerative Foundation Models via Continual Teacher Distillation
summary: Vision foundation models such as DINOv2, SigLIP2, and MASt3R develop complementary capabilities from different pretraining objectives, yet their knowledge remains distributed across separate, specialized models. Multi-teacher knowledge distillation offers a path toward consolidating these capabilities into a single agglomerative backbone, but existing approaches assume a fixed set of teachers, and incorporating a new teacher requires repeating expensive joint distillation over the entire teacher set. We introduce GRAFT, a continual multi-teacher distillation framework that enables a unified backbone to progressively acquire capabilities from an open-ended sequence of foundation models. When a new teacher arrives, GRAFT treats the previously distilled model as a teacher for preserving learned capabilities, while the current student jointly learns from both the previous model and the incoming teacher. Furthermore, to reconcile the incompatible representation geometries of heterogeneous teachers, we introduce Teacher Specific Readout Tokens, which grant each teacher an independent read-out of the shared encoder, together with Geometry Agnostic Relational Loss that aligns a vision-language teacher by matching image-text similarity structures rather than raw feature values.
