We provide GRAFT model, which is a single, continually extensible backbone that unifies five domains, including image understanding, 2D dense prediction, 3D human pose estimation, 3D vision, and vision-language, delivering strong performance across all of them while acquiring each new capability at the cost of a single distillation rather than a full re-distillation.

AI.tldr: GRAFT 是一个持续式多教师蒸馏框架，使统一骨干网络能够从开放式序列的基础模型中逐步获取能力。
AI.motivation: DINOv2、SigLIP2、MASt3R 等视觉基础模型因预训练目标不同而具备互补能力，但知识分散在各自独立的专用模型中。多教师知识蒸馏可将这些能力整合进单一骨干，但现有方法假设教师集合固定，新增教师需对整个教师集重复进行昂贵的联合蒸馏。
AI.method: GRAFT 将先前蒸馏所得模型作为教师以保留已学能力，当前学生同时向旧模型与新到教师学习。针对异构教师表示几何不兼容的问题，提出 Teacher Specific Readout Tokens，为每位教师提供对共享编码器的独立读出，并提出 Geometry Agnostic Relational Loss，通过匹配图文相似度结构而非原始特征值来对齐视觉-语言教师。
AI.result: GRAFT 模型作为可持续扩展的单一骨干，统一了图像理解、2D 稠密预测、3D 人体姿态估计、3D 视觉与视觉-语言五个领域，并在各领域均取得强劲性能。
AI.conclusion: GRAFT 以单次蒸馏而非全量再蒸馏的代价获取每项新能力，实现了开放式多教师能力整合。

title: "I just assumed that it would translate": examining MT risk awareness among healthcare staff with abbreviations as a use case
comment: To appear in the proceedings of Convergence 2026 conference
summary: In the UK, public healthcare staff report turning to machine translation (MT) - predominantly Google Translate (GT) - to communicate with patients across language barriers. Though intended to support their duty of care, potentially uninformed reliance on MT in such contexts could have serious consequences for patient safety. Research nonetheless remains limited on staff awareness of the possible risks posed by higher-stakes MT use in general and with patient medical records in particular, most existing literature instead examining its use in interpersonal situations or with patient-oriented documentation. Moreover, medical abbreviations are well-documented as increasing patient risk even monolingually, with outcomes from their misuse and/or misinterpretation ranging from temporary harm to the death of the patient. Abbreviations were therefore selected as a use case for identifying the potential risks posed by their translation with MT. Contextualised French and Spanish data examples drawn from authoritative clinical corpora and translated via GT were presented during semi-structured interviews to 21 healthcare staff participants in diverse roles and specialties. The results were then subject to qualitative analysis and cross-analysis.

AI.tldr: 英国医护人员常使用机器翻译（以谷歌翻译为主）跨语言沟通，但对其在高风险医疗场景（尤其涉及病历和医学术语）中的风险认知研究不足。本研究以医学缩略语为切入点，通过半结构化访谈考察21名医护人员对谷歌翻译处理法、西临床文本的认知。
AI.motivation: 英国医护人员为跨越语言障碍与患者沟通，普遍转向机器翻译（主要是谷歌翻译）。虽意在支持照护职责，但在此类语境中对机器翻译的盲目依赖可能严重危及患者安全。然而，关于医护人员对高风险机器翻译使用（尤其是涉及患者病历）潜在风险的认知研究仍然有限，现有文献多关注其在人际沟通场景或面向患者的文档中的应用。此外，医学缩略语即便在单语环境下也已被证实会增加患者风险，其误用和/或误解可导致从暂时性伤害到患者死亡的后果。因此，作者选择医学缩略语作为用例，以识别机器翻译处理缩略语时可能带来的风险。
AI.method: 选取源自权威临床语料库的法语和西班牙语语境化数据示例，通过谷歌翻译进行处理，并在对21名不同岗位和专业领域的医护人员进行的半结构化访谈中呈现。随后对结果进行定性分析和交叉分析。
AI.result: 摘要未报告具体研究结果，仅说明对访谈结果进行了定性分析和交叉分析。
AI.conclusion: 以医学缩略语为用例，通过访谈与定性、交叉分析，可识别机器翻译在涉及患者病历的高风险医疗沟通中对患者安全的潜在风险，并揭示医护人员对其风险的认知状况。

title: PowerBench: Measuring Language Model Bias in Power-shifting Requests
summary: Language models increasingly assist people with power-related requests, so systematic differences in whom they help could shift the distribution of power at scale, or be exploited by users who learn which identities are refused less. We introduce PowerBench, an evaluation of power-shifting requests that distinguishes self-empowerment, disempowerment, and power grabbing, plus a control of refusal-inducing requests that shift no power. We build, curate, and open-source a dataset of such requests varying the power domain, the context, the scale of the affected party, and the prior power standing of the user, and evaluate 24 models (12 from US and 12 from Chinese developers) under three experimental conditions: reciprocal nationalities of user and affected party, an AI agent as the user, and 8 request languages. Models refuse power grabbing more than disempowerment, and disempowerment more than self-empowerment. Refusal of power grabbing rises with the scale of the affected party, from an individual to a society. Models are biased toward helping others take power from the US and against helping US users take power from others, but favor the US when it gains power and nobody loses it. When the user is an AI agent, refusal of power-shifting requests increases, especially in power grabbing against an individual. Finally, language biases refusal, but in model-specific ways that largely cancel on average. We release PowerBench to make these asymmetries measurable in current and future models.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 PowerBench，一个评估语言模型处理“权力转移请求”的基准，区分自我赋权、去权与夺权三类请求，并构建开源数据集，在三种实验条件下评测 24 个模型（美国与中国开发者各 12 个）。
AI.motivation: 语言模型日益辅助涉及权力的请求，若模型在“帮助谁”上存在系统性差异，可能大规模改变权力分布，或被用户利用以规避拒绝。因此需要可量化的评估工具来揭示这些不对称性。
AI.method: 构建、筛选并开源 PowerBench 数据集：请求涵盖不同权力领域、上下文、受影响方规模及用户既有权力地位，并设“不改变权力”的拒绝诱导请求作为对照。评测 24 个模型（美国、中国开发者各 12 个），在三种实验条件下进行：用户与受影响方国籍互置、以 AI 智能体作为用户、以及 8 种请求语言。
AI.result: 模型对夺权的拒绝高于去权，对去权的拒绝高于自我赋权；对夺权的拒绝随受影响方规模（从个体到社会）上升而增加。模型倾向帮助他方从美国夺取权力，而不愿帮助美国用户从他人处夺权，但当美国获得权力且无人受损时则偏向美国。当用户为 AI 智能体时，对权力转移请求的拒绝增加，尤其在针对个体的夺权情形中。语言会影响拒绝率，但影响因模型而异，平均而言大致相互抵消。
AI.conclusion: PowerBench 的发布使当前及未来模型中的上述权力相关不对称性可被系统测量，为模型权力偏向研究提供可复现的评估基础。

title: CSIR: Contextually and Socially Informed Robots for Efficient Person Goal Navigation
summary: We address the Person Goal Navigation (PersonNav) problem, enabling robots to search for people under realistic constraints on information accessibility and language uncertainty. This tackles the current solutions revolving around rigid person finding systems requiring exact knowledge of the individual for item-delivery in indoor settings. While the focus in literature is on learned methods using unavailable public or sparse data due to human privacy. We propose a planning framework that combines distance and semantic information about the recipient (habits and intent) weighted by the trust of the user-provided information. A synthetic benchmark of scenarios is also developed including actors, items, and requests to evaluate performance before real-world deployment aiming to simulate natural language human-robot interactions. Results show our informed search outperforms classical distance-based graph baselines, while semantics alone lead to ungrounded, sporadic search. Our method achieves strong gains over baselines, with an LLM-based variant performing comparably, and its explicit belief representation naturally supports future Bayesian filtering. Hardware tests demonstrate our method supports real-world embodiment able to leverage between semantic and distance information in a real setting. This work moves toward more intelligent mobile service agents capable of human-like, informed search in realistic environments to be leveraged in day-to-day use. https://anonymous.4open.science/r/personnavsite-4ED2/index.html.

AI.tldr: 论文提出PersonNav任务及规划框架，融合距离与语义信息（受用户信息可信度加权）实现机器人在现实约束下的人物搜索，并构建合成基准验证。
AI.motivation: 现有寻人系统依赖对个体的精确已知信息，且受限于隐私导致公开数据匮乏，难以在信息可及性与语言不确定性等现实约束下工作。
AI.method: 提出一种规划框架，结合关于目标（习惯与意图）的距离信息和语义信息，并按用户提供信息的可信度加权；同时构建包含演员、物品与请求的合成基准用于评估，并设计基于LLM的变体。
AI.result: 知情搜索优于经典基于距离的图基线，仅用语义会导致不接地、零散的搜索；方法取得显著增益，LLM变体表现相当；显式信念表示支持未来贝叶斯滤波；硬件测试表明可支持真实环境部署。
AI.conclusion: 该工作朝更智能的移动服务代理发展，使其能在现实环境中进行类人、知情搜索，以用于日常场景。

title: Imagine the Future, Internalize the Gist: Efficient VLA Reasoning via Internalized Spatiotemporal Imagination
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models increasingly incorporate intermediate reasoning to improve robotic manipulation, yet existing approaches primarily reason about observed states without explicitly anticipating future scene evolution. Extending such reasoning to explicit future rollouts at every inference step, however, introduces substantial computational overhead. We propose IG-VLA, a VLA reasoning framework that enables models to imagine the future and internalize the gist. Our Latent Spatiotemporal Reasoning learns to imagine task-relevant future scene evolution directly in visual representation space, guiding action prediction without costly pixel-level video generation. To further reduce inference overhead, we introduce Scene Gist Memory, which internalizes reasoning-derived scene-behavior associations into a compact Scene Gist Token, preserving the benefits of future reasoning while bypassing explicit future imagination at inference. Extensive experiments on LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, and VLABench demonstrate the effectiveness and efficiency of IG-VLA. On the LIBERO-Plus Language suite, both the reasoning and gist policies outperform the strongest baseline by nearly 6% in success rate. The gist policy also achieves up to 6.38x speedup over baselines, reducing inference latency from 1081ms to 169.5ms per action chunk on a single NVIDIA A6000 GPU. These results demonstrate that future spatiotemporal reasoning can be effectively internalized for efficient VLA deployment.

AI.tldr: 提出 IG-VLA 框架，让 VLA 模型在视觉表征空间中进行潜在时空推理以"想象未来"，并通过场景要点记忆将推理结果内化为紧凑的 Scene Gist Token，在保持性能提升的同时大幅降低推理开销。
AI.motivation: 现有 VLA 模型虽引入中间推理以提升机器人操作能力，但主要针对已观测状态进行推理，未显式预判未来场景演化；若在每个推理步都显式展开未来 rollout，则会带来巨大的计算开销。
AI.method: 1) 潜在时空推理（Latent Spatiotemporal Reasoning）：在视觉表征空间中直接想象任务相关的未来场景演化，用于指导动作预测，避免昂贵的像素级视频生成；2) 场景要点记忆（Scene Gist Memory）：将推理得到的场景—行为关联内化为紧凑的 Scene Gist Token，在推理阶段跳过显式未来想象，保留未来推理收益。
AI.result: 在 LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus 和 VLABench 上验证有效性与效率。LIBERO-Plus Language 套件上，推理策略与要点策略的成功率均比最强基线高近 6%；要点策略相较基线最高实现 6.38 倍加速，在单张 NVIDIA A6000 GPU 上单动作块推理延迟从 1081ms 降至 169.5ms。
AI.conclusion: 未来时空推理可被有效内化，从而实现高效 VLA 部署。

title: HXAI: Hierarchical Privacy-Preserving Explainable AI in Distributed Energy Systems
summary: Balancing electricity demand and supply is increasingly difficult due to the inherent intermittency of renewable power generation and the stochastic power consumption. Grid operators require fine-grained, decision-relevant insights into household energy consumption to manage peak loads and design responsive tariffs, but increased transparency at this level raises significant privacy concerns. Traditional methods for explainable AI (XAI) can reveal sensitive information, while standard privacy techniques often reduce the usefulness of explanations. To address this issue, we introduce HXAI, a hierarchical framework that preserves privacy while enabling reasonable explainable analysis for grid-level demand management. HXAI consists of two main components: (1) a local model that generates fine-grained explanations within a secure, private environment, and (2) a zonal model that aggregates these explanations to support grid-level analysis while enforcing privacy through flexible privacy-budget management. We explicitly limit cumulative privacy exposure under repeated operator queries and show that the proposed framework preserves decision-relevant information without compromising household privacy. Experiments on both simulated and real-world energy datasets demonstrate that HXAI provides useful insights for zonal load management while ensuring that appliance-level consumption remains local and is never transmitted to grid operators. Our results show that preserving the semantic structure of explanations, rather than minimizing numerical error, is the key to XAI under differential privacy. This framework provides a way to achieve both privacy and explainability in energy management.

AI.tldr: 提出分层框架HXAI，在保护隐私的前提下为电网级需求管理提供可解释分析，兼顾隐私与可解释性。
AI.motivation: 可再生能源的间歇性与用电的随机性使电力供需平衡日益困难，电网运营商需要细粒度、与决策相关的家庭能耗洞察以管理峰值负荷和设计响应式电价；但细粒度透明化带来严重隐私问题。传统XAI方法可能泄露敏感信息，而标准隐私技术往往削弱解释的可用性。
AI.method: HXAI包含两个主要组件：(1) 本地模型，在安全私密环境中生成细粒度解释；(2) 区域（zonal）模型，聚合这些解释以支持电网级分析，并通过灵活的隐私预算管理实施隐私保护。框架显式限制重复查询下的累计隐私暴露。
AI.result: 在模拟与真实能源数据集上的实验表明，HXAI为区域负荷管理提供有用洞察，同时确保家电级用电数据保留在本地、绝不传输给电网运营商；结果还显示，在差分隐私下保持解释的语义结构而非最小化数值误差，是XAI的关键。
AI.conclusion: 该框架在能源管理中同时实现隐私与可解释性，为电网级需求管理提供了可行路径。

title: Slow-Fast Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation for Capability Preservation
summary: Foundation multimodal large language models are designed to support a broad spectrum of capabilities across diverse domains. Multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) provides an effective framework for consolidating domain-specific expertise into a single student model. However, MOPD training gradually drives the student away from its initialization model, and general capabilities decline as the displacement grows, resulting in capability interference. A direct remedy is constraining the student toward its initialization, but this suppresses the acquisition of domain expertise as well. We propose Slow-Fast Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation (SF-MOPD), which couples a fast model, the current student updated directly by each teacher, with a slow model, an exponential moving average of the student. The slow model absorbs the learning signal gradually, serving as a moving capability reference that fuses the general foundation with confirmed domain expertise. For each teacher, SF-MOPD computes the teacher-induced update in log-probability space and removes only the component that pushes the fast model further away from the slow model, while retaining aligned and orthogonal components. Experiments across multiple model scales demonstrate that SF-MOPD effectively mitigates capability interference, enhances specialized multimodal capabilities, and reduces the average degradation on general-capability benchmarks, consistently outperforming vanilla MOPD.

AI.tldr: 本文提出慢-快多教师在线策略蒸馏（SF-MOPD），用学生模型的指数移动平均构建"慢模型"作为动态能力参考，仅移除各教师更新中使快模型偏离慢模型的分量，从而在注入领域专长的同时抑制通用能力退化。
AI.motivation: 多教师在线策略蒸馏（MOPD）能把多个领域的专长整合进单一学生模型，但训练会使学生逐渐偏离其初始化模型，偏离越大通用能力下降越明显，形成"能力干扰"。直接约束学生靠近初始化又会压制领域专长的习得，二者存在矛盾。
AI.method: SF-MOPD 将当前由各教师直接更新的学生（快模型）与学生的指数移动平均（慢模型）耦合。慢模型渐进吸收学习信号，充当融合通用基础与已确认领域专长的动态能力参考。对每个教师，方法在对数概率空间中计算教师诱导的更新量，仅移除使快模型进一步远离慢模型的分量，保留与参考方向一致（对齐）和正交的分量。
AI.result: 在多个模型规模上的实验表明，SF-MOPD 有效缓解能力干扰，提升专业化多模态能力，并降低通用能力基准上的平均退化，一致优于原始 MOPD。
AI.conclusion: 以慢模型作为移动能力参考、在更新空间中做分量筛选，是缓解多教师蒸馏中通用-专长权衡的有效方案，兼具专长注入与通用能力保持的平衡。

title: Proprioceptive Sketches as Long-Horizon Intent for Generative Action Policies
summary: Generative robot policies predict short action chunks but lack explicit long-horizon intent. Recent methods expose longer-horizon structure through language plans, subgoal images, or video forecasts, which are costly to generate and still need to be translated into robot motion. Predicting future robot motions avoids this translation, but a dense, time-indexed trajectory requires numerous parameters to cover the full remaining task, and over a short horizon it largely repeats the action chunk and adds little guidance for action generation. We propose Proprioceptive Action Models (PAM), which jointly generate a compact, timing-free sketch of the robot's remaining joint-space path and a dense executable action chunk within a single transformer denoiser. The sketch parameterizes the path by arc length rather than time, capturing geometric intent invariant to execution timing. Block-causal attention and a staggered denoising schedule maintain directed sketch-to-action dependence, ensuring the action tokens condition on a progressively cleaner sketch throughout sampling. In simulation, PAM improves over its action-only counterparts on Push-T and LIBERO-Long; on four real-world bimanual tasks, it raises success from 47.5% to 75.0%. Project page: https://nicehiro.github.io/pam_dp/

AI.tldr: 提出本体感受动作模型（PAM），在单一transformer去噪器中联合生成“无时间戳的路径草图”与“密集可执行动作块”，仅为动作块补全长时程几何意图，显著提升仿真与真实双臂任务成功率。
AI.motivation: 生成式机器人策略仅预测短动作块，缺乏显式长时程意图；现有用语言规划、子目标图像或视频预测来暴露长时程结构的方法生成代价高，且仍需翻译为机器人运动。直接预测未来机器人运动虽免去翻译，但密集、按时间索引的轨迹参数多、覆盖剩余任务需大量参数，且在短时程上与动作块高度重复，对动作生成指导有限。
AI.method: PAM在单个transformer去噪器内联合生成两部分：(1) 机器人剩余关节空间路径的紧凑、无时间信息的草图；(2) 密集可执行动作块。草图按弧长而非时间参数化路径，从而捕获与执行时序无关的几何意图。采用块因果注意力与错位去噪调度，维持有向的“草图→动作”依赖，使动作token在整个采样过程中条件于逐步变干净（渐进清晰）的草图。
AI.result: 仿真中，PAM在Push-T与LIBERO-Long上优于仅动作的对应基线；在四个真实世界双臂任务上，成功率从47.5%提升至75.0%。
AI.conclusion: 以弧长参数化的紧凑路径草图作为长时程意图表示，并与密集动作块在单一去噪器中联合生成、通过块因果注意力与错位去噪保持依赖，是一种有效且轻量的长时程机器人策略增强方式，且已在仿真与真实双臂任务上验证。

title: Capturing Dynamics: The 4D Facial Expression Intensity Dataset
summary: The estimation and analysis of facial expression intensity play a crucial role in affective communication and human-computer interaction. Previous research has primarily focused on detecting and estimating facial expression intensity from frame-level 2D representations. However, this limitation restricts a comprehensive understanding of real-world facial expressions, as they are inherently 3D and temporally continuous. This paper investigates the perception of facial expression intensity by introducing the 4D Facial Expression Intensity Dataset (4DFEID). We employ a parametric face model and compile a total of 2,869 mesh sequences with controlled geometric variations, generating 4D data instances with diverse peak intensities and identity attributes. Using a Likert scale, we collect more than 90,000 subjective intensity perception ratings via a crowdsourcing platform. We explore various architectures and aggregation methods to establish baselines for episode intensity estimation on the new dataset, revealing that spatial-temporal graph models consistently outperform traditional frame-aggregation methods. In contrast to existing datasets that rely on 2D static imagery, the proposed 4D-FEID dataset provides the community with a unique and vital resource for investigating the perception of facial expression intensity through the use of dynamic 3D stimuli. By offering high-fidelity, spatio-temporally coherent facial data, 4D-FEID establishes a new foundation for research into more nuanced and naturalistic expression analysis, thereby addressing a gap in the current landscape of affective computing and human-computer interaction studies. The dataset is available at link.

AI.tldr: 本文提出4D面部表情强度数据集（4D-FEID），包含2,869条参数化面部网格序列、覆盖不同峰值强度与身份属性，并通过众包收集超90,000条Likert量表主观强度评分；基于该数据集建立多种架构与聚合方法的基线，发现时空图模型显著优于传统帧聚合方法。
AI.motivation: 以往面部表情强度估计多基于帧级2D表征，而真实表情本质上是3D且时间连续的，这一局限阻碍了对表情强度的全面理解，因此需要一个动态3D刺激下的表情强度感知数据集。
AI.method: 构建4D Facial Expression Intensity Dataset（4D-FEID）：采用参数化人脸模型生成2,869条具有受控几何变化的网格序列，得到峰值强度与身份属性多样的4D数据实例；通过众包平台以Likert量表收集90,000余条主观强度感知评分；并探索多种架构与聚合方法，建立episode强度估计基线。
AI.result: 时空图模型在强度估计上持续优于传统帧聚合方法；数据集提供高保真、时空一致的面部数据，成为基于动态3D刺激研究表情强度感知的独特资源。
AI.conclusion: 4D-FEID为更细致、自然的表情分析研究奠定了新基础，弥补了情感计算与人机交互领域在动态3D表情强度感知数据方面的空白，数据集已公开。

title: World Action Modeling with Progressive Visual Planning
summary: World action models (WAMs) have emerged as a promising paradigm for robotic control by jointly predicting future visual dynamics and actions from an initial observation and instruction. However, existing WAMs struggle with long-horizon prediction, as generating dense video rollouts is highly inefficient. Some recent WAMs address this by predicting a single future frame without generating the full video, but this approach neglects how to progress toward the goal. We present ProWAM, a progressive world action model that jointly predicts actions and an ordered sequence of sparse visual sub-goals, providing explicit visual guidance to anchor action generation throughout task execution. This design scales naturally, as sub-goal prediction can be learned from large-scale action-free videos, allowing the video backbone to offload complex visual planning from the action policy. For efficient action generation, ProWAM executes a single video-backbone forward pass to cache sparse sub-goal features, eliminating iterative full-video generation and requiring only lightweight action denoising during replanning. Across extensive evaluations, ProWAM achieves superior out-of-distribution robustness. On simulation benchmarks, it sets new state-of-the-art results on LIBERO-Plus (85.8%) and randomized RoboTwin (75.7%), outperforming the strongest baseline with relative gains of up to +35.9%. On RoboCasa365, ProWAM achieves a 48.1% success rate and 18.2% on the challenging Composite-Unseen split, ranking 4th overall. Crucially, in zero-shot real-world experiments, ProWAM achieves 70.0% success, outperforming the strongest baseline by +15.0 (from 55.0% to 70.0%, a +27.3% relative gain) in novel scenes. These results demonstrate the value of progress-indexed visual foresight for closed-loop control. Our program is in https://sii-ferenas.github.io/ProWAM-page.

AI.tldr: ProWAM是一种渐进式世界动作模型，通过联合预测动作和有序稀疏视觉子目标序列，为动作生成提供显式视觉引导，实现长时程机器人控制的高效性与强鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有世界动作模型（WAMs）在长时程预测上效率低下：生成密集视频展开计算开销大；而仅预测单帧未来图像的方法又缺乏向目标推进的引导。因此需要一种既能高效生成动作、又能提供明确视觉进度引导的范式。
AI.method: ProWAM联合预测动作与有序的稀疏视觉子目标序列，作为锚定动作生成的显式视觉引导。子目标预测可从大规模无动作视频中学习，使视频骨干网络承担复杂视觉规划，从而为动作策略减负。推理时仅需一次视频骨干前向传播以缓存稀疏子目标特征，无需迭代生成完整视频，重规划时仅执行轻量级动作去噪。
AI.result: 仿真基准上达到新SOTA：LIBERO-Plus 85.8%，随机化RoboTwin 75.7%，相对最强基线最高提升+35.9%；RoboCasa365成功率48.1%，Composite-Unseen划分18.2%，总排名第4。零样本真实世界实验中，新场景成功率70.0%，较最强基线（55.0%）提升+15.0个百分点（相对提升+27.3%）。
AI.conclusion: 进度索引的视觉前瞻（progress-indexed visual foresight）对闭环控制具有显著价值，ProWAM在分布外鲁棒性与真实场景零样本泛化上均优于现有方法，验证了渐进式稀疏子目标引导范式的有效性。

title: Drive vs. Decay: On the Training Dynamics of Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 (Main Track). 57 pages, 10 pages of main text; appendices and the NeurIPS paper checklist included. Code: https://github.com/jose-melo/drive-vs-decay
summary: Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) are prone to representation collapse, typically mitigated through empirical heuristics. We develop an early-training stability theory that unifies these heuristics. Linearising the coupled JEPA gradient flow around the trivial fixed point reveals two competing effects: a driving force ($γ$) and a decay effect ($σ$). Under approximate spectral decoupling, a per-mode stability ratio $μ_i = γ_i / σ_i$ factorises into independent data-side and predictor-side terms and the count of unstable modes tracks the rank of representations that can emerge. The framework predicts a phase boundary, which we confirm empirically across more than 800 Tabular-JEPA configurations. It also unifies predictor scaling, masking ratio, and EMA as distinct mechanisms for shifting $μ$. Guided by this analysis, we introduce ResidualPred, a transformer predictor whose attention is biased toward the identity at initialisation; it improves both effective rank and downstream accuracy on tabular benchmarks and in I-JEPA pretraining on CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, STL-10, and ImageNet. Our framework connects empirical collapse-avoidance heuristics to an explicit dynamical picture, yielding theory-driven stabilizers. Code is available at https://github.com/jose-melo/drive-vs-decay.

AI.tldr: 本文提出JEPA早期训练稳定性理论，将表征坍缩的经验性启发式统一为驱动力γ与衰减效应σ的竞争，给出逐模态稳定性比μ_i与相边界，并据此设计ResidualPred预测器提升有效秩与下游精度。
AI.motivation: JEPA类联合嵌入预测架构易发生表征坍缩，现有缓解手段多为经验性启发式，缺乏统一的理论解释，难以指导稳定器的设计。
AI.method: 在平凡不动点附近线性化耦合的JEPA梯度流，识别出驱动项γ与衰减项σ；在近似谱解耦下将逐模态稳定性比μ_i=γ_i/σ_i分解为独立的数据侧与预测器侧因子，用不稳定模态数刻画可涌现表征的秩，并推导相边界；进一步提出ResidualPred——一种初始化时将注意力偏向恒等映射的Transformer预测器。
AI.result: 在800余组Tabular-JEPA配置中验证了相边界；统一解释了预测器尺度、掩码比例与EMA作为移动μ的不同机制；ResidualPred在表格基准上提升了有效秩与下游精度，并在CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100、STL-10及ImageNet的I-JEPA预训练中取得提升。
AI.conclusion: 该框架把避免坍缩的经验启发式与显式动力学图景相连接，区分了数据侧与预测器侧的稳定化作用，从而给出理论驱动的稳定器设计原则。

title: Localized Conformal Safety Monitoring with Vision-Language Models for Autonomous Driving
comment: 5 pages, 2 figures, 1 table. Extended abstract. Disha Kamale and Dmitry Berenson are joint senior authors
summary: Monitoring planned driving trajectories requires accurately estimating the collision likelihood with actors whose motion is itself impacted by the ego motion. Existing classical approaches are often limited by the quality of their forecasting model. Vision-language models (VLMs) have shown promise in reasoning about the consequences of high-level actions, yet their approximate predictions are unsuitable for safety-critical applications such as autonomous driving. Conformal prediction (CP) has emerged as a data-driven framework for quantifying the uncertainty of black-box model predictions. We propose Split Label-Localized Conformal Prediction (SLLCP), a post-hoc calibration layer over frozen VLMs that transforms their unreliable predictions into probabilistically calibrated safety prediction sets. We consider how the ability to estimate safety can depend on the observed driving scene and introduce a localized procedure that upweights relevant past experience when calculating uncertainty thresholds. We provide label-conditional finite-sample distribution-free coverage under exchangeability. Evaluated over 15k CARLA trajectories from unseen scenarios, SLLCP correctly flags 89.6% of collision-causing trajectories with a Qwen backbone and 88.4% with a Cosmos backbone, while the base VLMs only flagged 4.6% and 39.1% of the collision-causing trajectories, respectively. These results indicate that local, label-conditional calibration can reduce missed unsafe trajectories.

AI.tldr: 提出SLLCP——一种作用于冻结VLM的事后校准层，通过局部化、标签条件化的保形预测，将VLM不可靠的预测转化为概率校准的安全预测集，大幅提升碰撞轨迹识别率。
AI.motivation: 监测规划驾驶轨迹需在与自车运动相互影响的环境中准确估计碰撞可能性。经典方法受限于预测模型质量；VLM虽能推理高层动作后果，但其近似预测不适用于自动驾驶等安全关键场景，因此需要一种数据驱动的不确定性量化手段。
AI.method: 提出Split Label-Localized Conformal Prediction（SLLCP）：在冻结的VLM之上加装事后校准层，将不可靠预测转换为概率校准的安全预测集。考虑安全估计能力依赖于所观察的驾驶场景，引入局部化流程，在计算不确定性阈值时对相关历史经验加权。在可交换性假设下提供标签条件化的有限样本无分布覆盖保证。
AI.result: 在来自未见场景的15k条CARLA轨迹上评估：SLLCP以Qwen为骨干时正确标记89.6%的致碰撞轨迹，以Cosmos为骨干为88.4%；而基础VLM仅分别为4.6%和39.1%。
AI.conclusion: 局部化、标签条件化的校准能显著减少被漏检的不安全轨迹，表明SLLCP可有效提升VLM在安全关键驾驶任务中的可靠性。

title: SpectralCache: Accelerating Diffusion-Based World Models via Spectral Feature Caching
summary: Diffusion-based world models enable high-quality interactive environment generation but suffer from substantial inference overhead due to repeated Transformer evaluations during denoising. Existing caching methods mainly exploit temporal redundancy at the feature or token level, leaving the underlying mathematical structure of diffusion features largely unexplored. In this work, we reveal that world-model features exhibit highly stable singular subspaces across nearby denoising steps, while their singular values follow predictable evolution patterns. Building on this observation, we propose SpectralCache, a training-free spectral caching framework that reuses stable singular subspaces and estimates only low-dimensional singular values through linear extrapolation. We further exploit the spectral consistency between neighboring full-computation features to skip selected expensive backbone evaluations via singular value scaling. Extensive experiments on representative world models demonstrate that SpectralCache consistently improves inference efficiency while preserving generation quality. On HunyuanWorld-Voyager-13B, SpectralCache achieves 5.22x acceleration while maintaining a WorldScore of 65.90 for static scenes, substantially outperforming existing training-free caching methods in inference efficiency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SpectralCache，一种免训练谱缓存框架，通过复用稳定奇异子空间并线性外推低维奇异值来加速基于扩散的世界模型推理，在 HunyuanWorld-Voyager-13B 上实现 5.22 倍加速且保持生成质量。
AI.motivation: 基于扩散的世界模型可高质量生成交互式环境，但因去噪过程中反复进行 Transformer 评估而存在显著推理开销；现有缓存方法主要利用特征或 token 层面的时间冗余，未充分挖掘扩散特征背后的数学结构。
AI.method: 作者发现世界模型特征在相邻去噪步间具有高度稳定的奇异子空间，且奇异值遵循可预测的演化规律。据此提出免训练谱缓存框架 SpectralCache：复用稳定奇异子空间，仅通过线性外推估计低维奇异值；并利用相邻全计算特征间的谱一致性，通过奇异值缩放跳过部分昂贵的骨干网络评估。
AI.result: 在代表性世界模型上的大量实验表明，SpectralCache 在保持生成质量的同时持续提升推理效率。在 HunyuanWorld-Voyager-13B 上，实现 5.22 倍加速，静态场景 WorldScore 达 65.90，推理效率显著优于现有免训练缓存方法。
AI.conclusion: 从扩散特征的谱结构（奇异子空间稳定性与奇异值演化规律）出发进行缓存设计是一种有效的加速思路，SpectralCache 在免训练前提下兼顾了推理效率与生成质量，优于现有方法。

title: On-Premises Multi-Course RAG Tutoring for Business Education: Hardware-Software Trade-offs in a Campus AI Tutor
summary: Campus AI tutors based on retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) must ground answers in assigned course materials while keeping textbooks and student dialogue on institutional infrastructure. We present CourseChat, an on-premises, multi-course RAG tutor for undergraduate business education, deployed behind a campus web gateway and intended for use embedded in Moodle. Six isolated course offerings, each keyed by its own course reference number (CRN), share twin-edge AI hosts running a FastAPI service, a local vector database, and a local large language model (LLM) served by Ollama. We report two generation-model bake-off rounds, a separate fixed-evidence source-fidelity comparison, and conversation and quiz audits. Several larger models failed the classroom speed gate, but a 12B model and a 7B alternative passed. A separate mixture-of-experts candidate improved some corrections while introducing new factual and continuity errors. We therefore retain the 8B production model pending a demonstrated overall improvement, rather than claiming that 8B is universally optimal. Software changes improved follow-up topic resolution while preserving course scope; 435 prebuilt questions across 65 modules decouple practice from live generation. The results support treating model choice, evidence selection, serving compatibility, and product design as a joint engineering decision. They do not establish learning gains: faculty ratings, peak-load capacity, and complete public-gateway acceptance remain separate evaluation needs.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍 CourseChat：一个面向本科商科教育的本地化、多课程 RAG 智能辅导系统，部署于校园网关并在双边缘 AI 主机上以 FastAPI + 本地向量库 + Ollama 本地 LLM 提供服务。通过两轮生成模型比选、固定证据溯源保真对比及对话与测验审计，确认 12B 与 7B 模型通过课堂速度门槛，最终保留 8B 生产模型，并将模型选择、证据选取、服务兼容与产品设计视为联合工程决策。
AI.motivation: 校园 AI 辅导系统需将答案锚定在指定课程材料中，同时把教材与学生对话保留在院校自有基础设施内，因而需要本地化部署方案；此外，模型能力与课堂响应速度之间存在张力，需明确教学场景下的可行模型区间及证据保真要求。
AI.method: 系统层面：构建本地部署的多课程 RAG 辅导系统 CourseChat，经校园 Web 网关发布并计划嵌入 Moodle；六个以课程参考号（CRN）为键的隔离课程共享双边缘 AI 主机，运行 FastAPI 服务、本地向量数据库与由 Ollama 提供的本地 LLM。评测层面：开展两轮生成模型比选（bake-off）、一次独立的固定证据来源保真度对比，以及对话与测验审计；同时进行软件改动对后续话题解析能力的评估，并预置 435 道题覆盖 65 个模块。
AI.result: 多个较大模型未通过课堂速度门槛，而 12B 模型与一个 7B 备选模型通过；另一混合专家（MoE）候选模型改善了部分纠错，但引入新的事实性错误与连贯性问题。软件改动提升了后续话题解析能力，且未破坏课程范围限定；预置的 435 道题（覆盖 65 个模块）使练习与实时生成解耦。据此保留 8B 生产模型，待整体改进得到验证后再更换。
AI.conclusion: 模型选择、证据选取、服务兼容性与产品设计应被视为联合工程决策，而非独立优化项。当前结果未建立学习增益；教师评分、峰值负载容量以及完整公共网关验收仍属独立的后续评估需求。

title: Mitigating Convergence Collapse in Fixed-Target Anomaly Detectors via Kernel-Anchored Locality Regularization
summary: A family of tabular anomaly detectors trains a neural map toward a fixed target under squared-error loss and scores anomalies by the test-time residual; contraction matching, one-step rectified flow, and reconstruction autoencoders all fit this template. We characterize a convergence collapse: better optimization makes the detector worse. At convergence, the learned map tracks the target even off-distribution, so the residual signal vanishes on anomalies as well as on normal data. These detectors therefore rely on implicit non-convergence (early stopping, capacity caps) to retain signal. We argue this is structural: effective anomaly detection requires a locality constraint that blocks unconstrained extrapolation. Classical detectors (kNN, KDE, isolation forests, LOF) enforce locality explicitly; fixed-target neural detectors do not. We formalize the connection by showing that the kernel-regression analog of a fixed-target detector is a finite-bandwidth Nadaraya-Watson smoother, which we call Kernel Contraction Matching (KCM). KCM is closed-form, training-free, and CPU-efficient, yet matches established neural baselines on ADBench. Building on this bridge, we introduce the Kernel-Anchored Regularizer (KAR), which penalizes deviation of the neural prediction from a kernel-weighted average of training targets. Across collapse-prone ADBench datasets and three backbones, KAR mitigates collapse and improves AUROC under prolonged training.

AI.tldr: 该论文揭示了固定目标表格异常检测器的"收敛坍缩"现象：优化越充分，检测性能越差；并从理论上将其归因于缺乏局部性约束，提出核锚定正则化器（KAR）以缓解该问题。
AI.motivation: 一类表格异常检测器（收缩匹配、一步整流流、重构自编码器）均在平方误差损失下训练神经网络映射逼近固定目标，并以测试时残差作为异常分数。这类方法隐含依赖"未收敛"（早停、容量限制）来保留信号，但此前缺乏对"为何收敛会损害检测"的结构性解释。
AI.method: 作者首先刻画"收敛坍缩"：收敛时学习到的映射在分布外也跟踪目标，导致异常样本上的残差信号同样消失。随后论证有效异常检测需要阻止无约束外推的局部性约束，指出经典检测器（kNN、KDE、孤立森林、LOF）显式施加局部性，而固定目标神经检测器则不然。为形式化该联系，提出核收缩匹配（KCM）——固定目标检测器在核回归意义下等价于有限带宽的 Nadaraya-Watson 平滑器，具有闭式解、免训练、CPU高效率。基于此桥梁进一步提出核锚定正则化器（KAR），惩罚神经预测与训练目标核加权平均之间的偏离。
AI.result: KCM 无需训练且在 ADBench 上匹配已有神经基线；在易坍缩的 ADBench 数据集及三种骨干网络上，KAR 能缓解收敛坍缩，并在延长训练时提升 AUROC。
AI.conclusion: 收敛坍缩是固定目标神经异常检测器的结构性问题，根源在于缺乏局部性约束；核回归视角（KCM）既提供了理论桥梁又给出了高效基线，而 KAR 作为即插即用正则项可有效恢复长时间训练下的检测性能。

title: SimpleTouch: Can Vision-Language-Action Models Master Contact-Rich Manipulation Without Tactile Policy Pretraining?
summary: Tactile sensing provides essential contact information for robotic manipulation, yet incorporating it into pretrained vision-language-action (VLA) models remains challenging. A common concern is that simply introducing touch during task-specific fine-tuning may fail to bridge the cross-modal gap, yielding limited gains or even reduced success. Consequently, existing methods often rely on large-scale tactile policy pretraining or separate visuotactile alignment, adding data requirements and training stages. We introduce SimpleTouch, a simple VLA extension that augments $π_{0.5}$ with a tactile expert, to test whether these additional stages are necessary. Leveraging all tokens from a frozen pretrained tactile encoder, the expert learns from action supervision and multi-horizon prediction of future tactile latents. This single-stage training uses only task demonstrations, without additional tactile policy pretraining or separate alignment. With 50 demonstrations per task, SimpleTouch achieves the highest success rate among evaluated methods on all six UniVTAC tasks. Its average success rate reaches 77.5%, compared with 45.2% for FTP-$π_{0.5}$ and 66.7% for FTP-1, corresponding to gains of 32.3 and 10.8 percentage points, respectively. Across four real-world tasks, it averages 71.3%, exceeding FTP-1 by 8.8 percentage points. These results demonstrate that, given pretrained VLA and tactile representations, additional tactile policy pretraining is not a prerequisite for strong performance on these tasks, offering a simpler route to contact-rich manipulation. Project page: https://simpletouch-robot.github.io/

AI.tldr: SimpleTouch 通过在 π₀.₅ 的 VLA 模型上增加一个触觉专家模块，单阶段利用任务演示进行训练，无需大规模触觉策略预训练或独立的视触觉对齐，即在 6 个 UniVTAC 任务与 4 个真实任务上超过 FTP 基线，表明触觉策略预训练并非强性能的必要前提。
AI.motivation: 触觉感知对机器人操作至关重要，但将其融入预训练 VLA 模型存在跨模态鸿沟：仅在任务微调阶段引入触觉往往收益有限甚至降低成功率。因此现有方法普遍依赖大规模触觉策略预训练或独立的视触觉对齐，带来额外数据与训练阶段开销。本文旨在验证这些额外阶段是否必要。
AI.method: 提出 SimpleTouch：在 π₀.₅ 上扩展一个触觉专家（tactile expert）。使用冻结的预训练触觉编码器的全部 token，专家通过动作监督与未来触觉潜变量的多时域预测进行学习。训练为单阶段，仅使用任务演示，无需额外触觉策略预训练或独立对齐。
AI.result: 每个任务 50 条演示下，SimpleTouch 在 6 个 UniVTAC 任务上均取得最高成功率，平均 77.5%，高于 FTP-π₀.₅ 的 45.2% 与 FTP-1 的 66.7%，分别提升 32.3 与 10.8 个百分点。在 4 个真实任务上平均 71.3%，超过 FTP-1 8.8 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 在已有预训练 VLA 与触觉表征的前提下，额外的触觉策略预训练并非取得强性能的必要前提，SimpleTouch 为接触丰富的操作提供了一条更简洁的路径。

title: CHASE-VLA: Post-Training Quantization Framework for Vision-Language-Action Models with Chunk-Aware Scale Estimation
comment: Accepted at ACCV 2026. 22 pages, including references and supplementary material
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models map visual observations and language instructions to continuous robot actions, but a diffusion-based action expert (AE) poses a key challenge for low-bit post-training quantization (PTQ). The AE is repeatedly invoked across denoising steps and policy queries, where fixed calibration scales can be mismatched with activation ranges that vary with denoising progress and intended motion. We propose CHASE-VLA, a chunk-aware PTQ method that exploits a VLA-specific signal readily available from the policy: the generated action chunk, including its unexecuted future suffix. Rather than relying only on static scale matching for AE layers, CHASE-VLA combines the previously generated chunk as causal action context with denoising step group information to adapt AE activation scales. This enables W4A4 quantization of both MLP and attention projections in the repeated AE without modifying the pretrained policy. On LIBERO, CHASE-VLA achieves 97.3% average success rate on $π_{0.5}$ when both MLP and attention projections in the AE are quantized to W4A4, restoring FP16-level performance. CHASE-VLA also reduces the weight storage of the quantized AE linear layers by 73.4% and their single-chunk memory traffic by 70.9% and 71.2% on $π_{0.5}$ and GR00T N1.6, respectively, with a predictor overhead of at most 1.26% of the saved storage.

AI.tldr: CHASE-VLA：面向VLA扩散动作专家（AE）的分块感知PTQ方法，利用生成的动作块及其未执行后缀作为因果上下文，结合去噪步分组信息自适应调整AE激活尺度，实现W4A4量化并恢复FP16性能。
AI.motivation: VLA模型将视觉观测与语言指令映射为连续机器人动作，其中基于扩散的AE是低比特PTQ的关键难点。AE在去噪步与策略查询中被反复调用，固定校准尺度与随去噪进度及预期运动变化的激活范围不匹配，导致量化误差。
AI.method: 提出CHASE-VLA分块感知PTQ方法，挖掘VLA特有信号，即生成的动作块（含未执行的未来后缀）。不依赖AE层的静态尺度匹配，而是将先前生成的动作块作为因果动作上下文，与去噪步分组信息结合，自适应调整AE的激活尺度，在修改预训练策略的前提下对AE的MLP与注意力投影实现W4A4量化。
AI.result: 在LIBERO上，对π0.5的AE中MLP与注意力投影均量化为W4A4时，CHASE-VLA取得97.3%平均成功率，恢复FP16级性能；量化后AE线性层权重存储减少73.4%，单块内存流量在π0.5和GR00T N1.6上分别减少70.9%与71.2%，预测器开销至多为节省存储的1.26%。
AI.conclusion: CHASE-VLA利用动作块因果上下文与去噪步分组实现AE激活尺度自适应，突破了扩散动作专家的低比特量化瓶颈，在不改动预训练策略下达到W4A4并保持精度，同时显著降低存储与内存流量。

title: Hypothesis-guided discovery of cognitive algorithms via program refinement
summary: Developing cognitive models of algorithmic reasoning from behavioral data is a central problem in cognitive science that challenges current methods. Traditional approaches to cognitive modeling are interpretable and benefit from human expertise, but lack flexibility and scalability. Emerging techniques using large language models (LLMs) for de novo generation of cognitive models are scalable and flexible, but lack a role for human expertise and have mostly been applied to simpler tasks than algorithm recovery. We propose a hybrid system that treats discovery of cognitive algorithms as a program refinement problem. Human-created cognitive models are expressed as probabilistic programs and provided to a system of LLM agents with a mandate to: identify mismatches between model and behavior; propose code-level modifications within researcher-specified constraints; and verify structural fidelity. Revisions propagate to a probabilistic inference module that performs inference for latent variables and data likelihood computations. We evaluate the pipeline on human behavior in a problem-solving paradigm that exposes a variety of cognitive algorithms. Revised models consistently improve model fit relative to ancestral models and reveal a small set of recurring innovations that capture meaningful behavioral variability in this task.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出一个混合认知建模系统，将认知算法发现视为程序精化问题：由研究者提供概率程序形式的认知模型，LLM智能体在约束内识别模型与行为的错配、提出代码级修改，并验证结构保真度，修改结果传递至概率推断模块完成隐变量与似然的计算。在问题解决范式的人类行为数据上，修订模型拟合优度持续优于原始模型，并揭示出少量反复出现的、能刻画任务中行为变异的重要创新。
AI.motivation: 认知科学的核心难题之一是从行为数据出发构建算法推理的认知模型，而现有方法各有局限：传统认知建模方法可解释且依赖人类专业知识，但缺乏灵活性与可扩展性；基于大语言模型（LLM）的从头生成认知模型方法虽具可扩展性与灵活性，但未纳入人类专家知识，且多应用于比"算法还原"更简单的任务。因此需要一个兼取二者优势的框架。
AI.method: 提出一种混合系统，将认知算法发现形式化为程序精化（program refinement）问题。人类创建的认知模型以概率程序（probabilistic programs）形式表达并输入给LLM智能体系统，其任务为三项：识别模型与行为之间的错配；在研究者指定的约束内提出代码级修改；验证结构保真度（structural fidelity）。模型修订结果传播至概率推断模块，用于执行隐变量推断与数据似然的计算。
AI.result: 在能够激发多种认知算法的问题解决（problem-solving）范式的人类行为数据上评估该流程。修订后的模型相对于其祖先模型（ancestral models）持续提升模型拟合度，并揭示出一小组反复出现的创新（recurring innovations），这些创新捕捉了该任务中具有意义的行为变异性。
AI.conclusion: 将认知算法发现建模为程序精化，并把LLM智能体的人机协作式代码修订与概率推断模块相结合，可在保留研究者专家约束与可解释性的同时获得可扩展性与灵活性，从而有效提升认知模型的行为拟合，并提炼出可泛化的建模创新。

title: From Behavior to Provenance: Attributing Tabular Foundation Models to Synthetic Pretraining Data
summary: Training-data attribution aims to identify which training examples shape model behavior, yet validating such claims is difficult because causal training influence is rarely observable. We argue that controlled synthetic pretraining makes attribution experimentally testable. Using O'PRIOR, a provenance-rich synthetic task generator for tabular foundation models, we construct a testbed in which every pretraining task carries explicit lineage over structural mechanisms, missingness, confounding, shortcuts, and distribution shift. We combine behavior-conditioned attribution with counterfactual retraining and provenance-aware interventions to test both task-level faithfulness and mechanism-level consistency. On held-out real tasks, removing the top-attributed 5% of synthetic tasks decreases mean ROC-AUC by 0.013, compared with 0.002$\pm$0.004 under random removal, while removing bottom-attributed tasks improves performance by 0.003. Within shortcut-provenance tasks, targeted removal yields an effect of 0.043 versus 0.016 for matched random removal. Provenance discrimination is more modest by ranking AUROC (0.55-0.62), despite substantial top-k enrichment, revealing that provenance association and interventional faithfulness need not coincide. Our results establish synthetic provenance as a controlled setting for verifiable contributive attribution

AI.tldr: 该论文提出利用可控合成预训练构建可实验验证的训练数据归因测试平台O'PRIOR，结合行为条件归因、反事实重训与溯源干预，验证归因的任务级忠实性与机制级一致性。
AI.motivation: 训练数据归因旨在识别哪些训练样本塑造了模型行为，但因果训练影响通常不可观测，导致归因声明难以验证。作者主张通过可控合成预训练使归因变得可实验检验。
AI.method: 构建O'PRIOR——面向表格基础模型的溯源丰富合成任务生成器，每个预训练任务对结构机制、缺失性、混杂、捷径与分布偏移带有显式血缘；采用行为条件归因、反事实重训和溯源感知干预，同时检验任务级忠实性与机制级一致性。
AI.result: 在留出真实任务上，移除归因排名前5%的合成任务使平均ROC-AUC下降0.013，而随机移除为0.002±0.004；移除末位归因任务则提升性能0.003。在捷径溯源任务中，定向移除效应为0.043，匹配随机移除为0.016。溯源判别按AUROC排序较温和(0.55-0.62)，但top-k富集显著，说明溯源关联与干预忠实性并不必然一致。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明合成溯源可作为可验证贡献性归因的可控实验环境，并揭示溯源关联与干预忠实性可能相互分离。

title: Skill2Real: Agentic Skill Learning for Zero-Shot Sim-to-Real Robot Manipulation
summary: Transferring robotic skills from simulation to reality requires task knowledge that remains usable across differences in perception, dynamics, and embodiment. We introduce Skill2Real, an agentic policy framework that learns executable skills through a shared application programming interface (API). A Proposer-Verifier-Governor (PVG) loop uses privileged simulation evidence to diagnose outcomes and validate updates, while keeping learned skills grounded in public observations and API semantics. The Cerebellum first acquires local manipulation skills; the Brain then learns task-level composition with the Cerebellum frozen. Both memories transfer to the real robot without task-policy fine-tuning or skill-memory updates. As GPT-5.6 Sol learns skills on LIBERO-90, evaluating each frozen checkpoint with GPT-6 Astra raises LIBERO-Pro Long success from 2.0% to 56.3%, without training on Pro Long. Independent Robosuite training reaches 85.1% and 89.4% mean success with Sol and Opus 5 across seven tasks, respectively. Frozen Sol-trained LIBERO-90 skills achieve 78.75% mean completion across four real-world manipulation tasks with Astra. Removing the Verifier or Governor during LIBERO-90 training lowers final Pro Long success by 17.3 and 13.3 percentage points, respectively. These results support learning and transferring a hierarchy of executable skills through a common robot interface.

AI.tldr: Skill2Real 提出一种通过共享 API 学习可执行技能的智能体策略框架，利用 PVG 循环与分级（Cerebellum→Brain）技能记忆实现仿真到真实机器人的无微调迁移。
AI.motivation: 仿真到现实（sim-to-real）迁移要求任务知识能够跨越感知、动力学与本体差异仍然可用；现有方法往往依赖任务级策略微调或技能记忆更新，迁移代价高、泛化性受限。
AI.method: 构建 Skill2Real 智能体策略框架：以共享 API 定义可执行技能；采用 Proposer-Verifier-Governor（PVG）循环，用仿真中的特权证据诊断结果并验证更新，同时将技能约束在公开观测与 API 语义上。分两层学习：Cerebellum 先获取局部操作技能，随后冻结 Cerebellum 由 Brain 学习任务级组合。两类记忆迁移到真机时不进行任务策略微调或技能记忆更新。
AI.result: 在 LIBERO-90 上学习技能时，使用冻结检查点并由 Astra 评估，将 LIBERO-Pro Long 成功率从 2.0% 提升至 56.3%（未在 Pro Long 上训练）；Robosuite 七个任务上 Sol 与 Opus 5 分别达到 85.1% 与 89.4% 平均成功率；Sol 训练的 LIBERO-90 冻结技能在四个真实操作任务上，配合 Astra 达到 78.75% 平均完成率。训练中移除 Verifier 或 Governor 分别使最终 Pro Long 成功率下降 17.3 与 13.3 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，通过统一机器人接口学习并迁移分层可执行技能是可行的；PVG 的验证与治理组件对技能学习质量有显著贡献，且分层技能记忆可在无任务级微调下实现仿真到真机迁移。

title: Revisiting Visual Representation Enhancement of VLMs via Kernel Canonical Correlation Analysis
summary: Vision-language models such as CLIP exhibit strong semantic generalization, but remain limited in fine-grained visual perception. A recent work named KUEA presents a natural remedy by finetuning the image encoder under the supervision of the vision-centric DINOv2 to align their kernel matrices element-wisely, while regularizing the embeddings to remain close to the pretrained visual encoder for preserving image-text semantics in CLIP. However, we show that diminishing the role of the alignment loss to DINOv2 does not necessarily degrade its fine-grained visual performance, suggesting that the kernel-matrix discrepancy may be insufficient for further visual representation enhancement, motivating us to revisit the alignment formulation. In this work, we present a novel perspective to characterize representation alignment on feature subspaces through Kernel Canonical Correlation Analysis (KCCA), which maximizes the projection correlations. In optimization, we derive an efficient end-to-end training scheme upon KKT conditions, avoiding the eigenvalue problem in KCCA. Further, we extend our method into a 3-view formulation, i.e., 3vKCCA, in which the projections from the pretrained text encoder are also incorporated under a unified optimization framework for joint alignment. With CLIP ViT-L/14 on ImageNet-1K, our 3vKCCA improves the MMVP-VLM accuracy from 17.8 to 25.9, substantially outperforming the existing methods, and meanwhile maintains zero-shot image--text retrieval performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于核典型相关分析(KCCA)的表示对齐方法，并从两视图扩展到三视图(3vKCCA)，在保持零样本图文检索性能的同时显著提升CLIP的细粒度视觉感知能力。
AI.motivation: CLIP等视觉-语言模型语义泛化强但细粒度视觉感知弱。已有工作KUEA通过以DINOv2监督微调图像编码器、逐元素对齐核矩阵来改善该问题，但作者发现削弱对DINOv2的对齐损失未必损害细粒度视觉性能，说明核矩阵差异不足以刻画进一步的视觉表示增强，因此需要重新审视对齐的建模方式。
AI.method: 从特征子空间角度重新刻画表示对齐，采用核典型相关分析(KCCA)最大化投影相关性；在优化上基于KKT条件推导出高效的端到端训练方案，规避KCCA中的特征值问题；进一步扩展为三视图形式3vKCCA，将预训练文本编码器的投影也纳入统一优化框架进行联合对齐。
AI.result: 在ImageNet-1K上使用CLIP ViT-L/14，3vKCCA将MMVP-VLM准确率从17.8提升至25.9，显著优于现有方法，同时保持零样本图文检索性能。
AI.conclusion: 以子空间投影相关性的视角进行表示对齐比核矩阵逐元素对齐更有效；3vKCCA在提升细粒度视觉感知的同时不损失语义对齐能力，为视觉-语言模型的视觉表示增强提供了新的对齐范式。

title: Learning What to Investigate Next: Meta-Reasoning for Long-Horizon Research Agents
summary: Long-horizon research agents must decide both how to investigate and what to investigate next as evidence accumulates. This is hard to learn because such decisions are sparse in long execution traces, and their consequences may emerge several investigations later. We introduce Meta-reasoning for Iterative Research Agents (MIRA), a hierarchical architecture separating research allocation from execution. An outer-loop meta-reasoner curates context from a persistent research record, then writes a work order for the next investigation or ends the episode. A fresh inner-loop executor carries out each work order, making execution part of the transition between meta-reasoning actions. Without policy training, MIRA improves long-horizon inference and allocates additional compute more effectively in theorem proving and open-ended neural-architecture research. Its decision boundaries also provide natural units for credit assignment. At each boundary, we train a generative critic to forecast expected remaining return from partial states, outperforming token-level alternatives. Cross-environment pretraining improves forecasting and adaptation, yielding a transferable prior for valuing partial progress. We use this prior to initialize MIRA-AC, a generative actor-critic jointly trained to forecast remaining return and choose the next investigation, without a separate critic model. MIRA-AC concentrates policy optimization on meta-reasoning decisions, enabling efficient long-horizon reinforcement learning without directly optimizing the longer execution traces they initiate. Training MIRA-AC on the model's own proxy hill-climbing signals improves gold performance across four autoresearch environments; the actor transfers with cross-environment value initialization. Together, these results show that meta-reasoning can be learned as an explicit policy for directing long-horizon autonomous research.

AI.tldr: 提出MIRA分层架构，将研究分配与执行分离，通过生成式评论家与actor-critic实现长时程自主研究的元推理策略学习。
AI.motivation: 长时程研究智能体需在证据累积过程中决定"如何研究"与"研究什么"，但此类决策在长执行轨迹中稀疏，且后果往往在多次调查后才显现，导致难以学习。
AI.method: MIRA采用分层结构：外循环元推理器从持久研究记录中整理上下文，并撰写工作指令以启动下一次调查或结束回合；内循环执行器执行每条指令，使执行成为元推理动作间的转移。基于决策边界做信用分配，训练生成式评论家从部分状态预测期望剩余回报（优于token级基线）。跨环境预训练提升预测与适应，形成可迁移的部分进展估值先验；以此初始化MIRA-AC，一种生成式actor-critic，联合预测剩余回报并选择下一调查，无需独立critic模型，将策略优化集中于元推理决策。
AI.result: 无需策略训练即可提升长时程推理并更有效分配额外计算（定理证明与开放式神经网络架构研究）；生成式评论家优于token级替代方案；跨环境预训练改善预测与适应；在四个自动研究环境中基于模型自身的代理爬山信号训练MIRA-AC，提升gold表现，actor可跨环境迁移。
AI.conclusion: 元推理可作为显式策略被学习，用于指导长时程自主研究；分层分离与生成式评论家为长时程强化学习提供了高效路径与可迁移的估值先验。

title: Does Every User Need a Private LoRA? Decoupling Personalization from Per-User Adaptation
comment: 10 pages main content, 36 pages total including appendix, 7 figures
summary: Personalized large language models often require a complete adaptation state for each user. However, this paradigm scales poorly as the user population grows. We revisit this design through the lens of personalization capacity allocation: how much adaptation capacity can be shared across users, how the shared capacity should be composed, and how much must remain user-specific. We answer them through three complementary empirical analyses. We find that independent user adapters contain substantial cross-user reusable structure, that the utility of reusable directions reflects both user relevance and variation across queries, and that user histories provide transferable signals for compact individual correction. Motivated by these findings, we propose LINEUP. It learns a bank of reusable low-rank personalization factors, composes them through user-conditioned recall and query-dependent calibration, and restricts target-user adaptation to a tiny user code over a shared correction space. This design decouples expressive personalization capacity from per-user trainable state. Each target user optimizes only eight scalars, while all shared components remain fixed. By comparison, the evaluated private-LoRA configuration uses 4.19 million per-user parameters. Our theoretical analysis gives a finite-step, finite-history risk bound and sufficient conditions for user-code refinement to improve on history initialization. Across six tasks spanning personalized classification, prediction, and generation, LINEUP leads on all 12 metrics, each averaged over three independent runs (e.g., reducing LaMP-3 RMSE by 11.4% relative to the strongest baseline). It maintains advantages under limited history. These results show that rich personalization can be supported primarily by reusable, conditionally composed shared capacity, while independent user adaptation remains confined to a tiny correction state.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出LINEUP，通过"个性化容量分配"视角将个性化大模型解耦为可复用的共享低秩因子库与极小的用户专属修正码，目标用户仅需优化8个标量即可实现丰富个性化，在六项任务12个指标上全面领先。
AI.motivation: 现有个性化大模型通常为每个用户维护完整的适配状态（如private-LoRA需419万参数/用户），随用户规模增长扩展性差。作者由此重新审视设计：多少适配容量可跨用户共享、共享容量应如何组合、多少必须保留为用户专属。
AI.method: 通过三项互补的实证分析发现：独立用户适配器含大量跨用户可复用结构；可复用方向的有效性同时取决于用户相关性与查询间变化；用户历史提供可迁移信号用于紧凑个体修正。据此提出LINEUP：学习可复用低秩个性化因子库，经用户条件召回与查询相关校准进行组合，并将目标用户适配限制为共享修正空间上的极小用户码。
AI.result: 理论分析给出有限步、有限历史的风险界及用户码精化优于历史初始化的充分条件。在覆盖个性化分类、预测、生成的六项任务上，LINEUP在全部12个指标（各3次独立运行平均）均领先，如LaMP-3 RMSE相对最强基线降低11.4%，且在历史有限时仍保持优势。
AI.conclusion: 丰富的个性化能力主要可由可复用、条件组合的共享容量支撑，而独立用户适配可被压缩至极小的修正状态（每用户仅8个标量），从而将表达能力与每用户可训练状态解耦，显著提升个性化大模型的可扩展性。

title: ManiPhysicsBench: Physics-Based Assessment of Object Preservation in VLA Manipulation
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models aim to perform diverse manipulation tasks, but task success in existing rigid-body benchmarks does not indicate whether they preserve objects. We introduce ManiPhysicsZoo, which consolidates literature-supported material properties, 3D meshes, and supporting references into reusable object assets. Using these assets, a solver-based assessment computes grasp-specific damage thresholds from object geometry, material properties, and recorded grasp conditions and compares them with recorded contact forces to assess potential deformation and fracture. Building on these components, ManiPhysicsBench evaluates object preservation in LIBERO and SimplerEnv across three physics axes and three difficulty levels. Public VLA checkpoints show a substantial gap between task success and safe success, defined as task completion while preserving the object. Their gripper commands concentrate near full opening and closure, with largely similar aggregate distributions across objects, consistent with binary gripper supervision. We examine how object-specific continuous gripper labels change model behavior by retraining a VLA model. The retrained model shows more object-dependent gripping and higher safe success, but lower task success and limited generalization of object-preserving behavior.

AI.tldr: 提出ManiPhysicsZoo资产库与ManiPhysicsBench基准，评估VLA模型在操作任务中对物体的保全能力，发现任务成功率与"安全成功率"存在显著差距。
AI.motivation: 现有刚体操作基准仅衡量任务是否完成，无法反映VLA模型是否物理上保全物体（避免变形或断裂），任务成功不等于物体得以保全。
AI.method: 整合文献支持的材质属性、3D网格与相关文献构建可复用物体资产库ManiPhysicsZoo；基于求解器，从物体几何、材质属性与记录的抓取条件计算抓取特定的损伤阈值，并与记录的接触力比较以评估潜在变形与断裂；据此在LIBERO与SimplerEnv上沿三个物理轴、三个难度等级构建ManiPhysicsBench评估物体保全；并通过对物体特定连续夹爪标签重训练VLA模型，检验其对模型行为的影响。
AI.result: 公开VLA检查点在任务成功与"安全成功"（完成任务且保全物体）之间存在显著差距；其夹爪指令集中在接近完全张开与闭合处，不同物体间聚合分布大体相似，与二元夹爪监督一致；重训练模型表现出更强的物体依赖抓取与更高的安全成功率，但任务成功率下降，且物体保全行为的泛化有限。
AI.conclusion: 仅凭刚体任务成功率不足以衡量VLA模型的物体保全能力；需要引入物理感知的评估与物体特定的连续夹爪监督，但这在提升安全性的同时会牺牲任务成功率与泛化能力。

title: SymRegFlow: Symmetry-Regularized Flow Matching for Video World Models
summary: Flow-matching-based multi-view world models generate realistic videos, but are commonly restricted to fixed camera rigs. Extending them to continuously varying camera poses requires paired pose--video observations with dense pose coverage, which are costly to acquire. We introduce \emph{SymRegFlow}, a symmetry-regularized flow-matching framework for multi-view-consistent video generation across continuous viewpoints without ground-truth novel-view RGB supervision. For each target pose, SymRegFlow geometrically warps source views into noisy anchors and combines masked dual-anchor supervision with cross-anchor denoising-output consistency to mitigate anchor-specific errors. Under an affine Gaussian surrogate, we prove that suitable consistency regularization recovers the clean-reference optimum at fixed noise levels, strictly outperforming single- and merged-anchor baselines. Experiments on Cosmos-Drive-Dreams and nuScenes demonstrate high-quality, multi-view-consistent autonomous-driving video generation: on nuScenes, SymRegFlow achieves the lowest FVD and FVMD among the evaluated baselines, reducing FVD by over 31\% relative to the best baseline, and source-conditioned inference also attains the best FID and instance preservation.

AI.tldr: 提出SymRegFlow，一种对称正则化的流匹配框架，在无新视角RGB真值监督下实现连续视角的多视图一致视频生成。
AI.motivation: 现有基于流匹配的多视图世界模型通常局限于固定相机架设；扩展至连续变化的相机位姿需要密集位姿覆盖的成对位姿-视频观测，采集成本高昂。
AI.method: 对每个目标位姿，将源视图几何扭曲为含噪锚点，结合掩码双锚点监督与跨锚点去噪输出一致性以缓解锚点特化误差；在仿射高斯代理下证明恰当的一致性正则可恢复干净参考最优解，严格优于单锚点与合并锚点基线。
AI.result: 在Cosmos-Drive-Dreams与nuScenes上实现高质量、多视图一致的自动驾驶视频生成；nuScenes上FVD与FVMD均为最优，FVD较最佳基线降低超31%，源条件推理取得最佳FID与实例保持。
AI.conclusion: SymRegFlow通过对称正则化突破了固定相机架设限制，无需新视角RGB监督即可实现连续视角、多视图一致的视频生成，并在自动驾驶数据集上取得领先性能。

title: How To Train Your World Model: Fine-tuning vs RAG for LM-based World Modeling
summary: World models (WMs) simulate the transition dynamics of environments, enabling agents to plan over the consequences of their actions. In text-based environments, fine-tuning a Language Model (LM) to serve as a WM has emerged as a dominant paradigm. However, despite the widespread success of non-parametric approaches such as Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG), retrieval for LM-based world modelling remains underexplored. We conduct a systematic evaluation across five diverse environments spanning embodied, web navigation and social settings, comparing fine-tuning and RAG-based approaches for LM-based world modelling. Our study reveals that fine-tuning often outperforms RAG, with fine-tuned WMs enabling agents to obtain higher rewards on 15/20 settings. While both construction paradigms benefit from additional and more diverse exploration, RAG-based approaches prove more data-efficient, and fine-tuning approaches disproportionately benefit from scaling the amount of experience collected. With a focus on RAG-based WMs, we devise a procedure that uses counterfactual intervention to estimate the error rate of the retrieval stage, and show that retrievers consistently surface suboptimal transitions from the experience buffer. Hoping to address this failing, we study a variety of query reformulation strategies, demonstrating that a hierarchical approach outperforms the traditional retrieval pipeline. Finally, we compose our findings into a hybrid world modelling system that parametrically captures core environment dynamics, while learning to rely on retrieval from an actively maintained memory store. Our hybrid system consistently outperforms other methods across multiple environments and models, showcasing the robustness of the approach and the applicability of our findings.

AI.tldr: 本文系统比较了基于微调与基于RAG的语言模型世界模型构建范式，提出反事实干预估计检索错误率、层级式查询重构及混合世界模型系统。混合方法在多个环境与模型中稳定优于其他方法。
AI.motivation: 文本环境中的世界模型多以微调LM为主流范式，尽管RAG等非参数方法广泛应用，但检索式世界建模仍缺乏系统研究，微调与RAG两类范式的优劣、数据效率与扩展性差异尚不明确。
AI.method: 在具身、网页导航与社会环境等五个环境中系统评测微调与RAG方法；设计基于反事实干预的流程估计检索阶段错误率；比较多种查询重构策略（含层级式方法）；构建混合世界模型，用参数化方式捕捉核心环境动态，同时从主动维护的记忆库中检索。
AI.result: 微调通常优于RAG，在15/20设置中使智能体获得更高回报；二者均受益于更多样化的探索，但RAG数据效率更高，微调更受益于经验规模扩展；检索器常从经验缓冲区召回次优转移；层级式查询重构优于传统检索流程；混合系统在多个环境和模型中持续优于其他方法。
AI.conclusion: 检索式世界模型存在检索次优转移的缺陷，可通过查询重构与混合建模范式缓解；混合世界模型兼具参数化动态建模与检索记忆优势，具有稳健性与可推广性。

title: Why Does Adaptive Batching Help LLM Pretraining? A Perspective from Unbounded Variance
summary: Increasing the batch size during training is a common practice in large language model (LLM) pretraining, yet the theoretical justification behind its success is not well understood. Analyses of stochastic optimization often assume uniformly bounded stochastic gradient variance, yet recent evidence suggests that this assumption fails in many practical nonconvex problems. The Blum--Gladyshev (BG-$0$) noise model relaxes this assumption by allowing the variance to grow quadratically with the distance from initialization, suggesting that batch size schedulers can help by controlling the variance growth during training. However, this growth can be overly conservative in practice. We empirically investigate variance growth in LLM pretraining and observe that a generalized BG model with a tunable growth exponent provides a tighter description of practical noise behavior. Motivated by this observation, we introduce the generalized BG-$a$ noise model, which interpolates between bounded variance ($a=0$) and BG-$0$ noise ($a=2$). Under $L$-smoothness, we derive an information-theoretic lower bound with growth-dependent oracle complexity $Ω(ε^{-(4+a)})$ and establish a matching upper bound in $ε$-dependence by increasing the batch size as the iterates move away from initialization. Finally, we propose an adaptive batch scheduler that controls variance growth through dynamic batch size adjustments during training. In pretraining OLMo2 models of up to 1B parameters on C4, our scheduler achieves a lower validation loss than both small and large batch training under matched token budgets, while using less than 10\% of the iterations of small batch training.

AI.tldr: 本文研究大模型预训练中批量大小调度的理论依据，提出广义BG-$a$噪声模型（在有限方差$a=0$与BG-$0$噪声$a=2$之间插值），给出增长相关的最优oracle复杂度下界$Ω(ε^{-(4+a)})$并构造匹配上界，进而提出自适应批量调度器，在OLMo2（至1B参数）C4预训练中取得更低验证损失且迭代次数不足小批量训练的10%。
AI.motivation: 增大批量是LLM预训练的常见做法，但其理论依据不清晰。随机优化分析通常假设随机梯度方差一致有界，然而在非凸实际问题中该假设常不成立。BG-$0$噪声模型允许方差随距初值距离二次增长，从而为批量调度提供理论支持，但这种增长在实际中过于保守；作者通过实证发现带可调增长指数的广义BG模型能更紧致地刻画实际噪声行为。
AI.method: (1) 对LLM预训练中的方差增长进行实证分析，发现广义BG模型（带可调增长指数）拟合更优；(2) 提出广义BG-$a$噪声模型，在$a=0$（有界方差）与$a=2$（BG-$0$）之间插值；(3) 在$L$-光滑条件下推导信息论下界，growth-dependent oracle复杂度为$Ω(ε^{-(4+a)})$，并通过对随迭代远离初值而增大的批量大小构造在$ε$依赖上匹配的上界；(4) 提出自适应批量调度器，通过训练中动态调整批量大小控制方差增长。
AI.result: 在C4上预训练至多1B参数的OLMo2模型，在相同token预算下，所提调度器的验证损失低于小批量和大小批量训练，同时迭代次数不到小批量训练的10%。理论层面得到了复杂度下界与匹配上界，验证了增长依赖复杂度$Θ(ε^{-(4+a)})$。
AI.conclusion: 实际LLM预训练的噪声行为位于有界方差与BG-$0$之间，可由广义BG-$a$模型更紧致描述；增长依赖的信息论复杂度刻画了批量调度的必要性，且自适应批量调度器在实践中同时优于固定小批量和固定大批量训练，兼具计算效率与泛化性能。

title: LOCUS: Landmark-Oriented Container Discrimination Using Spatial Graphs
summary: As robots are increasingly deployed in unstructured, real-world environments, the ability to reason about complex spatial and semantic relationships among objects remains a fundamental challenge in enabling robust and generalizable manipulation and navigation. For example, deciding where to search for an object that is not in plain sight depends on where it is physically plausible as well as semantically likely. Popular methods such as cosine similarity with CLIP struggle to disambiguate between spatially and semantically similar objects that could contain a target object. We propose Landmark-Oriented Container Discrimination Using Spatial Graphs (LOCUS). To jointly reason about spatial information and semantics, we train a GNN to update CLIP embeddings on a full environment scene graph by passing embedding information between nodes based on proximity. CLIP embeddings, augmented by semantic knowledge from a fusion of household ontologies provide a robust semantic signal. We evaluate in simulation on a noiseless scene graph from simulator metadata, making the approach detection-agnostic. Our approach outperforms random, CLIP, Tidybot, and an LLM planner in the majority of room classes and configurations in simulation. To show our approach is robust to scene graph node placement and label noise, we demonstrate a physical mobile manipulator running in an exploration pipeline start-to-finish including scene graph labels from Detic.

AI.tldr: 提出LOCUS方法，用图神经网络在场景图上传递嵌入信息，联合推理空间与语义关系，提升机器人寻找隐藏物品的方位推断能力，在仿真中超越CLIP、Tidybot和LLM规划器。
AI.motivation: 机器人在非结构化真实环境中作业时，需要推理物体间复杂的空间与语义关系。当目标物体不在视野内时，判断"去哪里找"既取决于物理合理性（空间），也取决于语义可能性。现有方法如CLIP余弦相似度难以区分在空间和语义上相近的候选容器。同时，标签噪声与场景图节点定位误差也会影响下游任务鲁棒性。
AI.method: LOCUS（Landmark-Oriented Container Discrimination Using Spatial Graphs）：1) 构建完整环境场景图；2) 训练GNN，依据节点邻近关系在节点间传递嵌入信息，从而更新CLIP嵌入，实现空间与语义联合推理；3) 将CLIP嵌入与家庭本体（household ontologies）融合得到的语义知识相结合，提供鲁棒的语义信号。评测使用仿真器元数据生成的无噪声场景图，使方法不依赖检测器性能。此外，在真实移动操作机器人上，使用Detic生成的场景图标签运行完整探索流水线。
AI.result: 在仿真中，于多数房间类别和配置下，LOCUS优于随机基线、CLIP、Tidybot以及LLM规划器；在真实移动操作机器人的端到端探索流水线中，使用Detic提供的场景图标签，验证了方法对场景图节点位置偏差和标签噪声的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 通过GNN在场景图上传递嵌入并结合本体语义融合，可有效联合利用空间与语义信息，缓解CLIP在相似候选容器上的歧义，且方法对场景图噪声具有鲁棒性，适用于检测器无关的评测与真实机器人探索任务。

title: Correcting Guided Diffusion Trajectories with Spectral Alignment
summary: The practical success of conditional image generation hinges on fine-grained differences in condition alignment and visual fidelity. Classifier-free guidance (CFG) is central to this success, but its lack of an explicit criterion makes it difficult to assess whether the guided trajectory is progressing as intended. To address this gap, we show that spectral alignment provides a principled criterion for understanding guidance behavior and improving guided diffusion sampling through adaptive correction. Our analysis identifies the spectra of intermediate states as an indicator of consistency with the expected spectral evolution of the forward process. Based on this observation, we introduce Spectral Correction Guidance, a method that corrects deviations from an analytic reference spectrum during sampling. The proposed method is training-free and applicable across diffusion backbones and conditional generation tasks without modifying the underlying model. Experiments demonstrate consistent gains in preference-based metrics over baseline guidance methods in text-to-image generation and improved generation quality over CFG on ImageNet. These improvements persist across a range of guidance scales and with fewer denoising steps. Our analyses and ablations provide insight into guidance behavior and how the proposed method affects generation quality.

AI.tldr: 论文提出谱对齐（spectral alignment）作为理解无分类器引导（CFG）行为的准则，并据此提出无需训练的谱校正引导（Spectral Correction Guidance），在文本到图像及 ImageNet 生成中取得稳定提升。
AI.motivation: CFG 是条件图像生成成功的关键，但缺乏显式判据，难以评估引导轨迹是否按预期进展，因此需要一个有原理支撑的准则来理解和改进引导采样。
AI.method: 通过分析中间状态的谱，将其作为与正向过程预期谱演化一致性的指标；据此提出 Spectral Correction Guidance，在采样过程中对偏离解析参考谱的偏差进行校正。该方法无需训练，可直接应用于不同扩散骨干与条件生成任务，不修改底层模型。
AI.result: 在文本到图像生成中，基于偏好的指标相较基线引导方法取得一致提升；在 ImageNet 上相较 CFG 生成质量更好。这些改进在多种引导尺度及更少去噪步数下依然保持。分析与消融实验揭示了引导行为及该方法对生成质量的影响。
AI.conclusion: 谱对齐为理解引导行为提供了原理性判据，所提无需训练的谱校正引导可跨骨干、跨任务提升生成质量，并对引导机制提供了新的洞察。

title: How to Have a Sensitive Debate: An Instance-Optimal Protocol for AI Debate
summary: As powerful AI systems reach and sometimes surpass the abilities of human experts across a range of cognitively demanding tasks, the problem of accurate oversight and supervision of these systems has become increasingly urgent. One promising approach is AI debate, which seeks to leverage a debate between two powerful AIs to break complex questions down into simpler claims that can be easily judged directly. Theoretical work on debate has formalized this intuition in the language of computational complexity theory, where the goal is to design protocols (i.e., rules of the debate game) that provide rigorous guarantees on correctness for judging solutions to complex problems with limited supervision. Specifically, the current best protocol has been shown to work for all problems that have sufficiently stable decompositions into subproblems. In this paper, we design a new protocol for this same class of problems that improves on the prior work in several ways. First, correctness holds in a worst-case rather than an average-case sense. Second, being honest and correct is a dominant-strategy equilibrium for both debaters, rather than a Stackelberg equilibrium. Finally, we prove black-box lower bounds, showing that our new protocol is instance-wise optimal. That is, no protocol for this class of problems can outperform ours while making only black-box queries to human judgments. We obtain these results by relating the notion of stable problem decompositions to the concept of fractional block sensitivity from query complexity.

AI.tldr: 本文针对AI辩论监督中具有稳定子问题分解的一类问题，提出了一种新的辩论协议，在保证强度（最坏情况正确性、占优策略均衡）和最优性（黑盒查询下实例级最优）方面全面改进先前工作。
AI.motivation: 随着强AI系统在多种高认知难度任务上达到甚至超越人类专家水平，如何对其进行准确监督与监管日益紧迫。AI辩论是一种有前景的方案，其理论基础以计算复杂性理论形式化，目标是在有限监督下设计辩论规则，为复杂问题求解提供严格正确性保证。已有最优协议仅对具有稳定分解的问题有效，但存在平均情况正确性、Stackelberg均衡较弱、缺乏最优性刻画等不足。
AI.method: 针对具有稳定子问题分解的同一类问题设计新辩论协议；将稳定问题分解的概念与查询复杂性中的分数块敏感度（fractional block sensitivity）建立联系；并通过黑盒下界证明进行最优性分析。
AI.result: 新协议在三方面改进先前工作：其一，正确性在最坏情况意义下成立而非平均情况；其二，诚实且正确构成两位辩论者的占优策略均衡，而非Stackelberg均衡；其三，证明了黑盒下界，表明该协议是实例级最优的——对于该类问题，任何仅对人工判断进行黑盒查询的协议都无法超越它。
AI.conclusion: 通过将稳定问题分解与分数块敏感度相关联，本文给出的新辩论协议在保证强度与最优性上均优于既有工作，为有限监督下的AI辩论监督提供了更强的理论保证与实例级最优刻画。

title: Lexicographic Multi-Objective On-Policy Distillation
summary: Reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR) usually optimizes answer correctness, yet useful language-model behavior also requires high-quality reasoning and concise responses. Existing multi-reward post-training methods typically scalarize rewards or combine specialists without explicitly protecting a reward priority order. This is problematic when trade-offs are asymmetric: conciseness, for example, should not improve at the cost of correctness. We introduce Lexicographic Multi-Objective On-Policy Distillation (LMOPD), a multi-teacher method for integrating reward-specialized policies under explicit priorities. For each student rollout, LMOPD selects the specialist for the first objective whose gate detects a deficiency, then locally projects its centered log-policy correction to remove components that oppose higher-priority specialists. We evaluate 30B-A3B mixture-of-experts transformer models in two- and four-expert settings on three math benchmarks, measuring retained specialist gains. With two experts, LMOPD's point estimates fully retain the accuracy and reasoning-quality gains while acquiring $46.9\%$ of the conciseness gain. With four experts, it retains $\approx90\%$ of both the accuracy gain and reasoning-correctness gain, compared to only $\approx57\%$ by the next best evaluated baseline. Matched four-expertablations show that lexicographic routing outperforms random routing and that projection further strengthens both top-priority capabilities. Across both scales, LMOPD preserves the highest-priority capabilities more effectively than the existing baselines we evaluate, demonstrating the value of explicit priorities for specialist integration.

AI.tldr: LMOPD 提出一种词典序多目标在线策略蒸馏方法，在多教师、多奖励场景下显式保护奖励优先级，使高优先级能力（如正确性）不被低优先级目标（如简洁性）牺牲。
AI.motivation: 现有 RLVR 多奖励后训练通常对奖励做标量化或直接组合专家策略，未显式保护奖励优先顺序；当权衡不对称时（如简洁性不应以牺牲正确性为代价）会出问题。
AI.method: LMOPD 是一种多教师方法：对每条学生 rollout，先按词典序选择第一个门控检测到不足的目标所对应的专家，再将其中心化 log-policy 修正做局部投影，剔除与更高优先级专家相冲突的分量。
AI.result: 在 30B-A3B MoE 模型上，两专家设置下点估计完全保留准确率与推理质量增益，并获取 46.9% 的简洁性增益；四专家设置下保留约 90% 准确率增益与推理正确性增益，而最佳基线仅约 57%。四专家消融显示词典序路由优于随机路由，投影进一步强化最高优先级能力。
AI.conclusion: 在两个规模上，LMOPD 比现有基线更有效地保护最高优先级能力，证明显式优先级对专家整合的价值。

title: SARI: Phase-Split Sim-Real Co-Training for Contact-Rich Manipulation
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models often require costly real-world demonstrations to adapt to contact-rich manipulation tasks, particularly when generalization across object placements is needed. We propose SARI (Simulated Approach, Real Interaction), a phase-split sim-and-real co-training framework built on a simple insight: spatial coverage and contact physics should be acquired from the domains best suited to them. Specifically, free-space approaches require spatial diversity but tolerate modest simulation gaps, making them ideal for synthetic generation; conversely, contact interactions demand accurate physics but vary little across object placements, allowing a few real demonstrations to generalize across the workspace. SARI generates diverse simulated approaches in a photorealistic digital twin while collecting real contact interactions at only a few placements. Post-trained on these phase-segmented demonstrations, a single policy seamlessly stitches simulated approaches with real contact interactions using visual appearance alignment and a shared camera-relative action representation--without explicit phase labels or hand-coded switches. Across five real-world contact-rich manipulation tasks, SARI reduces real-data collection time by 34.3% and achieves 27.5% success at unseen placements, where all full-task sim-real baselines fail completely (0%).

AI.tldr: SARI 提出"仿真接近+真实接触"的分阶段仿真-现实协同训练框架，用少量真实演示即可泛化到新放置位置，在5个接触丰富任务上减少34.3%数据采集时间，未见位置成功率27.5%（基线全为0%）。
AI.motivation: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型适配接触丰富操作任务时，依赖昂贵真实演示数据，尤其在跨物体放置位置泛化场景下数据成本极高。核心动机：空间覆盖与接触物理应分别从各自最适合的域获取。
AI.method: SARI（Simulated Approach, Real Interaction）将任务拆为两阶段：自由空间接近阶段在照片级数字孪生中合成生成（对空间多样性需求高、对仿真误差容忍度高）；接触交互阶段在少量真实位置采集（对物理精度需求高、跨放置变化小）。基于分阶段演示后训练单一策略，通过视觉外观对齐与共享的相机相对动作表示无缝拼接仿真接近与真实接触，无需显式阶段标签或人工切换逻辑。
AI.result: 在5个真实世界接触丰富操作任务上，真实数据采集时间减少34.3%；在未见放置位置达到27.5%成功率，而所有全任务仿真-现实基线完全失败（0%）。
AI.conclusion: 按域特性拆分阶段进行仿真-现实协同训练，可显著降低真实数据成本并提升跨放置泛化能力，验证了"空间覆盖取自仿真、接触物理取自现实"这一设计原则的有效性。

title: FiberGeoText: A Vision-Language Model for Population- Level Organization of Superficial White Matter
summary: The superficial white matter (SWM), a critical brain region for cognition across the lifespan and brain disease, contains abundant short-range association fibers whose organization remains incompletely characterized, in part because the short trajectories and highly variable cortical folding make correspondence across individuals challenging. Anatomically corresponding connections may vary in spatial location across individuals and therefore may not be adequately defined by geometric proximity alone. We introduce FiberGeoText (FGT), a vision-language model (VLM) for organizing short-range superficial white matter (SWM) streamlines reconstructed from ultra-high-resolution diffusion MRI into population-level clusters. FGT jointly represents three complementary properties of each streamline: its three-dimensional trajectory, its cortical anatomical context, and its shape. Cortical endpoint information from multiple parcellation schemes is expressed as text and encoded using a pretrained large language model (LLM), enabling heterogeneous anatomical descriptions to contribute to a common continuous representation. We evaluated FGT on acquired submillimeter 0.76 mm diffusion MRI data. Compared with state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods, FGT produced substantially greater cortical parcel coherence, within-cluster shape consistency, cluster-size consistency, and cross-subject correspondence. The trained model also generalizes well to unseen subjects with an average of 96.7% of the 5,000 learned clusters recovered, and high consistency of cluster structure between training and testing data. Together, these findings demonstrate that integrating geometric, anatomical, and shape information by learning multimodal deep embeddings with a VLM model enables robust learning of population-consistent SWM organization despite interindividual anatomical variability.

AI.tldr: 提出视觉语言模型FiberGeoText（FGT），联合编码短程浅表白质流线的三维轨迹、皮层解剖上下文与形状，实现跨个体的群体水平聚类。
AI.motivation: 浅表白质（SWM）富含短程联络纤维，但其组织规律尚未充分刻画。短轨迹与高度变异的皮层折叠导致个体间对应关系难以建立；解剖上对应的连接在空间位置上存在个体差异，仅靠几何邻近性无法充分定义，因此需要融合多模态信息来刻画跨个体一致的连接组织。
AI.method: 提出FiberGeoText（FGT）视觉语言模型，对超高分辨率扩散MRI重建的短程SWM流线进行群体聚类。模型联合表征每条流线的三种互补属性：三维轨迹、皮层解剖上下文与形状。将多个脑图谱分区方案得到的皮层端点信息转化为文本，用预训练大语言模型编码，使异质解剖描述映射到统一的连续表示。在0.76 mm亚毫米扩散MRI数据上评估。
AI.result: 与SOTA方法相比，FGT在皮层分区一致性、簇内形状一致性、簇大小一致性及跨被试对应性方面均有显著提升。模型对未见被试泛化良好，平均可恢复5000个学习簇中的96.7%，训练与测试数据间簇结构高度一致。
AI.conclusion: 通过VLM学习多模态深度嵌入，整合几何、解剖与形状信息，可在存在个体解剖变异的情况下稳健学习群体一致的浅表白质组织规律。

title: Mitigating Social Sycophancy via Pluralistic Preference Optimization
summary: Personal advice, including relationship advice, now ranks among the most common uses of generative AI. But language models (LMs) exhibit sycophancy: they affirm users much more often than humans do, which can make people overconfident and less willing to repair their relationships after a conflict. Prior work on mitigating sycophancy has focused on factual settings where a response can be checked against a ground truth answer, while mitigations for social sycophancy (e.g., personal advice, where there is no ground truth) have relied on simple prompting and post-training methods with limited effectiveness. Our insight is that social sycophancy occurs in part because LMs overly center on the user and fail to consider the perspectives of other stakeholders impacted by the user's behavior. To address this problem we propose Pluralistic Preference Optimization (PlurPO): given inputs describing interpersonal conflicts, the LM identifies and simulates the relevant stakeholders, and is then trained to prefer and generate responses acceptable to all stakeholders. PlurPO uses only signals the model produces about its own outputs, without ground-truth labels. PlurPO substantially reduces social sycophancy across four datasets and four model families compared to prior methods. For example, on statements of intent to cause harm, where the users' actions should not be endorsed, PlurPO reduces the endorsement rate by 89% on average across four models. On general advice questions, where the target is to match the endorsement rate of human responses, it closes the gap by more than half, from 17.8% to 8.0% on average. The preference dataset constructed by PlurPO for an 8B model also effectively transfers to mitigating sycophancy in a larger (32B) model. Our results indicate that social sycophancy can be reduced by leveraging a model's own capabilities to simulate a plurality of relevant perspectives.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PlurPO（多元偏好优化），通过让语言模型识别并模拟人际冲突中涉及的多方利益相关者视角，无需真实标签即可训练模型偏好让所有相关方都能接受的回复，从而减轻社交谄媚。
AI.motivation: 语言模型在个人建议等社交场景中表现出谄媚倾向，比人类更频繁地肯定用户，导致用户过度自信、在冲突后更不愿修复关系。已有缓解方法多针对有标准答案的事实性场景，而社交谄媚（无标准答案）的缓解仅依赖简单提示和有限效果的后训练方法。
AI.method: 提出PlurPO：给定描述人际冲突的输入，模型先识别并模拟相关的利益相关者，随后被训练为偏好并生成对所有相关方都可接受的回复。该方法仅使用模型对自身输出产生的信号，不需要真实标签。
AI.result: 在四个数据集和四个模型家族上，PlurPO相比先前方法显著降低社交谄媚。例如在伤害意图陈述上，四个模型平均将认同率降低89%；在一般建议问题上，将认同率与人类回复的差距从17.8%缩小到8.0%，缩小过半。为8B模型构建的偏好数据集也能有效迁移，缓解更大32B模型的谄媚。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，利用模型自身能力模拟多种相关视角，可以有效减少社交谄媚。

title: ArrivalBench: Agent-Generated Data Pipelines Are Correct Once and Wrong Under Time
comment: Accepted as a poster at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop "Who Verifies the Agents?". 20 pages
summary: Benchmarks for agent-generated data work grade a pipeline by running it once against a fixed snapshot. ArrivalBench instead re-executes the pipeline an agent leaves behind under adversarial but replayable delivery schedules (late, duplicated, out-of-order and retried records) and requires its final state to equal a batch recomputation of the complete log. Because the oracle recomputes rather than classifies, a wrong table and a crash are distinct verdicts: a crash is visible to monitoring a team already runs, and a wrong table is not. On 40 tasks we built, our reimplementation of single-execution grading certifies 86-100% of the pipelines eleven models produce; re-executing the same artifacts finds 7.0-79.2% of the certified ones silently wrong. The gap is not produced by the repair loop: within the same model and task, pipelines repaired against the snapshot test fail replay about as often as those that passed it first time. In every model, idempotency hazards fail more often than ordering hazards. Separating a wrong answer from a crash also changes how interventions read: a hazard warning cuts one model's silent failure from 48.2% to 10.5% while raising its crash rate from 9.0% to 37.0%, so all-in failure moves only from 51.0% to 44.0%. All eleven arms were independently re-run, and rates moved by at most 5.9 points.

AI.tldr: ArrivalBench 通过在可重放的对抗性送达调度下重执行 agent 留下的数据流水线，并以完整日志的批重算为判定基准，揭示单次快照评测会高估流水线正确性，且能区分"结果错误"与"崩溃"两种失败。
AI.motivation: 现有 agent 生成数据处理任务的基准仅用固定快照单次运行来评分，无法暴露流水线在记录延迟、重复、乱序和重试等真实送达条件下的静默错误。
AI.method: 构造 40 个任务，重执行 agent 产出的流水线，施加可重放的对抗性送达调度（延迟、重复、乱序、重试），要求其最终状态等于完整日志的批重算结果；判定采用重算而非分类，从而将"错误表"与"崩溃"区分为不同裁决。
AI.result: 单次执行式评测对 11 个模型产出的流水线认证通过率达 86–100%，而重执行同一产物发现其中 7.0–79.2% 的已认证流水线静默出错；修复循环并非差距来源；各模型中幂等性隐患比顺序性隐患更易失败；告警提示使某模型静默失败从 48.2% 降至 10.5%，但崩溃率从 9.0% 升至 37.0%，总失败率仅从 51.0% 降至 44.0%；11 个实验组独立重跑后比率变动不超过 5.9 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 仅凭单次快照的通过/失败评分系统性高估数据流水线的可靠性，必须区分静默错误与崩溃，否则干预效果的评估会产生误导。

title: Learning Reflexive Behavior for Contact-Rich Manipulation
summary: During contact-rich manipulation, interactions between a robot and its environment carry information about local geometry: a surface prevents penetration, a bore guides a peg. A controller that exploits these interactions can comply with environmental constraints while preserving task intent. Robot-earning systems commonly use position, hybrid force-position, or Cartesian impedance control. Their prescribed tracking objectives, stiffness, or force-control directions may not match local constraints and may degrade performance. We learn a proprioceptive reflex policy in simulation on three simple interaction primitives: a spring, a plane, and a rail. The policy maps task-space commands to joint-position targets using state history, without direct force or geometrical measurements. Once trained, it serves as a frozen execution layer beneath higher-level controllers. We evaluate it in dual-arm box lifting, peg insertion, and surface following. In box lifting, the reflex kept the force below the threshold while the baseline failed. In rough-surface following it stayed below the 10 N reference, on par with tuned hybrid force-position control. In 0.02 mm peg insertion It reduced mean estimated contact force to less than half that of the baseline while increasing hardware success rates from at most 22 % to 36-58 %. By separating contact response from command generation, the reflex policy provides motion planners, learned policies, and teleoperators with robust contact-rich execution.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一种基于本体感觉的反射策略，在仿真中学习弹簧、平面、导轨三种交互基元，将任务空间指令映射为关节位置目标，作为冻结执行层与上层控制器解耦，在双臂举箱、轴孔装配与曲面跟随任务中提升了力控制与成功率。
AI.motivation: 接触丰富的操作中，机器人与环境的交互蕴含局部几何信息（表面防穿透、孔引导轴），可被控制器利用以兼顾环境约束与任务意图。但常用的位置控制、力位混合控制或笛卡尔阻抗控制，其预设的跟踪目标、刚度或力控方向可能与局部约束不匹配，导致性能下降。
