AI.method: 在仿真中针对三种简单交互基元（弹簧、平面、导轨）学习一个本体感觉反射策略。该策略无需直接力或几何测量，仅利用状态历史将任务空间指令映射为关节位置目标。训练完成后作为冻结的执行层，置于上层控制器之下运行。
AI.result: 在双臂举箱、轴孔装配和曲面跟随中评估：举箱时反射策略将力保持在阈值以下而基线失败；粗糙曲面跟随中保持在 10 N 参考值以下，与调优的力位混合控制相当；0.02 mm 轴孔装配中将平均估计接触力降至基线的一半以下，硬件成功率从最高 22% 提升至 36–58%。
AI.conclusion: 通过将接触响应与指令生成解耦，该反射策略为运动规划器、学习策略和遥操作者提供了稳健的接触丰富执行能力。

title: TRAC: Trajectory-aware Reuse and Adaptive Correction for Efficient Autoregressive Video Generation
summary: In this paper, we present trajectory-aware reuse and adaptive correction (TRAC), a training-free framework for efficient autoregressive (AR) video generation. Existing acceleration methods mainly target single-trajectory generation with bidirectional attention. AR video generation, by contrast, sequentially couples chunk-level denoising trajectories. Consequently, approximation errors accumulate and propagate through the generation process. TRAC addresses this challenge with three components, including robust cumulative scheduling (RCS), autoregressive trajectory-aware guidance scheduling (ATGS), and spectral structure correction (SSC). RCS selects cache reuse schedules by cumulative rollout error and cross-chunk/prompt variation. ATGS coordinates CFG refreshes along the global AR trajectory. SSC restores low-frequency structure of the first chunk to correct long-term structural loss. Experiments on SkyReels-V2 and FramePack-F1 show that, compared with existing methods, TRAC achieves both the highest inference efficiency and the best generation quality for AR video generation.

AI.tldr: 提出无训练框架TRAC，针对自回归视频生成的误差累积问题，通过三项组件实现高效高质量推理。
AI.motivation: 现有加速方法主要面向双向注意力的单轨迹生成，而自回归视频生成按块级去噪轨迹顺序耦合，导致近似误差在生成过程中累积与传播，因此需要专门面向AR轨迹的加速方案。
AI.method: TRAC包含三个组件：RCS（鲁棒累积调度）依据累积展开误差及跨块/跨提示变化选择缓存复用调度；ATGS（自回归轨迹感知引导调度）沿全局AR轨迹协调CFG刷新；SSC（谱结构校正）恢复首块低频结构以修正长期结构损失。
AI.result: 在SkyReels-V2与FramePack-F1上，相比现有方法，TRAC在AR视频生成中同时取得最高推理效率与最佳生成质量。
AI.conclusion: TRAC作为无训练框架，通过轨迹感知复用与自适应校正有效缓解AR视频生成的误差累积，兼顾效率与质量。

title: Answering clinicians' questions over trial evidence tables with verifiable, feedback-driven language models
summary: Systematic reviews condense clinical trials into evidence tables, yet clinicians can interrogate these tables only through database queries, and many questions concern attributes that the table does not record, such as a drug's target class or a harmonised endpoint. Here we introduce FD-SCoPE, a language-model framework that answers both kinds of question, exposes the query, the selected trials and the derivation rule behind every answer, and learns from expert corrections. On an oncology evidence table of 159 immune checkpoint inhibitor trial records, FD-SCoPE completed all 140 clinician-style tasks (alternatives, 90.7-97.9%). For questions needing derived attributes it retrieved 99.3% of relevant trial records at a positive predictive value of 89.8% and outperformed four alternative approaches (derived-value F1 77.7% versus 64.8-73.4%). Corrections on 299 questions, simulated from reference answers, raised F1 on 1,201 unseen questions from 77.9% to 84.9%. Language models coupled with executable queries, verified programs and expert feedback can give clinicians auditable access to trial evidence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FD-SCoPE，一种语言模型框架，可回答关于系统综述证据表的直接查询与派生属性查询，并公开查询、所选试验及推导规则，且能从专家纠正中学习。
AI.motivation: 系统综述将临床试验压缩为证据表，但临床医生只能通过数据库查询访问这些表，且许多问题涉及表中未记录的属性（如药物靶点类别或统一终点）。
AI.method: FD-SCoPE基于语言模型，结合可执行查询、经验证的程序和专家反馈，对每个答案公开查询语句、所选试验记录及推导规则，并能从专家纠正中学习。在包含159条免疫检查点抑制剂试验记录的肿瘤学证据表上评测。
AI.result: 完成全部140项临床医生风格任务（替代方法为90.7-97.9%）；需派生属性的问题检索到99.3%相关试验记录，阳性预测值89.8%，优于四种替代方法（派生值F1 77.7%对64.8-73.4%）；基于参考答案模拟的299个问题纠正，使1,201个未见问题的F1从77.9%提升至84.9%。
AI.conclusion: 语言模型结合可执行查询、经验证的程序与专家反馈，可为临床医生提供可审计的试验证据访问方式。

title: Co-design Gym: A Unified Benchmark for Embodiment-Policy Co-optimization
comment: Aviraj Newatia and Yordan Tsvetkov contributed equally
summary: Finding an optimal behaviour policy within a given environment is a widely studied problem in domains as diverse as games, robotics, energy infrastructure, communication networks, and multi-agent systems. Numerous benchmarks have been developed to support such research, but the vast majority assume that the agent's embodiment (design) is fixed, focusing instead on policy learning alone. Lifting this assumption gives rise to a broader class of problems in which optimizing embodiment and policy separately is highly suboptimal. An agent's embodiment strongly shapes which control policies can be discovered, while the optimal embodiment is in turn defined by the policies it admits. To help the research community study this class of problems explicitly and systematically, we introduce Co-Design Gym - a suite of benchmark environments for jointly optimizing embodiment and policy. Our environments span domains such as robotic manipulation and locomotion, multi-robot cooperation, deformable and soft dynamics, video games, electricity grids, wireless networks, F1 racing, multi-agent warehouses, and optimal control, offering 20 environment families (domains), with over 85 distinct co-design presets in total. We further contribute a systematic evaluation of representative co-design algorithms, characterizing the current state of the art. Together, these contributions lay the groundwork for cumulative, comparable progress in co-design.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Co-Design Gym，一个用于联合优化智能体形态（embodiment）与控制策略的基准环境套件，涵盖20个环境族、85+个预设，并系统评估了代表性协同设计算法。
AI.motivation: 现有大多数基准假设智能体形态（设计）固定，仅关注策略学习；但形态与策略相互制约、相互定义，单独优化二者显著次优，因此需要专门的环境体系来系统化研究这类协同设计问题。
AI.method: 构建 Co-Design Gym 基准套件，覆盖机器人操作与运动、多机器人协作、可变形与软体动力学、视频游戏、电网、无线网络、F1赛车、多智能体仓库、最优控制等领域；包含20个环境族、85+个协同设计预设；并给出代表性协同设计算法的系统评估。
AI.result: 提供了跨多领域的20个环境族与85+个协同设计预设，并对代表性协同设计算法进行了系统评测，刻画了当前技术水平（state of the art）。
AI.conclusion: Co-Design Gym 为协同设计研究奠定了可累积、可比较的进展基础，支持该问题类别被更系统、明确地研究。

title: Register-Routed Delayed Fusion: Rewiring Shortcut-Prone Observation Fusion in Visuomotor Imitation
summary: Visuomotor imitation policies combine high-dimensional visual observations with compact signals such as proprioception, and their fusion topology determines when and through which tokens these streams interact. In dense token fusion, visual tokens may attend directly to compact tokens from the first encoder layer, allowing action-predictive compact cues to influence spatial visual representations early in their formation. We ask whether controlling this route improves visual responsiveness and policy behavior. We introduce Register-Routed Delayed Fusion (RRDF), which masks direct compact-visual attention and stages cross-modal interaction through a learned register workspace. Its isolate-collect-route schedule protects an early stream-separated prefix and later permits only register-mediated exchange, while compact conditioning remains available to the native action generator. Across five simulation tasks and three real-robot tasks, RRDF matches or improves dense ACT under nominal conditions. Appearance-shift evaluations on four simulation tasks and held-out-position evaluations on three real-robot tasks also favor RRDF. Phase-matched input probes show lower measured state-to-image sensitivity, while ablations indicate that adding registers alone does not reproduce the full performance gain. These results support controlling cross-modal propagation while retaining compact action conditioning.

AI.tldr: 提出 Register-Routed Delayed Fusion（RRDF），通过遮蔽紧凑-视觉直接注意力并由可学习 register 工作区中转跨模态交互，在仿真与真机任务中匹配或优于 dense ACT，并提升外观偏移与位置泛化。
AI.motivation: 视觉运动模仿策略中，视觉与本体感觉等紧凑信号的融合拓扑直接决定跨模态交互的时机与路径。dense token fusion 允许视觉 token 从首层就直接关注紧凑 token，可能使动作预测相关的紧凑线索过早影响空间视觉表征。作者希望验证：控制这条直接通路是否能提升视觉响应性与策略行为。
AI.method: RRDF 遮蔽紧凑-视觉直接注意力，采用 isolate-collect-route 调度：早期保持流分离前缀，后期仅允许经 register 工作区的中转交换；紧凑条件信息仍可直达原生动作生成器。并以相位匹配输入探针与消融（仅加 register 不路由）进行机制分析。
AI.result: 在 5 个仿真任务与 3 个真机任务上，标称条件下 RRDF 匹配或优于 dense ACT；4 个仿真任务的外观偏移评估与 3 个真机任务的留出位置评估同样更优。输入探针显示更低的状态-图像敏感度，消融表明仅添加 register 无法复现完整增益。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明应控制跨模态传播路径，同时保留紧凑信号对动作生成的直接条件作用，可改善视觉响应性与策略泛化。

title: FUSEye: Training-Light Fisheye Detection with Overlapping Views and Zero-Initialized Adapters
comment: Source code will be available at https://github.com/Su-wenya/FUSEye
summary: Fisheye cameras give mobile robots a single-sensor, low-cost view of their surroundings, yet the COCO-pretrained detectors that practitioners routinely reuse fail on them: strong radial distortion warps local image structure, while boundary compression shrinks objects to near-invisible sizes. Full fine-tuning closes much of the gap but requires abundant fisheye labels and compute. We present FUSEye, a training-light framework that turns a frozen-backbone COCO-pretrained extra-large YOLO26 detector (YOLO26-x) into a fisheye detector. FUSEye adds roughly 227k new parameters while updating the inserted modules and the pretrained detection head. It addresses the transfer gap at three causally linked levels. At the input level, overlapping grid view generation and box remapping (GridViews) enlarge compressed boundary regions. At the feature level, zero-initialized residual adapters (Z-Adapters) correct distortion-induced feature misalignment. At the decision level, learned cross-projection agreement fusion (AgreeFusion) promotes low-confidence detections only when they are supported by consistent evidence across multiple views. On the WoodScape surround-view fisheye benchmark, FUSEye raises YOLO26-x from 0.148 to 0.266 mAP50 and retains 84.3% fully fine-tuned accuracy. Moreover, randomly using only 25% of the labeled training images, FUSEye achieves 0.2597 mAP50, retaining 97.6% of its full-label performance. FUSEye also consistently improves YOLOv8-11 detectors, showing that the recipe is architecture-agnostic. Source code will be available at https://github.com/Su-wenya/FUSEye.

AI.tldr: FUSEye提出一种轻量训练框架，将冻结骨干的COCO预训练YOLO26-x改造为鱼眼检测器，仅新增约227k参数，在WoodScape基准上将mAP50从0.148提升至0.266，并保留84.3%全量微调精度。
AI.motivation: 鱼眼相机为移动机器人提供低成本单传感器全景视野，但现成的COCO预训练检测器在其上失效：强径向畸变扭曲局部图像结构，边界压缩使目标缩小至近乎不可见。全量微调虽能弥补差距，但需要大量鱼眼标注与算力，因此需要一种训练成本低的迁移方案。
AI.method: FUSEye冻结预训练骨干，仅更新插入模块与预训练检测头，新增约227k参数，从三个因果关联层面缩小迁移差距：输入层采用重叠网格视图生成与框重映射（GridViews）放大被压缩的边界区域；特征层使用零初始化残差适配器（Z-Adapters）校正畸变引起的特征错位；决策层引入可学习的跨投影一致性融合（AgreeFusion），仅当多视图证据一致时才提升低置信度检测。
AI.result: 在WoodScape环视鱼眼基准上，FUSEye将YOLO26-x的mAP50从0.148提升到0.266，保留84.3%的全量微调精度；仅随机使用25%标注训练图像时达到0.2597 mAP50，保留全标签性能的97.6%。该方法还可一致地提升YOLOv8-11检测器，表明该方案与架构无关。
AI.conclusion: FUSEye以极小的参数与标注开销有效弥合了COCO预训练检测器到鱼眼域的迁移差距，兼具高精度保持率、低标注依赖与架构通用性，为移动机器人鱼眼感知提供了实用方案。

title: Labels Override Definitions in Jev-Style Typed Decision Models
summary: A typed decision model answers a fixed question about an input by returning a probability for each of several caller-defined options. Each option carries a short label and a written definition, which is where a developer states the rule the model should apply. Jev introduced this interface for routing, moderation and triage, open implementations followed, and the same operation occurs whenever a language model is used as a classifier by scoring label strings. We study the open implementations, whose weights we can inspect and patch, and ask whether the probability follows the definitions or the labels. A preference for the label we call option-label bias. Across four open-weight typed decision models, three ways of reading an answer from a Qwen2.5 backbone, eleven classification tasks and PolicyBench, a synthetic routing suite we introduce in which the rule appears only in the definitions, the answer is mostly the labels. Deleting every definition leaves accuracy unchanged (laya-td: 0.8559 against 0.8487), although those definitions support 0.7971 on their own, and renaming the options to A and B raises accuracy by +0.1511 [+0.1377, +0.1646]. One system, von, is unaffected, and the two code bases differ in one expression: laya writes each option as "{label}: {definition}", while von writes only the definition. Changing that expression in both directions, with no weight changed, makes all three laya checkpoints exactly invariant (+0.0000 [+0.0000, +0.0000]) and creates the effect in von, whose accuracy falls from 0.8511 to 0.2281 when a label contradicts its definition. Earlier work attributed this failure to the constrained decision head these models use in place of a text decoder; our results locate it in the prompt rendering. We give a two-call test that tells a practitioner which case applies to their model, and measure what four mitigations are worth.

AI.tldr: 开放权重"类型化决策模型"在多数情况下依据选项标签而非定义作答，即存在选项标签偏置；该偏置源于提示渲染中"标签: 定义"的写法，而非约束决策头，可通过改变渲染表达式或两次调用测试识别并缓解。
AI.motivation: 类型化决策模型通过为若干调用者定义的选项返回概率来回答问题，选项含短标签与书面定义，开发者据此表述模型应遵循的规则。既有开放实现中以语言模型作为分类器（对标签串打分）普遍存在，但尚不清楚模型输出的概率究竟依据定义还是标签。作者希望定位该失效来源（约束决策头还是提示渲染），并给出可操作的诊断与缓解手段。
AI.method: 作者考察可检查并修补权重的开放实现，在四个开放权重类型化决策模型、Qwen2.5 骨干的三种答案读取方式、十一个分类任务以及新提出的合成路由套件 PolicyBench（规则仅出现在定义中）上进行评测。采用定义删除、定义单独支撑、选项重命名为 A/B、标签与定义相互矛盾等干预，并双向修改提示表达式（"{label}: {definition}" 与仅定义）而保持权重不变，比较准确率变化。
AI.result: 整体上答案主要跟随标签：删除全部定义后准确率基本不变（laya-td 0.8559 vs 0.8487），尽管定义单独支撑达 0.7971；将选项重命名为 A、B 使准确率提升 +0.1511 [+0.1377, +0.1646]。von 系统不受影响，两套代码仅在表达式上不同（laya 写"{label}: {definition}"，von 只写定义）。双向修改该表达式、不改变权重，使三个 laya 检查点完全不变（+0.0000 [+0.0000, +0.0000]），而在 von 中产生该效应，当标签与定义矛盾时准确率由 0.8511 降至 0.2281。
AI.conclusion: 该失效并非源于这些模型使用的约束决策头，而是位于提示渲染层。作者提出两次调用测试以判断从业者模型属于哪种情形，并测量了四种缓解措施的收益。

title: Latent-MOPD: Latent Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student on the responses it generates. Existing LLM multi-teacher OPD transfers what specialists predict through their output distributions. We introduce Latent-MOPD, to our knowledge the first representation-level multi-teacher OPD method for LLMs. It integrates existing specialists through both their predictions and the hidden states used to compute them, without additional teacher training. To coordinate representation supervision from multiple specialists, we select late-layer targets according to the teacher-student relationship, bridge unequal hidden widths with a shared projection, and group updates by domain. Each teacher's supervision gradually shifts from hidden states to token predictions, with both channels using the same routed specialist. In our main same-family setting, Latent-MOPD outperforms the token-only, representation-only and uniform-averaging baselines on all nine benchmarks across math, code and logic. With the same parameter count as each teacher, the student also surpasses the per-benchmark best teacher on a majority of these benchmarks. With larger, separately developed cross-family teachers, Latent-MOPD outperforms both single-channel baselines on all benchmarks. A same-family all-layer representation-only control remains stable with domain-pure updates but collapses when teacher domains are interleaved within an update. Our results show that a single student can integrate capabilities from several specialists through both their output distributions and internal representations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Latent-MOPD，首个面向LLM的表征级多教师在线策略蒸馏（OPD）方法，同时利用专家的预测分布与隐藏状态进行蒸馏，在数学、代码、逻辑等九个基准上超越单通道与均匀平均基线。
AI.motivation: 现有多教师OPD仅通过教师的输出分布传递专家能力，忽略了用于计算这些预测的隐藏状态所含的丰富表征信息，因此表征级多教师蒸馏尚属空白。
AI.method: Latent-MOPD在无需额外教师训练的前提下，同时整合专家的预测与隐藏状态。为协调多专家表征监督：依据师生关系选择后层目标；用共享投影桥接不等的隐藏维度；按领域对更新进行分组。每位教师的监督逐步由隐藏状态转向token预测，且两条通道使用同一路由的专家。
AI.result: 同族设置下，Latent-MOPD在数学、代码、逻辑共九个基准上全面优于token-only、representation-only与uniform-averaging基线；在学生参数量与各教师相同时，多数基准上超过逐基准最优教师。跨族大规模教师设置下，在所有基准上优于单通道基线。同族全层仅表征对照在领域纯净更新时稳定，而教师领域在单次更新中交错时崩溃。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，单一学生模型可通过输出分布与内部表征两个通道有效整合多个专家能力，表征级多教师在线策略蒸馏可行且有效。

title: FastOPD: On-Policy Distillation for Lightweight VLA Deployment
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) foundation models have scaled rapidly to enhance manipulation performance and generalizability, but this scaling incurs high computational costs that render real-world deployment increasingly challenging. Existing approaches typically mitigate this issue by designing smaller architectures or reducing the iterative denoising steps in flow-based policies. In this work, we propose FastOPD, a foundation-to-lightweight VLA framework that enables the practical deployment of large-scale VLAs through efficient on-policy distillation. Specifically, FastOPD adapts a flow map for single-state teacher supervision and combines it with a self-consistency objective to construct a compact student that learns the teacher dynamics. Furthermore, we theoretically demonstrate that minimizing this objective allows the distilled student to recover a distribution on par with that induced by an ideal few-step teacher model. We evaluate FastOPD across diverse foundation policies in simulation and real-world experiments. On LIBERO, FastOPD retains 84% of the performance of $π_{0.5}$ with only two inference steps, reducing inference latency by 78.1% while outperforming existing few-step distillation baselines in average success rate. With LingBot-VLA as the teacher, FastOPD improves the single-step success rate over the base student by 15.9 percentage points on RoboTwin 2.0. We further demonstrate its applicability to a World Action Model (WAM) and deploy a compact student distilled from MolmoAct2 on a real robot.

AI.tldr: FastOPD：通过高效on-policy蒸馏，将大规模VLA基础模型压缩为轻量学生模型，实现少步甚至单步推理，大幅降低部署延迟。
AI.motivation: VLA基础模型规模快速扩大虽提升了操作性能与泛化性，但带来高昂计算成本，使真实世界部署愈发困难。现有方案多依赖缩小架构或减少flow策略的迭代去噪步数，存在性能或通用性局限。
AI.method: 提出FastOPD，一种foundation-to-lightweight的VLA框架。核心为高效on-policy蒸馏：为单状态教师监督适配flow map，并结合自一致性目标，构建学习教师动力学的紧凑学生模型。理论上证明最小化该目标可使蒸馏学生恢复与理想少步教师模型相当的分布。
AI.result: 在LIBERO上，FastOPD仅用两步推理保留π_{0.5} 84%性能，推理延迟降低78.1%，平均成功率优于现有多步蒸馏基线；以LingBot-VLA为教师时，在RoboTwin 2.0上单步成功率较基础学生提升15.9个百分点；并验证了其向World Action Model (WAM) 的适用性，以及在真实机器人上部署从MolmoAct2蒸馏的紧凑学生模型。
AI.conclusion: FastOPD通过on-policy蒸馏有效桥接大规模VLA与轻量部署需求，在少步/单步推理下兼顾性能与效率，具备跨模型与真实场景的通用性。

title: TerrainForge: Physics-Grounded road geometry Editing for Counterfactual Autonomous Driving
summary: Road geometry (e.g., crests, sags, and speed humps) and surface conditions (e.g., wet or icy pavement) affect how vehicles move, what drivers and onboard cameras observe, and how much clearance remains between vehicles. Editing these properties in a driving scene therefore requires corresponding changes in vehicle motion. Capturing these differences in a driving video requires a road edit to propagate to vehicle motion, camera viewpoint, and the clearance between vehicles. We present TerrainForge, a framework for generating road geometry-focused counterfactuals from reconstructed multi-vehicle driving episodes. A unified road model connects scene deformation with four-wheel vehicle dynamics, allowing crests, sags, speed humps, and friction changes to propagate through vehicle motion, camera viewpoint, and inter-vehicle clearance. Vehicle dynamics are evaluated against CarSim, and prescribed road geometry is verified in reconstructed Waymo scenes. Across 18 episodes, leaving surrounding vehicles on their recorded trajectories instead of recomputing their responses produces median peak differences in predicted ego-lead distance of 1.52 m for crests and 1.41 m for sags. We further simulate the ego response to 15,758 road edits across 983 braking episodes, pairing each edit with its safety outcomes relative to an unedited replay. These pairs train a first-stage screening surrogate that takes the original driving context and candidate road-edit parameters as input and predicts the resulting change in the ego's terminal gap. On held-out scenes, this prediction achieves 22-40% lower mean absolute error than predicting no change, so candidates can be screened cheaply before the full multi-vehicle rollout.

AI.tldr: 提出 TerrainForge 框架，从重建的多车驾驶片段生成以道路几何为核心的反事实场景，统一道路模型将场景形变与四轮车辆动力学耦合，使坡顶、坡谷、减速带与摩擦变化传播至车辆运动、相机视角与车间距，并训练首阶段筛选代理模型降低预测误差。
AI.motivation: 道路几何（坡顶、坡谷、减速带）与路面条件（湿滑、结冰）会影响车辆运动、驾驶员与车载相机观测以及车辆间净空。在驾驶场景中编辑这些属性必须同步改变车辆运动，因此需要在驾驶视频中让道路编辑传播到车辆运动、相机视角与车间距。
AI.method: TerrainForge 从重建的多车驾驶片段生成道路几何反事实。采用统一道路模型连接场景形变与四轮车辆动力学，使坡顶、坡谷、减速带及摩擦变化传播至车辆运动、相机视角和车间距。车辆动力学与 CarSim 对比评估，规定道路几何在重建的 Waymo 场景中验证。基于 983 个制动片段中的 15,758 次道路编辑模拟自车响应，与未编辑回放配对得到安全结果，训练首阶段筛选代理模型，以原始驾驶上下文和候选道路编辑参数为输入，预测自车终端间距变化。
AI.result: 18 个片段中，若周围车辆保持记录轨迹而不重算其响应，坡顶与坡谷情形下预测的自车-前车间距中位峰值差异分别为 1.52 m 和 1.41 m。在留出场景上，筛选代理模型的预测平均绝对误差比"预测无变化"基线低 22–40%，可在完整多车推演前低成本筛选候选编辑。
AI.conclusion: TerrainForge 实现了道路几何编辑向车辆运动、视角与车间距的传播，并通过筛选代理模型在完整多车推演前对候选道路编辑进行低成本筛选，验证了周围车辆响应重算对间距预测的必要性。

title: Open-Endedness Bench: Measuring Epistemic Process from Agent Records
summary: Agents are increasingly given open-ended research tasks: discovering an empirical law from self-designed experiments, improving a heuristic whose optimum nobody knows, or beating a standing record. Their execution logs record every step of this research, yet the runs are still judged by their outcome score. That score alone does not establish whether an agent's claims follow from executed experiments, and a reference answer may be unavailable. We evaluate the agent's epistemic process: how it forms hypotheses, tests them, and revises them in response to evidence. We introduce OEB (Open-Endedness Bench), a benchmark-agnostic methodology that reads only the agent's execution record and never a reference answer or an outcome score. OEB compiles the record into a unified epistemic event graph whose edges connect the propositions the agent states to the executed actions that test them; each node carries an exact excerpt that code verifies against the record. One principle governs scoring: prose can state a proposition, but only evidence returned by an executed action can support or refute it, so OEB checks what the agent writes against what it actually ran. From the graph, OEB scores four competence axes (evidence, experiment, revision, and no reward hacking), mostly as the share of opportunities for sound research that the agent took, and profiles six subjective persona traits that describe the agent's research habits. We score 119 existing runs over 12 tasks from three benchmarks: LLM post-training, chip design, and a training-speed record. Against logged results, only 16-29% of the improvements agents claim are real. On 9 of 10 tasks, the best run tries more new ideas in its second half than the worst run. The persona readings follow the model: for every trait, the model that ran explains more of its variance across runs than the task (a median of 43% against 7%).

AI.tldr: 本文提出 OEB（Open-Endedness Bench），一个与具体基准无关的评估方法，仅读取智能体的执行记录，将其编译为统一的"认知事件图"，从证据、实验、修正、无奖励黑客四个能力维度打分，并刻画六种研究习惯画像。
AI.motivation: 开放式研究任务（如发现经验规律、改进未知最优的启发式、打破记录）的执行日志虽完整记录每一步，但现有评估只看结果分数。结果分数无法证明智能体的主张是否由实际执行的实验推出，且往往没有参考答​​案可用。因此需要评估智能体的认知过程本身。
AI.method: OEB 方法：只读取智能体的执行记录，不使用参考答案或结果分数。将记录编译为统一的认知事件图，边连接智能体陈述的命题与其执行过的、用于检验该命题的动作；每个节点带有经代码与记录核验的精确摘录。评分原则：文字可以陈述命题，但只有执行动作返回的证据才能支持或反驳该命题（即核对智能体所写与所运行）。基于该图，对四个能力轴（证据、实验、修正、无奖励黑客）打分——主要以智能体抓住的健全研究机会占比计，并刻画六种描述研究习惯的主观画像特质。
AI.result: 在三个基准（LLM 后训练、芯片设计、训练速度纪录）的 12 个任务上对 119 个已有运行进行评分。与日志记录的结果对比，智能体声称的改进中仅 16-29% 是真实的。在 10 个任务中的 9 个上，最佳运行在后半段尝试的新想法多于最差运行。画像读数随模型变化：对每个特质，运行模型解释的跨运行方差多于任务本身（中位数 43% 对 7%）。
AI.conclusion: 结果分数不足以验证开放式研究智能体的主张；OEB 通过分析执行记录中的认知过程，提供了与基准无关、无需参考答案的评估框架，揭示了大部分声称的改进并不真实，并表明研究习惯主要由模型而非任务决定。

title: The Surprising Effectiveness of Shared Memory in Looped Transformers
summary: Looped Transformers apply the same layers several times per token, adding compute to improve quality without more parameters. Each recursion, however, writes its own key-value cache, so memory still grows with compute. Inference-time techniques can shrink this cache at a cost in quality. We pretrain looped language models to share memory: only the first recursion writes a cache, and later recursions read it while keeping a short window of their own. Surprisingly, we find that sharing memory does not cost quality and instead improves it. At 150M-1B parameters, our Looped Prediction Transformer (LPT) and its hybrid variant set a new quality-memory frontier for looped models: with five recursions, the hybrid lowers validation perplexity on FineWeb-Edu by 1.12-1.82 relative to a same-size standard Transformer while using 76-79% less context memory. Through an extensive analysis, we investigate why memory sharing helps. Shared and local memory develop different representations, and later recursions attend mostly to the shared memory, which also acts as a gradient highway to the first recursion.

AI.tldr: 提出Looped Prediction Transformer（LPT）及其混合变体，通过让多次递归共享同一KV缓存（仅首次递归写入），在提升质量的同时显著降低上下文内存占用，并给出机制性分析。
AI.motivation: 循环Transformer每次递归都会写入独立的key-value缓存，导致内存随计算量增长；现有推理期压缩缓存的方法会牺牲质量。作者希望从预训练阶段直接解决循环模型的内存瓶颈。
AI.method: 预训练循环语言模型以共享内存：仅首次递归写入KV缓存，后续递归读取该共享缓存，同时保留一小段自身的局部窗口。并设计LPT与混合变体两种架构。
AI.result: 在150M-1B参数规模下，混合变体在五次递归时将FineWeb-Edu验证困惑度较同规模标准Transformer降低1.12-1.82，同时减少76-79%的上下文内存；共享内存不仅未损失质量，反而提升质量。
AI.conclusion: 共享与局部内存发展出不同表征，后续递归主要关注共享内存，且共享内存充当前递归的梯度通路，这解释了共享内存带来质量提升的原因，为循环模型建立了新的质量-内存前沿。

title: PointWAM: 3D World Action Modeling for Dexterous Robotic Manipulation
summary: World action models jointly learn to forecast world dynamics and predict robot actions, such that the learned internal world dynamics guide accurate actions. Existing approaches typically represent the world as RGB frames or latent counterparts while predicting actions as end-effector poses or joint angles, but they often struggle to capture the 3D spatial structure and contact geometry central to dexterous manipulation. We introduce Point World Action Model (PointWAM), a 3D world action model that decomposes the world into a scene (i.e., environment) and hands (i.e., actor), and jointly forecasts both as 3D point trajectories within a shared space-time coordinate frame. This explicit, disentangled representation enables effective pre-training on large-scale human demonstration videos without requiring any task-specific object or keypoint selection. Given a colored point cloud and a language instruction, PointWAM predicts how the scene and hands co-evolve in 3D space over time, then retargets the forecast hand motion to robot actions. Pre-training on human videos improves average DexJoCo success by 56.9 percentage points, and scene-trajectory supervision adds 10.9 points over forecasting the hands alone. With both, PointWAM surpasses the prior state of the art on ten DexJoCo tasks by 11.7 points and outperforms strong VLAs on a real robot.

AI.tldr: PointWAM提出将世界分解为场景与手部的3D点轨迹联合预测框架，在共享时空坐标系中建模世界-动作耦合，通过人类视频预训练显著提升灵巧操作性能。
AI.motivation: 现有世界动作模型多以RGB帧或潜表示描述世界、以末端位姿或关节角预测动作，难以捕捉灵巧操作核心的3D空间结构与接触几何。
AI.method: 将世界解耦为场景（环境）与手（行动者），在统一时空坐标系中以3D点轨迹联合预测二者演化；输入彩色点云与语言指令，预测场景与手部在3D空间的协同演变，再将预测的手部运动重定向为机器人动作；无需任务特定的物体或关键点标注即可在大规模人类演示视频上预训练。
AI.result: 人类视频预训练使DexJoCo平均成功率提升56.9个百分点；场景轨迹监督较仅预测手部再增10.9个百分点；两者结合后在10项DexJoCo任务上超越先前最优11.7个百分点，并在真实机器人上优于强VLA模型。
AI.conclusion: 显式解耦的3D点轨迹世界表示可有效利用无标注人类视频，为灵巧操作提供可扩展的预训练范式，并优于RGB/潜空间表示与现有VLA方法。

title: Seeing, Saying, but Not Using: From Reportable Spatial Facts to Usable States in Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: A multimodal large language model that correctly reports a spatial fact does not necessarily use that fact in subsequent reasoning. To study this distinction, we introduce \textsc{SpaceConflict}, a benchmark of 23{,}196 inputs for the construction and use of spatial state. Under a unified Supported/Contradictory/Unknown judgment interface, it covers local fact binding (L1), relational composition (L2), cross-observation consistency (L3), and state judgment under transformation (L4). Posing a direct-state query, a full-transformation query, and an explicit-initial-state query on the same world reveals an availability--utilization gap: models recover the initial state from visual evidence yet fail when that state must drive a transformation. For Qwen3.5-9B, 50 of 100 sequences with a correctly recovered initial state fail the full transformation, and supplying the state explicitly repairs all 50; the gap narrows with scale but does not close. We therefore propose Operational State Supervision (OSS), which supervises task-relevant spatial states and their transformation trajectories and aligns shared facts across contexts. OSS improves paired accuracy on matched judgments most on L3 and L4, the levels that depend on organizing and using state. Evaluating multimodal spatial reasoning thus requires asking not only whether a model can see and state a spatial fact, but whether that fact becomes a usable state in subsequent computation.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 SpaceConflict 基准（23,196 条输入）区分空间事实的"可用性"与"可利用性"，发现多模态大模型能正确报告空间事实却无法在其后续推理中使用，并将此现象定义为 availability–utilization gap；为此提出 Operational State Supervision（OSS）训练方法，在 L3/L4 层级显著提升配对判断准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态空间推理评测多关注模型能否"看到并说出"空间事实，而忽视了该事实能否在后续计算中作为可用状态被调用。作者希望揭示"正确报告"与"正确使用"之间的本质区别，从而更严格地评估空间推理能力。
AI.method: 构建 SpaceConflict 基准，含 23,196 条输入，采用统一的 Supported/Contradictory/Unknown 判断接口，覆盖四个层级：L1 局部事实绑定、L2 关系组合、L3 跨观测一致性、L4 变换下的状态判断。对同一世界设置三类查询（直接状态查询、全变换查询、显式初始状态查询）以分离"状态恢复"与"状态使用"。在此基础上提出 Operational State Supervision（OSS），对任务相关空间状态及其变换轨迹进行监督，并对齐跨上下文的共享事实。
AI.result: 实验揭示 availability–utilization gap：模型能从视觉证据恢复初始状态，但当该状态须驱动变换时却失败。Qwen3.5-9B 在 100 条正确恢复初始状态的序列中有 50 条全变换失败，而显式提供该状态可修复全部 50 条；该差距随模型规模增大而缩小但不消失。OSS 在匹配判断上的配对准确率提升，在依赖状态组织与使用的 L3、L4 层级上收益最大。
AI.conclusion: 评估多模态空间推理不仅要问模型能否看到并陈述空间事实，更要问该事实是否在后续计算中成为可用的状态。SpaceConflict 与 OSS 为这一更严格的空间推理评测与改进提供了基准与方法。

title: TasteBench: Multimodal Benchmark for Sensory Prediction, from Molecules to Sustainable Foods
comment: First two authors contributed equally. Accepted to NeurIPS 2026, Evaluations & Datasets track. Code available at https://github.com/Food-Intelligence-Lab/tastebench
summary: Sustainable protein discovery lacks the fast computational proxies, analogous to molecular docking or density functional theory, that accelerate drug and materials discovery. Evaluating whether a novel food tastes like its animal-based target requires expensive human sensory panels, bottlenecking the design-build-test loop. We introduce TasteBench, a multimodal benchmark and privacy-preserving competition for sensory prediction, spanning two tasks: a food-level ranking task built on 21K+ human evaluations across 215 plant-based foods in 24 product categories, yielding 935 within-category ranking pairs, and a supporting molecular-level taste classification task over 15K flavor molecules. To enable rigorous interpretation of model performance, we characterize the ground truth: inter-rater agreement among panelists is low (Krippendorff's $α= .077$), and the split-half reliability ceiling of panel-aggregated rankings is .825, establishing the range within which ML systems on this benchmark should be assessed. We evaluate baselines across four input modalities; on the same pairs panelists rated, the best model achieves .661 pairwise accuracy, competitive with the median individual panelist (.650), and .683 across all within-category pairs. TasteBench provides the evaluation infrastructure and baselines for measuring progress on computational screening for sustainable protein discovery.

AI.tldr: TasteBench：面向可持续蛋白发现的多模态感官预测基准与隐私保护竞赛，涵盖食品级排序与分子级味觉分类两项任务，并刻画了人类评价的可靠性上限作为模型性能的参照区间。
AI.motivation: 可持续蛋白发现缺乏类似分子对接或密度泛函理论的快速计算代理；评估新食品是否具有动物基目标的风味需依赖昂贵的人类感官panel，成为"设计-构建-测试"循环的瓶颈。因此需要一个标准化的计算评测基础设施来加速筛选。
AI.method: 提出TasteBench多模态基准与隐私保护竞赛，包含两任务：(1)食品级排序任务，基于215种植物基食品、24个产品类别的21K+人类评价，构建935个类内排序对；(2)分子级味觉分类任务，覆盖15K风味分子。刻画真值可靠性：评价者间一致性低（Krippendorff's α=.077），panel聚合排序的分半信度上限为.825。在四种输入模态上评估基线模型。
AI.result: 在panelist评分的同一批配对上，最佳模型达到.661成对准确率，与个体panelist中位数（.650）相当；在所有类内配对上达.683。
AI.conclusion: TasteBench为可持续蛋白发现的计算筛选提供了评测基础设施与基线，并给出应评估模型性能的合理区间（受人类评价可靠性上限约束）。

title: Hesitation Has a Geometry: Entropy-Trained Hyperbolic Probes for Sparse Activation Steering
summary: When a large language model solves a mathematical problem, its reasoning is largely hierarchical, and the solution often branches at a few tokens where the next-token entropy is high. Such tree-like structure embeds in hyperbolic space with far lower distortion than in Euclidean space. Activation steering, however, usually edits the hidden states of a pretrained model by adding one fixed Euclidean vector at every token, even though most tokens of a solution are already determined by the context. We propose Hyperbolic Entropy Steering (HEST), which embeds the hidden states in the Poincaré ball with a lightweight probe whose only label is the model's own next-token entropy. Where this entropy exceeds a threshold, HEST moves the embedded state along the geodesic of steepest descent of a readout of the probe and maps the change back to the hidden state. For the Busemann readout of a learned ideal point, we prove that a step of fixed length lowers it by the same amount at every state. On three instruction-tuned models from the Qwen2.5-Math and Llama-3.1 families, HEST with the Busemann readout improves greedy accuracy on MATH-500 and GSM8K in five of six settings, by up to 1.8 points, whereas a contrastive steering vector added at every token lowers accuracy. With a Euclidean probe trained in the same way, this gain disappears on Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B-Instruct. The gains are largest on problems where the model hesitates often, and accuracy on the remaining problems is almost unchanged.

AI.tldr: 本文提出双曲熵引导（HEST），将隐藏状态嵌入庞加莱球并仅以模型自身下一词元熵为标签训练轻量探针，仅在熵超过阈值的词元处沿测地线最速下降方向微调状态；在Qwen2.5-Math与Llama-3.1系列上多数设置提升贪心准确率最多1.8个百分点。
AI.motivation: 大模型解数学题的推理呈层级化、树状分支结构，且分支发生在少数下一词元熵较高的词元处；这种树状结构在双曲空间中嵌入的失真远小于欧氏空间。然而现有激活引导方法通常在每个词元处都加同一个固定的欧氏向量，忽略了大多数词元已由上下文决定这一事实，因而可能引入不必要的扰动。
AI.method: HEST用轻量探针把隐藏状态嵌入Poincaré球，训练标签仅为模型自身的下一词元熵；当熵超过阈值时，将嵌入状态沿某个探针读出函数的最速下降测地线方向移动，再把变化映射回原始隐藏状态。对学习到的理想点的Busemann读出，论文证明固定步长在每个状态下对该读出值的降低量相同。
AI.result: 在Qwen2.5-Math和Llama-3.1系列的三个指令微调模型上，使用Busemann读出的HEST在MATH-500和GSM8K的六个设置中有五个提升了贪心准确率，最高提升1.8个百分点；而在每个词元处加对比式引导向量的做法反而降低准确率。在Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B-Instruct上，若改用同样方式训练的欧氏探针，该增益消失。增益主要集中在模型频繁犹豫的问题上，其余问题上的准确率几乎不变。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，仅在模型高熵（犹豫）词元处进行双曲几何引导即可带来稳定增益，且该增益依赖双曲嵌入而非欧氏探针，验证了将推理树状结构建模于双曲空间并按熵稀疏干预的有效性。

title: Permutation Robustness Is Not Enough: Action Collapse in Multi-Agent Transformer Policies
summary: Transformer policies are attractive for multi-agent robot learning because self-attention can model interactions among agents. However, multi-agent teams are unordered, while transformers typically process agents as ordered token sequences. We study how this mismatch affects cooperative navigation policies under agent-order permutations. Our results show that low permutation error alone can be misleading: policies may appear robust simply because all agents choose the same action. We therefore evaluate policies using both permutation-consistency metrics and action-collapse diagnostics, including action diversity, same-action fraction, and maximum action frequency. A PPO-ID baseline yields non-collapsed behavior but remains order-sensitive, while strong equivariance regularization can still induce homogeneous behavior. A weak equivariance penalty improves the robustness while preserving more diverse actions for teams with \(N=3\) agents, whereas teams with \(N=4\) agents require substantially smaller regularization weights. These findings suggest that multi-agent transformer policies should be evaluated not only by return and permutation robustness, but also by whether they maintain non-collapsed, differentiated multi-agent behavior.

AI.tldr: 该研究指出，仅凭排列误差评估多智能体Transformer策略具有误导性，因为策略可能因所有智能体选择相同动作而看似鲁棒。作者提出结合排列一致性指标与动作坍缩诊断（动作多样性、同动作比例、最大动作频率）来评估，发现弱等变性惩罚在N=3时能兼顾鲁棒性与动作多样性，而N=4需更小的正则权重。
AI.motivation: Transformer策略因自注意力能建模智能体间交互而适用于多智能体机器人学习，但多智能体团队是无序集合，而Transformer通常按有序token序列处理智能体。作者旨在研究这种无序性与有序序列处理之间的不匹配如何影响协作导航策略在智能体顺序排列下的表现，并揭示现有评估方式的缺陷。
AI.method: 在协作导航任务中考察智能体顺序排列对策略的影响；采用排列一致性指标与动作坍缩诊断（动作多样性、同动作比例、最大动作频率）双重评估；对比PPO-ID基线、强等变性正则化、弱等变性惩罚在不同智能体数量（N=3、N=4）下的表现。
AI.result: 低排列误差可能具有误导性，策略看似鲁棒实则因所有智能体选择相同动作。PPO-ID基线表现为非坍缩但顺序敏感；强等变性正则化仍可能诱发同质化行为；弱等变性惩罚在N=3时提升了鲁棒性并保留更多样化动作，而N=4的团队需要显著更小的正则权重。
AI.conclusion: 多智能体Transformer策略的评估不应仅依赖回报和排列鲁棒性，还应考察其是否维持非坍缩、差异化的多智能体行为；等变性正则化强度需随团队规模调整。

title: Found but Not Read: When Extracted Text Closes the Retrieval-Reading Gap in Document Vision-Language Models
comment: 5 pages, 5 figures, 3 tables. Submitted to ICASSP 2027
summary: Retrieval-augmented document question answering assumes that once the right page is found, a vision-language model (VLM) can read it. We show that this assumption often fails, leaving a retrieval-reading gap: evidence found but not used. A paired protocol isolates this gap by comparing answers from the retrieved page images alone with answers from the same images plus their extracted text. On FoveDoc-Bench, our benchmark with traceable evidence, retrieval finds nearly every evidence page, yet adding CPU-OCR text raises strict accuracy by 13 to 16 points. An exact text layer roughly doubles the gain, which appears across six VLMs from three families and, within one family, narrows with scale without closing. The reader can read this evidence but cannot find it: crops of it recover most of the text gain, boxes around it on the page none. The same protocol identifies two boundaries. Extracted text helps on textual evidence but is neutral or harmful on charts and figures. Its advantage shrinks as retrieval degrades, and unrelated text of the same form adds nothing detectable. Extracted text is an amplifier of retrieval that works, not a substitute for retrieval that does not. Our code is available at https://github.com/atoz03/fovedoc-sup.

AI.tldr: 论文揭示检索增强文档问答中普遍存在"检索—阅读鸿沟"：证据页已被检索到，但VLM未能有效利用其中的证据。作者提出配对实验协议予以量化，并构建FoveDoc-Bench基准进行验证。
AI.motivation: 既有检索增强文档问答默认"只要检索到正确页面，VLM就能读懂"，但实践中这一假设常常失效，导致"证据被找到却未被使用"。作者希望严格隔离并量化这一检索与阅读之间的断层，并厘清抽取文本在何种条件下有效、何种条件下无效。
AI.method: 提出配对协议：同一批检索到的页面图像，一组仅输入图像，另一组输入图像加抽取文本，对比二者答案以隔离阅读环节的差异。据此构建带可溯源证据的FoveDoc-Bench基准，并在来自三个家族、共六个VLM上检验规模效应；进一步通过证据裁剪、页内边界框、不同证据类型、检索质量下降及同形式无关文本等对照实验定位边界条件。
AI.result: 检索几乎能召回全部证据页，但加入CPU-OCR文本后严格准确率提升13—16个点；使用精确文本层约使增益翻倍，该效应在六个VLM上一致出现，且在同一家族内随模型规模增大而缩小但未消失。裁剪证据区域可恢复大部分文本增益，而页内边界框标注则几乎没有帮助。抽取文本对文字型证据有效，对图表和图形证据中性甚至有害；检索退化时其优势缩小；同形式的无关文本无可检测增益。
AI.conclusion: 检索增强文档问答的瓶颈不在于检索本身，而在于阅读器对已检索证据的定位与利用。抽取文本是"有效检索的放大器"，而非"失效检索的替代品"，因此应结合证据定位机制并在文字与图表证据上区别对待。

title: Time Series Forecasting Benchmarks Need Scenario-Grounded Stress Testing
summary: Time series forecasting (TSF) increasingly drives decisions in transportation, energy, finance, healthcare, and infrastructure, yet current evaluation remains overly narrow: standard benchmarks reward low held-out error, while robustness studies typically reduce failure to Gaussian noise, random masking, or bounded adversarial perturbations. This obscures the real failure modes of deployed forecasting systems. Input-side anomalies are not merely noisier inputs: they often reflect structured events that alter temporal dynamics, break cross-variable dependencies, induce regime shifts, or propagate from faulty sensors to downstream decisions. These semantic, causal, and system-level failures cannot be faithfully captured by i.i.d. perturbations alone. The rise of TSF foundation models makes this evaluation gap more urgent, as unauditable pretraining corpora make held-out generalization increasingly unreliable. We therefore advocate scenario-grounded stress testing. Each test instance should include historical inputs and future targets, together with a semantic scenario, an explicit failure operator, and a measurable difficulty level. This shift makes evaluation interpretable, attributable, and deployment-relevant and friendly, enabling the community to ask not only which model is accurate, but under what conditions it fails and why.

AI.tldr: 该文指出时间序列预测(TSF)评测过窄，主张以"场景化压力测试"替代传统低误差/Gaussian噪声式评测。
AI.motivation: 现有评测只奖励低留出误差，鲁棒性研究又将失败简化为高斯噪声、随机掩码或有界对抗扰动，掩盖了真实部署中的失效模式。输入侧异常常反映结构化事件，会改变时序动态、破坏跨变量依赖、引发状态转移或从故障传感器向下游决策传播，这些语义、因果与系统级失败无法被独立同分布扰动刻画。TSF基础模型的兴起使该评测缺口更紧迫，因其预训练语料不可审计，留出集泛化愈发不可靠。
AI.method: 倡导场景化压力测试(scenario-grounded stress testing)：每个测试实例包含历史输入与未来目标，并附带语义场景、显式失败算子及可度量的难度等级。
AI.result: 该评测范式使评估具备可解释性、可归因性和部署相关性，使社区不仅追问哪个模型准确，还能追问模型在何种条件下失败及原因。
AI.conclusion: TSF评测应从追求低留出误差转向场景化压力测试，以揭示真实失效模式并支撑可部署、可审计的预测系统评估。

title: Inherit-MAS: Test-Time Evolution of Multi-Agent Systems through Workflow and Execution Inheritance
summary: Multi-agent systems (MAS) built from large language models coordinate specialized agents to tackle complex tasks, but effective workflows are difficult to design in advance. Test-time evolution refines workflows using execution feedback, yet broad revisions can disturb useful components, while re-executing unchanged requests can incur redundant computation. Inspired by the interplay of inheritance and selection in biological evolution, we introduce Inherit-MAS, which makes inheritance explicit at the workflow and execution levels. A meta-model first synthesizes a workflow of worker agents with declared roles, communication inputs, and tool permissions, and a separately prompted judge scores each executed candidate and diagnoses its deficiencies. In ordinary refinement rounds, \emph{workflow inheritance} starts from the latest completed candidate, may discard removable nodes judged unhelpful, and applies a validated edit to address the diagnosed deficiency. When the new candidate executes, \emph{execution inheritance} inherits eligible stored results only if the complete resolved request and execution context match, avoiding redundant model and tool calls. With GPT-4o-mini workers, Inherit-MAS achieves 55.4\% completion on WorkBench and 49.7\% joint F1 on HotpotQA FullWiki, outperforming EvoAgent, EvoMAS, and TacoMAS. With Qwen3-32B workers, it also exceeds these evolving-MAS baselines on both benchmarks. Compared with rerunning the same controller with execution inheritance disabled, execution inheritance reduces worker-token usage by 29.1\% on WorkBench and 34.6\% on HotpotQA, and total token usage by 5.3\% and 18.1\%.

AI.tldr: 提出 Inherit-MAS，将生物进化的“遗传与选择”映射到多智能体工作流，在“工作流层”和“执行层”显式引入继承机制，从而在测试时演化中减少冗余计算并保持有益组件。
AI.motivation: 基于大语言模型的多智能体系统需协调专用智能体完成复杂任务，但有效工作流难以预先设计。现有测试时演化方法存在两个问题：大幅修改会破坏已有有用组件；重新执行未变化的请求会带来冗余计算。
AI.method: 受生物进化中遗传与选择相互作用启发，提出 Inherit-MAS。元模型先生成含角色、通信输入与工具权限的 worker agent 工作流；独立提示的 judge 评估每个已执行候选并诊断缺陷。普通细化轮中，工作流继承从最新完成候选出发，可丢弃判定无用的可移除节点，并施加经校验的编辑以修复诊断出的缺陷。执行继承仅当完整解析后的请求与执行上下文匹配时，才复用已存结果，避免冗余模型与工具调用。
AI.result: 使用 GPT-4o-mini workers 时，WorkBench 完成率 55.4%，HotpotQA FullWiki 联合 F1 49.7%，优于 EvoAgent、EvoMAS 和 TacoMAS；使用 Qwen3-32B workers 时亦在两个基准上超过这些演化式多智能体基线。相比禁用执行继承重跑同一控制器，执行继承使 worker token 用量在 WorkBench 降低 29.1%、HotpotQA 降低 34.6%，总 token 用量分别降低 5.3% 和 18.1%。
AI.conclusion: Inherit-MAS 通过在工作流层与执行层显式建模继承，可在提升多智能体任务性能的同时显著降低 token 开销，为测试时演化式 MAS 提供更高效且更稳健的优化路径。

title: SceneFactory-3D: Lifting 2D Traffic Scenes into 3D Physical Counterfactuals for Scalable Physically Grounded Safety Evaluation
summary: Scalable driving simulators typically execute vehicle commands using prescribed behavioral or kinematic rules, overlooking the physics of tire-road interfaces, thereby limiting their ability to capture how adverse road and environmental conditions alter vehicle execution and propagate through traffic. To address this limitation, we present SceneFactory-3D, a GPU-batched, physics-grounded multi-agent driving simulator. Vehicles execute acceleration and steering commands via suspension- and friction-limited forces evaluated at each wheel-contact point. Spatially varying friction, per-world 3D heightfields, gravity, and rigid contact consistently govern wheel motion and chassis collisions. Per-world terrain isolation and GPU batching enable SceneFactory-3D to run matched physical counterfactuals in parallel: traffic scenario setup and vehicle controllers remain fixed while only the road condition changes, enabling the resulting closed-loop effects to be evaluated across parallel worlds. To demonstrate the advantage of the SceneFactory-3D-enabled counterfactual evaluation, we conduct an empirical study on vehicle controllers' sensitivity to road conditions. We study three learned-policy families on 1,024 matched 12-vehicle worlds per condition, and two classical planners on a shared 32-world subset, across 21 friction and grade conditions. When friction drops from 1.0 to 0.18, the share of vehicles that clear the work zone safely falls by 6 to 90 percentage points across learned policies (18-19 for classical planners), and near-collision situations become more frequent for every learned policy. Code: https://github.com/SmallWorldLab/SceneFactory_3D

AI.tldr: 提出GPU批量、物理接地的多智能体驾驶仿真器SceneFactory-3D，通过车轮接触点受力建模实现路面条件反事实并行评估；实验显示低摩擦条件下学习型策略安全通过率大幅下降。
AI.motivation: 现有可扩展驾驶仿真器多用预设行为或运动学规则执行车辆指令，忽视轮胎-路面接触物理，难以刻画恶劣道路与环境条件如何改变车辆执行并沿交通流传播。
AI.method: SceneFactory-3D采用GPU批量多智能体架构，车辆通过每个车轮接触点的悬架与摩擦力受限力执行加速度与转向指令；空间变化摩擦、逐世界3D高度场、重力与刚性接触共同约束车轮运动与底盘碰撞；通过逐世界地形隔离与GPU批量，在交通场景与控制器固定、仅改变道路条件下并行运行匹配的物理反事实。
AI.result: 对三类学习型策略在每种条件1,024个匹配12车世界、两类经典规划器在共享32世界子集上，覆盖21种摩擦与坡度条件进行实证研究。摩擦从1.0降至0.18时，学习型策略安全通过工作区的车辆比例下降6至90个百分点（经典规划器为18-19个百分点），且所有学习型策略的近碰撞情形更频繁。
AI.conclusion: 物理接地的反事实并行仿真揭示了控制器对路面条件的显著敏感性，SceneFactory-3D为可控条件下的闭环交通影响评估提供了有效工具。

title: Revealing Epistemic Uncertainty in MLLMs via Causal-Invariant Masking
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) suffer from hallucinations, creating a critical need for Uncertainty Quantification (UQ) to ensure reliable deployment. However, existing approaches struggle to detect uncertainty caused by superficial associations, especially when the query-relevant signal is weak. We mainly attribute this issue to their bias toward aleatoric uncertainty arising from data ambiguity, overlooking epistemic uncertainty stemming from model limitations. To further decompose uncertainty types for a comprehensive UQ, we propose Causal-Invariant Masking (CIM), which measures the semantic shift between the original predictions and those conditioned on a causally-focused view. Based on this framework, we introduce Semantic Divergence as our core metric for UQ and provide theoretical evidence that it converges to the variance of model's sensitivity to non-causal correlations, establishing its ability to capture MLLM's limitation. To accelerate UQ in MLLMs, we further propose Expected Embedding Drift (EED), a fast geometric proxy metric that estimates semantic shift directly within the hyperspherical embedding space. Experiments show that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance on various benchmarks, while the proposed EED accelerates by nearly 50% with comparable performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出因果不变掩码(CIM)框架与语义散度指标,分离认知不确定性,并给出快速几何代理指标EED,在多基准上达到SOTA且加速近50%。
AI.motivation: 多模态大模型(MLLM)存在幻觉,部署需不确定性量化(UQ)。现有方法难以检测由浅层关联引起的不确定性,尤其在查询相关信号微弱时;作者将其归因于方法偏向数据歧义导致的偶然不确定性,忽视模型局限导致的认知不确定性。
AI.method: 提出Causal-Invariant Masking (CIM):度量原始预测与以因果聚焦视图为条件的预测之间的语义漂移。基于该框架提出核心UQ指标Semantic Divergence,并从理论上证明其收敛于模型对非因果相关性的敏感度方差。进一步提出Expected Embedding Drift (EED),在超球嵌入空间中直接估计语义漂移的快速几何代理指标。
AI.result: 在多个基准测试上取得SOTA性能;EED在性能相当的情况下加速近50%。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式分解并度量认知不确定性,CIM与Semantic Divergence能更全面地进行UQ并刻画MLLM的能力局限,EED则提供了高效实用的近似方案。

title: VERSE: Verified Self-Evolving Optimizer for Agent Harnesses
summary: Harness evolution improves an LLM agent's prompts, tools, and workflow, while the optimizer's own tools and procedures often remain fixed. We study whether an optimizer can improve another agent more effectively by also improving how it diagnoses failures, develops edits, and tests their effects. Two observations guide our design. In a controlled study, optimizer self-evolution fails to improve performance without execution-based verification, but achieves the best result of that study when verification is available. Across five executors, self-evolving optimizers build their own tools for failure analysis, verification, training audits, and workflow control. Motivated by these findings, we introduce VERSE, a Verified Self-Evolving optimizer for agent harnesses. VERSE lets the optimizer test draft edits, replay failures, and perturb suspected steps before submission, while tracking fixes and regressions across rounds. Using this feedback, the optimizer revises both the executor harness and its own prompts, skills, tools, hooks, and notes, while the weights of the optimizer and executor models stay fixed. Under a shared protocol with disjoint training, validation, and test tasks, VERSE improves all four evaluated harness optimizers on held-out SWE-rebench tasks and newer out-of-distribution tasks in five languages. Its best validation-selected harness reaches 42.3% and 37.7% accuracy, respectively, against 39.2% and 29.3% for the strongest baselines. Code is available at https://github.com/wzekai/VERSE.

AI.tldr: 论文提出VERSE——一种经执行验证的自进化优化器，让优化器在改进被优化智能体harness的同时也改进自身的诊断、编辑与验证流程，在SWE-rebench及跨语言OOD任务上超越强基线。
AI.motivation: 现有harness进化方法通常只优化被优化智能体的提示、工具与工作流，而优化器自身的工具和流程保持固定；作者希望验证优化器能否通过改进自身的失败诊断、编辑生成与效果测试方式，更有效地优化另一个智能体。一项受控研究显示：无执行验证时优化器自进化无法提升性能，而有验证时效果最佳，这为设计提供了动机。
AI.method: 提出VERSE（Verified Self-Evolving optimizer），使优化器在提交前能测试草稿编辑、回放失败案例、扰动可疑步骤，并跨轮次跟踪修复与回归。基于该反馈，优化器同时修订被优化的执行器harness以及自身的提示、技能、工具、钩子与笔记，且优化器与执行器模型权重固定。采用训练、验证、测试任务不相交的共享协议进行评测。
AI.result: 在五个执行器上，自进化优化器会自行构建用于失败分析、验证、训练审计和工作流控制的工具。VERSE在留出SWE-rebench任务和更新的跨五种语言OOD任务上改进了全部四类评测的harness优化器；其验证集选出的最佳harness分别达到42.3%和37.7%准确率，而最强基线为39.2%和29.3%。
AI.conclusion: 在权重固定的前提下，优化器对自身流程的经执行验证的自进化能显著提升对另一智能体harness的优化效果，并在域内留出任务与跨语言OOD任务上均优于现有强基线。

title: Validated Data Onboarding for AI Demand Forecasting on U.S. Building Meter Data: Design, Controlled Evaluation, and a Corrected Negative Result
comment: Technical report; 8 pages, 5 figures, 2 tables. Code, data manifests, and reproducibility artifacts: https://github.com/LIANGYIXUAN3335/energy-data-onboarding-forecasting . Preprint; not peer reviewed
summary: Electric utilities and grid operators increasingly rely on machine-learning models to forecast next-day demand, and those models learn from meter data that is routinely defective: readings go missing, sensors freeze, buildings read zero for hours, and units change by a factor of 100. This report presents a data-onboarding pipeline that detects and repairs such defects before a model is trained, using only information available at forecast time, and a controlled experiment that measures whether the pipeline protects a 24-hour-ahead forecast. On hourly electricity data for twelve U.S. buildings from the public Building Data Genome 2 dataset (210,528 rows, 2016-2017), seeded, hash-logged defects touching 0.10% of the training period raised the error of a gradient-boosting forecaster by 86%; after detection and past-only repair the error returned to the clean-data level (mean absolute scaled error 0.760 clean, 1.415 corrupted, 0.729 repaired) while 93% of training targets were retained. At a defect prevalence calibrated to published field studies (1.6% of training rows) the unprotected forecaster's error reached 4.4 times that of a seasonal-naive rule, and the repaired forecaster again matched the clean baseline. The same pattern held for ridge regression and a random forest and across horizons of 1 to 24 hours. A first version of the pipeline over-cleaned natural data and made forecasts 25% worse; that result is retained, its cause is traced in the published artifacts, and the per-building calibration that corrects it is documented as a dated amendment. Every number is reproducible from pinned public inputs with SHA-256 verification, 84 automated tests and continuous integration.

AI.tldr: 该报告提出仅使用预测时可用信息的数据接入管线，在训练前检测并修复电表缺陷，并以受控实验验证其对24小时超前负荷预测的保护作用。
AI.motivation: 电网与电力公司依赖机器学习模型预测次日需求，但训练所用的电表数据普遍存在缺失、传感器冻结、连续零值、单位量级变化等缺陷，直接训练会导致预测误差显著上升，因此在建模前需要可靠的数据检测与修复。
AI.method: 基于公开 Building Data Genome 2 数据集中12栋美国建筑的小时级用电数据（210,528行，2016-2017年），构建仅使用预测时可得信息的数据接入管线，对人为注入并哈希记录、覆盖0.10%训练期的缺陷进行检测与"仅用过去信息"的修复；以梯度提升预测器为主，并在岭回归、随机森林以及1至24小时多种预测步长下重复对照实验，按已发表现场研究的1.6%缺陷率校准验证。
AI.result: 0.10%训练期缺陷使梯度提升预测误差上升86%；检测与仅用过去信息修复后误差回到干净数据水平（MASE 干净0.760、污染1.415、修复0.729），同时保留93%训练目标。1.6%缺陷率下未防护预测器误差达季节朴素规则的4.4倍，修复后再次匹配干净基线；岭回归与随机森林、1-24小时各步长均呈相同规律。首版管线对自然数据过度清洗，使预测误差增加25%，该结果被保留并追溯原因，其按建筑校准的修正以带日期的修订形式记录。
AI.conclusion: 仅用预测时可获得信息的检测与修复管线能有效抵御电表数据缺陷，保护次日负荷预测精度，且在多种模型与预测步长上稳健；所有结果可基于固定公开输入、SHA-256校验、84项自动化测试与持续集成复现。

title: MixVLA: Adaptive Mixing of Non-Invariant Information for Generalizable Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have achieved remarkable advances in robotic manipulation, yet their zero-shot generalization under out-of-distribution (OOD) conditions remains limited. These models often entangle task-relevant invariant structure with environment-specific non-invariant factors, causing policies to rely on spurious appearance cues during action prediction. In this work, we propose \textbf{MixVLA}, a model-agnostic training framework that improves the generalization of VLA models without requiring additional OOD data or architectural modifications. The key component of MixVLA is \textbf{Adaptive Mixing of Non-Invariant Information (AMI)}. AMI stochastically mixes non-invariant representations to regularize distribution-specific variability while preserving complementary predictive cues. The mixed non-invariant features are then fused with invariant representations for final action prediction, resulting in improved robustness without sacrificing policy expressiveness. Extensive experiments across challenging manipulation settings, including LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, the RoboTwin perturbation suite, and real-world tasks, demonstrate that MixVLA improves overall zero-shot robustness while retaining strong in-domain performance.

AI.tldr: 提出MixVLA模型无关训练框架，通过自适应混合非不变信息（AMI）正则化分布特异的变异性，提升VLA模型在OOD条件下的零样本泛化能力，无需额外OOD数据或架构改动。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA模型在机器人操作中表现出色，但在分布外（OOD）条件下的零样本泛化仍然受限。核心问题是模型将任务相关的不变结构与环境特异的非不变因素纠缠在一起，导致策略在动作预测时依赖虚假的外观线索。
AI.method: 提出MixVLA框架，其核心组件为自适应混合非不变信息（AMI）：随机混合非不变表示，以正则化分布特异的变异性，同时保留互补的预测线索；随后将混合后的非不变特征与不变表示融合，用于最终动作预测。该框架模型无关，不需要额外OOD数据或架构修改。
AI.result: 在LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus、RoboTwin扰动套件以及真实世界任务等具有挑战性的操作设置中进行了大量实验，结果表明MixVLA在提升整体零样本鲁棒性的同时，保持了较强的域内性能。
AI.conclusion: MixVLA通过解耦并正则化非不变信息，在不牺牲策略表达力的前提下显著改善了VLA模型的零样本泛化鲁棒性，是一种即插即用的通用训练方案。

title: ViTok: Improving Dense Semantics in AM-RADIO-Style Multi-Teacher Distillation with PHI-S and Masked Image Modelling
summary: We study how to consolidate the current VITOK progress into a single multi-teacher distillation recipe that jointly preserves global recognition and dense semantics. Our starting point is an AM-RADIO-style student distilled from SigLIP2 and DINOv3-L, where SigLIP2 supplies strong global semantics and DINOv3-L supplies stronger dense features. The central empirical issue is that the same recipe does not optimize all objectives equally well: changes that improve ImageNet-1K kNN accuracy can still degrade ADE20K segmentation. We summarize a progression of modifications that make this trade-off more explicit and more manageable: split adaptor heads for CLS and patch tokens, asymmetric cosine/MSE losses, initialization from a DINOv3-L checkpoint, teacher reweighting, masked image modeling (MIM), and PHI-S feature balancing. The resulting model reaches 83.2 patch kNN and 85.2 CLS kNN, slightly surpassing the DINOv3-L teacher on ImageNet-1K kNN classification, while PHI-S restores ADE20K performance from 46.5/58.1 to 48.5/61.0 mIoU/mAcc, matching the teacher on this dense benchmark. We also summarize negative results: scaling distillation from ImageNet-1K to ImageNet22K does not consistently help, and naively adding extra teachers such as SAM3 or HOG features introduces interference. Rather than claiming a final recipe, this paper distills the current project state into a compact empirical story and a concrete set of lessons for future iterations.

AI.tldr: 本文总结了一条多教师蒸馏配方的迭代经验：以 SigLIP2 与 DINOv3-L 为教师训练 AM-RADIO 风格学生，通过拆分适配头、非对称损失、教师重加权、MIM 与 PHI-S 特征平衡等改进，在 ImageNet-1K kNN 与 ADE20K 上分别达到 83.2 patch kNN / 85.2 CLS kNN 和 48.5/61.0 mIoU/mAcc，基本追平或略超教师；同时报告了 ImageNet22K 扩展与引入 SAM3/HOG 教师的负面结果。
AI.motivation: 现有 VITOK 进展分散，存在核心矛盾：能提升 ImageNet-1K kNN 分类精度的改动往往损害 ADE20K 分割性能，即全局语义与稠密语义难以被同一蒸馏配方同时优化。作者希望将该权衡显式化并加以可控管理，把当前项目状态沉淀为可复用的经验教训。
AI.method: 采用 AM-RADIO 风格学生模型，教师为提供全局语义的 SigLIP2 与提供更强稠密特征的 DINOv3-L。逐步引入并总结以下修改：为 CLS 与 patch token 拆分独立适配头、非对称 cosine/MSE 损失、从 DINOv3-L checkpoint 初始化、教师重加权、掩码图像建模（MIM）、PHI-S 特征平衡；并考察蒸馏数据从 ImageNet-1K 扩展到 ImageNet22K，以及额外加入 SAM3 或 HOG 特征作为教师的效果。
AI.result: 最终模型取得 83.2 patch kNN 与 85.2 CLS kNN，在 ImageNet-1K kNN 分类上略超 DINOv3-L 教师；PHI-S 将 ADE20K 从 46.5/58.1 提升至 48.5/61.0 mIoU/mAcc，在该稠密基准上追平教师。负面结果包括：从 ImageNet-1K 扩展到 ImageNet22K 并不稳定带来收益；朴素地加入 SAM3 或 HOG 等额外教师会引入干扰。
AI.conclusion: 本文不宣称给出最终配方，而是把当前项目状态凝练为一段紧凑的经验叙事与一组具体教训，说明多教师蒸馏中全局与稠密目标间的权衡可被显式建模和管理，并为后续迭代提供方向。

title: CuBEs: Culturally-Situated Behavioral Evaluations and the Limitations of Culture-Blind LLM Judges
summary: Evaluating the occurrence and triggers of large language model (LLM) behaviors - such as sycophancy, self-preference, or over-confidence - is critical for predicting real-world model deployment risks. However, existing situated behavioral evaluations typically ignore cultural context, limiting their generalizability across an increasingly global user base. To address this gap, we propose CuBEs - Culturally-situated Behavior Evaluations that probe for response patterns across diverse user cultures. We first extend an automated testing pipeline to inject cultural context into behavioral test scenarios and subsequent evaluation. We assess the cultural adaptability of this pipeline by building a human-labeled dataset that captures nuanced dimensions of behavior understanding across 12 distinct cultures. Our dataset reveals significant cross-cultural variations that one-size-fits all judgments fail to capture. Through evaluating 13 open- and closed-source LLMs, we find that introducing cultural situatedness in the evaluation scenario creates significant variation in the presence of a behavior. For example, while our baseline experiments testing for political bias capture localized Western political dimensions like the American conservative-progressive divide, non-Western culturally situated evaluations surface entirely different axes of bias such as religious and colonial political issues. Our findings demonstrate that standard, culturally-agnostic evaluations fail to capture these shifts, highlighting the necessity of culturally situated behavioral testing for global deployments.

AI.tldr: 提出CuBEs —— 文化情境化行为评测框架，通过将文化语境注入自动化测试流水线与评测环节，在12种文化上构建人工标注数据集，并对13个开源与闭源LLM进行评测，发现文化情境化会显著改变所探测到的行为表现及其维度。
AI.motivation: 现有情境化行为评测（如谄媚、自我偏好、过度自信等）通常忽视文化语境，导致评测结论难以泛化到日益全球化的用户群体，无法准确预测真实部署风险。
AI.method: 扩展自动化测试流水线，将文化语境注入行为测试场景与后续评测；构建覆盖12种文化的人工标注数据集以检验流水线的文化适应性；在13个开源与闭源LLM上开展基线对比与情境化评测（如政治偏见维度）。
AI.result: 人工标注数据集显示存在显著的跨文化差异，一刀切式判断无法捕捉；引入文化情境后，行为出现与否发生显著变化。例如基线实验仅捕捉到美国保守—进步等西方本土政治维度，而非西方情境化评测则浮现出宗教与殖民等完全不同的偏见轴线；文化无关的标准评测无法捕捉这些变化。
AI.conclusion: 标准化的文化无关行为评测存在系统性盲区，面向全球部署必须采用文化情境化的行为测试方法，以更可靠地预测跨文化场景下的模型风险。

title: VisAudit: Evaluating Multimodal Agents for Visual Diagnosis and Repair
summary: Multimodal agents are increasingly used for data visualization tasks but remain limited in autonomous review. Unlike humans, they may fail to recognize when a visualization is incorrect, determine what to change, repair it without disrupting correct content, and verify whether the intervention succeeded. Existing benchmarks largely evaluate predefined individual capabilities such as chart generation, instruction-guided editing, or defect detection, and therefore do not capture this gap in autonomous review. We introduce VisAudit, a benchmark for evaluating visualization diagnosis, repair, and verification. Given a rendered chart and configurable auxiliary evidence, including its source data table, intended text summary, and visualization code, an agent iteratively diagnoses potential defects, modifies and executes visualization code, inspects execution and visual feedback, and determines when no further intervention is needed. VisAudit defines three tracks spanning diagnosed repair, autonomous repair, and open-world verification, and contains 1,900 flawed instances across 21 chart types and 10 flaw categories, together with 300 initially correct charts. We construct the benchmark through controlled perturbations of validated source visualizations, with systematic verification and human-aligned quality control to ensure that injected defects are well-defined and recoverable from the available evidence. Experiments with leading multimodal models reveal a substantial gap from reliable autonomous review: the strongest evaluated model fully recovers only $47.4\%$ of flawed charts in the autonomous-repair setting.

AI.tldr: 本文提出VisAudit基准，用于评估多模态智能体在数据可视化中的自主审查能力，涵盖诊断、修复与验证三个环节。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态智能体在可视化任务中难以自主识别错误、决定修改内容、在不破坏正确内容的前提下修复并验证修复是否成功；而现有基准多评估预定义的单一能力（如图表生成、指令引导编辑或缺陷检测），无法刻画这一自主审查能力的缺口。
AI.method: 构建VisAudit基准：给定渲染图表与可配置辅助证据（源数据表、预期文本摘要、可视化代码），智能体迭代诊断缺陷、修改并执行可视化代码、检查执行与视觉反馈，并判断何时停止干预。基准设三个轨道：诊断式修复、自主修复与开放世界验证；包含21种图表类型、10类缺陷的1900个缺陷实例及300个初始正确图表；通过受控扰动已验证的源可视化并辅以系统验证与人类对齐的质量控制来构建。
AI.result: 在领先多模态模型上的实验显示，其与可靠自主审查存在显著差距：最强模型在自主修复设置中仅能完全恢复47.4%的缺陷图表。
AI.conclusion: VisAudit揭示了当前多模态智能体在可视化自主审查方面的明显不足，为该能力的系统评估与后续改进提供了基准。

title: From Language Priors to Field Adaptation: Preference Learning for Traversability Estimation
summary: Image-based traversability estimation is inherently dependent on the robot platform, deployment domain, and mission preferences, which limits the applicability of purpose-trained models. To facilitate domain adaptation, this work aims to reduce the number of required annotations in the target domain using sample-efficient preference learning. Our method represents traversability through von Mises-Fisher mixture prototypes in a frozen vision-language feature space. Relative natural-language rules provide a commonsense prior, while sparse relative image annotations adapt the prototype directions and utilities to a target domain through computationally and sample-efficient fine-tuning. Experiments on WayFAST demonstrate accuracy competitive with end-to-end trained estimators while enabling sample-efficient image-based adaptation. Qualitative experiments further demonstrate the language prior's zero shot applicability and the fine-tuned estimator's improved dense prediction on semantic maps. Evaluation is complemented via semantic interpretation of learned prototypes by dissecting semantically close natural language prompts. Code and trained estimators available at https://resireg.github.io

AI.tldr: 该工作提出基于冻结视觉-语言特征空间的von Mises-Fisher混合原型来表示可通行性，利用自然语言规则的常识先验与稀疏相对图像标注微调原型方向与效用，实现样本高效的目标域适配。
AI.motivation: 图像可通行性估计高度依赖机器人平台、部署域与任务偏好，导致专用训练的模型难以迁移，而目标域标注成本高。因此需要减少目标域标注需求以实现域适应。
AI.method: 在冻结的视觉-语言特征空间中以von Mises-Fisher混合原型表征可通行性；使用相对自然语言规则提供常识先验，并通过稀疏的相对图像标注对原型方向与效用进行计算机与样本高效的微调。
AI.result: 在WayFAST数据集上，精度可与端到端训练的估计器竞争，同时实现样本高效的图像域适配；定性实验显示语言先验具备零样本适用性，微调后的估计器在语义图上密集预测更优；通过拆解语义相近的自然语言提示对所学原型进行语义解释。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，将自然语言常识先验与稀疏相对标注结合于原型式可通行性表征，能够在保持竞争性精度的同时实现样本高效、可解释的域适配，代码与训练好的估计器已公开。

title: Custom Forcing: Training-Free Subject Customization for Autoregressive Video Generation
summary: Autoregressive video models can generate minute-long videos in real time, but they produce generic subjects from text rather than specific subjects from user-provided images. Existing customization methods either require costly per-subject optimization or use pretrained conditioning networks that jointly process all video frames with bidirectional attention. Neither approach is designed for causal streaming. We present Custom Forcing, a training-free method that stores reference-based anchor frames in the persistent KV cache of a frozen autoregressive video model. However, fixed anchors face two limitations: simple conditioning allows identity to drift, and the text prompt continues to favor a generic subject. To address these problems, drift-adaptive value amplification (DVA) scales reference influence with the degree of identity drift, while anchor contrast guidance (ACG) steers generation away from the generic class prior. Over two-minute rollouts, fixed anchors fall from 0.58 to 0.42 in DINO-I, while Custom Forcing keeps it between 0.58 and 0.62 without reducing motion. Custom Forcing also achieves higher subject similarity than bidirectional customization methods and better preserves identity over 30s than causal image-to-video and reference-to-video models, while generating each frame 9.5-28.5 times faster than these long-video baselines.

AI.tldr: Custom Forcing 是一种免训练方法，通过在冻结的自回归视频模型的持久 KV 缓存中存储基于参考的锚帧，并结合漂移自适应值放大（DVA）与锚对比引导（ACG），实现用户指定主体的长时视频流式定制生成。
AI.motivation: 自回归视频模型能实时生成长视频，但只能根据文本生成通用主体，无法根据用户提供的图像生成特定主体。现有定制方法要么需昂贵的逐主体优化，要么使用双向注意力的预训练条件网络联合处理所有帧，二者均不适合因果流式生成，因此需要一种面向因果流式、免训练的定制方案。
AI.method: 提出 Custom Forcing：在冻结的自回归视频模型的持久 KV 缓存中存入基于参考的锚帧。针对固定锚帧的两个缺陷（身份漂移、文本提示偏向通用主体），引入两项技术：漂移自适应值放大（DVA）按身份漂移程度缩放参考影响；锚对比引导（ACG）引导生成远离通用类别先验。
AI.result: 在两分钟以上的生成中，固定锚帧的 DINO-I 从 0.58 降至 0.42，而 Custom Forcing 保持在 0.58–0.62 且不降低运动幅度。其主体相似度高于双向定制方法，在 30 秒内身份保持优于因果图生视频与参考生视频模型，且每帧生成速度比这些长视频基线快 9.5–28.5 倍。
AI.conclusion: Custom Forcing 无需训练即可在自回归视频模型中实现基于图像的主体定制，在长时流式生成中有效缓解身份漂移和通用先验问题，兼顾主体一致性、运动幅度与生成效率，优于双向定制及长视频基线方法。

title: Lost in the Request: How Communication Variation Disrupts Retrieval and Action in Email Agents
comment: Accepted by NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Evaluation of Interactive Agents
summary: An email assistant should not complete less work simply because a user phrases the same request differently. Yet most benchmarks test each task with only one canonical request, leaving this form of robustness largely unmeasured. We test whether email assistants remain reliable when the requested information, available evidence, and expected outcome stay fixed, but the communication style or English variety changes. We construct validated variants along five communication-style axes and four rule-based dialect conditions, and evaluate them on three benchmarks: a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipeline and two tool-using agents. Indirect requests reduce performance on all three benchmarks, while formal requests reduce performance on both agentic benchmarks. Examining the systems more closely shows that these failures have different causes. Verbose requests mainly hurt a lexical retriever by making the relevant email harder to find. By contrast, indirect and dialect variants remain harmful even when the relevant email is retrieved. In the agentic setting, indirect and formal requests mainly cause the agents to omit required actions, not to take more unsupported actions. These results show that a successful response is not enough to establish robustness: evaluations should vary how requests are expressed and separately measure whether agents complete the requested work.

AI.tldr: 论文构建了5类沟通风格与4类英语变体的邮件请求变体，在1个RAG流程与2个工具智能体基准上评估鲁棒性，发现间接请求全面降效、正式请求使智能体降效，且失效原因各异。
AI.motivation: 现有邮件助手基准多以单一"标准措辞"测试任务，未衡量同一请求不同表述下的鲁棒性。然而现实中用户会以不同沟通风格或英语变体表达相同需求，助手不应因此减少完成的工作量，这一维度的鲁棒性基本未被测量。
AI.method: 在保持请求信息、可用证据与期望结果不变的前提下，仅改变沟通风格或英语变体。构建经校验的变体：5个沟通风格轴与4个基于规则的方言条件。在三个基准上评测：一个检索增强生成（RAG）流程与两个使用工具的智能体。通过细粒度分析定位失效原因（检索失败 vs. 检索成功后的生成/行动失败，以及遗漏必要动作 vs. 执行多余无依据动作）。
AI.result: 间接请求使三个基准全部性能下降；正式请求使两个智能体基准性能下降。原因分化：冗长请求主要通过使相关邮件更难被词法检索器找到而致错；间接与方言变体即使在相关邮件已被检索到的情况下仍带来损害。在智能体场景中，间接与正式请求主要导致智能体遗漏必要动作，而非执行更多无依据动作。
AI.conclusion: 成功响应不足以证明鲁棒性。评估应变换请求的表达方式，并单独测量智能体是否完成了被请求的工作（而非仅看输出是否看似成功）。这要求基准在表述多样性与任务完成度上分别度量。

title: Trained Agentic Context Management
comment: 17 pages, 6 figures, 4 tables. Code: https://github.com/brycesandlund/infinite-context. Under review
summary: We study long context language models. Instead of training long context natively, or designing a long context harness, we train a model over the simplest possible harness: a tool to call itself with any specified prompt and a tool to read tokens in a range from the input context. We finetune Qwen3.6-35B-A3B on a diverse synthetic dataset using this harness. With only 8,000 tokens of context, our small model is as strong as GPT-5.4 with 1M tokens of context on the OOLONG-synth benchmark when document length exceeds 40K tokens.

AI.tldr: 该工作不原生训练长上下文，也不设计复杂外部框架，而是让模型通过"自调用"与"读取输入上下文指定区间 token"两个最简工具来扩展有效上下文。作者用多样合成数据微调 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B，仅用 8K 上下文，在 OOLONG-synth 上文档长度超过 40K token 时即达到使用 1M 上下文的 GPT-5.4 的水平。
AI.motivation: 长上下文能力通常依靠原生长窗口训练或复杂的外部检索/编排框架实现，两者成本高、工程复杂。作者希望验证：能否用极简的"自我递归 + 区间读取"工具接口，以很小的上下文预算获得等效的长上下文能力。
AI.method: 构建最简工具框架：一是可携带任意指定 prompt 递归调用自身，二是可读取输入上下文中任意 token 区间。基于此框架，用多样化合成数据集对 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 做微调，训练时上下文仅 8,000 token。
AI.result: 在 OOLONG-synth 基准上，当文档长度超过 40K token 时，仅用 8K 上下文的微调小模型性能与使用 1M 上下文窗口的 GPT-5.4 相当。
AI.conclusion: 长上下文能力可通过极简工具化接口与针对性微调"外化"到递归调用与区间读取中，从而以远小于任务规模的上下文预算逼近大窗口强模型的等效表现，为长上下文处理提供了一条低成本替代路径。

title: On Representational Alignment among Embodied Agents
summary: Embodied agents interacting with the same physical process may maintain heterogeneous, asynchronous, and observer-relative representations. Rather than assuming that such representations should always be globally aligned, we investigate which distinctions among them must actually be resolved for coherent interaction. We formalize this question through relational sufficiency: an interaction-specific relational-evidence map defines the representational ambiguity left unresolved by comparison, and sufficiency holds when each residual ambiguity fiber lies within an interaction-equivalence class. When this condition fails, additional sensorimotor anchors must separate precisely the ambiguities that can change the interaction-relevant outcome. For smooth systems, we derive a local first-order lower bound on the number of inde- pendent scalar anchors required, given by the dimension of directions that are invisible to relational evidence but visible to the interaction-relevant map. We instantiate the theory in two variants of an asynchronous hand-off scenario that share the same observer agents, representations, transports, and relational evidence. Relative synchronization requires no additional anchor, whereas hand-off at an absolute time requires exactly one. The analysis there- fore provides a task-relative stopping condition for representational alignment: residual disagreement need not be eliminated when it is invariant with respect to the interaction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"关系充分性"（relational sufficiency）框架，将异质、异步、观察者相对的表征之间的对齐问题转化为任务相关的可判定条件：当残余歧义纤维落在交互等价类内时无需全局对齐；否则需引入最少量的传感器运动锚点。
AI.motivation: 具身智能体在与同一物理过程交互时往往持有异质、异步且相对于观察者的表征。既有研究通常默认这些表征应当全局对齐，但全局对齐代价高且未必必要。作者追问：为实现一致交互，表征之间究竟哪些区分必须被消解。
AI.method: 形式化"关系充分性"：用交互特定的关系证据映射刻画比较后仍未消解的歧义，若每个残余歧义纤维都落在交互等价类内则满足充分性；不满足时引入传感器运动锚点，精确分离能改变交互结果的歧义。对光滑系统推导局部一阶下界，给出所需独立标量锚点数的下界，等于"关系证据不可见但交互相关映射可见"的方向维数。并在同一批观察者智能体、表征、传输与关系证据下的两个异步交接（hand-off）场景变体中实例化该理论。
AI.result: 在一对照实例中，相对同步（relative synchronization）无需额外锚点，而绝对时间交接（hand-off at an absolute time）恰好需要一个锚点，与该下界一致，验证了理论的判别力。
AI.conclusion: 研究给出了表征对齐的任务相对性停止准则：当残余分歧相对于交互不变时，无需将其消除；仅需针对可影响交互结果的歧义引入最小锚点。

title: Kinematics-Induced Multimodal 3D Human Pose Estimation with Subject-Level Privacy
summary: Multimodal 3D Human Pose Estimation (3D HPE) combines complementary information from RGB, LiDAR, and mmWave radar, but models trained on correlated observations from the same individuals, raise privacy risks overlooked by record level analysis. We present a unified framework for multimodal 3D HPE that couples kinematics-induced sensor fusion with subject level privacy auditing and private training. First, our multimodal model aligns modality specific joint representation, injects skeletal structure and adaptively aggregates complementary sensor evidence for accurate pose prediction. Second, we formulate a black-box subject membership inference attack for 3D HPE, complemented by an empirical pointwise maximal leakage analysis, which characterizes how individual attack score outcomes change inference about the membership outcome. Third, we instantiate user-level differential privacy via Action Temporal Stratification, a population weighted within-subject sampling strategy that enforces action and temporal coverage. We evaluate our framework on the MM-Fi dataset across three diverse experimental protocols. Source-code will be released upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个统一的多模态3D人体姿态估计框架，将运动学驱动的传感器融合与受试者级隐私审计及隐私训练相结合，并在MM-Fi数据集上验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 多模态3D人体姿态估计融合RGB、LiDAR和mmWave雷达的互补信息，但现有模型在同一受试者的相关观测上训练，带来隐私风险，而传统基于记录级的分析忽视了这种风险。
AI.method: 方法包含三部分：(1) 多模态模型对齐各模态特定的关节表示，注入骨骼结构，并自适应聚合互补的传感器证据以预测姿态；(2) 针对3D HPE设计黑盒受试者成员推断攻击，并辅以逐点最大泄漏（pointwise maximal leakage）经验分析，刻画单个攻击得分结果如何改变对成员身份的推断；(3) 通过动作时间分层（Action Temporal Stratification）实现用户级差分隐私，这是一种群体加权的受试者内采样策略，用以保证动作和时间覆盖度。
AI.result: 在MM-Fi数据集上，跨三种不同的实验协议对框架进行了评估。源代码将在论文接收后发布。
AI.conclusion: 该统一框架将多模态3D HPE与受试者级隐私保护相结合，兼顾姿态估计准确性与隐私审计和用户级差分隐私训练。

title: Designing the Future of User Feedback for Generative AI
summary: Post-deployment feedback from users can be a cost-effective, scalable, and representative means to monitor and improve generative AI systems and features. When implemented effectively, giving such feedback can increase users' engagement with and trust in GenAI systems. Government regulations and industry guidelines call for post-deployment user engagement, but there is little guidance on designing mechanisms that are usable for consumers and provide actionable input for product teams. We conducted a multi-phase study as a collaboration between academic researchers and eBay. Our benchmark evaluation of current industry approaches identified common issues including lack of discoverability, unclear terminology, and inattention to user value. Based on these findings, we developed best-practice recommendations and designed and tested a prototype feedback-collection tool. The tool aimed to provide users with an efficient, flexible, and positive feedback-giving experience, and provide product teams with rich data on performance and potential problems in a usable format.

AI.tldr: 论文研究生成式AI系统部署后的用户反馈机制设计，通过与eBay合作的多阶段研究，评估现有行业方案、提出最佳实践建议，并设计测试了一个反馈收集原型工具。
AI.motivation: 部署后用户反馈是低成本、可扩展且具代表性的GenAI系统监控与改进手段，且能提升用户参与度和信任；政府法规与行业指南也要求部署后用户参与。但现有设计指南稀缺，缺乏兼顾消费者可用性与产品团队可执行性的机制指导。
AI.method: 学术研究者与eBay合作开展多阶段研究：首先对当前行业反馈方案进行基准评估，识别常见问题；据此提炼最佳实践建议；进而设计并测试一个原型反馈收集工具。
AI.result: 基准评估发现现有行业方案存在共性问题：可发现性不足、术语不清晰、忽视用户价值。原型工具旨在为用户提供高效、灵活且正向的反馈体验，并为产品团队提供可用的、关于性能与潜在问题的丰富数据。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为GenAI部署后用户反馈机制提供了设计指导与可落地的原型方案，兼顾用户端体验与产品端数据价值。

title: Efficient Neural Field Learning via Adaptive Coverage and Focused Sampling
summary: Implicit neural representations (INRs) provide a flexible framework for modeling high-dimensional continuous fields, but their training is often inefficient due to uniform subsampling that ignores spatial heterogeneity. Existing adaptive sampling methods partially address this issue by prioritizing high-error samples, but typically operate at the point level, often leading to redundant sampling in localized regions and insufficient coverage of the domain. We propose ACES (Adaptive Coverage-aware Efficient Sampling), a structured sampling framework that improves training efficiency by decoupling coverage and importance. ACES constructs adaptive spatial partitions to ensure domain coverage and reduce redundancy, and applies region-level importance weighting to prioritize informative regions during training. We provide a theoretical analysis showing that adaptive partitioning reduces gradient variance by increasing within-region homogeneity, and that controlled bias in region-level weighting may improve optimization efficiency relative to standard unbiased estimators. Experiments on scientific field learning tasks demonstrate that ACES achieves faster convergence and lower error than uniform and pointwise adaptive sampling baselines, with the largest gains in fields with highly localized complexity.

AI.tldr: 提出 ACES 结构化采样框架，通过解耦覆盖与重要性来提升 INR 训练效率。
AI.motivation: INR 训练效率低，因均匀子采样忽略空间异质性；现有自适应采样多在点级别，导致局部冗余采样与域覆盖不足。
AI.method: ACES 解耦覆盖与重要性：构建自适应空间划分以保证域覆盖并减少冗余，并在区域级别施加重要性权重以优先训练信息量高的区域。
AI.result: 理论分析表明自适应划分通过提高区域内同质性降低梯度方差，区域级加权的受控偏差可提升优化效率；实验中 ACES 收敛更快、误差更低，在局部复杂度高的场中增益最大。
AI.conclusion: ACES 在科学场学习任务上优于均匀与点级自适应采样基线，验证了结构化覆盖与区域重要性解耦的有效性。

title: Subject-Specific Predictive Musculoskeletal Simulations of Lower-Limb Exoskeleton Assistance: Metabolic and Biomechanical Effects of Joint Assistance Strategies
summary: Lower-limb exoskeletons have made considerable progress in reducing energy expenditure during walking. However, designing optimal assistance strategies remains challenging, particularly given inter-individual variability in anthropometry and biomechanics. This study explores energy-optimal lower-limb joint-assistance strategies using predictive simulations with musculoskeletal models. Subject-specific models of six able-bodied subjects, with BMI-based muscle strength scaling, were used in predictive simulations to generate gait at self-selected walking speeds. Ideal actuators were incorporated to simulate various combinations of joint assistance at peak levels of 25 Nm and 50 Nm to examine the effects of assistance on gait and metabolic savings. The effects of each assistance configuration were assessed through cost of transport (COT), joint kinematics, muscle activations, assistive torques, and joint-level power metrics to characterize the biomechanical and energetic impacts of different assistance strategies. At 50 Nm, combined H+K+A (hip-knee-ankle) assistance resulted in the greatest mean COT reduction of 48.50 +/- 4.55%, with individual reductions ranging from 42.22% to 54.65% across the subjects. Among single-joint conditions, assisting the hip was most effective, reducing COT by 31.77 +/- 5.21%; the knee and ankle produced smaller, comparable reductions (19.17% and 17.02%). H+A (hip-ankle) assistance (44.60 +/- 7.08%) emerged as the most effective two-joint assistive configuration. Increasing the torque bound increased positive assistive power primarily at the hip and ankle, while knee assistance showed little sensitivity and delivered positive power near pre-swing. These results support H+A assistance as an efficient two-actuator target, while identifying the knee's atypical pre-swing power strategy as a candidate for targeted experimental validation.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过肌肉骨骼模型预测仿真，系统评估了下肢不同关节助力组合（髋、膝、踝单关节及多关节组合）在25 Nm和50 Nm峰值下的能量最优性，发现H+K+A组合节能最多（COT降低48.50%），而H+A是最高效的双执行器方案。
AI.motivation: 下肢外骨骼在减少行走能耗方面已有进展，但最优助力策略设计仍具挑战，尤其受个体在人体测量学与生物力学方面差异的影响。作者希望借助预测仿真，探索能量最优的关节助力策略，并揭示不同助力配置对步态与代谢节省的作用机制。
AI.method: 采用肌肉骨骼模型开展预测仿真。为六名健全受试者构建个性化模型，并按BMI进行肌力缩放，生成自选步速下的步态。引入理想执行器，模拟峰值25 Nm与50 Nm下多种关节助力组合。通过运输成本（COT）、关节运动学、肌肉激活、助力力矩及关节级功率指标评估各助力配置的效果。
AI.result: 在50 Nm下，H+K+A联合助力获得最大平均COT下降，为48.50±4.55%（个体范围42.22%–54.65%）。单关节条件下髋部助力最有效，COT降低31.77±5.21%；膝与踝效果较小且相近（19.17%与17.02%）。双关节中H+A最有效（44.60±7.08%）。提高力矩上限主要增加髋与踝的正助力功率，膝部助力敏感性低，且其正功率出现在预摆动期。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持将H+A助力作为高效的双执行器目标方案；同时指出膝部在预摆动期表现出的非典型功率策略，可作为后续针对性实验验证的候选对象。

title: When Predicting Nothing Beats SAM 3: Revisiting Evaluation in Video Object Segmentation
summary: Video Object Segmentation (VOS) in complex and long videos is increasingly important for real-world applications, where target objects often appear only intermittently within long temporal horizons. However, existing benchmarks largely focus on temporally salient objects that remain visible for most of the video. To address this gap, we introduce FaVOS (A Benchmark for Video Object Segmentation with Fractional Temporal Visibility), a benchmark designed to evaluate VOS methods under low temporal visibility. We show that, in this regime, the standard J&F metric can collapse VOS evaluation into absence classification, because empty predictions receive high rewards on target-absent frames. Consequently, even a trivial empty-mask predictor can outperform strong models such as SAM 3, revealing a fundamental mismatch between current metrics and practical VOS performance. To mitigate this issue, we propose Volumetric J&F, which evaluates mask sequences as spatio-temporal volumes and reduces the dominance of target-absence rewards while preserving sensitivity to segmentation quality and temporal structure. Project page: https://aidaslab.github.io/FaVOS.

AI.tldr: 论文提出FaVOS基准，用于评估低时间可见度下的视频目标分割（VOS），并指出标准J&F指标在此场景下退化为“缺失判定”，进而提出Volumetric J&F指标以缓解该问题。
AI.motivation: 现有VOS基准多聚焦于在视频大部分时间内持续可见的时间显著目标，而真实复杂长视频中目标常仅间歇性出现。这一差距导致现有评测无法反映低时间可见度场景下的实际VOS性能。
