AI.method: 构建FaVOS基准（A Benchmark for Video Object Segmentation with Fractional Temporal Visibility），用于在低时间可见度条件下评测VOS方法；分析标准J&F指标在该场景下的失效机制；提出Volumetric J&F，将掩码序列作为时空体（spatio-temporal volume）进行评估，降低目标缺失帧奖励的主导地位。
AI.result: 在低时间可见度场景下，标准J&F指标会使VOS评测坍缩为“缺失分类”，因为空预测在目标缺失帧上获得高奖励；甚至一个简单的空掩码预测器也能超过SAM 3等强模型，暴露出当前指标与实际VOS性能之间的根本性不匹配。Volumetric J&F可降低缺失奖励的主导性，同时保持对分割质量和时间结构的敏感性。
AI.conclusion: 当前VOS评测指标与真实低可见度场景下的实际性能存在根本性错配；FaVOS基准与Volumetric J&F指标为解决该问题提供了新的评测框架和方向。

title: Batched Speech Decisions Without Decoding: Single-Token Supervision Lets a Frozen LLM Hear Beyond the Transcript
comment: 5 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables. Submitted to ICASSP 2027. Code and weights: https://github.com/adventists-ai/duplexjev
summary: Full-duplex voice agents make many small, closed decisions, which current systems answer by slow autoregressive decoding. We propose DuplexJev, which feeds ASR-encoder hidden states through a small connector into a frozen LLM and reads each question as a single-token distribution over its options. Nothing is decoded, and an 8-GPU node answers 80 decisions about eight utterances in about 0.1 s. With a last-layer connector, spoken QA stays close to reading the transcript (90% vs. 91%). DuplexJev also hears the speaker: gender and emotion accuracy both reach 90% (from 55% and 28%) with a cross-attention connector, whose spoken QA drops by only 1 point (83% to 82%). We train decisions with cross-entropy on the read-out answer token, instead of the usual transcript distillation, whose teacher never hears the voice, and keep distillation for content. Encoders and LLMs are interchangeable; we release weights, training recipe, a batched-inference pipeline for full-duplex serving and a bilingual spoken-QA set.

AI.tldr: 提出 DuplexJev，将 ASR 编码器隐状态经小型 connector 注入冻结 LLM，把每个封闭式决策读作单 token 分类分布，避免自回归解码，实现全双工语音代理的毫秒级多决策响应。
AI.motivation: 全双工语音代理需频繁做出大量小型封闭式决策，而现有系统依赖缓慢的自回归解码，延迟高、吞吐低，难以满足实时交互需求。
AI.method: 将 ASR 编码器隐状态经小型 connector 送入冻结 LLM，对每个问题的选项直接读取单 token 分布，不做自回归生成；采用两种 connector（末层连接、跨注意力连接），并用交叉熵在读出答案 token 上训练决策，仅对内容保留蒸馏。编码器与 LLM 可替换。
AI.result: 8 卡节点约 0.1 s 完成 8 段语音的 80 个决策；末层 connector 下语音问答接近文本（90% vs 91%）；跨注意力 connector 使性别、情感准确率均达 90%（分别从 55%、28% 提升），语音问答仅降 1 点（83%→82%）。
AI.conclusion: DuplexJev 以单 token 读出替代自回归解码，在保持语音问答性能的同时显著提升决策速度并赋予副语言感知能力，且具模块可替换性，并开源权重、训练配方、批推理流水线与双语语音问答集。

title: Prompted to Discriminate: Generalizing Malicious-Input Probes in the Wild
comment: 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026). Workshop: Agents in the Wild: Safety, Security, and Beyond
summary: LLM agents increasingly rely on activation probes as runtime monitors for prompt injection, jailbreaks, and unsafe requests, reading the model's own hidden state to catch a harmful input before the agent acts on it. A cheap, increasingly common move, borrowed from LLM-as-judge prompting, is to append a short classification instruction after the user's turn and read the probe at that point, to sharpen it: the instruction asks the model to represent the incoming request as a class, concentrating the signal the probe must separate, at negligible serving cost. But does the wording of that suffix matter, and does its benefit hold in the wild, on attack types the probe never saw in training, the regime a deployed monitor faces? We test this with a controlled ladder of post-user suffixes under strict leave-one-dataset-out (LODO) evaluation across 13 safety benchmarks (jailbreak, injection, and benign chat) and three open-weight model families (Llama-3.1-8B, Qwen3.5-9B, Gemma-4-12B). On a single-position probe, a classification suffix consistently improves out-of-distribution detection over no suffix (up to ~4 AUC points); yet which suffix matters: prompting the model to classify the input, even into content-free labels, reliably wins; an off-topic or merely-attentive suffix helps little. The gain comes from the classification format, not the named criterion: a content-free suffix matches the real malicious/benign one, with the criterion adding precision only at strict thresholds. This is not an artifact of the single-position read: the benefit carries to the multi-position pooling probes used in production (attention, multi-max, MLP), though the best-performing suffix there is readout-dependent. Served through a KV-cache fork, it is a cheap drop-in for any activation-probe monitor, though not an automatic win: which suffix helps, and by how much, depends on the model and the readout.

AI.tldr: 在13个安全基准、3个开源模型家族上采用严格LODO评估发现：在用户回合后追加"分类指令"后缀能一致提升激活探针的分布外检测性能（最高约4个AUC点），增益主要来自"分类格式"而非具体判定标准，且对生产中常用的多位置池化探针同样有效。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体越来越多地用激活探针作为运行时监控器（检测提示注入、越狱、不安全请求），而从LLM-as-judge借鉴的"追加简短分类指令"做法虽廉价常见，但其措辞是否重要、在训练时未见过的攻击类型（真实部署场景）上是否仍有效，尚不清楚。
AI.method: 构建受控的后缀阶梯实验，在严格的留一数据集（LODO）评估下，覆盖13个安全基准（越狱、注入、良性对话）与三个开源模型家族（Llama-3.1-8B、Qwen3.5-9B、Gemma-4-12B）；对比无后缀、分类后缀、离题后缀、仅注意型后缀，并在单位置探针与多位置池化探针（attention、multi-max、MLP）上验证，通过KV-cache fork部署。
AI.result: 单位置探针上，分类后缀相比无后缀在OOD检测上稳定提升（最高约4个AUC点）；让模型对输入分类（即使标签无语义）可靠占优，离题或仅注意型后缀收益很小；增益源于分类格式而非命名标准，无语义后缀可媲美真实恶意/良性后缀，具体标准仅在严格阈值下提升精度；该收益可迁移到生产中的多位置池化探针，但最优后缀依赖读出方式。
AI.conclusion: 经KV-cache fork部署，该方法可作为任意激活探针监控器的低成本即插即用方案，但并非自动获胜：哪个后缀有用、增益多大，取决于模型与读出方式。

title: Safe Streaming Flow Planning by Aligning Sampling Dynamics with Execution Dynamics
comment: Accepted to the 10th Conference on Robot Learning (CoRL 2026). Project page: https://jang-seunghwan.github.io/SafeStreamingFlowPlanning/
summary: Generative planners based on diffusion/flow matching can learn to synthesize long-horizon trajectories from demonstrations. However, real-world deployment requires (i) enforcing safety constraints during execution and (ii) tight online replanning at fast execution rates. Prior safe diffusion/flow planners generate the agent's full trajectory at once, while repeatedly perturbing intermediate states to satisfy safety constraints. This approach is not only computationally intensive, but also introduces distribution shift since the learned sampling dynamics is distinct from the system's execution dynamics. We propose SafeStreamingFlow, a goal-conditioned planner that aligns flow sampling dynamics with execution dynamics by sequentially integrating a learned state vector field with hierarchical state prediction. Importantly, we need to enforce safety constraints only for the executed step via high order control barrier functions. Across navigation, racing, and locomotion benchmarks, SafeStreamingFlow reduces planning latency and improves safety compared to existing methods, while maintaining competitive goal-reaching success.

AI.tldr: 提出SafeStreamingFlow：一种目标条件流规划器，通过将流采样动态与执行动态对齐，顺序积分学习的向量场并做层次化状态预测，仅在执行步上用高阶控制障碍函数施加安全约束，在导航/竞速/运动基准上降低规划延迟、提升安全性且保持竞争力。
AI.motivation: 基于扩散/流匹配的生成式规划器能从示范中学习长时程轨迹，但实际部署需要（i）执行时满足安全约束，（ii）以快速执行频率进行紧耦合的在线重规划。现有安全扩散/流规划器一次性生成整条轨迹，并反复扰动中间状态以满足安全约束，导致计算量大，且因学习的采样动态与系统执行动态不一致而引入分布偏移。
AI.method: SafeStreamingFlow：目标条件规划器。将流采样动态与执行动态对齐，顺序积分学习到的状态向量场，并采用层次化状态预测。安全约束仅对被执行的那一步，通过高阶控制障碍函数（HOCBF）施加。
AI.result: 在导航、竞速与运动（locomotion）基准上，相比现有方法，SafeStreamingFlow降低了规划延迟并提升了安全性，同时保持具有竞争力的目标到达成功率。
AI.conclusion: 通过将流采样动态与执行动态对齐并仅在执行步施加安全约束，SafeStreamingFlow在保证目标到达性能的同时实现了低延迟、安全性更强的在线重规划，适用于实时部署。

title: TerraVis: Towards Evaluation of World-Grounded Visual Consistency in Text-to-Image Generation via MLLM Workflows
summary: Recent text-to-image models have made substantial progress in photorealism, aesthetics, and text-image alignment. Yet visually appealing images can still violate real-world plausibility, exhibiting malformed object structures, impossible anatomy, physically implausible interactions, or inconsistent spatial relationships. Such failures are not well captured by existing fidelity, aesthetics, preference, or alignment metrics. To address this gap, we introduce TerraVis, a framework for evaluating world-grounded visual consistency in generated images. TerraVis defines a structured taxonomy of world-consistency violations spanning object-, interaction-, and scene-level failures, and employs a multi-stage evaluation framework to identify and quantify them. Given an image, TerraVis first uses an MLLM to assess its eligibility for evaluation, then detects violations across 18 taxonomy-defined types and classifies them as minor or major to derive an overall world-consistency score. Across diverse open-source and proprietary text-to-image models on two widely used benchmarks, TerraVis achieves the strongest correlation with human judgments of world consistency among existing metrics. Our benchmark results further show that models that achieve strong performance on conventional metrics can still exhibit substantial world-consistency failures. These findings highlight world consistency as a complementary evaluation dimension and demonstrate that TerraVis enables systematic quantification, diagnosis, and comparison of such failures. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/ShyFoo/TerraVis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 TerraVis，一个评估生成图像"世界一致性"的框架，通过结构化分类法（对象级、交互级、场景级共18类违规）和多阶段 MLLM 评估流程，量化图像在现实世界合理性上的失败，并在两个基准上取得与人类判断最高相关性。
AI.motivation: 现有文本到图像模型虽在写实性、美学和文图对齐上进步显著，但生成的图像仍可能违反现实世界合理性（如结构畸形、解剖异常、物理上不可能的交互、空间关系不一致）。现有的保真度、美学、偏好或对齐指标无法有效捕捉这类失败，评价维度存在空白。
AI.method: TerraVis 首先定义涵盖对象级、交互级、场景级失败的结构化世界一致性违规分类法；随后采用多阶段评估框架：给定图像，先用 MLLM 判断其是否具备评估资格，再在18种分类法定义的违规类型上检测违规，并将其分为轻微或严重，最终推导出整体世界一致性得分。
AI.result: 在多个开源与专有文本到图像模型、两个广泛使用的基准上，TerraVis 与人类对世界一致性的判断达到了现有指标中最强的相关性。基准结果还显示，在传统指标上表现优异的模型仍可能存在显著的世界一致性失败。
AI.conclusion: 世界一致性是一个互补的评价维度；TerraVis 能够系统性地量化、诊断和比较这类失败。代码已公开于 https://github.com/ShyFoo/TerraVis。

title: Coherence-Driven Belief Formation and Population Dynamics of Contagion in LLM Agents
comment: 18 pages, 6 figures. Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Foundations of Agentic Systems Theory (FAST)
summary: Models of social contagion usually assume how individuals adopt beliefs and derive population behavior from it. We instead empirically measure belief adoption in language model agents, quantifying the probability an agent adopts a claim given how many peers endorse it. We find this adoption kernel to be sigmoid, a characteristic of complex contagion, with a threshold that is sensitive to three sources: the claim's plausibility, the source's reliability, and the agent's disposition. These three dimensions are well approximated by a single effective dimension which we propose can be understood as the coherence of the incoming belief with the LLM agent's prior beliefs. Further, we observe a characteristic of complex contagion in the collective dynamics of belief adoption in a system of AI agents: further spread on clustered than random networks. These systems also exhibit a bifurcating cascade window, and self-sustaining hysteretic consensus which lead to consensus being far harder to remove than to establish.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过实验测量大语言模型智能体的信念采纳概率，发现其随认同同伴数量呈S型（复杂传染特征），阈值受主张合理性、来源可靠性与智能体倾向三因素影响，且可归约为单一"连贯性"有效维度；集体动力学上呈现聚类网络传播更强、分岔级联窗口与滞后共识。
AI.motivation: 既有社会传染模型通常预设个体如何接受信念并据此推导群体行为，而非对信念采纳过程本身进行实证测量。作者希望直接在语言模型智能体中经验性地刻画信念采纳规律，以检验复杂传染理论在AI智能体系统与群体行为层面的适用性。
AI.method: 以语言模型智能体为对象，测量其采纳某主张的概率关于认同该主张的同伴数量的函数，即"采纳核"；并考察主张合理性、信息来源可靠性和智能体自身倾向三个因素对采纳阈值的影响，尝试将其降维为单一有效维度。进一步在多智能体系统中比较聚类网络与随机网络上的传播差异，并分析集体动力学中的级联与共识现象。
AI.result: 采纳核呈S型曲线，符合复杂传染特征，其阈值对主张合理性、来源可靠性与智能体倾向均敏感；三者可由单一有效维度（推测为"与智能体先验信念的一致性"）良好近似。集体动力学上，聚类网络比随机网络传播更广，系统表现出分岔式级联窗口，以及自维持的滞后共识——共识一旦形成，比建立时更难被消除。
AI.conclusion: 语言模型智能体中的信念采纳遵循复杂传染规律，且其多因素阈值可归约为单一的有效连贯性维度；由此产生的集体行为具有聚类增强传播、分岔级联与滞后共识等特征，意味着AI智能体系统中的共识具有高度不可逆性。

title: The AI Theorist reveals excitonic structure in $α$-RuCl$_3$
summary: Advances in experimental instrumentation and automation generate increasingly rich datasets, but turning experimental observations into microscopic understanding remains a bottleneck in scientific discovery. To accelerate this process, we introduce AI Theorist, a system of artificial intelligence (AI) agents for autonomous discovery of physical models through hypothesis generation, first-principles calculations and evidence-driven refinement. We apply the framework to $α$-RuCl$_3$, a leading candidate material for realizing a Kitaev quantum spin liquid, to investigate its electronic structure through optical spectra. AI Theorist develops a new interpretation of the optical and photocurrent observations, identifying distinct excitonic states with contrasting optical selection rules and real-space distributions. To our knowledge, this is the first demonstration of an AI system autonomously developing a physical model to explain previously unpublished experimental observations in a quantum material, utilizing first-principles electronic-structure and many-body calculations. Our results establish a route to autonomous theoretical discovery in materials science, in which AI agents use first-principles calculations to turn experimental observations into physical models and testable predictions.

AI.tldr: 提出AI Theorist多智能体系统，通过假设生成、第一性原理计算与证据驱动迭代，自主构建量子材料物理模型，并以α-RuCl₃光学谱为例实现可检验的光学解释。
AI.motivation: 实验仪器与自动化产生海量数据，但将实验观测转化为微观物理理解仍是科学发现的瓶颈，尤其是量子材料中缺乏自动化理论建模手段。
AI.method: 构建AI Theorist多AI智能体框架，执行假设生成、第一性原理电子结构计算与多体计算，并通过证据驱动的方式进行模型迭代修正；应用该框架分析α-RuCl₃（Kitaev量子自旋液体候选材料）的光学与光电流谱。
AI.result: AI Theorist给出光学与光电流观测的新解释，识别出具有相反光学选择定则和不同实空间分布的多个激子态；据称是首个AI系统利用第一性原理和多体计算，自主提出物理模型解释未发表量子材料实验观测的案例。
AI.conclusion: 该工作展示了材料科学中自主理论发现的可行路径：AI智能体可借助第一性原理计算，将实验观测转化为物理模型与可检验预言。

title: Beyond Reward Hacking: Proxy Divergence Across Four Layers of a Staged Humanoid Learning Pipeline
summary: A reinforcement-learning (RL) pipeline for a legged robot is assembled from proxies. A reward stands in for intended behaviour, a curriculum gate stands in for competence, an evaluation statistic stands in for robustness, and a reference motion stands in for an achievable skill. The traditional view treats only the first of these as optimised against, and so locates specification failure (reward hacking) in the reward alone. I argue that all four are proxies in the same formal sense, that each has a characteristic divergence mechanism, and that each admits a reformulation that closes it. For every layer I state the traditional formulation, derive the condition under which it diverges from its target, and give the alternative: first-order (L1) costs where quadratic kernels are flat, peak and outcome statistics where curriculum gates average, gate reachability and information checks, deterministic and phase-desynchronised evaluation, curriculum state treated as part of the model, feasibility-first reference design with residual feed-forward, and function-preserving input widening that lets one policy grow instead of being retrained. The arguments are illustrated by measurements from one continuous lineage of a PPO policy for a simulated 1.91 m humanoid, grown over four stages and 13,500 iterations on a single laptop GPU. Among them, a curriculum gate built on averaged error advanced at its rate limit on every check while the skill it gated was absent, and a batched push test whose synchronised resets aliased the gait phase ranked a 0.5 m/s push as more dangerous than a 2.0 m/s one.

AI.tldr: 本文主张强化学习腿足机器人流程中的奖励、课程门控、评估统计与参考运动四者本质同为代理指标，各有其特征性偏差机制，均可通过相应重构予以消除；并用单一PPO人形策略谱系的实测数据加以佐证。
AI.motivation: 传统观点只把奖励视为被优化对象，因而将规范失效（奖励黑客）仅归因于奖励本身，忽视了课程门控、评估统计与参考运动同样是与目标存在偏差的代理，导致系统性误判与掩盖失败。
AI.method: 对四个层级逐一给出传统表述、推导其偏离目标的偏差条件，并提出替代方案：以L1代价替代平坦的二次核、以峰值与结果统计替代课程门控的均值、加入门控可达性与信息检查、采用确定性与相位去同步的评估、将课程状态纳入模型、以可行性优先的参考设计配合残差前馈，以及函数保持的输入加宽实现策略增长而非重训。以单张笔记本GPU上13,500次迭代、四阶段生长的1.91米仿真人形PPO策略谱系进行验证。
AI.result: 实测显示：基于平均误差的课程门控在每次检查中都以速率上限推进，而其所门控的技能实际并不存在；批量推力测试因同步重置与步态相位混叠，将0.5 m/s的推力误判为比2.0 m/s更危险。
AI.conclusion: 奖励、课程、评估与参考运动是同一形式意义上的代理，各自具有可识别的偏差机制与可封闭的重构路径；单一策略谱系的测量表明忽视这些代理层会带来实质性误判。

title: Post-Training Frontier Text-to-Image Models by Composing Preference and Rubric Rewards
summary: Recent text-to-image generation models have achieved remarkable visual quality, but improving them through post-training remains challenging because no single reward signal captures the full range of human preference. In this work, we develop a simple and effective post-training recipe for open-domain text-to-image generation based on the composition of complementary reward signals. Our reward system consists of two main components: a preference reward, trained on large-scale human preference data using a Bradley-Terry objective to capture overall human aesthetic and perceptual preferences, and rubric-based rewards, which explicitly evaluate prompt faithfulness and other desirable properties while providing safeguards against reward hacking. A key challenge is how to combine these heterogeneous reward signals. We show that a naive weighted average leads to suboptimal optimization behavior, and propose a simple reward composition strategy that more effectively balances preference optimization with rubric satisfaction. In the Arena text-to-image leaderboard (https://arena.ai/), our RL-trained Flux2dev achieves an Elo rating 69 points above the base model, and our post-trained Ideogram-4 surpasses every open-source model on the leaderboard, reaching an Elo of 1223.5. (Claims of state-of-the-art performance are based on the Arena leaderboard snapshot as of September 4, 2026.) Our results suggest that effective rewards for frontier generative-model training require broad coverage of user intent and robustness to exploitation under optimization. To support reproducible research, we release Arena-T2I-Training, a 1K subset of training data that recovers some gains of full-scale training, providing a resource that we hope will facilitate future work on post-training for text-to-image models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于互补奖励组合的开放域文生图后训练配方：以Bradley-Terry偏好奖励捕捉人类审美偏好，以规则化奖励评估提示忠实度并防止奖励黑客，并提出一种优于朴素加权平均的奖励组合策略。RL训练的Flux2dev在Arena榜单Elo提升69分，后训练的Ideogram-4以Elo 1223.5超越所有开源模型，并开源1K规模训练子集Arena-T2I-Training。
AI.motivation: 现有文生图模型视觉质量已很高，但后训练难以提升，原因是单一奖励信号无法覆盖人类偏好的全部维度：纯偏好奖励易被奖励黑客攻击，而仅靠规则化指标又无法刻画整体审美。因此需要构建覆盖用户意图且对优化利用具有鲁棒性的奖励体系。
AI.method: 构建由两部分组成的奖励系统：（1）偏好奖励，基于大规模人类偏好数据、采用Bradley-Terry目标训练，捕捉整体审美与感知偏好；（2）规则化奖励（rubric-based），显式评估提示忠实度及其他期望属性，并为防止奖励黑客提供保障。针对异质奖励信号的融合问题，指出朴素加权平均会导致次优优化行为，进而提出一种简洁的奖励组合策略，以更有效地平衡偏好优化与规则满足。
AI.result: 在Arena文生图榜单上，经RL训练的Flux2dev相较基座模型Elo提升69分；后训练的Ideogram-4以Elo 1223.5超越榜单上所有开源模型（SOTA声明基于2026年9月4日的Arena榜单快照）。同时发布Arena-T2I-Training——1K规模训练数据子集，可复现全量训练的部分增益。
AI.conclusion: 前沿生成模型训练所需的有效奖励需具备两个特性：对用户意图的广泛覆盖，以及在优化下对奖励利用（reward hacking）的鲁棒性。开源小规模训练子集为文生图后训练的可复现研究提供了资源。

title: A GHOST in Long-Horizon Agents: Governance Hazard from Overlooked Safety Constraints across Turns
summary: Long-horizon agents are now playing an increasingly significant role in assisting humans with complex problem-solving. However, it is exactly their extended interaction history that introduces an underexplored execution-safety concern. Under benign interaction conditions, an agent may execute an action that violates a safety constraint specified many turns earlier. We term this failure mode Governance Hazard from Overlooked Safety Constraints across Turns (GHOST), which may cause irreversible damage. Our experiments reveal that GHOST events are not isolated cases: this failure mode, occurring precisely under benign interaction conditions, yields an occurrence rate of 11.5% on GPT-5.5. Furthermore, we theoretically show that if the residual conditional violation hazard along each safe prefix is bounded below by a non-summable sequence, the execution enters the hazard region almost surely. Leveraging this theoretical insight, we further propose STAR-Guard, a two-layer defense coupling historical semantic safety constraint restoration with pre-execution audit. STAR-Guard restores applicable safety constraints to reduce unsafe proposals, while its deterministic audit layer prevents residual violations from reaching the environment. Consistent with this two-layer design, we observe no GHOST events in our experiments under the GPT-5.5 setup.

AI.tldr: 本文提出长程智能体在良性交互下因遗忘早期安全约束而违规的失效模式GHOST，实证其发生率可达11.5%，并从理论上证明其几乎必然发生的条件，进而提出双层防御方法STAR-Guard消除该风险。
AI.motivation: 长程智能体在复杂问题求解中作用日益重要，但其超长交互历史带来一个尚未被充分探索的执行安全问题：在良性交互条件下，智能体可能执行违反许多轮之前所设定安全约束的动作。该失效模式可能造成不可逆损害，且此前缺乏系统研究与应对手段。
AI.method: 作者首先将上述失效模式形式化为GHOST（Governance Hazard from Overlooked Safety Constraints across Turns），通过实验测量其发生率，并从理论上分析残差条件违规风险沿安全前缀的累积性质。基于理论洞察，提出STAR-Guard双层防御：第一层进行历史语义安全约束恢复以减少不安全提案；第二层为确定性预执行审计，阻止残余违规动作到达环境。
AI.result: 实验表明GHOST并非个例：在良性交互条件下，GPT-5.5上的发生率达11.5%。理论分析证明，若沿每个安全前缀的残差条件违规风险下界为一个不可求和的序列，则执行几乎必然进入风险区域。在GPT-5.5实验设置下，采用STAR-Guard后未观察到任何GHOST事件。
AI.conclusion: 长程智能体在良性交互中因跨轮遗忘安全约束而违规（GHOST）是一种真实且高发的执行安全风险，其理论机制可被刻画；STAR-Guard通过“约束恢复＋确定性审计”的双层设计，能够有效防止残余违规触达环境，实现零GHOST事件。

title: Geometry-Aware Time Reparameterization for Flow-Map Distillation
summary: Flow-map distillation enables one- and few-step generation by learning finite-time transitions of a pretrained generative ODE. We investigate whether changing the teacher's time parameterization can make these transitions easier to learn. Motivated by the hypothesis that trajectory segments with large normal acceleration are harder to distill, we propose a geometry-aware time reparameterization that allocates more student time to these regions while preserving the teacher's geometric paths and terminal distribution. We derive a shared clock that equalizes a population normal-acceleration statistic under suitable assumptions, and construct a practical approximation from robust, regularized estimates across teacher trajectories. We incorporate this clock into Lagrangian flow-map distillation, using the transformed time coordinate to condition the student. The clock is estimated once before distillation and requires neither teacher retraining nor additional student parameters or inference-time network evaluations. Experiments on synthetic data, CIFAR-10, and CelebA-64 show improved sample quality over identity-time distillation at matched inference budgets, including improvements in one- and two-step image generation. The gains in one-step generation, where no intermediate sampling times can be adjusted, highlight the benefits of time reparameterization during distillation.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出几何感知的时间重参数化方法，通过构造共享时钟将更多学生时间分配给法向加速度较大的轨迹段，从而提升流映射蒸馏的一步与少步生成质量。
AI.motivation: 流映射蒸馏通过学生学习预训练生成ODE的有限时间转移来实现一步/少步生成。作者假设轨迹段中法向加速度越大越难蒸馏，因此希望改变教师模型的时间参数化方式，使这些转移更易学习。
AI.method: 提出几何感知的时间重参数化：在保持教师几何路径与终端分布不变的前提下，构造一个共享时钟，使某种群体法向加速度统计量趋于均衡；在合理假设下推导该时钟，并基于跨教师轨迹的鲁棒正则化估计构造实用近似。将该时钟融入拉格朗日流映射蒸馏，用变换后的时间坐标条件化学生模型。时钟在蒸馏前一次性估计，无需教师重训练，也不增加学生参数或推理时的网络评估。
AI.result: 在合成数据、CIFAR-10和CelebA-64上的实验表明，在相同推理预算下，该方法相比恒等时间蒸馏提升了样本质量，包括一步和两步图像生成的改进。一步生成中无法调整中间采样时间，其增益进一步凸显了蒸馏过程中时间重参数化的价值。
AI.conclusion: 通过几何感知的时间重参数化使难蒸馏的高法向加速度区域获得更多学习时间，可在不增加推理成本的前提下提升流映射蒸馏的生成质量。

title: DexJoCo-X: Benchmarking Action Representations for Multi-Hand Dexterous Manipulation
summary: As dexterous hands proliferate, collecting data and training policies separately for every morphology becomes increasingly impractical. Scalable cross-embodiment learning therefore requires a unified representation that captures shared manipulation structure while preserving morphology-specific control. Differences in hands, tasks, datasets, and control interfaces prevent existing studies from isolating the effects of representation, pretraining, and architecture. We introduce DexJoCo-X, a benchmark and toolkit for controlled comparison across seven representative dexterous hands, six single-arm and bimanual tasks, and 2,100 balanced demonstrations. DexJoCo-X provides a matched multi-hand, multi-task protocol with common scenes, success criteria, and execution interfaces, redesigned glove-to-hand mappings, and an automated pipeline that expands reviewed demonstrations across randomized scenes. Using $π_{0.5}$, Ego-Pi, and Being-H0.5, we examine whether a shared action interface is sufficient for multi-hand learning. Expanding $π_{0.5}$ to an 80-dimensional bimanual output yields near-zero success. Ego-Pi preserves the pretrained action head through interleaved prediction and supports per-hand multi-task learning, but remains ineffective for seven-hand joint training. By contrast, Being-H0.5 combines cross-embodiment pretraining, a unified action space, and embodiment-aware experts, enabling one policy to control all seven hands. Within this architecture, function-aligned action slots achieve 47.7% mean success, compared with 47.0% for native coordinates and 33.1% for DexLatent. These results show that cross-embodiment representation depends on the entire learning system: action coordinates, pretraining, and architecture must jointly separate shared manipulation structure from embodiment-specific control.

AI.tldr: 提出DexJoCo-X基准与工具包，在七种灵巧手、六类任务、2100条平衡演示上进行受控跨本体学习比较，发现跨本体表征依赖动作坐标、预训练与架构的协同设计。
AI.motivation: 灵巧手种类激增，为每种形态单独采数据、训策略难以扩展；跨本体学习需统一表征，在捕捉共享操作结构的同时保留形态特定控制。现有研究因手、任务、数据集与控制接口不一致，无法隔离表征、预训练与架构各自的作用。
AI.method: 构建DexJoCo-X基准与工具包：统一场景、成功判据与执行接口的双手/多任务匹配协议；重设计手套到手部的映射；自动化流水线在随机化场景中扩增经审核的演示。基于该协议用π0.5、Ego-Pi、Being-H0.5进行对照实验，比较共享动作接口、原生坐标、DexLatent与功能对齐动作槽等方案。
AI.result: π0.5扩展至80维双臂输出成功率近乎为零；Ego-Pi通过交错预测保留预训练动作头，支持单手多任务学习，但七手联合训练无效；Being-H0.5结合跨本体预训练、统一动作空间与本体感知专家，实现单一策略控制全部七种手。功能对齐动作槽平均成功率47.7%，原生坐标47.0%，DexLatent 33.1%。
AI.conclusion: 跨本体表征效果取决于整个学习系统，动作坐标、预训练与架构必须协同设计，才能将共享操作结构与本体特定控制有效分离。

title: Rethinking Fixed Temporal Grids: Frequency-Disentangled Motion Generation
summary: Most human motion generation methods encode motion as tokens on a uniform temporal grid, where every token spans the same fixed time window. Human motion, however, is temporally heterogeneous: slowly evolving global trajectories coexist with rapid transient events such as foot contacts and joint impulses. Forcing such multi-scale dynamics onto tokens of identical temporal resolution entangles motion frequencies, leaving slow regions redundant while smoothing out the rapid details that distinguish realistic motion. We propose \textbf{FreqMo}, a scale-adaptive motion representation that decomposes motion into wavelet frequency bands, separating dynamics across temporal scales while preserving temporal localization and exact reconstruction. Unified Frequency Residual Quantization (UFRQ) then encodes all bands within a single shared codebook, compressing the token sequence threefold and enabling stable single-stage generation. Experiments show FreqMo attains SOTA fidelity with substantially improved high-frequency preservation, and the same decomposition transfers to continuous diffusion backbones.

AI.tldr: FreqMo 提出基于小波频带分解的尺度自适应运动表示，配合统一频率残差量化（UFRQ）在单一共享码本中编码所有频带，令牌序列压缩三倍并支持稳定的单阶段生成，达到 SOTA 保真度并显著改善高频细节保留，且该分解可迁移至连续扩散骨干。
AI.motivation: 现有人体运动生成方法将运动编码为均匀时间网格上的令牌，每个令牌覆盖相同固定时间窗。但人体运动具有时间异质性：缓慢演化的全局轨迹与快速瞬态事件（如足部接触、关节冲量）并存。将这种多尺度动态强制映射到相同时间分辨率的令牌上，会导致运动频率纠缠，使缓慢区域的令牌冗余，同时抹平区分真实运动的关键快速细节。
AI.method: 提出 FreqMo：一种尺度自适应的运动表示，将运动分解为小波频带，在时间尺度上分离动态，同时保持时间定位与精确重构；进一步提出统一频率残差量化（UFRQ），在单一共享码本内编码所有频带。
AI.result: 实验表明 FreqMo 达到 SOTA 保真度，高频保留能力显著提升；令牌序列压缩三倍，并支持稳定的单阶段生成；相同分解方式可迁移至连续扩散骨干网络。
AI.conclusion: 通过小波频带分解与共享码本量化，FreqMo 有效缓解了均匀时间网格带来的频率纠缠问题，在多尺度运动建模、生成稳定性与高频细节保留方面均表现优越，且具有良好的骨干通用性。

title: Spend Teacher Tokens Where They Matter: Success-Referenced On-Policy Distillation
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) combines student-generated rollouts with dense token-level supervision from a teacher, but providing such supervision for every rollout requires substantial teacher computation. We introduce Success-Referenced On-Policy Distillation (SR-OPD), which reduces this cost by selecting which prompts and rollouts receive teacher supervision. When the student produces both successful and failed rollouts for the same prompt, a successful rollout can serve as a natural reference for selecting failed rollouts. SR-OPD therefore focuses on such prompts and prioritizes failed rollouts whose hidden-state trajectories show sustained divergence from a successful reference, while accounting for estimated teacher-input cost. Across three teacher-student pairs and six mathematical reasoning benchmarks, SR-OPD uses only 3.46-5.02% of the teacher-input tokens required by Vanilla OPD in the one-pass setting while maintaining comparable reasoning performance. Under a controlled setting matched to 5% of Vanilla OPD's teacher-input budget, further experiments support both key design choices: focusing supervision on prompts with both successful and failed rollouts, and using successful rollouts to guide failure selection. These results indicate that a student's own successful behavior can serve as a useful reference for allocating teacher supervision under a fixed teacher-input budget.

AI.tldr: 提出 SR-OPD，通过仅在学生同时产生成功与失败 rollout 的 prompt 上进行教师监督，并以成功 rollout 为参考优先选择持续偏离的失败 rollout，从而将教师输入 token 降至 Vanilla OPD 的 3.46-5.02%，同时保持可比的推理性能。
AI.motivation: On-policy distillation (OPD) 结合学生 rollout 与教师 token 级监督，但对每个 rollout 都提供监督需大量教师计算，成本过高。核心动机是在固定教师输入预算下，更高效地分配教师监督。
AI.method: SR-OPD 选择哪些 prompt 和 rollout 接受教师监督：聚焦于学生同时产生成功与失败 rollout 的 prompt；在失败 rollout 中，优先选择其隐状态轨迹相对成功参考轨迹持续发散的样本，同时考虑估计的教师输入成本。
AI.result: 在 3 组教师-学生对与 6 个数学推理基准上，单次（one-pass）设置下 SR-OPD 仅使用 Vanilla OPD 教师输入 token 的 3.46-5.02%，推理性能相当。在与 Vanilla OPD 教师输入预算 5% 匹配的受控设置下，消融实验支持两个关键设计：聚焦于同时含成功与失败 rollout 的 prompt，以及用成功 rollout 指导失败选择。
AI.conclusion: 学生自身的成功行为可作为有效参考，在固定教师输入预算下指导教师监督的分配。

title: CRISP: A Framework for Clause-Reconstructed Interpretable NeuroSymbolic Propositions
comment: Preprint for an accepted paper at International Symposium of the Tsetlin Machine (ISTM) 2026 Conference
summary: Deep neural networks achieve high accuracy through layered numerical transformations, yet their decisions remain difficult to audit because decision evidence is encoded in hidden activations rather than explicit rules. This paper introduces CRISP, a framework that reconstructs the last-layer activation vector (LLAV) of binary neural teachers as Tsetlin Machine (TM) clauses. CRISP sign-binarizes the teacher's penultimate pre-logit activations, and assigns one Individual TM (ITM) to each LLAV neuron. Each reconstructed hidden bit is represented by propositional clauses over Booleanized input features, which gives a direct symbolic trace from named input thresholds to a named teacher neuron. CRISP is evaluated on MNIST, KMNIST, FashionMNIST (FMNIST), SVHN, and CIFAR10 using a BinaryConnect convolutional neural network (BCCNN) teacher and a fully binary neural network (BNN) teacher, with an additional study on binary thresholding, thermometer encoding, and quartile binning at multiple bit depths. The results show that LLAV sign-binarization does not reduce teacher-head accuracy in the tested BNN setting, while ITM reconstruction error is the main limiting factor. Quartile one-bit Booleanization gives the strongest reconstruction fidelity on SVHN at 87.52% test fidelity and is competitive on CIFAR10, and the reconstructed LLAV preserves 78.41% teacher-head accuracy on FMNIST. Pooled clause-evidence visualizations show that the learned ITM literals concentrate on the object region in centered benchmarks. CRISP therefore provides a clause-level route for inspecting the final hidden representation of binary neural teachers.

AI.tldr: 提出 CRISP 框架，将二值神经教师的最后一层激活向量（LLAV）重建为 Tsetlin Machine 子句，实现符号化可审计。
AI.motivation: 深度神经网络决策证据编码于隐藏激活中，缺乏显式规则，难以审计；需要为二值神经教师提供从输入阈值到隐藏神经元的直接符号追踪路径。
AI.method: CRISP 对教师倒数第二层 pre-logit 激活做符号二值化，为每个 LLAV 神经元分配一个 Individual TM（ITM），用基于布尔化输入特征的命题子句表示每个重建隐藏位。在 MNIST、KMNIST、FMNIST、SVHN、CIFAR10 上，用 BinaryConnect CNN（BCCNN）与全二值网络（BNN）教师评测，并研究二值阈值化、温度计编码、四分位分箱及多种位深。
AI.result: LLAV 符号二值化在测试的 BNN 设置下不降低教师头部精度，ITM 重建误差是主要限制因素；四分位一比特布尔化在 SVHN 上取得最高重建保真度 87.52% 测试保真度，在 CIFAR10 上具竞争力；重建 LLAV 在 FMNIST 上保留 78.41% 教师头部精度；池化子句证据可视化显示学习的 ITM 文字集中于中心化基准中的目标区域。
AI.conclusion: CRISP 为检查二值神经教师的最终隐藏表示提供了子句级途径。

title: HexVIO: Towards All-Day Stereo-Inertial Tracking Through Commodity DSPs
summary: The ability of a device to localize itself within its surroundings is a fundamental prerequisite for spatial computing. Visual-inertial odometry (VIO) has proven to be a cost-effective and accurate solution for this task. Robots, wearables, XR devices, and drones can benefit significantly from efficient implementations of VIO since they allow for cooler, lighter, and cheaper devices with longer battery life and a better user experience. In this work, we propose to enhance the efficiency of a VIO system by leveraging the Hexagon DSP, a commodity co-processor present in many modern smartphones and XR devices. Our approach offloads the visual frontend of a stereo-inertial odometry system to the DSP while keeping the backend on the main CPU. By optimizing the implementation for the DSP architecture, we achieve significant reductions in power consumption and latency compared to CPU-only execution. Our system, HexVIO, demonstrates a 67% reduction in power consumption or an 86% increase in throughput on a commodity smartphone, with the ability to sustain long-term real-time 30 fps tracking for 0.83 W, corresponding to ~18 hours of tracking on the testing device. These results highlight the potential of commodity DSPs for enabling all-day visual-inertial tracking in robotics and mobile devices.

AI.tldr: 提出HexVIO系统，将立体惯性里程计的视觉前端卸载到Hexagon DSP，后端保留在CPU，在商用手机上实现功耗降低67%或吞吐提升86%，以0.83 W持续30 fps实时跟踪约18小时。
AI.motivation: 视觉惯性里程计（VIO）是空间计算中设备自定位的基础技术，机器人、可穿戴设备、XR与无人机均需高效实现以降低功耗、重量与成本并延长续航，但CPU-only执行难以满足全天候实时跟踪需求。
AI.method: 利用现代智能手机与XR设备中普遍存在的商用协处理器Hexagon DSP，将立体惯性里程计的视觉前端卸载至DSP，后端保留在主CPU，并针对DSP架构进行实现优化，与CPU-only执行进行对比。
AI.result: 在商用智能手机上，HexVIO相较CPU-only执行实现功耗降低67%或吞吐提升86%，能够以0.83 W持续30 fps长期实时跟踪，对应测试设备上约18小时的跟踪时长。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明商用DSP具备支撑机器人与移动设备全天候视觉惯性跟踪的潜力，为低成本、低功耗的空间计算自定位提供了可行路径。

title: RYOPO: Bringing End-to-End Category-Level Object Pose Estimation into Real Time
summary: Category-level object pose estimation predicts the rotation, translation, and metric size of unseen instances within known categories. Many accurate RGB-D methods rely on external instance segmentation and crop-based pose estimation, introducing separate stages and object-dependent processing costs that hinder real-time inference. To bring accurate pose estimation into real time, we present \ours{}, an end-to-end trainable query-based RGB-D set predictor. It jointly detects and segments objects and estimates their \mbox{9-DoF} poses without explicit CAD-derived shape priors or a separately trained instance segmentor. Shared image and scene encoding avoids repeated per-object crop encoding. A query-conditioned geometry pathway associates observed 3D points and RGB features with object queries and incorporates shared scene context. Object-centric refinement uses the resulting point descriptors to update an explicit pose state through pose-conditioned cross-attention and recurrent residual corrections. On NOCS, \ours{} substantially improves on published RGB-D joint detection and pose estimation results. It achieves competitive performance compared with two-stage methods under all-object evaluation on REAL275 and HouseCat6D, while enabling real-time full-frame pose estimation at $31.8$ FPS on an RTX~A6000. Project page: https://yopo-series.github.io/RYOPO-project-page/.

AI.tldr: RYOPO：基于查询的端到端 RGB-D 集合预测器，联合检测、分割并估计未见实例的 9-DoF 位姿，无需外部实例分割或 CAD 形状先验，实现实时全帧位姿估计。
AI.motivation: 现有高精度 RGB-D 位姿估计方法依赖外部实例分割与基于裁剪（crop-based）的位姿估计，引入分离阶段和与目标数量相关的处理开销，阻碍实时推理。作者希望将精确位姿估计带入实时场景。
AI.method: 提出 RYOPO，一个端到端可训练的查询式 RGB-D 集合预测器：联合检测与分割目标并估计其 9-DoF 位姿，无需显式 CAD 形状先验或单独训练的实例分割器。共享图像与场景编码避免逐目标重复的 crop 编码；查询条件几何通路将观测 3D 点与 RGB 特征关联到目标查询并融入共享场景上下文；目标中心细化利用所得点描述子，通过位姿条件交叉注意力和循环残差修正更新显式位姿状态。
AI.result: 在 NOCS 上显著优于已发表的 RGB-D 联合检测与位姿估计结果；在 REAL275 与 HouseCat6D 的全目标（all-object）评测中与两阶段方法性能相当；在 RTX A6000 上以 31.8 FPS 实现实时全帧位姿估计。
AI.conclusion: RYOPO 通过端到端查询式集合预测架构，在保持与两阶段方法竞争性精度的同时，消除了对外部分割与裁剪编码的依赖，实现了类别级 6D/9-DoF 位姿估计的实时推理。

title: DataWeave: Deploying Human-LLM Analytics for Exploratory Structured Data Analysis
summary: Data journalism, the practice of using data analysis to surface newsworthy stories, depends increasingly on the ability of reporters and investigative journalists to uncover trends, disparities, and accountability narratives. In practice, exploring large structured datasets remains slow and brittle: journalists must navigate hundreds of variables across many datasets over years, understand data coding conventions, and write non-trivial analysis code while hypotheses evolve. Although LLMs are often touted as "ask in English, get SQL/answers," real newsroom workflows expose recurring failures, e.g., schema mismatches and drift, misread domain semantics and units, and silent assumptions. We present DataWeave, a system that addresses these needs by combining conversational interaction, schema grounding, analytical planning, and executable query generation to support exploratory analysis over structured data. Rather than treating LLMs as autonomous answer engines, DataWeave frames them as interactive partners whose outputs can be inspected, corrected, and steered as hypotheses shift. We present a case study with professional journalists using our system to analyze the U.S. Department of Education's Integrated Postsecondary Education Data System (IPEDS), a high-stakes public dataset with substantial domain semantics and frequent schema updates. We also report how deployment experience and iterative refinement shaped the current DataWeave architecture and its analytical workflow. Our findings distill design principles and deployment lessons for trustworthy human-LLM collaboration in structured data analysis.

AI.tldr: DataWeave 是一个结合对话交互、模式接地、分析规划与可执行查询生成的系统，用于支持记者对大型结构化数据集的可信探索性分析，并以 IPEDS 数据集的记者案例研究提炼人机协作设计原则。
AI.motivation: 数据新闻依赖记者对大型结构化数据集进行趋势、差异与问责叙事分析，但实际工作流缓慢且脆弱：需跨多年、多数据集处理数百个变量，理解编码约定并编写非平凡分析代码，且假设不断演变。尽管 LLM 常被宣传为"用英文提问即得 SQL/答案"，真实新闻编辑室却反复出现模式不匹配与漂移、领域语义与单位误读、隐性假设等失败。
AI.method: 提出 DataWeave，将对话交互、模式接地（schema grounding）、分析规划与可执行查询生成相结合，支持结构化数据的探索性分析。系统不将 LLM 视为自主答案引擎，而是定位为可交互伙伴，其输出可被检查、修正并随假设变化而引导。以美国教育部 IPEDS（具有丰富领域语义与频繁模式更新）开展专业记者案例研究，并结合部署经验与迭代改进塑造架构与分析工作流。
AI.result: 通过与专业记者使用 DataWeave 分析 IPEDS 的案例研究，验证了系统在真实新闻编辑室场景中的可用性，并记录了部署经验与迭代改进对 DataWeave 当前架构及分析工作流的塑造过程。
AI.conclusion: 研究提炼出面向结构化数据分析中可信人-LLM 协作的设计原则与部署经验，强调将 LLM 作为可检查、可修正、可引导的交互伙伴，而非自主答案引擎。

title: Are you Synthesizing or Recalling? Evaluating LLMs on Algorithmic Code Retrieval
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong performance in code generation, where success depends on both recalling relevant algorithmic knowledge and reasoning about how to apply it. However, existing LLM pipelines are opaque, with no explicit separation between these two components. We argue that for well-known algorithms whose canonical implementations are widely accessible in pretraining corpora, code generation is better measured as \textit{parametric code retrieval}: reproducing a named algorithm from internalised knowledge rather than synthesizing a novel one. We introduce AlgoREval, a benchmark of 599 problems spanning classical 77 algorithms across 14 domains, 7 programming languages, and 4 graph-input representations to evaluate this capability in isolation, and assess 15 models (7B--34B parameters) in a zero-shot setting. We find substantial variation in retrieval accuracy across languages and input representations, even for widely documented algorithms and show that prompt augmentation with retrieved code snippets or structured algorithmic hints improve accuracy on complex algorithms, while SFT achieves broader language gains and GRPO achieves larger per-language gains on specific languages. Together, our results establish parametric code retrieval as a distinct, measurable capability and caution against deploying AI-generated algorithmic code without systematic validation.\footnote{Code and dataset are available at https://github.com/Nickil21/AlgoREval

AI.tldr: 该论文提出将代码生成重定义为"参数化代码检索"，并构建AlgoREval基准（599题，覆盖77种经典算法、14个领域、7种编程语言、4种图输入表示），评测15个7B–34B模型，揭示检索能力在语言与输入表示间差异显著，并比较了提示增强、SFT与GRPO三种改进策略。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM代码生成流程不透明，未显式区分"算法知识回忆"与"应用推理"两个环节。作者主张：对于规范实现广泛存在于预训练语料中的经典算法，代码生成更适合被衡量为参数化代码检索（从内部化知识复现指定算法），而非合成新算法。但缺乏隔离评测这一能力的手段，因此需要专门基准。
AI.method: 构建AlgoREval基准：599道题，涵盖14个领域77种经典算法、7种编程语言、4种图输入表示；在零样本设定下评测15个模型（7B–34B参数），以隔离地测量参数化代码检索能力。同时对比三种增强策略：检索代码片段/结构化算法提示的提示增强、SFT、GRPO。
AI.result: 检索准确率在不同编程语言与图输入表示之间存在显著差异，即便对于文档化充分的算法亦然。提示增强（检索代码片段或结构化算法提示）可提升复杂算法上的准确率；SFT带来更广泛的语言层面增益；GRPO在特定语言上取得更大的单语言增益。
AI.conclusion: 结果确立了参数化代码检索是一项独立且可测量的能力，并警示：在没有系统性验证的情况下不应部署AI生成的算法代码。

title: Equivariant Visual-Tactile Diffusion Policy for Contact-Rich Manipulation
comment: 21 pages, 6 figures. Accepted to the 10th Conference on Robot Learning (CoRL 2026)
summary: Imitation learning for contact-rich manipulation requires high-quality expert data that is expensive to obtain. This makes learning a sample-efficient policy a key issue. To address this, we propose VISTA, a workspace-level equivariant visuotactile diffusion policy for data-efficient contact-rich imitation learning. VISTA projects visual and tactile observations into spherical tokens, injects tactile contact cues into visual spherical directions through permutation-equivariant spherical fusion, and rotates the fused harmonic representation using the end-effector orientation. The resulting representation conditions an equivariant diffusion policy to predict spatially consistent actions. Extensive experiments in both simulation and real-world robotic settings show that VISTA substantially improves data efficiency over strong visuotactile imitation learning baselines. Project website: https://vista-paper.github.io/

AI.tldr: 提出VISTA，一种工作空间级等变视触觉扩散策略，用于高数据效率的接触丰富模仿学习。
AI.motivation: 接触丰富操作的模仿学习依赖高质量专家数据，获取成本高昂，因此需要样本高效（数据高效）的策略。
AI.method: VISTA将视觉与触觉观测投影为球面token，通过置换等变球面融合将触觉接触线索注入视觉球面方向，并利用末端执行器姿态旋转融合后的调和表示（harmonic representation）；该表示条件化等变扩散策略，以预测空间一致的的动作。
AI.result: 在仿真与真实机器人环境中的大量实验表明，VISTA相较强视触觉模仿学习基线显著提升数据效率。
AI.conclusion: 工作空间级等变的视触觉扩散策略能有效提升接触丰富模仿学习的数据效率。

title: OmniAct3D: Leveraging Foundation Geometry and Evidence-Grounded Reasoning for Panoramic 3D Detection
summary: Accurate 3D detection is essential for mobile embodied agents, while Vision Foundation Models (VFMs) offer transferable visual and geometric priors. Yet existing VFM-based 3D detectors rely on narrow-view monocular images or discrete perspective views, limiting coherent surround perception; equirectangular projection (ERP) instead encodes a continuous 360 scene in a single image. Direct transfer remains difficult because ERP organizes geometry and visual information differently, making object-relevant cues hard to model, localize, and preserve. We propose OmniAct3D, a framework that adapts perspective-trained VFM detectors to ERP while preserving transferable VFM priors. To resolve geometric mismatch, the ERP-Ray Geometry Adapter (ERGA-Ray) models spherical viewing rays and periodic spatial structure. To localize evidence in scene-wide context, the Visual-Action Reasoning Chain (VARC) grounds each hypothesis in relevant panoramic evidence and converts it into a structured geometric action. To recover local cues lost under fixed token budgets, the Appearance-Guided Heading Expert (AGHE) re-encodes object regions at higher resolution for heading estimation. Experiments show that OmniAct3D improves over the previous best 3D detector by 2.96 NDS points on Spheriverse and over the unadapted VFM baseline by 24.87 mAP points on PanoMMOcc. With target-specific geometry adaptation, VARC retains 95--98% of the same-configuration mAP, indicating reusable object-level 3D reasoning across sensing configurations. The source code will be made publicly available at https://github.com/FeiT-FeiTeng/OmniAct3D.

AI.tldr: OmniAct3D将透视训练的视觉基础模型检测器适配到ERP全景，通过ERGA-Ray、VARC、AGHE三个模块解决几何不匹配、证据定位与局部线索丢失问题，在Spheriverse提升2.96 NDS、在PanoMMOcc提升24.87 mAP。
AI.motivation: 移动具身智能体需精确3D检测，视觉基础模型（VFM）可提供可迁移的视觉与几何先验。但现有基于VFM的3D检测器依赖窄视场单目图像或离散透视视图，难以实现连贯的环视感知；ERP虽可在单张图像中编码连续360°场景，但因其几何与视觉信息组织方式不同，导致目标相关线索难以建模、定位与保留，直接迁移困难。
AI.method: 提出OmniAct3D框架，将透视训练的VFM检测器适配至ERP并保留可迁移先验。包含三个模块：1) ERP-Ray Geometry Adapter (ERGA-Ray) 建模球面视射线与周期空间结构以解决几何不匹配；2) Visual-Action Reasoning Chain (VARC) 在全景上下文中为每个假设定位相关证据并转化为结构化几何动作以在场景级上下文中定位证据；3) Appearance-Guided Heading Expert (AGHE) 以更高分辨率重编码目标区域以在固定token预算下恢复局部线索进行朝向估计。
AI.result: OmniAct3D在Spheriverse上较此前最优3D检测器提升2.96 NDS；在PanoMMOcc上较未适配的VFM基线提升24.87 mAP。在目标特定几何适配下，VARC保持同配置mAP的95–98%，表明对象级3D推理可跨传感配置复用。代码将公开于GitHub。
AI.conclusion: OmniAct3D通过针对ERP的几何适配模块与视觉-动作推理链，有效弥合了透视训练VFM与全景ERP输入之间的几何与信息组织差距，在环视3D检测上取得显著提升，并展现出可复用的对象级3D推理能力，源代码将开源。

title: Large language models exhibit unreliable updating of clinical judgment as patient evidence evolves
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly explored for clinical reasoning, but whether they appropriately revise judgments as patient evidence evolves remains unclear. We evaluated longitudinal belief updating using matched intensive-care trajectories from electronic health records. Across diverse LLMs, conditioning on a preceding judgment more often increased than reduced prediction error when estimates changed, replicated for a second endpoint. Controlled interventions revealed two failure modes. First, with preceding assessment fixed, models responded more strongly to worsening than matched improving respiratory evidence; this asymmetry persisted after headroom normalization at moderate and strong evidence levels. Second, with current evidence fixed, increasing prior risk from 10% to 90% shifted estimates by 26.2 percentage points, demonstrating causal influence of prior model beliefs. Prompting did not restore reliable updating. Evidence-Validated Longitudinal Update (EVLU) identified fewer, more reliable revisions, revealing a reliability-coverage trade-off. These findings establish longitudinal belief updating as a distinct dimension of LLM reliability.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究大语言模型（LLM）在临床推理中的纵向信念更新能力，发现模型在证据演变时更常增大而非减小预测误差，并揭示两种失效模式及一种更可靠的更新方法（EVLU）。
AI.motivation: LLM 越来越多被用于临床推理，但其能否随患者证据的演变而适当修正判断尚不明确，纵向信念更新是否可靠构成 LLM 可靠性的一个独立维度。
AI.method: 利用电子健康记录中匹配的重症监护轨迹进行纵向信念更新评估；通过对照干预（固定前置评估、固定当前证据、调节先验风险）分离失效模式；并提出 Evidence-Validated Longitudinal Update（EVLU）方法。
AI.result: 以先验判断为条件时，估计值变化更多导致预测误差增大而非减小（在第二个终点上亦复现）；存在两种失效模式——对恶化证据的反应强于程度相当的改善证据（头room 归一化后仍存在），以及先验风险由 10% 升至 90% 时估计值偏移 26.2 个百分点；提示工程无法恢复可靠更新；EVLU 识别出更少但更可靠的修正。
AI.conclusion: 纵向信念更新是 LLM 可靠性的一个独立维度；提示无法解决更新失效，EVLU 揭示了可靠性—覆盖率权衡。

title: A Generative Model of Complex Networks Using Graphons and Neural Inverse Operators
summary: Generative graph models are central to understanding and simulating complex networks. However, existing approaches have complementary strengths and limitations. Mechanistic models offer interpretability but rely on instance-specific estimation methods. Deep generative models, on the other hand, offer amortized inference at the cost of interpretability and are largely limited to graph sizes seen during training. Scientific applications motivate a framework that retains the strengths of both paradigms. We bridge them by formulating both the generative model and parameter recovery in function space. A multifractal step graphon extends standard step graphons with a recursive construction that compactly parameterizes complex networks. This formulation admits a neural inverse operator to recover its parameters, enabling inference on unseen graph sizes. We evaluate our model, trained only on synthetic multifractal step graphon realizations, against both paradigms. Against a graph foundation model pretrained on empirical networks, our method achieves the best average performance on three of four metrics in a zero-shot graph-generation benchmark, indicating that the model transfers to real-world graphs. We also apply our method to single-observation networks, a regime largely inaccessible to deep models that require training corpora, where it performs comparably to an instance-specific method that optimizes on each graph. In a multi-subject EEG case study, the inferred parameters track a reversible change in brain state more sensitively than traditional network statistics. Together, these results indicate that mechanistic interpretability and amortized inference can be effectively unified in a generative graph model to enhance our understanding of complex networks.

AI.tldr: 该文提出在函数空间统一图生成模型与参数恢复，用多重分形阶梯graphon递归参数化复杂网络，并以神经逆算子实现跨规模摊销推断。
AI.motivation: 机制模型可解释但需逐实例估计，深度生成模型可摊销推断但可解释性差且受训练图规模限制，科学应用需要兼具两者优势的框架。
AI.method: 在函数空间中同时形式化生成模型与参数恢复；以多重分形阶梯graphon递归扩展标准阶梯graphon以紧凑参数化复杂网络；训练神经逆算子从其实现中恢复参数，从而支持未见图规模的推断。
AI.result: 仅用合成多重分形阶梯graphon实现训练，在零样本图生成基准中四项指标有三项取得最佳平均性能，优于在经验网络上预训练的图基础模型；在单观测网络上与逐图优化的实例特定方法相当；在多名受试者EEG案例中，推断参数比传统网络统计量更敏感地追踪可逆脑状态变化。
AI.conclusion: 机制可解释性与摊销推断可在同一生成图模型中被有效统一，并提升对复杂网络的理解与科学应用能力。

title: KungfuAthleteBot: learning high-dynamic humanoid motion from video with unified robust recovery
summary: Video is an abundant, inexpensive source of human motion data that is rich in extreme athletic behaviors. Making it usable for humanoid robots, however, is not a matter of simply retargeting a reconstructed trajectory: video-derived motion is physically inconsistent, devoid of actuation information, and says nothing about failure or recovery. We present KungfuAthleteBot (KAB), a framework that treats learning high-dynamic motion from video as the central problem and resolves each of these three failure modes in turn. (C1) We build the KungfuAthlete dataset from videos of national-level martial artists and introduce a physics-guided parabolic trajectory correction that removes height floating, ground penetration, and high-frequency jitter from reconstructed aerial and landing phases. (C2) Because video carries no force information, strict tracking of a reconstructed trajectory is dynamically infeasible, and error-driven initialization keeps re-launching the policy from infeasible aerial poses. We introduce physics-driven pseudo-low-kinetic-energy (LKE) sampling, our central mechanism for making such references learnable: it biases initialization towards dynamically feasible states, letting the policy discover feasible actuation patterns instead of imitating infeasible ones. (C3) Finally, we introduce a direct training paradigm in which disturbance rejection and fall recovery are learned inside the same policy that tracks the video motion, requiring no recovery reference data and no manual mode switching. On a humanoid robot, KAB learns dynamic skills from video and recovers from arbitrary falls in about 0.7 s, the fastest reported recovery for a unified policy. Ablations on the unified policy confirm the necessity of its components, supporting the view that repairing and compensating video data, rather than only collecting more of it, is what unlocks high-dynamic humanoid skills.

AI.tldr: KAB 将"从视频学习高动态人形机器人运动"作为核心问题，依次解决视频数据的三类缺陷（物理不一致、无驱动力信息、无失败/恢复信息），实现约 0.7 秒的最快统一策略跌倒恢复。
AI.motivation: 视频是廉价且海量的人体运动数据来源，富含极限运动行为，但无法直接用于人形机器人：视频重建轨迹物理不一致、缺少驱动力（actuation）信息、也不包含失败与恢复的过程。因此作者主张关键不在于收集更多视频，而在于"修复与补偿"视频数据。
AI.method: 框架分三部分：(C1) 构建 KungfuAthlete 数据集（国家级武术运动员视频），引入物理引导的抛物线轨迹修正，消除空中与落地阶段的悬浮、穿地和抖动；(C2) 提出物理驱动的伪低动能（LKE）采样，将策略初始化偏向动力学可行状态，使策略能自行发现可行驱动力模式，而非模仿不可行轨迹；(C3) 提出直接训练范式，在同一策略内同时学习视频运动跟踪、抗扰动与跌倒恢复，无需恢复参考数据和人工模式切换。
AI.result: 在人形机器人上，KAB 从视频学到动态技能，并能在约 0.7 秒内从任意跌倒中恢复，为已报道的统一策略最快恢复速度；对统一策略的消融实验验证了各组件的必要性。
AI.conclusion: 修复与补偿视频数据（而非单纯扩大数据量）是解锁高动态人形机器人技能的关键；所提三类机制分别对应并解决了视频数据的三种失效模式。

title: ReSCUE: Re-translation with Sentence Commitment for Unsegmented Long-Form Simultaneous Sign Language Translation
summary: Simultaneous Sign Language Translation (SLT) is critical for real-time communication, yet existing methods remain largely confined to sentence-level, offline settings that assume pre-segmented inputs. These assumptions hinder deployment in realistic scenarios involving continuous, unsegmented video streams. We present ReSCUE, a unified framework for simultaneous SLT on unsegmented long-form sign language videos that aligns training and inference with realistic streaming conditions. ReSCUE combines inference-aware training to handle partial inputs, non-signing pauses, and multi-sentence contexts, stabilized re-translation to enable low-latency yet revisable predictions with reduced output flicker, and a sentence commitment mechanism for online segmentation and memory management. Experiments on standard sentence-level benchmarks show that ReSCUE achieves lower latency and the best translation quality under low-latency settings. On long-form unsegmented datasets, ReSCUE approaches the translation quality of oracle offline systems that use ground-truth sentence boundaries, while operating at substantially lower latency, demonstrating its practicality for real-world streaming scenarios.

AI.tldr: ReSCUE 是一个面向未分段长视频的同步手语翻译统一框架，通过推理感知训练、稳定重翻译和句子提交机制，在低延迟下实现接近离线上限的翻译质量。
AI.motivation: 现有同步手语翻译方法多局限于句子级、离线场景，假设输入已预分段，无法适应连续、未分段的视频流，难以在真实场景部署。
AI.method: ReSCUE 通过三项机制实现训练与推理条件对齐：推理感知训练以处理部分输入、非手语停顿及多句上下文；稳定重翻译以支持低延迟且可修订的预测并减少输出闪烁；句子提交机制用于在线分段与内存管理。
AI.result: 在标准句子级基准上，ReSCUE 在低延迟设置下取得更低延迟和最优翻译质量；在长视频未分段数据集上，其翻译质量接近使用真实句子边界的离线 oracle 系统，同时延迟显著更低。
AI.conclusion: ReSCUE 证明了同步手语翻译在真实流式场景中的可行性，为未分段长视频的实时手语翻译提供了实用方案。

title: Decoupling Memory from Context: Structured Memory for Token-Efficient Test-Time Continual Learning
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in enterprise, scientific, and medical applications, where agents must incorporate domain-specific knowledge and adapt from experience. Context engineering offers a practical alternative to weight updates by improving model behavior through instructions, strategies, and evidence supplied at inference time. However, adapting context online typically requires a costly trial-and-error process, while queries are often processed independently, preventing useful experience from carrying forward. Memory systems address this limitation by retaining information across interactions, but approaches that continually append information to a shared context face increasing token costs, context-window limits, and performance degradation as the context expands. We introduce a unified formulation of context optimization and show that an agent memory system update can be interpreted as an optimization update procedure over the model's context. This perspective attempts to provide a principled framework for studying memory design and its efficiency. We then propose GraphMemory, a lightweight graph-based memory that accumulates, refines, organizes, and connects reusable strategies. For each query, GraphMemory retrieves only the relevant subgraph, enabling online context adaptation without exposing the model to the entire memory. Under bounded retrieval, the amount of retrieved memory remains constant as the number of processed examples grows. Experiments show that GraphMemory achieves competitive downstream performance while using approximately 81-85% fewer memory-construction tokens than our baselines.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出统一的上下文优化框架，将智能体记忆系统的更新解释为对模型上下文的优化更新过程，并据此设计轻量级图结构记忆系统 GraphMemory，通过检索相关子图实现高效在线上下文自适应。
AI.motivation: 大模型在企业、科研、医疗等场景需融入领域知识并从经验中学习。上下文工程相较权重更新更实用，但在线调整上下文通常依赖代价高昂的试错，且查询往往被独立处理，经验无法累积。已有的记忆系统通过持续追加信息到共享上下文来缓解该问题，却面临token成本上升、上下文窗口受限及随上下文膨胀而性能退化的问题。因此需要一个有原则的记忆设计框架，兼顾经验累积与效率。
AI.method: 作者首先给出上下文优化的统一建模，证明智能体记忆系统的更新可视为对模型上下文的一种优化更新过程，从而为记忆设计及其效率分析提供理论框架。基于此提出 GraphMemory：一种轻量级、基于图的记忆结构，能够累积、精炼、组织并连接可复用的策略。对每个查询，仅检索相关子图，实现无需暴露整个记忆的在线上下文自适应；在有界检索下，检索到的记忆量随已处理样本数增长而保持恒定。
AI.result: 实验表明，GraphMemory 在下游任务上达到有竞争力的性能，同时相比基线减少了约 81-85% 的记忆构建 token 消耗。
AI.conclusion: 该工作通过上下文优化的统一视角为记忆系统设计提供了原则性框架，并验证了图结构、按需检索的记忆机制能在保持性能的同时显著降低记忆构建开销，为可扩展的智能体记忆提供了高效方案。

title: Bandits via Additive Quantized Representations
comment: 40 pages, 16 figures, 12 tables. Accepted at NeurIPS 2026
summary: Contextual bandits require balancing nonlinear reward modeling with online efficiency. Tree ensembles and neural methods capture nonlinearities but require periodic retraining and large replay buffers. Linear models update efficiently per observation with O(1) memory, but are fundamentally restricted to linear reward structures. We propose Residual Quantization (RQ) as a representation layer to bridge this gap. An offline-trained RQ codebook maps continuous contexts into discrete centroid assignments across multiple levels, set dynamically through a shadow mechanism. This enables a spectrum of additive bandit algorithms that achieve nonlinear expressivity with strictly bounded memory. Across 13 datasets, RQ variants beat their non-RQ counterparts on 11 of 13 datasets, often by wide margins, while matching doubling-retrain XGBoost and neural baselines using up to 1000 times less memory.

AI.tldr: 提出残差量化(RQ)作为表示层，将连续上下文映射为多层级离散质心分配，使加性线性bandit算法具备非线性表达能力且内存严格受限。
AI.motivation: 上下文bandit需在非线性奖励建模与在线效率间权衡：树集成与神经方法能捕捉非线性，但需周期性重训练和大回放缓冲区；线性模型可O(1)内存逐观测高效更新，却受限于线性奖励结构。
AI.method: 离线训练RQ码本，通过多层级将连续上下文映射为离散质心分配，并借助shadow机制动态设定，从而构建一系列加性bandit算法。
AI.result: 在13个数据集上，RQ变体在11个数据集上优于非RQ对应方法，且常优势明显；同时以最多少1000倍的内存匹配doubling-retrain XGBoost与神经基线。
AI.conclusion: RQ有效弥合了非线性表达与在线效率之间的鸿沟，在近乎不增加内存的前提下显著提升加性bandit算法表现。

title: I2CD: Direct Image-to-Convex Decomposition for Simulation-Ready Collision Geometry
summary: Physics simulators and motion planners require convex collision geometry, yet image-to-3D generative models output dense, frequently non-manifold visual meshes. Bridging the two today takes a slow, brittle reconstruct-then-decompose pipeline of repair, decimation, and approximate convex decomposition. We present I2CD, which predicts a convex decomposition directly from a single RGB image. Rather than train a new image-to-3D model, I2CD freezes the pretrained Hunyuan3D-2 image-conditioned diffusion transformer and shape decoder and trains only a lightweight cross-attention head (38M parameters, under ten GPU-hours) whose learned "convex-slot" tokens emit the halfplane parameters of $K$ convex polytopes. The output is compact, convex by construction, and loads into physics engines without any post-processing, in ${\sim}0.5$s per image. On $227$ held-out OmniObject3D and Google Scanned Objects instances, I2CD attains the highest volumetric IoU among eight reconstruct-then-decompose pipelines while running $6$-$37\times$ faster end-to-end. In a cross-simulator study in MuJoCo, PyBullet, Genesis, and Isaac Sim, every engine uses I2CD geometry as delivered, whereas raw generated meshes "load" everywhere but are silently replaced by a different collision shape in most cases or need seconds to minutes of per-object preprocessing. On a physical xArm7, I2CD produces planner-ready geometry for a $20$-object cluttered scene in $11$s versus $328$s for the strongest baseline, at comparable pick-and-place execution success ($85$ vs. $90$ of $100$ trials).

AI.tldr: I2CD直接从单张RGB图像预测凸分解，冻结预训练的Hunyuan3D-2并仅训练一个38M参数的交叉注意力头，输出K个凸多面体的半平面参数，无需后处理即可载入物理引擎，约0.5秒/图像。
AI.motivation: 物理仿真器和运动规划需要凸碰撞几何，而图像到3D生成模型输出的是稠密、常为非流形的视觉网格。当前将两者衔接需"先重建后分解"的流水线（修复、简化、近似凸分解），速度慢且脆弱。
AI.method: 冻结预训练的Hunyuan3D-2图像条件扩散Transformer与形状解码器，仅训练一个轻量级交叉注意力头（3800万参数，不足十GPU小时），其学习到的"凸槽"（convex-slot）token输出K个凸多面体的半平面参数。
AI.result: 在227个留出的OmniObject3D与Google Scanned Objects实例上，I2CD在八种"先重建后分解"流水线中取得最高的体积IoU，端到端速度快6–37倍。在MuJoCo、PyBullet、Genesis和Isaac Sim的跨仿真器研究中，各引擎均直接使用I2CD几何；而原始生成网格虽处处可"加载"，但多数情况下被静默替换为不同碰撞形状，或需数秒至数分钟的逐对象预处理。在物理xArm7上，I2CD为20个物体的杂乱场景在11秒内生成可供规划的几何（最强基线需328秒），抓取放置执行成功率相当（100次试验中85 vs. 90）。
AI.conclusion: I2CD表明可从单张图像直接生成紧凑、构造上即为凸的分解几何，免去修复、简化与近似凸分解流程，输出紧凑、按构造即为凸、可无后处理载入物理引擎，且端到端速度与跨仿真器可用性显著优于现有基线。

title: CrowdOcc: Monocular Semantic Scene Completion for Quadruped Robots in Crowded Indoor Environments
comment: 8 pages, 4 figures. Submitted to IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation (ICRA) 2027
summary: Monocular semantic scene completion (SSC) for quadruped robots remains underexplored in real crowded indoor environments, where human-scene occlusion disrupts static geometry and human occupancy predictions are often incomplete or spatially misplaced. We present CrowdOcc, an RGB-D dataset and monocular SSC framework for this setting. CrowdOcc contains 25.1K frames from 11 indoor scenes, with semantic occupancy annotations constructed through static dynamic decoupling. Our framework combines: (i) Normal Guided Scene Geometry Fusion (NGSGF) to complement depth-aware lifting with surface-normal cues for occlusion robust geometry; and (ii) Human-Centric Sparse Interaction (HCSI) to selectively model human-human and local human scene relations in 3D. Our method achieves state-of-the-art SSC performance on CrowdOcc's scene-disjoint test set, reaching 15.80 IoU, 11.40 mIoU, and 46.23 Human IoU, demonstrating generalization to unseen indoor scenes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CrowdOcc，一个面向四足机器人在拥挤室内环境的RGB-D数据集与单目语义场景补全框架，通过静态-动态解耦标注与两项关键模块实现遮挡鲁棒的空间理解。
AI.motivation: 四足机器人在拥挤真实室内环境中的单目语义场景补全尚缺乏研究。人-场景遮挡会破坏静态几何结构，且人类占用预测常不完整或空间错位。
AI.method: 构建CrowdOcc数据集（11个室内场景、25.1K帧），采用静态-动态解耦生成语义占用标注。框架包含：(i) NGSGF，将深度感知提升与表面法向线索结合，实现遮挡鲁棒的几何补全；(ii) HCSI，在3D中选择性建模人-人及局部人-场景关系。
AI.result: 在CrowdOcc的场景分离测试集上取得SOTA性能：15.80 IoU、11.40 mIoU、46.23 Human IoU，并展现出对未见室内场景的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: CrowdOcc为拥挤室内场景下的单目语义场景补全提供了数据集与有效方法，验证了遮挡鲁棒几何融合与人体中心稀疏交互设计的有效性及跨场景泛化性。

title: Learning to Revise Reasoning with Segment-wise On-Policy Distillation
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) improves large language model reasoning by training students on their own rollouts with dense token-wise supervision from the teacher. However, token-wise OPD does not explicitly provide a coherent alternative reasoning step showing how the student's step could be revised to improve subsequent reasoning. Furthermore, this paradigm can become less effective when the student produces a degenerate reasoning prefix, as subsequent teacher supervision remains conditioned on that prefix and may reinforce poor reasoning patterns. In this work, we focus on learning reasoning revision with segment-wise OPD to rework intermediate reasoning steps and better support subsequent reasoning. Through controlled reasoning interventions, we find that replacing student segments with teacher redrafts improves subsequent reasoning accuracy. Therefore, we address the problem of turning teacher redrafts into explicit supervision for learning to revise reasoning. We propose Segment-wise On-Policy Distillation (Seg-OPD), which selects student segments based on an uncertainty metric and obtains corresponding teacher redrafts. Seg-OPD trains the student to prefer teacher redrafts over their paired student segments while retaining dense token-wise OPD supervision. Extensive experiments on mathematical reasoning and competitive programming tasks show that Seg-OPD-trained students achieve higher revision success rates than baselines. Seg-OPD consistently outperforms the compared state-of-the-art baselines in reasoning accuracy with an average relative improvement of 5.22% across diverse models and tasks. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/Seg-OPD.

AI.tldr: 本文提出分段式在线策略蒸馏（Seg-OPD），通过在片段级别引入教师重写作为显式监督，使学生学会修正中间推理步骤，从而提升推理准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有token级在线策略蒸馏（OPD）存在两个问题：其一，它只提供逐token的稠密监督，未给出连贯的替代推理步骤，无法显式教学生如何修正当前步骤；其二，当学生产生退化的推理前缀时，教师监督仍以该前缀为条件，可能强化错误的推理模式。
AI.method: 作者先通过受控推理干预实验验证：用教师重写替换学生片段能提升后续推理准确率。基于此提出Seg-OPD：利用不确定性度量挑选学生推理片段，获取对应的教师重写片段，并训练学生偏好教师重写而非原学生片段（片段级偏好监督），同时保留token级OPD的稠密监督。
AI.result: 在数学推理与竞赛编程任务上的大量实验表明，Seg-OPD训练的模型修正成功率高于基线，推理准确率在多种模型与任务上平均相对提升5.22%，持续优于现有最先进基线。
AI.conclusion: 将token级监督扩展为片段级重写监督，能有效学习推理修正，缓解退化前缀问题，是提升LLM推理性价比高的蒸馏范式。

title: AI-driven Thermal-aware Data Center Capacity Planning
summary: The emerging of large language models (LLMs) has posed significant challenges to the thermal management of data center. Intense GPU computation for LLMs results in localized hotspots. Moreover, spiking thermal loads during training and inference bursts make real-time cooling response more difficult to predict and control. Thermal-aware capacity planning of data center requires massive expensive high-fidelity CFD simulations. AI models can perform real-time prediction for unseen designs. However, existing works either have large prediction error, or have over-simplified assumptions for data center operations. This work presents an AI-driven framework that can perform thermal-aware capacity planning for a real-world data center in seconds. The embedded AI model learns from numerous key parameters (rack power, server power, server placement, HVAC settings etc.), and provides temperature prediction within milliseconds. This AI model is tested against high-fidelity CFD simulations, and results show that for unseen data center designs, model can achieve high accuracy with 10000X speedup. Driven by the AI model, the authors design the thermal-aware capacity planning framework. This framework can help data center designers and operators instantaneously optimize both workload distribution and HVAC cooling efficiency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种AI驱动的数据中心热感知容量规划框架，内嵌AI模型可从机架功率、服务器功率与布局、HVAC设置等关键参数中学习，在毫秒级完成温度预测，并在未见过的设计上相对高保真CFD仿真实现高精度与10000倍加速，从而支持秒级的热感知容量规划，帮助设计与运维人员即时优化负载分配与冷却效率。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型（LLM）的兴起给数据中心热管理带来显著挑战：GPU密集计算产生局部热点，训练与推理突发造成的热负载尖峰使实时冷却响应更难预测与控制。同时，数据中心热感知容量规划高度依赖昂贵的高保真CFD仿真。现有AI方法要么预测误差大，要么对数据中心运行做了过度简化的假设，难以满足实际需求。
AI.method: 作者构建了一套AI驱动的热感知容量规划框架。其核心是嵌入的AI模型，以机架功率、服务器功率、服务器放置位置、HVAC设置等大量关键参数为输入进行学习，实现毫秒级温度预测；并将该模型与高保真CFD仿真进行对比验证。在此基础上，设计容量规划框架，联合优化工作负载分布与HVAC冷却效率。
AI.result: 针对未见过的数据中心设计，AI模型相对高保真CFD仿真取得较高预测精度，并实现10000倍加速；整体框架可在数秒内完成真实数据中心的热感知容量规划。
AI.conclusion: AI驱动的代理模型可有效替代或大幅减少昂贵的CFD仿真，在保证精度的同时提供毫秒级温度预测，支撑秒级的热感知容量规划；该框架能帮助数据中心设计者与运维者即时协同优化工作负载分布与HVAC冷却效率，应对LLM带来的热管理挑战。

title: MobiAgent: Dual-Loop Recursive Policy Self-Improvement for Long-Horizon Mobile Manipulation
comment: Accepted at the Conference on Robot Learning (CoRL) 2026. Project page: https://kaiknower.github.io/mobiagent
summary: Long-horizon mobile manipulation presents significant challenges due to compounding execution errors and capacity interference between locomotion and arm control. While recent Vision-Language-Action models excel at short-horizon tasks, they lack the hierarchical reasoning required for multi-stage objectives. Furthermore, existing hierarchical agents suffer from rigid sub-task mapping, inflexible replanning, and a lack of continuous learning. To address these limitations, we introduce MobiAgent, a dual-loop agentic framework that bridges robust deployment execution and recursive policy self-improvement. During deployment, the Inner Loop decouples high-level reasoning from low-level control through highly composable atomic skills. It employs Vision-Language models for receding-horizon planning and visual reflection, dynamically composing skills to ensure robust error recovery. These skills are executed by specialized flow-matching experts that share a unified VLM backbone, maximizing reusability while mitigating capacity interference. Concurrently, the Outer Loop drives automated lifelong learning by autonomously segmenting and verifying deployment rollouts, clustering them to discover atomic skills, and continuously fine-tuning the skill library without human annotations. Evaluations on RoboCasa, BEHAVIOR-1K, and real-world tasks demonstrate the effectiveness of MobiAgent. It outperforms $π_{0.5}$-TA by 22.5 percentage points on BEHAVIOR-1K and enables robust recovery from execution failures. Through autonomous data recycling, success improves from 7.50% to 27.50% on RoboCasa and from 32.5% to 57.5% on Astribot S1.

AI.tldr: MobiAgent：面向长时程移动操作的双环智能体框架，通过可组合原子技能与自主终身学习实现鲁棒部署与递归自我改进。
AI.motivation: 长时程移动操作面临执行误差累积以及移动与机械臂控制之间的容量干扰问题；现有VLA模型擅长短时程任务但缺乏多阶段目标所需的层次推理能力；已有层次化智能体存在子任务映射僵化、重规划不灵活、缺乏持续学习等缺陷。
AI.method: 提出双环智能体框架：内环将高层推理与低层控制解耦，通过高度可组合的原子技能，利用VLM进行滚动时域规划与视觉反思，动态组合技能以实现错误恢复，技能由共享统一VLM骨干的专用流匹配专家执行；外环通过自主分割与验证部署轨迹、聚类发现原子技能并持续微调技能库，无需人工标注实现终身学习。
AI.result: 在RoboCasa、BEHAVIOR-1K及真实世界任务上验证：BEHAVIOR-1K上超出π0.5-TA 22.5个百分点，并能从执行失败中鲁棒恢复；通过自主数据回收，RoboCasa成功率由7.50%提升至27.50%，Astribot S1由32.5%提升至57.5%。
AI.conclusion: MobiAgent有效解决了长时程移动操作中的误差累积与容量干扰问题，兼顾鲁棒部署与递归策略自改进，验证了双环智能体框架及自主数据回收机制的有效性。

title: Parasitic Co-Denoising: Unlocking 3D Human Motion Generation in a Frozen Video Diffusion Model
summary: Despite never being supervised on explicit 3D motion, large-scale text-to-video diffusion models synthesize realistic human motion in their generated videos. We ask whether this implicit knowledge can be turned into explicit 3D motion generation, without training a separate motion model. Probing a frozen Wan2.1 reveals that a recoverable motion signal is present in its intermediate states across the entire denoising schedule, not confined to the clean output. Motivated by this, we introduce parasitic co-denoising, a paradigm in which motion is decoded from the host model along its denoising schedule rather than produced by an independent generator. We instantiate it as the Parasitic Motion Decoder (PMD), an efficient flow-matching decoder that shares the host's noise schedule and reads its intermediate features through a $σ$-adaptive multi-layer fusion, leaving the host unmodified. Drawing its coverage from the host rather than from motion data, PMD leads dedicated motion generators on text-motion alignment at a small fraction of their trainable parameters, while producing paired video and motion in a single pass that motion-only baselines cannot match.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"寄生式共同去噪"范式，直接从冻结的视频扩散模型中间层解码3D运动，无需训练独立运动模型，实现了高效且与文本对齐的3D运动生成。
AI.motivation: 大规模文本到视频扩散模型虽未显式监督3D运动，却能生成逼真的人体运动，暗示其内部隐含了可用的3D运动知识。作者希望将这种隐式知识转化为显式3D运动生成，并避免训练独立的运动生成模型。
AI.method: 通过对冻结的Wan2.1进行探测，发现其中间状态在整个去噪过程中均存在可恢复的运动信号，而非仅限于最终干净输出。据此提出寄生式共同去噪范式，并实例化为寄生运动解码器（PMD）：一个高效的流匹配解码器，与宿主共享噪声调度，并通过σ自适应多层融合读取宿主中间特征，同时保持宿主模型不被修改。
AI.result: PMD的运动覆盖能力源自宿主模型而非运动数据，因此在文本-运动对齐上超越专门的运动生成器，且可训练参数仅为其一小部分；同时它能在单次前向中生成成对的视频与运动，这是纯运动基线无法做到的。
AI.conclusion: 视频扩散模型的中间去噪状态蕴含可利用的3D运动信号，通过寄生式解码可将其转化为显式运动生成，为复用大规模视频模型进行多模态生成提供了新思路。

title: Label-Efficient Time Series Classification at Scale: A Dual-Stream OSSE-LSTM with Counterfactual Attribution
summary: Time series are produced continuously at enormous scale by industrial equipment, wearables, power grids, and clinical monitors, yet annotation remains manual, expensive, and expert-dependent. The binding constraint in large-scale time series analytics is therefore not data volume but label volume, and the question facing a practitioner is concrete: how many examples per class must be labeled before a classifier becomes usable? We study this question directly, in a regime where the label space is fixed and known in advance and the decision rule must be constructed from only K labeled examples per class. We propose Dual-Stream OSSE-LSTM, an episodic metric-learning framework that pairs an Omni-Scale CNN with Squeeze-and-Excitation recalibration, for multi-scale motif extraction without per-dataset kernel tuning, with a Bidirectional LSTM for global temporal context. The two streams are independently normalized and fused into a prototype-oriented embedding. Because decisions taken from a few labels must also be explainable, we introduce Counterfactual Integrated Gradients (C-IG), which attributes the prototype margin between target and opposing classes rather than an isolated classifier logit, and reuses the resulting maps as soft masks for test-time prototype refinement without updating the encoder. On 19 univariate UCR datasets, OSSE-LSTM attains the highest average accuracy and per-dataset win count at every support size, and its accuracy remains within a 0.36-point band (96.36-96.72%) across that range. Its weakest configuration still exceeding the best result any compared baseline achieves at any K (93.99%).

AI.tldr: 提出 Dual-Stream OSSE-LSTM 情景式度量学习框架，在每类仅 K 个标注样本的少样本设定下实现高精度时间序列分类，并引入可解释的反事实积分梯度用于原型优化。
AI.motivation: 时间序列由工业设备、可穿戴设备、电网与临床监测等大规模持续产生，但标注依赖人工、成本高且需要专家知识。因此大规模时间序列分析的核心瓶颈不是数据量而是标签量，实践者面临的具体问题是：每类需要标注多少样本，分类器才可用。论文针对标签空间固定且已知、需仅凭每类 K 个标注样本构建决策规则的设定展开研究。
AI.method: 提出 Dual-Stream OSSE-LSTM 框架：1) 双流结构，一流为 Omni-Scale CNN 结合 Squeeze-and-Excitation 重校准，实现无需逐数据集调核的多尺度 motif 提取；另一流为双向 LSTM 建模全局时序上下文。2) 两流独立归一化后融合为面向原型的嵌入（prototype-oriented embedding）。3) 提出 Counterfactual Integrated Gradients（C-IG），对目标类与对立类之间的原型间隔进行归因而非孤立分类器 logit，并将归因图复用为软掩码，在测试时精炼原型而不更新编码器。
AI.result: 在 19 个单变量 UCR 数据集上，OSSE-LSTM 在每个支持集规模（support size）下均取得最高平均精度与最多单数据集获胜次数；在整个 K 范围内精度波动仅 0.36 个百分点（96.36–96.72%）；其最弱配置仍超过所有对比基线在任意 K 下的最佳结果（93.99%）。
AI.conclusion: 在标签空间固定、每类仅 K 个标注样本的少样本时间序列分类设定下，OSSE-LSTM 通过多尺度卷积与全局时序建模的双流融合，结合原型式度量学习，实现了对支持集规模高度稳健的高精度分类；C-IG 归因兼顾可解释性并可用于测试时原型精炼。

title: A Composable AI-Accelerated Iterative Solver for 3D-IC Thermal Modeling
summary: Accurate thermal analysis of heterogeneous 2.5D/3D-IC packages is essential yet computationally prohibitive. A single full-package FEM simulation can take hours, while AI-based surrogates treat the entire stack as a monolithic prediction target and must be retrained whenever the die count or topology changes. To address this limitation, this work proposes Domain-Decomposed AI-Accelerated Iterative Solver for Thermal Analysis (DAIST), a composable thermal solver that decomposes the global package simulation into block-level subdomain problems, replaces subdomain solvers with neural operators, and couples them through iterative exchanges of interfacial temperature and heat flux. This local-to-global architecture eliminates the topology lock-in of monolithic models: block-level neural operators can be directly reused in unseen package assemblies without retraining. The iterative coupling strategy further provides a controllable accuracy-runtime tradeoff, where the iteration budget can be adjusted to trade accuracy for runtime. Evaluated on a multi-chiplet system and an advanced packaging system, DAIST achieves up to $178\times$ speedup over traditional FEM solvers with mean temperature errors of 0.068% and 0.323%, respectively, while demonstrating cross-topology reuse of block-level models across structurally distinct package assemblies.

AI.tldr: DAIST 提出一种域分解的 AI 加速迭代求解器，将 2.5D/3D-IC 封装热仿真分解为块级子域，用神经算子替代子域求解器并通过界面温度与热流迭代耦合，实现可复用、可调精度-速度权衡的热分析，最高较 FEM 加速 178 倍。
AI.motivation: 异构 2.5D/3D-IC 封装热分析至关重要，但计算代价高昂：单次全封装 FEM 仿真耗时数小时；而基于 AI 的代理模型将整个堆叠视为单一预测目标，存在"拓扑锁定"，一旦芯片数量或拓扑变化就需重新训练。
AI.method: 提出 DAIST（Domain-Decomposed AI-Accelerated Iterative Solver for Thermal Analysis）：将全局封装仿真分解为块级子域问题，用神经算子替代子域求解器，并通过界面温度与热流的迭代交换进行耦合，形成 local-to-global 架构。
AI.result: 在多芯片（multi-chiplet）系统与先进封装系统上评估，DAIST 相较传统 FEM 求解器最高实现 178 倍加速，平均温度误差分别为 0.068% 与 0.323%，并展示了块级模型在结构不同封装组件间的跨拓扑复用能力。
AI.conclusion: 块级神经算子可直接复用于未见过的封装组装而无需重新训练，消除单体模型的拓扑锁定；迭代耦合策略提供可控的精度-运行时权衡，可通过调整迭代预算在两者间取舍。

title: Detect and Suppress: A Mechanistic Defense against Adversarial Patches in VLA Models
summary: Adversarial patches can disrupt Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models by manipulating visual observations, leading to failures in robot control. However, it remains poorly understood which internal mechanisms underlie these failures and how targeted interventions can mitigate them. In this work, we mechanistically analyze VLA representations using a sparse autoencoder (SAE) and identify a feature whose activation strongly correlates with the presence of an adversarial patch. Based on this analysis, we suppress the identified feature at inference time only when a linear probe detects an attack. This intervention improves robustness without the cost of fine-tuning the VLA. We evaluate our method against VLA adversarial patch attacks on LIBERO-10. Conditional intervention improves success rate under intermittent attacks, whereas continuously applying the same intervention substantially degrades policy performance. These results show that attack-related internal representations can provide useful targets for VLA adversarial defense and that controlling when to intervene is important for limiting disruption to nominal policy behavior.

AI.tldr: 本文用稀疏自编码器(SAE)对VLA模型的内部表征进行机制分析，找到与对抗补丁强相关的特征，并仅在攻击被线性探针检测到时抑制该特征，从而在不微调模型的情况下提升鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 对抗补丁能通过操纵视觉观测破坏视觉-语言-动作(VLA)模型，导致机器人控制失败，但学界对其内部失效机制及如何有针对性地干预以缓解攻击仍缺乏理解。
AI.method: 利用稀疏自编码器对VLA表征做机制分析，识别出激活与对抗补丁存在高度相关的特征；然后用线性探针检测攻击，仅在检测到攻击时于推理阶段抑制该特征，无需微调VLA模型。在LIBERO-10上针对VLA对抗补丁攻击进行评估。
AI.result: 在间歇性攻击下，条件式干预提升了成功率；而持续施加相同干预则显著降低了策略性能。
AI.conclusion: 攻击相关的内部表征可作为VLA对抗防御的有效靶点，同时控制"何时干预"对于限制对正常策略行为的干扰至关重要。

title: BeeWhere: Segmenting Bumble Bee Colonies to Quantify Behavioral Effects
comment: Preprint. Accepted to ECCV 2026 Computer Vision for Ecology Workshop Proceedings. Proceedings DOI pending
summary: Social bees are important pollinators that support biodiversity and crop pollination globally and serve as important model systems for collective behavior, but scalable measurement of individual- and colony-level behavior remains difficult in dense, occluded nest environments. Existing monitoring workflows use fiducial tags (e.g., ArUco) to preserve individual identity, yet tag-based tracking can fail when markers are obscured and provide limited information about body extent, spatial context, and untagged individuals. We present BeeWhere, an AI-assisted annotation and analysis workflow that combines ArUco detections with deep-learnt instance segmentations to quantify bumble bee behavior from high-resolution colony images and videos. Using bumble bee (Bombus impatiens) microcolonies as a test case, we annotate 483 frames containing 8,443 bee instances. We additionally annotate pollen balls, nest structures, and chamber boundaries, and train YOLO instance segmentation models for downstream behavioral analysis. Instance segmentations enable quantification of important behavioral metrics based on body contours, including nearest-neighbor distance, proximity to nest structures, spatial occupancy within the nest, and detection counts over time. We apply the BeeWhere models to tag-based tracking in an exploratory validation study assessing the behavioral impacts of neonicotinoid pesticide exposure. BeeWhere increased detection rates compared to tag-based tracking, particularly when bees were partially obscured or under challenging imaging conditions, and also captured treatment-associated changes in bee spatial organization not captured using tag-based tracking alone. These results suggest that instance segmentation can complement fiducial-marker tracking by recovering behaviorally meaningful signals under challenging colony conditions.

AI.tldr: 我们提出BeeWhere，一种结合ArUco标记检测与深度学习实例分割的AI辅助标注与分析工作流，用于从高分辨率蜂群图像和视频中量化熊蜂行为，并将其应用于新烟碱类农药暴露的行为影响验证研究。
AI.motivation: 社会性蜜蜂是全球生物多样性和作物授粉的重要支撑，也是研究集体行为的重要模式系统，但在密集、遮挡严重的巢内环境中，对个体和群体层面的行为进行可扩展测量仍然困难。现有基于基准标记（如ArUco）的监测工作流虽能保持个体身份，但标记被遮挡时跟踪易失败，且只能提供有限的体态范围、空间背景信息，也无法处理未标记个体。
AI.method: 以熊蜂（Bombus impatiens）微型蜂群为测试对象，标注483帧、共8,443个蜜蜂实例，并额外标注花粉球、巢结构和巢室边界；训练YOLO实例分割模型，将ArUco检测与深度学习的实例分割相结合，构建BeeWhere标注与分析工作流，用于下游行为分析。
AI.result: 实例分割可基于体轮廓量化多项行为指标，包括最近邻距离、与巢结构的接近度、巢内空间占据以及随时间变化的检测计数。在针对新烟碱类农药暴露行为影响的探索性验证研究中，BeeWhere相较基于标记的跟踪提高了检测率，尤其在蜜蜂被部分遮挡或成像条件困难时表现更优，并捕捉到仅靠标记跟踪无法发现的与处理相关的空间组织变化。
AI.conclusion: 实例分割能够补充基准标记跟踪，在具有挑战性的蜂群条件下恢复具有行为意义的信号，为密集遮挡巢环境中的可扩展行为测量提供了可行方案。

title: Ego2World: Compiling Egocentric Cooking Videos into Executable Worlds for Belief-State Planning
summary: Egocentric videos capture how people carry out everyday activities, yet testing an agent requires evaluating the consequences of actions it chooses itself. We introduce Ego2World, a benchmark that turns annotated cooking activities into executable planning environments under partial observation. Its compiler links source steps and objects to symbolic action rules, persistent world states, and explicit task conditions, so researchers can execute an agent's proposed actions and check their outcomes. World state and agent belief are maintained separately, enabling controlled studies of planning and information reuse across continuing tasks. Evaluating six planners on 105 tasks shows that accepted operations often leave task goals unmet. Execution traces and condition checks distinguish interrupted runs, partial attainment, and completed execution without goal attainment. In a separate paired Qwen-Plus study, persistent belief improves action validity by 4.15 percentage points and reduces visual-query attempts by 90.27%, with higher token use and no detected completion gain. Ego2World provides a reusable testbed for tracing how planning and memory choices affect execution, observation demand, and task attainment, connecting recorded human activity to the development and evaluation of interactive agents.
