AI.tldr: Ego2World 是一个将第一人称烹饪活动标注转化为可执行规划环境的基准，支持在部分可观测条件下评估智能体自选动作的后果，并区分规划与记忆选择对执行、观测需求和任务达成的影响。
AI.motivation: 第一人称视频记录了人们的日常活动，但评估智能体需要检验其自选动作的后果。现有评估难以在部分观测下执行智能体提议的动作并核查结果，也缺少对规划与信息复用（记忆）作用的受控研究。
AI.method: 提出 Ego2World 基准：通过编译器将标注的烹饪活动中的步骤与物体链接为符号动作规则、持久世界状态和显式任务条件；将世界状态与智能体信念分开维护，从而支持在持续任务中对规划与信息复用的受控研究。在 105 个任务上评估六种规划器，并开展配对的 Qwen-Plus 研究。
AI.result: 六种规划器结果显示，被接受的操作常常未能满足任务目标；执行轨迹与条件检查可区分中断运行、部分达成、以及执行完成但未达成目标。在配对 Qwen-Plus 研究中，持久信念将动作有效性提高 4.15 个百分点，并将视觉查询尝试减少 90.27%，但 token 使用更高，且未检测到完成度提升。
AI.conclusion: Ego2World 提供了一个可复用的测试平台，用于追踪规划与记忆选择如何影响执行、观测需求和任务达成，将记录的人类活动与交互式智能体的开发与评估连接起来。

title: Capability Scaling-Down Laws for LLM Compression
summary: LLM compression reduces inference costs and memory requirements, but selecting a method and configuration remains largely empirical because comparable resource reductions can produce different capability losses. We systematically investigate capability scaling-down laws for LLM compression across pruning, quantization, and distillation. Our framework measures capability loss in mathematics, code generation, and question answering, and relates these measurements to model size, training stage, compression settings, data availability, and training exposure. We develop simple predictive relations and evaluate their accuracy, measurement efficiency, and generalization to unseen configurations and model states. Sharing the density response across pruning levels halves the configuration measurements needed to fit a pruning predictor: on new Pythia states, on pre-registered OLMo-2 test states and under Wanda pruning, the compact relation matches a regression fitted with all measurements on math and code to within 0.020 nats per token, with coefficients refitted for each setting. Controlled distillation experiments show that the cost of heavy data reuse recurs across question-answering distributions, while the net benefit depends on the evaluation distribution. We further evaluate the decision value of these predictions by comparing numerical selection with configuration medians and fixed method priorities. Independent evaluations across two model families show that selection captures most of the available cross-method benefit for question answering within the tested candidate sets, where a fixed method priority attains the same regret, with smaller opportunities for mathematics and code. These results clarify the predictive scope of capability scaling-down laws and their use in compression method selection. Our code is publicly available at: https://github.com/LabRAI/scaling_down_law.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究LLM压缩（剪枝、量化、蒸馏）的能力下降缩放律，提出预测能力损失与压缩配置之间的简单关系，并评估其在压缩方法选择中的决策价值。
AI.motivation: LLM压缩可降低推理成本与内存需求，但方法及配置选择多凭经验，因为相近的资源缩减可能导致不同的能力损失，缺乏可预测的规律指导选择。
AI.method: 构建统一框架，测量数学、代码生成、问答三领域的能力损失，关联模型规模、训练阶段、压缩设置、数据可用性与训练暴露量；开发简单预测关系（如跨剪枝层级共享密度响应以减半拟合所需测量），并通过控制蒸馏实验与决策价值评估（对比数值选择、配置中位数与固定方法优先）进行验证。
AI.result: 共享密度响应使剪枝预测器拟合所需配置测量减半；在新Pythia状态、预注册的OLMo-2测试状态及Wanda剪枝下，紧凑关系与使用全部测量拟合的回归在数学与代码上差距在0.020 nats/token以内；蒸馏中重数据复用的成本在多个问答分布上稳定复现，而净收益依赖评估分布；两个模型族的独立评估显示，方法选择在问答上捕获了大部分跨方法收益，与固定方法优先的regret相当，数学与代码机会较小。
AI.conclusion: 结果明确了能力下降缩放律的预测范围及其在压缩方法选择中的实用价值，代码已公开。

title: XGenAct: Geometry-Enhanced World Action Models through Cross-Task Generation
summary: World action models (WAMs) have advanced robot control by predicting how observations and actions evolve over time. Despite this progress, RGB and action based future prediction does not explicitly address the spatial understanding needed for robot manipulation. Existing efforts often add a limited set of spatial prediction tasks through specialized heads or branches, leaving both the range of spatial supervision and the model architecture fragmented. We introduce XGenAct, a world action model that represents RGB observations, robot actions, metric depth, surface normals, and functional role segmentation as RGB videos through deterministic codecs. By sampling perception and action tasks during training, XGenAct uses one video diffusion transformer and one objective to learn temporal prediction across these spaces without modality specific learned heads. On held out RLBench tasks, structured perception training improves average closed loop success over RGB only training, and XGenAct achieves 52% success in the five task external comparison, versus 26% for the strongest evaluated baselines. It also predicts future depth and segmentation more accurately than the evaluated pipelines that generate RGB first and then apply a frozen perception expert.

AI.tldr: 提出XGenAct世界动作模型，将RGB观测、机器人动作、度量深度、表面法线与功能角色分割统一编码为RGB视频，用单一视频扩散Transformer和单一目标学习跨空间时序预测。
AI.motivation: 现有世界动作模型主要基于RGB和动作预测未来，未显式建模机器人操作所需的空间理解；已有方法仅通过专用头或分支添加少量空间预测任务，导致空间监督范围与模型架构碎片化。
AI.method: 利用确定性编解码器将RGB观测、机器人动作、度量深度、表面法线和功能角色分割统一表示为RGB视频；训练时对感知与动作任务进行采样；采用一个视频扩散Transformer和一个目标函数，在不使用模态专用学习头的情况下学习跨这些空间的时序预测。
AI.result: 在留出的RLBench任务上，结构化感知训练相比仅RGB训练提升了平均闭环成功率；在五项任务外部对比中，XGenAct成功率为52%，最强评估基线为26%；其未来深度与分割预测精度也优于先生成RGB再应用冻结感知专家的评估流程。
AI.conclusion: 将多种空间感知任务统一为RGB视频表示并用单一扩散Transformer和统一目标训练，可有效提升机器人操作的闭环成功率及未来深度和分割预测精度。

title: Where to Look Is Not How to Fix: Pre-Denoising Diagnostics and Modality-Dependent Control in Diffusion Composition
summary: Understanding compositional failures in text-to-image diffusion requires identifying both where stress is detectable and how intervention changes the output. We study these questions through a controlled anchor--stress protocol that jointly evaluates text-encoder diagnostics and denoiser interventions. We introduce a text-only Compositional Stress Index (CSI), which separates common from rare compositions across SD1.5, SDXL, and the SD3 text path and provides an upstream diagnostic coordinate. A matched six-prompt localization study links intervention location to distinct outcomes: residual-minimizing embedding adapters improve representation fit, while downstream cross-attention intervention increases color hit rate (CHR) by 0.0272. Across SD1.5 and SDXL denoiser blocks, the largest positive signed diagnostic-accessibility mean occurs at the deep encoder, whereas selective boost has its largest positive mean CHR response at decoder blocks. Selective subtraction and broad ablation reveal further modality- and architecture-dependent responses, including a substantial CHR decrease when SDXL decoder cross-attention is broadly ablated. We find a diagnosis-control dissociation under our controlled attribute-object composition setting: compositional defects are diagnosable before denoising, but the representation coordinate that exposes risk is not necessarily the coordinate or modality that improves generation.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过"锚点—压力"协议，联合评估文本编码器诊断与去噪器干预，揭示了组合式文生图失败中"诊断—控制解耦"现象。
AI.motivation: 理解文生图扩散模型组合失败，既需定位压力可检测之处，也需明确干预如何改变输出，而现有工作对二者的联系缺乏受控分析。
AI.method: 设计受控锚点—压力协议，同时评估文本编码器诊断与去噪器干预；提出纯文本组合压力指数（CSI），在SD1.5、SDXL与SD3文本路径上区分常见与罕见组合；开展匹配的六提示定位研究，比较残差最小化嵌入适配器与下游交叉注意力干预；并在SD1.5与SDXL去噪器块上分析符号化诊断可及性均值与选择性增强的CHR响应。
AI.result: 残差最小化嵌入适配器改善表征拟合，下游交叉注意力干预使颜色命中率（CHR）提升0.0272；最大正符号化诊断可及性均值出现在深层编码器，而选择性增强的最大正CHR响应出现在解码器块；选择性减除与广泛消融呈现模态与架构依赖的响应，SDXL解码器交叉注意力广泛消融导致CHR显著下降。
AI.conclusion: 在受控的属性—对象组合设定下存在诊断—控制解耦：组合缺陷在去噪前即可诊断，但暴露风险的表征坐标未必是改善生成的坐标或模态。

title: On the Chain-of-Thought Monitorability of Looped Language Models
summary: Chain-of-thought (CoT) monitoring provides a promising approach for detecting undesirable model behavior. Looped language models (LoopLMs) repeatedly apply shared transformer layers, increasing effective computational depth and enabling additional latent computation without increasing model size. However, the effect of looped architectures on CoT monitorability remains largely unexplored. In this work, we provide the first systematic evaluation of CoT monitorability in LoopLMs. We study two complementary settings: (1) varying the loop depth within the same LoopLM family to isolate the effect of additional recurrent computation, and (2) comparing LoopLMs with non-looped language models matched by parameter size, transformer-layer count, or effective depth to study whether LoopLMs are less monitorable. Across eight tasks from MonitorBench and both standard and stress-test settings, we observe task-dependent reductions in CoT monitorability under stress tests on specific Logic/Science/Engineering \texttt{Cue Answer} tasks, while other tasks exhibit weaker or qualitatively different trends. Our diagnosis suggests that these declines are not fully explained by task difficulty, verification pass rate, or generated token length; qualitative examples further suggest changes in how deeper-loop models explicitly use or attribute provided cues. Our cross-model comparison finds no evidence that LoopLMs are systematically less monitorable than non-looped language models matched on size or depth. Overall, our results suggest that deeper loop depth can reduce CoT monitorability in some tasks under stress tests, but looped transformer architecture alone does not necessarily imply lower monitorability.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统评估循环语言模型（LoopLM）的思维链（CoT）可监控性，发现更深循环深度在部分Logic/Science/Engineering的Cue Answer压力测试任务下会降低可监控性，但循环架构本身并不必然导致可监控性下降。
AI.motivation: CoT监控是检测模型不良行为的有效手段，而循环语言模型通过重复应用共享transformer层增加有效计算深度，却可能影响CoT可监控性；这一影响此前基本未被探索，因此需要系统评估。
AI.method: 设置两类互补实验：(1) 在同一LoopLM家族内改变循环深度，以隔离额外循环计算的影响；(2) 将LoopLM与在参数量、transformer层数或有效深度上匹配的非循环语言模型对比。评估覆盖MonitorBench的八个任务，包含标准与压力测试两种设置，并分析任务难度、验证通过率、生成长度等混杂因素及定性样例。
AI.result: 在特定Logic/Science/Engineering的Cue Answer任务压力测试下观察到任务依赖的CoT可监控性下降，其他任务趋势较弱或性质不同。该下降无法完全由任务难度、验证通过率或生成长度解释；定性样例显示更深循环模型对给定线索的显式使用或归因方式发生变化。跨模型对比未发现LoopLM比同规模或同深度非循环模型系统性更难监控的证据。
AI.conclusion: 更深循环深度在部分任务的压力测试下可能降低CoT可监控性，但循环transformer架构本身并不必然意味着更低的可监控性。

title: Threshold-Aware Conformal Routing
summary: High-fidelity simulations are essential to scientific and engineering design, but can be expensive to run repeatedly. Learned surrogates offer a faster alternative, yet their higher errors may alter downstream decisions. This accuracy-speed tradeoff creates a need to determine whether a surrogate can be used or the full simulator remains necessary. We study decisions determined by whether a scalar quantity of interest lies above or below a fixed threshold. For each input, we use the surrogate when its conformal interval lies entirely on one side of the threshold and route the input to simulation when the interval intersects it. Standard conformal prediction constructs intervals without reference to the downstream decision threshold: even a narrow interval near the threshold can cross it and trigger simulation, whereas a wider interval farther away can remain entirely on one side and require no simulation. We introduce Threshold-Aware Conformal Routing (TACR), which learns an input-dependent scale using a threshold-aware objective that concentrates interval tightness near the decision boundary. Exact split-conformal calibration on held-out data preserves distribution-free marginal coverage, which also upper-bounds the probability of an incorrect threshold decision that is not routed. Across various scientific and engineering datasets, TACR reduces simulator deferrals by 14-75% relative to standard conformal prediction at the same coverage target. Against a variant without threshold-local weighting but with similar predictor accuracy, TACR further reduces deferrals by 10-24% on four datasets. These results show that optimizing interval allocation for routing can reduce simulator calls without weakening the standard conformal guarantee.

AI.tldr: TACR：一种阈值感知的共形路由方法，学习输入相关的区间尺度，将区间紧致性集中于决策边界附近，在保持无分布边际覆盖保证下，显著减少所需的模拟器调用次数。
AI.motivation: 高保真模拟在科学和工程设计中不可或缺，但重复运行成本高昂。学习型代理模型虽快，却可能因更高误差而改变下游决策。因此存在精度-速度的权衡问题：需判断某个代理是否可用，还是必须调用完整模拟器。本文针对由"某一标量关注量是否高于或低于固定阈值"所决定的决策场景展开研究。
AI.method: 对每个输入，若代理的共形区间完全位于阈值一侧，则采用代理；若区间与阈值相交，则将输入路由至模拟器。标准共形预测构建区间时不参照下游决策阈值：即便很窄的区间只要靠近阈值仍可能跨越阈值而触发模拟，而离阈值较远的较宽区间却可能完全位于一侧而无需模拟。为此提出阈值感知共形路由（TACR），通过阈值感知目标学习输入相关的缩放尺度，使区间紧致性集中于决策边界附近。在留出数据上进行精确的分裂共形校准，保持无分布边际覆盖保证。
AI.result: 在多个科学与工程数据集上，相同覆盖目标下，TACR相比标准共形预测将模拟器推迟次数减少14%–75%。与一个无阈值局部加权但预测器精度相近的变体相比，TACR在四个数据集上进一步将推迟次数减少10%–24%。
AI.conclusion: 为路由而优化区间分配可在不削弱标准共形保证的前提下减少模拟器调用，证明了阈值感知的区间尺度设计在精度-速度权衡中的有效性。

title: DR-IPC: Disturbance-Resilient Integrated Planning and Control for LiDAR-Based Quadrotor Navigation
summary: LiDAR-based quadrotor navigation in cluttered environments remains challenging under external disturbances, particularly when obstacle-aware motion generation and disturbance-rejection control are handled in separate layers. This article presents disturbance-resilient integrated planning and control (DR-IPC), which combines lightweight path guidance with nonlinear model predictive control (NMPC) to directly generate angular velocity and thrust. An interconnected extended Kalman filter and nonlinear disturbance observer jointly provide filtered state estimates and reconstructed disturbances for NMPC prediction. The resulting formulation unifies nonlinear quadrotor dynamics, actuator constraints, local motion generation, and penalised safe-flight-corridor residuals without requiring a separate trajectory-optimization stage. Gazebo and MARSIM simulations, together with indoor and outdoor experiments, validate DR-IPC under wind, suspended payloads, narrow passages, ball impacts and reactive avoidance of a dynamic obstacle. In multi-goal navigation with disturbances, DR-IPC increases the number of completed missions from 1/10 to 9/10 in Gazebo and reduces the altitude RMSE from 0.34 to 0.01 m in experiments. The complete system operates onboard at 100 Hz. Supplementary videos are available on the project page https://drpp316.github.io/DR-IPC-Page/, and the source code will be released.

AI.tldr: 本文提出扰动韧性集成规划与控制（DR-IPC），将轻量路径引导与非线性模型预测控制（NMPC）统一，直接输出角速度与推力，实现LiDAR四旋翼在杂乱环境与外部扰动下的自主导航。
AI.motivation: LiDAR四旋翼在杂乱环境中的导航面临外部扰动挑战，尤其是当避障运动生成与抗扰控制被分层处理时，系统性能易于受损，亟需一体化解决方案。
AI.method: 采用轻量路径引导结合NMPC直接生成角速度与推力；由互联的扩展卡尔曼滤波与非线性扰动观测器联合提供滤波状态估计与重构扰动用于预测；公式化统一了非线性四旋翼动力学、执行器约束、局部运动生成与带惩罚的安全飞行走廊残差，无需独立轨迹优化阶段。
AI.result: 在Gazebo与MARSIM仿真及室内外实验中，经受风扰、悬挂负载、狭窄通道、球体撞击与动态障碍反应式避障验证；多目标导航任务完成数由1/10提升至9/10，实验高度RMSE由0.34降至0.01 m；整机机载100 Hz运行。
AI.conclusion: DR-IPC通过规划与控制一体化显著提升抗扰能力与任务成功率，具备机载实时性与工程可用性，相关视频与源码将公开。

title: NegT2IBench: When Negation Changes the Picture. A Polarity Benchmark for Text-to-Image Models
summary: Text-to-image (T2I) models are judged by benchmarks that measure whether requested content appears, but these benchmarks largely overlook the complementary ability to satisfy negated constraints, for example, generating "a non-red cup." Measuring negation raises challenges not faced by affirmation-based benchmarks and requires careful prompt and evaluation design. We introduce NegT2IBench, a benchmark of 4,800 prompts covering two attribute types and four relation categories. Prompts are organized by polarity: the number of positive statements that must hold and negated statements that must not, each ranging from 0 to 2. Varying the two independently separates the effect of negation from the effect of prompt complexity. Our detector-based scoring is reproducible, auditable, and pinpoints which requirement failed. On 600 images with three-annotator labels, it agrees with humans as closely as vision-language judges up to 30x larger, while using only a fraction of their GPU memory. Across eleven T2I models and 211,200 images, nine score lower on a single negated statement than on a single positive one. Per-statement scoring reveals that the loss is largest for color and near zero for proximity, and that 41.5% of failed statements render exactly what the prompt forbids. Rendering what a prompt asks for and withholding what it forbids are distinct capabilities that an aggregate compositional score cannot distinguish. NegT2IBench measures the latter directly, providing a controlled testbed for diagnosing negation failures and developing methods to overcome them.

AI.tldr: 该文提出NegT2IBench基准，用4,800条提示词、极性与复杂度解耦设计及基于检测器的评分，直接测量文生图模型处理否定约束的能力，并揭示其与正向生成能力的显著差距。
AI.motivation: 现有文生图基准主要检验所请求内容是否出现，忽视了对否定约束（如"非红色的杯子"）的满足能力；而测量否定在提示设计与评估上都有特殊挑战，需要可控、可复现的专用基准。
AI.method: 构建NegT2IBench，含4,800条提示词，覆盖两种属性类型与四类关系；按极性组织，正向与否定陈述数量各取0至2，独立变化以解耦否定效应与提示复杂度效应；采用基于检测器的可复现、可审计评分，可定位失败的具体要求；并用600张、三位标注者的图像验证其与人类的吻合度。
AI.result: 在600张图像上，检测器评分与人类一致程度接近大至30倍的视觉语言评判器，而GPU显存占用仅为后者一小部分；在11个模型、211,200张图像上，9个模型在单条否定陈述上的得分低于单条正向陈述；逐条评分显示损失在颜色上最大、在邻近关系上接近零，且41.5%的失败陈述恰好生成了提示所禁止的内容。
AI.conclusion: 生成所要求的内容与抑制所禁止的内容是两种可区分的能力，聚合式组合评分无法区分二者；NegT2IBench直接测量后者，为诊断否定失败并改进方法提供了受控测试平台。

title: Dynamic LLM Routers are Often Misguided
comment: 8 pages, 15 figures, under review at NAACL
summary: Dynamic LLM routers promise to cut inference costs by sending each query to the cheapest model that can answer it correctly. We analyze six commercial routers across 14 settings on a diverse benchmark spanning eight task categories, finding that none of them outperforms a router that randomly selects between two well-chosen models at matched cost. Some underperform by more than 10 percentage points. We trace this gap to four patterns prevalent across routers: difficulty blindness, length reversal, semantic matching, and roster suboptimality. We show that the first three are what the standard objective rewards: cost-accuracy Pareto efficiency on realized costs favors escalating moderately hard queries over the hardest ones, shorter queries over longer ones, and routing by a query's source over its difficulty. We also argue that the two assumptions that would justify large rosters, model granularity and model specialization, do not hold empirically. We propose an alternative evaluation methodology that does not reward these patterns, and as a proof of concept, we design a simple two-model router that avoids all four. Nevertheless, its gain over random routing is limited, because a well-chosen roster leaves little to route.

AI.tldr: 论文对六种商用LLM路由器在14种设置、8类任务上进行评测，发现其均不优于在成本匹配下随机选择两个精选模型的基线；作者将差距归因于四种失效模式，并指出标准评估目标本身在激励这些模式。
AI.motivation: 动态LLM路由器本应通过把查询分配给能正确回答的最便宜模型来降低推理成本，但现有路由器是否真正有效缺乏系统检验。作者希望厘清商用路由器的真实表现、其失败的成因，以及评估方法本身是否存在误导。
AI.method: 在覆盖8个任务类别的多样化基准上，对六种商用路由器在14种设置下进行评测，并与“成本匹配下随机选择两个精选模型”的基线对比；通过归因分析识别出四种普遍模式（难度盲视、长度反转、语义匹配、模型集合次优）；随后分析标准目标函数（基于实际成本的成本-准确率帕累托效率）如何奖励前三种模式，并检验支撑大模型集合的两个假设（模型粒度、模型专精）；最后提出替代评估方法，并设计一个规避四种模式的简单双模型路由器作为概念验证。
AI.result: 没有任何商用路由器在成本匹配条件下优于随机双模型基线，部分路由器落后超过10个百分点。四种模式在路由器中普遍存在；前三种正是标准目标所奖励的行为——该目标倾向于对中等难度而非最难查询升级、偏好更短而非更长的查询、按查询来源而非难度进行路由。模型粒度与模型专精这两个支撑大模型集合的假设在实证中不成立。
AI.conclusion: 现有的商用LLM路由器未证明其价值，标准评估目标会激励难度盲视、长度反转和语义匹配等劣质行为，且大模型集合缺乏实证依据。作者提出的替代评估方法可避免奖励这些模式，其双模型路由器概念验证能规避全部四种模式，但相对随机路由的提升有限，因为精选的模型集合本身已使路由空间很小——这意味着路由的收益上限可能被高估。

title: Harnessing LLMs as Agents: What Does It Cost?
summary: Language-model agents increasingly rely on harnesses that manage bounded context, persistent memory, tools, verification, and repeated execution, yet existing notions of model capability do not quantify the computational resources these mechanisms consume. We introduce the Language Model Agent Machine (LAM), a resource-bounded abstraction that fixes the underlying semantic model while explicitly charging harness-level resources. We establish four classes of results. Communication: LAM execution is instancewise equivalent to red--blue pebbling under simultaneous call--transfer budgets, transferring classical I/O lower bounds to context--memory traffic. Access: memory interfaces induce asymptotic separations, including a $Θ(n)$ gap between random and non-speculative sequential access on pointer chasing. Recomputation: bit-reversal DAGs require $Θ(n^2/(C+S)+n)$ model calls with context capacity $C$ and persistent-memory capacity $S$, quantifying when stored intermediate state avoids repeated semantic computation. Reliability: we derive tight stage-local sampling bounds, exact imperfect-verification costs, and a Young--Daly-type checkpoint law with a closed-form optimal verification interval. Controlled and held-out experiments on GPT-6 Astra test communication and reliability predictions, including checkpoint optima, policy selection under programmatic checking, and tradeoffs among call granularity, logical input traffic, and reliability on chained MATH tasks. Together, these results provide a resource theory for the computational cost of language-model agent harnesses.

AI.tldr: 本文提出语言模型智能体机器（LAM），一个资源受限抽象，显式计入harness层面的通信、访问、重计算与可靠性开销，并建立四类理论结果，用GPT-6 Astra实验验证。
AI.motivation: 现有语言模型能力度量未量化harness机制（上下文管理、持久记忆、工具、验证、重复执行）所消耗的计算资源，缺乏对智能体系统计算成本的资源理论。
AI.method: 构建LAM资源受限抽象，固定底层语义模型、显式计入harness资源；理论上将其执行等价为带同时调用-传输预算的红蓝卵石游戏，导出I/O下界、内存接口渐近分离、位反转DAG的模型调用复杂度，以及采样、验证与检查点定律；并在GPT-6 Astra上进行受控与留出实验。
AI.result: 通信上转移经典I/O下界到上下文-记忆流量；访问上任一指针追逐中随机与非投机顺序访问存在Θ(n)差距；重计算上位反转DAG需Θ(n²/(C+S)+n)次模型调用；可靠性上给出紧致阶段局部采样界、精确非完美验证成本及含闭式最优验证区间的Young-Daly型检查点定律；实验证实通信与可靠性预测。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为语言模型智能体harness的计算成本提供了统一的资源理论，量化了上下文、记忆、重计算与可靠性之间的权衡。

title: Autonomous Robotic Navigation for Endovascular Brain-Computer Interface Access
summary: Endovascular brain-computer interfaces (BCIs) avoid craniotomy but require precise device delivery through anatomically variable cerebral veins. This work presents the first demonstration of in vitro autonomous robotic navigation for endovascular BCI access in the cerebral venous system. Soft Actor-Critic controllers were trained in silico for two sequential tasks spanning the right internal jugular vein to the superior sagittal sinus, using geometric augmentation of one training anatomy. Navigation was evaluated in a training anatomy and an anatomically unseen hold-out model over 250 in silico episodes and five fluoroscopy-guided in vitro robotic runs per task-anatomy condition, comprising 1,000 simulated episodes and 20 physical runs overall. Task recurrent predictors were also evaluated for online identification of impending navigation failure. In silico success rates for Tasks A and B were 85.6% and 98.4% in the training anatomy and 42.0% and 91.6% in the hold-out anatomy, respectively. Fourteen of 20 physical runs were successful (70% overall), including 80% success for Task B in the hold-out phantom. In silico the predictors detected 99.3-100.0% of failures with false-alarm rates of 0.8-6.7%. During in vitro evaluation, predicted risk increased before failed episodes, but elevated probabilities during some successful runs showed reduced calibration after transfer. These results demonstrate the feasibility of autonomous cerebral venous access and show how online failure prediction could support human oversight, while also identifying anatomical generalization and sim-to-real calibration as priorities before preclinical translation.

AI.tldr: 该研究首次演示了血管内脑机接口（BCI）在脑静脉系统中的体外自主机器人导航，采用Soft Actor-Critic控制器完成两阶段任务，并结合在线失败预测，验证了自主脑静脉通路的可行性，同时揭示了跨解剖泛化与仿真到现实校准的瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 血管内BCI可避免开颅，但器械需经解剖变异极大的脑静脉精准递送，人工操作难度高，因此需要自主导航与风险监测手段来提升递送精度与安全性，并为临床前转化提供依据。
AI.method: 在仿真环境中基于单一训练解剖结构进行几何增强，训练Soft Actor-Critic控制器，完成从右侧颈内静脉到上矢状窦的两个序贯导航任务；在训练解剖与解剖学未见过的留出模型上评估，共1000个仿真回合与20次透视引导的体外机器人实验（每个任务-解剖条件5次）；同时评估任务递归预测器用于在线识别即将发生的导航失败。
AI.result: 仿真成功率：任务A和B在训练解剖中分别为85.6%和98.4%，在留出解剖中为42.0%和91.6%；20次实体实验中14次成功（总体70%），其中留出体模任务B成功率达80%。预测器在仿真中以0.8%–6.7%的误报率检出99.3%–100.0%的失败；体外实验显示失败前预测风险升高，但部分成功运行中概率偏高，表明迁移后校准下降。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明自主脑静脉通路具备可行性，在线失败预测有助于支持人工监督；但解剖泛化能力与仿真到现实的校准问题是实现临床前转化前需优先解决的关键。

title: Beyond Single Videos: Benchmarking and Active Evidence Seeking for E-Commerce Cross-Video Reasoning
summary: E-commerce videos are information-dense and frequently compared by consumers evaluating products and merchants assessing marketing strategies. However, existing multimodal models mainly focus on single-video understanding and have limited ability to compare information across videos. We introduce AdsCVR, the first e-commerce cross-video reasoning benchmark, containing 2,483 videos and 6,110 question-answer pairs across six reasoning dimensions. Cross- video reasoning requires models to locate fine-grained evidence among many redundant frames and integrate visual details, speech, and on-screen text. We therefore propose AdSeek, an agentic framework that dynamically selects visual and audio tools during multi-turn exploration, replacing static uniform sampling with active evidence acquisition. To address the sparse credit assignment of reinforcement learning, we develop an offline trajectory rectification mechanism that identifies reasoning errors and missing multimodal evidence in RL-generated trajectories. The corrected trajectories provide supervised fine-tuning signals that reduce biases learned during RL. This mechanism supports a rectified bootstrapping pipeline in which initial RL exposes reasoning bottlenecks, supervised fine-tuning corrects them, and a final RL stage further improves the policy. AdSeek achieves 74.30 percent accuracy on the AdsCVR test split, outperforming its Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct backbone by 27.90 percentage points. It also generalizes to the open- domain CrossVid benchmark, demonstrating effective active evidence gathering.

AI.tldr: 该论文面向电商跨视频推理，提出首个基准AdsCVR与智能体框架AdSeek，通过工具调用式主动取证与离线轨迹修正的自举训练，显著超越基座模型并具泛化性。
AI.motivation: 电商视频信息密集，消费者与营销方常需跨视频比较，但现有多模态模型主要聚焦单视频理解，跨视频信息比较能力有限，缺乏相应评测基准与方法。
AI.method: 1) 构建AdsCVR：含2,483个视频、6,110个问答对，覆盖六个推理维度；2) 提出AdSeek智能体框架，在多轮探索中动态选择视觉与音频工具，以主动取证替代静态均匀采样；3) 针对强化学习信用分配稀疏，设计离线轨迹修正机制，识别RL轨迹中的推理错误与缺失的多模态证据，将修正轨迹作为SFT监督信号，形成"RL暴露瓶颈—SFT纠偏—再RL提升"的修正自举流程。
AI.result: AdSeek在AdsCVR测试集达74.30%准确率，较Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct基座提升27.90个百分点；并在开放域CrossVid基准上取得泛化效果，验证了主动证据采集的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 跨视频推理需细粒度证据定位与多模态整合；主动工具调用式取证结合轨迹修正的自举训练可有效提升模型跨视频比较能力，并为开放域任务提供可迁移方案。

title: Law And Order: Tax Law Autoformalization
summary: Legal systems are increasingly implemented through software, yet scalable methods for translating legal texts into accurate symbolic representations remain underdeveloped. We study this problem through tax law, where forms and filing instructions define large computational structures involving arithmetic, branching, recursion, and tabular reasoning. We propose Law&Order, a neuro-symbolic framework for automatically formalizing tax forms and instructions into executable symbolic programs. Our approach establishes two forms of correspondence between law and logic: structural correspondence, which aligns legal and symbolic components such as cells and schedules, and denotational correspondence, which requires symbolic components to implement the computations specified by their legal counterparts. We combine large language model synthesis with cell-level verification and iterative localized error repair using human-written OpenTaxSolver tax returns. We then evaluate the resulting formalizations on independently authored, held-out TaxCalcBench returns, that are never exposed during generation or repair. Although the most advanced LLM achieves only 66% accuracy, Law&Order achieves 100% cell-level and form-level accuracy on 51 held-out returns, demonstrating the effectiveness of combining LLM-based synthesis with symbolic verification for scalable and verifiable large-scale legal autoformalization compared with using an LLM alone.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Law&Order 神经符号框架，将税法表格与填报说明自动形式化为可执行符号程序，通过结构对应与指称对应两种映射，结合 LLM 合成、单元格级验证与局部迭代修复，在 51 份留出税表上实现 100% 单元格级与表级准确率。
AI.motivation: 法律系统日益由软件实现，但将法律文本可扩展地翻译为准确符号表示的方法仍不成熟；税法中表格与填报说明涉及算术、分支、递归与表格推理，构成大规模计算结构，亟需可验证的自动形式化手段。
AI.method: 以税法为研究对象，提出 Law&Order 神经符号框架。建立两种法律—逻辑对应：结构对应（对齐单元格、附表等法律与符号组件）与指称对应（符号组件须实现其法律对应物所规定的计算）。方法上结合大语言模型合成、单元格级验证，以及利用人工编写的 OpenTaxSolver 税表进行迭代式局部错误修复。
AI.result: 在独立编写、生成与修复阶段从未接触的留出集 TaxCalcBench 税表上评估：最先进 LLM 仅达 66% 准确率，而 Law&Order 在 51 份留出税表上达到 100% 的单元格级与表级准确率。
AI.conclusion: 将基于 LLM 的合成与符号验证相结合，相比单独使用 LLM，能有效支撑可扩展且可验证的大规模法律自动形式化。

title: LiteEMG-FM: An Efficient and Deployable Foundation Model for Robust EMG Sensing
summary: Electromyography (EMG) signals vary substantially across individuals, body regions, recording sessions, and sensing hardware, limiting the generalization of models for assistive devices and human-computer interaction. Existing time-series foundation models are also computationally expensive for real-time wearable deployment and often fail to capture EMG-specific time-frequency characteristics. We present LiteEMG-FM, an efficient hybrid CNN-Transformer foundation model for practical EMG sensing. Pretrained on 16 diverse upper- and lower-limb EMG datasets, LiteEMG-FM learns representations that generalize across users and datasets. For resource-constrained deployment, we implement a hierarchical wake-up architecture in which a lightweight, always-on 1D-CNN filters rest and non-target activity and activates LiteEMG-FM only for valid gestures. We evaluate full inference offloading, split inference, and full on-device processing, characterizing their trade-offs in latency, power consumption, and memory footprint. Across diverse evaluation settings, LiteEMG-FM outperforms state-of-the-art time-series foundation models and supervised baselines, particularly under zero-calibration cross-participant and data-scarce conditions. These results demonstrate that LiteEMG-FM is an effective, efficient, and deployable foundation model for EMG applications.

AI.tldr: LiteEMG-FM 是一个高效的混合 CNN-Transformer 肌电（EMG）基础模型，结合层级唤醒架构实现资源受限下的可部署性，在跨被试、零校准与数据稀缺条件下优于现有时间序列基础模型和监督基线。
AI.motivation: EMG 信号在个体、身体部位、采集会话与传感硬件间差异显著，限制了辅助设备与人机交互模型的泛化能力；现有时间序列基础模型计算开销大，难以实时可穿戴部署，且未充分建模 EMG 特有的时频特性。
AI.method: 提出 LiteEMG-FM：混合 CNN-Transformer 基础模型，在 16 个多样化上、下肢 EMG 数据集上预训练；面向资源受限部署设计层级唤醒架构，由常开轻量 1D-CNN 过滤静息与非目标活动，仅在检测到有效手势时激活主模型；并评估全推理卸载、拆分推理与全端侧处理三种方案。
AI.result: 在多种评测设置下优于当前最优时间序列基础模型与监督基线，尤其在零校准跨被试与数据稀缺场景中表现突出；同时刻画了全卸载、拆分推理与端侧处理在延迟、功耗与内存占用上的权衡。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明 LiteEMG-FM 是一种有效、高效且可实际部署的 EMG 基础模型，兼顾泛化性能与资源受限实时应用需求。

title: RATE: Risk-Aware Tactile Encoding for Contact-rich Robotic Manipulation
summary: Tactile sensing is particularly valuable for contact-rich robotic manipulation. Recent work has made substantial progress in tactile representation learning for robotic manipulation. However, similar tactile observations can arise from interaction conditions with very different task-risk implications, such as sensor noise, task-necessary variations, and emerging undesirable contact. Without context-grounded risk information, these cases can be ambiguous to downstream policies, leading to unnecessary corrections to benign variations or delayed responses to genuinely risky contact. To address this limitation, we propose Risk-Aware Tactile Encoding (RATE), which learns tactile representations that encode task-conditioned interaction risk. Specifically, history-conditioned prediction captures interaction context, while alert supervision associates this context with task-conditioned risk. The learned risk-aware representation complements conventional tactile features through a lightweight residual adapter. Experiments in both simulation and the real world demonstrate substantial improvements in task success, with controlled ablations confirming the complementary benefits of alert-guided learning and predictive temporal modeling.

AI.tldr: 本文提出风险感知触觉编码（RATE），学习编码任务条件下交互风险的触觉表示，以缓解相似触觉观测对应不同风险含义的歧义问题。
AI.motivation: 接触丰富的机器人操作中，相似触觉观测可能来自风险差异极大的交互条件（传感器噪声、任务必需变化、新出现的异常接触）。缺乏基于情境的风险信息会导致下游策略产生歧义，进而对良性变化做不必要修正，或对真正危险接触响应延迟。
AI.method: 提出RATE：通过历史条件预测捕获交互情境，并以告警监督将该情境与任务条件风险关联，从而学习风险感知的触觉表示；该表示通过轻量级残差适配器与常规触觉特征互补融合。
AI.result: 仿真与真实世界实验均显示任务成功率显著提升；受控消融验证了告警引导学习与预测性时序建模的互补收益。
AI.conclusion: 任务条件下的风险感知触觉表示可作为常规触觉特征的有效补充，提升机器人操作中应对歧义触觉输入的性能。

title: A Benchmark for Spatially Grounded Gesture Generation
comment: 13 pages, 9 figures. Benchmark of the Referential Gesture Challenge at the HSI Workshop, ECCV 2026. Data and video: https://huggingface.co/datasets/hsi-workshop/referential-gesture-challenge
summary: Communication in shared space interweaves verbal and non-verbal signals, and pointing gestures anchor language to the environment: "put the cup on that one" is uninterpretable without the gesture that fixes the referent. Yet no common framework exists for evaluating whether generated gestures indicate their intended referent; distributional metrics reward a gesture aimed at the wrong object as long as it looks natural. We introduce a benchmark for spatially grounded gesture generation, comprising ~2K pointing-annotated clips from naturalistic VR dialogue with ground-truth 3D referents, a task in which systems must decide when, how and where to point within conversational speech, and a protocol that separates temporal alignment, spatial grounding and perceived naturalness. We also provide a flow-matching baseline, MM-Conv-Flow. Evaluating it alongside an independent retrieval-based system and captured human motion, we find that geometric grounding can exceed that of human pointing without any gain in perceived naturalness, showing that referential gesture quality must be measured along separate dimensions.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一个面向空间锚定手势生成的基准，包含约2K个带指向标注的VR对话片段及真值3D指称物，并设计了将时间对齐、空间锚定与感知自然度分离的评测协议，同时提供流匹配基线MM-Conv-Flow。
AI.motivation: 共享空间中的交流融合言语与非言语信号，指向手势将语言锚定到环境（如"把杯子放在那个上面"离开手势则无法解读）。然而目前缺乏通用框架来评估生成手势是否指向了意图指称物：分布性指标只要手势看起来自然，就会奖励指向错误物体的手势。
AI.method: 构建了空间锚定手势生成基准：约2K个来自自然VR对话、带指向标注的片段，含真值3D指称物；定义了一个任务，要求系统判定在对话语音中何时、如何、何处指向；并提出将时间对齐、空间锚定与感知自然度三者分离的评测协议。此外提供流匹配基线MM-Conv-Flow。
AI.result: 将MM-Conv-Flow与一个独立的基于检索的系统以及采集的人类动作进行对比评估，发现几何锚定可以超过人类指向，但感知自然度没有任何提升。
AI.conclusion: 指称手势质量必须在相互独立的维度上分别度量，不能由自然度或分布性指标替代空间锚定的正确性。

title: PAPER2LLM++: Continual Self-Evolution of LLMs from Research Papers
summary: Research on LLMs continually uncovers model limitations, their causes, and potential solutions. Yet these human discoveries remain largely disconnected from model evolution: an LLM does not automatically learn from new research about its own failures. We introduce PAPER2LLM++, a framework for continual self-evolution of LLMs from research papers. Rather than treating papers merely as knowledge to retrieve, PAPER2LLM++ uses the growing literature as a stream of evidence and supervision for model improvement. For each incoming paper, it extracts evidence-grounded findings, tests whether the reported limitation persists in the current model, and, when needed, converts the findings into candidate learning signals. A try-evaluate-commit procedure integrates an update only when it improves the targeted behavior without substantially forgetting prior improvements or degrading general capabilities. Across a sequential stream of research-discovered LLM failures, we show that models can progressively incorporate new findings while retaining earlier gains. PAPER2LLM++ thus takes a step toward closing the loop between human discovery and model evolution, enabling models to continually learn from research about their own limitations and improvements.

AI.tldr: 提出 PAPER2LLM++ 框架，将研究论文作为持续监督信号，使 LLM 能自动从关于自身缺陷的研究中发现、验证并吸收改进，实现在不遗忘与不损害通用能力前提下的持续自演化。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 研究不断揭示模型局限、成因与解决方案，但这些人类发现与模型演化基本脱节：模型无法自动从针对自身失败的新研究中学习。论文旨在打通"人类发现—模型演化"的闭环，让模型持续从关于自身局限与改进的研究中获益。
AI.method: PAPER2LLM++ 不把论文仅当作检索知识，而是将其视为改进模型的证据与监督流。对每篇新论文：①抽取有证据支撑的发现（evidence-grounded findings）；②检验该局限在当前模型中是否仍存在；③必要时将发现转化为候选学习信号；④采用 try-evaluate-commit 流程，仅当更新能改善目标行为、且不明显遗忘既有改进或损害通用能力时才提交。
AI.result: 在一系列按顺序到达的"研究发现的 LLM 失败"流上实验，模型能够逐步吸收新发现，同时保留此前的改进效果，验证了持续自演化的可行性。
AI.conclusion: PAPER2LLM++ 朝"人类发现与模型演化闭环"迈出一步，使模型能持续从关于自身局限与改进的研究中学习，为研究驱动的 LLM 自演化提供了框架。

title: Multi-Fidelity Policy Gradients Stabilize Data-Scarce Reinforcement Learning
summary: Policy gradient methods for on-policy reinforcement learning (RL) can become unstable when expensive, scarce target-domain data yield noisy gradient estimates. We address this challenge by complementing limited high-fidelity (HF) target-domain data with abundant, cheap, but biased low-fidelity (LF) data, e.g., from a simplified simulator. Most existing methods directly optimize biased objectives based on LF data. In contrast, the recently introduced multi-fidelity policy gradient (MFPG) framework uses LF data solely to construct a control variate that reduces variance and improves HF data efficiency without biasing the policy gradient estimator. However, published work on MFPG is limited to REINFORCE on small-scale simulation tasks. We develop MFPG for modern actor-critic learning in GPU-parallel simulation and on a physical robot. Our analysis and experiments show that naive extensions to proximal policy optimization (PPO) can lose cross-fidelity correlation or inflate variance. Our MFPG-PPO addresses these failures by redesigning the sampling, advantage estimation, and control variate construction to preserve cross-fidelity correlation, and by monitoring estimator uncertainty to prevent variance inflation. We also introduce a budget-aware MFPG-PPO to divide a fixed sampling budget among high- and low-fidelity data sources. Across simulated robot locomotion tasks of varying LF-to-HF transfer difficulty and HF data budgets, MFPG-PPO improves upon PPO trained on HF data alone in nearly all settings, and consistently matches the performance of PPO trained with 16x more HF data on the hardest task at the smallest HF budgets. In contrast, most baselines that use LF data perform well only where direct LF-to-HF transfer succeeds. MFPG-PPO enables stable learning on a physical Franka arm using only 4 real-robot episodes per update and no human demonstrations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MFPG-PPO，将多保真度策略梯度框架从REINFORCE扩展到现代actor-critic学习，并引入预算感知变体，在仿真与真实机器人上验证其在有限高保真数据下的稳定性和数据效率。
AI.motivation: 在线策略强化学习在目标域数据稀缺、昂贵时，梯度估计噪声大、训练不稳定。现有利用低保真数据的方法大多直接优化有偏目标，而MFPG虽用低保真数据构造控制变量以无偏降方差，但仅局限于小规模仿真上的REINFORCE，缺乏与现代actor-critic方法（如PPO）及GPU并行仿真、真实机器人的结合。
AI.method: 作者将MFPG扩展到现代actor-critic学习。分析表明，直接扩展到PPO可能丢失跨保真度相关性或放大方差。据此提出MFPG-PPO：重新设计采样、优势估计与控制变量构造以保持跨保真度相关性，并通过监控估计器不确定性来防止方差膨胀；进一步提出预算感知的MFPG-PPO，在固定采样预算下在高、低保真数据源间分配采样。
AI.result: 在不同低保真到高保真迁移难度和高保真数据预算的仿真机器人运动任务中，MFPG-PPO在几乎所有设置下均优于仅用高保真数据训练的PPO；在最难任务、最小高保真预算下，其性能可媲美使用16倍高保真数据训练的PPO。多数直接利用低保真数据的基线仅在其低保真到高保真迁移成功时表现良好。MFPG-PPO还能在真实Franka机械臂上仅用每次更新4个真实机器人回合、且无人类示范的情况下实现稳定学习。
AI.conclusion: MFPG-PPO成功将无偏的多保真度策略梯度框架推广到现代actor-critic学习与真实机器人场景，在保持跨保真度相关性和控制方差的同时显著提升高保真数据效率，并支持预算约束下的采样分配，展现出比传统PPO和低保真基线更强的稳定性与实用性。

title: A Unified Framework for Empowerment and Predictive Control
summary: Sampling-based model predictive control (MPC) is a powerful approach to trajectory optimization, but its performance depends on an informative cost function that often requires substantial domain knowledge to design. An alternative is to derive objectives directly from the system dynamics. Empowerment, defined as the channel capacity between an agent's inputs and its future state, provides such a goal-agnostic objective and has been shown to produce useful behaviors across a range of domains. However, existing empowerment-based controllers have two key limitations: empowerment is estimated using a virtual probing policy distinct from the executed control policy, obscuring its connection to the resulting behavior; and its computation typically requires second-order derivatives of the dynamics, limiting compatibility with standard MPC methods. We formulate empowerment using a single policy for both probing and acting, directly linking the empowerment objective to the executed behavior. The resulting objective requires only first-order derivatives and can be optimized with standard MPC solvers, either alone or in combination with a task-specific cost. We evaluate the proposed approach on classical control tasks and show that combining empowerment with task costs matches or exceeds the success rate achieved by either objective alone. Our formulation provides a practical bridge between standard MPC and intrinsically motivated control.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种将empowerment目标与采样型MPC统一的方法，用同一策略同时完成探测与执行，使目标仅需一阶导数即可用标准MPC求解器优化。
AI.motivation: 采样型MPC依赖需大量领域知识设计的信息性代价函数；empowerment作为目标无关的内在动机目标虽有用，但现有控制器存在两个问题：探测策略与执行策略不一致，导致目标与行为脱节；计算需二阶导数，难以兼容标准MPC。
AI.method: 用单一策略同时承担探测与执行，将empowerment目标直接与所执行行为关联；由此得到的优化目标只需动力学的一阶导数，可用标准MPC求解器优化，并可单独使用或与任务特定代价组合。
AI.result: 在经典控制任务上评估，empowerment与任务代价相结合的成功率达到或超过任一目标单独使用的水平。
AI.conclusion: 该形式化方法为标准MPC与内在动机控制之间提供了实用的桥梁。

title: In-Distribution Forcing for Long Video Generation at Test Time
summary: Modern autoregressive (AR) video diffusion models excel at short-horizon video generation, yet generating long videos remains challenging due to drifting, where colors and textures shift, and motion dynamics decay. Existing works primarily rely on KV conditioning, which selects or modifies cached key-value (KV) entries to mitigate drifting. However, we observe that KV conditioning alone is insufficient as it assumes cached KV entries remain in-distribution. This assumption fails beyond the training horizon: nothing constrains the construction of KV entries during rollout, giving rise to the KV-provenance problem where cached entries themselves become out-of-distribution (OOD). To address this, we propose In-Distribution Forcing (ID-Forcing), a test-time framework that aligns both KV caching and KV conditioning with training configurations. Its key mechanism, self-caching, prevents OOD KV entries at their source. Each chunk is cached without attending to prior KV entry, keeping the rolling window exactly in-distribution. Consequently, ID-Forcing seamlessly extends short-horizon models to minute-scale video generation. Extensive evaluations show that our method remains competitive on standard video generation benchmark while substantially outperforming prior work in mitigating drifting, as validated by both our drift metrics and a user study.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 ID-Forcing 测试时框架，通过 self-caching 机制保证 KV 缓存与条件化均处于训练分布内，从而缓解长视频自回归扩散生成中的漂移问题。
AI.motivation: 现有自回归视频扩散模型擅长短视频生成，但长视频生成受"漂移"影响（颜色纹理偏移、运动动态衰减）。已有方法主要依赖 KV conditioning，通过选择或修改缓存 KV 条目缓解漂移，但作者观察到该类方法不足：它假设缓存 KV 条目仍在分布内，而超出训练时长后这一假设失效，KV 条目的构造不受约束，导致缓存本身变为分布外（OOD），即 KV-provenance 问题。
AI.method: 提出 In-Distribution Forcing（ID-Forcing）测试时框架，使 KV 缓存与 KV conditioning 均与训练配置对齐。其核心机制为 self-caching：每个 chunk 在被缓存时不关注先前的 KV 条目，从而让滑动窗口严格保持在分布内，从源头上避免 OOD KV 条目。
AI.result: 在标准视频生成基准上保持竞争力，同时显著优于先前工作地缓解漂移，并通过自研漂移指标与用户研究双重验证。
AI.conclusion: ID-Forcing 可无缝地将短时域视频模型扩展至分钟级视频生成，说明从源头上保证 KV 分布一致性是解决长视频漂移的有效途径。

title: Modeling Shared and Individual Structure for Cross-Subject Continuous Affect Regression from EEG-fNIRS
summary: Continuous, second-by-second valence-arousal estimation from physiological signals is typically studied in a subject-dependent setting, where the model sees labeled data from the same person it is later evaluated on. We study the harder zero-shot cross-subject variant on a synchronized EEG-fNIRS dataset: predict raw-scale ([1, 255]) valence and arousal trajectories for subjects whose labels the model never observes, given only their unlabeled EEG/fNIRS recordings while watching the same video stimuli as a disjoint set of training subjects. We decompose the affect trajectory into a structure shared across subjects who watch the same stimuli and an individual structure estimated for each test subject from a label-free EEG marker (alpha-band cross-channel synchrony), which rescales the shared trajectory around the scale midpoint. We validate the per-subject calibration mechanism on four independent axes: leave-one-subject-out correlation between the marker and each subject's true optimal gain, a functional-form comparison against non-linear alternatives, a repeated leave-4-out component ablation isolating each part of the pipeline's contribution, and a ceiling analysis bounding the remaining headroom for per-subject scaling. On held-out subjects, the model reaches an overall MAE of 25.96 / 22.80 across two evaluation batches (valence 21.94 / 19.6, arousal 29.98 / 26.0), well below EEGNet and ASAC-Net baselines reported for the same subject-independent split (raw scale score 60.6 and 55.0 respectively). We further report a systematic negative-result search across model architectures, feature representations, and prediction targets that found no signal able to improve on the single alpha-synchrony marker.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究基于同步EEG-fNIRS的零样本跨被试连续效价-唤醒度估计，通过将情感轨迹分解为跨被试共享结构与基于无标签alpha波段跨通道同步性估计的个体结构，实现测试被试的逐人校准，MAE显著优于基线。
AI.motivation: 现有连续逐秒效价-唤醒度估计多在被试依赖设定下研究（模型看过同一被试的标注数据），而零样本跨被试设定更困难且更具实用价值：需在完全未见标签的被试上预测原始尺度情感轨迹。作者希望解决该更难的变体。
AI.method: 在同步EEG-fNIRS数据集上，给定测试被试仅有无标签EEG/fNIRS记录（与训练被试观看相同视频刺激但被试不重叠），将情感轨迹分解为：（1）观看相同刺激的被试间共享结构；（2）由无标签EEG标记——alpha波段跨通道同步性——估计的个体结构，用于围绕尺度中点对共享轨迹进行重缩放。通过四个独立维度验证逐被试校准机制：标记与真实最优增益的留一被试相关、与非线性替代形式的功能形式比较、重复leave-4-out组件消融、以及对逐被试缩放的剩余空间上限分析。
AI.result: 在留出被试上，模型在两个评估批次达到总体MAE 25.96/22.80（效价21.94/19.6，唤醒度29.98/26.0），显著低于相同被试独立划分下EEGNet与ASAC-Net基线的原始尺度得分（分别为60.6与55.0）。此外，跨模型架构、特征表示与预测目标的系统性负结果搜索未发现能优于单一alpha同步性标记的信号。
AI.conclusion: 无标签的alpha波段跨通道同步性可作为有效的逐被试校准标记，在零样本跨被试连续情感估计中实现显著优于基线的性能；单一alpha同步性标记已具较强表达力，其他架构/特征/目标未带来增益，且上限分析界定了逐被试缩放的剩余提升空间。

title: Post-Training Quantization of Autoregressive Weather Models
summary: Advancements in high-resolution numerical weather prediction (NWP) and data assimilation (DA) have shaped the developments in deep learning (DL) architectures emulating atmospheric dynamics. Emulators for weather forecasting exhibit forecast quality comparable to physics based models at forecast horizon scaling from few days to subseasonal time scales. The emulators are driven by hardware-accelerated matrix multiplication in autoregressive inferences, significantly reducing the computation time and resources required for NWP. Optimization of the matrix multiplication processes in GPU architectures provides opportunities to scale towards high-resolution domain, and offers implementation of out of the box solutions. Post-training quantization (PTQ) has been demonstrated across multiple DL architectures to accelerate and increase the number of computations in unit time while consuming less power, enabling applications on edge hardware. In this study, we investigate the effect of PTQ on pre-trained AI emulators for global-scale weather forecasting. We implement PTQ algorithms in Deep Learning Weather Prediction (DLWP) and FourCastNet (FCN) models as a proof of concept for geophysical fluid dynamics applications. We systematically investigate the effect of PTQ on emulator inferences over short-range forecast horizons. Evaluation of PTQ configurations using simulated quantization hints at qualitatively meaningful forecasts over short-time horizons. These results provide a first benchmark of PTQ for autoregressive weather emulators and a basis for quantization-based optimization of DL models for dynamical systems.

AI.tldr: 本研究首次对预训练的全球尺度天气AI模拟器（DLWP与FourCastNet）实施训练后量化（PTQ），系统性评估其对短时预报推理的影响，为地流流体动力学应用的量化优化提供基准。
AI.motivation: 高分辨率数值天气预报（NWP）与数据同化（DA）推动了深度学习（DL）大气动力学模拟架构的发展。基于GPU的矩阵乘法加速显著降低了计算开销，而训练后量化（PTQ）能在降低功耗的同时提升单位时间计算量，支持边缘硬件部署，因此有必要研究PTQ对天气模拟器预报质量的影响。
AI.method: 在预训练的DLWP和FourCastNet（FCN）全球天气预报模型上实现PTQ算法，作为地球物理流体动力学概念验证；通过模拟量化配置，系统性考察PTQ对短时预报时效内模拟器推理的效果。
AI.result: 使用模拟量化评估PTQ配置，显示在短时预报时效内可获得定性上有意义的预报结果。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提供了自回归天气模拟器PTQ的首个基准，并为动力系统DL模型的量化优化奠定了基础。

title: AVL-JEPA: Preventing Causal Dynamics Information Collapse In Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture World Models
summary: Joint embedding predictive architectures (JEPAs) predict future latent representations without reconstructing observations, enabling world models to focus on high-level semantic dynamics. However, a JEPA can preserve high dimensional visual information while discarding information about the physical consequences of actions. We call this failure mode causal dynamics information collapse and propose action-grounded vision-invariance latent (AVL) to prevent this collapse. We first use the executed action as an auxiliary dynamics anchor that encourages the model to preserve dynamics information, and then use a vision-invariance pathway which aligns perturbed and clean latent predictions without discarding dynamics information, forcing the model to fully understand and utilize causal dynamics information. We validate AVL on four robotic control tasks (TwoRoom, PushT, OGBench Cube, and Reacher), showing that it substantially improves success rates under visual perturbations while preserving clean-environment performance. We further evaluate physical consequence alignment, clean-noisy dynamics consistency, and the causal effect of targeted transition subspace erasure. Collectively, these results indicate that dynamic information causally relevant to planning is preserved from collapse under AVL.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AVL方法，通过动作锚定与视觉不变性通路，缓解JEPA中的因果动态信息坍塌，提升视觉扰动下的机器人控制成功率。
AI.motivation: JEPA类世界模型在不重建观测的情况下预测未来隐表示，但存在一种失败模式：模型保留高维视觉信息，却丢弃关于动作物理后果的信息。作者将此称为因果动态信息坍塌（causal dynamics information collapse），需要加以解决。
AI.method: 提出动作锚定视觉不变性隐表示（AVL）。首先以实际执行的动作作为辅助动态锚点，促使模型保留动态信息；其次采用视觉不变性通路，在不丢弃动态信息的前提下对齐扰动与干净隐预测，迫使模型充分理解并利用因果动态信息。
AI.result: 在四个机器人控制任务（TwoRoom、PushT、OGBench Cube、Reacher）上验证，AVL在视觉扰动下显著提升成功率，同时保持干净环境性能。进一步通过物理后果对齐、干净-噪声动态一致性以及定向转移子空间擦除的因果效应进行评估。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果表明，与规划因果相关的动态信息在AVL下得以免于坍塌并被保留。

title: Foresight: planning future perception in streaming VLMs without retraining
summary: Existing streaming vision-language models (VLMs) continuously perceive and reason over visual streams, but their computational pathways remain fixed throughout inference. Consequently, they cannot adapt computation to evolving scene dynamics, where different future events demand different levels and forms of perception. We show that streaming VLMs inherently possess the ability to anticipate the immediate future, and leverage this capability to dynamically configure future computation in a training-free manner. Realizing such anticipatory computation, however, is very challenging: future anticipation must be sufficiently reliable to guide computation, planning must run concurrently with streaming inference, and online reconfiguration must incur negligible overhead. To address these challenges, we introduce FORESIGHT, a dual-stream architecture comprising two Siamese LLMs with shared weights, input encoders, and KV cache. The first LLM continuously processes incoming tokens, while the second runs ahead of the stream to anticipate future context, plan future computation, and generate task responses without interrupting streaming inference. Each plan decides when to reason next, what to check then, and how densely to sample, keeping transient evidence separate from persistent control. The resulting computation plan is executed online through an efficient reconfiguration protocol with schemaguided decoding and lightweight diff-based updates, enabling dynamic adaptation with low overhead. With a frozen Qwen3-VL-8B backbone, FORESIGHT achieves 23.0 mean joint F1 on OmniPro Online evaluation beating strongest trained baseline by 9.5%, while improving the backbone by 6.7 on StreamingBench and 15.4 on OVO-Bench, with the largest gain of 18.7 when evidence arrives later in the video stream. Our source code will be made publicly available.

AI.tldr: 提出FORESIGHT双流架构，使流式VLM在免训练条件下预测未来并动态配置计算，显著提升在线视频理解性能。
AI.motivation: 现有流式视觉语言模型在推理过程中计算路径固定，无法根据不断变化的场景动态调整计算的层级与形式；而不同未来事件所需的感知程度与方式并不相同。作者发现流式VLM本身具备预测近期未来的能力，希望据此免训练地动态配置未来计算。但实现这一目标面临三大挑战：未来预测须足够可靠以指导计算、规划须与流式推理并发进行、在线重配置开销须可忽略。
AI.method: 提出FORESIGHT，一种双流架构：由两个共享权重、输入编码器和KV缓存的Siamese LLM组成。第一个LLM持续处理到来的token，第二个LLM超前于数据流运行，预测未来上下文、规划未来计算并生成任务响应，且不打断流式推理。每个规划决定何时再次推理、届时检查什么以及采样密度，将瞬态证据与持久控制分离。所生成的计算计划通过高效重配置协议在线执行，包括schema引导解码与轻量级diff式更新，实现低开销的动态自适应。骨干网络为冻结的Qwen3-VL-8B。
AI.result: 在OmniPro Online评测上取得23.0的平均联合F1，超过最强已训练基线9.5%；在StreamingBench上较骨干提升6.7，在OVO-Bench上提升15.4，其中当证据在视频流中较晚出现时增益最大，达18.7。
AI.conclusion: FORESIGHT证明流式VLM可免训练地利用自身未来预测能力来动态配置计算，在冻结骨干下显著提升在线视频理解性能，尤其在证据延迟出现的场景中优势突出。源代码将公开。

title: BitNest: Bit-Nested Speculative Decoding for Memory-Efficient LLM Inference Acceleration
summary: Speculative decoding accelerates autoregressive generation by using a lightweight draft to propose multiple tokens for parallel verification. However, existing methods often require an additional draft model or weight representation, introducing non-negligible memory overhead on resource-constrained devices. Self-speculative approaches reduce this overhead, yet still face trade-offs between draft quality, target quality, and storage efficiency. We propose BitNest, a bit-nested speculative decoding framework that embeds a low-precision draft directly into the higher-precision target representation. Instead of deriving a draft from a predefined target, BitNest first constructs a strong low-precision base and then recovers the higher-precision target through residual refinement, enabling both models to share a single physical weight representation. BitNest further extends this progressive-precision design to the KV cache for long-context inference. Across multiple 7B--8B edge-friendly LLMs and diverse workloads, BitNest achieves an average speculative acceptance rate of 95.2% while closely preserving higher-precision model quality, and delivers 1.48--1.61x end-to-end speedup over FP16 autoregressive decoding. On the LLaMA models supported by all representative self-speculative baselines, BitNest also achieves consistently competitive or higher decoding speedup.

AI.tldr: BitNest 提出一种位嵌套（bit-nested）自推测解码框架，将低精度草稿模型嵌入高精度目标模型的权重表示中，共享单一物理权重，从而在资源受限设备上以低内存开销实现加速。
AI.motivation: 现有推测解码方法通常需要额外的草稿模型或权重表示，带来不可忽视的内存开销；自推测方法虽降低开销，但在草稿质量、目标质量和存储效率之间仍存在权衡。因此需要一个能同时兼顾这三者的轻量化框架。
AI.method: BitNest 不预先定义目标模型再派生草稿，而是先构建强力的低精度基座，再通过残差细化恢复高精度目标，使两个模型共享同一物理权重表示；并将这种渐进式精度设计扩展到 KV cache，以支持长上下文推理。整体形成位嵌套式自推测解码框架。
AI.result: 在多个 7B--8B 边缘友好 LLM 与多样工作负载上，BitNest 达到平均 95.2% 的推测接受率，同时较好保持高精度模型质量，相比 FP16 自回归解码实现 1.48--1.61x 端到端加速；在所有代表性自推测基线均支持的 LLaMA 模型上，也取得一致更优或相当的解码加速。
AI.conclusion: BitNest 通过位嵌套的渐进式精度设计，在单一权重表示内同时获得高质量草稿与目标模型，兼顾存储效率与推理质量，为资源受限设备上的自推测解码提供了有效方案，并具备向 KV cache 与长上下文场景扩展的能力。

title: Student-Guided Teacher Distillation for Efficient LLM Task Routing: Positioning Against Jev-Style System-1 Classifiers
summary: Zero-shot classifiers are useful for routing user requests to specialized LLM tasks, but scoring every request against a large candidate set is expensive: a zero-shot NLI classifier must evaluate one premise-hypothesis pair per label, so cost scales linearly with taxonomy size. We study a student-guided teacher distillation pipeline for a fixed taxonomy of 60 LLM task categories: a compact ModernBERT classifier predicts the full category distribution in one forward pass and retrieves a small top-k candidate set, and a larger DeBERTa-v3 zero-shot NLI classifier reranks only those candidates rather than all 60 labels; the resulting teacher labels iteratively improve the student, which produces sharper candidates for the next round. Unlike generic embedding retrieval or clustering-derived shortlists used in extreme multi-label classification, our candidate generator is trained end-to-end on the target taxonomy and is the same model serving production traffic, distinguishing it from LLM-routing work that routes between candidate models, and from concurrent System-1 encoder-classifier proposals (e.g. TypeSafe AI's Jev and the open-source Laya project) whose training methodology is undocumented or RL-based. Our best student checkpoint reaches 77.5% teacher agreement on a 200-example evaluation set, and preliminary coverage measurements show Coverage@16 of 91-100%, suggesting top-k sets retain most of the teacher's decision-relevant information. We further show truncated top-k teacher scores should not be treated as full 60-class soft targets for KL distillation: zeroing untruncated classes destroys the dark knowledge soft-label distillation depends on, introducing systematic bias rather than a harmless sparse approximation. A complete evaluation, including coverage at multiple k on a held-out set, an embedding-retrieval baseline, and a larger human-reviewed test set, remains in progress.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种学生引导的教师蒸馏流水线，用于60类LLM任务路由：紧凑的ModernBERT学生模型一次前向预测全类别分布并检索top-k候选，再由大型DeBERTa-v3零样本NLI教师仅对候选重排序，教师标签迭代改进学生。最佳学生检查点达到77.5%教师一致率，Coverage@16为91-100%；并指出截断top-k教师分数不应作为完整60类软目标用于KL蒸馏。
AI.motivation: 零样本分类器适合将用户请求路由到专门的LLM任务，但对大型候选集逐一打分成本高昂：零样本NLI分类器需对每个标签评估一个前提-假设对，成本随分类体系规模线性增长。因此需要降低路由打分成本，同时保留教师的决策相关信息。
AI.method: 针对固定60类LLM任务分类体系，构建学生引导的教师蒸馏流水线：紧凑的ModernBERT分类器一次前向传播预测完整类别分布并检索小的top-k候选集；较大的DeBERTa-v3零样本NLI分类器仅对这k个候选重排序而非全部60个标签；产生的教师标签迭代改进学生，使下一轮候选更精准。候选生成器在目标分类体系上端到端训练，且即为生产流量服务的同一模型。作者进一步分析截断top-k教师分数用于KL蒸馏的问题。
AI.result: 最佳学生检查点在一个200样本评估集上达到77.5%的教师一致率；初步覆盖率测量显示Coverage@16为91-100%，表明top-k集合保留了教师大部分与决策相关的信息。研究还表明，截断的top-k教师分数不应被当作完整60类软目标用于KL蒸馏：将未截断类别置零会破坏软标签蒸馏所依赖的暗知识，引入系统性偏差而非无害的稀疏近似。（完整评估仍在进行中）
AI.conclusion: 学生-教师蒸馏流水线可在一次前向传播中完成大分类体系的路由打分，通过教师重排序少量候选来保持信息量，同时显著降低零样本NLI打分成本；截断top-k软目标会破坏暗知识并引入偏差，需谨慎处理。完整评估（多k覆盖率、held-out集、嵌入检索基线及更大人工审核测试集）尚在进行。

title: World Action Learning via Interaction-Centric Spectral Latent Guidance
summary: Learning general-purpose robot policies requires large-scale real-world interaction data, yet collecting robot demonstrations remains expensive and difficult to scale. Egocentric videos offer abundant human interaction experience with task-relevant semantics for robotic manipulation, but direct transfer is challenging for two reasons: latent actions inferred from frame reconstruction can be dominated by nuisance variation such as ego-camera motion, and human and robot behaviors often exhibit different temporal dynamics. We propose WING (World Action Learning via INteraction-Centric Spectral Latent Guidance), a framework for transferring interaction knowledge from egocentric videos to robot policies. WING first separates observer-induced motion from hand-object interaction and distills the interaction-centric component into latent actions. It then exploits the observation that cross-embodiment task semantics are concentrated in slowly varying temporal structures, identifying shared low-frequency components between egocentric latent actions and robot behaviors in the spectral domain and using them to guide action generation. WING achieves average success rates of 99.20% on LIBERO, 93.80% on RoboTwin 2.0, and 57.7% on RoboCasa-GR1, and also performs strongly across four real-world manipulation tasks under diverse generalization settings. These results show that interaction-centric spectral guidance provides an effective and scalable way to transfer physical interaction knowledge from human egocentric video to robot control. Project page: https://mikuz12.github.io/wing/

AI.tldr: 提出WING框架，通过分离手物交互与观察者运动、并在谱域中利用低频共享结构，将第一人称视频中的交互知识迁移到机器人策略。
AI.motivation: 机器人策略学习依赖大规模真实交互数据，但机器人示教采集昂贵且难以扩展；第一人称自我中心视频虽富含任务语义，却因两个问题难以直接迁移：一是帧重建推断的潜在动作易被自我相机运动等无关变化主导，二是人与机器人行为的时间动态存在差异。
AI.method: WING先分离观察者引起的运动与手-物交互，将交互中心成分蒸馏为潜在动作；再基于跨本体的任务语义集中于缓慢变化的时间结构的观察，在谱域中识别自我中心潜在动作与机器人行为之间的共享低频成分，并用其引导动作生成。
AI.result: 在LIBERO上平均成功率达99.20%，RoboTwin 2.0上为93.80%，RoboCasa-GR1上为57.7%；在四项真实世界操作任务与多种泛化设置下也表现强劲。
AI.conclusion: 以交互为中心的谱域引导为从人类第一人称视频向机器人控制迁移物理交互知识提供了一种有效且可扩展的途径。

title: Behavior Pack Optimization for Video MLLM Post-Training
summary: Video multimodal large language models (MLLMs) keep climbing video question answering benchmarks, yet shuffling the frames, masking the segment that supports the answer, or occluding the target object barely changes their predictions. The accuracy rests on appearance and language priors, not on the temporal evidence the question asks for. We trace this to the unit of post-training: rewards are computed on a single response to the original clip, so the model is never asked to behave consistently across views. We propose Behavior Pack Optimization (BPO), which replaces the single response with a behavior pack of outputs across counterfactual views chosen by question type, scored jointly. The pack reward asks for stability when the intervention is irrelevant, sensitivity when key evidence is removed, and abstention when no evidence remains. To keep this objective stable at small pack sizes, BPO uses an anchor-relative advantage: the response on the original view serves as a per-prompt reference instead of a group mean over mixed views. On TempCompass, MVBench, and NExT-QA, BPO improves the macro accuracy of Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct by 4.7 pp, the temporal-hard subset by 7.8 pp, and abstention F1 by 20.0 pp over a budget-matched vanilla GRPO baseline from the same SFT checkpoint. The gains transfer to Video-MME, LongVideoBench, and to LLaVA-Video-7B; ablations confirm they follow the view sets, not the rollout count. We hope this pack-level perspective offers a useful starting point for the video MLLM and multimodal post-training community as the field moves toward evidence-grounded video reasoning.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出视频多模态大模型(Video MLLM)的准确性依赖外观与语言先验而非时序证据，提出行为包优化(BPO)，在反事实视图上联合评分，显著提升时序推理与拒答能力。
AI.motivation: 视频MLLM虽在视频问答基准上不断提升，但对帧打乱、关键证据段遮挡、目标物体遮蔽等干预几乎不改变预测，说明模型依赖外观和语言先验而非问题所需的时序证据。作者将其归因于后训练的基本单元：奖励仅基于对原始片段的单一响计算，模型从未被要求在不同视图间保持一致行为。
AI.method: 提出行为包优化(BPO)，用跨反事实视图的输出"行为包"替代单一响应，并按问题类型选择视图集，进行联合评分。包奖励要求：干预无关时保持稳定、关键证据被移除时表现敏感、无证据时可拒答。为在小包尺寸下稳定该目标，BPO采用锚点相对优势(anchor-relative advantage)，以原始视图上的响应作为每个prompt的参考，而非混合视图上的组均值。
AI.result: 在TempCompass、MVBench和NExT-QA上，相比同一SFT检查点、预算匹配的vanilla GRPO基线，BPO将Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct的宏平均准确率提升4.7个百分点，时序困难子集提升7.8个百分点，拒答F1提升20.0个百分点。增益可迁移至Video-MME、LongVideoBench以及LLaVA-Video-7B；消融实验证实增益来源于视图集而非rollout数量。
AI.conclusion: 包级(pack-level)视角为视频MLLM与多模态后训练社区提供了有用起点，有助于推动领域迈向基于证据的视频推理。

title: VIGOR: Zero-Shot Visual Generalization via Latent-Space Consistency in Model-Based Reinforcement Learning
summary: Model-based reinforcement learning (MBRL) achieves strong sample efficiency by planning within learned latent dynamics, yet its performance degrades substantially under unseen visual distractions such as background variations, lighting changes, or camera shifts. Unlike model-free RL, where encoder perturbations affect only single-step predictions, MBRL suffers from a two-level vulnerability: visual distractions first push encoder outputs out of distribution, and these errors then compound through recursive latent rollouts over the planning horizon. We propose visual generalization via latent-space consistency in model-based RL (VIGOR), a framework that enables zero-shot generalization to unseen visual distractions while retaining the sample efficiency of its MBRL backbone. VIGOR integrates three interdependent components: (i) asymmetric weak-to-strong augmentation, which pairs weak-only and weak-to-strong latent views within a single batch; (ii) dynamics-level consistency, which enforces augmentation-invariant transition predictions through direct latent regression; and (iii) encoder-level stabilization, which prevents encoder drift under the cross-augmentation supervision imposed by dynamics-level consistency. Evaluations on the DeepMind Control Suite (DMC) and Robosuite show that VIGOR outperforms state-of-the-art model-free and model-based baselines, surpassing the second-best baseline by 3.4% on DMC and 43.6% on Robosuite. Ablations further show that VIGOR's robustness is augmentation-agnostic: replacing the default augmentation with alternatives from distinct perturbation families preserves strong generalization, confirming that latent-space consistency, not the augmentation choice, drives robustness.

AI.tldr: VIGOR：通过潜在空间一致性实现基于模型强化学习的视觉零样本泛化
AI.motivation: 基于模型的强化学习（MBRL）虽具样本效率优势，但在未见的视觉干扰（背景、光照、相机变化）下性能显著下降。不同于无模型RL中编码器扰动仅影响单步预测，MBRL存在"两级脆弱性"：视觉干扰先使编码器输出偏离分布，误差再通过规划时段内的递归潜在推演不断累积。
AI.method: 提出VIGOR框架，包含三个相互依赖的组件：(i) 非对称弱到强增强，在同一批次内配对"仅弱增强"与"弱到强"的潜在视图；(ii) 动态级一致性，通过直接潜在回归强制增强不变的转移预测；(iii) 编码器级稳定化，防止动态级一致性所施加的跨增强监督导致编码器漂移。整体保留MBRL骨干的样本效率，实现零样本泛化。
AI.result: 在DeepMind Control Suite (DMC) 与 Robosuite 上，VIGOR优于当前最优的无模型与基于模型基线，分别超出第二名基线3.4%（DMC）和43.6%（Robosuite）。消融实验表明其鲁棒性与增强方式无关：替换为不同扰动族的替代增强仍保持强泛化，证实驱动鲁棒性的是潜在空间一致性而非增强选择。
AI.conclusion: VIGOR通过潜在空间一致性有效解决MBRL在未见视觉干扰下的两级脆弱性问题，兼顾零样本泛化与样本效率，且鲁棒性来源明确、不依赖特定增强策略。

title: Learning the Latent Structure: A Feature-Centric Approach to Graph Data Augmentation
summary: Graph-structured data plays a pivotal role in modeling complex relationships. However, real-world graphs are often incomplete due to data collection and observational constraints, severely limiting the effectiveness of modern graph learning pipelines. While existing Graph Data Augmentation (GDA) methods attempt to refine graph structures for improved downstream performance, they are typically label-dependent, computationally expensive, and inherently transductive, limiting their applicability in practical scenarios. In this work, we present a novel feature-centric graph data augmentation framework that bypasses explicit structure modeling by operating directly in the embedding space. Through a self-supervised inverse masking process, our method captures latent ties between observed and complete graphs, enabling recovery of unobserved structural signals through refined node representations. To enhance robustness under noisy and sparse supervision, we introduce a message regularizer and a bootstrap strategy for effective training and generalization. Evaluated on ten graph datasets spanning multiple domains, our approach, SelfAug, consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods in both accuracy and efficiency across inductive and cold-start settings, highlighting its potential as a scalable and generalizable solution for real-world graph learning scenarios.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SelfAug——一种以特征为中心、直接在嵌入空间操作的自监督图数据增强框架，通过逆掩码过程恢复未观测结构信号，在十个图数据集上于归纳与冷启动场景中同时取得精度与效率优势。
AI.motivation: 真实图常因数据采集与观测限制而不完整，结构缺失严重制约图学习效果。现有图数据增强（GDA）方法普遍依赖标签、计算开销大且本质上是直推式（transductive），难以应用于实际场景。
AI.method: 提出 SelfAug：绕过显式结构建模，直接在嵌入空间进行以特征为中心的增强；采用自监督逆掩码（inverse masking）过程，捕获观测图与完整图之间的潜在关联，由精炼的节点表示恢复未观测结构信号；并引入消息正则化器（message regularizer）与自举策略（bootstrap strategy）以提升噪声与稀疏监督下的鲁棒性和泛化性。
AI.result: 在覆盖多个领域的十个图数据集上评估，SelfAug 在归纳（inductive）与冷启动（cold-start）设置下，精度与效率均一致优于当前最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: SelfAug 具备可扩展性与泛化性，为真实世界图学习场景提供了一种有效且高效的解决方案。

title: Bridging Frontier Reasoning and Robot Execution: From Autonomous Demonstration Generation to Dense Language Supervision
summary: Recent advances in frontier models enable robot manipulation from only a few demonstrations, but high inference latency limits their use for real-time robot control. To bridge this gap, we study two complementary approaches that connect frontier reasoning with low-latency local execution. First, we use a frontier model to autonomously generate demonstrations that supplement human demonstrations for training a fast local policy. We augment its in-context examples with corrective demonstration segments that show how to recover from physical errors, improving generation reliability. Generation time and cost decrease as successful examples accumulate in context, suggesting a path toward more efficient data collection. At deployment, a harness combines frontier-generated instructions with a fast local policy, enabling efficient execution while preserving the frontier model's ability to guide and correct actions. With low-latency execution delegated to the local policy, the bottleneck shifts to its capacity to reliably follow the frontier model's diverse instructions. Our second bridge introduces dense language supervision across three nested granularities---primitive, atomic, and composite---with multi-aspect descriptions at each level. Across long-horizon tasks in RoboCasa 365 and BEHAVIOR-1K, where instructions change as execution progresses, the combined supervision achieves the highest performance under both oracle and frontier-model instructors, demonstrating more reliable instruction following through the policy's language interface. Finally, we evaluate both bridges together on a crossword task that combines semantic planning and manipulation within a fixed time budget. These results support autonomous demonstration generation and dense language supervision as complementary components for connecting frontier reasoning to low-latency local execution.

AI.tldr: 本文将前沿模型推理与低延迟局部执行连接，提出两条互补路径：以前沿模型自主生成演示（含纠错片段）扩充训练数据，并在部署时用执行框架结合前沿指令与快速局部策略；同时引入粗、原子、组合三层嵌套的多方面语言密集监督。在 RoboCasa 365 与 BEHAVIOR-1K 长时程任务中取得最优性能，二者在填字任务中联合验证有效。
AI.motivation: 前沿模型已能仅凭少量演示实现机器人操作，但推理延迟高，难以满足实时机器人控制需求；需要把前沿推理能力与低延迟本地执行打通。
AI.method: 方法包含两条互补路径：（1）由前沿模型自主生成演示以补充人类演示，用于训练快速局部策略；在上下文示例中加入纠错演示片段以提升生成可靠性；部署时用执行框架将前沿模型指令与快速局部策略结合。（2）引入跨越原始、原子、组合三层嵌套粒度、每层含多方面描述的密集语言监督。
AI.result: 生成时间与成本随上下文中成功示例的累积而下降。在 RoboCasa 365 和 BEHAVIOR-1K 的长时程任务中（指令随执行进程变化），多粒度密集监督在 oracle 与前沿模型指令条件下均取得最高性能。二者在固定时间预算内结合语义规划与操作的填字任务上联合评估。
AI.conclusion: 自主演示生成与密集语言监督是连接前沿推理与低延迟局部执行的两类互补组件；低延迟执行交由局部策略后，瓶颈转为策略可靠遵循前沿模型多样化指令的能力。

title: CalCErt: Bin-wise Certification of Confidence Calibration in Medical Image Classification
summary: Deep neural networks remain vulnerable to adversarial perturbations, which can distort not only predictions but also confidence scores, undermining uncertainty calibration. While existing certification methods focus on preserving the predicted category, providing guarantees on how calibration behaves under adversarial attacks remains overlooked. In this work, we introduce CalCErt, a simple and efficient post-hoc strategy that certifies bin-wise confidence calibration for any pretrained differentiable classifier. Our approach combines empirical calibration estimates, statistical concentration bounds, and local Lipschitz estimates of the confidence function to derive data-dependent upper bounds on worst-case miscalibration within an $ell_2$-ball of radius R. We evaluate CalCErt across 11 medical image classification tasks and multiple adversarial perturbations, demonstrating substantially higher certified coverage than baseline strategies while maintaining competitive tightness. Our code is available at https://github.com/leofillioux/calcert.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CalCErt，一种简单高效的事后方法，可为任意预训练可微分类器提供分箱置信度校准的认证保证。
AI.motivation: 深度神经网络易受对抗扰动影响，扰动不仅会改变预测结果，还会扭曲置信度分数，破坏不确定性校准。现有认证方法只关注保持预测类别，忽略了对抗攻击下校准行为如何变化的保证。
AI.method: CalCErt 结合经验校准估计、统计集中不等式以及置信度函数的局部 Lipschitz 估计，推导出在半径 R 的 $\ell_2$ 球内最坏情况误校准的数据依赖上界。
AI.result: 在 11 个医学图像分类任务和多种对抗扰动上进行评估，CalCErt 相比基线策略实现了显著更高的认证覆盖率，同时保持了有竞争力的紧致性。
AI.conclusion: CalCErt 为对抗条件下的置信度校准提供了此前被忽视的认证保证，在医学图像分类任务中验证了其有效性与效率。

title: ROUTEAUDIT: Interaction-Aware Identification for Budgeted Multi-Verifier Routing
summary: Adaptive multi-verifier systems are commonly compared through endpoint quality-cost gaps, even when the verifier catalog, availability, accounting, information filtration, or scorer changes with the policy. We formulate verifier routing as a contract-conditioned identification problem. The contract records request support, verifier catalog, realized availability, resource accounting, online filtration, and post-trace scoring; a matched route contrast changes only the policy coordinate. ROUTEAUDIT adds three measurable objects to this contract. A contract lattice averages coordinate increments over every admissible bridge order and reports the resulting attribution together with its path sensitivity. A policy-independent response tape identifies paired sequential contrasts when adaptive policies reveal different observations. For incomplete matching, request-level bounds use whichever potential outcome remains observed and give a sharp finite-population interval. The protocol commits paid observations and ledger events before the oracle join and returns an attribution certificate for each comparison. On two held-out raw-tail caches, matched static SF+SA equals the cascade, assigning the apparent gains of 0.1797 and 0.1250 over full static to the verifier-set edge. On 1,319 held-out task requests, the learned and RLVR studies report quality 0.9522 and 0.9553 versus 0.9484 for matched static; the RLVR-static paired difference is +0.0068 with a request-paired interval $[0.0015,0.0122]$ and a training-seed-by-request hierarchical interval $[0.0006,0.0131]$. Controlled attribution recovery yields route mean absolute error 0.0011 and endpoint reconstruction error 0.0004. Factorial, bridge-order, and stochastic-provider studies evaluate the certificate interface; RLVR supplies a learned-policy stress test under the same identification contract.

AI.tldr: 本文将验证器路由形式化为"契约条件下的辨识问题"，提出 ROUTEAUDIT 协议，通过契约格、策略无关响应带与请求级有限总体界，实现自适应多验证器系统的可归因比较与置信区间输出。
AI.motivation: 自适应多验证器系统常以"端点质量—成本差"进行比较，但验证器集合、可用性、资源记账、信息过滤或评分器会随策略变化，导致比较结果混淆，无法判定增益究竟来自策略还是来自验证器集合等坐标变化。
AI.method: 将验证器路由建模为契约条件下的辨识问题，契约记录请求支持、验证器目录、实际可用性、资源记账、在线过滤与事后评分；匹配路由对比只改变策略坐标。ROUTEAUDIT 引入三类可测量对象：(1) 契约格，对所有可行桥接顺序求坐标增量平均，报告归因及其路径敏感性；(2) 策略无关的响应带，在自适应策略揭示不同观测时识别成对序贯对比；(3) 针对不完整匹配的请求级界，利用仍可观测的潜在结果给出锐利有限总体区间。协议在 oracle join 前提交付费观测与账本事件，并为每次比较返回归因证书。
AI.result: 在两个留出原始尾部缓存上，匹配静态 SF+SA 与级联相等，将相对完整静态的 0.1797 与 0.1250 表观增益归因于验证器集合优势；在 1319 条留出任务请求上，学习策略与 RLVR 质量分别为 0.9522 与 0.9553，匹配静态为 0.9484；RLVR-静态配对差为 +0.0068，请求配对区间 [0.0015,0.0122]，训练种子×请求分层区间 [0.0006,0.0131]。受控归因恢复的路由 MAE 为 0.0011，端点重构误差为 0.0004。
AI.conclusion: 在统一的辨识契约下，验证器路由的增益可被精确归因，表观端点收益主要由验证器集合等坐标贡献而非策略本身；ROUTEAUDIT 的归因证书在因子、桥接顺序与随机提供者研究中均得到验证，RLVR 提供了学习策略压力测试。

title: Instance-Dependent Regret for CMDPs with Step-Wise Constraints
summary: We study online learning in episodic tabular constrained Markov decision processes with step-wise safety constraints. In such a setting, the constraints induce a safe subgraph that shapes the variance of cumulative rewards under feasible policies and, consequently, the difficulty of learning. Exploiting this structure, however, requires learning which actions are safe while controlling constraint violations. We propose Safe Variance-Adaptive Exploration (SVAE), an efficient algorithm that learns candidate safe subgraphs and performs variance-adaptive optimistic planning within them. With high probability, SVAE achieves cumulative regret of order $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(\sqrt{SAH\min\{\mathbb{V}_Σ,K\mathrm{Var}^{\star}\}}+S\sqrt{AH^3\min\{K,\mathcal{C}\}}+S^2AH^2)$ over $K$ episodes, where $H$ is the horizon of a single episode, while $S$ and $A$ are the numbers of states and actions, respectively. Here, $\mathrm{Var}^{\star}$ is the maximum return variance among safe policies, $\mathbb{V}_Σ$ is the variance accumulated before the first unsafe action is encountered, and $\mathcal{C}$ captures the statistical complexity of eliminating actions incorrectly considered potentially safe. SVAE additionally attains $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(H\sqrt{SAK}+S^2AH^2)$ step-wise constraint violation and a gap-dependent violation bound that is polylogarithmic in $K$. Finally, we establish a lower bound showing that dependence on these instance-specific quantities is unavoidable.

AI.tldr: 本文研究带逐步安全约束的片段式表格约束马尔可夫决策过程在线学习问题，提出SVAE算法，通过方差自适应探索获得近优后悔界、约束违反界，并给出下界证明其依赖性的必要性。
AI.motivation: 在带逐步安全约束的CMDP中，约束诱导出一个安全子图，该子图决定可行策略下累积回报的方差，从而影响学习难度。然而利用这一结构需要同时学习哪些动作安全并控制约束违反，现有方法难以高效处理。
AI.method: 提出Safe Variance-Adaptive Exploration (SVAE)算法：在候选安全子图内进行方差自适应乐观规划，同时学习候选安全子图，以在控制约束违反的同时利用方差结构。
AI.result: SVAE以高概率获得累计后悔 $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(\sqrt{SAH\min\{\mathbb{V}_\Sigma,K\mathrm{Var}^{\star}\}}+S\sqrt{AH^3\min\{K,\mathcal{C}\}}+S^2AH^2)$；同时达到 $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(H\sqrt{SAK}+S^2AH^2)$ 的逐步约束违反界及对K具多对数依赖的间隙依赖违反界；并建立下界证明对实例特定量的依赖不可避免。
AI.conclusion: SVAE在带逐步安全约束的表格CMDP中实现了方差自适应的近优后悔与约束违反保证，且下界表明所依赖的实例特定量本质上是不可回避的。

title: LLA-MPC on Embedded Hardware: Rapid Adaptive Control with Thousands of Parallel Models
comment: This work has been accepted in the Sim2Real and Classical Control: From Rigorous Theory to Data-Driven Robotics Workshop at the 2026 IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS 2026), Pittsburgh, PA, USA
summary: We present a generalized implementation of Look-Back and Look-Ahead Adaptive Model Predictive Control (LLA-MPC), a learning-free framework for real-time, rapid adaptive system identification and control. The original formulation was demonstrated only in simulation, for autonomous racing with a fixed model structure. Our implementation has modular dynamics and integrators, and we validate it on the F1TENTH platform under constrained computation and noisy state estimation. The system identifies tire parameters online by evaluating thousands of candidate models in real time on an embedded computer. Experiments with low-friction tires across changing surfaces show that LLA-MPC completes high-speed tracking tasks where a fixed nominal model fails. Code, videos, and our related work are available at: https://lla-control.github.io.

AI.tldr: 本文实现了通用化的Look-Back and Look-Ahead自适应模型预测控制（LLA-MPC），将其从仿真扩展到F1TENTH实车平台，在受限算力和噪声状态估计下实现无学习、实时的自适应系统辨识与控制。
AI.motivation: 原始LLA-MPC仅停留在仿真验证阶段，且模型结构固定，缺乏在真实硬件、受限计算资源与噪声状态估计条件下的实用性和通用性验证。
AI.method: 采用模块化动力学与积分器设计，构建无学习框架的LLA-MPC；在F1TENTH平台上以嵌入式计算机实时评估数千个候选模型，实现轮胎参数的在线辨识，并测试低摩擦轮胎在变化路面下的表现。
AI.result: LLA-MPC能够在固定标称模型失效的高摩擦变化场景中完成高速跟踪任务，验证了其在受限算力和噪声状态估计下的实时性与鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作证明LLA-MPC可从仿真推广至真实嵌入式平台，具备模块化、无学习、实时自适应的特性，为真实环境下的自适应控制提供了可行方案。

title: Does Physics Live in the Activations? Localizing Physical Quantities in Video Diffusion Models
summary: Video generation models produce strikingly realistic sequences and are increasingly proposed as world models, yet recent benchmarks reveal pronounced deficits in their physical reasoning. This raises the question of whether these models internalize physical principles or merely reproduce familiar motion patterns. We address this by probing internal representations of video Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) for simulator-derived ground-truth physical quantities spanning kinematic motion and rigid-body dynamics under gravity and contact. We find that these quantities are linearly decodable with high accuracy early in the denoising process, substantially outperforming a baseline decoded directly from the model's own noised latents, indicating that the relevant physical information is actively constructed during denoising rather than already present in the input. Additionally, we show that activations at on-object tokens carry the relevant physical information and that quantities defined over multiple frames are readable from single latent frames. Hence, information is sharply localized within the token sequence and is computed globally but stored locally. The probes further show partial extrapolation, transferring to scene variations and object configurations outside their training regime, so what they read is not simply a correlate of the scenes they were fit on. When fitted directly in the full-resolution activation space, the probing directions can serve as steering vectors to change the model's output.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过线性探针检验视频DiT内部表征，发现物理量在去噪早期即可高精度解码，信息在物体token处局域存储但全局计算，并可用作引导向量改变模型输出。
AI.motivation: 视频生成模型生成的序列日益逼真且被提议作为世界模型，但近期基准测试显示其物理推理能力存在明显缺陷。核心问题是：这些模型是真正内化了物理原理，还是仅复现了熟悉的运动模式。作者希望通过探查模型内部表征来回答这一问题。
AI.method: 研究者针对由模拟器生成的真值物理量（涵盖运动学运动，以及重力和接触下的刚体动力学）对视频扩散Transformer（DiT）的内部表征进行线性探针分析。同时设置了一个直接从未加噪的噪声潜变量中解码的基线作为对比。此外，分析了对物体token处的激活、多帧定义的物理量能否从单帧潜变量读取，以及探针在训练分布外的场景和物体配置上的外推能力。最后在完整分辨率激活空间中拟合的探针方向被用作引导向量。
AI.result: 这些物理量在去噪过程的早期阶段即可被线性高精度解码，显著优于从模型自身噪声潜变量直接解码的基线，说明相关物理信息是在去噪过程中主动构建的，而非已存在于输入中。物体token处的激活携带相关物理信息，且多帧定义的物理量可从单个潜变量帧中读出，表明信息在token序列中高度局域化——全局计算但局域存储。探针还表现出部分外推能力，可迁移到训练范围之外的场景变化和物体配置，说明其所读取的并非仅仅是拟合场景的关联物。在完整分辨率激活空间中拟合的引导向量可改变模型输出。
AI.conclusion: 视频DiT内部确实构建并存储了物理量信息，且这些信息可以主动被构建、局域存储、部分外推，并可用于引导模型生成，为理解视频生成模型是否内化物理原理提供了机制性证据。

title: iS-KV: Online Low-Rank KV Cache Compression via Block-Incremental SVD
summary: Long chain-of-thought reasoning substantially increases KV-cache memory during autoregressive decoding, as every generated token introduces new key and value states and causes the cache to grow linearly with decoding length. Existing KV-cache compression methods typically control this growth through token eviction, but irreversible deletion can remove historical states that later reasoning may need to revisit. SVD-based low-rank compression provides an alternative by retaining all positions with a more compact representation. However, extending it from a fixed prompt cache to online decoding is non-trivial. Through our investigation, we find that if the basis is updated for new tokens while old tokens keep their coordinates in the old basis, the stored history drifts substantially. Based on this observation, we propose iS-KV, an online low-rank KV-cache compression method for long-horizon reasoning. iS-KV keeps a recent window exact while incrementally folding older states into bounded-rank representations. As the low-rank basis evolves, it synchronizes historical coordinates with the updated basis to maintain representation consistency.
