On DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B, iS-KV achieves 82.6% accuracy at 4.06-fold persistent-KV compression, close to the original model's 83.6%. On Qwen3-8B, it achieves 89.2% accuracy at 5.64-fold compression. Under matched memory budgets, iS-KV consistently outperforms token-eviction baselines.

AI.tldr: iS-KV：面向长思维链推理的在线低秩KV缓存压缩方法
AI.motivation: 长链思维链的自回归解码使KV缓存随解码长度线性增长，显存开销巨大。现有token驱逐方法不可逆地删除历史状态，可能导致后续推理无法回溯；基于SVD的低秩压缩虽能保留全部位置，但从固定prompt缓存扩展到在线解码存在困难：若为新token更新基而旧token沿用旧基坐标，历史表示会产生显著漂移。
AI.method: 提出iS-KV在线低秩KV缓存压缩方法：保留最近窗口为精确表示，将较旧状态增量折叠进有界秩的低秩表示；随低秩基演化，同步更新历史坐标以与新基保持一致，从而维持表示的连贯性。
AI.result: 在DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B上，4.06倍持久KV压缩下达到82.6%准确率，接近原始模型的83.6%；在Qwen3-8B上，5.64倍压缩下达到89.2%准确率；在相同内存预算下持续优于token驱逐类基线。
AI.conclusion: 通过增量低秩折叠与基坐标同步，iS-KV在在线解码场景下实现了高压缩比与近原始精度的长思维链KV缓存压缩，优于token驱逐方案。

title: BaCP: Backbone Contrastive Pruning for Preserving Representations in Extremely Sparse Neural Networks
summary: Unstructured pruning at extreme sparsity often suffers from representational collapse, causing sharp drops in accuracy. To address this, we study Backbone Contrastive Pruning (BaCP), which regularizes the sparse network's embedding space by aligning it with pretrained, fine-tuned, and historical snapshot models. Building on the contrastive decomposition of the CAP framework (Xu et al., 2022), we provide a rigorous matched-budget characterization of this approach across multiple pruning criteria. Evaluated across 90 settings, BaCP improves accuracy substantially in extreme sparsity regimes where standard pruning fails, and is close to baseline where representations remain intact.

AI.tldr: 本文研究 Backbone Contrastive Pruning (BaCP)，通过对齐稀疏网络与预训练、微调及历史快照模型的嵌入空间来缓解极端稀疏下的表征坍塌，并在 90 个设置上验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 极端稀疏度下的非结构化剪枝常导致表征坍塌，使准确率急剧下降。现有剪枝方法在极端稀疏区间性能失效，需要一种能够正则化稀疏网络嵌入空间、维持表征完整性的方案。
AI.method: 提出 BaCP（Backbone Contrastive Pruning）：以对比学习方式将稀疏网络的嵌入空间与预训练模型、微调模型以及历史快照模型进行对齐，从而约束稀疏表征。方法建立在 CAP 框架（Xu et al., 2022）的对比分解之上，并在多种剪枝准则下给出严格的等预算（matched-budget）理论刻画。
AI.result: 在 90 个实验设置中评估，BaCP 在标准剪枝失效的极端稀疏区间显著提升准确率；在表征保持完好的区间则与基线接近，未造成明显损失。
AI.conclusion: BaCP 通过对比对齐多个参考模型的嵌入空间，可有效缓解极端稀疏剪枝的表征坍塌问题，在极端稀疏下带来显著收益且不影响常规稀疏区间的性能。

title: CORNAV: Construction-Aware Reasoning for Robot Navigation on Active Worksites
summary: The construction industry faces persistent labor shortages, low productivity that costs the global economy over $1.6 trillion annually, and one of the highest injury rates among major industries. These factors motivate the use of autonomous robots to improve efficiency and worker safety. Existing language-grounded navigation systems, however, rely on semantic scene understanding alone and lack access to construction-specific context such as architectural plans, evolving work schedules, and safety constraints. As a result, they localize permanent building features unreliably and cannot safely navigate active jobsites. We present CORNAV, a blueprint-grounded, schedule-aware navigation framework that operates from 2D CAD drawings and project schedules without requiring a Building Information Model. CORNAV aligns architectural blueprints against hierarchical open-vocabulary 3D scene graphs to ground object queries, converts project schedules into time-varying navigation constraints, and validates requests through an LLM-based safety module that escalates hazardous zones before planning. An A* planner then enforces mandatory exclusion zones while preferentially avoiding higher-risk areas. Across an indoor office and a real construction site, blueprint grounding raises task success from 13.0% to 72.2% over semantic retrieval alone, schedule awareness eliminates all hard-zone violations, and the safety module correctly rejects hazardous requests arising from mislabeled project schedules.

AI.tldr: CORNAV：基于施工蓝图与进度表的接地导航框架，通过CAD图纸对齐开放词汇3D场景图、将进度转为时变约束，并经LLM安全模块校验，在室内办公室与真实工地中将任务成功率从13.0%提升至72.2%，并消除硬性禁区违规。
AI.motivation: 建筑业长期存在劳动力短缺、生产力低下（每年给全球经济造成超1.6万亿美元损失）以及高工伤率等问题，促使采用自主机器人提升效率与工人安全。但现有语言接地导航系统仅依赖语义场景理解，缺乏建筑领域上下文（如建筑图纸、动态工期计划、安全约束），导致对永久建筑特征的定位不可靠，且无法在活跃工地上安全导航。
AI.method: 提出CORNAV框架，仅需2D CAD图纸与项目进度表，无需BIM模型。具体包括：将建筑蓝图与层次化开放词汇3D场景图对齐以接地物体查询；把项目进度表转换为时变导航约束；通过基于LLM的安全模块校验请求，在上游对危险区域进行升级告警；最后由A*规划器强制执行强制禁区并优先规避高风险区域。
AI.result: 在室内办公室与真实施工现场两类环境中，蓝图接地相较纯语义检索将任务成功率由13.0%提升至72.2%；进度感知消除所有硬性禁区违规；安全模块能正确拒绝因项目进度表错误标注而产生的危险请求。
AI.conclusion: 引入建筑蓝图接地、进度感知与LLM安全校验，可显著提升施工环境下语言接地自主导航的可靠性与安全性，且无需依赖完整的BIM建模，为机器人在活跃工地的部署提供了可行路径。

title: Geometry-Aligned Semantic Matching for Cross-Modal Planar Image Registration
summary: Cross-modal image matching establishes stable and accurate geometric correspondences across modalities for planar registration. Existing semantic representations provide cross-modal consistency, but semantic similarity does not necessarily imply geometric correspondence. Meanwhile, fine-grained CNN features provide accurate local details but lack global cross-modal semantic guidance for stable refinement. To address these issues, we propose CDPM, which first establishes geometrically consistent semantic representations and then preserves their dominant role in correspondence estimation during fine-grained localization. Specifically, we progressively adapt DINOv3 using geometrically consistent cross-modal patch pairs, enabling feature similarity to better reflect true cross-modal spatial correspondences. We then construct a DINO-Centric Feature Pyramid, where multi-scale DINO representations maintain stable cross-modal correspondences, while a lightweight CNN branch provides auxiliary structural details for precise local refinement. Extensive experiments on three cross-modal datasets demonstrate the superior performance of CDPM. On VIS-IR, compared with the dense matcher RoMa, CDPM improves AUC@3/5/10/20 by 7.36, 13.40, 13.75, and 10.42 percentage points, respectively, and reduces mACE from 5.83 to 2.78 pixels. It also outperforms RoMa v2 across all metrics while requiring 45.6% fewer FLOPs. The online demo and dataset are available, and the code will be released on our project page at https://warren-wzw.github.io/CDPM/.

AI.tldr: 提出CDPM跨模态图像匹配框架，先建立几何一致的语义表征，再在细粒度定位中保持其主导作用。
AI.motivation: 现有语义表征具跨模态一致性但语义相似不等于几何对应；CNN细粒度特征局部精确却缺乏全局跨模态语义引导，难以稳定细化。
AI.method: 用几何一致的跨模态patch对渐进式适配DINOv3，使特征相似度反映真实空间对应；构建DINO-Centric特征金字塔，多尺度DINO表征维持稳定跨模态对应，轻量CNN分支提供辅助结构细节用于精确局部细化。
AI.result: 在三个跨模态数据集上性能优越。VIS-IR上较RoMa的AUC@3/5/10/20分别提升7.36、13.40、13.75、10.42个百分点，mACE从5.83降至2.78像素；全面超越RoMa v2且FLOPs减少45.6%。
AI.conclusion: 验证了几何一致语义表征主导匹配、CNN辅助细化的有效性，兼顾精度与效率，代码与数据集将开源。

title: MetaRubric: Learning to Reward for Rubric-Based Reinforcement Learning
summary: Rubric-based reinforcement learning extends reward-driven optimization to open-ended tasks by assigning partial credit to individual response requirements. However, rubric judges can assign a high criterion score even when the information or action it requires is absent from the response, a failure mode we term Vacuous Credit. Such awards persist after the required information is removed and can reverse the sign of a response's GRPO advantage. To address this problem, we introduce MetaRubric, which alternates evidence-aware policy optimization with response-guided rubric adaptation. We construct counterfactual counterparts by changing one task-relevant fact in each prompt. During policy optimization, credit is assigned only when the response contains sufficient evidence to satisfy the required rubric criterion. After each policy-optimization stage, current policy responses guide revisions to original and counterfactual criteria while preserving the meaning of the original prompt's initial rubric as interpreted under each prompt's facts. We also adapt criterion weights at stage boundaries to better address observed policy errors. Across multiple backbones, MetaRubric improves PubMedQA accuracy by 6.00--20.40 percentage points over static-judge GRPO, with further gains on HealthBench-Hard and two multimodal medical benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 MetaRubric，通过证据感知的策略优化与响应引导的评分标准自适应的交替机制，解决评分式强化学习中的"空洞得分"问题。
AI.motivation: 基于评分标准的强化学习将奖励优化扩展到开放式任务，但评分模型可能在响应缺少所需信息或行为时仍给出高分，即"空洞得分"。这种错误奖励在移除所需信息后仍存在，甚至会反转响应 GRPO 优势的符号。
AI.method: MetaRubric 交替进行证据感知的策略优化与响应引导的评分标准自适应。通过在每个提示中改变一个任务相关事实来构造反事实对照。策略优化阶段，仅当响应包含满足评分标准所需充分证据时才给予得分。每轮策略优化后，当前策略响应指导原始与反事实标准的修订，同时保留原始提示初始评分标准在各提示事实下的含义。此外，在阶段边界自适应调整标准权重，以更好应对观察到的策略错误。
AI.result: 在多种主干模型上，MetaRubric 相比静态评判 GRPO 将 PubMedQA 准确率提升 6.00–20.40 个百分点，并在 HealthBench-Hard 及两个多模态医学基准上取得进一步提升。
AI.conclusion: MetaRubric 有效缓解空洞得分问题，验证了证据感知得分与评分标准协同自适应的有效性，提升了开放式任务强化学习的奖励可靠性与下游性能。

title: Autoregressive Differentiable Method for Integer Programming
summary: We introduce an autoregressive differentiable method to solve 0-1 integer programs. We fix an arbitrary order of the binary variables and we train a transformer to predict the next bit while remaining in the feasible set. Our method is first trained on feasible incumbents provided by any solver, thus allowing us to initialize the transformer in the feasible set. Our procedure then implements a Lagrangian penalty to penalize infeasible solutions, and the transformer is further trained to explore the feasible set using Gumbel-softmax activations on the relaxed objective. We have tested our method on non-convex instances of quadratic knapsack problem and demonstrated consistent improvement upon state-of-the-art open-source solvers for dense problems up to 10,000 binary variables. In particular, we empirically demonstrate a phenomenon akin to a tunneling effect where the effective change of variables from binary variable to the continuous weights of the transformer that the method implements enables crossing barriers in the relaxed objective landscape.

AI.tldr: 提出一种自回归可微方法求解0-1整数规划：固定二进制变量顺序，用Transformer逐位预测，先由求解器提供的可行解初始化，再通过拉格朗日罚项与Gumbel-softmax在松弛目标上训练以探索可行域，在稠密二次背包问题上优于开源求解器。
AI.motivation: 求解0-1整数规划（尤其是非凸问题）是组合优化中的核心难题，传统求解器在大规模稠密实例上效率有限，需要一种能结合学习方法、保持可行性并有效探索可行域的新途径。
AI.method: 1) 固定二进制变量的任意顺序，训练Transformer自回归预测下一位并保持在可行集内；2) 先用任意求解器给出的可行解（incumbents）训练，使Transformer初始化于可行集；3) 引入拉格朗日罚项惩罚不可行解，并在松弛目标上使用Gumbel-softmax激活继续训练以探索可行域。
AI.result: 在非凸二次背包问题实例上测试，对高达10,000个二进制变量的稠密问题，持续优于最先进的开源求解器；并经验性地观察到类似隧穿效应的现象——从二进制变量到Transformer连续权重的有效变量替换，使方法能够跨越松弛目标景观中的势垒。
AI.conclusion: 该自回归可微框架将Transformer与拉格朗日罚项、Gumbel-softmax结合，能在保持可行性的同时有效探索大规模非凸0-1整数规划可行域，并展现出类似隧穿的优势，为学习型组合优化求解提供了可行方向。

title: EyeRobot 2.0: Active Gaze for Precise Manipulation without Wrist Cameras
summary: Inspired by human vision, we introduce a framework using active gaze to enable fine-grained bimanual manipulation with only a single stereo camera. EyeRobot 2.0 physically attends to a 3D fixation point in the scene by swiveling two eye viewpoints to center their gaze on it. The resulting images are processed foveally by allocating more visual tokens to the image centers, focusing computation on task-relevant features. Such Active Visual Fixation (AVF) requires carefully coordinated gaze during task execution, which we accomplish hierarchically by first training a low-level gaze servoing policy conditioned on a goal object, then training a target selector which emits fixation goals based on task progress. Both modules are trained with RL on real-world data: the first is trained with a dense geometric reward and the second co-trains with the BC gripper policy which allows it to discover fixation sequences that can resemble a human's fixation sequence while performing the task. EyeRobot 2.0 further takes advantage of fixation by canonicalizing gripper information into a fixation-relative SE(3) frame, which compacts the size of the action distribution to learn. We collect teleoperation data for 7 real-world and 6 simulated tasks, and conduct over 1000 physical and 1800 simulated robot trials comparing EyeRobot 2.0 against passive stereo and ego + wrist camera policies trained on the same data. Removing wrist cameras is costly for standard policies: with only passive stereo, real-world success drops from 52% to 27%. EyeRobot 2.0 closes this gap with only stereo, outperforming passive stereo by 40% in real and 20% in sim. It matches ego + wrist policies when their wrist views are clear (69% vs. 64%), and more than doubles their success when grasped objects occlude the wrist cameras (48% vs. 22%)

AI.tldr: 提出EyeRobot 2.0框架，用主动注视(单台立体相机)实现精细双手操作，通过低层注视伺服与目标选择器分层训练，并用注视相对SE(3)动作规范化，在7个真机与6个仿真任务上平均成功率显著优于被动立体与自我+腕部相机策略。
AI.motivation: 标准策略在移除腕部相机后性能骤降（真机从52%降至27%），而腕部视角易被抓取物体遮挡；受人类视觉主动注视启发，希望仅用单台立体相机就获得精细双手操作所需的局部高分辨视觉信息。
AI.method: 采用双注视点机械眼，将两个视点对准场景中3D注视点；图像以中心凹方式处理，将更多视觉token分配至图像中心以聚焦任务相关特征(Active Visual Fixation)。分层训练：先以密集几何奖励用RL训练基于目标物体的低层注视伺服策略，再训练根据任务进度输出注视目标的选择器，与BC夹爪策略协同训练以发现类人注视序列；并将夹爪信息规范化为注视相对SE(3)坐标系以压缩动作分布。数据为7个真机+6个仿真任务的遥操作数据，与被动立体、自我+腕部相机策略对比，进行超1000次真机与1800次仿真试验。
AI.result: 仅用立体时，EyeRobot 2.0相比被动立体在真机提升40%、仿真提升20%；在腕部视角清晰时接近自我+腕部策略(69% vs 64%)，当抓取物体遮挡腕部相机时成功率超过其两倍(48% vs 22%)。
AI.conclusion: 主动注视可作为腕部相机的有效替代，用单台立体相机实现精细双手操作，并在遮挡场景下具备明显鲁棒性优势。

title: PocketSplat: Mobile Gaussian Reconstruction via World-Space Latent Allocatio
summary: Mobile Gaussian reconstruction must satisfy two requirements: the reconstruction model must execute within a device resource envelope, and the resulting Gaussian asset must expose a representation size suited to downstream mobile use. Existing feed-forward Gaussian reconstructors commonly decode dense, image-aligned candidates whose final cardinality is implicitly determined by the input resolution and number of views. We present PocketSplat, a feed-forward framework for budgeted mobile Gaussian asset construction. Given a prescribed output budget, PocketSplat organizes dense geometry-aware latent candidates in predicted world space, allocates exact integer capacity across local latent cells, and decodes complete Gaussian attributes only for retained candidates. Cell-conditioned latent fusion aggregates repeated multi-view evidence before decoding, while spatial responsibility decoding adapts Gaussian support after local sparsification. Experiments on DL3DV and out-of-distribution benchmarks establish a strong quality--budget trade-off against feed-forward Gaussian reconstruction baselines. On Mip-NeRF 360, PocketSplat executes directly on a target iPhone and constructs compact, higher-quality Gaussian assets substantially faster than a deployable streamed MVSplat variant; native MVSplat and DepthSplat exceed the device memory budget.

AI.tldr: PocketSplat：面向移动端的预算化前馈高斯资产重建框架，按指定输出预算分配整数容量并仅解码保留候选，在DL3DV与Mip-NeRF 360上实现质量-预算权衡与真机高效运行。
AI.motivation: 移动端高斯重建需同时满足两点：模型须在设备资源包络内执行，且生成的Gaussian资产表示大小要适配下游移动使用。现有前馈重建器通常解码稠密、与图像对齐的候选，最终基数由输入分辨率和视图数隐式决定，难以控制资产规模与设备内存。
AI.method: 提出PocketSplat前馈框架：给定输出预算，在预测世界空间中组织稠密几何感知隐候选，跨局部隐单元分配精确整数容量，仅对保留候选解码完整高斯属性；采用单元条件隐融合在解码前聚合多视图重复证据，并用空间责任解码在局部稀疏化后自适应调整高斯支撑。
AI.result: 在DL3DV与分布外基准上，相较前馈高斯重建基线取得更强的质量-预算权衡。在Mip-NeRF 360上可直接在目标iPhone运行，构建紧凑且更高质量的Gaussian资产，速度显著快于可部署的流式MVSplat变体；原生MVSplat与DepthSplat超出设备内存预算。
AI.conclusion: PocketSplat通过预算驱动的候选组织与稀疏化解码，实现了移动设备可部署的前馈高斯资产构建，在受控表示规模下兼顾质量与效率。

title: Scaling Trajectories for Complex Tasks through Recursive Self-Rewrite
summary: Successful trajectories on difficult tasks provide valuable supervision for model improvement, but specialized harnesses introduce interventions that may be unavailable during deployment. We propose Recursive Self-Rewrite (RSR), a framework that uses one base model, Qwen-3.8-27B, to discover successful solutions under diverse harnesses and reconstruct them as training trajectories under a general harness. A planner extracts procedures into runbooks, a critic screens for verifier and solution leakage and guides recursive revision, and an executor follows qualified runbooks in fresh sandboxes. Across approximately 3K self-curated terminal tasks, three harnesses jointly solve 759 tasks, 34.3% more than the strongest individual harness in the recorded pool. RSR expands 2,001 successful source trajectories into 11,094 rewritten trajectories for supervised finetuning. Training on these trajectories outperforms both the base model and direct trajectory SFT. Compared with the base model, pass@3 increases from 57.0% to 74.2% on Terminal-Bench 2, from 1.5% to 9.1% on Terminal-Bench 4, from 39.0% to 63.0% on our self-curated Terminal-Bench Hard, and from 3.0% to 6.0% on our Software Terminal-Bench. Process reward on Long-Horizon Terminal-Bench rises from 0.21 to 0.29. These results show how diverse harness-assisted experiences can be reconstructed into reusable capabilities for a model operating under a general harness.

AI.tldr: 提出 Recursive Self-Rewrite (RSR) 框架，用单个基座模型在多种专用 harness 中发现问题解，并将其重写为通用 harness 下的训练轨迹，从而把多样化的 harness 经验转化为可复用能力。
AI.motivation: 困难任务上的成功轨迹对模型改进有重要监督价值，但专用 harness 引入了部署阶段可能不存在的干预手段，导致这些经验难以直接迁移到通用环境。
AI.method: 以 Qwen-3.8-27B 为基座，构建 planner–critic–executor 三组件流程：planner 抽取过程并整理为 runbook；critic 筛查验证器与解法泄漏并指导递归修订；executor 在全新沙箱中按合格 runbook 执行。基于约 3K 自筛选终端任务，用三种 harness 联合采集成功轨迹，并重写为通用 harness 下的 SFT 数据。
AI.result: 三种 harness 联合解出 759 个任务，比记录池中最强单一 harness 多 34.3%；将 2,001 条成功源轨迹扩展为 11,094 条重写轨迹。SFT 后性能优于基座与直接轨迹 SFT：Terminal-Bench 2 pass@3 由 57.0% 升至 74.2%，Terminal-Bench 4 由 1.5% 升至 9.1%，自建 Terminal-Bench Hard 由 39.0% 升至 63.0%，自建 Software Terminal-Bench 由 3.0% 升至 6.0%；Long-Horizon Terminal-Bench 过程奖励由 0.21 升至 0.29。
AI.conclusion: 多样化的 harness 辅助经验可以被重构为通用 harness 下可复用的模型能力，验证了 RSR 在轨迹扩展与监督微调上的有效性。

title: Reward Inflation: A Healthy Stimulus for Reinforcement Learning
summary: Reward serves as the primary learning signal in reinforcement learning (RL). However, while reward magnitudes are typically held fixed throughout training, their temporal modulation remains underexplored. In this paper, we propose reward inflation, a gradual scaling of rewards over the course of training, and show that it can act as a healthy stimulus for RL. Theoretically, reward inflation induces an implicit recency weighting that upweights recent transitions during policy updates, enabling faster adaptation. We further show that, by sustaining gradient signals as the policy saturates, reward inflation suppresses the emergence of dormant neurons and helps preserve plasticity. Empirical results on ALE games and MuJoCo tasks corroborate these findings, showing that an appropriate level of reward inflation benefits a broad range of tasks. Finally, we introduce Fed, an adaptive variant that adjusts the inflation level on the fly, and find that it often improves upon fixed inflation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"奖励膨胀"（reward inflation）——在训练过程中逐步放大奖励幅度，并将其作为强化学习的健康刺激手段，理论揭示其隐式近期权重与保持可塑性的机制，实验验证其在多任务上的收益并提出自适应变体Fed。
AI.motivation: 强化学习中奖励通常作为主要学习信号，但其幅度在整个训练过程中被固定，奖励的时间调制（temporal modulation）尚未被充分探索。作者希望回答：动态改变奖励幅度能否作为有益的刺激来改善学习。
AI.method: 提出reward inflation：随训练进程逐步缩放奖励幅度。理论上分析其两条机制——(1) 诱导隐式的近期加权（recency weighting），在策略更新中提升近期transition的权重，加快适应；(2) 在策略饱和时维持梯度信号，抑制"休眠神经元"（dormant neurons）的产生，从而保持可塑性。进一步提出自适应变体Fed，在线动态调整膨胀水平。
AI.result: 在ALE游戏与MuJoCo任务上的实验与理论分析一致：适当程度的reward inflation对广泛任务均有收益；自适应的Fed通常优于固定膨胀水平。
AI.conclusion: 奖励的时间调制是一种被忽视但有效的RL设计维度；reward inflation通过隐式近期加权与保持可塑性带来益处，并且自适应调节（Fed）能进一步提升效果。

title: GlanceWAM: Sparse Test-Time Imagination for World-Action Models
summary: Video generative models provide rich physical priors for robot learning, yet existing world-action models (WAMs) face a fundamental trade-off: synchronous video generation at control rate is latency-prohibitive, while abandoning test-time visual imagination sacrifices task success. We show that visual imagination achieves both real-time inference and superior success rates when generated asynchronously off the critical path and consumed directly in latent space. We introduce GlanceWAM, which decouples imagination from control on a single shared video DiT backbone: an asynchronous proposer glances ahead on a slow clock to imagine a single lookahead frame seconds into the future in the background, while an action head decodes action chunks at control rate (48 ms) purely in latent space without blocking. Enabled by a non-interfering attention mask that isolates video representations and staleness-robust horizon training that accommodates asynchronous lookahead aging, GlanceWAM breaks the speed-success dilemma. Trained purely on demonstrations, it attains 72.2% on the 24-task RoboCasa kitchen benchmark (vs. 67.1% for synchronous Cosmos Policy) and 99.0% on LIBERO while cutting per-chunk control latency $24\times$ relative to synchronous world-action models (48 ms on one A100). In single-arm and bimanual real-robot manipulation, it achieves higher average success than $π_{0.5}$ without any robot-data pretraining. Code is available at https://github.com/linhanwang/GlanceWAM.

AI.tldr: GlanceWAM 将视觉想象与控制解耦，在共享视频 DiT 骨干上异步生成单帧前瞻想象并在潜空间直接消费，实现实时推理与更高成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有 world-action models 存在根本性权衡：在控制频率上同步生成视频延迟过高，而放弃测试时视觉想象又牺牲任务成功率。因此需要一种既保持实时性又不损失想象能力的方法。
AI.method: 提出 GlanceWAM，在单一共享视频 DiT 骨干上解耦想象与控制：异步 proposer 以慢时钟在后台想象未来数秒后的单帧前瞻图像；action head 以控制频率（48 ms）纯在潜空间中解码动作块而不阻塞。关键技术包括互不干扰的注意力掩码（隔离视频表征）和抗陈旧性的时域训练（适应异步前瞻老化）。仅用示教数据训练。
AI.result: 在 24 任务 RoboCasa kitchen 基准上达 72.2%（同步 Cosmos Policy 为 67.1%），LIBERO 上 99.0%，同时将每块控制延迟相对同步 WAM 降低 24 倍（单张 A100 上 48 ms）。在单臂与双臂真实机器人操作中，无需任何机器人数据预训练即取得高于 π_{0.5} 的平均成功率。
AI.conclusion: 异步潜空间视觉想象可打破速度—成功率困境，在实时性与任务成功率上同时超越同步世界-动作模型，并在真实机器人任务上具备强泛化性。

title: Bridging Research and Practice: A Systematic Evaluation of Generalist and Dermatology-Specific Models in Clinical Skin Lesion Classification
comment: 10 pages, 1 figure, 3 tables, approved at MICCAI 2026
summary: The application of machine learning to dermatology has grown substantially in recent years, moving beyond proof-of-concept studies toward potential applications. However, clinical dermatology remains a challenging and still open problem. Diagnostic assessment is often ambiguous, and skin lesions exhibit high variability, compounded by differences in acquisition modality, device quality, and patient demographics. These factors hinder the development of robust models suitable for safe and equitable clinical use. To support translation into practice, it is essential to systematically evaluate how contemporary models generalize across heterogeneous data sources. In this work, we benchmark a diverse set of architectures on recent dermatology datasets, spanning dermoscopic images and smartphone-based clinical photographs. We assess the robustness of recent general-purpose and medical vision-language models, as well as foundation models, and compare them against task-specific dermatology classifiers, including embedding-based approaches and convolutional neural networks. Our study provides an evaluation of model performance under distribution shifts, modality changes, and demographic variability. By quantifying the gap between current state-of-the-art models and the requirements of clinical deployment, we aim to contribute to the development of reliable, accessible, and clinically applicable AI systems for dermatology.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评测了通用视觉语言模型、医学视觉语言模型、基础模型及任务特定皮肤科分类器在皮肤镜与智能手机临床照片等多种皮肤科数据集上的表现与泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 皮肤科诊断常存在模糊性，皮损高度多变，且受采集模态、设备质量与人群差异影响，阻碍了稳健、安全且公平的临床模型开发，因此需系统评估现有模型在异质数据源上的泛化能力以支持临床转化。
AI.method: 在近期皮肤科数据集（涵盖皮肤镜图像与智能手机临床照片）上对多种架构进行基准测试，评估通用与医学视觉语言模型、基础模型，并与任务特定分类器（基于嵌入的方法与卷积神经网络）进行对比，考察分布偏移、模态变化与人口统计学差异下的性能。
AI.result: 研究给出了模型在分布偏移、模态变化和人群差异条件下的性能评估，量化了当前最先进模型与临床部署要求之间的差距。
AI.conclusion: 通过量化现有模型与临床部署需求的差距，为开发可靠、可及且可临床应用的皮肤科AI系统提供参考。

title: MLCommons Jailbreak Benchmark v1.0
summary: Modern AI systems are designed to refuse hazardous requests. A jailbreak is a prompt crafted to bypass those safeguards and elicit outputs that the system would normally refuse to provide. The MLCommons Jailbreak Benchmark v1.0 provides an end-to-end methodology for evaluating the robustness of large language models to single-turn, text-based jailbreak attacks. It combines criteria-driven system and attack selection, paired baseline and adversarial evaluation, human annotation, automated evaluator calibration, scoring, grading, and risk-calibrated disclosure within a single benchmarking pipeline. The benchmark evaluates eight open-weight systems using 264 seed prompts spanning eleven hazard categories and representative attacks drawn from the MLCommons Jailbreak Taxonomy. Responses are assessed using the AILuminate Assessment Standard v1.4, and robustness is measured through the Resilience Gap: the change in safety performance between baseline and adversarial conditions. Across all evaluated systems and attacks, the unsafe-response rate increased from 11.08% under baseline conditions to 18.65% under jailbreak conditions, producing an average Resilience Gap of 7.57%. Accessible systems showed a larger mean gap, while attack effectiveness varied substantially across attack categories and hazards. The benchmark also examines evaluator reliability and sources of measurement error. Beyond reporting results, Jailbreak Benchmark v1.0 establishes a reproducible methodological foundation for comparative jailbreak evaluation and for future expansion across systems, attacks, hazards, and evaluation methods.

AI.tldr: MLCommons 发布 Jailbreak Benchmark v1.0，提供单轮文本越狱攻击的端到端评测方法，用 Resilience Gap 衡量安全性能下降，在 8 个开放权重模型上测得不安全响应率从 11.08% 升至 18.65%，平均 Resilience Gap 为 7.57%。
AI.motivation: 现代 AI 系统被设计为拒绝有害请求，但越狱提示可绕过安全防护并诱导其输出本应拒绝的内容。因此需要一套可复现、系统化的方法学来评估大语言模型对越狱攻击的鲁棒性。
AI.method: 该基准面向单轮、纯文本越狱攻击，整合了标准驱动的系统与攻击选择、基线与对抗条件的配对评测、人工标注、自动评估器校准、打分与分级、以及风险校准的信息披露。评测覆盖 8 个开放权重系统、264 条种子提示、11 个危害类别，攻击取自 MLCommons 越狱分类法；响应依据 AILuminate Assessment Standard v1.4 评估，鲁棒性以基线到对抗条件下安全性能变化的 Resilience Gap 度量。
AI.result: 在所有被测系统与攻击上，不安全响应率由基线 11.08% 升至越狱条件下的 18.65%，平均 Resilience Gap 为 7.57%；可获取性更高的系统平均差距更大，且攻击有效性在不同攻击类别与危害之间差异显著。基准还考察了评估器可靠性与测量误差来源。
AI.conclusion: Jailbreak Benchmark v1.0 不仅报告评测结果，还建立了可复现的方法学基础，用于越狱评测的横向比较，并支持未来在系统、攻击、危害与评估方法上的扩展。

title: Test-time Multi-agent Coordination by Decomposed Value Gradient Flow
summary: Offline multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) faces a persistent trade-off. Expressive generative policies can represent multi-modal coordination in the data, but cannot distinguish high-value regions, while value-optimized policies exploit the learned Q-function but collapse the multi-modal into a single dominant mode. A single agent's mode collapse can break joint coordination, and simultaneous drift across agents can push the joint policy into unseen regions of the action space. We propose scalable coordination via optimal unified transport (SCOUT), the first offline MARL framework to combine a generative foundation model with a learned value function through test-time action refinement. SCOUT trains two decoupled components: a flow-matching behavioral prior and a decomposed value function. At test-time, it transports behavioral samples toward high-value regions via Stein variational gradient descent. The number of transport steps controls adaptive test-time scaling, replacing a fixed regularization coefficient. Under the individual-global-max (IGM) principle, we prove a single-term KL bound on the joint soft-value gap that vanishes as transport converges, with an irreducible additive residual proportional to the IGM violation. Empirically, SCOUT achieves the best average performance across discrete and continuous offline MARL benchmarks and yields performance improvements in all offline-to-online configurations.

AI.tldr: 提出 SCOUT，首个将生成式基础模型与学习价值函数通过测试时动作精炼结合的离线多智能体强化学习框架。
AI.motivation: 离线 MARL 存在持续权衡：生成式策略能表达多模态协调但无法辨别高价值区域；价值优化策略能利用 Q 函数却使多模态坍缩为单一主模态。单智能体模式坍缩会破坏联合协调，多智能体同时漂移会将联合策略推入未见动作区域。
AI.method: SCOUT 训练两个解耦组件：流匹配行为先验与分解式价值函数。测试时通过 Stein 变分梯度下降将行为样本传输至高价值区域；传输步数控制自适应测试时扩展，替代固定正则化系数。在 IGM 原则下证明联合软价值差的单步 KL 界，随传输收敛趋于消失，剩余不可约残差与 IGM 违背程度成正比。
AI.result: 在离散与连续离线 MARL 基准上取得最佳平均性能，并在所有离线到在线配置中均有性能提升。
AI.conclusion: SCOUT 通过测试时动作精炼统一生成式先验与价值优化，兼顾多模态表达与高价值利用，并提供理论保证与实证优势。

title: Fewer Tokens, Better Action: GPT-6 Astra Robot Agents with 14% Higher Success Rate but 65% Fewer Tokens
summary: Vision language model (VLM) agents can control robots through visual feedback and action primitives, but repeated model invocations and redundant observations incur substantial token overhead. We introduce PyRUA-Lean, an interactive code-execution framework that couples feedback-driven primitive composition with selective observation: the agent composes classical robot primitives and learned vision-language-action (VLA) policies into Python cells that perform conditional checks and local retries, returning only explicitly requested images and state feedback for replanning. Across 700 simulated task instances from LIBERO-PRO, RoboTwin 2.0, and RoboCasa365, we compare PyRUA-Lean with a tool-calling baseline using the same GPT-6 Astra planner and underlying robot primitives. Under equal LLM-call budgets, PyRUA-Lean increases overall success from 63.1% to 71.7%. On instances solved by both agents, it uses 49% fewer LLM calls and 65% fewer input tokens.

AI.tldr: PyRUA-Lean是一个交互式代码执行框架，将机器人原语与VLA策略组合为可条件判断和局部重试的Python单元，仅返回按需的图像与状态反馈；在700个仿真任务上以同等LLM调用预算将成功率从63.1%提升至71.7%，已解决实例上减少49%调用与65%输入token。
AI.motivation: VLM智能体虽能通过视觉反馈与动作原语控制机器人，但反复调用模型和冗余观测带来大量token开销。
AI.method: 提出PyRUA-Lean交互式代码执行框架：将经典机器人原语与学习型VLA策略组合进Python单元，在其中执行条件检查与局部重试，并只返回显式请求的图像和状态反馈用于重规划。
AI.result: 在LIBERO-PRO、RoboTwin 2.0、RoboCasa365共700个仿真任务实例上，与使用同一GPT-6 Astra规划器和相同底层原语的工具调用基线对比，同等LLM调用预算下成功率由63.1%升至71.7%；在双方均解决的实例上，LLM调用减少49%、输入token减少65%。
AI.conclusion: 结构化代码执行与选择性观测可在不增加（乃至减少）LLM调用与token开销的前提下显著提升机器人智能体任务成功率。

title: Contextual Flow Matching: Adaptive Step Selection in Flow Models for Efficient Visual Generation
summary: Flow Matching enables high-quality visual generation via continuous-time dynamics, but inference remains costly due to multiple sequential function evaluations. Existing acceleration methods reduce the number of function evaluations but often introduce additional training overhead, degrade quality, or fail to account for input-dependent variability. We propose COFLOW, an inference-time method that adaptively selects the step counts each generation based on the prompt features. Our context-aware COFLOW is trained online with an unsupervised reward that balances inference efficiency and generation fidelity. Our method is plug-and-play, requiring no retraining of the underlying generative model. It generalizes to image and video generation, achieving over 2.5x speedup while preserving perceptual and semantic quality. We further provide a theoretical analysis establishing an O(1/K) forward-Euler discretization error bound under standard regularity conditions.

AI.tldr: 提出COFLOW，一种基于提示特征的推理时自适应步数选择方法，无需重训练生成模型即可实现2.5倍以上加速，并给出O(1/K)离散化误差界。
AI.motivation: Flow Matching可高质量生成视觉内容，但需多次顺序函数评估导致推理成本高；现有加速方法或增加训练开销、或损害质量、或忽略输入相关的可变性。
AI.method: COFLOW为推理时方法，依据提示特征自适应该次生成的步数；采用在线训练，以无监督奖励平衡推理效率与生成保真度；即插即用，无需重训练底层生成模型。
AI.result: 可泛化至图像与视频生成，实现超过2.5倍加速，同时保持感知与语义质量；理论分析在标准正则条件下建立O(1/K)的前向欧拉离散化误差界。
AI.conclusion: COFLOW通过上下文感知的在线无监督奖励实现自适应步数推理加速，兼具即插即用性与理论保证。

title: FSPO: Policy-Consistent Risk and Pareto-Feasible Control for Budgeted LLM RL Post-Training
summary: Adaptive LLM reinforcement-learning post-training changes multiple training actuators online, including rollout temperature, group size, clipping, KL regularization, verifier allocation, and update budget. Three coupled issues remain unresolved. A future-risk model trained from behavior trajectories need not estimate the risk induced by the controller that will be deployed; a score calibrated on logged state-action pairs can become miscalibrated after selective action choice; and independent per-resource minimum costs do not in general certify a feasible multi-resource continuation. We introduce FSPO, a feedback-state controller for budgeted LLM RL post-training that addresses these issues jointly. FSPO learns a policy-consistent risk-to-go model whose Bellman target follows the same frozen controller used for future decisions, together with a long-horizon utility model. Decision-conditioned trajectory calibration (DCTC) calibrates risk on cross-fitted trajectories generated by actions selected by provisional controllers. A Pareto resource continuation certificate (PRCC) admits an action only when a non-dominated cumulative reservation remains feasible over the residual horizon. Under a matched GRPO resource envelope, FSPO reaches 66.11% held-out and 59.43% OOD accuracy, compared with 64.47% and 57.03% for PB2, the strongest evaluated adaptive baseline. Three paired training seeds give gains of +2.42 and +3.19 percentage points over the contextual bandit on held-out and OOD evaluation. Under high behavior-deployment mismatch, policy-consistent risk lowers selected-decision ECE from 0.108 to 0.053; DCTC lowers it from 0.039 to 0.022 at matched acceptance; PRCC removes false-feasible admissions on an 18-action catalog ($0.197\rightarrow0.000$); and enabling all three components reduces trajectory failure from 0.181 to 0.083 in a factorial ablation.

AI.tldr: FSPO提出一种反馈状态控制器，联合解决预算约束下LLM强化学习后训练中的风险估计、校准偏移与多资源可行性问题。
AI.motivation: 自适应LLM强化学习后训练会在线调整多个训练执行器（如rollout温度、组大小、裁剪、KL正则、验证器分配与更新预算），但存在三个耦合未解问题：由行为轨迹训练的未来风险模型未必能估计即将部署控制器所诱导的风险；在日志状态-动作对上校准的分数在选择性动作选择后可能失准；各资源独立的最小成本通常无法保证多资源余续可行。
AI.method: FSPO学习策略一致的风险-to-go模型，其Bellman目标遵循与未来决策相同的冻结控制器，并配以长时程效用模型；提出决策条件轨迹校准（DCTC），在由临时控制器所选动作生成的交叉拟合轨迹上校准风险；提出Pareto资源余续证书（PRCC），仅当非支配累积预留量在剩余时程内可行时才允许某动作。
AI.result: 在匹配GRPO资源包络下，FSPO取得66.11%的留出集与59.43%的OOD准确率，优于最强自适应基线PB2的64.47%与57.03%；三个配对训练种子相对上下文老虎机在留出与OOD上分别提升+2.42与+3.19个百分点。高行为-部署失配下，策略一致风险将所选决策ECE从0.108降至0.053；DCTC在匹配接受率下将ECE从0.039降至0.022；PRCC在18动作目录上消除假可行准入（$0.197→$0.000）；因子消融中同时启用三组件将轨迹失败率从0.181降至0.083。
AI.conclusion: FSPO通过策略一致风险建模、决策条件校准与Pareto资源余续证书的联合设计，在预算约束的LLM RL后训练中同时改善准确率、校准质量与多资源可行性，并显著降低轨迹失败率。

title: Neuron merging via inverse-activation regression for post-training compression of sigmoid neural networks
summary: As neural networks continue to grow in scale, model compression is becoming increasingly important for efficient inference under limited computational resources. Structured pruning methods remove neurons or channels that are estimated to be less important, but the removed units may still contain useful information. From the viewpoint of coarse-graining a trained network, it is valuable to ask which information should be retained when multiple neuronal degrees of freedom are consolidated. In this paper, we discuss cluster-based merging methods for compression of trained neural networks. In addition to a data-free contribution-weighted averaging method, we propose neuron-merging methods in which neuron responses are mapped back to the pre-activation space via the inverse activation function, and the weights and biases of each representative neuron are estimated using the least-squares method. We also examine both a data-assisted strategy with actual training inputs and a data-free strategy using randomly generated inputs. The comparisons provide empirical evidence, in the tested sigmoid networks, that weight information is particularly useful for clustering whereas activation information is useful for representative-neuron reconstruction in the merging process.

AI.tldr: 本文研究训练后神经网络的聚类式神经元合并压缩方法，提出在激活前空间用最小二乘重建代表神经元，并比较数据辅助与无数据策略，发现在测试的sigmoid网络中权重信息利于聚类、激活信息利于代表神经元重建。
AI.motivation: 神经网络规模不断增大，在有限算力下高效推理需要模型压缩。结构化剪枝虽能移除不重要的神经元或通道，但被移除单元仍可能含有效信息。因此从训练网络粗粒化的角度，需要研究在合并多个神经元自由度时应保留哪些信息。
AI.method: 提出基于聚类的神经元合并压缩方法：除无数据的贡献加权平均法外，还提出将神经元响应经逆激活函数映射回激活前空间，并用最小二乘法估计各代表神经元的权重与偏置；同时考察使用真实训练输入的数据辅助策略和随机生成输入的无数据策略。
AI.result: 在测试的sigmoid网络上的对比实验提供了经验证据：权重信息对聚类特别有用，而激活信息对合并过程中的代表神经元重建有用。
AI.conclusion: 聚类式神经元合并是训练网络压缩的有效途径，且权重与激活信息在聚类和代表神经元重建中各有优势，可指导后续压缩方法的设计。

title: VisionMX: Unlocking Microscaling Post-Training Quantization for Vision Models
summary: Microscaling (MX) formats are emerging as a hardware-supported approach to efficient training and inference. They combine low-precision elements with shared block scales, but their impact on vision models remains underexplored. We systematically investigate post-training MX quantization across vision models and tasks. An analysis of direct conversion identifies three sources of error: block-scale representation, the poor alignment of some small convolutional weight tensors with nonuniform element grids, and the underuse of signed codes by nonnegative activations. These findings motivate VisionMX, a post-training MX quantization method that optimizes bounded weight rounding and applies a foldable affine correction to activations. We evaluate VisionMX across image classification, object detection, semantic segmentation, and low-light image enhancement using several MX-style formats. It improves on direct conversion and the evaluated post-training quantization baselines, with the largest performance recoveries in architectures most sensitive to MX conversion

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究 microscopy (MX) 格式在视觉模型中的后训练量化，识别直接转换的三类误差来源，并提出 VisionMX 方法，通过有界权重舍入与可折叠仿射激活校正提升多任务性能。
AI.motivation: MX 格式结合低精度元素与共享块尺度，已被硬件支持用于高效训练与推理，但其对视觉模型的影响尚未被充分探索。作者希望系统评估 MX 量化在视觉任务中的表现并分析误差来源。
AI.method: 作者系统研究视觉模型与任务上的后训练 MX 量化。通过直接转换分析，识别三类误差：块尺度表示误差、部分小型卷积权重张量与不均匀元素网格对齐差、非负激活未充分利用有符号编码。基于此提出 VisionMX：优化有界权重舍入，并应用可折叠的仿射校正到激活。
AI.result: 在图像分类、目标检测、语义分割和低光图像增强任务上，使用多种 MX 风格格式评估 VisionMX。结果表明其优于直接转换与所评估的后训练量化基线，对 MX 转换最敏感的架构取得最大性能恢复。
AI.conclusion: VisionMX 是一种有效的后训练 MX 量化方法，能缓解 MX 直接转换的关键误差来源，并在多种视觉任务与架构上实现性能恢复，尤其对敏感架构收益最大。

title: AMBER: Multi-View Adaptive Budget Allocation for Listwise Vision-Language Reranking
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) are powerful listwise rerankers for multimodal retrieval, but high inference costs restrict them to evaluating small local candidate views. Existing multi-call strategies rely on fixed schedules, wasting expensive VLM calls on uninformative candidate pairs and easy queries. To address this, we propose Adaptive Multi-view Budgeted Elo Reranking (AMBER), an online, budgeted multi-view reranking framework that dynamically optimizes global resource allocation. AMBER treats fragmented listwise VLM outputs as local tournaments, using continuous Elo updates to maintain a lightweight global ranking state. Building on this, it allocates computation at two levels: dynamically constructing candidate views with high score ambiguity, and scheduling queries to maximize expected information gain. We show that each Elo update corresponds to a stochastic gradient ascent step on the Bradley-Terry log-likelihood, and provide a submodular information-theoretic motivation for the query-level allocation strategy. Experiments on CIRR, CIRCO, and PhotoBench demonstrate that AMBER achieves the strongest overall performance among the compared multi-call VLM reranking methods under comparable VLM-call budgets, while remaining effective in lower-budget settings. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/wnlfc/AMBER.

AI.tldr: 提出 AMBER，一种在线、预算约束的多视图重排框架，通过 Elo 动态更新与两级自适应计算分配，在相同 VLM 调用预算下提升多模态检索重排性能。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型（VLM）作为多模态检索的 listwise 重排器效果强，但推理成本高，只能评估小规模局部候选视图；现有多调用策略采用固定调度，会把昂贵的 VLM 调用浪费在无信息量的候选对和简单查询上，缺乏全局资源优化。
AI.method: AMBER 将碎片化的 listwise VLM 输出视为局部锦标赛，用连续 Elo 更新维护轻量级全局排序状态；在两个层面分配计算：(1) 动态构建分数歧义高的候选视图，(2) 调度查询以最大化期望信息增益。理论上面证明每次 Elo 更新对应 Bradley-Terry 对数似然上的随机梯度上升步，并为查询级分配策略提供子模的信息论动机。
AI.result: 在 CIRR、CIRCO 和 PhotoBench 上，AMBER 在可比 VLM 调用预算下取得所比较的多调用 VLM 重排方法中最强的整体性能，且在更低预算设定下仍然有效。
AI.conclusion: AMBER 通过在线预算化的多视图重排与自适应全局资源分配，有效缓解固定调度带来的调用浪费，为高成本 VLM 重排提供了高效、可扩展的方案；代码已开源。

title: OpenGameEval: Benchmarking Agentic Programming and Exploration in a Stateful Game Engine
comment: A shorter version appears at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Evaluation of Interactive Agents
summary:
We present OpenGameEval, a benchmark and evaluation framework for agentic game development inside Roblox Studio. It runs language models as agents in reproducible, stateful game-engine sessions and scores each run with executable checks, both on the edited scene and in a simulated play session. Most agentic coding benchmarks require exploration but score only final task success. OpenGameEval separates observation tools from editing tools in its eight-tool action space, so exploration can be measured directly. We measure the pass rates and exploration behavior of 13 frontier models on 84 human-curated core tasks, with 16 attempts per task.
  The tasks are hard for current models. The best model solves 51.7% of tasks on a single attempt and 39.4% five times out of five, and no tested model solves six of the tasks. Models at the frontier reach similar pass rates by solving different tasks: splitting tasks by the kind of work they require spreads the top five by 5.0pp on script-authoring tasks and 12.5pp on scene-change tasks.
  Exploration behavior predicts whether a run succeeds. Holding task and model fixed, a run that inspects every object a reference solution touches before acting on it passes 13.4pp more often than a run that inspects none of them on scene-only tasks, and 9.8pp more often on script-only tasks.
  We release the task suite, its place files, the per-task annotations, a plugin that runs the tasks inside Roblox Studio, and an updated leaderboard under the MIT license at https://github.com/Roblox/open-game-eval.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 OpenGameEval——一个面向 Roblox Studio 内智能体游戏开发的基准与评测框架，通过可复现的状态化引擎会话与可执行校验，分离观测/编辑工具以直接度量探索行为。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体编码基准多要求探索，但仅以最终任务成功率计分，无法度量探索过程本身，也缺少针对游戏引擎内开发场景的可复现评测。
AI.method: 在 Roblox Studio 中以可复现、有状态会话运行语言模型智能体；八工具动作空间将观测工具与编辑工具分离；在每个任务上用可执行检查对编辑后的场景与模拟游玩会话双重打分；在 84 个人工筛选核心任务上评测 13 个前沿模型，每任务 16 次尝试。
AI.result: 任务对当前模型较难：最优模型单次通过率 51.7%，五次全通过率 39.4%，有 6 个任务无任何模型解出；按工作类型切分后，前五名在脚本编写任务上相差 5.0pp，在场景修改任务上相差 12.5pp。控制任务与模型后，检查参考解涉及的每个对象再行动的运行，在纯场景任务上通过率高 13.4pp，纯脚本任务上高 9.8pp。
AI.conclusion: 探索行为可预测运行成败，工具分离设计使探索可直接度量；作者以 MIT 许可发布任务套件、place 文件、逐任务标注、Roblox Studio 插件及更新后的排行榜。

title: VDOT++: Unified Few-Step Video Generation via Unbalanced Optimal Transport Distillation
summary: Video creation spans text-to-video (T2V), image-to-video (I2V), and condition-based generation, yet video diffusion models remain costly because they repeatedly evaluate large backbones during sampling. Distribution matching distillation (DMD) reduces this cost, but its reverse Kullback--Leibler (KL) objective can provide unstable or incomplete guidance when the student and teacher distributions have limited overlap. VDOT addressed this issue by adding optimal transport distillation (OTD), whose explicit coupling supplies geometric directions for condition-based generation. Balanced OTD, however, performs full-mass matching between the spatial tokens of each corresponding student--teacher frame pair. This assumption weakens for T2V and I2V, where one condition admits many valid outputs and spatial content need not align across different realizations. We present VDOT++, a unified distillation framework that applies the same training recipe separately to generators for the three task families. It makes OTD robust to output diversity through an asymmetric unbalanced formulation that allows unreliable student tokens to carry less mass while maintaining coverage of the teacher tokens. An $\ell_1$ ground cost further replaces mean-based aggregation with a more mode-preserving weighted median that limits the influence of distant transport targets. The two changes respectively determine whom to match and how the selected targets should be aggregated. We additionally combine distribution matching and adversarial refinement through sequential backward passes, and exploit the decoupled score networks for cross-scale distillation, where larger score networks improve a compact generator. Experiments on UVCBench, VBench, VBench-I2V, and the VACE benchmark show that the resulting four-step generators are competitive with many-step teachers and strong few-step baselines across all three task families.

AI.tldr: 提出 VDOT++，一个统一视频扩散蒸馏框架，通过非对称非平衡最优传输与 ℓ1 加权中值聚合，使四步生成器在 T2V、I2V 与条件生成三类任务上媲美多步教师模型。
AI.motivation: 视频扩散模型采样成本高，因其反复评估大型骨干网络。DMD 的反向 KL 目标在师生分布重叠有限时指导不稳定或不完整；VDOT 引入 OTD 提供几何方向，但其平衡 OTD 对每对师生帧的空间 token 做全质量匹配，该假设在 T2V/I2V 中不成立——同一条件可对应多个有效输出，空间内容不必对齐。
AI.method: VDOT++ 对三类任务家族的生成器分别套用同一训练配方。核心两点：(1) 非对称非平衡 OTD，令不可靠的学生 token 携带较少质量，同时保持对教师 token 的覆盖；(2) 用 ℓ1 地面代价替代均值聚合，以更保模态的加权中值抑制远距离传输目标的影响。二者分别决定"匹配谁"与"如何聚合选中目标"。此外通过顺序反向传播结合分布匹配与对抗精修，并利用解耦分数网络进行跨尺度蒸馏（大分数网络提升紧凑生成器）。
AI.result: 在 UVCBench、VBench、VBench-I2V 与 VACE 基准上，所得四步生成器在三类任务家族中均与多步教师及强少步基线具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 通过非平衡最优传输与中值聚合缓解多解条件生成中的匹配失配，并以顺序反向传播与跨尺度蒸馏增强统一框架，VDOT++ 实现了跨 T2V、I2V、条件生成的高效少步视频生成。

title: DNAlign: Dynamic Null-Space Safe Alignment for LLMs
comment: Regular Paper; 13 pages, 8 figures, and 1 table
summary: Ensuring the safe and reliable deployment of large language models (LLMs) remains a fundamental challenge. Existing safety alignment approaches either incur high computational cost or unintentionally disrupt the model's core knowledge, leading to degraded fluency and factual accuracy on benign tasks. This reveals a persistent trade-off between safety and utility. We propose DNAlign, a lightweight alignment framework that integrates control-theoretic optimization with null-space projection. By treating the LLM as a dynamic system, the proposed framework introduces controllable perturbations to steer generation toward safe behavior. A key component is the projection module, which restricts these perturbations to the harmful-related subspace derived from neutral hidden states, thereby preserving general knowledge and response quality. A value function trained on human preference data adaptively optimizes the control signals to align with human safety preferences. Extensive evaluations across multiple LLM backbones demonstrate that our framework consistently reduces harmful outputs while maintaining fluency, coherence, and factual utility. It achieves superior overall performance compared to prior alignment baselines without sacrificing generation diversity. These results indicate that the proposed framework provides an effective and practically deployable solution for safe LLM alignment. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/DNAlign.

AI.tldr: 提出DNAlign轻量对齐框架，融合控制论优化与零空间投影，在大模型上实现安全性提升同时保持通用能力。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM安全对齐方法要么计算成本高，要么在提升安全性时破坏模型核心知识，导致流畅性与事实准确性下降，安全与效用难以兼顾。
AI.method: 将LLM视为动态系统，通过引入可控扰动引导生成趋于安全行为；利用投影模块将扰动限制在由中性隐状态导出的有害相关子空间内，以保留通用知识与响应质量；并用基于人类偏好数据训练的价值函数自适应优化控制信号以对齐人类安全偏好。
AI.result: 在多个LLM基座上的广泛评估表明，该框架持续减少有害输出，同时保持流畅性、连贯性与事实效用，整体性能优于先前对齐基线且不牺牲生成多样性。
AI.conclusion: DNAlign为安全LLM对齐提供了一种有效且可实际部署的解决方案，缓解了安全与效用之间的权衡，代码已开源。

title: DISSOLVR: An Interpretable and Fast Framework for Aqueous and Organic Solubility Prediction
comment: 48 pages, 19 tables, 6 figures. Accepted to the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026)
summary: High-fidelity solubility prediction is fundamental to pharmaceutical development and environmental partitioning, where accurate modeling must couple molecular structure with thermodynamic behavior across diverse chemical environments. However, recent advancements have been dominated by deep learning architectures that often sacrifice physical interpretability for predictive power. We challenge this trend by showing that state-of-the-art performance does not require such non-transparent architectures. To address this, we introduce DISSOLVR, a transparent framework for molecular solubility prediction. In addition, we perform a comprehensive literature review and a benchmarking study against various methods. We show that DISSOLVR approaches the aleatoric limit of experimental uncertainty and achieves OOD generalization through structural invariance, derived by mapping molecules to physically-grounded descriptors. Then, we present an LLM-assisted post-hoc explanation pipeline that bridges the gap between symbolic model artifacts and chemically grounded narratives. Finally, a comparative benchmark of a survey involving 22 expert chemists reveals that expert evaluators provide deep insights.

AI.tldr: 提出透明框架DISSOLVR预测分子溶解度，性能逼近实验不确定性极限并具OOD泛化，配LLM解释管道及专家评估。
AI.motivation: 高保真溶解度预测对制药与环境分配至关重要，但当前深度学习模型以牺牲物理可解释性换取预测能力，作者试图证明SOTA性能不依赖不透明架构。
AI.method: 引入透明框架DISSOLVR，将分子映射为物理基础描述符以获得结构不变性；辅以文献综述与多方法基准测试，并构建LLM辅助的事后解释管道连接符号化模型产物与化学叙述。
AI.result: DISSOLVR逼近实验不确定性的偶然极限，并通过物理描述符实现OOD泛化；22位化学专家的调查基准提供深入见解。
AI.conclusion: 透明可解释模型可达到SOTA性能，兼顾泛化与化学可解释性，挑战了必须依赖黑箱深度学习架构的趋势。

title: Uncertainty as a Proxy for Semantic Correctness in Diffusion-Based Medical Image Synthesis
summary:
Diffusion models can synthesise contrast-enhanced CT (CECT) from non-contrast CT (NCCT), avoiding contrast administration and its environmental and patient-access costs. However, visually realistic images are not necessarily anatomically correct, and the pixel-intensity and feature-space similarity metrics used to assess generation quality do not directly measure anatomical correctness. In this work, we investigate whether uncertainty can serve as a proxy for semantic correctness in diffusion-based medical image synthesis.
  We study NCCT-to-CECT synthesis using AortaDiff, a multitask diffusion framework that jointly generates CECT images and lumen segmentations. The segmentation output provides an explicit representation of the generated vascular anatomy, enabling segmentation-derived errors to be used as a quantitative measure of generation correctness. Six methods spanning weight (Ensemble, HyperDiff, BayesDiff), architecture-perturbation (MCDropout), generative-stochasticity (RDS) and input-perturbation (TTA) uncertainty are compared at the pixel, region and image levels, and for detection of clinically relevant out-of-distribution (OOD) cases.
  Uncertainty proves informative at all three spatial scales, remains informative on an external multi-centre dataset under distribution shift, and supports OOD detection. MCDropout stands out among the six: it ranks among the leading methods at every scale, generalizes well on the external dataset, and can be enabled at inference on any model already trained with dropout, so reliable uncertainty comes at no extra training cost. Uncertainty reliably flags severe failures but discriminates poorly among already high-quality images. These findings support uncertainty as a practical and computationally economical signal for quality filtering, reliability assessment and OOD detection in NCCT-to CECT synthesis.

AI.tldr: 研究探讨扩散模型在NCCT→CECT合成中，不确定性是否可作为语义正确性的代理指标。以AortaDiff多任务框架为对象，比较六种不确定性方法，发现不确定性在像素、区域、图像三个尺度均有信息量，能支持OOD检测与严重失败识别，其中MCDropout表现最优且零额外训练成本。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型可从非增强CT（NCCT）合成增强CT（CECT），规避造影剂使用及其环境与患者可及性成本。但视觉逼真的图像未必解剖结构正确，而常用的像素强度与特征空间相似度指标并不直接衡量解剖正确性。为此，作者希望验证不确定性能否作为医学图像合成中语义正确性的代理信号。
AI.method: 基于AortaDiff多任务扩散框架开展NCCT→CECT合成，该框架联合生成CECT图像与管腔分割，分割输出显式表征生成血管解剖结构，从而可用分割误差定量衡量生成正确性。比较六种不确定性方法：权重层面（Ensemble、HyperDiff、BayesDiff）、架构扰动（MCDropout）、生成随机性（RDS）与输入扰动（TTA），在像素、区域、图像三个层级以及临床相关OOD病例检测上进行评估。
AI.result: 不确定性在三个空间尺度上均具信息量，在分布偏移下的外部多中心数据集上仍保持有效，并支持OOD检测。MCDropout在六种方法中最为突出：在各尺度均居领先，在外部数据集上泛化良好，且可在任何已用dropout训练的模型上于推理阶段启用，无需额外训练成本即可获得可靠不确定性。不确定性可可靠标记严重失败，但对已属高质量的图像区分能力较弱。
AI.conclusion: 不确定性可作为NCCT→CECT合成中实用且计算经济可靠的信号，用于质量筛选、可靠性评估与OOD检测；但其价值主要体现在识别严重失败，而非在高质量图像间精细排序，这为其应用边界提供了明确界定。

title: Bounded Reachability & Jailbreak Detection via Contraction-Constrained State Space Models
summary: Safety heads are lightweight classifiers attached to pretrained language models for flagging harmful inputs before generation. Their empirical detection performance has been studied, but their formal robustness properties remain largely unexplored. We ask when a State Space Model (SSM)-based safety head can be certified to produce the same prediction for all inputs within a bounded embedding-space perturbation. We prove that the answer turns on a single condition: the $l_\infty$ norm of the state transition matrix must satisfy $\norm{A}_\infty<1$ (the \emph{contraction condition}), which enables exact interval bound propagation (IBP) certification for linear time-invariant classifiers. When the contraction condition holds, the reachable output interval has bounded steady-state width and examples can be certified as robustly classified. When it fails, the interval grows exponentially with sequence length and certification is impossible at any practical perturbation radius. We enforce contraction with a hinge penalty and show on toxic comment data that certified fraction improves from 41\% to 59\%, with a sharp empirical phase transition at $\norm{A}_\infty=1$ matching the theory. Applying a contraction-regularized S4 head to jailbreak detection on JailbreakBench, we achieve a zero-shot transfer to AdvBench (DR=0.994) and HarmBench (DR=0.988). A logistic regression on mean-pooled Mamba-130M embeddings matches or exceeds the S4 head on every detection metric, confirming that harmful intent is already linearly separable in the embedding space. The S4 safety head's contribution is not superior discrimination but the formal certification that no probe-based approach provides.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究基于状态空间模型（SSM）的安全头（safety head）的形式化鲁棒性，证明其可认证性取决于状态转移矩阵的 l∞ 范数是否满足收缩条件 ‖A‖∞<1，并通过铰链惩罚强制收缩，使认证比例从 41% 提升至 59%，在越狱检测任务上实现零样本迁移。
AI.motivation: 安全头作为附加在预训练语言模型上的轻量分类器，其经验检测性能已被研究，但形式化鲁棒性属性基本未被探索。作者希望回答：在什么条件下，基于 SSM 的安全头能够被认证为对嵌入空间有界扰动内的所有输入产生相同预测。
AI.method: 论文聚焦线性时不变（LTI）分类器的精确区间界传播（IBP）认证，证明认证成立当且仅当状态转移矩阵满足 l∞ 范数收缩条件 ‖A‖∞<1：此时可达输出区间具有有界稳态宽度，可认证样本为鲁棒分类；条件不满足时区间随序列长度指数增长，任何实际扰动半径下都无法认证。作者用铰链惩罚强制收缩，并在有毒评论数据上验证，同时将收缩正则化的 S4 头应用于 JailbreakBench 越狱检测，迁移至 AdvBench 与 HarmBench；另用均值池化的 Mamba-130M 嵌入做逻辑回归对照。
AI.result: 理论预测在 ‖A‖∞=1 处存在尖锐的经验相变。强制收缩后认证比例从 41% 提升至 59%。收缩正则化 S4 头在 JailbreakBench 上训练后零样本迁移至 AdvBench（DR=0.994）与 HarmBench（DR=0.988）。逻辑回归在均值池化 Mamba-130M 嵌入上在所有检测指标上匹配或超过 S4 头。
AI.conclusion: S4 安全头的价值不在于更强的判别能力——有害意图在嵌入空间中已近似线性可分，逻辑回归即可达到同等或更优检测效果——而在于提供了基于探针的方法所不具备的形式化认证保证。

title: Dense Mixture-of-Experts as a Reparameterized Wide FFN: A Granularity Sweep at Fixed Compute
summary: Sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models combine learned routing with selection from a large expert pool. We isolate the contribution of dynamic expert combination using a dense analogue: $K$ SwiGLU experts, all active for every token and combined by a softmax gate, at fixed total FFN width. With no larger pool or discrete selection, the dense baseline is the $K=1$ case. Validation loss varies non-monotonically with $K$: $K=2$ improves over the baseline by $0.0048$, whereas $K=4$ and $K=6$ worsen it by $0.0053$ and $0.0197$, respectively. Routing generally remains soft and expert usage balanced, except in the first layer of the $K=4$ model, where routing is nearly one-hot. Forcing this gate to uniform increases loss by $2.4$ nats on a diagnostic subset, indicating that its concentrated routing is functionally important. We further show that the architecture is exactly a dense SwiGLU with token-dependent, simplex-constrained group scaling and contains the dense baseline in its function class. These single-run results suggest a granularity sweet spot for always-active, softly gated FFNs at fixed width, with $K=2$ performing best among the configurations tested.

AI.tldr: 本文用稠密类比（K个全部激活的SwiGLU专家，以softmax门控组合，总FFN宽度固定）隔离动态专家组合的贡献，发现验证损失随K非单调变化，K=2最优，并给出该架构的等价理论刻画。
AI.motivation: 稀疏Mixture-of-Experts（MoE）将学习到的路由与大规模专家池中的选择相结合，但其性能增益中"动态专家组合"这一因素本身的贡献难以单独评估，因为专家池规模与离散选择同时变化。本文希望隔离动态专家组合的独立作用。
AI.method: 采用稠密类比：设置K个SwiGLU专家，对所有token均激活，由softmax门控组合，总FFN宽度固定；不引入更大专家池，也不做离散选择，K=1即稠密基线。在不同K下测量验证损失，并观察路由软硬程度与专家使用均衡性；对K=4模型首层门控做强制均匀化的诊断实验。同时从理论上分析该架构的函数形式。
AI.result: 验证损失随K非单调变化：K=2较基线改善0.0048，K=4与K=6分别恶化0.0053与0.0197。路由总体保持较软、专家使用均衡，唯一例外是K=4模型的第一层，其路由接近one-hot；将该门控强制为均匀分布会使诊断子集损失上升2.4 nats，说明该集中路由具有功能重要性。理论上证明该架构等价于带有token依赖、单纯形约束的组缩放（group scaling）的稠密SwiGLU，且其函数类包含稠密基线。
AI.conclusion: 在固定宽度下，始终激活、软门控的FFN存在一个"粒度甜点"：在测试的配置中K=2表现最佳，K过大反而损害性能。这些单次运行结果提示动态专家组合的收益并非单调于专家数量。

title: EmbPASS: Towards Cross-Embodiment Open Panoramic Segmentation
summary: Panoramic images provide a complete 360-degree field of view, enabling comprehensive scene understanding for embodied perception. However, heterogeneous embodied platforms exhibit substantial differences in observation viewpoints and spatial layouts, giving rise to cross-embodiment observation shifts that pose additional challenges to consistent and reliable panoramic perception, while systematic studies of this problem remain limited. To bridge this gap, we introduce a new task, termed Cross-Embodiment Open Panoramic Segmentation. Meanwhile, we establish EmbPASS, a multi-platform panoramic semantic segmentation benchmark spanning Vehicle, Drone, Wearable, and Quadruped platforms under a unified semantic taxonomy, providing a testbed for systematically studying cross-embodiment panoramic perception. We further propose EPONet, an open-vocabulary panoramic semantic segmentation network that integrates Relation-Aware Metric Adapter (RAMA) and Content-Adaptive Semantic Transfer (CAST) to enhance spatial modeling and semantic transfer under heterogeneous embodied observations. Extensive experiments show that EPONet achieves the best platform-balanced performance on EmbPASS with 35.82% mIoU, outperforming the strongest baseline by 1.10%, while remaining competitive on existing panoramic segmentation benchmarks. The source code and EmbPASS benchmark will be made publicly available at https://github.com/guopj1/EmbPASS.

AI.tldr: 本文提出跨具身开放全景分割新任务，构建EmbPASS多平台全景语义分割基准，并设计EPONet网络（含RAMA与CAST模块），在EmbPASS上取得35.82% mIoU的最佳平台均衡性能。
AI.motivation: 全景图像具有360度视场，利于具身感知，但不同具身平台在观测视角与空间布局上差异显著，导致跨具身观测偏移，给一致可靠的全景感知带来挑战，而该问题的系统研究仍然有限。
AI.method: 提出跨具身开放全景分割任务；构建EmbPASS基准，覆盖车辆、无人机、可穿戴、四足四类平台，采用统一语义分类体系；提出开放词汇全景语义分割网络EPONet，集成关系感知度量适配器（RAMA）与内容自适应语义迁移（CAST），增强异构具身观测下的空间建模与语义迁移。
AI.result: 在EmbPASS上，EPONet以35.82% mIoU取得最佳平台均衡性能，比最强基线高1.10%；在现有全景分割基准上保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 该工作填补了跨具身全景感知系统研究的空白，提供了统一基准与有效方法，代码与EmbPASS基准将开源。

title: Harness-Aware Distillation for Small Language Model Agents
summary: Language model agents are deployed with a harness, the software around the model that manages its context, tools, and feedback. When such an agent is distilled into a smaller one, the harness stays in place, so the student mainly needs the teacher-specific abilities that the harness cannot provide, such as acting correctly on harness information. Standard distillation, however, imitates the teacher's full outputs and treats the harness as part of the input. We propose Harness-Aware Distillation (HAD), which focuses distillation on what the teacher adds beyond the harness. HAD complements on-policy distillation with two components: an action preference that contrasts the same teacher's actions with and without the harness information, scored after the student's own reasoning, and a validity check that drops preference pairs whose preferred action contradicts the harness records. We show that the contrast gives the student information that imitating the teacher alone cannot provide, and HAD needs no task rewards, success labels, or future information. Across multiple long-horizon agent benchmarks and models, HAD outperforms on-policy distillation baselines with the same fixed harness. Our analysis shows that HAD enters fewer unproductive loops and recovers from errors more often than the baselines, and suggests that it adaptively keeps learnable feedback in its weights while reading state information from the harness.

AI.tldr: 提出 Harness-Aware Distillation (HAD)，将蒸馏目标聚焦于"harness 之外的教师能力"，通过对同一教师在有/无 harness 信息下的动作做偏好对比，并过滤与 harness 记录矛盾的偏好对，在无需任务奖励、成功标签或未来信息的情况下，于多个长时程 agent 基准上超越同 harness 的 on-policy 蒸馏基线。
AI.motivation: 语言模型智能体运行在 harness（管理上下文、工具与反馈的外围软件）之上；当大模型蒸馏为小模型时 harness 保持不变，学生原则上只需学习 harness 无法提供的教师特有能力（如正确利用 harness 信息）。但标准蒸馏模仿教师完整输出，把 harness 当作输入的一部分，导致学生浪费容量去复现 harness 已经提供的内容，学习效率低下。
AI.method: HAD 在 on-policy 蒸馏基础上增加两个组件：(1) 动作偏好（action preference）：对同一教师在有 harness 信息与无 harness 信息下的动作构造对比，并在学生自身推理之后评分；(2) 有效性检查（validity check）：丢弃偏好动作与 harness 记录相矛盾的偏好对。整个过程不依赖任务奖励、成功标签或未来信息。
AI.result: 在多个长时程 agent 基准与模型上，HAD 在保持相同固定 harness 的条件下优于 on-policy 蒸馏基线。分析表明 HAD 更少陷入无效循环、更常从错误中恢复；理论上证明该对比提供了单纯模仿教师无法提供的信息。
AI.conclusion: HAD 表明蒸馏应只针对 harness 之外的学生可学信号：学生自适应地把可学习的反馈知识保存在权重中，而把状态信息交由 harness 读取，从而提升长时程智能体的蒸馏效果与鲁棒性。

title: Fisher-Guided Submodular Data Selection for Continual Pre-Training of Large Language Models
summary: Data selection is already a central bottleneck in large-language-model training, where web-scale corpora are noisy and token budgets are finite. In continual pre-training (CPT), it becomes a forgetting-control problem: a poorly chosen target-domain corpus can overwrite capabilities encoded in the pretrained checkpoint. Existing CPT practice either scores candidates with parameter-agnostic scalars such as perplexity, or mitigates forgetting by spending many extra general-domain replay tokens. Neither strategy directly asks how training on a candidate will move the model parameters. We show that loss-based selection causes the post-CPT Fisher diagonal to drift downward on exactly the high-Fisher coordinates the pretrained model had committed to, while leaving low-Fisher coordinates largely untouched. This asymmetry exposes a parameter-space mechanism for catastrophic forgetting. Motivated by this observation, we propose a Fisher-aware CPT selector that decomposes each candidate's gradient into an anchor component, which measures perturbation along committed parameter directions, and a frontier component, which measures update capacity in unconstrained low-Fisher subspaces. We aggregate these signals with a log-determinant submodular objective and optimize it in a single pass using a scalable streaming data selection pipeline. On TinyLlama-1.1B and Llama-3.1-8B CPT over medical data, our selector improves target-domain quality while bounding forgetting on held-out pretraining benchmarks. Most importantly, it is substantially more token-efficient than forgetting-aware replay. 1B selected tokens already outperform the replay strategy trained with 10B tokens on both adaptation and forgetting, giving a 10x token-efficiency advantage.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一种Fisher感知的持续预训练数据选择器，将候选梯度分解为锚定分量与前沿分量，用对数行列式次模目标进行流式单遍优化，在1B与8B模型医疗CPT上同时改善目标任务质量并抑制遗忘，且比回放策略具有10倍以上的token效率优势。
AI.motivation: 持续预训练（CPT）中数据选择不仅是效率问题，更是遗忘控制问题：目标域语料选择不当会覆盖预训练检查点中已编码的能力。已有做法要么使用困惑度等与参数无关的标量打分，要么消耗大量通用域回放token来缓解遗忘，都没有直接回答"在候选数据上训练会如何移动模型参数"这一核心问题。作者观察到基于损失的选择会使后CPT阶段的Fisher对角在高Fisher坐标上下降，而这些坐标正是预训练模型已经固化承诺的方向，低Fisher坐标几乎不受影响，这种非对称性揭示了灾难性遗忘在参数空间中的机制。
AI.method: 提出Fisher感知的CPT选择器：将每个候选样本的梯度分解为锚定分量（度量沿已承诺参数方向的扰动）与前沿分量（度量在未受约束的低Fisher子空间中的更新容量）；将这两类信号通过对数行列式（log-determinant）次模目标进行聚合；使用可扩展的流式数据选择流水线在一次遍历中完成优化。
AI.result: 在TinyLlama-1.1B与Llama-3.1-8B上针对医疗数据进行CPT：选择器提升了目标域质量，同时在留存的预训练基准上限制了遗忘。最显著的是token效率优势——仅用1B选择token即已在适配与遗忘两个指标上超过用10B token训练的回放策略，实现约10倍的token效率提升。
AI.conclusion: 参数空间视角（Fisher对角漂移的非对称性）能够解释CPT中的灾难性遗忘，并可直接转化为数据选择准则；基于锚定—前沿梯度分解与次模目标的选择器在无需大量回放数据的前提下实现适配与抗遗忘的更好权衡，具有显著token效率优势。

title: Mind the Refinement Gap: When Safe High-Level Robot Plans Produce Unsafe Executions
summary: Language-enabled robot systems increasingly combine semantic-graph planning with temporal-logic safety monitors. We investigate a trace-completeness assumption in these systems: whether the high-level action sequence checked by a monitor represents the navigation and implicit action effects induced during execution. We audit this assumption in RoboGuard by comparing its verdict on a surface plan with its verdict on a graph-refined trace under the same Linear Temporal Logic (LTL) specification. Our evaluation comprises 28 controlled cases spanning five action-abstraction families and 14 end-to-end cases in which SPINE [1] generates plans from natural-language instructions while RoboGuard generates scene-grounded safety specifications. In the controlled evaluation, all 12 targeted abstraction cases exhibit the predicted surface-versus-refined discrepancy while all 16 controls behave as expected, motivating graph-based trace refinement as a lightweight mitigation and a diagnostic tool for physical-AI safety monitors.

AI.tldr: 本文审视语言驱动机器人系统中"迹完备性假设"：安全监控器所检查的高层动作序列是否真实反映执行中产生的导航与隐式动作效应。
AI.motivation: 语言使能的机器人系统将语义图规划与时间逻辑安全监控器结合，但监控器检查的高层动作序列可能无法代表执行期间实际发生的导航与隐式动作效应，该"迹完备性假设"此前未被系统审查。
AI.method: 以RoboGuard为对象，在同一LTL规范下比较其对"表层计划"与"图精化迹"的判定结果；开展28个受控案例（覆盖五类动作抽象家族）与14个端到端案例（SPINE由自然语言指令生成计划，RoboGuard生成场景落地安全规范）。
AI.result: 受控评估中，12个目标抽象案例全部呈现预期的表层-精化差异，16个对照案例表现符合预期，验证了假设缺陷的存在与可控性。
AI.conclusion: 图基迹精化可作为轻量级缓解手段，并可作为物理AI安全监控器的诊断工具。

title: COSMI: COmpositional Synthesis of Multi-object Interactions
summary: Generative models of human-object interaction are bounded by the data that exists: everyday activities involve several objects, but most captured datasets record one at a time, as multi-object capture is combinatorially expensive. Our observation is that interactions are local, so single-object captures already contain the parts of multi-object activities. We compose them: contact-consistent clips of single interactions, mirrored to balance the hands, transfer between bodies, and a language model and geometric checks admit only the pairings that are plausible, semantically and physically. Therefore, the dataset grows combinatorially with the clips rather than recording time. The COSMI dataset holds 222k sequences and 275 hours with up to five objects, nearly thirty times the largest multi-object capture, and can be extended by adding datasets or even hand-object recordings. On this data we train the COSMI method, a text-to-interaction diffusion transformer that follows how the data is built: weight-shared object slots generate a variable number of objects, predicted relative to the body parts that move them. On a benchmark with an unseen object and unseen interaction combinations, models trained on the dataset generalize to the unseen combinations. COSMI outperforms baselines in text alignment and contact accuracy, where its margin is largest on the unseen object. Code, models, and the dataset pipeline will be released on the project page: https://ptrvilya.github.io/cosmi.

AI.tldr: 提出COSMI数据集与COSMI方法：通过组合单物体交互片段（镜像、跨体迁移、语言模型与几何校验筛选）构建大规模多物体人-物交互数据，并用权重共享object slots的扩散transformer生成可变数量物体交互。
AI.motivation: 多物体人-物交互数据获取存在组合爆炸问题：日常活动涉及多个物体，但现有数据集多仅记录单物体交互，多物体采集代价随物体数量组合式增长，导致生成模型受数据规模限制。
AI.method: 核心洞察是人-物交互具有局部性，单物体捕捉已包含多物体活动的组成部分。方法分两步：(1) 数据构建——将单交互片段按接触一致性进行组合，通过镜像平衡双手、跨身体迁移，并借助语言模型与几何校验仅保留语义与物理上合理的配对，使数据量随片段数组合式增长；(2) 模型训练——COSMI为文本到交互的扩散transformer，采用权重共享的object slots生成可变数量物体，物体预测相对于驱动其运动的身体部位。
AI.result: COSMI数据集包含222k序列、275小时、最多五物体，规模接近最大多物体采集数据集的近三十倍，且可通过增加数据集甚至手-物录制来扩展。在含未见物体与未见交互组合的基准上，基于该数据训练的模型能泛化到未见组合，COSMI在文本对齐与接触精度上优于基线，且在未见物体上优势最大。
AI.conclusion: 局部性假设使单物体数据经组合筛选可高效扩增为多物体交互数据，据此设计的权重共享扩散transformer在泛化性、文本对齐和接触准确性上表现优越；代码、模型与数据管线将开源。

title: TACD: Distilling Efficient Text-to-Motion Models via Terminal Amplification Control
summary: Recent text-to-motion models have improved motion quality and instruction following, yet many-step denoising and large model components make deployment slow and memory-intensive. We present Terminal-Amplification-Controlled Distillation (TACD), an on-policy approach for training efficient motion generators from text prompts and pretrained teachers, without real-motion training data. Building on segmented on-policy flow distillation, we supervise clean-motion predictions along student-generated trajectories. We identify a failure mode in which velocity matching on a fixed supervision grid repeatedly overweights errors near the denoising endpoint, degrading few-step generation. TACD ties the latest teacher query to the student's step size, bounding the effective loss weights in clean-motion space without changing inference. Experiments on HumanML3D and KIT-ML demonstrate improved few-step generation, including a 58% reduction in eight-step HY-Motion student FID relative to distillation without this bound. For diffusion teachers, the endpoint-matching form of TACD yields four-step students with lower FID and matched or improved text-motion retrieval relative to their 50-step teachers on HumanML3D. On HY-Motion and Kimodo, eight-step students with compact components achieve 7.7-11.9x end-to-end speedups and reduce peak GPU memory by 3.8-6.7x relative to their teachers. Project page: https://vkgo.github.io/TACD/

AI.tldr: 提出TACD（终端放大控制蒸馏），一种无需真实动作数据的on-policy蒸馏方法，通过将教师查询与步长绑定来抑制去噪端点附近的误差放大，实现文本到动作的少步高效生成。
AI.motivation: 现有文本到动作模型虽提升了动作质量与指令跟随能力，但多步去噪和庞大模型组件导致部署慢、显存占用高。已有蒸馏方法在固定监督网格上进行速度匹配时，会在去噪端点附近重复放大误差，损害少步生成质量。
AI.method: 基于分段on-policy流蒸馏，沿学生自生成轨迹监督干净动作预测；定位到固定监督网格速度匹配在端点过度加权误差的失效模式；TACD将最新教师查询与学生的步长绑定，在干净动作空间内限制有效损失权重，且不改变推理过程；对扩散教师采用端点匹配形式。
AI.result: HumanML3D与KIT-ML上少步生成提升，八步HY-Motion学生FID相比无约束蒸馏降低58%；对扩散教师，四步学生在HumanML3D上FID更低、文本-动作检索匹配或优于50步教师；HY-Motion与Kimodo上八步学生实现7.7–11.9倍端到端加速，峰值GPU显存降低3.8–6.7倍。
AI.conclusion: TACD通过终端放大控制解决了蒸馏中端点误差加权失衡问题，在无需真实动作数据的前提下显著提升少步生成质量与效率，兼顾动作质量、文本跟随与部署性能。

title: How Causality Bridges the Semantic Gap
summary: Numerical measurements capture how a system behaves, but often leave the meanings of its variables unspecified. Some variables are measured but never labeled, and others are never measured at all. Existing methods assign semantics to such variables by consulting general human knowledge, but this inherits its biases where that knowledge exists and offers nothing where it does not. We bridge this gap between measurements and their meanings with causal structure instead, reading a variable's semantics from how it acts on other variables. We formalize this as structure-constrained semantic alignment, in which the embedding of each unnamed variable is solved under the dependence relations implied by the causal graph, with the embeddings of a few known names as anchors. Accordingly, we build CausalBridge, a framework that discovers the causal graph from the measurements, latent variables included, solves for the embeddings under those relations, and expresses them as names through a language model. The causal structure reflects the mechanism that generated the measurements and is recovered from the measurements alone, which may make it the one source of information free of bias from human knowledge. We evaluate CausalBridge on five questionnaires and three robotics scenarios, with 20 to 90% of the variable names masked. It recovers the semantics of observed and latent variables more accurately than existing methods that rely on association, and its lead widens as less of the system is documented. The graph it discovers names variables as accurately as the documented one, and a new system is named in minutes and at a fraction of the cost of sampling methods. Once the semantic gap is bridged faithfully, machines can understand the world and take actions causally.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CausalBridge 框架，用因果结构而非人类知识为变量赋予语义，通过结构约束的语义对齐恢复已观测与潜在变量的名称，在问卷与机器人场景上优于关联方法。
AI.motivation: 数值测量记录系统行为却常不标注变量含义：有的变量被测量但无标签，有的根本未测量。现有方法借助通用人类知识赋义，既继承了知识的偏见，又在知识缺失处无能为力。作者希望找到一种不受人类知识偏见影响的信息来源来弥合测量与语义之间的鸿沟。
AI.method: 将问题形式化为结构约束的语义对齐：每个无名变量的嵌入在因果图所蕴含的依赖关系下求解，以少量已知名称的嵌入作为锚点。据此构建 CausalBridge：从测量数据（含潜在变量）中发现因果图，迁移到该因果关系下求解嵌入，再通过语言模型将嵌入表达为名称。
AI.result: 在五个问卷和三个机器人场景上评估，遮蔽 20% 至 90% 的变量名。CausalBridge 对已观测和潜在变量语义的恢复比依赖关联的现有方法更准确，且文档越少其领先幅度越大；其发现的因果图命名变量的准确率与人工记录的因果图相当，命名新系统只需数分钟且成本仅为采样方法的一小部分。
AI.conclusion: 因果结构源自生成测量的机制、仅从测量本身恢复，可能成为免受人类知识偏见影响的唯一信息源。一旦语义鸿沟被忠实弥合，机器便能理解世界并以因果方式采取行动。

title: Consecutive Posterior Fusion for Diffusive Recovery of Unobservable Image Structures
summary:
Solving severely ill-posed imaging inverse problems requires recovering image structures that are unobservable or weakly constrained by the measurements. Diffusion models provide expressive learned priors for inferring such missing information, while posterior sampling incorporates measurement consistency along the reverse process. Standard diffusion posterior samplers, however, rely on instantaneous measurement-aware estimates, without explicitly exploiting information carried by previous posterior corrections.
  We introduce Consecutive Posterior Fusion Denoising Diffusion Null-Space Models (CPF-DDNM), an inference-time strategy that fuses consecutive measurement-aware estimates to improve the diffusive recovery of unobservable image structures, without requiring retraining or additional denoiser evaluations. We instantiate this principle within DDNM, whose range/null-space decomposition reveals that consecutive fusion preserves the measurement-determined component while acting exclusively on the prior-driven null-space estimate. We thus provide a geometric interpretation of CPF-DDNM and a local error analysis that characterizes the optimal time-dependent fusion coefficient, including the extrapolative regime.
  Experiments on sparse-view and simulated low-dose computed tomography, as well as medical image super-resolution, show consistent improvements over DDNM and competitive performance against diffusion-based inverse solvers.

AI.tldr: 提出CPF-DDNM，一种在推理时融合连续测量感知估计的扩散后验采样策略，无需重训练或额外去噪评估，改善病态逆问题中不可观测结构的恢复。
AI.motivation: 严重病态成像逆问题需要恢复测量无法观测或弱约束的图像结构。扩散模型虽提供表达力强的学习先验，但标准扩散后验采样器仅依赖瞬时测量感知估计，未显式利用此前后验校正所携带的信息。
AI.method: 提出连续后验融合去噪扩散零空间模型（CPF-DDNM）：在推理阶段融合连续的测量感知估计以改善不可观测结构的扩散恢复，无需重训练或额外去噪器评估。将其实例化于DDNM框架，借助值域/零空间分解，证明连续融合保持测量决定分量不变，仅作用于先验驱动的零空间估计；并给出几何解释与局部误差分析，刻画最优时间相关融合系数（含外推区域）。
AI.result: 在稀疏视角CT、模拟低剂量CT及医学图像超分辨率实验中，相较DDNM取得一致提升，并与基于扩散的逆问题求解器性能相当。
AI.conclusion: 连续后验融合为扩散后验采样提供了一种无需额外计算开销的有效改进机制，具有几何与误差理论支撑，在多种严重病态医学成像任务中验证有效。

title: PsyEvo: A Personalized Counseling Agent That Self-Evolves at Test Time
summary: Mental health disorders affect a substantial proportion of the global population, yet a persistent shortage of trained practitioners leaves the majority without adequate care. Large language model (LLM)-based counselors present a promising direction for delivering scalable conversational psychological support. Offline model training alone leaves limited room to adapt to individual clients or to learn from ongoing therapeutic interaction at test time. We introduce PsyEvo, an LLM-based counseling framework that enables both client-specific personalization and response-policy improvement at test time through three components: Hierarchical Bayesian Skill Policy (HBSP) personalizes what intervention to apply by maintaining a per-client skill posterior updated from session feedback; Inter-session Listwise Preference Optimization (LiPO) improves how the selected skill is expressed by updating a shared response adapter from cross-client preference evidence; and State-conditioned Ordinal Credit Assignment (SOCA) supplies candidate preferences and trajectory credit to the two components through consistency-checked comparisons and ordinal projection. In simulated-client evaluation with shared online cohort adaptation, PsyEvo obtains 7.684 Overall on PsychEval and exceeds every component variant in each of three matched runs. Removing individual components lowers mean overall score by 0.138--0.171 under the shared configuration, supporting conditional contributions within the complete scaffold. Our code is available at https://github.com/Lingxi-mental-health/PsyEvo

AI.tldr: PsyEvo是一个基于大语言模型的心理咨询框架，通过分层贝叶斯技能策略、会话间列表偏好优化和状态条件序数信用分配，在测试时实现来访者个性化与响应策略改进。
AI.motivation: 全球心理健康障碍患者众多，但受训从业者长期短缺，多数人无法获得充分照护。基于LLM的咨询师有望提供可扩展的对话式心理支持，然而仅靠离线模型训练难以适配个体来访者，也无法在测试时从持续的治疗互动中学习。
AI.method: PsyEvo包含三个组件：1）分层贝叶斯技能策略（HBSP），通过维护基于会话反馈更新的每位来访者技能后验，个性化干预技能的选择；2）会话间列表偏好优化（LiPO），利用跨来访者偏好证据更新共享响应适配器，改进所选技能的表达方式；3）状态条件序数信用分配（SOCA），通过一致性校验比较和序数投影，为前两个组件提供候选偏好与轨迹信用。
AI.result: 在共享在线队列自适应的模拟来访者评估中，PsyEvo在PsychEval上取得7.684的Overall分数，并在三次配对运行中均超过所有组件变体。在共享配置下，移除任一单个组件会使平均总分下降0.138–0.171，支持各组件在完整框架内的条件性贡献。
AI.conclusion: PsyEvo通过组件协同在测试时同时实现来访者级个性化与响应策略优化，消融结果验证了各组件在完整框架中的必要性，为可扩展的LLM心理咨询提供了可行路径。代码已开源。

title: Activation Sparsity with Weight Approximation for Faster LLM Decoding on Offloaded Weights
summary: Deploying LLMs on consumer-grade GPUs with insufficient memory to hold their weights can result in prohibitively slow inference, because decoding repeatedly transfers offloaded weights from system RAM or flash storage into GPU at much lower bandwidth than local GPU-memory access. Activation sparsity reduces these transfers by skipping weights associated with zero or near-zero activations. However, as more activation contributions are omitted, model quality eventually degrades rapidly, indicating that weights associated with small-magnitude activations collectively influence model quality sharply. In this work, we improve the trade-off between model quality and decoding performance when exploiting activation sparsity. Our key idea is to replace the binary choice of whether or not to read a weight with three options: fully retain it, approximate it using a compressed weight representation, or omit it entirely. SpAx skips weights associated with activations closest to zero, reads approximate weights for smaller-magnitude activations, and reads original weights for the largest-magnitude activations. Smaller-magnitude activations attenuate the errors introduced by approximate weights, while compressed weight representations require fewer bytes to be transferred. With weights offloaded to CPU memory, SpAx speeds up decoding by 3.86X on average (up to 5.57X) with 16-bit weights and 2.06X (up to 2.74X) with 4-bit weights, at a WikiText-2 perplexity increase of at most 10%. With weights offloaded to flash storage, the speedups are 3.31X on average (up to 4.81X) and 1.54X (up to 2.03X).

AI.tldr: SpAx通过将激活稀疏性中的二元权重读写决策扩展为"完全保留/压缩近似/完全省略"三种选项，在保持模型质量的同时显著加速权重卸载场景下的LLM解码。
AI.motivation: 消费级GPU显存不足以容纳LLM权重时，解码需反复从系统RAM或闪存向GPU传输被卸载的权重，带宽远低于GPU本地显存访问，导致推理极慢。激活稀疏性可跳过零或近零激活对应的权重以减少传输，但当省略的激活贡献过多时模型质量会急剧下降，说明小幅值激活对应的权重集体对模型质量影响显著，因此需要改善模型质量与解码性能之间的权衡。
AI.method: SpAx用三选项替代"是否读取权重"的二元选择：对最接近零的激活对应权重完全省略、对小幅值激活读取压缩表示的近似权重、对最大幅值激活读取原始权重。小幅值激活会衰减近似权重引入的误差，而压缩权重表示所需传输字节更少。
AI.result: 权重卸载到CPU内存时，16位权重解码平均加速3.86X（最高5.57X），4位权重平均加速2.06X（最高2.74X），WikiText-2困惑度增幅至多10%；权重卸载到闪存时，加速分别为平均3.31X（最高4.81X）和1.54X（最高2.03X）。
AI.conclusion: SpAx通过细粒度的三级权重处理策略改善了激活稀疏性下的质量-性能权衡，在不同权重精度和存储介质下均实现了显著解码加速且质量损失可控。

title: Moving Forward with Video Saliency: A New Dataset and Benchmark where Motion Matters
summary: Video saliency prediction is inherently harder to model than static image saliency due to the additional temporal dimension. Video saliency benchmarks rest on the premise that predicting gaze on video requires utilizing temporal activity distributed across frames. Prior work has challenged this, showing that static baselines recover a significant fraction of the explainable gaze information on LEDOV, a popular video saliency dataset, and that video saliency models fail in the same places as this static baseline. We verify that this diagnosis still stands: under a more capable gold standard than the original analysis, and an updated panel of recent architectures, the strongest temporal architecture in the panel still does not substantially improve over a fine-tuned static baseline. However, it remains unclear whether the marginal gain reflects limitations of current temporal architectures or a lack of temporal patterns in the benchmark itself. We introduce SalTempto, a video saliency benchmark with greater dynamism: 224 clips of highly dynamic content, sourced from the HACS-Segments dataset so that each clip contains an event together with its lead-up and aftermath, with gaze recordings from up to 16 subjects and a training split for adapting pretrained models. On SalTempto, the static baseline recovers only about 13\% of the headroom above the centerbias, against more than half on LEDOV. A fine-tuned temporal architecture shows a substantial gain in performance over the static baseline, indicating that it does capture meaningfully more temporal information, which LEDOV fails to measure. Yet, even this SoTA model still leaves nearly half of SalTempto's headroom unexplained, indicating room for improvement in video saliency modelling. Examination of SalTempto also lets us describe human tendencies that models miss. SalTempto link: https://huggingface.co/datasets/bethgelab/video_saliency.

AI.tldr: 论文指出现有视频显著性基准LEDOV过于静态，静态基线即可恢复过半可解释注视信息；为此提出高动态性基准SalTempto，静态基线仅恢复约13%余量，而微调后的时序模型显著超越静态基线，但仍留有近一半余量未被解释。
AI.motivation: 视频显著性建模因额外时间维度而被认为难于静态图像显著性，相关基准的前提是预测视频注视必须利用跨帧的时间活动信息。已有工作质疑该前提：静态基线在LEDOV上即可恢复相当比例的可解释注视信息，且视频模型与静态基线在相同位置失败。作者验证该诊断依然成立，但指出尚不清楚性能边际提升是源于当前时序架构能力不足，还是基准本身缺乏时间模式，因此需要一个更具动态性的基准来区分二者。
