AI.method: 1) 复现并加固原诊断：采用比原分析更强的gold standard，并使用更新的近期模型集合，检验最强时序架构相对微调静态基线是否仍无实质提升。2) 构建SalTempto基准：从HACS-Segments数据集选取224个高动态片段，每个片段含一个事件及其前因与后续；采集最多16名被试的注视数据，并提供训练划分以适配预训练模型。3) 在SalTempto上对比静态基线与微调时序架构的性能，并以centerbias余量（headroom）为度量分析可解释注视信息的占比。
AI.result: 在SalTempto上，静态基线仅恢复约13%的相对于centerbias的余量，而在LEDOV上超过一半。微调后的时序架构相对静态基线取得显著性能提升，说明其确实捕获了LEDOV未能度量的额外时间信息。但即使该SoTA模型仍留下近一半的SalTempto余量未被解释。此外，对SalTempto的分析揭示了若干模型未能刻画的人类注视倾向。
AI.conclusion: LEDOV等现有视频显著性基准因动态性不足而无法有效度量时序信息，SalTempto通过高动态内容与事件结构解决了这一测量问题。结果表明当前最强时序模型虽能利用真实时间信息，但仍远未充分解释人类注视，视频显著性建模存在明显提升空间；同时SalTempto可揭示模型遗漏的人类注视行为。

title: Interpreting at Write Time: A Policy Ablation for Multi-Goal Agent Memory
comment: Accepted to PALM workshop at NeurIPS 2026
summary: A long-running assistant cannot keep everything it has seen, so it summarises. Summarising is not neutral: what is kept is chosen against some notion of what the record is for, and that choice is made once, before anyone knows which of the user's standing goals will ask. Goals rarely disagree about what happened. They disagree about which parts of it were worth the space. Once the history is too long to re-read, the summary replaces the stream, and whatever it left out is gone. We ask what a memory should summarise for when it serves several standing goals at once. Three policies answer differently: summarise with no goal in view, write one summary covering every goal, or write one summary per goal and read them together. We compare them across several models and event streams, holding the read step fixed so that only the write differs. The goals do pull apart: summaries written for different goals overlap each other less than a summary overlaps a rewrite of itself. Per-goal summaries win on relevance, completeness and accuracy, and the all-goal summary loses even to the neutral one written at a fraction of its budget. Interpreting at write pays off, but only for the goal that later asks.

AI.tldr: 本文研究当记忆需同时服务多个长期目标时应如何摘要。比较三种写作策略：无目标摘要、覆盖全部目标的单一摘要、以及每个目标各写一份摘要并联合读取（读取步骤固定，仅写作不同）。结果发现不同目标的摘要彼此差异显著，按目标分别摘要的做法在相关性、完整性与准确性上均最优，而覆盖式全目标摘要甚至不如预算仅为其一部分的中性摘要。
AI.motivation: 长期运行的助手无法保留全部历史记录，必须进行摘要。而摘要是非中性的：保留什么取决于对"这份记录用途"的预设，且该选择在写作时一次性做出，此时尚不知用户哪个长期目标会用到。目标之间少有对"发生了什么"的分歧，分歧在于"哪些部分值得占用空间"。一旦历史过长无法重读，摘要即取代原始流，被舍弃的内容便永久丢失。因此需要研究记忆在服务多个长期目标时应以何为摘要对象。
AI.method: 提出并比较三种写作策略：（1）不带任何目标视角的摘要；（2）写一份覆盖所有目标的单一摘要；（3）为每个目标各写一份摘要并联合读取。在多个模型与事件流上进行实验，固定读取步骤，使差异仅来自写作环节。
AI.result: 目标确实会使摘要分化：为不同目标所写的摘要之间的重叠度，低于一份摘要与其自身重写版本之间的重叠度。按目标分别摘要的策略在相关性、完整性和准确性三项指标上均胜出；覆盖式全目标摘要即使在数倍预算下，也仍不如中性摘要。写作阶段的"解读"确有收益，但仅对后来提出需求的那个目标有效。
AI.conclusion: 记忆摘要应面向具体目标写作，而非追求单一通用摘要。为多目标写一份大而全的摘要收益低下，按目标拆分摘要更优。写作时的目标解读带来收益，但该收益具有目标特异性，只惠及真正提出需求的对应目标。

title: Seer: Maximum Likelihood Regression for Learning-Speed Curves
comment: 104 pages. Ph.D. dissertation, Department of Computer Science, University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign, 1995. Original dissertation deposited in arXiv in 2026
summary:
The research presented here focuses on modeling machine-learning performance. The thesis introduces Seer, a system that generates empirical observations of classification-learning performance and then uses those observations to create statistical models. The models can be used to predict the number of training examples needed to achieve a desired level and the maximum accuracy possible given an unlimited number of training examples. Seer advances the state of the art with 1) models that embody the best constraints for classification learning and most useful parameters, 2) algorithms that efficiently find maximum-likelihood models, and 3) a demonstration on real-world data from three domains of a practicable application of such modeling.
  The first part of the thesis gives an overview of the requirements for a good maximum-likelihood model of classification-learning performance. Next, reasonable design choices for such models are explored. Selection among such models is a task of nonlinear programming, but by exploiting appropriate problem constraints, the task is reduced to a nonlinear regression task that can be solved with an efficient iterative algorithm. The latter part of the thesis describes almost 100 experiments in the domains of soybean disease, heart disease, and audiological problems. The tests show that Seer is excellent at characterizing learning-performance and that it seems to be as good as possible at predicting learning performance. Finally, recommendations for choosing a regression model for a particular situation are made and directions for further research are identified.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 Seer 系统，通过经验观测并建立统计模型来刻画与预测分类学习性能，并在三个真实领域数据上验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 机器学习性能的建模具有重要价值，可用于预测达到目标精度所需的训练样本数，以及样本无限时的最大可达精度。论文旨在推进该方向的建模能力。
AI.method: Seer 首先生成分类学习性能的经验观测，再用其构建统计模型。模型设计上引入适用于分类学习的最佳约束与最有用参数；将模型选择这一非线性规划问题，借助问题约束简化为可由高效迭代算法求解的非线性回归任务。
AI.result: 在大豆病害、心脏病和听力学三个领域开展近 100 项实验。结果表明 Seer 能很好地刻画学习性能，并在预测学习性能方面表现优异，接近最优。
AI.conclusion: Seer 在分类学习性能建模与预测上效果显著；论文最后给出针对具体情形选择回归模型的建议，并指出未来研究方向。

title: T3lescope: Arbitrary-Resolution High-Fidelity Generative Surface Reconstruction from Images
summary: We reconstruct high-fidelity 3D scene meshes from posed multi-view images without per-scene optimization, across scales ranging from single objects to large outdoor scenes. Per-scene optimization methods lack the learned 3D prior needed when observations are sparse or surfaces are glossy or transparent. Existing generative methods leverage such priors to complete geometry in sparsely observed regions, but typically operate at a fixed resolution over a limited spatial extent, trading spatial coverage against detail. Reconstructing a large scene therefore often requires partitioning it into independently processed overlapping local regions, making it difficult to maintain global geometric consistency. To address these issues, we propose T3lescope, which applies a single fixed-resolution generator across scene scales in an inference-time coarse-to-fine cascade. A coarse level establishes the scene layout, and finer levels perturb and denoise geometry inherited from the coarser level within progressively finer spatial cells to recover surface detail. The model is trained on individual cells at multiple scales and shares its weights across all levels, so no hierarchy is fixed during training, and the number of levels, cell scales, and cell locations are determined at inference time. On indoor, outdoor, and city-scale scenes, T3lescope outperforms feed-forward and generative baselines, matches or surpasses per-scene optimization, and recovers fine structures as well as glossy and transparent surfaces. These results show that our method generalizes across diverse scenes, view counts, and image resolutions. Project page: https://pfnet-research.github.io/t3lescope/

AI.tldr: 提出 T3lescope，通过单一固定分辨率生成器在推理时级联式由粗到细重建跨尺度 3D 场景网格，无需逐场景优化，兼顾全局一致性与细节。
AI.motivation: 逐场景优化方法在观测稀疏或表面为光泽/透明材质时缺乏学到的 3D 先验；现有生成式方法虽有先验补全几何，但受限于固定分辨率和有限空间范围，需将大场景分块独立处理，难以维持全局几何一致性。
AI.method: T3lescope 采用单个固定分辨率生成器，在推理阶段执行由粗到细的级联：粗层级确定场景布局，细层级在逐步细化的空间单元内对继承自粗层级的几何进行扰动与去噪以恢复表面细节。模型在多尺度单元上训练并跨层级共享权重，训练时不固定层次结构，层数、单元尺度与位置均在推理时确定。
AI.result: 在室内、室外和城市级场景上，T3lescope 优于前馈与生成式基线，达到或超过逐场景优化方法，并能恢复精细结构及光泽、透明表面；在多种场景、视图数量和图像分辨率下展现良好泛化。
AI.conclusion: 跨尺度的推理时级联策略使单一生成器无需逐场景优化即可实现高保真 3D 场景网格重建，兼顾大范围覆盖与全局一致性。

title: LUMOS: Tracing Parametric Knowledge from Training Data to Behavioral Outputs in LLMs
summary: Current analyses of LLMs' parametric knowledge are largely output-centric, drawing conclusions about what a model knows without verifying what it was actually trained on. This leaves fundamental questions, such as whether a correct response reflects genuine generalization or rote memorization, grounded in speculation rather than evidence. To resolve these ambiguities, we introduce LUMOS, a diagnostic framework that traces knowledge along the causal chain from training-data exposure to behavioral output, leveraging OLMo 2 with its fully transparent training corpus. By grounding analysis in verified exposure, we reveal that models internally encode rare facts with high separability (84%) yet fail to express them behaviorally (54%), though this retrieval gap narrows with scale. Furthermore, when models are asked to self-reflect on their own answers, they perform reliably on trained content (83%) but drop to random-baseline levels (49%) on unseen content. This collapse persists even under chain-of-thought prompting, which inflates confidence signals rather than improving calibration. Collectively, these findings demonstrate that incorporating the training-data axis into LLM evaluation transforms speculative diagnoses into verifiable claims, and we advocate that this axis should be a standard component of knowledge assessment in LLMs.

AI.tldr: 提出LUMOS框架，基于OLMo 2的透明训练语料，沿"训练数据暴露→内部表征→行为输出"的因果链诊断LLM参数化知识，揭示模型对罕见事实存在"能编码却难表达"的检索鸿沟及自我反思失效现象。
AI.motivation: 现有对LLM参数化知识的分析多基于输出（output-centric），即仅从模型回答推断其"知道什么"，而未验证模型实际训练所用数据。这使得"正确回答究竟源于真正的泛化还是死记硬背"等根本问题只能停留在推测层面，缺乏证据支撑。作者希望将训练数据这一维度纳入评估，把思辨性诊断转化为可验证的结论。
AI.method: 提出LUMOS诊断框架，利用OLMo 2完全透明的训练语料，沿因果链追踪知识：从训练数据暴露（verified exposure）→模型内部编码→行为输出。通过受控的已验证暴露数据，对比模型对罕见事实的内部可分离性与其行为表达能力，并考察随模型规模扩大的变化；同时设置自我反思（self-reflection）与思维链（chain-of-thought）提示实验，比较模型在已训练内容与未见内容上的表现与校准。
AI.result: 模型内部对罕见事实具备高可分离性编码（84%），但行为层面仅能表达54%，存在明显的检索鸿沟（retrieval gap），且该鸿沟随模型规模增大而收窄。在自我反思任务中，模型对已训练内容表现可靠（83%），但在未见内容上降至随机基线水平（49%）；这一崩塌在思维链提示下依然存在，且思维链更多是放大了置信度信号，而非改善校准。
AI.conclusion: 将训练数据维度引入LLM评估，可将原本依赖推测的诊断转化为可验证的命题。作者主张该维度应成为LLM知识评估的标准组成部分，标志着从"输出中心"向"暴露中心"评估范式的转变。

title: Scale-Recursive Rectified Flows for Few-Step Precipitation Ensembles
summary: Fine-resolution precipitation estimates support flood risk assessment and water management, but coarse satellite products cannot resolve rainfall within each grid cell. Generative models address this ambiguity by producing ensembles of plausible high-resolution rainfall fields. Among these models, rectified flows generate samples by iteratively transforming random noise into rainfall fields. Reducing the number of sampling steps accelerates generation but can make ensemble members too similar, understating uncertainty. We propose a scale-recursive rectified flow that generates broad patterns before local details and guides sampling-step allocation by comparing ensemble variability with prediction error across spatial scales. Validation scores and rainfall power spectra constrain the allocation to avoid excessive amplification. In satellite-to-radar downscaling over the contiguous United States, our analysis identified broad rainfall patterns as the main source of insufficient ensemble variability under reduced sampling budgets. Allocating more steps to the coarse flow improved probabilistic accuracy and rain detection across training seeds at fixed architecture and computational cost. The proposed model also achieved better probabilistic accuracy with shorter sampling time than a nonrecursive flow using more steps.

AI.tldr: 提出尺度递归整流流模型，通过将采样步数按空间尺度分配（先粗后细），解决了减少采样步数导致集合成员相似、低估不确定性的问题，在卫星到雷达降尺度中提升概率精度与检测能力。
AI.motivation: 高分辨率降水估计对洪水风险评估和水资源管理至关重要，但粗分辨率卫星产品无法刻画网格内降水变率。生成模型可产生合理的高分辨率降水场集合以应对该不确定性，然而整流流等模型减少采样步数虽加速生成，却使集合成员过于相似、低估不确定性。作者旨在解决"加速采样与保持集合多样性"之间的矛盾。
AI.method: 提出尺度递归整流流（scale-recursive rectified flow）：先生成大尺度降水格局，再生成局部细节；通过比较各空间尺度上集合变异性与预测误差来指导采样步数分配；并利用验证评分与降水功率谱约束该分配，防止过度放大。
AI.result: 在覆盖美国本土的卫星到雷达降尺度任务中，分析发现大尺度降水格局是减少采样预算下集合变异性不足的主要来源。在固定架构与计算成本下，将更多采样步数分配给粗尺度流，提升了概率精度与降水检测能力（在多个训练随机种子下均成立）。同时，该模型以更短采样时间取得了优于使用更多步数的非递归流的概率精度。
AI.conclusion: 按空间尺度递归分配采样步数、并对粗尺度格局倾斜采样预算，可在不增加计算成本的前提下显著缓解整流流集合多样性不足的问题，兼顾生成效率与概率刻画质量，为降水降尺度提供有效方案。

title: A Fully Automatic Pipeline for 3D Dendrite Instance Segmentation in SBF-SEM
comment: Accepted at 2026 IEEE-EMBS Conference on Biomedical Engineering and Sciences (IECBES)
summary: Accurate three-dimensional (3D) reconstruction of individual dendrites in serial block-face scanning electron microscopy (SBF-SEM) is essential for quantifying structural plasticity in the brain, yet manual annotation at scale is infeasible. We present a fully automatic pipeline for 3D dendrite instance segmentation that unifies YOLOv6-guided Segment Anything Model (SAM) prompting on downsampled slices, iterative two-dimensional mask refinement, random forest 3D instance linking, and instance-aware high-resolution refinement using nnU-Net at native resolution into a single system requiring no manual prompting at inference. Applied to hippocampal CA1 SBF-SEM datasets from a control rat and a pilocarpine- induced epileptic rat, our pipeline reconstructs coherent, well- separated dendrites with high semantic accuracy (Dice 0.93 and 0.91) and strong instance-level performance on control tissue, while analysis of the more challenging epileptic tissue identifies instance recognition in dense regions as the principal remaining limitation. The high-resolution refinement stage recovers thin dendritic protrusions, providing a basis for downstream spine- level analysis. Code is available at https://github.com/ ZE-WEN/dendrite-3d-instance-seg.

AI.tldr: 提出一套全自动3D树突实例分割流水线，整合YOLOv6引导SAM提示、迭代2D掩膜精修、随机森林3D实例连接与nnU-Net高分辨率精修，无需推理阶段人工提示，在CA1 SBF-SEM数据上实现高精度重建。
AI.motivation: SBF-SEM中单个树突的精确3D重建对量化脑结构可塑性至关重要，但大规模人工标注不可行，因此需要全自动的3D树突实例分割方法。
AI.method: 流水线包含四个环节：在降采样切片上以YOLOv6引导SAM提示；迭代式二维掩膜精修；基于随机森林的3D实例连接；以及利用nnU-Net在原始分辨率下进行实例感知的高分辨率精修。整个系统在推理阶段无需人工提示。
AI.result: 在对照大鼠与匹罗卡品诱导癫痫大鼠的海马CA1 SBF-SEM数据上，重建出连贯且分离良好的树突，语义精度较高（Dice 0.93与0.91），对照组织实例级表现良好；较困难的癫痫组织中，密集区域的实例识别是主要剩余局限。高分辨率精修阶段可恢复纤细树突突起，为后续树突棘水平分析奠定基础。
AI.conclusion: 该全自动流水线可实现高通量、高精度的3D树突实例分割，在正常组织上表现优异，并支持下游树突棘分析；密集区域的实例识别是未来需重点改进的方向。代码已开源。

title: Frequency Is Not Sensitivity Identifying Safety-Sensitive Experts in Sparse MoE LLM
summary: Suppressing a small set of routed experts can weaken the safety behavior of a sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language model without retraining. Which experts to suppress is therefore a security question, and the usual answer is activation frequency, but frequency measures use, not influence. We test an alternative: router-gradient sensitivity, the sensitivity of the sequence loss to the gate weights that select an expert. Across five MoE architectures, we rank experts by each signal on 500 benign and 500 malicious prompts and measure refusal on 100 held-out malicious prompts under two budgets: equal expert counts and equal nominal malicious routing traffic (1%-5%). Under each of the two budgets, router-gradient selection reduces refusals more than activation in 24 of 25 conditions, and more than a ten-trial random mean in all 25. The largest effect is in OLMoE, where refusals fall from 34 to 9 of 100 prompts (73.53% relative) with no degraded outputs, indicating substantive compliance rather than broken generation. After matching expert counts in every layer, gradient selection still produces greater refusal reduction than activation in 23 of 25 conditions, with two ties. An exploratory cross-model analysis links larger malicious-versus-benign concentration gaps to greater peak gradient effects (rho = 0.90; exact two-sided p = 0.083, n = 5). Together, the results support gradient selection under the tested budgets.

AI.tldr: 在两类预算下，路由梯度敏感度比激活频率更能削弱MoE模型的安全行为，OLMoE中拒绝率从34/100降至9/100，表明其为实质性顺从。
AI.motivation: 削弱稀疏MoE语言模型安全行为的关键在于选择哪些专家进行抑制，而通常依据激活频率，但频率衡量的是使用程度而非影响程度，因此需要更有效的专家影响力度量。
AI.method: 提出路由梯度敏感度，即序列损失对选择专家的门控权重的敏感度。在五种MoE架构、500条良性提示与500条恶意提示上分别按两种信号对专家排序，并在100条留出恶意提示上测量拒绝率，采用两类预算：等专家数量与等名义恶意路由流量（1%-5%）。
AI.result: 在两类预算下，梯度选择在25种条件中有24种比激活选择更大幅降低拒绝率，并在全部25种条件下超过十次随机试验均值。最大效应出现在OLMoE，拒绝率从34/100降至9/100（相对降低73.53%），且无输出退化。逐层匹配专家数量后，梯度选择仍在25种条件中的23种优于激活（2种持平）。探索性跨模型分析显示，恶意-良性集中度差距越大，峰值梯度效应越强（rho=0.90；双侧精确p=0.083，n=5）。
AI.conclusion: 在所测试的预算下，路由梯度敏感度作为专家选择依据优于激活频率，能够更有效降低安全拒绝且不破坏生成质量。

title: What Is Lost in Post-Training? Default Collapse and the Loss of In-Context Steerability Across Diverse Perspectives
summary: AI models serving a heterogeneous population must act on the principles appropriate to each user and context. While post-training has been shown to narrow the views large language models express, prior work has focused on default behavior rather than the ability to adapt to in-context information. We show that post-training also degrades a model's ability to be steered in-context toward perspectives it was not trained to favor. In controlled experiments, we fine-tune models toward one side of cultural-value disagreements and evaluate checkpoints throughout training. The trained side becomes increasingly dominant in ordinary use, while the ability to recognize and faithfully enact the opposing view declines. These findings point to a tension between prioritizing a single set of values and preserving the technical capacity needed to serve diverse stakeholders. Finally, we propose and analyze an alternative objective that maximizes reward subject to a prescribed distribution over expressed perspectives, and present stance-distribution matching as a practical implementation.

AI.tldr: 后训练在塑造大模型默认立场的同时，会削弱其在上下文内被引导至未受训练偏好视角的能力，揭示了单一价值对齐与多元服务能力之间的张力，并提出"立场分布匹配"作为替代目标。
AI.motivation: AI模型需服务异质人群，应按用户与情境采取恰当原则。既有研究多关注后训练对模型默认表达立场的收窄，却忽视其对上下文适应能力的影响。作者希望检验后训练是否会损害模型依据上下文信息被引导至其他视角的技术能力。
AI.method: 在受控实验中，针对文化价值分歧的某一侧对模型进行微调，并在训练全过程中评估各检查点；观察默认行为与被引导行为的演变。此外，提出一个替代目标：在给定表达视角分布约束下最大化奖励，并给出"立场分布匹配"作为具体实现。
AI.result: 随训练推进，被训练的立场在日常使用中日益占据主导；同时模型识别并忠实执行对立视角的能力持续下降。这表明后训练在强化单一价值的同时牺牲了上下文可引导性。
AI.conclusion: 优先固化单一价值体系与保留服务多元利益相关者所需的技术能力之间存在张力。作者建议采用以规定视角分布为约束的奖励最大化目标，并用立场分布匹配加以实现，以兼顾对齐与服务多样性。

title: LAS-CLIP: A Lightweight Adapter Steering Approach for CLIP's Visual Encoder
summary: CLIP's visual encoder produces only global image representations, limiting its use in region-level tasks. Existing adaptations rely on visual prompting, input masking, or encoder fine-tuning, each compromising pre-trained representations. We propose LAS-CLIP, a Lightweight Adapter Steering approach that keeps every CLIP parameter frozen. A compact MaskAdapter generates per-head, per-layer attention biases from an input mask and injects them into the frozen self-attention layers, steering attention toward the target region. Crucially, because the backbone remains strictly untouched, LAS-CLIP seamlessly reverts to vanilla CLIP when no mask is provided, preserving its foundational zero-shot capabilities. With approximately 116K to 145K trainable parameters and 100K training samples on two T4 GPUs, LAS-CLIP achieves competitive or superior results compared to Alpha-CLIP on ImageNet-S zero-shot classification and RefCOCO referring expression comprehension, despite the latter fine-tuning its entire encoder on millions of samples. Qualitative analysis further confirms stronger representational fidelity under incorrect masks and in downstream generation. Our project page is link to https://github.com/AnhKhoa585/lasclip

AI.tldr: LAS-CLIP 提出一种轻量级适配器引导方法，在冻结全部 CLIP 参数的前提下，通过 MaskAdapter 生成逐头逐层注意力偏置并注入自注意力层，实现对目标区域的注意力引导，兼顾区域级任务性能与零样本能力保持。
AI.motivation: CLIP 视觉编码器仅输出全局图像表示，难以用于区域级任务；现有适配方式（视觉提示、输入掩码、编码器微调）均会损害预训练表示，且微调成本高。
AI.method: 提出 LAS-CLIP：保持 CLIP 全部参数冻结。由紧凑的 MaskAdapter 根据输入掩码生成逐头（per-head）、逐层（per-layer）的注意力偏置，注入冻结的自注意力层，将注意力引导至目标区域；无掩码时可无缝退回原版 CLIP。
AI.result: 仅约 116K–145K 可训练参数、10 万训练样本、两张 T4 GPU，在 ImageNet-S 零样本分类与 RefCOCO 指代表达理解上取得与 Alpha-CLIP 相当或更优的结果；后者需在数百万样本上微调整个编码器。定性分析显示在错误掩码与下游生成中表示保真度更强。
AI.conclusion: 通过注意力偏置注入的轻量适配器可在完全不改动 CLIP 主干的情况下实现区域级能力，成本极低且保留零样本泛化，是区域级视觉-语言任务的高效替代方案。

title: HASTE: Evolving Agent Harnesses Against Emerging Attacks Using Sparse Evidence
summary: Agent harnesses play a critical role in defenses by enforcing safety constraints to prevent unsafe actions. However, rapidly emerging attacks outpace manual harness adaptation, motivating automated harness evolution. Yet the signals available for harness evolution are often sparse, such as brief descriptions or a few attack examples in threat reports and preprints. To address this limitation, we introduce HASTE, a multi-agent framework that evolves agent harnesses from sparse threat evidence through an adversarial interplay between safety-specification generation and attack-case generation. Safety specifications guide harness updates toward addressing identified safety vulnerabilities, while attack cases probe for remaining safety vulnerabilities after each update. By feeding evaluation outcomes back into both processes, HASTE enables harness evolution against emerging attacks beyond the initially observed evidence. Experimental results across multiple backbone models, attack types, and evidence forms show that HASTE consistently reduces attack success rates while preserving benign-task utility. The code is available at https://github.com/xxiqiao/HASTE.

AI.tldr: HASTE：一种多智能体框架，通过安全规范生成与攻击用例生成之间的对抗性交互，从稀疏威胁证据中演化智能体防护壳（agent harness）。
AI.motivation: 智能体防护壳通过强制安全约束来阻止不安全行为，是防御的关键。但攻击快速涌现，人工适配防护壳已跟不上节奏，因此需要自动化演化。然而可用于演化的信号往往很稀疏，例如威胁报告与预印本中仅有简短描述或少量攻击样例，这限制了自动化演化的效果。
AI.method: HASTE 是一个多智能体框架，核心是安全规范生成与攻击用例生成之间的对抗性交互。安全规范引导防护壳更新以修补已识别的安全脆弱点；攻击用例则在每次更新后探测仍存在的安全脆弱点。两者的评估结果被反馈回这两个过程，从而推动防护壳针对涌现攻击持续演化，并超越最初观察到的证据范围。
AI.result: 在多种骨干模型、攻击类型和证据形式上的实验表明，HASTE 在保持良性任务效用的同时，一致地降低了攻击成功率。
AI.conclusion: HASTE 能够利用稀疏威胁证据实现防护壳的自动化演化，在维持正常任务可用性的前提下提升安全性，为应对快速演变的攻击提供了一种可行路径。

title: Quantifying the Value of Constructive Induction, Knowledge, and Noise Filtering on Inductive Learning
comment: 12 pages, including a modern cover note and the unchanged 11-page author manuscript from 1991. Extended author version of a paper published in Machine Learning Proceedings 1991 (ICML 1991), pp. 153-157. Deposited in arXiv in 2026
summary: Learning research, as one of its central goals, tries to measure, model, and understand how learning-problem properties affect average-case learning performance. For example, we would like to quantify the value of constructive induction, noise filtering, and background knowledge. This paper describes the effective dimension, a new learning measure that helps link problem properties to learning performance. Like the Vapnik-Chervonenkis (VC) dimension, the effective dimension is often in a simple linear relation with problem properties. Unlike the VC dimension, the effective dimension can be estimated empirically and makes average-case predictions. It is therefore more widely applicable to machine and human learning research. The measure is demonstrated on several learning systems including Backpropagation. Finally, the measure is used to precisely predict the benefit of using FRINGE, a feature construction system. The benefit is found to decrease as the complexity of the target concept increases.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"有效维度"这一新的学习度量，用于连接问题属性与平均情况下的学习性能，可经验估计并做平均情况预测，并在多个学习系统（含反向传播）上验证，最后用它精确预测了特征构造系统FRINGE的收益。
AI.motivation: 学习研究的核心目标之一是衡量、建模并理解学习问题属性如何影响平均情况下的学习性能，例如量化构造性归纳、噪声过滤与背景知识的价值。VC维度等现有度量虽与问题属性呈线性关系，但难以经验估计、也无法给出平均情况预测，因此在机器学习和人类学习研究中适用性受限。
AI.method: 提出"有效维度"（effective dimension）这一新的学习度量。它与VC维度类似，常与问题属性呈简单线性关系；但不同的是，有效维度可以经验性地估计，并能给出平均情况下的预测，从而更广泛地适用于机器与人类学习研究。
AI.result: 在若干学习系统（包括反向传播）上对有效维度进行了验证。此外，用该度量精确预测了使用特征构造系统FRINGE所带来的收益，并发现该收益随目标概念复杂度的增加而下降。
AI.conclusion: 有效维度是一种可经验估计、能进行平均情况预测的学习度量，比VC维度适用性更广，可用于量化问题属性对学习性能的影响，并能为特征构造等方法的收益提供精确预测。

title: How to Find and Reuse Policies for Continuous Adaptation in Lifelong Reinforcement Learning
summary: In lifelong reinforcement learning, retaining previously learned policies is not sufficient for effective transfer to a new task. Useful knowledge may be distributed across several prior policies, and its relevance may change as the learner acquires experience. One hypothesis is that task similarity can be effectively used in a continual learning setting to find and combine previously learned policies. To test it, Adaptive Mask Selection and Composition (AMSC) is designed to estimate similarity from online experience via non-parametric Wasserstein task embeddings from state-action-reward samples. The z-score-normalized sparsemax of the similarity scores are used to derive a variable-size support to periodically choose and weight policies to form a prior when learning a new task. On CT-graph and MiniGrid, AMSC achieves higher mean performance and forward transfer than the evaluated modular composition baselines while exhibiting no forgetting. Results on Continual World suggest that identifying relevant prior knowledge and determining its layer-specific composition may require additional layer-specific tuning. Ablations show that selecting relevant sources and determining how strongly to reuse them are central to these gains. Independently measured pairwise transfer is also positively associated with task-embedding similarity. These results indicate that task similarity can be an effective criterion to select and weight specific knowledge for reuse in lifelong reinforcement learning.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 Adaptive Mask Selection and Composition (AMSC) 方法，利用在线经验估计任务相似度，以选择并组合先前策略来促进终身强化学习中的知识迁移。
AI.motivation: 在终身强化学习中，仅保留先前策略不足以有效迁移到新任务。有用知识可能分布在多个先前的策略中，其相关性也随学习经验而变化。作者假设任务相似度可用于持续学习场景，以发现并组合先前学习的策略。
AI.method: 提出 AMSC：基于状态-动作-奖励样本，通过非参数 Wasserstein 任务嵌入从在线经验中估计相似度；对相似度分数进行 z-score 归一化后使用 sparsemax，得到可变大小的支撑集，以此周期性选择并加权策略，形成学习新任务时的先验。
AI.result: 在 CT-graph 和 MiniGrid 上，AMSC 取得了比所评估的模块化组合基线更高的平均性能和前向迁移，且无遗忘。在 Continual World 上的结果表明，识别相关先验知识及其层特定组合可能需要额外的层特定调优。消融实验显示，选择相关来源与确定复用强度是性能提升的关键。独立测量的成对迁移与任务嵌入相似度呈正相关。
AI.conclusion: 任务相似度可作为终身强化学习中筛选与加权特定知识以促进复用的有效准则。

title: EVEWorld: Physical Evolution Supervision for Embodied World Models
summary: Embodied world models enable scalable simulation of embodied interactions for robot learning. However, existing models are prone to Model Laziness, as they focus on visual fidelity at the expense of physical reasoning and lack process-level supervision over the temporal dynamics of manipulated objects. In this work, we propose EVEWorld, a physical evolution-supervision framework for physically consistent target evolution. EVEWorld consists of two components: Instance-Guided Restoration (IGR) and Temporal Instance Alignment (TIA). First, IGR promotes instance consistency through restoration supervision. Second, TIA promotes cross-frame consistency by aligning target instances across adjacent frames. We further introduce the Model Laziness Rate (MLR), a metric that measures persistent violations of instance consistency in generated trajectories. Extensive experiments on DreamGenBench, EWMBench, and PBench demonstrate the effectiveness of EVEWorld, notably achieving an 87.5% reduction in MLR compared with GigaWorld-0. On the WorldArena 2.0 Track 1 leaderboard, our model ranks 6th in JEPA Similarity and 17th overall, which further validates the performance of our evolution supervision strategy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EVEWorld，一个物理演化监督框架，通过实例引导修复（IGR）与时序实例对齐（TIA）提升具身世界模型的物理一致性与跨帧一致性，并提出模型惰性率（MLR）指标，实验证明其有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有具身世界模型存在"模型惰性"问题：过度关注视觉保真度而忽视物理推理，且缺乏对被操作物体时序动态的过程级监督，导致生成的轨迹中实例一致性被持续破坏。
AI.method: EVEWorld包含两个组件：（1）实例引导修复（IGR），通过修复监督提升实例一致性；（2）时序实例对齐（TIA），通过相邻帧间目标实例对齐提升跨帧一致性。此外引入模型惰性率（MLR）指标，用于量化生成轨迹中持续违反实例一致性的程度。
AI.result: 在DreamGenBench、EWMBench与PBench上的大量实验验证了EVEWorld的有效性，相比GigaWorld-0将MLR降低87.5%。在WorldArena 2.0 Track 1排行榜上，JEPA相似度排名第6，综合排名第17。
AI.conclusion: 演化监督策略能够有效缓解模型惰性问题，显著提升具身世界模型的物理一致性与时序实例一致性，为机器人学习的可扩展仿真提供更可靠的方案。

title: Positive-Unlabeled Learning for Agent Safety False Alarm Auditing
summary: Safety monitors help safeguard language-model agents interacting with external tools and environments, but conservative monitoring can generate many false alarms, consuming extensive review resources and weakening trust in alerts. Because false and genuine alarms often remain interleaved in native monitor scores, obtaining a reliable cutoff still requires substantial manual verification. In practice, a small set of verified-safe non-alarmed trajectories may be available while alarms remain unlabeled, naturally casting false-alarm auditing as a positive-unlabeled (PU) ranking problem. The key challenge is monitor-induced selection, since observed safe references are accepted by the monitor, while the hidden safe alarms of interest are precisely those it incorrectly flags, making the observed positives poorly representative of the positives to be recovered. To address this challenge, we propose a two-stage framework in which Trust-aware PU Supervision adapts safe references toward the alarm domain and protects plausible false alarms from excessive negative pressure, while Reliability-gated Rank Distillation consolidates consistent ordering preferences from multiple PU reference models into a single student. Consensus-guided Structural Refinement then improves the student ranking using hierarchical safe-reference support, alarm relations, and predicted reference consensus. The framework requires no alarm safety labels for fitting and leaves the underlying monitor unchanged. Across mainstream safety monitors, our method achieves a macro AUPRC of $0.6444$, outperforming eight evaluated PU baselines by 5.27--16.98 absolute percentage points; compared with PULDA, the strongest evaluated PU baseline, it recovers 33.3% more false alarms at a 5% review budget.

AI.tldr: 提出两阶段PU排序框架审计安全监控器的误报，无需报警安全标签，在多款监控器上宏AUPRC达0.6444，优于八个PU基线5.27–16.98个百分点。
AI.motivation: 安全监控器保守告警产生大量误报，消耗审查资源并削弱告警可信度；原生监控分数中误报与真报交织，确定可靠阈值仍需大量人工核验。实践中仅有少量已验证安全的未告警轨迹，而告警本身无标签，因此误报审计天然可建模为PU排序问题。
AI.method: 核心挑战是监控器诱导的选择偏差：观测到的安全参考是被监控器接受的样本，而待恢复的隐藏安全告警恰是被其错误标记者，导致观测正例代表性不足。提出两阶段框架：1）Trust-aware PU Supervision，将安全参考向告警域对齐，并保护疑似误报免受过强负向压力；2）Reliability-gated Rank Distillation，将多个PU参考模型的一致排序偏好蒸馏到单一学生模型；随后Consensus-guided Structural Refinement利用层级安全参考支持、告警关系与预测参考共识优化学生排序。该框架拟合时无需告警安全标签，且不改变底层监控器。
AI.result: 在主流安全监控器上，方法宏AUPRC达0.6444，比评估的八个PU基线高5.27–16.98个绝对百分点；与最强PU基线PULDA相比，在5%审查预算下多恢复33.3%的误报。
AI.conclusion: 将误报审计形式化为受选择偏差影响的PU排序问题，并通过可信PU监督、可靠性门控排序蒸馏与共识引导结构精炼予以解决，在不改动监控器、不依赖告警安全标签的前提下显著提升误报发现效率与审查性价比。

title: Online Verification of Language Model Responses Under Cost Constraints
summary: As large language models are increasingly deployed for multi-step reasoning, verifying the correctness of their outputs has become essential for maintaining reliability at scale. Verifying the correctness of large language model outputs is often done by querying a costly ground-truth oracle, which is impractical to invoke at every step in an online setting. Prior work addresses this by querying a single weak verifier on every step, and using its score to decide whether the costly strong verifier needs to be queried as well, reserving strong verification for only a small fraction of the steps. However, a single fixed weak verifier may not perform consistently well as the subject matter or difficulty of incoming queries changes over time, and committing to one in advance risks either overly costly or inaccurate verification. We introduce OMVV (Online Multi-Verifier Verification), an algorithm that maintains a pool of $K$ candidate weak verifiers with differing cost and verification performance, and adaptively routes each round's decision to a verifier selected via an online score combiner and an exponential-weights routing policy. OMVV provides a distribution-free, finite-time guarantee on false-accept and false-reject rates across the full pool of verifiers, and further achieves sublinear regret against the best fixed verifier in hindsight under a combined cost and consistency objective. Experiments on reasoning dataset benchmarks show that OMVV achieves higher accuracy at lower verification cost than any single fixed verifier, across a range of operating budgets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 OMVV（Online Multi-Verifier Verification），一种在线多验证器选择算法：维护 K 个成本与性能各异的弱验证器池，通过在线分数组合器与指数权重路由策略自适应地为每轮决策选择验证器，从而在降低强验证调用成本的同时保证验证准确性。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型多步推理的在线场景下，逐步骤调用昂贵的强（ground-truth）验证器不切实际。已有工作仅在每步查询单个固定弱验证器，并依据其得分决定是否调用强验证器。但单一固定弱验证器难以在问题主题或难度随时间变化时保持稳定表现，事先选定一个验证器会面临成本过高或验证不准的风险。
AI.method: OMVV 维护一个包含 K 个候选弱验证器的池，各验证器在成本与验证性能上存在差异；每轮通过在线分数组合器（online score combiner）与指数权重（exponential-weights）路由策略，自适应地将决策分配给选中的验证器，并据此判断是否需要额外调用昂贵的强验证器。
AI.result: OMVV 在全部验证器池上提供无分布假设的、有限时间的假接受率与假拒绝率保证；在成本与一致性联合目标下，相对于事后最优的固定验证器实现次线性遗憾（sublinear regret）。在推理数据集基准上的实验表明，在多种运行预算下，OMVV 相比任何单一固定验证器都能以更低的验证成本取得更高的准确率。
AI.conclusion: OMVV 通过在线自适应地在多个弱验证器间路由，兼顾了验证准确性与成本效率，在理论上具备假接受/假拒绝的有限时间保证与次线性遗憾界，在实验中优于任何单一固定验证器，是一种适用于多步推理输出验证的实用方案。

title: Interpretable Deepfake Detection in Videos via Explicit Forensic Features and Temporal Modeling
summary: Deepfake detection in videos remains challenging, as manipulated content may appear visually consistent at the frame level while exhibiting subtle temporal inconsistencies. This paper introduces an interpretable deepfake detection framework that models spatially and temporally coherent facial features in video sequences. Unlike end-to-end deep models relying on implicit representations, the proposed approach explicitly encodes physically grounded forensic cues, enabling transparent analysis and improved multi-dataset generalization. The pipeline transforms videos into identity-consistent facial trajectories, segments them into fixed-length temporal windows, and represents each frame using 68 structured descriptors spanning four complementary domains: photometric, textural, geometric, and compression-based features. These descriptors provide a compact multi-domain representation of manipulation artifacts and are processed by a Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) network to capture temporal dependencies and subtle irregularities. Evaluation on four benchmark datasets, FaceForensics++, Celeb-DF v2, a curated subset of the DeepFake Detection Challenge (DFDC), and DeeperForensics, yields strong and consistent F1-scores of 98.0%, 91.0%, 97.6%, and 96.2%, respectively. The approach also demonstrated a good cross-dataset generalization, providing a robust and interpretable solution for video deepfake detection.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种可解释的视频深伪检测框架，显式建模时空一致的人脸取证特征，用LSTM捕捉时序依赖，在四个基准数据集上取得98.0%/91.0%/97.6%/96.2%的F1分数，并具备良好的跨数据集泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 视频深伪检测仍具挑战，因为篡改内容在帧级别可能视觉一致，却存在细微的时序不一致；端到端深度模型依赖隐式表示，缺乏透明性且泛化性有限。因此需要显式编码有物理依据的取证线索，以实现可解释分析与更好的多数据集泛化。
AI.method: 将视频转换为身份一致的人脸轨迹，切分为固定长度时序窗口；每帧用68个结构化描述子表示，涵盖光度、纹理、几何、压缩四个互补域；这些多域描述子输入LSTM网络以捕捉时序依赖和细微异常。
AI.result: 在FaceForensics++、Celeb-DF v2、DFDC精选子集、DeeperForensics四个基准数据集上，F1分数分别为98.0%、91.0%、97.6%、96.2%，并展现出良好的跨数据集泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为视频深伪检测提供了稳健且可解释的解决方案，通过显式的多域取证特征与LSTM时序建模，在保持高精度的同时提升了透明度和跨数据集泛化性。

title: When to Compile a Computer-Use Agent? Measuring Payback and Making Compilation Decisions for Token Efficiency
summary: Compiling GUI procedures that agents execute repeatedly into programs can reduce their token costs. However, measuring payback and deciding when to compile have two challenges. First, compilation costs are uncertain because attempts can require repair and still fail to produce a usable program. Second, future reuse is unknown because tasks may stop arriving or GUI drift may stop the program from working. To address these challenges, we propose PACE (Payback-Aware Compilation from Experience), a system with a measurement protocol and an online compilation algorithm. The measurement protocol records successful and failed compilation costs, and compares agent and program execution costs on matched task inputs to estimate per-use savings and payback counts. Using these measurements, the online algorithm compares estimated future savings with compilation costs, including failed attempts, based on past task arrivals and compilation outcomes. It checks execution and compilation charges against a cumulative budget determined by observed task arrivals before allowing either action. Under stated action-cost assumptions, total cost after each arrival is at most $1+ε$ times the cost of running every task with the agent. For successful compilation attempts, estimated payback counts excluding source agent runs are 2-16 uses. In simulations using recorded task arrivals, PACE reduces token costs by 17.3% compared with ReAct, 24.9% with the AutoRPA adaptation, and 17.3% with the ToolPro adaptation on average ($ε=0.25$).

AI.tldr: 提出 PACE 系统，通过测量协议与在线编译算法实现"回报感知"的 GUI 流程编译决策，在保证总成本不超过纯 Agent 执行 1+ε 倍的前提下降低 token 开销。
AI.motivation: Agent 重复执行 GUI 流程可编译为程序以降低 token 成本，但决定"何时编译"存在两大难点：编译成本不确定（可能需修复甚至失败），未来复用次数未知（任务可能不再到达，或 GUI 漂移导致程序失效）。
AI.method: PACE 含两部分：(1) 测量协议——记录成功与失败的编译成本，并在匹配的任务输入上对比 Agent 与程序执行成本，估计单次节省与回本次数；(2) 在线编译算法——结合历史任务到达与编译结果，比较估计的未来节省与编译成本（含失败尝试），在执行与编译支出前用累积预算校验，预算由观测到的任务到达决定。
AI.result: 在声明的动作成本假设下，每次任务到达后的总成本至多为全部用 Agent 执行成本的 1+ε 倍；成功编译的回本次数（不含源 Agent 运行）为 2–16 次；利用真实任务到达的模拟中，ε=0.25 时平均 token 成本较 ReAct 降低 17.3%，较 AutoRPA 适配降低 24.9%，较 ToolPro 适配降低 17.3%。
AI.conclusion: PACE 将编译成本不确定性与复用不确定性纳入统一测量与在线决策框架，在理论上给出 1+ε 的竞争比保证，并在实证上验证了显著的 token 成本节约。

title: Context-Tower Conversion Preserves Generation While Freezing Retains Knowledge: Low-Budget AR-to-Diffusion Conversion of MoE LLMs
summary: Converting a pretrained autoregressive (AR) model to a diffusion language model (dLLM) enables parallel generation without pretraining a new model. Published conversion methods differ by roughly three orders of magnitude in training data and have not been compared under a common protocol. We compare two conversions of the same 30B Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) parent, holding the corpus, supervised-token budget, trainable parameter set and evaluation harness fixed, each under its own training recipe. The in-place model updates a subset of the parent's weights using denoising and representation-alignment losses; the frozen-tower model instead conditions through cross-attention on a frozen causal copy of the parent. With 1B training tokens, the frozen-tower model scores 71.60 on HumanEval pass@10 against 6.19 for the in-place model, an 11.6x improvement. At the same budget it also keeps 95% of the parent's GSM8K score and 99% of its MMLU-Pro score. A dense-parent experiment reproduces the HumanEval separation. Within the two-tower design at about 500M tokens, freezing the context tower retains substantially more MMLU-Pro performance than training it, while both give similar observed HumanEval scores. Our theoretical analysis establishes that both conversion classes contain an exact sampler for the AR parent under a hard attention mask and left-to-right commitment of one position per round. Under a shared loss, freezing removes the gradient contribution through the context states. Furthermore, evaluation protocol substantially affects a published 500B-token conversion's scores in both directions across tasks, while its AR parent's scores vary by less than three points, so comparing dLLMs needs a common protocol. These results show that, in the tested low-budget regime, the frozen-tower configuration retains substantially more of the parent's generation performance than in-place conversion.

AI.tldr: 在统一协议下比较同一30B MoE父模型的两类扩散语言模型转换方法，发现冻结塔式转换在低预算下显著优于原位转换。
AI.motivation: 将预训练自回归(AR)模型转换为扩散语言模型(dLLM)可支持并行生成，无需重训新模型。但已有转换方法的训练数据量相差约三个数量级，且缺乏在统一协议下的对比，导致结论难以比较。
AI.method: 对同一30B MoE父模型进行两种转换并固定语料、监督token预算、可训练参数集和评测框架：(1)原位转换——用去噪和表征对齐损失更新父模型部分权重；(2)冻结塔转换——通过cross-attention对父模型的冻结因果副本进行条件化。另做dense父模型实验及两塔设计中冻结/训练context tower的对比，并给出理论分析。
AI.result: 在1B训练token下，冻结塔模型HumanEval pass@10为71.60，原位模型为6.19，提升11.6倍；同时保留父模型95%的GSM8K和99%的MMLU-Pro成绩。dense父模型实验复现了HumanEval差距。约500M token的两塔设计中，冻结context tower比训练它保留更多MMLU-Pro性能，HumanEval相近。理论证明两类转换在硬注意力掩码和每轮从左到右确定一个位置的条件下均包含AR父模型的精确采样器；共享损失下冻结会移除经context状态的梯度贡献。评测协议会显著影响已发表500B-token转换的分数，而其AR父模型分数变化小于3分。
AI.conclusion: 在测试的低预算条件下，冻结塔配置比原位转换保留显著更多父模型的生成性能；比较dLLM需要统一的评测协议。

title: Native Action-Prior Learning from Videos for World Action Models
summary: World action models integrate future visual dynamics with robot action prediction, but their scalability remains limited by the need for action-annotated robot trajectories. Observation-only videos contain rich evidence about interaction dynamics, but existing approaches typically use them either to pretrain visual representations that must later be adapted for control, or to infer latent actions that are subsequently grounded to robot commands. We present NAVA-WAM, which introduces native action-prior learning by directly pretraining the action policy from observation-only videos, avoiding indirect representation-to-control transfer or a separate latent-action model. Our training consists of two stages. First, we pretrain on observation-only videos, where future-video flow-matching supervision over visual transitions is propagated through transition-structured joint attention to optimize the Action-DiT and learn action-relevant priors. Second, we use action-labeled demonstrations to post-train the Action-DiT for robot control through joint video--action flow matching, while asymmetric attention decouples the visual branch from iterative action denoising and enables efficient action-only inference. Extensive experiments show that NAVA-WAM consistently outperforms prior approaches under both in-distribution and out-of-distribution settings, while demonstrating strong action-label efficiency and effective real-robot generalization. These results establish native action-prior learning as an effective approach to directly pretrain action policies from observation-only videos, providing a scalable path beyond action-labeled robot data.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 NAVA-WAM，通过"原生动作先验学习"直接从纯观察视频预训练动作策略，再以少量动作标注数据后训练，实现可扩展的世界动作模型。
AI.motivation: 现有世界动作模型依赖动作标注的机器人轨迹，可扩展性受限于数据获取成本。纯观察视频虽蕴含丰富的交互动力学信息，但现有方法要么只用其预训练视觉表征再适配控制，要么推断潜动作再与机器人指令对齐，均存在间接性缺陷。
AI.method: 两阶段训练：第一阶段在纯观察视频上，利用未来视频流匹配监督，通过转移结构化的联合注意力传播梯度以优化 Action-DiT，学习动作相关先验；第二阶段使用动作标注演示，通过视频-动作联合流匹配对 Action-DiT 进行机器人控制后训练，并采用非对称注意力解耦视觉分支与迭代动作去噪，实现高效的动作单模推理。
AI.result: 在分布内与分布外设置下均持续优于先前方法，并展现出较强的动作标签效率与有效的真实机器人泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 原生动作先验学习是一种从纯观察视频直接预训练动作策略的有效范式，为超越动作标注机器人数据提供了可扩展路径。

title: From Patching to Pruning Visual Computation in Vision Language Models
summary: Vision language models (VLMs) incur substantial inference cost because every visual token is processed by the attention and MLP projections of every decoder layer, even when token-specific visual computation is unnecessary at many depths. We introduce Patch-to-Prune (P2P), inspired by Mechanistic Interpretability, a training-free framework that converts activation patching from a diagnostic tool into an inference-time computation bypass. P2P performs validation-guided forward and backward layer sweeps to identify decoder regions whose visual-token projection outputs can be replaced by fixed neutral proxy activation vectors within a user-specified accuracy tolerance. Unlike conventional token-pruning methods, P2P preserves the sequence length, token order, positional information, attention mask, and residual pathways, thereby pruning computation without removing tokens or modifying the pretrained model weights. We evaluate P2P on four VLMs from the Qwen2.5-VL and LLaVA families across seven multi-modal benchmarks using mutually disjoint calibration, validation, and test partitions. P2P at a 3% tolerance retains around 94% of dense accuracy while reducing FLOPs by 55%. Beyond these efficiency gains, our layer-wise analysis suggests that visual processing in VLMs is non-uniformly distributed across decoder depth: early and late layers often require little token-specific visual computation, whereas intermediate layers appear to perform most task-relevant visual integration, enabling later reasoning to rely largely on visual information already embedded in shared residual and textual representations. This makes P2P both an efficient inference framework and a causal lens into visual information processing in VLMs.

AI.tldr: P2P是一个免训练框架，将机制可解释性中的激活替换技术转化为推理时的计算绕行，在不删除token、不改权重的前提下，用固定中性代理激活替换部分解码层视觉token投影输出，实现高效推理并揭示视觉处理的层级分布规律。
AI.motivation: VLM推理成本高：每个视觉token都要经过每一解码层的注意力和MLP投影，而许多深度上token专属的视觉计算其实并不必要，现有token剪枝方法会改变序列结构。
AI.method: 受机制可解释性启发，P2P执行验证引导的前向与反向层级扫描，识别在用户给定精度容差内、其视觉token投影输出可被固定中性代理激活向量替换的解码器区域；保留序列长度、token顺序、位置信息、注意力掩码与残差通路，仅绕行计算，不删除token也不修改预训练权重。
AI.result: 在Qwen2.5-VL与LLaVA四个VLM、七个多模态基准上，使用互不重叠的校准/验证/测试划分评估：3%容差下保留约94%稠密精度，FLOPs降低55%。层级分析显示视觉处理在解码深度上非均匀分布：早层与晚层几乎不需要token专属视觉计算，中间层承担主要任务相关视觉整合。
AI.conclusion: P2P既是高效推理框架，也是审视VLM视觉信息处理的因果工具；后期推理主要依赖已嵌入共享残差与文本表示中的视觉信息。

title: Continual Graph Memory for Mathematical Research Agents
summary: Using frontier agent harnesses to tackle mathematical research problems has emerged as an effective means of advancing mathematics. However, solving frontier problems in mathematics may require a massive number of agents working in parallel for extended periods to construct proofs, thereby generating an enormous volume of intermediate proof results. Organizing these intermediate results throughout a long-horizon proof-search process and reusing knowledge gained from prior explorations remain major challenges. We present Ansatz, a mathematical research agent built around Continual Graph Memory, a graph-based, evolvable, cross-problem mathematical research memory system that explicitly organizes the entire proof search process and reuses information from exploration trajectories of previous problems. Specifically, we develop a unified graph memory that represents all intermediate exploration results, including facts, plans, and counterexamples, together with edges that explicitly represent the relationships among them; dependency-aware retrieval supplies precisely targeted local context; an evidence-sensitive curator updates the research frontier and distills lessons from prior attempts; and scoped recall surfaces earlier statements and negative findings for local re-proving rather than uncritical reuse. Experiments cover runs across all ten First Proof Second Batch problems, together with four component studies. Ansatz reports closure on all ten research tasks, demonstrating its ability to sustain and resume long-horizon mathematical search. Beyond these problems, Ansatz also produces solutions to the Jamison caterpillar conjecture and Erdős Problems 289, 348, and 488 without human intervention, and makes partial progress on several open problems, illustrating its strong ability to solve open mathematical research problems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Ansatz——一个以"持续图记忆"（Continual Graph Memory）为核心的数学研究智能体，通过图结构化的可演化跨问题记忆系统组织长程证明搜索过程并复用既有探索知识，在十个 First Proof Second Batch 问题、Jamison caterpillar 猜想及多个 Erdős 问题上取得全封闭求解或无人工干预的解答。
AI.motivation: 前沿数学研究问题往往需要大量智能体长时间并行协作以构造证明，由此产生海量中间证明结果。如何在整个长程证明搜索过程中有效组织这些中间结果，并复用先前探索所得的知识，仍是主要挑战。现有方法缺乏对证明搜索全过程的显式组织与跨问题知识复用机制。
AI.method: 核心为持续图记忆（Continual Graph Memory）：(1) 统一图记忆，表示所有中间探索结果（事实、计划、反例），并以边显式刻画其间关系；(2) 依赖感知检索（dependency-aware retrieval），提供精准定位的局部上下文；(3) 证据敏感管理器（evidence-sensitive curator），更新研究前沿并从既往尝试中提炼经验教训；(4) 范围化召回（scoped recall），在局部重证时呈现早期陈述与否证性发现，而非不加批判地直接复用。
AI.result: 实验覆盖全部十个 First Proof Second Batch 问题，并包含四项组件研究。Ansatz 在全部十个研究任务上实现封闭（closure），展现出维持与恢复长程数学搜索的能力；此外还在无人干预下求解 Jamison caterpillar 猜想及 Erdős Problems 289、348、488（即所谓困难问题），并在若干开放问题上取得部分进展。
AI.conclusion: Ansatz 借助持续图记忆系统，能够有效组织长程证明搜索并跨问题复用知识，在封闭性、长程搜索可持续性以及开放数学问题的自动求解方面表现突出，表明图结构化、可演化的记忆机制是推进自动数学研究的有力途径。

title: Distributed Learning with Selective State Space Models: Architecture-Aware Convergence Analysis
summary: Modern state space models (SSMs), such as Mamba2, provide a compelling alternative to transformers by combining linear-time sequence modeling with recurrent state-space dynamics. However, the behavior of SSMs in distributed learning settings remains poorly understood. In particular, the existing standard federated learning methods are largely architecture-agnostic, and do not account for the stability, selectivity, and state-space parameterization that characterize modern selective SSMs. To address this, we derive architecture-aware gradient and smoothness bounds for single- and multi-layer selective SSMs, and convergence bounds for FedAvg and FedProx, characterizing how recurrent stability, input-dependent discretization, and state projection norms affect federated optimization. We then numerically validate the single-layer bounds on sequences generated by a teacher SSM, using a learner that follows the analyzed recurrence. We use this analysis to formulate expectations about the effects of local training and client heterogeneity, and examine these expectations by comparing nine federated learning algorithms on Mamba2 language modeling across six text domains. These experiments illustrate how SSM-specific bounds can provide a basis for interpreting the behavior of practical federated learning algorithms.

AI.tldr: 本文为现代选择性状态空间模型（SSM，如Mamba2）在联邦学习场景下的行为提供了架构感知的理论分析，并通过对9种联邦算法、6个文本域的实证加以验证。
AI.motivation: 现代SSM（如Mamba2）以线性时间序列建模和循环状态空间动力学成为Transformer的有力替代，但其在分布式/联邦学习中的行为尚不清楚。现有标准联邦学习方法基本是架构无关的，未考虑现代选择性SSM的稳定性、选择性和状态空间参数化特性，因此需要架构感知的分析。
AI.method: 推导单层与多层选择性SSM的架构感知梯度界与光滑性界，并给出FedAvg与FedProx的收敛界，刻画循环稳定性、输入依赖离散化和状态投影范数如何影响联邦优化；随后在由教师SSM生成的序列上对单层界进行数值验证；并据此提出关于本地训练与客户端异质性的预期，用9种联邦算法在Mamba2语言建模、6个文本域上进行比较检验。
AI.result: 得到单/多层选择性SSM的梯度与光滑性界及FedAvg/FedProx收敛界；单层界在教师SSM生成序列上获得数值验证；跨9种联邦算法、6个文本域的Mamba2语言建模实验展示了SSM特有界与实际联邦算法行为之间的关系。
AI.conclusion: SSM特有的理论界可为解释实际联邦学习算法的行为提供依据，将架构感知分析与实证结合，有助于理解选择性SSM在联邦优化中的表现。

title: Bidirectional Voronoi-biased Exploration Curriculum for Reinforcement Learning
summary: Long-horizon tasks with sparse rewards pose an exploration bottleneck for goal-conditioned reinforcement learning: a policy started from the initial state rarely reaches the goal and receives no learning signal. Reference motions, hand-designed curricula, and shaped rewards supply this signal but require demonstrations or task-specific engineering; automatic start-state and goal curricula avoid this but typically expand from one side only, so the full distance to the target must be covered from that side. We propose the Bidirectional Voronoi-biased Exploration curriculum for Reinforcement learning (BVER), which expands from both ends at once. Inspired by bidirectional RRT planning, BVER grows start states outward from the goal and goals outward from the initial state distribution, biases both toward unexplored task space, and steers them toward each other, training one goal-conditioned policy on both. On point-mass mazes, quadrupedal box climbing, and robot-arm ring-on-peg transfer, BVER learns faster than all compared reference-free curricula. On box climbing, it reaches 95% success on a 0.4 m box in roughly 65% fewer iterations than the best of them, is the only one of them to learn to climb a 0.7 m box, and yields a policy robust to start, goal, and yaw variation. Without a demonstration, it approaches the sample efficiency of reference-based curricula on the 0.4 m box and on ring-on-peg transfer. Ablations show that expanding from both ends outperforms either direction alone.

AI.tldr: 本文提出双向Voronoi偏置探索课程（BVER），同时从起点和终点两端扩展课程，用于稀疏奖励长时域目标条件强化学习，在多个任务上优于所有无参考课程方法。
AI.motivation: 稀疏奖励长时域任务中，从初始状态出发的策略难以到达目标，缺乏学习信号。参考动作、手工课程和塑形奖励可提供信号但需示范或任务特定工程；自动起止状态与目标课程无需示范，但通常仅从一端扩展，需覆盖到目标的全部距离，效率受限。
AI.method: BVER受双向RRT规划启发：从目标向外扩展起点状态、从初始状态分布向外扩展目标，两者均偏向未探索任务空间，并相互引导；在两端课程上联合训练一个目标条件策略，实现双向同时扩展。
AI.result: 在点质量迷宫、四足机器人爬箱和机械臂ring-on-peg转移任务上，BVER学习速度超过所有对比的无参考课程。爬箱任务中，0.4 m箱子达到95%成功率所需迭代约比最佳基线少65%；是唯一学会爬0.7 m箱子的方法，且策略对起点、目标和偏航变化鲁棒。无示范情况下，其样本效率接近基于参考的课程。消融表明双向扩展优于任一单向扩展。
AI.conclusion: 双向同时扩展课程能有效缓解稀疏奖励长时域目标条件RL的探索瓶颈，无需示范即可获得高样本效率与鲁棒策略。

title: Reasoning with Evidence, Not Merely Rationales: Verifiable Preference Proofs for LLM-Based Recommendation
summary: Large language models (LLMs) can infer user preferences from interaction histories and reviews, yet the rationales they generate may not reflect the information actually used for recommendation. A preference claim may be weakly supported by its selected evidence, or may have little effect on the final ranking. We refer to these two failures as the grounding-influence gap. We introduce PROVE-REC, a general framework for verifiable preference reasoning in LLM-based recommendation. Pass A converts the complete pre-target history into a compact preference proof consisting of positive and avoidance claims linked to selected evidence entries. Pass B predicts the next item using only the proof and its selected evidence, preventing the recommender from bypassing the reasoning path. To verify evidence-to-proof grounding, we compare the effect of masking selected evidence with masking a comparable control entry. To verify proof-to-recommendation influence, we remove a preference claim and measure the resulting decrease in the target item's ranking margin. A ranking-preservation objective further retains useful information from the complete history. Comprehensive experiments on wide-ranging real-world datasets demonstrate that PROVE-REC consistently outperforms strong sequential, generative, and LLM-enhanced baselines, with improvements of up to 7.45%. Controlled ablations confirm the effectiveness of the two-pass architecture and verification objectives. Moreover, PROVE-REC produces claims that are more strongly grounded in historical evidence and more influential to recommendation while preserving ranking quality.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 PROVE-REC 框架，通过双通道架构与可验证目标，解决 LLM 推荐中偏好推理的"grounding-influence gap"问题。
AI.motivation: LLM 能从交互历史和评论中推断用户偏好，但其生成的推理依据未必真正反映推荐所用信息：偏好主张可能缺乏所选证据支撑（grounding 不足），或对最终排序影响甚微（influence 不足）。作者将这两类失败统称为"grounding-influence gap"。
AI.method: 提出 PROVE-REC 通用框架。Pass A 将完整目标前历史压缩为紧凑的偏好证明，包含正向与规避主张，并链接到所选证据条目；Pass B 仅使用该证明及其证据预测下一物品，防止推荐器绕过推理路径。验证证据到证明的 grounding：对比掩蔽所选证据与掩蔽可比对照条目的效果；验证证明到推荐的 influence：移除某个偏好主张并测量目标物品排序边际的下降。另设排序保持目标以保留完整历史中的有用信息。
AI.result: 在多个真实世界数据集上，PROVE-REC 持续优于强序列、生成式及 LLM 增强基线，提升最高达 7.45%。受控消融验证了双通道架构与验证目标的有效性；其生成的主张在历史证据中 grounding 更强、对推荐影响更大，同时保持排序质量。
AI.conclusion: PROVE-REC 通过显式分离偏好证明生成与推荐预测，并引入 grounding 与 influence 双重验证机制，实现了可验证的偏好推理，缓解了推理依据与实际推荐不一致的问题。

title: AIGS: Adaptive Incremental Gating System for Online Representation Learning in Non-Stationary Data Streams
summary: Real-time data streams in Web of Things (WoT) and edge computing environments often evolve through latent regime changes. For online representation learning under strict computational constraints, the central problem is resolving the stability-plasticity dilemma: keeping useful historical knowledge while rapidly reacting to concept drift. Existing methods employ fixed update schedules or rolling windows. However, they suffer from parameter ossification during sudden shifts and waste computational resources when the stream remains stable. This paper proposes the Adaptive Incremental Gating System (AIGS), a lightweight closed-loop state-aware adaptation framework. AIGS introduces the Shock Ratio, an endogenous residual feedback mechanism that normalizes current reconstruction error against recent variation. This signal drives a Continuous Plasticity Controller that smoothly interpolates between learning plasticity and memory retention. By treating representation learning as a closed-loop control mechanism, AIGS avoids catastrophic forgetting and maintains a strictly linear $\mathcal{O}\left(k\cdot d\right)$ per-step complexity suitable for latency-sensitive edge devices. Experiments on real-world smart city dynamic streams-spanning traffic networks, meteorological systems, and industrial infrastructure-demonstrate distinct domain-dependent advantages. On Electricity Transformer Temperature datasets, AIGS achieves preventative early-warning lead times of 8.31 (ETTm1) and 9.88 (ETTm2) steps under gradual degradation. On Performance Measurement System traffic datasets, it shows significantly faster post-shift recovery after abrupt mutations. On the highly noisy Weather dataset, it improves anomaly recall while resisting stochastic noise overfitting. These findings establish AIGS as a practical, plug-and-play adapter for resource-constrained edge monitoring systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出自适应增量门控系统（AIGS），一种用于Web of Things与边缘计算在线表示学习的轻量闭环状态感知自适应框架。其核心是Shock Ratio内生的残差反馈信号驱动连续可塑性控制器，在学习可塑性与记忆保持间平滑插值，从而解决稳定性-可塑性困境，并保持严格的 O(k·d) 单步复杂度。在智能城市动态数据流（电力变压器温度、交通网络、气象等）上的实验表明，AIGS在渐进退化下具备预警提前量、在突变后具备快速恢复能力，并能提升异常召回同时抑制噪声过拟合。
AI.motivation: WoT与边缘计算环境中的实时数据流常经历潜在的状态变化（regime changes）。在严格算力约束下进行在线表示学习，核心难题是稳定性-可塑性困境：既要保留有用的历史知识，又要快速响应概念漂移。现有方法采用固定更新策略或滚动窗口，在突发漂移时出现参数僵化（parameter ossification），而在数据流平稳时又浪费计算资源。因此需要一种能根据流状态自适应调节更新强度的机制。
AI.method: 提出AIGS——轻量级闭环状态感知自适应框架。关键技术包括：（1）Shock Ratio：一种内生残差反馈机制，用当前重构误差相对于近期变化进行归一化，生成漂移敏感信号；（2）连续可塑性控制器（Continuous Plasticity Controller）：由Shock Ratio驱动，在学习可塑性与记忆保持之间平滑插值；（3）将表示学习建模为闭环控制机制，避免灾难性遗忘，并保持严格的线性 O(k·d) 单步复杂度，适配延迟敏感的边端设备。
AI.result: 在真实智能城市动态数据流上验证，呈现明显的领域依赖优势：在Electricity Transformer Temperature数据集上，渐进退化场景下实现预防性预警提前量达8.31步（ETTm1）与9.88步（ETTm2）；在Performance Measurement System交通数据集上，突发突变后展现出显著更快的漂移后恢复；在高噪声Weather数据集上，提升了异常召回率，同时抵抗随机噪声过拟合。
AI.conclusion: AIGS是一种实用、可即插即用的适配器，适用于资源受限的边缘监测系统，能够有效平衡历史知识保持与概念漂移响应，并在多类真实动态数据流上取得领域相关的性能优势。

title: UniIntervene++: An Adaptive Intervention Agent for Efficient Real-World Reinforcement Learning
comment: Yudong Lin and Haoyuan Deng contributed equally. Ziwei Wang is the corresponding author. Code is available in our \href{https://github.com/dannyyudong/An-Adaptive-Intervention-Agent-for-Efficient-Real-World-Reinforcement-Learning}{GitHub repository}
summary: Online reinforcement learning (RL) enables robot policies to improve through physical interaction, but the assistance they require changes as their competence evolves. Existing intervention strategies based on offline estimates or fixed decision rules can therefore become mismatched to the current policy. To address this, we propose UniIntervene++, an adaptive intervention agent that learns to allocate control between autonomous execution and heterogeneous assisted behaviors during online RL. Specifically, UniIntervene++ first formulates the evolving RL policy, trajectory correction, and a task-structured CodePolicy as Options in a unified semi-Markov decision process and learns their relative values online. Building on this, competence-adaptive intervention periodically probes the RL policy through unassisted execution, keeping control allocation responsive to its evolving capability. Finally, coupled experience learning allows assisted behaviors to improve the RL policy, whose evolving outcomes in turn reshape future intervention decisions. In this way, UniIntervene++ jointly determines when to intervene, how to intervene, and when to return control as the RL policy improves. Across five real-world manipulation tasks, UniIntervene++ achieves an average success rate of 89.67%, outperforming all baselines by at least 6 percentage points, while reducing human intervention to 0.77%, a relative reduction of at least 94.6% from the best baseline. Code is available in our \href{https://github.com/dannyyudong/An-Adaptive-Intervention-Agent-for-Efficient-Real-World-Reinforcement-Learning}{GitHub repository}.

AI.tldr: UniIntervene++ 提出一种自适应干预智能体，通过将演化中的RL策略、轨迹纠正与任务结构化CodePolicy统一建模为Options，并在线学习其相对价值，实现在线RL中"何时干预、如何干预、何时归还控制权"的联合决策。
AI.motivation: 在线强化学习依赖物理交互提升机器人策略，但策略能力随训练不断演化，所需的人类辅助程度也随之变化；基于离线估计或固定规则的既有干预策略会与当前策略能力失配，导致干预过多或不足。
AI.method: 1) 将演化中的RL策略、轨迹纠正（trajectory correction）和任务结构化CodePolicy统一表述为半马尔可夫决策过程（semi-Markov decision process）中的Options，并在线学习其相对价值；2) 能力自适应干预（competence-adaptive intervention）：周期性通过无辅助执行探测RL策略能力，使控制分配跟随其能力变化；3) 耦合经验学习（coupled experience learning）：辅助行为改进RL策略，而策略演化结果反过来重塑后续干预决策。
AI.result: 在五个真实世界操作任务上，UniIntervene++ 平均成功率达89.67%，优于所有基线至少6个百分点；同时将人类干预降至0.77%，相较最佳基线相对减少至少94.6%。
AI.conclusion: UniIntervene++ 能够随RL策略能力提升联合决定干预时机、干预方式与控制权归还时机，在提升任务成功率的同时显著降低人工干预成本，验证了能力自适应、异构辅助行为统一建模的有效性。

title: Beyond Entropy: Self-Diagnostic Multi-Role Token Optimization for Video Reasoning
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards has substantially advanced multimodal reasoning, yet it remains fundamentally limited by ambiguous token-level credit assignment. While high-entropy token heuristics encourage possibility exploration, naively extending them to video reasoning tends to induce lengthy reasoning, as the model becomes overly reliant on high-entropy visual activations. Alternative approaches that rely on counterfactual-based visual token localization for credit assignment also tend to over-prioritize visual exploration at the expense of decisive reasoning cues for answer derivation, thereby exacerbating the interference from spurious visual nuances. Moreover, these methods employ static counterfactual strategies that fail to co-evolve with the policy during training. In this paper, we introduce DyCPO, a co-evolutionary framework that jointly optimizes reliable token selection and adaptive counterfactual intervention. It constructs a multi-role dependence metric to balance visual exploration and answer-relevance mining in token-wise contrastive learning, while suppressing exploration-only filler tokens and spurious visual noise. Rather than relying on static counterfactual priors, DyCPO dynamically derives counterfactual signals from the model's own successful and failed rollouts, enabling self-diagnostic analysis and co-evolution of the optimization objective with the policy. Extensive experiments on complex video reasoning and general video understanding benchmarks demonstrate consistent performance improvements, establishing DyCPO as a robust token-level credit assignment paradigm for multimodal reinforcement learning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DyCPO，一个协同演化框架，联合优化可靠token选择与自适应反事实干预，以改进多模态强化学习中的token级信用分配。
AI.motivation: 基于可验证奖励的强化学习虽推动了多模态推理，但token级信用分配仍存在歧义。高熵token启发式在视频推理中易导致推理冗长，模型过度依赖高熵视觉激活；基于反事实视觉token定位的方法又过度偏向视觉探索，忽视决定性推理线索，放大虚假视觉细节干扰；且这些方法使用静态反事实策略，无法与策略共同演化。
AI.method: DyCPO构建多角色依赖度量，在token级对比学习中平衡视觉探索与答案相关性挖掘，同时抑制纯探索的填充token和虚假视觉噪声；不依赖静态反事实先验，而是从模型自身成功与失败的rollout中动态导出反事实信号，实现自诊断分析，使优化目标与策略协同演化。
AI.result: 在复杂视频推理与通用视频理解基准上的大量实验显示性能持续提升，验证DyCPO是稳健的多模态强化学习token级信用分配范式。
AI.conclusion: DyCPO通过可靠token选择与自适应反事实干预的协同演化，缓解了视觉探索与推理线索之间的失衡，为多模态强化学习提供了一种有效的token级信用分配方法。

title: CreateScore: Domain-Theory-Informed Bayesian Routing for LLM-Based CV Screening
comment: 11 pages, 5 figures, 7 tables (Excluding Appendix). CreateScore Planner App GitHub repo link: https://github.com/rupsa-arc1-2441139/createscore
summary: Large language models (LLMs) can support rubric-based screening of CVs, but applying a high-capability model to every candidate and criterion is costly. We present CreateScore, a domain-theory-informed Bayesian network for criterion-level LLM routing. A hand-specified directed acyclic graph with Dirichlet-multinomial conditional probability tables converts CV evidence into posterior uncertainty; low-uncertainty decisions are resolved by a local 8B model and uncertain ones are escalated to a 120B reference model. The graph is causally motivated, but the system performs standard Bayesian conditioning, not causal inference. The escalation threshold is calibrated on a training fold (target: 70% resolved locally) and then frozen. On 200 synthetic Data Science CVs (139 training and 61 test candidates, five criteria), 77.7% of criterion decisions were resolved locally (237 of 305). Relative to a reference condition in which the 120B model adjudicated every criterion, routed escalation reduced token use by 65.2% and raised exact score agreement from 32.8% (8B alone) to 42.6% (95% CI 31.0-55.1%); at n = 61 the gain was not statistically distinguishable. The uncertainty signal did not, however, identify the decisions on which the 8B model erred: disagreement with the reference was 16.2% among escalated and 19.4% among locally resolved decisions (AUROC 0.47, 95% CI 0.39-0.56), no better than random selection. We also document how an earlier evaluation was invalidated when truncated reasoning-model outputs were silently replaced by local labels, and we recommend safeguards for cascade evaluation. CreateScore is supported as an auditable cost-reduction mechanism, not yet as a targeted error detector, and is not an autonomous hiring system.

AI.tldr: CreateScore：基于领域理论启发的贝叶斯网络实现准则级LLM路由，以8B本地模型处理低不确定性决策、将高不确定性决策升级至120B模型，可降低65.2% token消耗，但不确定性信号无法有效识别8B出错样本（AUROC 0.47）。
AI.motivation: 将高能力LLM用于每位候选人、每项准则的简历筛选成本过高，需要一种可按准则级不确定性进行模型路由、在保持评分一致性的同时降低算力开销的机制。
AI.method: 构建手工指定DAG与Dirichlet-multinomial条件概率表的领域理论启发贝叶斯网络，将CV证据转为后验不确定性；低于阈值的决策由本地8B模型裁决，高不确定性升级至120B参考模型。升级阈值在训练折上校准（目标70%本地解决）后冻结。系统执行的是标准贝叶斯条件推断而非因果推断。
AI.result: 在200份合成数据科学CV（139训练、61测试，五项准则）上，77.7%（237/305）准则决策本地解决。相比120B全量裁决，路由升级使token用量降低65.2%，并将精确评分一致率从32.8%（仅8B）提升至42.6%（95% CI 31.0-55.1%），但在n=61下提升不具统计显著性。不确定性信号未能定位8B出错决策：升级样本与本地解决样本的参考分歧率分别为16.2%和19.4%（AUROC 0.47，95% CI 0.39-0.56），不优于随机选择。另记录了因截断的推理模型输出被本地标签静默替换而导致早前评测失效的问题，并给出级联评测的防护建议。
AI.conclusion: CreateScore可作为可审计的成本削减机制，但尚不能作为针对性错误检测器，也非自主招聘系统。

title: Less Decoder is More Encoder: Geometric Representation Learning from Novel View Synthesis
summary: This paper examines the role of Novel View Synthesis (NVS) in geometric representation learning. In principle, NVS should reason about 3D scene structure, thereby enabling transferable multi-view geometric representations. Yet, existing encoder-based NVS methods yield poor representations. This is not because of a lack of supervisory signal, but rather due to inconspicuous architectural choices: \textit{spatially expressive decoders} that dilute representational capabilities of the scene encoder, and \textit{low-level pixel-space targets} that hinder feature learning. We present SNAP, a self-supervised encoder-decoder transformer that addresses both through a pose-conditioned local decoder and a latent-space reconstruction objective. SNAP is task agnostic, and we show that it is competitive with special-purpose geometry-supervised methods. SNAP also performs competitively against self-supervised representations across five tasks: visual localization, pose estimation, point correspondence, depth estimation, and robot manipulation. Remarkably, SNAP's patch features exhibit emergent viewpoint invariance that approaches heavily supervised models despite lower compute and data budgets. Under camera shifts where standard 2D representations collapse, SNAP degrades more gracefully, revealing that restricting decoder expressivity actively prevents the suppression of transferable geometric structure. https://snap-nvs.github.io

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SNAP：一种自监督编码器-解码器 Transformer，用于通过 NVS 学习可迁移的几何表示。关键洞察是阻碍表示质量的不是监督信号不足，而是两个架构选择——空间表达力过强的解码器稀释了场景编码器、低层级像素空间目标阻碍了特征学习。SNAP 通过姿态条件的局部解码器和隐空间重建目标解决这两个问题，在五类任务上表现竞争性，并涌现出接近重监督模型的视角不变性。
AI.motivation: NVS 原则上需要推理 3D 场景结构，因此应当能产生可迁移的多视图几何表示。但现有基于编码器的 NVS 方法得到的表示质量很差。作者指出问题并非缺乏监督信号，而是不显眼的架构选择：空间表达力过强的解码器会稀释场景编码器的表示能力，低层级像素空间目标会阻碍特征学习。
AI.method: 提出 SNAP，一个自监督的编码器-解码器 Transformer，包含两项设计：(1) 姿态条件的局部解码器（pose-conditioned local decoder），限制解码器表达力以避免抑制可迁移几何结构；(2) 隐空间重建目标（latent-space reconstruction objective），替代低层级像素空间目标以促进特征学习。该方法任务无关（task agnostic）。
AI.result: SNAP 与专门的几何监督方法具有竞争力；在五项任务上（视觉定位、姿态估计、点对应、深度估计、机器人操作）与自监督表示相比表现竞争性。SNAP 的 patch 特征展现出涌现的视角不变性，在更低的算力和数据预算下接近重监督模型。在相机位移导致标准 2D 表示崩溃的情形下，SNAP 退化更平缓。
AI.conclusion: 限制解码器表达力能主动防止可迁移几何结构被抑制，说明 NVS 表示质量差主要源于架构设计而非监督信号不足。SNAP 提供了一种任务无关、自监督且计算高效的几何表示学习方案。

title: ForestQuery: Boundary-Aware and Spatially Anchored Query Learning for Unified Forest Point Cloud Segmentation
summary: Forest point cloud segmentation is fundamental for fine-grained 3D forest scene understanding, yet remains challenging due to irregular tree structures, severe occlusions, density variations, and ambiguous instance boundaries. Recent query-based forest segmentation methods have shown promise for unified semantic and instance prediction, but they still insufficiently exploit forest-specific spatial structure and account for boundary uncertainty. In this paper, we propose ForestQuery, a boundary-aware and spatially anchored query learning framework for unified forest point cloud segmentation. ForestQuery enhances instance and semantic query learning through two complementary designs. Specifically, boundary uncertainty is explicitly modeled to guide reliable instance query construction and modulate query optimization through adaptive loss reweighting. Meanwhile, spatially anchored semantic query enhancement (SA-SQE) introduces learnable 3D anchors encoding forest vertical stratification priors to enrich semantic queries with explicit spatial references. We evaluate ForestQuery on multiple public forest point cloud benchmarks and a self-collected annotated real-world dataset. Extensive experiments demonstrate consistent improvements in both individual-tree segmentation and semantic segmentation across diverse forest scenes. Code and data are publicly available at https://zhan994.github.io/ForestQuery

AI.tldr: 本文提出ForestQuery，一个边界感知与空间锚定的查询学习框架，用于统一的森林点云语义与实例分割。
AI.motivation: 森林点云分割因树木结构不规则、遮挡严重、密度变化大及实例边界模糊而困难；现有基于查询的方法未充分利用森林特有空间结构，也未考虑边界不确定性。
AI.method: 通过两个互补设计增强实例与语义查询学习：1）显式建模边界不确定性，指导可靠的实例查询构建，并通过自适应损失重加权调节查询优化；2）空间锚定语义查询增强（SA-SQE），引入可学习3D锚点编码森林垂直分层先验，为语义查询提供显式空间参考。
AI.result: 在多个公开森林点云基准及自采集标注的真实数据集上，单木分割与语义分割任务均取得一致性提升。
AI.conclusion: ForestQuery有效提升多样森林场景下的统一点云分割性能，代码与数据已公开。

title: Reliable Self-Evolution with Imperfect Proxy Rewards
summary: Large language model (LLM)-based self-evolving search is a promising approach to scientific discovery. However, high-fidelity evaluation of every candidate is prohibitively expensive in some domains. Self-evolving systems in such settings therefore rely on low-cost but imperfect proxy rewards, which may assign high scores to infeasible candidates. These false positives may contaminate both the final output and the feedback used to guide subsequent generations. This motivates statistically calibrated reward intervals for more reliable self-evolving search. We propose Conformal Interval-Driven Self-Evolution (CISE), which constructs candidate-specific reward intervals using conditional conformal inference and iteration-wise online density-ratio estimation. CISE uses conservative interval-based rewards for evolutionary feedback and returns candidates only when all required property intervals lie entirely within their respective feasible regions. We derive fixed-iteration coverage results under explicit assumptions of independence and covariate shift. We evaluate CISE on three self-evolving search tasks in materials science. In our experiments, all candidates returned by CISE are true positives under high-fidelity evaluation, whereas the baselines return more candidates but include false positives. These results highlight the value of a smaller, more precise shortlist when downstream validation budgets are limited. Our repository is available at https://github.com/MLAI-Yonsei/CISE.git.

AI.tldr: 提出CISE方法，用条件共形推断构建候选特异性奖励区间，结合逐迭代在线密度比估计，实现统计校准的自进化搜索，避免代理奖励假阳性污染。
AI.motivation: LLM自进化搜索中，高保真评估每个候选代价过高，只能依赖低成本但不可靠的代理奖励。代理奖励可能给不可行候选打高分，产生假阳性，污染最终输出并误导后续生成的反馈信号。因此需要统计校准的奖励区间以提升可靠性。
AI.method: CISE通过条件共形推断构造候选特异性奖励区间，并采用逐迭代在线密度比估计处理协变量偏移。进化反馈使用保守的区间奖励；仅当候选所有必需属性区间完全落入各自可行域时才被返回。理论上在独立性与协变量偏移的显式假设下推导了固定迭代覆盖率结果。
AI.result: 在材料科学三个自进化搜索任务上评估。实验显示CISE返回的所有候选在高保真评估下均为真阳性；基线返回候选更多但包含假阳性。结果表明当下游验证预算有限时，更小且更精确的候选清单更有价值。
AI.conclusion: CISE以统计校准的奖励区间替代点估计代理奖励，有效抑制假阳性，适用于验证预算受限的自进化科学发现场景。代码已开源。

title: LEAP: Learning Efficient Action Proposals For LLM Agents
summary: LLM agents are known to be slow in rollouts. An agent completes a task one step at a time. At each step, it reasons and then chooses an action to execute. The next step and action cannot start until the previous one has finished. Speculative decoding accelerates the rollouts at the reason phase by drafting and verifying the inference tokens. Recent works have also started to apply similar ideas at the action phase. These works use off-the-shelf models, usually large, to draft action proposals for target model to verify. Large drafters match the target more often but take longer to propose, while small off-the-shelf models are fast but rarely make the same decision as the target. We ask a more general question: what determines the end-to-end speedup of action speculation? To answer it, we develop a latency framework for the speculative round. The framework compares what a round gains with what it costs. The gain depends on how well the drafter predicts the target and on how many steps the task can take before it ends. The cost comes from drafting, from waiting for target verification and from executing tools. Guided by the framework, we introduce LEAP (Learning Efficient Action Proposals) which keeps the drafter small and makes it accurate by training it on the target actions sequences. With a small 0.6B model, LEAP agrees with the target on most decisions and makes agents up to 60% faster in end-to-end wall clock time, with no systematic change in task success. Across various datasets, target models and draft models, the framework accounts for most of the measured speedups. We also show the draft model can be online trained with no prior trace collection and match the performance of offline training, making LEAP practical to deploy in the real world.

AI.tldr: 本文提出延迟框架分析动作推测的端到端加速机制，并据此设计LEAP方法，用小模型经目标动作序列训练提升预测准确率，实现最高60%端到端加速且不改变任务成功率。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体逐步骤推理与执行，速度慢。已有工作在推理阶段用推测解码加速，并尝试在动作阶段用现成大模型做草稿、由目标模型验证，但大草稿模型匹配率高却耗时长，小草稿模型快却难以与目标决策一致。核心问题在于：决定动作推测端到端加速效果的因素尚不明确。
AI.method: 1) 建立推测轮次（speculative round）的延迟框架，比较一轮的收益与成本：收益取决于草稿模型对目标的预测准确度及任务可执行的步数，成本来自草稿生成、等待目标验证及工具执行。2) 基于该框架提出LEAP（Learning Efficient Action Proposals）：保持草稿模型小规模（0.6B），通过在目标动作序列上训练提升其准确率。3) 支持在线训练，无需预先收集轨迹。
AI.result: 使用0.6B小模型，LEAP在多数决策上与目标一致，使智能体端到端墙钟时间最多加快60%，且任务成功率无系统性变化。在多数据集、多目标模型与多草稿模型设置下，该框架能解释大部分实测加速效果。在线训练可达到与离线训练相当的性能。
AI.conclusion: 动作推测的端到端加速由草稿准确率、任务步数与各阶段成本共同决定；通过训练小规模草稿模型对齐目标动作，可在不损失成功率的前提下显著加速智能体，且在线训练使其具备实际部署可行性。

title: OuroReward: Sequential Reward Scheduling for Reinforcement Learning in Text-to-3D Generation
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) for Text-to-3D (T23D) generation requires optimization across multiple quality dimensions such as semantic alignment and texture clarity. Existing methods typically optimize these dimensions simultaneously through multiple reward aggregation, without explicitly modeling inter-dimension dependencies. This can cause imbalanced optimization and persistent interference among conflicting dimensions. To address this limitation, we propose OuroReward, an interference-aware sequential reward scheduling strategy for T23D RL. OuroReward first estimates pairwise dependencies among dimensions and constructs a cyclic optimization path that minimizes cumulative interference. By incorporating the tail-to-head dependency, the cycle captures global compatibility across the entire schedule. Then, OuroReward converts the cycle into a one-pass sequence, and starts optimization from the dimension with the lowest aggregate interference. Rather than assigning a fixed optimization budget to each dimension-wise reward, training adaptively determines when to advance to the next reward according to the remaining optimization headroom of the current one. We further introduce AdaSelect, an adaptive prompt selection strategy that identifies reliable and informative prompts aligned with the model's current capability. By focusing policy updates on these prompts, AdaSelect effectively improves training stability. Extensive experiments across different T23D models and RL algorithms demonstrate that our framework consistently improves generation quality across multiple dimensions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 OuroReward，一种干扰感知的序列化奖励调度策略，用于 Text-to-3D 强化学习，通过建模维度间依赖关系、构建最小累积干扰的最优优化路径，并结合自适应预算推进机制与 AdaSelect 提示选择策略，在多模型与多 RL 算法上一致提升多维度生成质量。
AI.motivation: 现有 T23D RL 方法将语义对齐、纹理清晰度等多个质量维度通过多奖励聚合同时优化，未显式建模维度间的依赖关系，导致优化不均衡，且冲突维度之间存在持续干扰。因此需要一种显式考虑维度间干扰的奖励调度方法。
AI.method: OuroReward 包含三个核心组件：1）估计各质量维度间的成对依赖关系，构建最小化累积干扰的循环优化路径，并引入尾到头依赖以捕捉全局兼容性；2）将循环转换为单趟序列，从聚合干扰最低的维度开始优化；3）不设固定优化预算，依据当前奖励的剩余优化空间自适应决定何时切换到下一奖励。此外引入 AdaSelect 自适应提示选择策略，识别与模型当前能力匹配的可靠且信息量高的提示，将策略更新集中于这些提示以提升训练稳定性。
AI.result: 在多种 T23D 模型和多种 RL 算法上的大量实验表明，该框架能够在多个质量维度上持续提升生成质量。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式建模维度间干扰并进行序列化奖励调度，可有效缓解多维度优化中的不均衡与冲突问题，配合自适应提示选择策略，OuroReward 为 T23D 强化学习提供了一种通用且有效的优化范式。

title: Relevant Evidence Decoding for Audio-Visual Hallucination Mitigation
summary: Audio-Visual Large Language Models (AV-LLMs) remain prone to cross-modal hallucinations, where one modality incorrectly affects predictions about another. Although contrastive decoding reduces hallucinations in vision-language models, its direct extension to AV-LLMs overlooks a key challenge: different questions require different perceptual evidence, including audio, video, or their interaction. Notably, we observe that joint audio-visual inference can weaken the prediction even when a model can recover the correct answer from a single informative modality. For example, when asked which instrument is heard, a model may correctly predict violin from the audio alone. Once a video showing a guitar is added, its confidence in violin may drop. In this paper, we introduce Relevant Evidence Decoding (RED), a training-free method that identifies question-relevant evidence and selectively strengthens its contribution. RED uses pointwise mutual information to quantify the predictive support provided by audio and video beyond the question alone. It decomposes their joint contribution into audio, video, and residual interaction components. A question-only inference pass determines the required evidence type, after which the model augments the original audio-visual prediction with the corresponding PMI contribution. Across three audio-visual hallucination benchmarks and three AV-LLMs, RED improves accuracy over standard decoding by up to 7% on CMM, 6.3% on AVHBench, and 3.8% on SVHalluc, with an average relative time to first token of 1.5x standard decoding.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出免训练的解码方法RED（Relevant Evidence Decoding），通过点互信息量化音频、视频及交互对预测的贡献，并根据问题类型选择性强化相关证据，以缓解音视频大语言模型的跨模态幻觉。
AI.motivation: 音视频大语言模型（AV-LLMs）易出现跨模态幻觉，即一种模态错误影响对另一模态的预测。将对比解码直接迁移到AV-LLMs存在关键问题：不同问题所需的感知证据不同（音频、视频或二者的交互）。作者观察到，联合音视频推理可能反而削弱预测——即使模型能从单一信息模态中得出正确答案，例如仅凭音频能正确判断听到的是小提琴，但加入显示吉他的视频后，对"小提琴"的置信度反而下降。
AI.method: RED是一种免训练方法，先识别与问题相关的证据并有选择地增强其贡献。具体地：用点互信息（PMI）量化音频和视频在问题之外提供的预测支持，并将其联合贡献分解为音频、视频和残差交互三个分量；通过一次仅问题（question-only）推理确定所需证据类型，随后将对应的PMI贡献加到原始音视频预测上。
AI.result: 在三个音视频幻觉基准和三个AV-LLM上，RED相比标准解码提升了准确率：CMM最高提升7%，AVHBench提升6.3%，SVHalluc提升3.8%；平均首token时间（TTFT）为标准解码的1.5倍。
AI.conclusion: RED通过显式区分并选择性利用问题相关证据，有效缓解了AV-LLMs的跨模态幻觉，在多个基准和模型上一致提升准确率，且仅带来约1.5倍的首token延迟开销。

title: RAOA: Alternating-Operator Neural Computation with Programmable Radio Propagation
summary: Can programmable radio propagation serve as computational depth rather than only as a communication channel or one-shot analog transform? We introduce the Radio Alternating Operator Ansatz (RAOA), a recurrent computing architecture that alternates an energy-derived problem update with a mixing update over a persistent latent state. Recomputing the problem field after each mix makes repeated passes compositional even when the same learned controls are reused across depth. We evaluate this idea through exact discrete optimization, constrained programmable-propagation simulation, and pretrained-model adaptation. On discrete objectives, repeated execution can improve solution quality without increasing the learned-control count, and the same formulation handles higher-order interactions directly. A passive phase-only free-space model further shows that the required operators can be approximated by programmable propagation while retaining useful downstream behavior despite realization error. When inserted as a zero-initialized residual adapter, RAOA adapts pretrained language models with WikiText performance close to a matched shallow MLP across three model families, while reasoning-task transfer remains model-dependent. Together, these results connect alternating-operator computation, programmable radio propagation, and neural adaptation within one recurrent framework. The RF realization evidence is simulation-based rather than a hardware demonstration.

AI.tldr: 论文提出RAOA（Radio Alternating Operator Ansatz），一种在持久隐状态上交替执行"问题更新"与"混合更新"的循环计算架构，将可编程无线电传播从通信信道/一次性模拟变换提升为可复用的计算深度；在离散优化、可编程传播仿真与预训练模型适配三类任务上验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有可编程无线电传播多被视作通信信道或一次性模拟变换，作者希望探讨其能否充当"计算深度"：即在深度方向上重复调用同一组学习到的控制参数，通过交替算子实现可组合的迭代计算，并检验这种物理可实现的计算范式能否连接离散优化、射频传播与神经网络适配。
AI.method: 提出RAOA循环架构，在持久隐状态上交替执行：由能量导出的"问题更新"与"混合更新"；关键在于每次混合后重新计算问题场，使重复迭代具有可组合性，即使跨深度复用同一组学习控制。验证途径包括：精确离散优化、受约束的可编程传播仿真，以及预训练模型适配；并采用被动式相位-only自由空间模型近似所需算子，作为零初始化残差适配器接入预训练语言模型。
