First, client ownership and participation jointly restrict long-window coverage: only 7.55\%--21.36\% of pooled-available 32-step windows have a locally complete anchor visited during training, averaged across diseases. Second, finer severity partitions accompany higher FedAvg error in 15 of 16 paired comparisons, while algorithm gains are small and horizon-dependent: FedProx reduces mean error by 0.56\%, with no consistent improvement at 32 steps. Third, algorithm labels conceal distinct update behavior, including inactive extrapolation and orders-of-magnitude differences in update scale. Cached-update performance also varies strongly across trajectory partitions under the same benchmark protocol. These results establish temporal access, participation coverage, optimization behavior, and horizon-resolved prediction as complementary dimensions for evaluating federated clinical world models.

AI.tldr: 该研究构建了跨时间联邦学习基准，用MIMIC-IV八种疾病队列的小时级动作条件临床预测，揭示了客户端所有权与参与度对时间上下文覆盖、优化行为及预测视野的联合约束。
AI.motivation: 世界模型从轨迹中学习状态演化，因此时序上下文的获取是核心训练需求。联邦学习可利用分布式记录，但轨迹内部的所有权边界限制了每个客户端能构造的样本，跨时间联邦设置缺乏系统评测。
AI.method: 在八个MIMIC-IV疾病队列上进行小时级动作条件临床预测，共40.87百万转移成员关系；设定基于严重度的客户端所有权、患者隔离构造、本地历史与未来窗口规则，以及1至32小时配对rollout评估；覆盖32种疾病–划分配置的十种联邦算法矩阵，五轮各10%参与率。
AI.result: 第一，客户端所有权与参与度共同限制长窗口覆盖：平均仅7.55%–21.36%的池化可用32步窗口在训练中被本地完整锚点访问；第二，更细的严重度划分在16组配对比较中有15组伴随更高的FedAvg误差，算法增益小且依赖视野，FedProx平均误差降低0.56%，32步处无一致改善；第三，算法标签掩盖了不同的更新行为，包括非激活外推与更新尺度的数量级差异，缓存更新性能在同一基准协议下随轨迹划分强烈变化。
AI.conclusion: 时序可及性、参与覆盖、优化行为与视野分辨预测构成评估联邦临床世界模型的互补维度。

title: Dirac-Interconnected Neural Elements: Discovering Modularity in Physical Systems Without Reduction
summary: Deep learning has shown remarkable success in the data-driven modeling of dynamical systems. Much of its success is attributed not to the flexibility of neural networks but to inductive biases based on physical prior knowledge, such as energy conservation and symplecticity. However, existing methods do not fully exploit the fact that real-world physical systems are interconnections of components. Some methods require the interconnection to be known a priori, while others assume the system to be reducible to an ordinary differential equation (ODE) and learn only the reduced ODE, discarding the algebraic constraints imposed by the interconnection. Here, we propose Dirac-interconnected neural elements (DINEs), a neural network model that represents a physical system as a differential-algebraic equation (DAE), whose algebraic constraints are given by a Dirac structure in kernel representation. With DINEs, we simultaneously identify from data the interconnection among the components as a Dirac structure and learn the characteristics of the components as neural networks. This allows us to keep the learned subsystems in unreduced form and isolate or compose them to make a new system without retraining. Moreover, DINEs can handle partially observable systems. Experimental results demonstrate these capabilities on physical systems beyond the reach of existing methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Dirac-interconnected neural elements (DINEs)，将物理系统建模为微分代数方程(DAE)，其代数约束由Dirac结构的核表示给出，从而同时从数据中识别组件间的互联结构并学习各组件的神经网络表征。
AI.motivation: 深度学习在动力系统建模中的成功主要归功于基于物理先验的归纳偏置（如能量守恒和辛结构）。然而现有方法未充分利用真实物理系统是组件互联这一事实：部分方法要求互联关系已知，另一些则假设系统可约化为常微分方程(ODE)并仅学习降阶ODE，从而丢弃了互联带来的代数约束。
AI.method: 提出DINEs模型，将物理系统表示为微分代数方程(DAE)，其代数约束由核表示形式的Dirac结构给出。该方法同时从数据中识别组件间的互联（作为Dirac结构）并学习组件特性（作为神经网络），从而保持子系统的未降阶形式，可在不重新训练的情况下隔离或组合以构建新系统，并能处理部分可观测系统。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，DINEs在上述能力上能够处理现有方法无法触及的物理系统。
AI.conclusion: DINEs通过将系统建模为带有Dirac结构约束的DAE，实现了互联结构与组件特性的联合学习，支持子系统复用与部分可观测场景，拓展了数据驱动物理建模的适用范围。

title: Depth as Time in One-Step Generative Models
summary: The recent wave of one-step generative models, which compress the multi-step trajectory of diffusion via either distillation or learned flow maps, has reached an inflection point where they can generate high-quality images. Here, we ask a natural question that follows from these advances: what happens to the denoising trajectory of multi-step diffusion when generation is compressed into a single forward pass? We offer an empirical observation we call \textit{depth as time}: the denoising computation that multi-step diffusion performs across sampling steps appears to unfold across the depth of a single forward pass, and can be recovered by decoding intermediate layers with the model's own output head. Most interestingly, we show that this depthwise computation depends on the transport task a flow map is trained to solve. The most surprising case is MeanFlow, where probing shorter transport intervals reveals both denoising and renoising within a single network evaluation. In contrast, generators trained without a time-indexed transport task, such as drifting models, do not exhibit the same depthwise denoising. Consequently, we show that models that exhibit the depthwise denoising phenomenon are more compressible across the layerwise computation: a MeanFlow \texttt{SiT-L/2} model can be compressed by $16.6\times$ in parameters into a single time-conditioned block. We offer an explanation for this denoise-then-renoise behavior and show that, when we treat the layerwise computation explicitly as a flow, a single time-conditioned block can be trained to denoise across layers, compressing a MeanFlow \texttt{SiT-L/2} model by $16.6\times$ in parameters. Together, these results suggest that the temporal computation of diffusion is not eliminated by one-step generation, but reorganized across network depth.

AI.tldr: 该论文观察到一步生成模型中扩散的时间维计算被重组到网络深度维（"深度即时间"），并据此提出可将MeanFlow SiT-L/2参数压缩16.6倍的层间流方法。
AI.motivation: 一步生成模型（通过蒸馏或学习流映射压缩多步扩散轨迹）已能生成高质量图像，但一个自然问题尚未被回答：当生成被压缩为单次前向传播时，多步扩散原有的去噪轨迹发生了什么？作者希望探究时间维去噪计算在一步生成模型中的去向。
AI.method: 作者提出经验性观察"深度即时间"（depth as time）：多步扩散在采样步间执行的去噪计算似乎展开在单次前向传播的深度上，可用模型自身的输出头解码中间层加以恢复。通过探测（probing）不同层的中间表示并结合模型的输出头进行解码来验证该现象；进一步分析其与流映射所训练的传输任务的关系，对比MeanFlow与drifting等无时间索引传输任务的生成器；并显式地将层间计算视为一个流，训练单个时间条件块跨层去噪。
AI.result: 该深度维计算依赖于流映射被训练求解的传输任务。最意外的是MeanFlow：探测更短传输区间时，在单次网络评估中同时观察到去噪与再噪（denoise-then-renoise）。相反，未使用时间索引传输任务训练的生成器（如drifting模型）不表现出同样的深度维去噪。表现出深度维去噪现象的模型在层间计算上更具可压缩性：MeanFlow SiT-L/2可在参数上压缩16.6倍，压缩为单个时间条件块。
AI.conclusion: 扩散的时间维计算并未被一步生成所消除，而是被重组到网络深度上；将层间计算显式视为流时，单个时间条件块可跨层训练去噪，实现16.6倍参数压缩。这些结果对一步生成模型的可解释性与压缩具有启示。

title: Differentiable Koopman Operator for Contrastive Learning on Dynamic Graphs
summary: Real-world interaction networks are inherently dynamic: edges form and dissolve as node behavior shifts over time. Most snapshot-based contrastive methods encode temporal dependencies implicitly in encoder weights, without an explicit model of how node representations evolve, making them brittle under distribution shifts. We propose KAIROS (Koopman-Aligned Invariant Representations for Open Dynamic Systems), a self-supervised framework that embeds a differentiable Koopman operator within a dynamic graph contrastive learning loop to linearize temporal evolution in the learned embedding space. A dual-view encoder pairs raw node features with a graph-diffused structural view and is optimized with multi-granularity contrastive objectives across temporal windows. For anomaly detection, KAIROS uses the Koopman prediction residual together with temporal inconsistency and local neighborhood deviation to separate irregular behavior from predictable graph evolution. Evaluated on nine dynamic graph benchmarks, KAIROS achieves state-of-the-art anomaly detection results on all nine datasets, with gains of up to 23.15 ROC-AUC points over prior work, while remaining competitive for unsupervised node classification. These results show that explicit dynamics modeling provides a scalable and effective inductive bias for temporal graph representation learning.

AI.tldr: KAIROS 将可微 Koopman 算子嵌入动态图对比学习，实现时序演化的显式线性化建模，在九个动态图基准上刷新异常检测SOTA。
AI.motivation: 真实交互网络本质动态，边随节点行为演进而产生与消失。现有基于快照的对比方法将时序依赖隐式编码进编码器权重，缺乏对节点表示如何演化的显式刻画，导致分布漂移下鲁棒性差。
AI.method: 提出 KAIROS 自监督框架，在学习到的嵌入空间内嵌入可微 Koopman 算子以线性化时序演化，并置于动态图对比学习循环中。双视图编码器将原始节点特征与图扩散结构视图配对，在多个时间窗上用多粒度对比目标优化。异常检测融合 Koopman 预测残差、时序不一致性与局部邻域偏差三项信号。
AI.result: 在九个动态图基准上全部取得最优异常检测性能，较此前工作最高提升 23.15 个 ROC-AUC 点，同时在无监督节点分类上保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 显式动力学建模为时序图表征学习提供了可扩展且有效的归纳偏置。

title: NeutronGym: Physics-Graded Neutron Instrument Design for LLM Agents
summary: Designing a scientific instrument tests whether language-model agents can do physics rather than recall it, provided the grading cannot be argued with. We introduce NeutronGym, to our knowledge the first executable environment for neutron instrument design: agents build instruments through validating tools, McStas ray-traces what they build, and a level-resolved ladder grades syntax, runtime, structure and science with no LLM judge. Procedural families supply unlimited instances of a fixed layout whose design parameters the agent must set, with held-out parameter regimes; a curated slice, McStasBench, adds 16 tasks from published instruments behind memorization probes and a sandbox. Seven models reproduce at most 7 of the 16, none retrieves a reference, and none meets an improvement target. The environment also trains. Reinforcement learning on its reward takes Qwen3-8B from 11% to 77% of held-out instances of a family whose targets come from a hidden design (69% at a second seed), past an untrained Qwen3-32B, and the recipe holds, at one seed each, on three further gated families. The analysis says what that gain is. Without the ladder's partial credit it collapses by 60 points. From reward alone the trained model reaches what a classical optimizer reaches, at the agent's simulation budget, only when handed the closed-form physics (77% against 81%, a gap that does not separate at this size), while frontier models still solve 98-99%. Getting a trustworthy result meant failing four task designs that no-model baselines could solve, and we release the probes that found them.

AI.tldr: 本文提出NeutronGym——首个可执行的中子仪器设计环境，代理通过工具构建仪器、McStas进行射线追迹，并以无LLM评判器的分层阶梯对语法、运行时、结构与科学目标打分。七个模型在精选基准McStasBench上最多复现16个任务中的7个，且无一检索到参考解或达到改进目标；RL训练可将Qwen3-8B从11%提升至77%。
AI.motivation: 检验语言模型代理是否真正具备物理学能力而非仅凭记忆回想，需要一个评分不可争辩、可执行且能防记忆的评测环境。
AI.method: 构建NeutronGym可执行中子仪器设计环境：代理通过验证工具搭建仪器，McStas做射线追迹；分层阶梯无LLM评判地评语法、运行时、结构与科学；程序化族提供固定布局的无限实例与留出参数区间，McStasBench含16个已发表仪器任务并设记忆探针与沙箱。
AI.result: 七个模型最多复现16个中的7个，均未检索参考解或达改进目标；RL将Qwen3-8B从11%提至77%（第二种子69%），超过未训练Qwen3-32B，并在三个受限族上复现；去掉阶梯部分分则下降60点；仅凭奖励达最优时需闭式物理（77%对81%，差异不显著），前沿模型仍解98–99%；构建过程中因无模型基线可解而否决了四个任务设计。
AI.conclusion: NeutronGym提供了可执行、可训练、防记忆的中子仪器设计评测，其RL配方有效且增益可归因于阶梯部分分，并发布了用于发现无效任务设计的探针。

title: Sentry: Learning to Recover from LLM Agent Failures at Test Time
summary: LLM agents often fail mid-task due to invalid tool calls, repeated actions, or poorly grounded reasoning, and learning from these failures is a path to reliability. We find that how failure knowledge reaches the agent matters as much as what it contains. Failure lessons are conditional: kept in the agent's context, they misfire when their failure is absent, and removing them from an evolving playbook improves performance. Runtime interventions, in contrast, act only when a failure occurs but do not learn from their repairs. We argue that failure knowledge is conditional knowledge and should be conditionally exposed, and instantiate this principle in Sentry, a failure-management layer that runs alongside the agent. When Sentry detects a failure, it retrieves matching lessons from an external playbook to guide recovery, verifies without access to task rewards whether the agent recovered, and stores a new lesson only if it did; the full playbook never enters the agent's context. Across multiple agentic benchmarks, Sentry outperforms the strongest runtime-intervention baseline on every benchmark, by 37\% on average, and the strongest context-evolution baseline by 39\% on the two benchmarks where both are evaluated; combining Sentry with context evolution yields further gains. Learned lessons transfer to held-out tasks, and controlled experiments show that exposing the full playbook to the agent lowers performance even when relevant lessons remain available on demand.

AI.tldr: 失败知识是条件性的，应仅在对应失败发生时按需暴露。Sentry 将失败管理外置为独立层，检测失败后检索匹配教训、验证恢复并按需存储新教训，全量 playbook 从不进入上下文，在多个 agent 基准上显著超越基线。
AI.motivation: LLM agent 常因无效工具调用、重复动作或推理缺乏依据而中途失败。作者发现"失败知识如何到达 agent"与"知识内容本身"同等重要：教训具有条件性，长期驻留上下文会在对应失败缺席时误触发；而运行时干预虽只在失败时生效，却不从修复中学习。因此需要一种既能条件性暴露失败知识、又能持续学习的两全机制。
AI.method: 提出 Sentry，作为与 agent 并行运行的失败管理独立层。当 Sentry 检测到失败时，从外部 playbook 检索匹配教训以指导恢复；在不访问任务奖励的条件下验证 agent 是否已恢复；仅当恢复成功才写入新教训。整个 playbook 始终不进入 agent 上下文，实现失败知识的条件性暴露与外部演化。
AI.result: 在多个 agentic 基准上，Sentry 在每个基准均优于最强运行时干预基线，平均提升 37%；在两个共同评估的基准上，比最强上下文演化基线高 39%；与上下文演化方法结合可获进一步提升。学到的教训能迁移到留出任务；控制实验显示，即便相关教训仍可按需获取，把完整 playbook 直接暴露给 agent 反而降低性能。
AI.conclusion: 失败知识应被视为条件性知识并按需暴露，而非常驻上下文。将失败管理卸载到外部层（Sentry）既能提升可靠性，又优于运行时干预与上下文演化基线，且与后者互补，验证了"条件性暴露"这一设计原则的有效性。

title: Credit Where It Matters: Dependency-Aware Policy Optimization for Terminal Agents
summary: Terminal-using agents benefit from reinforcement learning (RL) in coding, debugging, and other multi-step terminal tasks. In these tasks, later commands often depend on information or intermediate results produced by earlier commands. However, existing trajectory-level and step-level credit assignment methods do not explicitly trace the read-write dependencies through which commands affect the final outcome. Consequently, training signals could still be assigned to irrelevant operations, weakening learning from relevant steps. In this paper, we propose Dependency-Aware Group Policy Optimization (DepGPO), which uses execution dependencies between commands to guide credit assignment for terminal agents. Specifically, we construct a command dependency graph from execution traces and trace backward from the resources inspected by the task verifier. We then assign credit to relevant writes and their supporting reads along these paths, and use it to redistribute trajectory advantages across steps. Extensive comparative experiments and ablation studies demonstrate that DepGPO improves task performance and training stability on complex terminal tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出依赖感知组策略优化（DepGPO），利用终端命令间的执行依赖构建依赖图，从验证器检查的资源反向追踪，将信用分配给相关写操作及其支撑读操作，从而重新分配轨迹优势，提升复杂终端任务的表现与训练稳定性。
AI.motivation: 终端类智能体在多步任务（如编码、调试）中获益于强化学习，但后续命令常依赖前序命令的信息或中间结果。现有轨迹级和步骤级信用分配方法未显式追踪命令间的读写依赖，导致训练信号可能被分配给不相关操作，削弱了对关键步骤的学习。
AI.method: 提出DepGPO：从执行轨迹构建命令依赖图；从任务验证器检查的资源出发进行反向追踪；沿这些路径将信用分配给相关写操作及其支撑的读操作；据此在步骤间重新分配轨迹优势。
AI.result: 广泛的对比实验与消融研究证明，DepGPO在复杂终端任务上提升了任务性能与训练稳定性。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式建模执行依赖进行信用分配，DepGPO有效改善了终端智能体的强化学习效果，验证了依赖感知信用分配的必要性与有效性。

title: Temporal Geometry of Deep Networks: Hyperbolic Representations of Training Dynamics for Intrinsic Explainability
comment: Published as a main conference paper at ICLR 2026. 10 Main Pages, 22 pages of supplementary material
summary: Intrinsic explainability remains a challenging problem, particularly in contexts where multilayer perceptrons (MLPs) require dynamic re-training within an optimization environment. This paper investigates how MLPs and their training dynamics can be represented and studied in non-Euclidean spaces; our representation features the Poincaré model of hyperbolic geometry. We aim to capture the geometric evolution of their weighted topology and self-organization over time. Instead of restricting the analysis to single checkpoints---as per established measure-based explainability methods---we construct temporal \textit{parameter graphs}, i.e., snapshots over time $T$ steps of the optimization/training process for MLPs. This reflects the view that neural networks encode information not only in their weights but also in the trajectory traced during training. Drawing on the idea that many complex networks admit embeddings in hidden metric spaces where distances correspond to connection likelihood, we present a geometric and temporal graph-based metalearning framework for obtaining dynamic hyperbolic representations of the underlying neural parameter graphs. Our model embeds temporal parameter graphs in the Poincaré model ball, and learns from them while maintaining equivariance to within-snapshot neuron permutations and invariance to permutations of past snapshots. In doing so, the approach preserves functional equivalence over time and recovers the latent evolving geometry of the network. Experiments on regression and classification tasks with trained MLPs show strong meta-network performance, accompanied by hyperbolic temporal representations. This reveals how the network structure emerges over time under specific training environments, thus providing insights into the network's self-organization.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种几何与时序图基的元学习框架，用庞加莱双曲模型刻画MLP训练过程中参数图的动态演化，实现内在可解释性。
AI.motivation: 内在可解释性在多隐层感知机(MLP)于优化环境中需动态再训练的场景下仍是难题。传统基于度量的可解释方法仅关注单一检查点，忽视了训练轨迹中编码的信息。作者认为神经网络不仅将信息编码在权重中，也编码在训练过程中形成的轨迹里，因此需要捕捉加权拓扑的几何演化与自组织过程。
AI.method: 构造时序参数图，即MLP优化/训练过程T步的快照序列。基于复杂网络可在隐藏度量空间嵌入、且距离对应连接概率的假设，提出几何与时序图基的元学习框架：将时序参数图嵌入庞加莱模型球，同时保持对快照内神经元置换的等变性、对过去快照置换的不变性，从而在不同时刻保持功能等价并恢复网络潜在演化几何。
AI.result: 在回归与分类任务上训练MLP的实验表明，该元网络性能强劲，并伴随生成双曲时序表示，揭示了网络结构在特定训练环境下随时间涌现的过程，为网络自组织提供了洞见。
AI.conclusion: 利用双曲几何对时序参数图建模，可有效捕捉MLP训练动态中的内在几何结构，为神经网络内在可解释性与自组织分析提供新途径。

title: Do Large Language Models Know Colombian Law? A Reliability Benchmark for the Colombian Legal System
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to support legal practice, education, and research, yet their reliability in national legal systems outside the United States remains largely undocumented. We introduce an expert-validated benchmark for evaluating LLM reliability on the Colombian legal system. The benchmark comprises 1,042 items spanning ten areas of law and three question formats (closed multiple-choice, semi-open, and open-ended IRAC), built through a human-in-the-loop pipeline with multi-stage expert review. We evaluate 15 contemporary proprietary and open-weight models with format-appropriate metrics. Accuracy on closed questions ranges widely, from 0.905 (Gemini 3.1 Pro) to 0.577, but on free-text legal answers factual correctness never exceeds 0.45 (on a 0-1 scale) for any model. We find a dissociation between answer relevancy and correctness (Spearman rho = -0.46): models reliably sound responsive while frequently being wrong, a pattern of particular concern for non-expert users. Closed-question accuracy and free-text correctness are strongly rank-correlated (rho = 0.94), so cheap multiple-choice screening predicts model ranking but overstates absolute reliability. An independent rubric-based LLM judge and blind human expert scoring both reproduce the free-text ranking (rho >= 0.88). The judge further reveals that only about half of the norms models cite are correct; the rest are wrong or non-existent. Reliability varies systematically by legal area and follows an inverted-U across question complexity. Our results indicate that current LLMs require expert supervision for Colombian legal tasks, and that grounding answers in authoritative sources is a promising path to higher reliability. We release the benchmark construction pipeline to support reproducible evaluation.

AI.tldr: 该研究构建了首个经专家验证的哥伦比亚法律体系LLM可靠性基准（1042题、10个法律领域、3种题型），评测15个模型发现：封闭题准确率最高0.905，但自由文本事实正确率不超过0.45；答案相关性与正确性呈负相关，且模型引用法条约半数有误，说明当前LLM在哥伦比亚法律任务中必须依赖专家监督。
AI.motivation: LLM正日益用于法律实践、教育与研究，但其在美国以外国家法律体系中的可靠性缺乏系统记录。哥伦比亚等非美法域的评测资源几乎空白，而非专家用户难以识别模型"听起来合理却实际错误"的输出，因此需要一个专家验证的基准来量化模型在该法域的可靠性。
AI.method: 采用human-in-the-loop流水线并经多轮专家评审，构建包含1042个条目的基准，覆盖10个法律领域与3种题型（封闭多选、半开放、开放式IRAC）。以适配题型的指标评测15个当代闭源与开权重模型。使用独立基于评分量表的LLM评委与盲评人类专家进行验证，并分析答案相关性、引用法条正确性及法律领域与题目复杂度的影响。
AI.result: 封闭题准确率跨度大，从0.905（Gemini 3.1 Pro）到0.577；但自由文本法律答案的事实正确率在任何模型上均不超过0.45（0–1尺度）。答案相关性与正确性出现分离（Spearman rho = -0.46），即模型常"答得像样却答错"。封闭题准确率与自由文本正确性强秩相关（rho = 0.94），廉价多选题可作为模型排名的筛查手段但会高估绝对可靠性。LLM评委与盲评专家均复现自由文本排名（rho ≥ 0.88）。评委还发现模型引用法条中仅约一半正确，其余为错误或不存在。可靠性随法律领域系统性变化，并随题目复杂度呈倒U型。
AI.conclusion: 当前LLM用于哥伦比亚法律任务仍需专家监督；将答案锚定于权威来源是提升可靠性的可行路径。研究公开基准构建流水线以支持可复现评测。

title: Neural Data Needs Semantic Tokenization: Behavioral Events as Boundaries of Session-Transferable Tokens
summary: Extracellular electrophysiology records a different set of neurons in every session. Neural foundation models embed each neuron and each session into their tokens, so every new session is an input they have never seen, and they fail to generalize to it. A tokenizer for new sessions needs a unit that every session shares and that carries behavior. Population activity offers such a unit. It evolves on a low-dimensional manifold that persists across neuronal turnover and across animals once sessions are aligned. This manifold changes regime at task events such as stimulus onset and movement onset. Within each regime the population occupies a state, the part of the manifold it spans between two events, and each state carries its own behavioral meaning. We propose Tokenization with States (TWS), which segments each trial, one repetition of the task, at these events and converts every state into tokens of population geometry, with no neuron or session embedding. On held-out International Brain Laboratory (IBL) sessions, TWS decodes movement even from regime boundaries that carry no information about the target, while a per-neuron foundation model pretrained on those sessions decodes at chance. Frozen after training on mice alone, TWS transfers to macaques and Utah arrays with only a linear probe. On reach direction, a target that its boundaries do not define, it achieves a Matthews correlation of 0.23, where the event time alone achieves $0.01$. For cross-session generalization, the token matters more than the model on top.

AI.tldr: 提出 Tokenization with States (TWS)，以群体活动在事件间形成的状态为共享单元，将每次状态转为群体几何 token，不含神经元或 session 嵌入，实现跨 session、跨物种泛化。
AI.motivation: 细胞外电生理每次记录都包含不同神经元，而现有神经基础模型为每个神经元和 session 分配嵌入 token，导致新 session 成为未见输入、无法泛化。需要一个所有 session 共享且承载行为的单元作为新 session 的 tokenizer 基础。
AI.method: 群体活动在低维流形上演化，该流形在神经元更替和（对齐后的）不同动物间持续存在，并在刺激起始、运动起始等任务事件处发生 regime 切换；每一 regime 内群体占据一个 state（两事件间流形的一部分），各 state 具有独立行为含义。TWS 在每个任务事件处切分 trial，将每个 state 转换为群体几何 token，不使用神经元或 session 嵌入。
AI.result: 在留出的 IBL session 上，TWS 仅凭不含目标信息的 regime 边界即可解码运动，而预训练于这些 session 的 per-neuron 基础模型仅达随机水平。仅在数据上训练后冻结，TWS 仅用线性探针即可迁移至猕猴和 Utah array。在运动方向（其边界未定义该目标）上，Matthews 相关系数达 0.23，而仅用事件时间仅 0.01。
AI.conclusion: 跨 session 泛化中，token 比其上的模型更重要；以群体状态几何为 token 的表征可提供神经元与 session 无关的通用基础。

title: MRVQ: One Resident Index for Dimension- and Rate-Elastic Vector Search
summary: Dense-retrieval services must switch among embedding-prefix dimensions and index bit rates as latency, quality, and memory budgets change. Tuning a quantizer separately for each rate gives the best quality, but the retrieval tier then holds several code streams and quantizer states at once. We introduce Matryoshka Residual Vector Quantization (MRVQ), a post-hoc residual quantizer for frozen embeddings. Its maximum-rate code can be truncated two ways: dropping residual stages lowers the rate, and dropping embedding coordinates lowers the dimension. One resident artifact therefore serves every (dimension, rate) pair we evaluate. Across FiQA and NFCorpus, four embedding families, and {4, 8, 16}-byte codes, MRVQ is the lowest-RAM design we evaluate. It uses 17.8-22.0x less memory than three separately trained QINCo2 indices, and 1.89-2.02x less than a lean shared-model steelman. The saving is not free: per-rate QINCo2 is 0.026-0.107 nDCG@10 better on FiQA. But MRVQ beats PQ, OPQ, and AdANNS-OPQ at matched code size. We also evaluate a low-build-cost PCA-scalar design that attains quality comparable to RaBitQ and its extension while fitting 420x faster at the median. Finally, we report two negative results: QINCo2 collapses when trained at high rates, and a ranking-bound hypothesis misses its pre-specified acceptance criteria. MRVQ is therefore a low-memory operating point for elastic retrieval, not a universal quality winner.

AI.tldr: 提出MRVQ后处理残差量化方法，用单一常驻工件同时支持任意（维度, 码率）组合，以极低内存代价实现弹性稠密检索。
AI.motivation: 稠密检索服务需随延迟、质量、内存预算变化而动态切换嵌入前缀维度与索引码率；为每个码率单独调优量化器虽质量最优，但需同时驻留多套码流与量化器状态。
AI.method: Matryoshka Residual Vector Quantization (MRVQ)：面向冻结嵌入的事后残差量化器，其最高码率码字支持两种截断方式——丢弃残差级降码率、丢弃嵌入坐标降维度；另评估一种低构建成本的PCA-标量设计。
AI.result: 在FiQA与NFCorpus、四类嵌入族、{4,8,16}字节码下，MRVQ为最低RAM方案：比三个独立训练的QINCo2索引省17.8–22.0倍内存，比精简共享模型基线省1.89–2.02倍；但单码率QINCo2在FiQA上nDCG@10高0.026–0.107。MRVQ在同码长下优于PQ、OPQ、AdANNS-OPQ。PCA-标量设计质量与RaBitQ及其扩展相当，中位构建速度快420倍。两个负结果：QINCo2高码率训练崩溃；排序界假设未达预设接受标准。
AI.conclusion: MRVQ是面向弹性检索的低内存工作点，而非普适的质量最优方案。

title: AvoKV-E: Payload-Aware KV Cache Eviction for Long Reasoning
summary: Long-output reasoning shifts the KV-cache bottleneck from the fixed prompt to the generated trace. Existing reasoning-cache eviction methods largely treat cached entries as routing objects, estimating whether an old key will still be read, will recur, or can be replaced. This routing-only view overlooks two effects: low-attention entries can carry large value payloads whose removal changes future predictions, and newly generated states can appear stale before later queries have had a chance to read them. We introduce AvoKV-E, a training-free eviction policy that first delays eligibility for recent states and then ranks eligible entries using candidate-normalized read pressure, key redundancy, and value-payload potential. According to empirical evaluation across different models and datasets, AvoKV-E matches or exceeds redundancy-aware, recurrence-based, and thought-adaptive eviction baselines at matched active-KV budgets, with its largest gains in the tightest-cache regime. Component and counterfactual analyses further connect these gains to delayed observation, payload-aware scoring, redundancy, and scale-robust normalization. Together, the results show that long-reasoning KV eviction should preserve not only keys that are likely to be read, but also the value payloads that sustain the reasoning trajectory.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练KV缓存淘汰策略AvoKV-E，通过延迟近期状态的可淘汰资格并结合候选归一化读压力、键冗余与值载荷潜力评分，在长输出推理中匹配或超越多类基线，紧预算下增益最大。
AI.motivation: 长输出推理使KV缓存瓶颈从固定提示转移到生成的推理轨迹上，缓存随推理步数增长而形成压力。现有推理缓存淘汰方法多把缓存条目当作"路由对象"，只估计旧键是否仍会被读取、是否会复现或可否被替换。这种纯路由视角忽略两点：低注意力条目可能承载较大的值载荷，删除会改变未来预测；新生成状态可能在后继查询读取前就被误判为陈旧。
AI.method: AvoKV-E是免训练淘汰策略，分两步：先对近期生成状态延迟其可淘汰资格，避免过早淘汰尚未被读取的新状态；再对已获资格的条目按三项指标排序——候选归一化读压力、键冗余度、值载荷潜力。为验证各设计的作用，还做了组件消融与反事实分析。
AI.result: 在多种模型与数据集上的实证评估表明，在相同活跃KV预算下，AvoKV-E追平或超越冗余感知、复现基与思维自适应等淘汰基线，且缓存最紧张时增益最大。消融与反事实分析将这些增益分别归因于延迟观察、载荷感知评分、冗余处理与尺度鲁棒的归一化。
AI.conclusion: 长推理场景下的KV淘汰不仅应保留"可能被读取"的键，还应保护支撑推理轨迹的值载荷；延迟观察与载荷感知的联合评分是有效方向。

title: Transcriptome-informed multi-modal AI for predicting neoadjuvant therapy response from breast cancer biopsies
summary: Scarcity of labeled data limits development of deep learning biomarkers in oncology. We develop a two-stage AI model predicting pathological complete response (pCR) to neoadjuvant therapy in breast cancer. The first stage learns the transcriptome from histopathology using 8,742 patients across 32 cancer types, corroborated by pathologist review and spatial agreement with measured expression. This simplifies the second stage to predicting pCR from inferred expression and clinical variables. Developed using 1,080 patients (five cohorts) and evaluated in 1,412 patients (nine cohorts), the model achieves a pooled AUROC of 0.79 (95% CI, 0.73-0.85), discriminating responders within molecular subtypes. It outperforms histopathological biomarkers, remaining stable across intratumoral sampling and with minimal biopsy tissue. Ablations show transcriptome-wide inference improves discrimination over clinical variables alone or one-stage pathology models, and robustness by avoiding genomic assays' gene selection constraints. These results indicate that biologically informed compression may generalize to data-sparse applications in precision oncology.

AI.tldr: 提出两阶段AI模型：先由组织病理图像推断转录组，再结合推断表达与临床变量预测乳腺癌新辅助治疗病理完全缓解，在多队列中取得稳健且优于病理标志物的判别性能。
AI.motivation: 肿瘤学中深度学习生物标志物的发展受限于标注数据稀缺，尤其是需要基因组检测而获得的分子标签数据成本高、覆盖有限，因此需要一种能在数据稀疏条件下仍具泛化能力的建模思路。
AI.method: 两阶段建模：第一阶段利用32种癌型、8,742例患者的组织病理图像学习转录组推断，并通过病理学家复核及与实测表达的空间一致性加以验证；第二阶段将问题简化为基于推断表达与临床变量预测pCR。开发集1,080例（5个队列），外部评估1,412例（9个队列），并开展消融实验、瘤内采样稳定性分析及最小活检组织量测试。
AI.result: 合并AUROC为0.79（95% CI, 0.73-0.85），可在分子亚型内区分应答者；性能优于组织病理学生物标志物；对瘤内采样位置具有稳定性，且在极小活检组织条件下仍保持表现；消融显示转录组范围推断优于仅用临床变量或单阶段病理模型，并因规避基因组检测的基因选择约束而更具稳健性。
AI.conclusion: 生物学信息引导的压缩表示可能推广至精准肿瘤学中的数据稀疏应用场景。

title: Signal Simplification Is Not Predictive Simplification: Diagnosing Residual Neural Forecasting in Short-Horizon Volatility
comment: Accepted at the 10th Computational Methods in Systems and Software (CoMeSySo 2026). 17 pages, 4 figures
summary: Hybrid statistical-neural pipelines often assume that a successful statistical first stage leaves a cleaner and more learnable residual target. We examine that assumption in short-horizon volatility forecasting through a signal-forecast-system diagnostic framework. Across five liquid U.S. assets, a volatility-aligned HAR-style model outperforms AR, MA, and ARIMA. Within expanding training windows, the pre-standardization fitted residual process used to construct residual-LSTM sequences has about 82% lower variance than the corresponding target and near-zero lag-1 autocorrelation; independently, rolling pseudo-out-of-sample HAR errors show about 74% variance reduction and similarly weak lag-1 dependence. Residual-only LSTM augmentation nevertheless raises mean squared error from 0.3049 to 0.3594 on average, with deterioration on every asset. Pure LSTM records the lowest selected pseudo-out-of-sample MSE, 0.2649, while the residual hybrid requires substantially more end-to-end runtime without improving accuracy. We describe this pattern as forecaster-preconditioner asymmetry: first-stage forecasting success and statistical residual simplification need not translate into useful downstream neural preconditioning.

AI.tldr: 统计-神经混合流程中"成功的第一阶段会留下更易学的残差"这一假设在短期波动率预测中并不成立：尽管HAR残差方差降约82%、自相关近零，残差LSTM增强反而使MSE从0.3049升至0.3594，纯LSTM取得最低MSE 0.2649。
AI.motivation: 统计-神经混合流程普遍假设成功的第一阶段统计模型会留下更干净、更易学习的残差目标，但该假设缺乏系统检验。作者希望在短期波动率预测情境下，通过信号-预测-系统诊断框架验证：第一阶段的预测成功与残差统计简化，是否能真正转化为对下游神经网络有用的预条件化。
AI.method: 构建信号-预测-系统诊断框架，在五类高流动性美国资产上比较波动率对齐的HAR类模型与AR、MA、ARIMA。在扩展训练窗口中分析用于构造残差LSTM序列的标准化前拟合残差过程的方差与滞后1自相关；独立地考察滚动伪样本外HAR误差的方差缩减与滞后1依赖性。随后对比仅用残差的LSTM增强、纯LSTM及混合模型的伪样本外MSE与端到端运行时间。
AI.result: 波动率对齐的HAR类模型优于AR、MA和ARIMA。残差过程方差比对应目标低约82%，滞后1自相关近零；滚动伪样本外HAR误差方差缩减约74%，滞后1依赖同样微弱。然而仅用残差的LSTM增强使平均MSE从0.3049升至0.3594，且在所有资产上均恶化。纯LSTM取得最低的选中伪样本外MSE 0.2649，而残差混合模型需显著更长的端到端运行时间却未提升精度。
AI.conclusion: 作者将这一现象概括为"预测器-预条件器不对称"（forecaster-preconditioner asymmetry）：第一阶段预测的成功与残差的统计简化，并不必然转化为对下游神经网络有效的预条件化，统计上"更干净"的残差未必是神经模型更易学的目标。

title: Tailoring the Quantization Space for 1-Bit KV Cache Compression
summary: The key-value (KV) cache becomes a major memory bottleneck in long-context LLM inference, placing substantial pressure on memory capacity and bandwidth. To mitigate this bottleneck, vector quantization (VQ) has emerged as a promising approach for aggressive KV cache compression. However, existing VQ methods degrade substantially in the 1-bit regime. At such extreme compression, each codebook must represent a larger group of channels with a limited set of centroids, making effective use of its capacity increasingly challenging. To address this, we introduce $\textbf{TaSQ}$, which tailors the VQ target space by combining query-guided channel weighting, cross-head normalization, and covariance-aware channel grouping to better reflect the error sensitivity and statistical structure of cached activations. Since these transforms are RoPE-compatible and can be easily merged into projection weights and codebooks, TaSQ preserves the conventional VQ lookup structure and adds negligible serving overhead. Across general, long-chain-of-thought reasoning, and long-context retrieval benchmarks, TaSQ consistently outperforms existing low-bit KV cache VQ baselines while preserving reasoning stability. On a single RTX 6000 Ada GPU, its SGLang implementation supports up to $14\times$ larger batch sizes and achieves $1.87\times$ higher peak throughput compared to the BF16 baseline.

AI.tldr: TaSQ是一种针对长上下文LLM推理中KV缓存瓶颈的1-bit向量量化压缩方法，通过定制量化目标空间来提升极端压缩下的精度，并保持低服务开销。
AI.motivation: KV缓存成为长上下文LLM推理的主要内存瓶颈，对内存容量和带宽造成巨大压力。向量量化（VQ）虽是有前景的KV缓存压缩手段，但现有VQ方法在1-bit极端压缩区间性能显著退化——每个码本需用有限质心表示更多通道，难以有效利用其容量。
AI.method: TaSQ通过定制VQ目标空间来改善压缩效果，具体结合三种技术：查询引导的通道加权（query-guided channel weighting）、跨头归一化（cross-head normalization）、协方差感知的通道分组（covariance-aware channel grouping），以更好地反映缓存激活的误差敏感性与统计结构。这些变换与RoPE兼容，且可合并进投影权重和码本，从而保留传统VQ查表结构，服务开销可忽略。
AI.result: 在通用、长链思维推理及长上下文检索基准上，TaSQ一致优于现有低比特KV缓存VQ基线，并保持推理稳定性。在单张RTX 6000 Ada GPU上，其SGLang实现支持高达14倍的更大批量，峰值吞吐相比BF16基线提升1.87倍。
AI.conclusion: TaSQ通过定制量化目标空间有效缓解了1-bit极端压缩下VQ的性能退化，在保持低服务开销的同时显著提升精度与推理稳定性，并大幅改善批量规模与吞吐，为长上下文LLM推理的KV缓存压缩提供了实用方案。

title: Balancing Multimodal Learning via Functional Progress
summary: Multimodal learning often suffers from modality imbalance, where the joint optimization process is dominated by a single modality. Existing methods typically estimate modality imbalance from score disparities derived from prediction uncertainty or optimization statistics. However, due to distinct prediction uncertainty and learning dynamics across modalities, direct comparison of such scores may misinterpret intrinsic modality differences as progress gaps, leading to biased imbalance estimation. In this paper, we propose Function-Space Guided Multimodal Optimization (FGMO), which leverages a function-space progress signal to assess modality-wise optimization progress and coordinate optimization across modalities to alleviate modality imbalance. Specifically, we introduce Functional Progress Estimation (FPE) to measure each modality's update-induced function-space response and calibrate it against a loss-aligned unimodal reference, producing a comparable progress signal. Based on this signal, Functional Response Control (FRC) redistributes modality-level function-space budgets and realizes the target responses through tensor-wise learning-rate adjustment. Theoretical analysis establishes a one-step target-contraction property of FRC under bounded controller-state mismatch, and extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of FGMO across multiple multimodal benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Function-Space Guided Multimodal Optimization (FGMO)，通过函数空间进度信号评估各模态的优化进度并协调跨模态优化，缓解多模态学习中的模态不平衡问题。
AI.motivation: 多模态学习中普遍存在模态不平衡，联合优化过程常被单一模态主导。现有方法多依据预测不确定性或优化统计得出的分数差异来估计不平衡，但由于各模态的预测不确定性与学习动态不同，直接比较这些分数可能将内在模态差异误判为进度差距，导致有偏的不平衡估计。
AI.method: FGMO利用函数空间进度信号评估模态级优化进度。具体包括：Functional Progress Estimation (FPE) 度量每个模态更新引起的函数空间响应，并以与损失对齐的单模态参考进行校准，得到可比较的进度信号；Functional Response Control (FRC) 基于该信号重新分配模态级函数空间预算，并通过张量级学习率调整实现目标响应。
AI.result: 理论分析建立了FRC在有界控制器状态失配下的一步目标收缩性质；大量实验表明FGMO在多个多模态基准上有效。
AI.conclusion: FGMO通过函数空间进度信号实现更公平的跨模态优化协调，为缓解模态不平衡提供了新思路，并具有理论保证与广泛实验支持。

title: RIPPLE in Still Water: Zero-Shot Clustering in Federated Learning with Wavelet Scattering Transform
summary: Clustered Federated Learning (FL) partitions a client population into groups of similar local distributions and trains one specialized model per cluster, mitigating client drift that degrades single-model methods under non-IID data. Prior methods discover cluster structure inside the training loop through gradient similarity, loss evaluation, or EM-style updates, thus increasing communication overhead, exposing gradients to inversion attacks, and providing no mechanism to assign clients absent from training. We propose RIPPLE, a clustered FL framework in which cluster assignment is computed entirely offline from a spectral characterization of each client's local data: a variance-weighted principal-component prototype embedded via the Wavelet Scattering Transform and decoded by a Gaussian Mixture VAE trained server-side on synthetic client populations before federation begins. Per-round communication cost matches FedAvg exactly, and a client absent from training obtains a personalized model from a single forward pass, without gradient computation, model evaluation, or extra communication round. We prove that the gap between RIPPLE's surrogate clustered objective and the oracle is bounded by a computable quantity decaying with client sample size and independent of federation duration; per-cluster convergence matches the minimax-optimal rate for non-convex smooth objectives. Across five benchmarks spanning controlled and realistic heterogeneity, RIPPLE consistently outperforms all baselines, with margins growing on the most realistic partitions.

AI.tldr: RIPPLE是一种聚类联邦学习框架，完全离线基于客户端本地数据的谱表征计算聚类归属，每轮通信成本与FedAvg相同，缺席客户端可通过单次前向传播获得个性化模型。
AI.motivation: 解决非IID数据下联邦学习的客户端漂移问题。现有聚类联邦学习方法在训练循环内通过梯度相似度、损失评估或EM式更新来发现聚类结构，导致通信开销增加、梯度暴露于反演攻击，且无法为训练时缺席的客户端分配模型。
AI.method: RIPPLE完全离线地从每个客户端本地数据的谱表征计算聚类归属：使用方差加权主成分原型，经小波散射变换嵌入，并由在联邦开始前于服务器端合成客户端总体上训练的GMM-VAE解码。每轮通信成本与FedAvg完全一致；缺席客户端可通过单次前向传播获得个性化模型，无需梯度计算、模型评估或额外通信轮次。
AI.result: 理论方面证明RIPPLE的代理聚类目标与oracle之间的差距由可计算量界定，该量随客户端样本量衰减且与联邦时长无关；每聚类收敛速率匹配非凸光滑目标的极小极大最优速率。在五个涵盖受控与真实异质性的基准上，RIPPLE一致优于所有基线，且在最真实的划分上优势更大。
AI.conclusion: RIPPLE通过离线谱聚类归属实现了与FedAvg等价的通信成本，并支持零成本为缺席客户端分配个性化模型，在理论与实验上均优于现有聚类联邦学习方法，尤其在真实异质性场景下优势更为明显。

title: When Does Synthetic Relational Data Teach Models to Use Relations? Tracing Predictive Structure from Pretraining Data to Model Behavior
summary: Relational foundation models are increasingly pretrained on synthetic databases, yet downstream benchmarks reveal little about why one synthetic corpus produces a better model than another. In particular, strong performance may arise from realistic row-level statistics without the model ever learning to use relational structure. We study this as a data-attribution problem: which property of synthetic pretraining data induces relational computation? Using four Relational Transformer checkpoints trained with the same architecture, initialization, objective, and compute budget on corpora produced by four relational data generators, we trace a measurable property of the data to learned computation and downstream behavior. We hypothesize that relational mechanisms emerge when cross-table information is predictively necessary for the masked-cell pretraining objective. RelDiff exhibits by far the largest predictive gain from foreign-key-linked parents, and its corresponding model is uniquely sensitive to foreign-key interventions on unseen databases. This dependence survives a random-initialization control, grows monotonically with the fraction of corrupted links, and localizes to a serial cross-table pathway. Finally, disrupting the same mechanism during downstream inference removes RelDiff's advantage on relational tasks while leaving structure-insensitive models nearly unchanged. These results connect a property of synthetic training data to a learned mechanism and, through intervention, to downstream behavior.

AI.tldr: 本文把合成关系数据预训练中的"数据属性—学习机制—下游行为"作为数据归因问题，证明关系机制的涌现取决于跨表信息对掩码单元预训练目标是否具有预测必要性。
AI.motivation: 关系基础模型越来越多地使用合成数据库预训练，但下游基准无法解释为何某个合成语料比另一个更好。强表现可能仅来自逼真的行级统计分布，而模型并未真正学会使用关系结构，因此需要识别是合成数据中的哪种属性诱导了关系计算。
AI.method: 控制变量实验：使用相同架构、初始化、目标函数和算力预算的四个 Relational Transformer 检查点，分别在四个关系数据生成器产出的语料上训练。以"跨表信息对掩码单元预测目标的预测增益"为假设属性，比较各语料中由外键连接的父表带来的预测增益，并对模型施加外键干预（含随机初始化对照、损坏链接比例单调递增）以定位计算路径。
AI.result: RelDiff 语料中父表通过外键带来的预测增益远高于其他生成器，其对应模型对未见数据库上的外键干预具有独特敏感性；该依赖性在随机初始化对照下依然存在，随损坏链接比例单调增强，并定位于一条串行的跨表通路；在下游推理时破坏该机制会消除 RelDiff 在关系任务上的优势，而对结构不敏感的模型几乎无影响。
AI.conclusion: 当跨表信息对掩码单元预训练目标具有预测必要性时，关系机制才会涌现；研究将合成训练数据的某一属性与所学机制联系起来，并通过干预进一步关联到下游行为。

title: Learning Transferable Policies from Action-free Time Series Through Dynamical Embeddings
summary: Learning control from action-free recordings is challenging because intervention effects are unobserved and policies may exploit errors in reconstructed dynamics. We present a hierarchical model-based reinforcement learning framework that uses shared structure across related systems to learn system-specific control policies from action-free recordings. A hierarchical dynamical system reconstruction model captures shared dynamics and individual variation through low-dimensional embeddings. These embeddings are then reused to parameterize shared policy and value networks, linking differences in reconstructed dynamics to differences in control. Policies are trained entirely via simulation under an explicit intervention model with additive latent perturbations. Piecewise-linear recurrent neural networks enable mechanistic analyses of the controlled dynamics, while decoder-based constraints make the immediate effects of interventions interpretable in observation space and permit interventions on one modality while protecting another from direct manipulation. On Lorenz-63 and double-pendulum systems, hierarchical policies improve transfer over independently trained policies. On Lorenz-63, they also achieve a higher mean reward than repeated planning with the same reconstructed models, perform comparably to methods trained with controlled interactions, and generalize to systems absent from policy training after embedding inference alone. Applications to neural-behavioral recordings demonstrate suppression of predicted movement under constrained neural perturbations. Together, these findings show how shared dynamical representations support transferable control and mechanistic hypothesis generation from action-free recordings.

AI.tldr: 提出分层基于模型的强化学习框架，通过共享动力学结构与嵌入实现无动作记录下的可迁移控制。
AI.motivation: 无动作记录中干预效果不可观测，且策略易利用重建动力学中的误差，导致学习控制困难；需要借用相关系统间的共享结构。
AI.method: 分层动力学系统重建模型用低维嵌入捕获共享动力学与个体差异，嵌入复用于共享策略与价值网络参数化；策略在显式干预模型（加性潜扰动）下完全经仿真训练；采用分段线性RNN（PLRNN）支持机制分析，解码器约束使干预即时效应在观测空间可解释，并允许单模态干预而保护另一模态。
AI.result: 在Lorenz-63与双摆系统上，分层策略相比独立训练策略提升迁移性能；Lorenz-63上平均奖励高于同重建模型的重复规划，与使用受控交互训练的方法相当；经嵌入推断后可泛化到未参与策略训练的系统。神经-行为记录应用显示在受限神经扰动下可抑制预测运动。
AI.conclusion: 共享动力学表征支持从无动作记录中实现可迁移控制并生成机制性假设。

title: Learn Feasibility Once, Optimize All Objectives: Derivative-Free Diffusion Models for Chance-Constrained Programming
summary: Chance-constrained programs (CCPs) optimize decisions under uncertainty by limiting the probability of constraint violation. Despite advances in traditional and learning-based approaches, optimizing non-convex or non-smooth objectives and adapting to different objectives under fixed chance constraints remain challenging. In this paper, we propose a \textbf{D}erivative-free \textbf{D}iffusion-based framework that \textbf{D}isentangles constraint modeling from objective optimization, termed \textbf{D$^3$Opt}. We learn the chance-feasible structure once, independently of any particular objective, by training a risk-conditioned diffusion model solely on constraint-filtered decisions and freezing it as a reusable prior for post-specified objectives. At inference time, we propose an annealed, particle-based Feynman--Kac correction along the frozen reverse diffusion process to optimize post-specified objectives using only function evaluations. This enables derivative-free optimization of non-convex and non-smooth objectives without objective-specific retraining. We prove that the correction preserves feasibility when this property holds for the frozen prior, and derive an optimization-error bound separating learned-prior coverage, finite-particle approximation, and finite-temperature effects. Experiments on linear Gaussian CCPs, objective-transfer tasks, and chance-constrained economic dispatch demonstrate effective optimization across smooth and non-smooth objectives, including non-convex cases, and objective generalization under fixed chance constraints without retraining.

AI.tldr: 提出D³Opt，将机会约束的约束建模与目标优化解耦：先训练风险条件扩散模型学习可复用可行域先验，再在冻结的逆向扩散上做退火粒子Feynman–Kac校正，实现无需目标重训的无导数优化。
AI.motivation: 机会约束规划中，传统与学习类方法难以优化非凸/非光滑目标，且在固定机会约束下更换目标需重新训练，缺乏复用性与适应性。
AI.method: 用一个风险条件扩散模型仅在约束筛过的决策上训练，学习与目标无关的机会可行结构并冻结为可复用先验；推理时沿冻结逆向扩散过程施加退火、基于粒子的Feynman–Kac校正，仅用函数评估来优化事后给定的目标，因而不需目标特定重训。
AI.result: 理论上证明当冻结先验满足可行性时该校正保持可行性，并给出将优化误差分解为学习先验覆盖、有限粒子近似与有限温度效应的界。在线性高斯CCP、目标迁移任务与机会约束经济调度上，对光滑与非光滑目标（含非凸情形）均取得有效优化，并实现固定约束下的目标泛化且无需重训。
AI.conclusion: 通过解耦约束建模与目标优化，D³Opt为固定机会约束下的事后目标优化提供了可复用、无导数且具理论保证的框架。

title: Smart Sensing for Safer Bridges: From Sensor Signals to AI-Driven Anomaly Detection
summary: Bridges contribute significantly to transportation connectivity and urban development. Therefore, reliable bridge monitoring is crucial for protecting public safety and detecting anomalous behavior in bridge sensor data that may provide early indications of abnormal structural conditions. This paper investigates anomaly detection in real-world bridge sensor data using two different complementary approaches, namely signal processing and the data-driven machine learning model Isolation Forest. The real-time bridge sensor data is collected from an iBridge sensor device installed on a bridge in Norway. The methods are evaluated using anomaly counts, anomaly detection time, processing rate, anomaly rates, visualization, and temporal agreement. Moreover, a controlled anomaly-injection analysis is performed to evaluate the sensitivity of each method. Numerical results demonstrate distinct detection characteristics and computational requirements, highlighting the potential of machine learning, particularly the data-driven Isolation Forest, alongside signal processing for identifying anomalies in bridge sensor measurements.

AI.tldr: 本文针对挪威某桥梁实测传感器数据，采用信号处理与Isolation Forest机器学习两类方法开展异常检测，并通过多指标与受控异常注入实验进行比较评估。
AI.motivation: 桥梁对交通连通与城市发展至关重要，可靠的桥梁监测对保障公共安全、及早发现结构异常征兆十分关键，因此需要有效的桥梁传感器数据异常检测方法。
AI.method: 数据来自部署于挪威某桥梁的iBridge传感器设备，实时采集；采用两种互补方法——信号处理与数据驱动机器学习模型Isolation Forest；评估指标包括异常计数、异常检测时间、处理速率、异常率、可视化及时间一致性；并开展受控异常注入分析以评估各方法灵敏度。
AI.result: 数值结果表明两种方法具有不同的检测特性与计算需求；机器学习方法（尤其是数据驱动的Isolation Forest）与信号处理在识别桥梁传感器测量异常方面均展现出潜力。
AI.conclusion: 信号处理与Isolation Forest在桥梁传感器异常检测中各具特点、可互补，机器学习方法具有应用潜力，具体方法选择需权衡检测性能与计算开销。

title: Light Entropic Optimal Transport on Riemannian Manifolds
summary: Entropic Optimal Transport (EOT) has become a practical framework for learning stochastic couplings between complex distributions, with applications in generative modeling and domain adaptation. However, most EOT solvers are designed for Euclidean spaces, while manifold extensions remain limited and often rely on costly iterative methods, simulated dynamics, or generic neural models that do not fully exploit the underlying geometry. We introduce ManifoldLightOT, a light approach for learning kernel-induced EOT couplings directly on common manifolds. Using the kernel form of the EOT solution, we construct geometry-specific Gibbs kernels together with compatible potential parameterizations for spheres, tori, $\mathrm{SO}(3)$, and $\mathrm{SE}(3)$. These choices yield closed-form normalization and directly sampleable conditional distributions. Our formulation naturally extends to products of manifolds, making it applicable to more complex geometries. The parameters of the potentials are optimized directly from samples using Monte Carlo estimates of the learning objective. Through synthetic and real-world experiments, we show that ManifoldLightOT often outperforms existing manifold OT methods while retaining direct sampling.

AI.tldr: ManifoldLightOT：在球面、环面、SO(3)、SE(3)等流形上学习核诱导熵最优传输耦合的轻量方法，具闭式归一化与可采样条件分布。
AI.motivation: 现有熵最优传输（EOT）求解器多针对欧氏空间；流形扩展有限，常依赖高成本迭代、模拟动力学或通用神经模型，未充分利用几何结构。
AI.method: 利用EOT解的核形式，为各流形构造几何特定的Gibbs核及相容势参数化，得到闭式归一化与可直接采样的条件分布；用蒙特卡洛估计学习目标直接由样本优化势参数，并可自然推广到流形乘积。
AI.result: 在合成与真实数据实验中，ManifoldLightOT常优于现有流形OT方法，同时保持直接采样能力。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为常见流形及其乘积提供轻量、可采样的流形EOT学习框架，兼顾几何利用与性能。

title: Zephon: Elastic Determinism for Online, Stateful Foundation Model Data Loading Pipelines
comment: preprint; currently under revision at VLDB'27
summary:
Deterministic data loading is important for foundation model development: model researchers need confidence that differences they observe across costly ablations are caused by the parameter they changed rather than non-determinism in the training data sequence. The data loader must provide elastic determinism, i.e., a deterministic sequence of global training data batches despite changes to the GPU topology across runs (e.g., due to GPU scarcity), frequent checkpoint-resume cycles, and different data processing execution backends. Achieving this is difficult because modern foundation model data pipelines tokenize, pack, and mix samples online, introducing stateful n-to-m transformations that break sample indexing. Existing data loaders largely assume indexable 1-to-1 pipelines, and the common workaround of offline materialization is expensive and, for some modalities such as video, infeasible.
  We present Zephon, a data loader for foundation models that supports online, stateful pipelines while providing elastic determinism and efficient resumption from checkpoints. It partitions the global stream into topology-independent lanes, serializes ordering decisions while parallelizing stateless work on interchangeable backends, and checkpoints only bounded in-flight state so recovery cost does not grow with training progress. We evaluate Zephon on text and vision-language workloads and show that it achieves competitive throughput while providing a combination of guarantees that no existing loader offers for online, stateful pipelines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Zephon，一种面向基础模型训练的数据加载器，在支持在线、有状态流水线的同时提供弹性确定性（跨 GPU 拓扑、频繁断点续训、不同执行后端下的全局批次序列可复现），并实现高效的断点恢复。
AI.motivation: 基础模型研发中，研究者需确保昂贵消融实验间的差异源于被改动的参数，而非训练数据序列的非确定性。因此数据加载器必须具备"弹性确定性"：在 GPU 拓扑变化（如 GPU 资源紧张）、频繁的检查点-恢复周期以及不同数据处理执行后端下，仍能给出确定性的全局训练批次序列。然而现有加载器多假设可索引的 1-to-1 流水线，而现代流水线在线进行分词、打包和混合，引入有状态的 n-to-m 变换，破坏了样本索引；常见的离线物化方案代价高，对视频等模态甚至不可行。
AI.method: Zephon 将全局数据流划分为与拓扑无关的 lane；串行化排序决策，同时将无状态工作在可互换的后端上并行执行；仅对有限的在途状态（bounded in-flight state）做检查点，使恢复代价不随训练进度增长。
AI.result: 在文本与视觉-语言工作负载上评估，Zephon 在取得有竞争力吞吐量的同时，提供了现有加载器在在线、有状态流水线下均不具备的保证组合。
AI.conclusion: Zephon 解决了在线有状态流水线中弹性确定性与高效恢复的难题，兼顾吞吐与可复现性，为依赖严格对比实验的基础模型研发提供了可靠的数据加载方案。

title: ULTRADISCOVERY: Abductive Exploration in an Interconnected, Epistemically Open Universe
summary: Scientific discovery often begins when scattered clues call for a new way of describing the world. Such abductive exploration can require constructing the representation in which an explanation is stated, when the world is epistemically open, and composing evidence scattered across contexts, when it is structurally interconnected. Existing benchmarks rarely separate these two demands or control them independently. We introduce ULTRADISCOVERY, an interactive world of five domains in which an agent revises an initially successful theory and predicts the outcome of an unseen cross-domain intervention. A $2 \times 2$ design leaves the representation open or discloses it, and leaves the evidence distributed or aligns it, with the latent dynamics fixed. With the representation open, agents across eleven models often retract the axiom they were taught, and none introduces the unobserved entity or rewrites the variables that a replacement requires. Disclosure triples intervention requests and adds about one of the eighteen findings the world affords, and alignment adds less. Two vendor-harness systems carry discovery into more domains, and one of them rewrites the variables in Open episodes. No system makes the exact prediction within 200 paid actions. At larger budgets one exact prediction appears with both aids, while every Open episode remains inexact. The results locate the difficulty in the step from accumulating evidence to composing it into a representation that transfers.

AI.tldr: 提出交互式基准 ULTRADISCOVERY，用 2×2 设计分离"表征开放性"与"证据分布性"两个溯因发现要素，评测 11 个模型在五域世界中的理论修正与跨域干预预测能力。
AI.motivation: 科学发现常始于零散线索呼唤新的世界描述方式。此类溯因探索包含两种需求：在世界认识论开放时构建可表述解释的表征，以及在结构互联时跨情境组合证据。现有基准很少将这两者分离或独立控制。
AI.method: 构建 ULTRADISCOVERY 交互世界，含五个领域，智能体需修订最初成功的理论并预测未见跨域干预结果。采用 2×2 设计：表征开放 vs. 披露，证据分布 vs. 对齐，同时固定潜在动力学。共评测 11 个模型及两个厂商-框架系统。
AI.result: 表征开放时，11 个模型常撤回被教授的axiom，且无一引入未观测实体或重写变量；披露使干预请求增至三倍，仅增加约 1/18 项可得发现，证据对齐增益更小。两个厂商-框架系统拓展至更多领域，其中一个在 Open 回合重写变量。无系统能在 200 次付费动作内做出精确预测；更大预算下，仅在两种辅助同时具备时出现一次精确预测，而所有 Open 回合仍不精确。
AI.conclusion: 结果将难点定位在从"积累证据"到"组合为可迁移表征"之间的跃迁步骤。

title: LS-AR: Future-Predictive Latent Steering in Autoregressive LLMs
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop: Long-Context Foundation Models
summary: Standard autoregressive (AR) models process high-level task instructions, state history, and transient tokens within a single shared sequence of tokens. Consequently, they lack the architectural mechanisms needed to isolate macro-objectives from context noise. To overcome this single-channel limitation, we introduce Latent-Steered Autoregressive (LS-AR), a dual-channel architecture that decouples continuous goal steering from discrete token decoding via FiLM conditioning. We evaluate a Static Goal Encoder (P_0) for persistent macro-objective retention across long rollouts and a Dynamic State Tracker (P_t) for recurrent latent updates during generation. On long-horizon retrieval past context limits (H=1024, W=500), LS-AR (Static) achieves 100% target recall where parameter-matched baselines collapse (0%), while increasing throughput by ~35% and cutting peak VRAM by 52.8%. In Blocksworld planning under forced perturbations (k=1), LS-AR (Dynamic) sustains an 89.0% completion rate vs. 71.0% for the baseline, though zero-shot entity scaling (N -> N+1) exposes single-vector capacity limits (0%). Finally, dual-channel authority analysis shows that text goal dropout establishes latent-dominant control, offering structural defence against text prompt injection while introducing a latent vector attack surface.

AI.tldr: 提出双通道自回归架构 LS-AR，通过 FiLM 条件将连续目标引导与离散 token 解码解耦，以解决标准 AR 模型单通道无法隔离宏观目标与上下文噪声的问题。
AI.motivation: 标准自回归模型将高层任务指令、状态历史和瞬态 token 混在单一共享 token 序列中处理，缺乏从上下文噪声中隔离宏观目标（macro-objectives）的架构机制，即单通道限制。
AI.method: Latent-Steered Autoregressive (LS-AR) 双通道架构：通过 FiLM conditioning 将连续目标引导（goal steering）与离散 token 解码解耦。评估两种通道实现——Static Goal Encoder (P_0) 用于长 rollout 中持久保持宏观目标，Dynamic State Tracker (P_t) 用于生成过程中的循环潜变量更新。并进行双通道权威性分析。
AI.result: 长时程检索超过上下文限制（H=1024, W=500）时，LS-AR (Static) 目标召回率 100%，参数匹配基线崩塌至 0%，吞吐提升约 35%，峰值 VRAM 降低 52.8%；Blocksworld 强制扰动规划（k=1）下，LS-AR (Dynamic) 完成率 89.0% vs 基线 71.0%，但零样本实体扩展（N→N+1）暴露单向量容量限制（0%）。双通道权威分析表明文本目标 dropout 可建立潜变量主导控制，提供对文本提示注入的结构性防御，同时引入潜向量攻击面。
AI.conclusion: 解耦的潜空间引导机制能有效隔离宏观目标、提升长时程检索与规划鲁棒性及效率，但存在单向量容量瓶颈与潜向量攻击面等权衡；双通道权威分配可作为对文本提示注入的结构性防御手段。

title: Exploring the Trade-Off Between Structured Pruning and Fault Tolerance in Deep Neural Networks for Space Applications
summary: Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) inherently exhibit a degree of robustness to bit-level faults due to their distributed representation of information. As a model increases in width, this information becomes more dispersed, theoretically reducing the impact of any single bit fault. In this paper, we empirically investigate the relationship between model width and robustness to Single Event Upsets (SEUs). We conduct a comprehensive experiment in which baseline models undergo iterative structured pruning to reduce their width while preserving task performance as much as possible. At each pruning stage, we run a targeted fault-injection campaign to evaluate the model's performance under simulated bit-flip scenarios. Our results show that, although structured pruning increases per-inference sensitivity to faults by reducing redundancy, this effect is effectively counterbalanced by shorter execution time, which lowers the probability of encountering an SEU. These findings suggest that structured pruning can yield significant energy and latency savings without compromising overall reliability, providing useful guidance for designing robust AI systems for space applications.

AI.tldr: 本文实证研究了DNN模型宽度与单粒子翻转（SEU）鲁棒性的关系，发现结构化剪枝虽提高单次推理对故障的敏感度，但执行时间缩短降低了遭遇SEU的概率，二者相互抵消。
AI.motivation: DNN因分布式信息表示天然具有一定位级故障鲁棒性，且理论上模型越宽信息越分散、单个位故障影响越小。作者希望实证验证模型宽度与SEU鲁棒性之间的关系，为面向航天应用的可靠AI系统设计提供依据。
AI.method: 对基线模型进行迭代式结构化剪枝以在尽量保持任务性能的前提下缩减宽度；在每一剪枝阶段开展针对性的故障注入实验，评估模型在模拟位翻转场景下的性能表现。
AI.result: 结构化剪枝因减少冗余而提高了单次推理对故障的敏感度，但这一负面影响被更短的执行时间所抵消——执行时间缩短降低了遭遇SEU的概率。
AI.conclusion: 结构化剪枝可在不牺牲整体可靠性的前提下显著节省能耗与延迟，为面向航天应用的鲁棒AI系统设计提供了有益指导。

title: Coverage You Can Steer: Online Conformal Calibration for RL-Driven Hardware-Aware NAS
summary: Hardware-aware neural architecture search (NAS) is dominated by evaluation cost: every architecture must be trained before its reward is known. Conformal-prediction filters cut this cost by pruning candidates whose predicted-reward upper bound misses a threshold, with a distribution-free guarantee that at most a fraction $δ$ are wrongly discarded. That guarantee assumes exchangeability between calibration and test candidates, which the surrounding reinforcement-learning (RL) loop violates: the policy's proposals improve as search proceeds and, in layer-by-layer construction, shift within every episode. We replace one-shot quantile estimation with online feedback control (Adaptive Conformal Inference, with tuning-free, locally-adaptive, and group-conditional variants), restoring steerable coverage: dialing the target delivers it, monotonically and reproducibly, for arbitrary sequences. Across three neural-network architecture families and both single-step and sequential search (three seeds), it tracks every requested level to within ${\sim}10^{-3}$ while pruning 25-50% of evaluations at no measured accuracy cost, whereas static calibration loses control of its coverage and a Gaussian-process baseline stays conservative regardless of the request. Finally, used as an acquisition function on one constrained testbed, the same optimistic bound beats random search, a gain that fixed optimism already carries and online calibration sharpens. The source code is available at https://github.com/Vicomtech/rl-hw-nas.

AI.tldr: 将一次性分位数估计替换为在线反馈控制（自适应保形推断），在RL驱动的硬件感知NAS中恢复可控覆盖率，至多可剪枝25-50%的评估且无可测精度损失。
AI.motivation: 硬件感知NAS的主要成本在于评估：每个架构都需训练后才能获知奖励。已有的保形预测过滤器通过剪掉预测奖励上界低于阈值的候选来降本，并带有分布无关保证（误弃比例不超过δ）。但该保证依赖校准集与测试候选间的可交换性，而外围强化学习循环破坏这一假设——策略提案随搜索推进而改进，且在逐层构建时每个episode内部也会发生分布漂移。
AI.method: 用在线反馈控制替代一次性分位数估计：采用自适应保形推断，并涵盖免调参、局部自适应与分组条件三种变体，以在任意序列上恢复可操控的覆盖率。
AI.result: 在三种神经网络架构族、单步与序列搜索（三个随机种子）上，该方法将每个请求的覆盖水平跟踪到约10^-3以内，同时剪枝25-50%的评估且未测得精度损失；静态校准则失去覆盖控制，高斯过程基线无论请求如何都保持保守。作为约束测试台上的采集函数，该乐观上界优于随机搜索；这一增益固定乐观性已具备，在线校准进一步强化。
AI.conclusion: 在线自适应保形校准可有效消除RL循环中可交换性失效带来的覆盖失控问题，实现精确、单调、可复现的覆盖率控制，在不损精度的前提下显著降低NAS评估成本，并能作为有效的采集函数。代码已开源。

title: Page-EntroKV: Hardware-Aligned, Entropy-Weighted KV-Cache Eviction under Grouped-Query Attention
comment: 24 pages, 8 figures, 10 tables. Formal framework with pilot-scale empirical validation on Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct. Includes step-by-step derivations (Appendix C) and PyTorch reference implementation (Appendix D). Code and data available at: https://github.com/bruce12-glitch/PageEntro-KV
summary: Serving long-context autoregressive language models is constrained by the key-value (KV) cache. Most dynamic eviction methods score token importance per query head and choose tokens independently. This fits poorly with grouped-query attention (GQA), where several query heads share one physical KV buffer: divergent per-head selections force the serving engine to retain the union of their choices - inflating the cache by up to the group ratio r - while arithmetic mean pooling dilutes the specialized retrieval heads that carry factual recall. We introduce Page-EntroKV, a formal framework for KV-cache eviction operating at the granularity GQA serving actually allocates. Heads within each physical group are pooled by weights derived from sink-isolated collision (Renyi-2) entropy - one inner product per head, computed once at prefill with no calibration - so sink heads cannot masquerade as retrieval heads. Pooled scores are projected onto PagedAttention page frames, and eviction executes at the hardware tuple (layer, group, page). We formalize the union overhead ratio (UOR) and intra-group disagreement, prove an exact identity linking them for two-head groups alongside two-sided bounds at every group ratio, prove strict budget preservation and a finite-context needle-retention bound that arithmetic mean pooling provably violates, and give exact per-layer page accounting. On a pilot architecture (Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct, r=6), head-independent replay over 2,240 group measurements yields union overhead up to 4.75x at a 2% budget, while Page-EntroKV holds UOR exactly 1.000; sink isolation removes a 13x sink masquerade; needle recall is 100% versus 0% for mean pooling at a 20% budget; retained cardinality is exact for every page size; and QA and code tasks remain solvable at 20% retention.

AI.tldr: 提出 Page-EntroKV 框架，在 GQA 物理分组粒度上做 KV 缓存淘汰：用 sink 隔离的 Renyi-2 熵加权池化组内各头分数，并映射到 PagedAttention 页框，实现按 (layer, group, page) 硬件元组的淘汰，消除并集开销。
AI.motivation: 长上下文自回归模型的推理受 KV 缓存制约。现有动态淘汰方法按 query head 独立评分与选 token，与 GQA（多 query head 共享单个物理 KV 缓存）不匹配：各头选择分歧会迫使引擎保留其并集，使缓存膨胀最多达组比 r 倍；而算术平均池化又会稀释承担事实召回的专用检索头。
AI.method: 在 GQA 实际分配的物理组粒度上进行淘汰。组内各头按 sink 隔离的碰撞（Renyi-2）熵导出权重进行池化，每头仅一次内积，在 prefill 阶段一次性计算且无需校准，从而使 sink 头无法伪装成检索头。池化后的分数投影到 PagedAttention 页框，淘汰在 (layer, group, page) 硬件元组上执行。形式上定义并集开销比（UOR）与组内分歧，证明二者的精确恒等式（双头组）与任意组比下的双侧界，证明严格预算保持性和算术平均池化必然违反的有限上下文针保留界，并给出逐层页计数的精确公式。
AI.result: 在 Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct（r=6）上的实验显示：基于 2,240 个组测量的头独立重放，在 2% 预算下并集开销高达 4.75x，而 Page-EntroKV 的 UOR 恒为 1.000；sink 隔离消除了 13x 的 sink 伪装；20% 预算下针召回为 100%，均值池化为 0%；各种页大小下保留基数均精确；QA 与代码任务在 20% 保留率下仍可求解。
AI.conclusion: 按 query head 独立淘汰与 GQA 的共享物理缓存结构存在根本性错配，导致缓存膨胀与检索能力稀释。将淘汰下沉到 GQA 物理分组粒度，并以 sink 隔离熵加权池化，可精确消除并集开销、保持预算、避免 sink 伪装，并显著提升长上下文召回与下游任务表现。

title: Sample complexity of variance-reduced policy gradient: weaker assumptions and lower bounds
summary: Several variance-reduced versions of REINFORCE based on importance sampling achieve an improved $O(ε^{-3})$ sample complexity to find an $ε$-stationary point, under an unrealistic assumption on the variance of the importance weights. In this paper, we propose the \algo (Defensive Policy Gradient) algorithm, based on defensive importance sampling, which achieves the same rate without any assumption on the variance of ordinary importance weights. We also establish lower bounds in a generalized black-box policy-optimization model that hides states and actions and permits parameter-dependent rewards. In this model, the optimal rates are $Θ(ε^{-4})$ with bounded-variance one-policy feedback and $Θ(ε^{-3})$ with mean-square-smooth coupled two-policy feedback. Under standard policy-regularity conditions, REINFORCE and \algo realize the corresponding oracle conditions and attain the $O(ε^{-4})$ and $O(ε^{-3})$ upper bounds, respectively. Although the lower bounds do not apply directly to the classical MDP interaction model in which these algorithms operate, this correspondence provides oracle-level evidence that the faster rate of \algo is optimal and genuinely separated from that of vanilla policy gradient.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Defensive Policy Gradient（\algo）算法，基于防御性重要性采样，在不对普通重要性权重方差作任何假设的前提下，达到 $O(\epsilon^{-3})$ 的样本复杂度；并通过广义黑盒策略优化模型的下界分析，给出 \algo 速率最优且与普通策略梯度存在真实分离的 oracle 级证据。
AI.motivation: 已有基于重要性采样的方差缩减 REINFORCE 变体虽能达到 $O(\epsilon^{-3})$ 样本复杂度，但其依赖对重要性权重方差的不现实假设。作者希望在不引入该假设的情况下保持快速率，并从理论上澄清该快速率是否本质优于普通策略梯度。
AI.method: 提出 \algo（Defensive Policy Gradient）算法，采用防御性重要性采样以控制重要性权重方差；并在隐藏状态与动作、允许参数依赖奖励的广义黑盒策略优化模型中建立下界，区分有界方差单策略反馈与均方光滑耦合双策略反馈两类 oracle 条件；在标准策略正则条件下将 REINFORCE 与 \algo 与相应 oracle 条件对应。
AI.result: 在该广义模型中，有界方差单策略反馈的最优速率为 $\Theta(\epsilon^{-4})$，均方光滑耦合双策略反馈的最优速率为 $\Theta(\epsilon^{-3})$。REINFORCE 与 \algo 分别实现对应 oracle 条件，达到 $O(\epsilon^{-4})$ 与 $O(\epsilon^{-3})$ 的上界；\algo 无需重要性权重方差假设即达到 $O(\epsilon^{-3})$。
AI.conclusion: 下界虽不直接适用于这些算法实际运行的经典 MDP 交互模型，但这种对应关系提供了 oracle 级证据，表明 \algo 的更快速率是最优的，且与普通策略梯度的速率存在本质分离。

title: Predicting and Repairing Merge Collapse in Large Language Models
summary: Large language models fine-tuned from a shared base can be merged by averaging their task vectors, but some merges collapse far below the base model, and common merge operators give no warning before evaluation. We show that one statistic of the specialists' task vectors both predicts this collapse and calibrates its repair. The power that averaging removes equals the variance of the task vectors across specialists, our measure of interference. Under a working noise model, the disturbance that a merge injects grows with the merge coefficient and with interference, yielding a pre-merge score. In our experiments on twenty-two merge configurations from four model families, only destructive merges exceed a threshold on this score. We find that statistics of sign conflict between specialists, a common target of existing merge operators, are anti-predictive. We then predicted the outcomes of fourteen merges before evaluating them, and twelve predictions were correct, including the destructive outcome of a specialist pair pushed past the threshold by continued pretraining. To address this collapse, we introduce PRISM, an operator that averages the task vectors first and then soft-thresholds each layer at a level set by the layer's interference. Without data or tuning, PRISM keeps all five destructive merges above the threshold within evaluation noise of the base model, where plain averaging falls at least 14.4 points below it or collapses entirely. We apply PRISM only above the threshold and keep the plain average for merges below it, which include all fifteen harmless ones. Code is available at https://github.com/js-lee-AI/PRISM.

AI.tldr: 本文提出用「任务向量方差」度量专家模型间的干扰，据此在合并前预测并校准模型合并的崩溃；并给出算子PRISM，先平均再按各层干扰水平做软阈值处理，从而在无需数据和调参的情况下修复破坏性合并。
AI.motivation: 共享基座微调得到的大模型可通过平均任务向量合并，但部分合并会远低于基座性能；现有合并算子无法在评估前给出预警，即崩溃缺乏可预测性与可控修复手段。
AI.method: 提出干扰度量：平均所移除的「功率」等于各专家任务向量的方差；在噪声模型下，合并注入的扰动随合并系数与干扰增大，从而得到预合并评分与阈值。基于该统计量，提出PRISM：先平均任务向量，再按每层干扰水平对每层做软阈值。仅在超过阈值时启用PRISM，未超阈值时保持普通平均。
AI.result: 在四个模型族、22种合并配置上，仅破坏性合并超过评分阈值；符号冲突类统计反而呈反向预测。预先预测14次合并，12次正确，包括持续预训练把专家对推过阈值导致破坏性结果的情形。PRISM在无需数据与调参下使全部5个破坏性合并保持在阈值以上、与基座差异在评估噪声内，而普通平均至少低14.4分或完全崩溃；15个无害合并全部未超阈值。
AI.conclusion: 任务向量方差（干扰）可同时预测与校准合并崩溃，PRISM作为按层干扰加权的软阈值修复算子，能有效避免破坏性合并，且仅在必要时介入，保持普通平均的简洁性。

title: HyperFuse: Fast Self-Supervised Node Embeddings for Attributed Hypergraphs
summary: Self-supervised hypergraph representation learning can produce informative node embeddings, but existing methods often require deep encoders trained for hundreds of epochs, making embedding generation costly even for hypergraphs with a few thousand nodes. This limits applications requiring embeddings for many or evolving hypergraphs. We present HyperFuse, a label-free pipeline for fast hypergraph representation learning. HyperFuse (i) computes structural node coordinates by maximizing a spectral relaxation of hypergraph modularity using Banerjee's hypergraph adjacency and a matrix-free operator with cost linear in node-hyperedge incidences; (ii) constructs multi-scale feature summaries and assigns bounded utility weights to hyperedges based on member stability under feature and membership masking; and (iii) trains a lightweight utility-weighted hypergraph encoder for 100 epochs using an invariance-decorrelation objective. We compare HyperFuse with TriCL, SE-HSSL, VilLain, and HypeBoy on nine public hypergraphs using six downstream classifiers and k-means clustering. On the eight datasets where all methods completed, HyperFuse required 8.7 s per dataset on average, achieving 13-179x geometric-mean speed-ups over the baselines. It achieved the highest average accuracy with five of six classifiers, while classification and clustering performance was not significantly different from TriCL and SE-HSSL. Compared with HypeBoy, HyperFuse was 13x faster and 2.1-4.1 percentage points more accurate across all classifiers. HyperFuse provides a practical approach for fast, repeated hypergraph embedding generation.

AI.tldr: HyperFuse：一种无标签、快速超图表示学习流水线，通过谱坐标、多尺度特征摘要与轻量编码器，在九数据集上实现13-179倍加速且精度持平或更优。
AI.motivation: 现有自监督超图表示学习方法需训练深编码器数百轮，即使几千节点的超图嵌入生成代价也很高，限制了需要为大量或演化超图生成嵌入的应用。
AI.method: HyperFuse包含三部分：(i) 利用Banerjee超图邻接与无矩阵算子，在代价与节点-超边关联数成线性关系下，通过最大化超图模块度的谱松弛计算结构节点坐标；(ii) 构建多尺度特征摘要，并基于特征与隶属掩码下成员稳定性为超边分配有界效用权重；(iii) 用不变性-去相关目标训练轻量效用加权超图编码器100轮。
AI.result: 在九个公开超图上，用六种下游分类器与k-means聚类，与TriCL、SE-HSSL、VilLain、HypeBoy比较。在全部方法均完成的八个数据集上，平均每数据集8.7秒，相对基线几何平均加速13-179倍；六种分类器中五种取得最高平均准确率，分类与聚类性能与TriCL、SE-HSSL无显著差异；相比HypeBoy快13倍且准确率高2.1-4.1个百分点。
AI.conclusion: HyperFuse为快速、可重复的超图嵌入生成提供了实用方案，在显著提速的同时保持有竞争力的分类与聚类性能。

title: Kernel Singular Value Decomposition with Extension to Multiple Data Sources
summary: Kernel Singular Value Decomposition (KSVD) learns a pair of singular vectors w.r.t. an asymmetric kernel matrix, which can be induced by two data sources, e.g., the queries and keys in self-attention or the rows and columns of a given matrix. In this work, we extend KSVD to multiple data sources, namely eKSVD, which conducts joint nonlinear feature learning upon asymmetric kernels. In the primal formulation, the projections associated with each data source are jointly learned to capture maximal information, while incorporating pair-wise couplings. With the Lagrangian and its Karush-Kuhn-Tucker (KKT) conditions, the optimization in the dual leads to a generalization of the shifted eigenvalue problem in Lanczos decomposition theorem of KSVD. Further, a covariance-based framework is derived together with using neural networks (NNs) for explicit feature mappings, complementary to the kernel-based interpretation and optimization. Numerical experiments verify the effectiveness of our eKSVD compared to methods based on Mercer kernels for tackling multiple data sources, and our innovation of deploying NNs demonstrates great flexibility for kernel methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出eKSVD，将核奇异值分解（KSVD）从单对数据源扩展到多数据源的联合非线性特征学习，通过原始形式、对偶形式与协方差框架分别刻画优化问题，并用神经网络实现显式特征映射。
AI.motivation: KSVD仅能处理由两个数据源（如自注意力中的query与key、矩阵的行与列）诱导的非对称核矩阵，无法对多个数据源进行联合非线性特征学习，因此需要将其推广到多数据源场景。
AI.method: 提出eKSVD：在原始形式中联合学习各数据源的投影以最大化信息并引入成对耦合；借助拉格朗日函数与KKT条件，在对偶中导出KSVD的Lanczos分解定理中移位特征值问题的推广；进一步推导协方差框架，并用神经网络进行显式特征映射，与基于核的解释与优化互补。
AI.result: 数值实验验证了eKSVD相较于基于Mercer核的方法在处理多数据源时的有效性，同时表明引入神经网络为核方法带来了很大的灵活性。
AI.conclusion: eKSVD成功将KSVD推广至多数据源的非线性联合特征学习，兼具核视角与协方差/神经网络视角，在多数据源任务上优于Mercer核方法，并拓展了核方法的灵活性。

title: AdaStep: Adaptive Step Credit Weighting for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
summary: Long-horizon LLM agents are typically trained with sparse outcome rewards, making trajectory-level objectives too coarse to distinguish the contribution of individual decisions. Step-level credit assignment provides finer-grained supervision, but its estimates can be unreliable because observed returns also depend on subsequent actions, environment transitions, and trajectory length. We propose AdaStep, an Adaptive Step-credit weighting method that controls how strongly each group-derived local advantage modifies the trajectory-level signal. We formulate this weighting as a mean-squared-error estimation problem for the latent step advantage and, under an explicit conditional sampling assumption, derive an optimal per-state shrinkage coefficient. The coefficient admits a signal-to-total-variance interpretation: it preserves local credit when return variation is attributable to the selected action and suppresses it when variation is dominated by downstream randomness. AdaStep requires only lightweight scalar computation, with no critic, additional rollouts, or extra model inference. Experiments with three model backbones on ALFWorld, WebShop, and ScienceWorld show consistent improvements over baselines at low computational cost.

AI.tldr: 提出 AdaStep，一种自适应步级信用权重方法，通过最优收缩系数控制组内局部优势对轨迹级信号的修正强度，无需 critic 或额外推理即可提升长程 LLM 智能体性能。
AI.motivation: 长程 LLM 智能体通常仅使用稀疏的结果奖励训练，轨迹级目标过于粗糙，难以区分单个决策的贡献；而步级信用分配虽提供更细粒度监督，但其估计并不可靠，因为观测回报同时受后续动作、环境转移和轨迹长度影响。
AI.method: 将步级优势的加权建模为潜在步优势的均方误差估计问题，在显式的条件采样假设下推导出最优的逐状态收缩系数；该系数具有"信号-总方差"解释，当回报波动可归因于所选动作时保留局部信用，当波动由下游随机性主导时抑制之。仅需轻量标量计算，无需 critic、额外 rollout 或额外模型推理。
AI.result: 在 ALFWorld、WebShop 和 ScienceWorld 三个基准上，使用三种模型骨干进行实验，均以较低计算开销稳定优于基线方法。
AI.conclusion: AdaStep 通过可解释的最优收缩机制有效缓解了步级信用估计的噪声问题，在保持轻量计算的同时提升了长程 LLM 智能体的训练效果。

title: The Neuro-Physical Inverter: A Modular Framework for Magnetotelluric Inversion Coupling Ensemble Conditioning with Residual Learning
summary: We present the Neuro-Physical Inverter (NPI), a modular, uncertainty-aware framework for geophysical inversion that couples ensemble-based conditioning with constrained residual learning, demonstrated in the 1D magnetotelluric (MT) setting as a controlled testbed. The framework operates in two stages. An Ensemble-Conditional Gaussian Process (EnsCGP) conditions a prior ensemble of resistivity models on the observed response, producing a physically admissible reference ensemble. A residual-learning neural network then predicts targeted corrections to this reference, trained on synthetic data and fine-tuned per station for field application through a physics-coupled objective. Because an ensemble is conditioned, refined, and propagated through both stages, every estimate carries an associated ensemble spread. Synthetic experiments show that NPI systematically reduces ensemble-mean error without destabilizing the ensemble. Applied to broadband MT data from the Gabbs Valley geothermal region (Nevada, USA), NPI reduces the across-station mean misfit over the mid-period band while retaining comparable ensemble spread. The propagated ensemble yields a factor of uncertainty that serves as an operational measure of constraint within the assumed model class. Both stages are dimension-agnostic in formulation, and the design principles established here are intended to scale to higher-dimensional parameterizations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出神经-物理反演器（NPI），一种模块化、不确定性感知的地球物理反演框架，将集合条件化与受约束残差学习相结合，在1D大地电磁（MT）场景中验证。框架分两阶段：先用集合条件高斯过程（EnsCGP）将先验电阻率模型集合条件化于观测响应，生成物理可行的参考集合；再用残差学习网络预测针对性修正，并在现场应用中通过物理耦合目标逐台站微调。合成实验表明NPI可稳定降低集合均值误差，应用于Gabbs Valley地热区MT数据时降低了中周期频段跨台站平均失配，同时保持相当集合离散度，其传播集合给出的不确定性因子可作为模型类内约束的操作性度量。
AI.motivation: 传统地球物理反演往往难以兼顾物理可行性与不确定性量化，且神经网络直接预测易破坏集合稳定性。作者希望构建一个模块化、不确定性感知的反演框架，在保持物理约束和集合离散度的同时系统降低反演误差，并为高维参数化提供可扩展的设计原则。
AI.method: NPI为两阶段框架：第一阶段用Ensemble-Conditional Gaussian Process（EnsCGP）将先验电阻率模型集合条件化于观测响应，生成物理可行的参考集合；第二阶段用残差学习神经网络预测对该参考的针对性修正，先以合成数据训练，再通过物理耦合目标函数在现场逐台站微调。集合经条件化、修正并在两阶段中传播，故每个估计均携带集合离散度。
AI.result: 合成实验显示NPI系统性地降低集合均值误差，且不破坏集合稳定性。应用于美国内华达州Gabbs Valley地热区宽带MT数据时，NPI在中周期频段降低了跨台站平均失配，同时保持可比的集合离散度。传播集合导出的不确定性因子可作为假定模型类内约束强度的操作性度量。
AI.conclusion: NPI实现了物理约束与不确定性感知的统一，在1D MT测试台上验证有效；两阶段在形式上均与维度无关，所确立的设计原则有望扩展到更高维参数化。

title: D2K-Bench: Can LLM Agents Turn Expert Designs into Efficient GPU Kernels?
summary: GPU kernels generated by large language model (LLM) agents can remain less efficient than expert implementations, but runtime alone does not reveal how the gap relates to design discovery and implementation. We introduce D2K-Bench, a diagnostic benchmark of 26 tasks and 85 workloads that measures how effectively agents translate expert design guidance into efficient GPU kernels. The guidance covers L1: high-level algorithmic insights, L2: dataflow design, and L3: low-level optimization tricks, including dependencies among these levels. Pairwise runs with and without guidance share task descriptions, workloads, tools, hardware, and a 350-turn budget. Complementary assessments examine independently proposed designs and the design properties implemented in generated code. Across five models on NVIDIA B200 GPUs, guidance raises correctness over 130 model-task pairs from 93.1% to 98.5% and increases the Performance Score over all 26 tasks from 1.46 to 1.95. For the three frontier models with correct submissions on all 26 tasks in both runs (GPT-6-Astra, Claude-Opus-4.8, and GPT-5.6-Sol), geometric mean speedup increases from $1.69\times$ to $2.49\times$. Across all five models, the mean combined implementation score increases from 57 to 70 out of 100. These results show the value of expert design guidance while identifying design properties that remain unimplemented.

AI.tldr: 提出诊断性基准 D2K-Bench，用 26 个任务、85 个工作负载量化 LLM 智能体将专家设计指导转化为高效 GPU kernel 的能力，发现加入分层指导后正确率从 93.1% 提升至 98.5%，性能得分从 1.46 升至 1.95。
AI.motivation: LLM 智能体生成的 GPU kernel 效率常低于专家实现，但仅凭运行时无法揭示性能差距究竟源自设计探索不足还是实现能力不足，缺少可诊断两者关系的评测手段。
AI.method: 构建 D2K-Bench，包含 26 个任务、85 个工作负载；将专家指导分为三层——L1 高层算法洞察、L2 数据流设计、L3 底层优化技巧，并刻画层间依赖关系。采用有无指导的配对实验，两者共享任务描述、工作负载、工具、硬件及 350 轮预算；另设互补评估，考察独立提出的设计方案及生成代码中实际实现的设计属性。在 NVIDIA B200 GPU 上评测五个模型。
AI.result: 在 130 个模型-任务对上，指导使正确率由 93.1% 升至 98.5%；全部 26 个任务的 Performance Score 由 1.46 升至 1.95。对两轮中均全部正确的三个前沿模型（GPT-6-Astra、Claude-Opus-4.8、GPT-5.6-Sol），几何平均加速比由 1.69× 提升至 2.49×；五个模型的平均综合实现得分由 57 分升至 70 分（满分 100）。
AI.conclusion: 结果证实专家设计指导对正确率与性能均有显著增益，同时暴露出部分设计属性仍未被有效实现，说明智能体在将设计意图落地为高效实现方面仍存在可改进空间。

title: Cross-cohort TB classification using clinical data gathered in Uganda and South Africa
summary: We present a first evaluation of machine learning applied to patient clinical and demographic data gathered in two different countries for the purpose of tuberculosis (TB) screening to identify people who would benefit from expensive molecular testing. Experiments are based on the recently-compiled CAGE-TB dataset, which includes sub-cohorts of people with presumptive TB presenting at community health care centres in South Africa and Uganda. Three neural network architectures (logistic regression (LR), multilayer perceptrons (MLP) and convolutional neural networks (CNN)) are considered in conjunction with greedy feature selection. For the convolutional neural network, a strategy that jointly optimises feature selection and feature ordering is proposed and shown to lead to consistent development and test set improvements. For all three models, development set area under the receiver operating characteristic (AUROC) curve is improved by 2-7% using feature selection. LR after feature selection achieves an AUROC of 0.8 [0.75,0.86] (95% CI) and 0.84 [0.78,0.9] when testing on the held-out Ugandan and South African data respectively. Although outperforming LR on the development cohort, the deeper networks (MLP, CNN) show inconsistent trends on the held-out cohorts, while LR achieves performance within 1-2% of the best achieved in terms of AUROC. LR narrowly misses the WHO minimum requirements by 4-9% in sensitivity even though the network is being evaluated on a completely held-out cohort. The development of neural-network based classifiers for TB screening therefore appears viable.

AI.tldr: 该研究基于南非和乌干达的CAGE-TB数据集，首次评估机器学习用于结核病筛查，比较LR、MLP、CNN三种神经网络架构及贪心特征选择，并提出CNN联合优化特征选择与排序的策略。
AI.motivation: 结核病分子检测成本高昂，需借助机器学习从患者临床和人口学数据中筛选出真正受益于昂贵检测的人群，以实现资源优化配置。
AI.method: 采用CAGE-TB数据集（含南非和乌干达社区医疗中心的疑似结核病亚队列），使用LR、MLP、CNN三种架构结合贪心特征选择；针对CNN提出联合优化特征选择与特征排序的策略，并在开发集和测试集上评估AUROC及敏感性。
AI.result: 三种模型经特征选择后开发集AUROC提升2-7%；LR在留出的乌干达和南非数据上AUROC分别为0.80[0.75,0.86]和0.84[0.78,0.9]。深层网络（MLP、CNN）在留出队列上趋势不一致，LR性能与最佳AUROC相差仅1-2%。LR敏感性距WHO最低要求差4-9%。
AI.conclusion: 基于神经网络的结核病筛查分类器是可行的，其中LR在跨队列泛化上表现最稳定。

title: Mapping and Advancing the Scalability-Accuracy Frontier of Nonlinear Causal Discovery
summary: Scalable nonlinear causal discovery requires methods that combine flexible mechanism estimators with efficient search over large graph spaces. Several algorithmic families have been proposed to address this challenge, yet their accuracy-runtime trade-offs remain poorly understood. We empirically compare the four major approaches: differentiable structure learning, amortized structure learning, score-matching, and combinatorial search. Our results reveal complementary bottlenecks: differentiable and amortized methods scale well but exhibit an accuracy gap, score-matching methods can be accurate in low dimensions but degrade quickly for increasing feature sizes, and combinatorial methods remain accurate but are slowed by repeated and redundant local scoring. Motivated by this bottleneck, we develop SPADE, a spline-based score-evaluation scheme that compiles sufficient statistics once and reuses them throughout combinatorial search. Under bounded indegree, its Gaussian variant reduces algorithmic complexity from O(nd^3) to O(nd^2+d^3). Empirically, SPADE shifts the observed scalability-accuracy frontier by orders of magnitude: it solves 100-variable problems with 160K samples in seconds and 1600-variable problems with 2.5K samples in minutes, while retaining high structural accuracy across synthetic and real-world benchmarks.
